70010000076205.name: Vampire: The Masquerade - Reckoning of New York

70010000076207.description:
Froggy Bouncing Adventures is a cute, miniature puzzle platformer starring the eponymous Froggy the Frog.

When Froggy’s buddy, Buzzy, disappears through a mysterious portal, it’s up to our amphibian hero to come to his friend’s rescue. Get ready for 60 levels of jumping and dashing, accompanied by a cozy aesthetic with colorful pixel art and relaxing music. Froggy will need to travel four different biomes with your help!

Can you brave through each level and rescue Buzzy?
How many hats can you unlock?


Features:
* 60 levels split in 4 different biomes
* Pick coins and unlock up to 20 hats for Froggy
* Two difficulty modes, includes checkpoints for easy mode
* Mix of 2D and 3D pixel art aesthetic
* 2D puzzle platformer gameplay
70010000076207.intro: Rescue Froggy’s best friend and get some hats along the way!
70010000076207.name: Froggy Bouncing Adventures

70010000076210.description:
Unlife is a dystopian 2d platformer set in a haunting post-apocalyptic world.

Destroy merciless monsters, salvage weapons and supplies, overcome obstacles, and swim underwater as a necessary means of survival. The genetic material of the killed creatures can help cure the hero of the disease, which will affect the end of the game.

The main character of the game is the last survivor from his floating platform, and he must navigate a submarine towards salvation.

Can you find a cure in time to save yourself?


Features
* 2d platforming gameplay
* Battle dangerous monsters
* Control a submarine
* Dark, haunting atmosphere
* Two different endings
70010000076210.intro: Find salvation in this horrifying post-apocalyptic wasteland
70010000076210.name: Unlife

70010000076213.description:
Run and gun through 7 levels of alien-infested mayhem to save mankind from annihilation!

Shoot enemies with powerful weapons, defeat colossal bosses, and even race to beat your best time in this nostalgic platform shooter. As a human soldier stationed on a military fort in outer space, you must answer the distress signal emanating from a nearby planet.

It’s time to channel your inner heroic retro game commando and obliterate the alien horde!


FEATURES:
* Run & gun combat gameplay
* 7 challenging levels
* Retro game aesthetic
* Epic boss battles
* Speed run mode
70010000076213.intro: Battle your way through alien hordes to save humanity
70010000076213.name: Orion Haste

70010000076216.intro: Who said being a courier is boring? Arrange xtreme city bike races and deliver the order on time!
70010000076216.name: Extreme City Delivery: Bike Ride Simulator

70010000076221.description:
" WAR OF AERO " is a shooter released by ALLUMER in 1992.
The aircraft can be fitted with pods on either side, which can be turned around to shoot up and down.
In addition, when the 1P and 2P aircraft are stacked on top of each other, they merge to create a powerful attack.

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpiece that built a generation for video games.

*This game uses the Japanese ROM for the main part of the game.
The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.
70010000076221.intro: Can you stop this MEIOU project!!
70010000076221.name: Arcade Archives WAR OF AERO

70010000076242.description:
Welcome to feudal Japan, a world of samurai and danger.

Play as a heroic frog samurai tasked with taking down the deadly snake clan and bringing an end to the war. Your agility and speed will be tested as you go over obstacles, walls and ceilings, and navigate through portals.

But be careful, the snakes won't give up without a fight. You'll need to use all your frog skills to defeat them and save your kingdom.

Join the epic battle between frogs and snakes and prove yourself as the ultimate Frogurai!

Features:
* 50 levels and speed run mode
* Puzzle game, move in a single direction until you hit an obstacle
* Cute art and sound
* Fast-paced Samurai action
70010000076242.intro: Prove yourself as the ultimate frog samurai
70010000076242.name: Frogurai

70010000076245.description:
Dive into the exhilarating world of Tennis 2024 Simulator, a cutting-edge 3D game simulator that puts you right on the center court! Take on the role of a rising tennis star and embark on a thrilling journey through various championships, aiming to etch your name in tennis history.

Key Features:

Realistic 3D Gameplay: Immerse yourself in the stunningly realistic 3D graphics that bring every serve, volley, and smash to life. The meticulously crafted environments replicate iconic tennis arenas, providing an authentic tennis experience.

Diverse Player Selection: Choose your playing style from a diverse roster of tennis players, each with unique skills, strengths, and playing strategies. Whether you prefer the power game of a baseline hitter or the finesse of a net player, find the perfect match for your playing style.

Championship Variety: Compete in a series of prestigious championships, ranging from the swift-paced hard courts to the elegant grass of Wimbledon. Each championship offers a unique challenge, demanding strategic thinking and adaptability to different playing surfaces.

Career Mode: Rise through the ranks in an immersive career mode that spans multiple seasons. Train your player, improve skills, and make critical decisions to shape your career trajectory. Experience the highs of Grand Slam victories and the lows of challenging losses.

Multiplayer Battles: Challenge friends or players from around the world in intense multiplayer matches. Showcase your skills, climb the global leaderboards, and establish yourself as the ultimate tennis champion.

Customization: Personalize your player with a range of customizable options, from outfits and equipment to unique playing styles. Make a statement on the court with your distinctive look.

Realistic Physics: The game employs advanced physics to deliver a true-to-life tennis experience. Feel the weight of every shot, the speed of the ball, and the responsiveness of your player as you strive for victory.

Tennis 2024 Simulator is not just a game; it's a tennis extravaganza that invites players to step onto the court and write their own tennis legacy. Are you ready to conquer the Grand Slam titles and become a tennis legend? The court is yours!
70010000076245.intro: Are you ready to conquer the Grand Slam titles and become a tennis legend?
70010000076245.name: Tennis 2024 Simulator

70010000076253.description:
Zombiewood is back and remastered exclusively for Nintendo Switch™.

Zombies have invaded Los Angeles. The once glitzy and lavish streets that were alive with movie stars and celebrities are now overrun with hordes of the undead. For some, this spells terror, fear, panic… infection... But, for others, it’s an opportunity to light up the silver screen, roll camera and call ACTION! Take on the role of a stuntman-turned-action-hero, arm up your arsenal, and make your way to fame through the once-glamorous city now infested with flesh munchers!

KEY FEATURES
MINDLESS SHOOTING ACTION!
Switch your brain off for some cathartic entertainment and fast-paced action. Zap, boil & burn zombies with 30+ wicked 'n' wild weapons.

IMMERSIVE STORYLINE!
Each mission that you encounter is part of the movie-making process. Enjoy Story Mode with 18 different movies and 11 types of missions. Collect enough Reels from each movie to unlock your next blockbuster.

TWO LOCAL CO-OP MODES TO DOUBLE THE FUN!
In addition to playing as a solo zombie slayer, you can also team up with a friend in the Survival Modes to shred through wave after wave of zombies. Load up the gear you acquired from Story Mode in Run 'n' Gun, or try your luck in Loot 'n' Shoot, where you'll wield random weapons.

CUSTOMIZE YOUR STYLE!
Unlock 70+ costumes as you progress through the game. Customize your look to be as glamorous or hilarious as you wish while fighting against the crazy flesh-eating creatures.
70010000076253.intro: SOS: Hollywood becomes a zombie playground! Load up your fire and go solo in a shooting rampage, or team up for explosive co-op fun!
70010000076253.name: Zombiewood: Survival Shooter

70010000076258.description:
Join Spark on his mission to overthrow his rival once again. Blaze through fast action packed stages and experience a new and improved combat system.

The gameplay is a mix of action and platforming in a clever way, taking elements from many games of both genres, you are able to find powers that change the way you play, enjoy great freedom of movement, discover many different ways to beat each stage, and ways to do it faster.
70010000076258.intro:
High speed 3D action platformer!
Join Spark on his latest adventure.
70010000076258.name: Spark the Electric Jester 3

70010000076260.description:
Explore randomly generated card dungeons where you can only move Right and Down, use Dice to defeat mighty enemies, gather powerful artifacts, and learn new abilities! Will you be able to escape from the dungeon?

Each dungeon is randomly generated, so each game is unique! On each turn, the only decision you can make is to go right or down! Explore the card dungeon and fight against mighty enemies, get blessings in the sacred shrines, or buy new powerful artifacts from the shopkeeper!

Each time you move to a new encounter card, you have to use your dice! The battle is divided in turns. In the player's turn, roll the dice and place them on the enemies to defeat them! You can also place the dice in your skills to obtain different effects, like rolling more dice or healing yourself. But be careful, in the enemy's turn they will attack you and activate their skills!

*Unlock 6 heroes with different starting artifacts and skills to create your custom run!
*More than 100 artifacts with a wide variety of effects that you can unlock with every game you play!
*30 different dungeons. Each one adds a new rule to the game and will increase its difficulty!
*Daily Mode with randomly generated conditions!
70010000076260.intro: Explore randomly generated card dungeons where you can only move Right and Down and use Dice to defeat mighty enemies!
70010000076260.name: Right and Down and Dice

70010000076263.description:
Once a loyal knight, betrayed, and banished to the Abyss. A desecrated corpse inside reanimated armor. You rise to an eternal death. Branded KILL KNIGHT, you have one purpose - KILL THE LAST ANGEL.

FIVE ELDRITCH LAYERS
KILL, OR BE KILLED

MASTER THE DEMON WITHIN
Dance with death in the Abyss, and unveil intricate layers of gameplay lurking beneath the surface. Exploit enemy weaknesses, enact brutal executions, weave through your arsenal to tactically manage resources, and unleash destructive wrath blasts to turn the tide. Every encounter is testament to your mastery.

BEAUTY IN DECAY
KILL KNIGHT’s polished, minimalist aesthetic, and retro visuals pay homage to the neon-soaked arcades and shooters of the 90’s. Set across five relentless, hand-crafted eldritch arenas, KILL KNIGHT embraces lo-fi brutalism and revels in the dread and dream-like ruins that surround your descent into the Abyss.

ETERNAL DAMNATION
Survive the otherworldly onslaught and complete challenges to unlock powerful new equipment for your Knight’s Arsenal, and evolve your unique playstyle. Learn to harness the special abilities and fire-modes of KILL KNIGHT’s array of pistols, heavy weapons, swords, and armor. Take your fight to the global leaderboards against friends and foes alike. Enter if you dare, Knight, and revel in the carnage.

FEATURES
- Fast and visceral top-down, push forward combat that rewards aggression and precision
- An immersive otherworld dripping in corrosive atmosphere with a retro-inspired aesthetic
- Descend through five fatal layers, each more deadly than the last
- Choose your challenge, with three distinct difficulty settings to overcome
- Survive long enough to raise your Kill Power, increasing speed and damage
- Complete challenges to unlock your Knight’s Arsenal, and evolve your playstyle
- Dive into Master Mode, combining all five layers into one extended arena challenge
- Ascend the global leaderboards, and compete with friends for high-score supremacy
70010000076263.intro:
Arcade-inspired isometric action shooter.
MASTER THE DEMON WITHIN.
70010000076263.name: KILL KNIGHT

70010000076269.description: Relive the world of "They Always Run" in this collector's audio artbook!
70010000076269.name: Arts from They Always Run

70010000076282.description:
Step into the thrilling world of Gladiatorial Conquest Battle: Arena of Legends, an epic game set in the heart of the Middle Ages where the arena echoes with the clash of swords and the roar of the crowd.

In Campaign mode, players embark on a gripping journey to elevate their gladiator's career, facing a variety of enemies in challenging battles that test their mettle. From one-on-one duels to intense skirmishes against hordes of adversaries, the path to glory is fraught with peril and triumph.

Custom Battle mode provides a sandbox experience, allowing players to curate their own gladiatorial showdowns. Choose your gladiator from a diverse roster, handpick the enemies you wish to face, and select the battleground where legends will be made. Whether it's a dusty Roman colosseum or an ancient amphitheater, every arena has its unique challenges and dangers.

To rise victorious, strategic upgrades are essential.
Customize your gladiator's attributes, enhancing vital stats such as health, stamina, power attack, and speed attack. Unlock new combo attacks that can turn the tide of battle, leaving your foes in awe. The arena is not just a battlefield; it's a proving ground where the mightiest gladiators are forged.
Each victory brings you one step closer to earning the adoration of the crowd and etching your name in the annals of gladiatorial history.

Gladiatorial Conquest Battle: Arena of Legends offers an immersive and challenging experience, combining the thrill of combat with strategic decision-making. Are you ready to embrace the life of a gladiator and carve your legacy in the sands of time? The arena awaits, and destiny calls for those who seek fame, fortune, and the glory of the ultimate warrior.
70010000076282.name: Gladiatorial Conquest Battle: Arena of Legends

70010000076287.description:
Inspired by 1990's cult classic horror movies, Dark Days stands as an adventure horror game of its own. From an eerie motel to a haunted desert, solve puzzles and progress towards a disturbing truth. Dive in an American nightmare, immerse yourself in cinematographic environments, but be careful and think smart! Something is hunting you. There's only one rule: if you look at it, this nightmare kills.

- A Psychological Creepy Horror Game
- A first person point'n’click adventure
- An atmospheric and haunted escape room game
- 4h+ of gameplay with 20 secret tapes to find and randomized puzzles
- 2 different endings
70010000076287.intro: A Supernatural Thriller from the Makers of 'White Night' and “Under The Waves”.
70010000076287.name: Dark Days

70010000076293.description:
Embark on a journey in search of Wira and Taksa’s Master. Harness the power of gravity to your advantage and overcome dangers on your way in this arcade platformer mixed with puzzle elements.


TWO PLAYABLE CHARACTERS
The titular character Wira is a powerful warrior wielding a massive hammer capable of defeating enemies standing in the way. On the other hand, Taksa is characterized by extraordinary speed and agility. It allows him to evade traps and overcome various time-based challenges.


CHALLENGING JOURNEY
Wira and Taksa share the same life pool. If you run out of lives, the level will restart. Keep an eye out for life tokens along your journey to increase the number of your attempts. Remember that monsters inflict minor damage, while traps such as spikes or flames will defeat the heroes instantly.


DIVERSE LOCATIONS
As you progress through the levels you will discover the variety of locations. The calm forests will transform into fiery landscapes, and then they will be shrouded in darkness. Each one contains a different set of traps and obstacles. Switch your character based on the situation and adapt yourself to the current objective.
70010000076293.name: Wira & Taksa: Against the Master of Gravity

70010000076301.description:
Embark on an unforgettable journey in a charming 2D adventure that follows the courageous Henry as he endeavors to save a once-thriving kingdom from corruption. Join forces with the pint-sized hero as he takes on a nefarious dragon and its bandit minions in an epic quest for justice and redemption.

1- Dynamic 2D Platforming Action:
Experience classic 2D platforming with a modern twist. Guide Henry through intricately designed levels filled with challenges, secrets, and heart-pounding moments as he battles the corruption that threatens the realm.

2- Whimsical Pixel Art:
Immerse yourself in a visually enchanting world with charming pixel art that brings Tiny Knight Henry and his adversaries to life. Explore diverse landscapes, from lush forests to treacherous mountain passes, each filled with detail and personality.

3. Epic Boss Fights:
Each boss possesses a diverse and awe-inspiring arsenal of attacks. From devastating melee strikes to long-range projectiles, you'll need to stay nimble and use your wits to survive the onslaught and find openings to strike back.


Join Tiny Knight Henry on an unforgettable adventure filled with laughter, courage, and a quest for justice...

Small in size, mighty in heart..
70010000076301.intro: Kingdom of Corrupts is a 2d side scroller adventure game. The game tells the story of a kingdom ruined by the invasive efforts of bandits and dragon. Henry our hero, embarks on an adventur
70010000076301.name: Kingdom of Corrupts

70010000076308.description:
Gameplay
Combo attack battle action adventure game.
This is an action game where the player becomes a new member of the Metaverse and defeats enemies who are garbage information on the internet. Experience interesting things in chaotic servers and use your gamepad to carry out your "justice".
Learn various skills by clearing stages, and use a variety of combo attacks with over 20 unique skill combinations to annihilate your enemies and clear the stage!
You can also purchase items that allow you to gain special abilities as you progress through the stages. Buffs (items) allow you to use unique abilities such as damaging enemies all over the map or speeding up to advance the battle to your advantage.
Uppercut! Tornado whirlwind shot! Show the swarming enemies which one is more durable: the head or the gamepad!

Story
A story that unfolds in a deserted Metaverse, moderators abusing their power, owners doing whatever they want, generation gaps, and counterattacks by old members... Players who are newcomers will be able to relive the feelings of the members. However, I will stand up to overthrow the tyranny of moderators and server owners!
70010000076308.intro: At that time, the internet was definitely our place... Let's protect the memories of that time!
70010000076308.name: Internet Generation

70010000076313.description:
Love Language Stories is a romantic and educational game that immerses you in the complexities of relationships with 5 unique and charming characters. Your goal is to conquer hearts, unlock dates and uncover the mysteries of emotional connection.

With a love meter, every choice shapes the plot and brings you closer to or further from 10 different endings. More than a dating sim, it’s an educational experience that helps you understand emotions and develop interpersonal skills.

Dive into the universe of romance and learn valuable lessons about love and relationships in Love Language Stories.

Features:
● 5 unique characters with their own romantic stories
● A love meter that reacts to your decisions
● 10 different endings depending on your choices
● A romantic and educational experience about emotional connection

Will you dare to conquer hearts and discover the true language of love?
70010000076313.intro: Conquer hearts and unlock 10 endings in an unforgettable love story.
70010000076313.name: Love Language Stories

70010000076324.description:
Super XYX is a vertical scrolling shoot’em up presented in eye-scorchingly fluid pixel art animation. Choose from 6 unique pilots and their signature ships, each with unique shots and bombs, and blast off to face The Black Serpent’s forces head-on! Master 6 stages with screen-filling bosses, customize the experience with various difficulty settings and unlock alternate game modes as you progress!

Features:

• Master 6 vertical scrolling stages of bullet hell action!
• Choose from multiple pilots with unique spacecraft and weaponry.
• Blast through enemy swarms and screen-filling bosses!
• Unlock new playable characters and game modes.
• Collect medals for huge score bonuses.
• Achieve combos by destroying targets in quick succession!
70010000076324.intro: Defend humanity against the destroyer of worlds in retro shoot’em up style!
70010000076324.name: Super XYX

70010000076329.description:
TP Bullet is a puzzle platform game where you need to shoot your one shot to solve each puzzle and clear the level.

As a secret agent marksman, you are the only hope against the evil Skeleton King and his minions who attack the city. A kindly witch gives you an enchanted bullet which allows you to teleport so you can retrieve the ancient magic coins to defeat the villains.

Jump, shoot, and block your way to victory over 40 amazing and addictive levels.


Features:
* Puzzle platform gameplay
* Unique 2D teleport mechanic
* Catchy 8-Bit music
* Cute pixel art
* 40 levels
70010000076329.intro: Use your enchanted bullet to clear each level and save the city!
70010000076329.name: TP Bullet

70010000076332.description:
Super Destronaut Landed X Loaded is a 2D arcade with intense, addictive arena-based gameplay.

Battle for as long as possible in 10 different arenas, each with its own unique set of challenges. Shoot down enemy combatants, and gain special power-up drones that add extra firepower to your side. How long can you survive?

If you love 2D arcades then you will love Super Destronaut Landed X Loaded!


Features:
* Classic arcade gameplay
* Multiple enemies and allies
* Neon inspired retro graphics
	* Catchy music
70010000076332.intro: How long can you survive in this hostile robot arena?
70010000076332.name: Super Destronaut Landed X Loaded

70010000076335.description:
The most atmospheric jigsaw puzzle game ever has come back!

- 24 different jigsaw puzzles to complete
- Each puzzle with 12, 24, 48, 96, 192 and 384 pieces
- Save/load progress!
- Highly replayable, hours of gameplay
- The most atmospheric game of its genre
- Two alternative evil voices, male/female for commentary
- Optional against time and no-cheat game modes
- Great soundtrack and effects
- Gallery for completed portraits
- Different backgrounds
70010000076335.intro: Assemble your way through the murky portraits of Dark Fantasy Epic!
70010000076335.name: Dark Fantasy Epic Jigsaw Puzzle

70010000076340.description:
Axis Football 2024 features fluid simulation gameplay, endless customization, and the industry's best franchise mode.

New Gameplay Features In Axis Football 2024:
Completely overhauled blocking system, featuring over 75 types of blocking interactions
Resume a saved match! You can now save a match in progress and return to it later
Defensive playbook overhaul. Over 25 new defensive formations and over 100 defensive plays
New zone coverage types and defensive zone priorities added
Game difficulty overhaul to ensure each user has an appropriately challenging play experience
Player attribute changes to better reflect the complexities of American football
Base team roster reset to better balance the default teams
Two new stadiums: Las Vegas and Louisiana
In-match UI update (stylized score bug, redesigned playbook display and more)
New statistics and data analytic tracking for play calling to analyze what is and is not working
Improved gameplay presentation, featuring previous play displays, starting lineups, and an improved 'Ask Coach' flow
Bug fixes from previous versions

New Customization Features In Axis Football 2024:
Playbook Editor - select the specific plays you want included in your playbooks
User-created teams can now be deleted
Dozens of new logos added to the team creator suite

New Franchise Mode Features In Axis Football 2024:
New league sizes available. American-style leagues: 32, 24, 16, and 8 teams. Tier-style leagues: (36, 30, 24, and 18 teams)
Team Activity Menu that tracks all signings, drafts, trades, contract extensions, and releases for all teams across the league.
Better AI team management (signing free agents during the year, better draft logic, etc.)

Miscellaneous New Features in Axis Football 2024:
QB Run plays have been added as a new category when selecting the play calling weights
When editing attributes in the Player Editor, you will now find both a +1/-1 and a +10/-10 button
A notification at the top of the franchise dashboard will now appear whenever there are unsaved changes to a user’s franchise.
The schedule generator has been rewritten to produce more consistent and league-appropriate schedules.
Players that were injured in positions that are considered secondary starters (WR4, WR5, TE2, etc.) will no longer incorrectly make their way onto the field.
Injuries and roster changes made to teams during exhibition matches will no longer carry over into new franchises.
The depth chart will now show all available players that match the selected position at the top of the substation list rather than sorting the list solely on the OVR rating, regardless of the player’s position
Automatic substations due to fatigue or injury will no longer place players outside of their position group

Full Franchise Mode Features:
Multiple league setup options (NFL-style, Tier style)
All-time record tracking
Player Contracts
Trades
Injuries
Practice Squads
Free Agency
Retiring Players
Weekly and Yearly Awards
Dynamic, tiered league structure with playoffs, promotions, and relegations
Unlimited seasons
Player progressions based on performance, age, potential, and playtime
End of season drafts
Season-long team stats
Individual league leader stats
Franchise stats
Depth chart control
Play, coach, spectate, or simulate matches
League and team schedule viewer
Spectate other matches

Customization:
Complete team creator / editor suite
Customize team name, colors, uniforms, field, play selection, logo, and more!

Game Modes:
Player Vs AI
Coach Mode (1p & 2p)
Spectator Mode
Local Player Vs Player
Franchise Mode
70010000076340.intro: Axis Football is a simulation-style football game featuring the industry's best franchise mode, massive customization, and realistic gameplay.
70010000076340.name: AXIS FOOTBALL 2024

70010000076344.description:
Enter the hauntingly beautiful shadow world of In His Time, a 2D puzzle-solving adventure game. There you will meet Olly and join him to solve puzzles throughout each step of his emotional journey of growth and self-discovery.
I can't see them anymore. But I really wish that I could see and hold them again. Where is my special person? I wonder if I will ever meet them again. "In His Time" is a 2D mystery-solving adventure game that faces these feelings.
The main character Olly, a young boy who lost his father early, lives with his mother Lyla. His mother has recently become ill, so he is left to attend school and take care of the housework.
Even at school, Olly is bullied by Bobby the big kid, and his cronies Mila and Hugo. He is also scolded by his teachers every day....... It was as if the world was pushing Ollie into a corner.
One day Olly is threatened by Bobby and his friends and together they sneak into a spooky mansion. They steal "parts" of a certain work and escape, only to be caught by the owner of the house - an old man named Joseph. Joseph, who claims to be a watchmaker, asks Olly what happened to him and says he won't do anything bad to Olly if he gets the "parts" back from Bobby and his friends.
Will Olly be able to reconcile with Bobby and the others? What will happen to his mother? And who is Joseph? Olly's adventure begins. We hope you will join us to see how it ends and how he develops!
70010000076344.intro: For those of you who are unable to see their loved ones ever again.
70010000076344.name: In His Time

70010000076349.description:
The action takes place in Fochougny, a very quiet French village where the billionaire Harpagon Lonion lives. He regularly dresses up as Superfluous, a very useless superhero in such a peaceful countryside...

Helped by his assistant Sophie, who tries to somehow temper the enthusiasm of her employer, he will try to put his hands on the mysterious apple thief who terrorizes the orchards of Fochougny...

 - Can you identify this offender?
 - Will you finally discover a criminal of your caliber?
 - Will you find him in this charming village?

FEATURES

 - Immerse yourself in a colorful universe in the style of a 2D cartoon
 - Wander quietly through the village of Fochougny, an open world
 - Solve puzzles, find secret codes, pick up items, combine them, talk to people from Fochougny to try to figure out what happened
 - Enjoy finely cut dialogues and omnipresent humor (the quality of the jokes is non-contractual)
 - Relax playing a game where you can't lose, die or get stuck (but where you can to tear your hair out trying to solve some puzzles - hair implants are not provided)
 - Play at your own pace: with or without hints to help you progress
 - Text dialogues available in English, French and Italian
70010000076349.intro: The unnecessary video game of the useless superhero
70010000076349.name: Superfluous Returnz

70010000076351.description:
"Exvania " is an action game released by NAMCO (Bandai Namco Entertainment) in 1992.
The objective is to explode the orb, defeat other rivals, and rescue Princess Electra who is stuck in the final stage.
Break the treasure chests and take the items that come out to strengthen yourself and give yourself a leg up on your rivals.

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpiece that built a generation for video games.

*This game uses the Japanese ROM for the main part of the game.
The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.
70010000076351.intro:
Use orbs to annihilate your enemies! !
Capture a lot of castles and rescue Princess Electra!
70010000076351.name: Arcade Archives Exvania

70010000076356.description:
"EMERALDIA" is a puzzle action game released by NAMCO (Bandai Namco Entertainment) in 1993.
The falling cubes can be crashed by dropping them twice with the same color and bumping them together.
The game has three modes: adventure mode to enjoy the story, normal mode to enjoy the puzzles, and head-to head play mode.

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpiece that built a generation for video games.

The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.
70010000076356.name: Arcade Archives EMERALDIA

70010000076361.description:
"NUMAN ATHLETICS" is an sports game released by NAMCO (Bandai Namco Entertainment) in 1993.
Choose one of the four superhumans [Newman] and win a total of 8 types of competitions.
Each competition has a NEED value, and unless you exceed that record, you will not be able to clear the competition and move on to the next competition.

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpiece that built a generation for video games.

*The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.

* There are some scenes with intense blinking, because we respect the original and reproduce it as it is.
Please make the room bright and keep away from the screen while playing the game.
70010000076361.name: Arcade Archives NUMAN ATHLETICS

70010000076366.description:
Start your space expedition with Swing by - a game that will test your skills and reflexes! Become a master of spaceship control as you race through endless space. Your task is simple but challenging: collect valuable gems and win prizes while skillfully maneuvering through space.

*2D and 3D Game view*
Choose your gaming style between 2D and 3D perspectives. Experience the game in the way that suits you best.

*Split screen*
Multiplayer is supported, only in local split screen mode up to 4 players can play together.

*Gems and Ranks*
Collect gems to unlock new levels and spaceships. Each level brings new challenges and exciting rewards for you to discover.

*Various Spaceships*
Unlock different spaceships to customize your gaming experience. Each ship has its own special characteristics.
70010000076366.intro: Spin your ship around planets, collect as many valuable prizes as possible, and play solo or with up to 4 players. It's super fun either way!
70010000076366.name: Swing By

70010000076373.description:
Dreyer Crowley has a tough time growing up: he loses his parents and ends up in an orphanage.
As Dreyer grows older, he decides to put an end to an endless streak of bad luck and restore his family's reputation.
But there's one problem: Dreyer's out of luck.
Desperate, he decides to make a deal with Fortuna: infinite luck in exchange for loving hearts.
Beatrice and Franz are Dreyer's next targets.
Solve tricky puzzles, outwit the villain's henchmen, and save the lovebirds.

Now the game is on!
70010000076373.intro: Save your soulmate from Fortuna's grasp.
70010000076373.name: Connected Hearts: Fortune Play Collector's Edition

70010000076378.description:
"Santa's Workshop Challenge: The North Pole Gift Adventure" is an enchanting video game that takes players on a magical journey through the unexplored stories of Santa Claus. Designed as an interactive storybook, this game reveals never-before-told secrets and anecdotes about the iconic character. Each story is a mix of fantasy and reality, offering a unique insight into the adventures and challenges that Santa Claus faces.

· Discover the secrets of Santa Claus and what happens after Christmas at the North Pole.

· Discover what the life of elves, reindeer, fairies and what Santa Claus's workshop is like.

· More than 100 full color images

· 18 Classic Christmas Songs.

· +8000 words in 17 stories.

The game is packed with vivid, detailed illustrations, making each story a visually stunning experience. Readers will immerse themselves in diverse settings, from the toy workshop at the North Pole to exotic locations around the world, each with its own charm and mystery.

The soundtrack is another gem of this game, with melodies that capture the essence of Christmas and the magic of Santa Claus stories. Each musical track perfectly accompanies the narratives, enriching the gaming experience and transporting players to a world of wonder and joy.

"Santa's Workshop Challenge: The North Pole Gift Adventure" is not only a story to enjoy during the holiday season, but it is also a timeless experience that will delight readers of all ages, filling them with wonder, laughter, and maybe even a new perspective on the legendary Santa Claus.
70010000076378.intro: Discover unpublished and magical stories of Santa Claus, with beautiful illustrations and enchanting music. It's an interactive Christmas adventure for all ages.
70010000076378.name: Santa's Workshop Challenge: The North Pole Gift Adventure

70010000076392.description:
Make your grandma proud in Tokyo Cooking! Run your own restaurant and prepare the most iconic Japanese dishes. Take orders from customers, prepare their meals with passion and listen to their opinions to become better and better with each passing day.


DO THE COOKING BY THE BOOK…
Your kitchen has all the necessary equipment and ingredients you will need to prepare the most delicious sushi. Follow and complete each step from your to-do list while choosing from many available kinds of fish, vegetables and spices and adding them depending on the client's wish.


…AND CUSTOMIZE TO YOUR HEART’S CONTENT
Earn money from the orders and customize the interior of your Japanese restaurant in Tokyo Cooking. At the end of each day, you will have access to your laptop, where you can browse through equipment you can purchase for your place. Enjoy new chairs, tables, plants and utensils.

Become a master of composing the perfect sushi. Be precise and use the exact amount of ingredients such as soy sauce or rice. Complete mini-games to receive extra money as a bonus for your order.


KEY FEATURES:
- You can learn to make your own sushi!
- A total of 32 unique ingredients like fish, vegetables that NEVER run out
- Step-by-step recipes
- Interesting customers
- Day/night system and access to laptop after work
- 6 unique sushi recipes like Hosomaki or Uramaki and relaxing tea
70010000076392.intro: Run the best sushi restaurant in the city, talk to customers and learn new recipes.
70010000076392.name: Tokyo Cooking

70010000076397.description:
The cat, named serious Sam, is very upset when the house is in order and everything is in its place.
Help Sam get inner peace. The main task of the game is to spoil the life of the residents of the house. Playing as a cat, you will need to destroy everything around and not get caught by the owners of the house. Improvise, think over your moves in advance
Features of the game
	•	16 levels (we are sure you will not be able to pass all the levels from 1 time).
	•	Colorful graphics.
	•	Funny pranks (we broke our heads here while we came up with everything).
	•	Some levels are very difficult (test your strength).
	•	All this with cheerful music!
70010000076397.intro: Embrace chaos, mischief, and guide Serious Sam to his purr-fect inner peace in this feline quest for household mayhem.
70010000076397.name: Bad Cat Sam Simulator

70010000076403.description:
Our clever cat detective is back, and this time, the mystery unfolds throughout the entire flat. Dive into an extended adventure filled with captivating challenges, vibrant colours, and puzzles that tickle the brain.
Sherlock Purr 2 is an enchanting children's game, tailor-made for young explorers who adore cats and crave delightful mysteries. Join our whiskered hero, explore every nook and cranny, and embark on a meow-velous journey where every corner holds a delightful surprise.
70010000076403.intro: Get ready for a fur-tastic sequel with Sherlock Purr 2!
70010000076403.name: Sherlock Purr 2

70010000076408.description:
Musashi vs Cthulhu (or MxC) is a fast paced action game where you take control of Musashi - the most famous warrior from feudal Japan -,as he’s fighting for his life.

The ronin is a victim of a terrible curse that makes him a target for unspeakable monsters. In each match, hordes of monsters spawns endlessly and attack until there's no one standing.

The enemies comes from both sides of the screen and must be attacked with precise blows to bulging weak spots shown in their bodies. Challenge your friends to see who is the coldest and most precise warrior, even when facing impossible odds.

- Frenetic gameplay that will require both your attention and reflexes
- 5 different enemies to know and master
- Challenge your friends in weekly, monthly and all time Leaderboards
70010000076408.name: Musashi vs Cthulhu

70010000076425.description:
Self-Delusion is a first-person survival horror in the original setting of Slavic fairy tales. You will faces such unique monsters like: Kolobok, Leshy, Boggart, Lapot and other creepy creatures. Explore, hide or run. Just don't get devoured by them.

Features:

- Horror in the original setting
Monsters unique to the horror genre, only found in fairytales and folklore up 'til now.

- Opponents with unique abilities and behavior pattern
Find your survival strategy based on the behavior of the monsters and the environment.

- Atmosphere
Tense atmosphere complete with jump scares and heart hammering races to beat the clock.

- Exploring
Explore a strange village house and other locations. Can you uncover the secrets of these places?

- Different endings
Alternate endings that shed new insight on the story and add hours of re-playability.

- Story
An enthralling storyline that will leave you gasping in shock and on the edge of your seat.

- Complexity
Choose the game difficulty that suits you best, depending on your skills.

As you could have guessed the main goal is surviving. Sounds pretty easy, but do not delude yourself. The situation will change every second and the monsters have no mercy for you.
70010000076425.intro: These monsters have no mercy for you...
70010000076425.name: Self-Delusion

70010000076446.description:
Yuko Aso is an average high school student who becomes a Warrior of Valis. Her mission is to destroy Rogles, the ruler of Vecanti, and his four lackeys. She must also reclaim the five Fantasm Jewels.
The first game of the series was released in 1986.
70010000076446.intro: The legend of the Valis Warrior begins here.
70010000076446.name: VALIS: The Fantasm Soldier (PC-88)

70010000076450.description:
The main character, Yuko, while guided by the unfathomable power of Valis, becomes a dream warrior and embarks on an adventure in the Dream World!
In order to rescue the Dream Princess Valia, who was captured by the Demon Lord Rogles!
This title has stronger action RPG elements than other versions due to the use of a multi-ending system and complex maps.
70010000076450.intro: Will you be able to see the true last scene?!
70010000076450.name: VALIS: The Fantasm Soldier (Family Computer)

70010000076454.description:
Just when Yuko has returned to a normal life after saving the Dream World from the clutches of Rogles's demons, she is told by Reiko, her former classmate and best friend after many battles, of a new threat from the Cruel King Megas. While still confused by this new threat, she decides to fight again of her own volition.
The costume changing system that changes Yuko's performance depending on her costume was a hit with players.
70010000076454.name: VALIS: The Fantasm Soldier II (MSX2)

70010000076458.description:
Along with the Dream World and the Human World, the Dark World is one of the three worlds created by the gods. Now it was faced with an unprecedented crisis. The king of the Dark World, Glames, has begun an invasion of the Dream World in order to ensure the survival of his own race...
Yuko is informed of Vecanti's crisis by the demon girl Cham. Once again, she takes the Valis Sword in hand and decides to fight...
70010000076458.name: VALIS III (MEGA DRIVE)

70010000076465.description:
Ooga is a friendly bearded caveman living his peaceful life during the stone age. Until one day, his beloved grandfather, Booga, is abducted for ransom by a gang of bandits.

Our hero must defeat the evil bandit cavemen and free his beloved grandfather. Jump, dodge traps, and climb ladders. Crush dinosaurs with jumps and obtain primitive projectile weapons. Battle challenging bandit bosses. Collect coins to spend in the shop and level up.

The charming nostalgia of Caveman Ransom is enough to fondly take you back in time to long-lost era of gaming.


Features:
* 16-bit style platformer
* 50 levels
* 5 bosses
* Multiple weapons and items
70010000076465.name: Caveman Ransom

70010000076475.description: Slimeboo is a simple and fun platformer game that is perfect for children of all ages. The game is controlled with a single button, making it accessible to even the youngest players.
70010000076475.intro: Boo, a small and adorable slime, has gotten lost on a tropical island. To find his way home, he must leap over all the obstacles in his path. Help him overcome them! Good luck!
70010000076475.name: Slimeboo

70010000076480.description:
Embark on an epic odyssey in this Labyrinth of Legends : Roguelike Battle Quest adventure where every step leads to new challenges and encounters. Traverse diverse and visually stunning locations, each presenting its own set of enemies to overcome. As the protagonist, you wield a vast array of skills, each a testament to your mastery of elemental forces—harness the fluidity of water, the agility of air, and the destructive power of fire.

Every confrontation becomes an opportunity for growth as you learn and unlock new skills during gameplay. The dynamic skill progression system allows you to tailor your abilities to suit your playstyle, providing a deeply personalized gaming experience.

At the culmination of each chapter, face the ultimate test by confronting powerful main bosses. Your acquired skills will be put to the ultimate test as you strive to emerge victorious against these formidable adversaries.

Adding a strategic layer to your journey, defeating enemies rewards you with poison bottles, each carrying distinct effects. Choose wisely between health poison, mana poison, and others, adapting your strategy based on the situation at hand.

The game's cool and beautiful locations not only enhance the visual appeal but also contribute to the immersive atmosphere, making every moment of your Labyrinth of Legends : Roguelike Battle Quest adventure a memorable experience. Are you ready to explore, adapt, and conquer the ever-evolving world that awaits you? The challenge begins now!
70010000076480.name: Labyrinth of Legends: Roguelike Battle Quest

70010000076484.description:
Astoundingly simple and exciting every time: Who will be the first to arrange four of their chips in a row – vertically, horizontally or diagonally? Block your opponent and draw them into your trap. But be careful not to fall into a trap yourself.
Entertaining brain training for two bright minds!

• Simple rules
• Exciting tactics
• Choice of different settings
• For 1 to 2 players
70010000076484.intro: Everybody knows it, everybody loves it!
70010000076484.name: 4 in a row

70010000076490.description:
You are a butler, a loyal servant bound by vampire blood.

Unfortunately, after long years asleep in a coffin, your vampire mistress shrank to child-size form! In this condition, she's too weak to protect you.

Train the Little Mistress in skills so she can bite her way through obstacles
She might hunt criminals for their blood, become a celebrity and feed on her fans, raise a dark army to threaten the world, or many other possible outcomes!

Can you help her to rebuild her strength before your time runs out?
Will you make her a benevolent leader or a monster?

Your choices will shape the vampire's personality and determine the future that you share.


Features:
* Visual novel
* Stat-raising gameplay. Balance the vampire's schedule to train skills and earn gold.
* Multiple jobs, activities, and skills to increase
* Hunt targets to feed on in RPG minigame
* Over twenty different endings
70010000076490.name: Cute Bite

70010000076492.description:
Are you a speed lover and crave extreme racing? Then Hot Rider is for you!

Race on the highway, accelerate like a beast, test your car's capabilities, and dodge traffic like a pro. The better your performance, the more money you'll earn to spend on cool upgrades and new cars!

Feel the wind in your hair and enjoy the adrenaline rush with an electrifying soundtrack!
Track your progress with points, speed, distance, and high-speed records to become the ultimate champion.

Game features:
	•	Upgrade every vehicle: Improve the engine, brakes, handling, and appearance.
	•	Incendiary soundtrack: Feel the power of the music driving you to victory.
	•	4 game modes: One-way race, two-way race, time attack, and bomb mode.
	•	3 weather conditions: Choose your favorite - day, night, or rain.
	•	2 locations: Conquer the city or the vast desert.
	•	Leaderboards: Compete with other players for the top spot.
	•	8 unique cars: Find your perfect ride.

Ready to conquer the track?
70010000076492.intro: Fuel your need for speed. Take the lead and leave the rest in the dust.
70010000076492.name: Hot Rider Racing Simulator

70010000076508.description:
Lena, the strongest girl in the resistance, challenges their king, Gallagher, who intends to conquer the world, to a battle using the Valis Sword.
There are seven stages in total, including the Dream World battlefield, the ruins of Vanity Castle, the Hanging Gardens of Babylon, and Valhalla. Enemy attacks change depending on the difficulty level, so you can enjoy the game multiple times.
70010000076508.intro: A Demon Horde appears from the Red Moon. The bell of battle rings...
70010000076508.name: SUPER VALIS IV

70010000076514.description:
"Tutankham" is an action game released by KONAMI in 1982.
Built 4,500 years ago, the grand pyramids have labyrinthine interiors that are said to conceal countless treasures.
Use your horizontal-firing lasers and powerful flash bombs to fight through the enemies and make your way into the depths of the pyramids!

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpiece that built a generation for video games.

*The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.
70010000076514.intro: Seek out the lost treasure of Tutankham!
70010000076514.name: Arcade Archives Tutankham

70010000076541.description: Welcome to the kingdom of Brie: the tiniest land in the world ruled by the mouse king Oliver. Hidden deep in the foliage of the forest, between the blades of grass and mushrooms, there's a place where tiny people coexist with animals. Our little hero Max suddenly interrupts the search for his father when he is called home to help his mother save his childhood home. His only hope is to win a prize in a tournament, but as it turns out this is just the beginning of an epic adventure. Can he become a champion of the kingdom and discover the reason for a deadly drought that endangers everyone? Help Max to unravel mysteries, find clues in hidden objects and defeat all puzzles that stand in his path.  Follow the tiny man on an dangerous quest to discover a well-kept secret which, if revealed, could shake the very foundation of the kingdom of Brie. Become the hero and write your own chapter in Tiny Tales: Heart of the Forest.
70010000076541.name: Tiny Tales: Heart of The Forest

70010000076547.description:
Prepare for an epic tower defense showdown as you defend your planet against waves of incoming robot invaders! Strategically place powerful turrets armed with lasers, plasma balls, rockets, and more along the pathway connecting your planet to the enemy's.

Lead an army of diverse robots, each with its specialized weaponry and tactics. From sleek drones to hulking tanks and towering walkers, every unit brings a unique edge to the battlefield. Unleash laser-guided rockets, and beware colossal big bosses armed with plasma cannons. The fate of your planet hangs in the balance as you repel the metallic invaders and secure victory.

Across multiple stages featuring diverse planets and formidable robot races, the challenge intensifies. Quick reflexes and cunning strategy will be your greatest assets as you fend off increasingly formidable waves of invaders and unleash devastating attacks on the enemy world.

Enhance your defenses by upgrading turrets, unlocking new and more powerful options to repel the robotic threat. With vibrant graphics, addictive gameplay, and a cast of charming characters, this captivating tower defence game promises hours of entertainment for players of all ages. Get ready to defend your planet and launch an epic counter-offensive against the metallic threat!

Features
• Place turrets
• Deploy robot defenders
• Epic battles
• Three levels of difficulty
• Full controller support
• Touch Support
70010000076547.intro: Robots are invading – it's time to fight back! Build defences, lead armies, and defend your planet in this action-packed tower defence saga!
70010000076547.name: Cosmic Robots

70010000076549.description: True Fear: Forsaken Souls - Part 3 concludes the acclaimed thriller trilogy with gripping point-and-click mechanics, challenging puzzles, and a haunting atmosphere. Uncover answers, confront the Stonehouse family’s demon, and experience an unforgettable horror finale.
70010000076549.intro: True Fear: Forsaken Souls - Part 3 is the final part of one of the best-rated horror escape games.
70010000076549.name: True Fear: Forsaken Souls - Part 3

70010000076554.description:
Use your blunderbus to launch yourself from platform to platform, taking down enemies in graceful bullet-time aerial battles! Hone your skills and unlock even tougher encounters!

Monstrously privileged
The French aristocracy have morphed into an army of bile-spewing zombies. Take down gigantic bosses and uncover a plot against France herself!

Explore la Bastille
Storm your way through the sprawling Bastille prison complex, gathering parts to build yourself an airship. Discover secrets in shadowy corners and unlock new content.

Features:
-Thrilling hack’n’slash and bullet-time combat!
-A sprawling map full of secrets!
-Monstrous zombie bossfights!
-Test your blade and unlock tougher challenges!
-Fluency in French not required, just revolutionary spirit!
70010000076554.intro: A fast-paced, bullet-time action-platformer with speedrunning and revolutionary flair.
70010000076554.name: Sacre Bleu

70010000076560.description:
After millions played the first 3 parts of "Croc's World" it´s now time for "Croc's World 4"!
"Croc's World 4" is a classical platformer with a lot of new enemies and new twists!

It features:
+ 60 incredible levels on 4 islands!
+ 2 new characters to play: Kangaroo "Roodie" and "Baby Croc"
+ 2 new vehicles: submarine and helicopter
+ Nice graphics!
+ 6 different themes!
+ Many challenging enemies
+ 4 evil endbosses
70010000076560.name: Croc's World 4

70010000076566.description:
"VOLFIED" is a line-drawing action puzzle game released by TAITO in 1989.
Pilot the Monotros to drive out the aliens from your home world using the ship’s laser to take back the captured territory.
Retake 80% of a stage to win, but be careful the enemies do not come into contact with your ship or incomplete lines while your barrier is off.

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpiece that built a generation for video games.

*This game uses the Japanese ROM for the main part of the game.
The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.
70010000076566.intro:
Cut through the field!
Capture the enemy's energy!!
70010000076566.name: Arcade Archives VOLFIED

70010000076571.description:
" SURPRISE ATTACK " is an action game released by KONAMI in 1990.
Recover the space station, shuttle, and moon base from the forces of " BLACK DAWN ", an international terrorist group that threatens the universe.
The stage is cleared when all the bombs in the stage are recovered and the final location is reached.
After defeating the stage's boss, there is a bonus quiz, and if you answer correctly, you will receive bonus points.

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpiece that built a generation for video games.
70010000076571.intro:
Recover the moon base taken over
by an international terrorist group!!
70010000076571.name: Arcade Archives SURPRISE ATTACK

70010000076576.description:
"RASTAN SAGA" is an action game released by TAITO in 1987.
Control the main character, Rastan the thief, and defeat the rampaging dragon in return for the kingdom of Ceim’s treasures!
Jump and slash with your sword to advance through the stages, taking advantage of weapons, armor, and items along the way.

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpiece that built a generation for video games.

*The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.
70010000076576.intro: Save the kingdom of Ceim from the monstrous dragon!
70010000076576.name: Arcade Archives RASTAN SAGA

70010000076582.description:
The Vale is an audio-based action adventure game that places you in the worn leather boots of a blind adventurer.

Features:

5 hours+ gameplay.
Specialized 3D audio provide an incredibly immersive game experience
Action-adventure with RPG elements: Choose equipment, play-style, magic abilities, companions and quests.
Emotionally engaging story, quality sound design and voice performance.
Fully blind accessible
Headphones recommended for best experience

Story:

As your elder brother takes his place on the throne, you are made warden of a small castle on the outskirts of the kingdom. Blind from birth and sheltered for much of your childhood, you welcome your exile as a chance for a little adventure.

En route to the castle, your convoy is attacked by a huge invading army. You find yourself alone in hostile lands where you must scrape together supplies and seek out allies in hopes of surviving the long, dangerous journey home.

The path home follows a dark and winding valley known simply as “The Vale”. It shrouds the land’s darkest secrets including startling truths about your family’s past.
70010000076582.name: The Vale: Shadow of the Crown

70010000076587.description:
The classic puzzle game from 1989 returns, with over 140 levels to tax your mind and fingers.

Take on the role of puzzle-obsessed Chip, who desperately wants to join Melinda the Mental Marvel's computer club. His initiation test is a series of increasingly difficult puzzles. Chip must collect items, slide blocks, dodge hazards and more to collect the computer chips needed to pass each level. Are you up to the Challenge?

This collection allows you to play these classic games with many modern features, including:
• Display filters, including retro LCD and CRT filters
• Save games - save and restore your game at any point
• Right- and left-handed control presets
70010000076587.name: Chip's Challenge

70010000076592.description:
This game is a physics-based platformer. It consists of 40 levels of a platformer that can be played like one player or with friends up to 4 players and a variety of 12 arenas where you will fight with your friends as a team or against each other.

A platformer as a part of the game consists of locations with different physics obstacles. 1 - the main obstacle is a trampoline. 2 - the main obstacles are an ice, a sled, snowballs. 3 - the main obstacles are a rope and logs on the water. 4 - a jetpack. Each location has a candy which you have to carry to the finish of the level. You can pass a level without a candy, by doing a speedrun only but you have to keep in mind that a candy and speedrun give you stars which you can use to open new levels. These levels will be passed by you or you with your friends by a network multiplayer or local multiplayer.

The game has 12 different arenas also.
 - basketball
 - football
 - soccer
 - volleyball
 - the last life
 - boxes to one row
 - collecting
 - death match
 - catch up
 - obstacle course
 - holding a flag

Have fun with friends as you like. These arenas have a jetpack which changes the gameplay radically
70010000076592.intro: A physics-based platformer. 40 levels to pass. 12 fight arenas. Play with friends by local multiplayer or online multiplayer for up to 4 players
70010000076592.name: The jump guys

70010000076597.description:
Sunset Racer is an immersive racing game that transports players to the golden era of automobiles, where powerful cars with full tanks of gasoline raced into the sunset. In this heart-pounding adventure, you assume the role of a young man determined to win the affections of a captivating woman by conquering the world of racing and securing the most awe-inspiring machine on the track.

As you embark on your quest to impress the beautiful girl of your dreams, you'll navigate through a series of adrenaline-fueled races and thrilling challenges. Starting with a modest car, you'll need to showcase your racing skills, defeat formidable opponents, and earn the resources necessary to acquire the ultimate symbol of speed and power.

Choose from an array of meticulously designed cars, each representing the epitome of automotive engineering from the golden age. From sleek sports cars to roaring muscle machines and elegant classics, every vehicle captures the essence of a bygone era.

Experience the thrill of high-speed racing as you compete in a variety of environments, from city streets to scenic coastal routes and treacherous mountain passes. Each race offers a unique challenge, testing your reflexes, strategy, and mastery of the road.

With stunning visuals, realistic sound effects, and a dynamic day-night cycle that amplifies the atmosphere, Sunset Racer captures the nostalgia and excitement of a bygone era. Witness the glowing sunsets as you race towards victory, and feel the rush of wind as you speed through iconic landscapes.

Are you ready to embark on a journey where love and speed collide? Prepare to ignite your engine, chase the setting sun, and become a legend both on and off the race track in Sunset Racer. The power to impress and the thrill of victory await you.
70010000076597.name: Sunset Racer

70010000076602.description:
• Physics-Based Nitro Boost for Extreme Speed!
 Experience a physics-driven drifting system that delivers smooth controls and an exhilarating sense of speed. Build up nitro by drifting and unleash powerful boosts that perfectly match your kart and track. Sharpen your drifting and boosting skills, fine-tune your cornering strategy, and chase your best lap times!

• A Cast of Unique Characters & Battle Skills
 Choose from a variety of adorable characters, each with their own unique battle ability. In item races, unleash character skills or grab random items to gain the upper hand—taking down rivals is just another way to win!

• Master Every Track
 Each track features its own unique layout and flow. Watch out for traps, discover hidden shortcuts, and adapt your racing strategy to each course’s special mechanics. Learning the track is the key to climbing the ranks.

• Play with Friends
 Supports 2, 3, or 4-player local split-screen. Smooth performance even in local multiplayer mode!
70010000076602.intro: Drift, Nitro, Speed! Casual fun meets competitive racing.
70010000076602.name: Combat Kart

70010000076607.description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 30 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.
70010000076607.intro: Meet over 30 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!
70010000076607.name: Hentai Girls: Office Romance

70010000076609.description:
Defy gravity and warp to victory! Master your portal gun, strategically placing portals across diverse maps. Solve mind-bending puzzles, move cubes, disable lasers, and think your way through unique levels. No two are the same! Explore 4-5 hand-crafted maps, each with fresh challenges and themes. Unravel a mysterious story and become the ultimate portal master!

Features:
	•	Warp & Conquer: Shoot portals, defy gravity, solve puzzles!
	•	Think It Through: Move cubes, disable lasers, master portal placement!
	•	No Level Left Behind: 4-5 unique maps, each handcrafted with fresh challenges!
	•	Unlock the Secrets: Unravel a captivating story as you progress!
	•	Challenge Yourself: Speedrun leaderboards, hidden collectibles, push your limits!
Are you ready to become the ultimate portal master?
70010000076609.intro: Ready to warp, flip, and twist your way to victory? Dive into the portal puzzle adventure!
70010000076609.name: PORTAL SHOT GUN TELEPORT

70010000076620.description:
This is the Open Network Test for GUNDAM BREAKER 4, the newest in the series known for players creating their own ultimate Gundam.

The test servers will be open during the following periods:
- Session 1
UTC: 7/19 (Fri) 00:00 - 05:00
PDT: 7/18 (Thu) 5:00PM - 10:00PM

- Session 2
UTC: 7/19 (Fri) 09:00 - 14:00
PDT: 7/19 (Fri) 2:00AM - 7:00AM

- Session 3 (Whole day)
UTC: 7/20 (Sat) 02:00 - 7/21 (Sun) 06:00
PDT: 7/19 (Fri) 7:00PM - 7/20 (Sat) 11:00PM

Create your own ultimate Gundam in the newest Gundam Breaker game!

In Gundam Breaker 4 you will create and customize your own powerful Gunpla, and put it to the test in thrilling combat missions.

• BREAK
Use two different weapons at once in Gundam Breaker 4 and break off parts of your enemies to add them to your collection. It's your loot - you get to keep it and use it!

• BUILD
Choose from over 250 base kits and combine their parts to build your perfect Gunpla. Customize it with paint, weathering, and decals to make it uniquely your own and display it in the new Diorama Mode. With multiple backgrounds and special effects to choose from, you can create epic, dynamic scenes to share online!

• BATTLE
Take your custom Gunpla in a variety of intense combat missions and put it to the test as you battle tough opponents in online or single player modes. Fight with your friends, equip new skills to gain an edge, and destroy your enemies!

Enter the new era of the Gundam Breaker series and prepare to BREAK, BUILD, & BATTLE!

*Test schedule and content are subject to change without notice.
*Content may differ from the final product.
*Gameplay data will not transfer to the full game.
*Test may undergo emergency maintenance without notice.
70010000076620.name: GUNDAM BREAKER 4 Open Network Test

70010000076625.description:
From TOHO Games, subsidiary of the company that created Godzilla, and the up-and-coming game studio Nukenin LLC (winner of the Google Indie Game Festival 2021 TOHO Games Award) comes a new strategy puzzle game! Control Toho monsters as you save the world by repelling the invasion of the Fungoid mushroom menace! Progress through the stages to discover the truth behind these monster mushrooms!

▷Point of the Game：

▼ Find the optimal strategy for each stage!
Each of the six worlds includes multiple stages for you to take on. On each stage, you'll have to grapple with different monsters and try different approaches as you strive for victory. Repeat stages and aim to earn more points!

▼ Find the optimal strategy for each stage!
Each of the six worlds includes multiple stages for you to take on. On each stage, you'll have to grapple with different monsters and try different approaches as you strive for victory. Repeat stages and aim to earn more points!

▼ Additional challenges!
There are two sides to this world: the surface and what lies beneath. Once you've cleared the surface, put your skills to the test by attempting the more difficult underside. You can also build your own stages and share them for other players to try. Your ranking will increase as more players attempt stages you've created, so make a stage with your favorite monsters and share it with the world!

▼ An entirely original story!
Why have the Fungoids come to invade our world? Why is Godzilla fighting on our side? Find the Investigation Reports scattered across various stages to unravel the mysteries behind this crisis.
70010000076625.intro:
Get ready to battle using your brain!
A full-fledged turn-based strategy game with a difficulty level: GODZILLA!
70010000076625.name: Godzilla Voxel Wars

70010000076630.description:
Take to the skies in "Drone Delivery Simulator," a thrilling single-player game where you start as a humble pizza delivery pilot and rise to master a variety of complex delivery missions. Navigate a detailed map with your evolving drone fleet, facing diverse challenges and environments.

Key Features:
- Progressive Delivery Missions: Start with pizza deliveries and unlock more advanced tasks.
- Single Expansive Map: Explore different areas, from urban landscapes to suburban settings.
- Customizable Drone Fleet: Upgrade from basic models to advanced drones for varied missions.
- Realistic Controls and Physics: Master skillful flying in changing weather and environments.
- Strategic Gameplay: Plan efficient routes to meet diverse delivery deadlines.
- Continuous Challenge: Adapt to increasing difficulty and varied package requirements.

Embark on a unique drone delivery adventure and transform your piloting skills into a flourishing delivery service.
70010000076630.name: Drone Delivery Simulator

70010000076635.description:
Pogo Stick Champion is a 2D platformer game that pairs a relaxing aesthetic with challenging gameplay.

Use a pogo stick to bounce your way through each level to reach through the end of the stage while avoiding hard falls and pits. As the difficulty increases you’ll encounter lasers, circular saws, spikes and other deadly obstacles, but don’t worry all levels unlocked, so you won’t get stuck!

How far can you go with your pogo stick?


Features:
* 60 levels split into 4 worlds
* All levels unlocked, you won’t get stuck on a level!
* Pogo stick physics
* Relaxing music
70010000076635.intro: Bounce with your pogo stick to new lands!
70010000076635.name: Pogo Stick Champion

70010000076640.description: Take on the role of a clumsy commando, sent to fight a zombie horde. Turn-based gameplay, unusual mechanics dependent on your own pace of play. Gameworld and events inspired by a myriad of cult action movie parodies. Die, but take many of those mumbling green dudes with you!
70010000076640.intro: Take on the role of a clumsy commando sent to fight a zombie horde in this casual turn-based shooter.
70010000076640.name: Blind Shot

70010000076645.description:
Immerse yourself in a unique experience where each answer will not only unveil his personality but also the intriguing characteristics linked to his astrological sign.

In this thrilling game, each question is designed to unravel the mysteries of the zodiac, allowing you to get to know these boys in an entirely new way.

Features:

-Unlock images of the boys on the beach and discover their zodiac traits.
-As you progress, questions become more personal and linked to their zodiac sign.
-Different endings depending on how many questions you answer and how you interpret astrological signals.
-Unlock the secret features of each boy.
-Discover the secret and spicy question the boys will ask you in question 150, related to astrology.

Are you able to decipher the astrological signs and earn their trust? Find out in this new and exciting adventure.
70010000076645.intro: Discover the fascinating world of the zodiac signs as you embark on a journey to win the heart of the boy of your dreams.
70010000076645.name: Beach Boys 2: Zodiac Date

70010000076648.description:
Worlds collide when the rogue wizard Marin and M.E.A. officer Sari meet on the bustling streets of Shibuya. Under the brilliant night lights, the pair fight for what they believe in on the cusp of fantasy and reality, freedom and order.

In a world where magic is feared, you must choose when to hide your powers or unleash them to wreak havoc on your enemies. Should these gifted individuals be regulated, or be free to use their powers as they choose? Witness the clash between wizards and the law unfold in REYNATIS!
70010000076648.name: REYNATIS

70010000076651.description:
"Jigsaw Masterpieces 2" is a digital jigsaw puzzle game that anyone can easily play anytime, anywhere. In addition to the game modes of the previous title, which was well-received for its recreation of traditional jigsaw puzzle playability, the new game mode is easy to play on the Nintendo Switch™ Lite and the small screen of handheld mode. In addition, the game now supports moving picture puzzles, adding a new level of excitement.
This title offers a total of 10 different patterns to play with, including three animated puzzles. These include "Puppy and kitten napping", "Portrait of Irène Cahen d'Anvers / Pierre-Auguste Renoir", and "[Moving] Royal Castle in the Waterfall". In addition, a variety of additional contents such as landscapes, animals, sweets, and famous paintings are being added all the time. You are sure to find a puzzle to your liking.
With digital puzzles, you don't have to worry about losing pieces or where to put them when you stop playing. "Jigsaw Masterpiece 2" makes jigsaw puzzle more fun!

Features:
‐【NEW】Two game modes let you play on a big-screen TV or a small screen of handheld mode.
-【NEW】Animated jigsaw puzzle that creates new emotions
-Easy-to-play traditional jigsaw puzzle
-Selection of six background colors
-All puzzles can be played in 3 different sizes and 2 game modes
-Separate edge and inner pieces
-Ability to snap individual pieces together
-Auto save
-More puzzles will increase with DLC
70010000076651.intro:
Endless fun! Advanced Jigsaw Puzzles!
Animals, landscapes, paintings and moving images...
Jigsaw Masterpieces 2 brings the world to life!
70010000076651.name: Jigsaw Masterpieces 2

70010000076662.description:
Dive into the immersive world of Football Simulator 2024, the ultimate 3D football simulation that puts you in the heart of the action. Experience the thrill of the beautiful game as you take on the role of a rising football star, aiming to conquer different championships and etch your name in football history.

Key Features:

Championship Glory: Compete in a variety of championships, from local leagues to prestigious international tournaments. Test your skills against formidable opponents and lead your team to victory.

Realistic Gameplay: Enjoy a true-to-life football experience with stunning 3D graphics, precise player movements, and realistic ball physics. Every pass, shot, and goal feels like the real thing.

Build Your Legacy: Customize your player, choose your team, and embark on a journey to football greatness. Make strategic decisions both on and off the field to shape your career and leave a lasting legacy.

Dynamic Environments: Play in a variety of stadiums with dynamic weather conditions that affect the gameplay.

Skill Development: Hone your skills through realistic training sessions. Improve your passing, shooting, and defensive abilities to become a well-rounded player on the virtual pitch.

Are you ready to write your name in football history? Lace up your boots and step into the world of Football Simulator 2024. The pitch is yours to conquer!
70010000076662.intro: Are you ready to write your name in football history? Lace up your boots and step into the world of Football Simulator 2024.
70010000076662.name: Football Simulator 2024

70010000076671.description:
Step into a world where football meets the undead in "Zombie Football Simulator" a spine-chilling, low-poly 3D football experience like no other. Unleash your inner zombie athlete as you dive into the exhilarating world of championships and fierce competition.

Key Features:

Ghoulish Gameplay: Embrace the chaos as your team of zombified players hits the field in their quest for football glory. Experience the thrill of low-poly graphics, bringing a distinct visual style to the beautiful game.

Championship Mayhem: Compete in a variety of championships against diverse zombie teams, each with its own bone-chilling strengths and weaknesses. Rise through the ranks and prove your squad is the ultimate undead force on the football pitch.

Customize Your Horde: Personalize your zombie players with unique skins, accessories, and eerie outfits. Build a team that strikes fear into the hearts of opponents, all while retaining that signature zombie charm.

Special Abilities: Unleash supernatural moves and bone-crushing tackles with special abilities unique to each player. Turn the tide of the game with strategic plays that showcase the otherworldly talents of your undead team.

Dynamic Arenas: Play in a variety of haunting stadiums, each with its own atmospheric elements that add to the intensity of the matches. Navigate through obstacles, overcome eerie challenges, and score goals in environments that keep you on the edge of your seat.

"Zombie Football Simulator" is not just a football game; it's a thrilling journey into the afterlife of sports, where the undead rule the pitch, and victory tastes like brain-flavored triumph. Are you ready to kick off the apocalypse?
70010000076671.intro: Are you ready to kick off the apocalypse?
70010000076671.name: Zombie Football Simulator

70010000076676.description:
Dr. Ralph Goodwin invented a miracle cure to heal the world from almost all types of diseases and he is going to present his elixir to the audience at a press conference the next day.

But today his research laboratory was destroyed, and the elixir seems lost forever. And so the last hope for his son, who is critically ill, is gone.

His daughter Sara jumps into action, searches the laboratory for any clues about the whereabouts of the elixir. She was not prepared to uncover the dark events of her own past.

Amid mad scientists and ruthless assassins, will you be able to find the elixir?

- A modern blend between a point-and-click adventure and a hidden object game
- Explore 24 thrilling locations with immersive sci-fi atmosphere
- Solve many hidden object scenes and mini-games
- Elaborate storyline with many twists
- 3 game modes
70010000076676.intro: As Sara tries to find the miracle cure for her ailing brother, she unravels the dark events of her own past.
70010000076676.name: Greed: The Mad Scientist

70010000076683.description:
Let's play Desktop Baseball!
Master simple controls and think up complex tricks and strategies!
Share Joy-Con™ for another player to play along!
