Perfect for kids, this fast-paced adventure will keep you on your toes as you blast your way through waves of outlaws and restore peace to the Wild West!
70010000087206.intro: Bandit Buster: Western – Stop the Bandits, Save the Town, and Watch Out for Explosive Surprises!
70010000087206.name: Bandit Buster: Western

70010000087220.description:
Step onto the ice and experience hockey like never before in Casual Sport Series: Hockey! Whether you're a seasoned player or new to the rink, this vibrant, action-packed game delivers fast, easy-to-pick-up fun that anyone can enjoy. Perfect for solo play or intense local multiplayer showdowns with friends, it’s the ultimate casual sports experience!

Choose from a variety of unique teams, each with its own playstyle and strategy. Every team comes with a distinctive home arena, making each match feel fresh and exciting as you compete across different, colorful environments. With stunning, high-quality cartoon graphics and dynamic visual effects, every game is a visual treat.

Add to that smooth, intuitive controls and a fun, energetic soundtrack, and you’ve got a hockey game that’s as engaging as it is easy to play. Are you ready to lead your team to victory?
70010000087220.intro: Grab your controller, hit the ice, and prove you've got what it takes to score big!
70010000087220.name: Casual Sport Series: Hockey

70010000087225.description:
Survive the never-entered levels of Banban’s Kindergarten!

After the events of Garten of Banban 4, you are forced to run away and delve even deeper into the mysterious establishment that is Banban’s kindergarten.
You are heading down to where no human dares to be.

No more friends to make…
You have run out of friends to make. From now on, you only meet new enemies who will make sure you never feel alone!
In Banban’s Kindergarten, there are enemies to be made in every corner!

Additional languages:
- Arabic (AR),
- Czech (CZ/ČEŠTINA),
- Danish (DK/DANSK),
- Finnish (FIN/SUOMI),
- Hungarian (HU/MAGYAR),
- Indonesian (IDN/INDONESIA),
- Norwegian (NOR/NORGE),
- Polish (PL/POLSKI),
- Romanian (ROU/ROMÂNĂ),
- Russian (RUS/РУССКИЙ),
- Swedish (SE/SVENSKA),
- Turkish (TUR/TÜRKÇE),
- Ukrainian (UA/УКРАЇНСЬКА).
70010000087225.intro: Explore the forgotten levels of Banban’s Kindergarten. Survive the new terrors that reside below. Uncover the truth behind the place, and find the whereabouts of your missing child…
70010000087225.name: Garten of Banban 6

70010000087230.description:
Survive the monster-occupied levels of Banban’s Kindergarten!
After the latest events, you were separated from your friends. Delve deeper into the mysterious establishment that is Banban’s kindergarten.
You are now completely on your own and the future of everything depends on you.

No more friends to make…
You have run out of friends to make. From now on, you only meet new enemies who will make sure you never feel alone!
In Banban’s Kindergarten, there are enemies to be made in every corner... and pouch!

Additional languages:
- Arabic (AR),
- Bulgarian (BG/БЪЛГАРСКИ),
- Czech (CZ/ČEŠTINA),
- Danish (DK/DANSK),
- Finnish (FIN/SUOMI),
- Hungarian (HU/MAGYAR),
- Indonesian (IDN/INDONESIA),
- Norwegian (NOR/NORGE),
- Polish (PL/POLSKI),
- Romanian (ROU/ROMÂNĂ),
- Russian (RUS/РУССКИЙ),
- Swedish (SE/SVENSKA),
- Turkish (TUR/TÜRKÇE),
- Ukrainian (UA/УКРАЇНСЬКА).
70010000087230.intro: Explore the monster-occupied levels of Banban’s Kindergarten. Survive the dreads that reside below as you are now completely on your own. Uncover the truth behind the place!
70010000087230.name: Garten of Banban 7

70010000087235.description:
Turn this empty rooftop into your own green corner in the city. Glue together colorful pots, plant various seeds, and share your harvest with friends in Amelia’s Garden!


YOUR GARDEN IN A CITYSCAPE
There’s this old stairway in your building that leads to the rooftop. Not knowing what’s up there means that an adventure, however brief, awaits. You climb upstairs and push the handle of the heavy door that stands in your way. On the other side…
A big garden space, complete with a little fountain, a table, and benches. This fine view and plenty of broken flower pots are all yours now. With a clean, a bit of glue, and plenty of patience this place can be brought back to life – are you ready to start your own rooftop garden?


LITTLE STEPS TOWARD A COLORFUL FUTURE
Together with Amelia, you’ll be restoring this old garden to glory! There are 20 broken pots to put together, each with a unique plant. You can expect to see beets, tomatoes, strawberries, basil, and many more spices, veggies, and fruit alike.

Every pot has a unique puzzle required to put it together. After this task is finished, you can fill it with dirt, plant seeds, water it, and let it grow. Before you know it, you’ll see the fruit of your labor - though it can be a veggie of your labor, too. You can also move the pots however much you like and even organize them based on color!


A COZY SPACE FOR YOU AND YOURS
Various folks like various plants - Amelia’s friends are like this as well. As the plants grow you can give them out to people and earn hearts. Each person has a unique set of likes and dislikes, so even if you don’t like strawberries I’m sure someone else would gladly take them in!

Ease yourself into watching the cityscape while gardening. Relaxing music, hand-drawn artstyle, and non-timed puzzles are here to bring some peace to your life. Even in a bustling city, there has to be a place where you can take a deep breath. Don’t be afraid to make one for yourself!
70010000087235.intro: Repair these pots and start a brand new rooftop garden!
70010000087235.name: Amelia’s Garden

70010000087240.description:
Worried about what this might mean, Pooh, Piglet, Tigger, Rabbit and the others embark on an exciting investigation. Along the way, they find unexpected clues, confront suspicions among themselves and meet new friends.

As the mystery unravels, the characters learn important lessons about friendship, cooperation and the importance of caring for their common home.

This adventure-filled story is packed with funny, heartfelt and wise moments. With each step, the friends of the Hundred Acre Wood discover that when they work together, they can overcome any challenge, no matter how big or small.
70010000087240.intro: In this visual novel, a mysterious event occurs in the Hundred Acre Wood. Pooh and his friends spring into action when they discover that the honey has disappeared.
70010000087240.name: Winnie the Pooh: Honey for All

70010000087242.description:
Detective From The Crypt is a mystical Victorian detective story in which you play for a ghost girl helped by a ghost cat.

Jane wakes up in a crypt as a ghost. You are investigating the death of her family together. Seeking and researching evidences. Building an accusation based on them. You have a laboratory to research evidences. Play and get the feeling of being a true Victorian detective.

Reveal the secrets of the old estate while playing the game.

Features:
- There is a cat in the game who is your friend and an assistant
- You will have to communicate with the inhabitants of crypts and graves
- You will meet Egyptian mummies at the home museum
- You must find out why you died and reveal the secret your parents’ death
- Classic "Point and click" adventure
70010000087242.intro: Play and get the feeling of being a true Victorian detective.
70010000087242.name: Detective From The Crypt

70010000087247.description:
Together with his new friends, a wise turtle, a resourceful parrot, a mischievous monkey and a loyal dolphin, Mogli must join forces to unravel the island's secrets and restore peace. Through his journey, he will learn the value of friendship, courage and the power to protect his new home.

·A new Mogil story: Join Mogil on his exciting new adventure!

·Lots of new characters: Discover new friends full of personality.

·Colorful backgrounds: Immerse yourself in a visually stunning world with vibrant settings.

·Lovely music: Enjoy a soundtrack that the whole family will love.

·Immersive story: A story that captivates children and encourages positive values.

·Over an hour of fun: Educational entertainment for little ones!
70010000087247.intro: In this visual novel, Mogli, a curious and brave young man, finds himself stranded on a mysterious island after an unexpected storm.
70010000087247.name: The Jungle Book: New Wonder Adventures

70010000087252.description:
In a faraway fantasy kingdom, everything was peaceful... Until monsters started pouring out of a hole in the ground!

Put together a team of adventurers to secure, explore, and develop a vast underground network of caves in this cavern management simulator.

Your adventurers will face all kinds of challenges in the underground, but there's no obstacle you can't deal with if you know how. Place torches to light up the darkness, build bridges to traverse gorges, and use explosives to clear away large rocks!

To create a truly great cave, you'll have to stay on your toes and pay attention to the time of day. When the sun's up, organize your miners to discover new areas and build new fixtures. And when night falls, send in your adventurers to show those monsters who's boss! The deeper you dig, the better the treasure you'll find - just how deep can you go?

All that fame can come at a price. As your cave becomes more popular, thieves will appear to try and make off with its treasures. Keep your booty safe by laying devious traps around the entrance!

Not all monsters are bad. Some of them might even become your friends and fight alongside you!

Once you make an entire floor safe, merchants will be able to move in and set up shop there. With a cut of the profits for you, of course! Keep developing the space and earning gold, and pretty soon you'll have the finest cave in all the land!

In this quirky management sim, fun, adventure, and riches are lurking right under your nose... Or should we say, right under your boots?
70010000087252.intro: Build an underground network of caves in this fantasy-themed management sim.
70010000087252.name: Cavern Adventurers

70010000087265.description:
Step into a world of romance and flowers in this refreshingly mature Otome that charts the lives of four couples, centered around a local flower shop.

‘Him, the Smile and bloom’ is a unique exploration of the flourishing relationship between two adults and the highs and lows of their budding romance in a modern world.

From the initial spark of attraction to the struggles of maintaining a relationship and navigating life’s choppy waters - Him the Smile and bloom, deftly weaves heartwarming - and heart-breaking! - narrative threads for a genuinely distinct and memorable Otome experience!


Say it with flowers!: Him, the Smile and Bloom charts four whirlwind romances - from the tender love of youth, to thorny, tumultuous and steamy. There are four distinct love matches to explore.

Couple up! Rather than one protagonist with a selection of love interests, Him the Smile and Bloom instead focuses on the relationship between four couples and love interests - Wataru, Ginnosuke, Hokuto, and Tenya.

Twelve distinct endings: Each couple has three endings to explore. However! Rather than traditional ‘good’ or ‘bad’ endings, each of the couple’s potential futures are poignant and offer something worthwhile to enjoy, regardless of the romantic (or not!) outcome.

A refreshingly adult approach to Otome romance: By focusing on the growing relationship between four couples. Him, the Smile and bloom brings a unique maturity to the exploration of love and the lives of these couples.

Gorgeous production values: Wonderful character artwork and vibrant and detailed game world, combine with expressive voice work to really enhance the tenderness and emotion of each story.

Revised and improved localisation. Additional localisation edits and revisions to bring greater accuracy and quality to the western release of Him, the Smile and bloom.

Additional side stories: Completing the ‘Glow’ or ‘best’ ending to each couples’ story unlocks additional side stories to enjoy - bringing further life to these unforgettable characters.
70010000087265.name: Him, the Smile & bloom

70010000087269.description:
Use your powers of sorcery to fend off waves of fiendish enemies in top-down pixel art arenas!

Spellagis is a survival shooter where you take the role of a mage beset by swarms of blobs, snakes, ghosts, maggots and more. Wield your staff and fire magical projectiles to slay your foes, then collect coins they drop to buy items from the shop to keep stacking the deck in your favor, from spell enhancements and protective summons to food for quick health boosts. Destroy barrels in the arena for random potions and stacks of coins! Just always stay on your toes or enemy hordes will box you in.

Will you become the most powerful mage as you fight to survive, or will you succumb to the onslaught?

Features:

• Survive waves of enemies in top-down arena combat!
• Cast spells in twin-stick shooter style as you evade incoming attacks.
• Destroy barrels and collect coins!
• Buy items from the shop to aid you in combat!
• Earn perpetual upgrades to stack the deck in your favor for subsequent runs.
• Enjoy old-school pixel art aesthetics!
70010000087269.intro: Grow your magic skills to survive relentless waves of enemies in twin-stick shooter style!
70010000087269.name: Spellagis

70010000087274.description: A first-person narrative adventure game, telling the story of a sick child playing a 2D platformer. Made in partnership with Great Ormond Street Hospital Charity!
70010000087274.intro: A first-person narrative adventure game, telling the story of a sick child playing a 2D platformer. Made in partnership with Great Ormond Street Hospital Charity!
70010000087274.name: I'll be Brave, Tomorrow

70010000087278.description:
You will visit the most amazing corners of the world and national parks of America. You will visit certain peaks of mountains,  African savannahs and much more.
This game will offer you a new way of searching for objects, as well as a large number of enjoyable mini-games!
Go through the levels in the "Layers" modes and search there for the right items among a variety of different things.
This hidden object game is full of new interesting locations and hidden things. Use your search skills and logic to solve the puzzles and find all the hidden objects.

The collector's edition includes:
- 15 additional levels with different modes!
- 5 mini-games
- 4 collectible puzzles that you can collect as the game progresses!
70010000087278.intro: Start your search in this amazing hidden object marathon!
70010000087278.name: Lots of Things 2 Travel and Search Collector's Edition

70010000087282.description:
You, the player, have somehow lost your human body and been turned into an ‘Ichimatsu doll’. In this action-adventure game, you must explore a traditional Japanese house to find a way to turn back to normal.

The general course of action is using hints to hunt down various items that will enhance your abilities.
You mustn’t allow yourself to be spotted by humans. If you feel you’re about to be seen, you can play dead like an inanimate doll.

Should you be spotted, run away as fast as you can. If you get caught, it's game over.
While you can’t fight against humans directly, some of the items you collect can be used to create poltergeist phenomena that can stun or distract them.
70010000087282.intro: A stealth action adventure in which you play as a Japanese traditional doll and explore the house without anyone finding you.
70010000087282.name: Ichima-san

70010000087294.description:
When the weather’s bad, when the skies are grey…
When you’re looking for ways to spend the day…
Down the rainy road, there’s a lovely place:
A digital museum, full of fluffy strays ^^

It’s no secret that most artists love cats – and cats love those gentle souls, too!
From their ages-long kinship, Meowsterpiece Museum was created – housing both beautiful art, and adorable cats ^^
While safe within the confines of this venue, the cats are still a little shy and hard to spot for the average visitor – and that’s when you come into play!

Are you up for the challenge of finding five hundred sneaky cats? ^^

In this game, you’ll find:
- An original soundtrack...
- Replicas of 10 beautiful, famous paintings...
- 500 hidden cats...
- An atmosphere of thought and relaxation ^^
70010000087294.intro: Great painters love cats… So they hid some in their paintings! Can you spot them?
70010000087294.name: Meowsterpiece Museum

70010000087299.description: In Crasho Cars, race through the desert while evading obstacles and police cars that crash into each other. The goal is simple: stay alive as long as you can in this high-speed, chaotic chase!
70010000087299.intro: Collect money and power-ups to survive longer.
70010000087299.name: Crasho Cars

70010000087304.description:
The Tale of Bistun follows an amnesiac stone carver on his journey up the slopes of the intimidating Mount Bistun. He’ll have to battle legions of monstrous foes using fast-paced, melee combat and powerful magical abilities as he explores the real world and the mysterious place of forgotten memories, known as the Revelations Realm, in search of answers. All the while, a mysterious voice encourages him to keep going, recounting his every step and keeping close tabs on his quest through these beautiful but blight-infested lands.

Key Features:
- A Re-telling of a Persian Legend:
Based on an epic romantic poem from the 12th century, “Khosrow and Shirin”, The Tale of Bistun is a tale of love, loss, and adventure through a land where magic and bravery collide

- A Stunning Land of Myth and Magic:
Ascend the deadly slopes of Mount Bistun and battle through a gorgeous world that brings the ancient lands of Mesopotamia to life

- Hack, Slash, and Blast:
Battle hordes of dangerous foes using fast-paced tactical melee combat and ferocious magical abilities

- Carve Out Your Own Tale:
    King Darius, eat your heart out! Create your own Behistun Inscription and etch out beautiful engravings to tell the world your story.
70010000087304.intro: Based on an epic romantic poem from the 12th century, “Khosrow and Shirin”, the game is a tale of love, loss, and adventure in a land where magic and bravery collide.
70010000087304.name: The Tale of Bistun

70010000087309.description:
As the world turns short of Mana, Mirage, the city of illusions, is in danger of collapsing! Help Kyuboy’d make his way through 50 mind-boggling puzzles to save his hometown from impending doom!

Each level challenges your perception and forces you to see the world from different angles. The cuboid movement also tests your spatial reasoning and problem solving skills in small spaces. Use the power of perspective to navigate impossible terrain. But beware, one wrong move and you will have to start the level again!

Features:
• 50 puzzles that test your puzzle solving skills!
• An inventory to manage items and use them to your advantage!
• Stunning stylized environments to navigate!
• Overcome your best scores!
70010000087309.intro: Control a cuboid, see things from different perspectives, and overcome impossible terrain in this unique and innovative isometric puzzle!
70010000087309.name: Mirage: Ignis Fatuus

70010000087314.description:
Break blocks, grab powerups, solve puzzles, and beat bosses! When a mysterious tower appears in the forest, Chico the Chipmunk and his new friend Beeatrice decide to go exploring. In the tower they'll find a whole host of block-breaking challenges, clever environmental puzzles, and secrets to be unraveled! How can a tower appear out of nowhere? The answers are waiting inside.

In the block breaking Rebound challenges, you'll be tasked with clearing every block from the stage by bouncing around Chico's trusty giant walnut. Keep a long volley going to get a high score! Chico can change the angle of the ball by tail-whipping it while he runs, to give you control over your shot. It's simple to start but takes skill to master!

Of course, it's not always so simple. There are over a dozen types of blocks, and different power-ups for the walnut that change how they interact. Fire power burns grass blocks, spikes smash through blocks with ease, explosive power breaks stone, and much much more! Fans, cannons, ghosts, and more turn each level into a unique challenge! It's block-breaking like you've never experienced it before.

In between block breaking challenges you'll explore the mysterious Celestial Tower, a large interconnected dungeon full of environmental puzzles! Explore all 6 floors of the tower, unlock new paths, and make your way to the very top! You'll meet a cast of characters who need your help, as they try to complete their secret mission. Can you solve the puzzles, uncover the truth of the Celestial Tower, and save the day?

Have fun and show off your unique style! Save up the sunflower seeds you collect, and you can trade them in for special designs for both your walnut and the game's interface! Why not bounce around a watermelon or a paper lantern instead of a walnut? There are a bunch of colors and styles to choose from.
70010000087314.intro: Master skill-based block breaking challenges, solve environmental puzzles, and explore the mysterious tower with Chico the Chipmunk!
70010000087314.name: Chico's Rebound

70010000087316.description:
"KONAMI’s TABLE TENNIS" is a sports game released by KONAMI in 1985.
This title captures the fun and thrills of actual table tennis, where matches hang on split-second decisions that keep your reflexes sharp.
Don't miss your openings, and return the ball with a smash!

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpiece that built a generation for video games.

*The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.
70010000087316.intro: Show your brilliance at table tennis!
70010000087316.name: Arcade Archives KONAMI's TABLE TENNIS

70010000087326.description:
"City Bomber" is a car action game released by KONAMI in 1987.
Take control of Cat Burglar 306 after stealing the haul from a corrupt casino, and try to escape from the gang that's after you.
You control a unique car in this title. Use its high jumps to clear difficult terrain, radial saws to attack enemies in front of you, and a variety of other gadgets to make your way through!

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpiece that built a generation for video games.

*The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.
70010000087326.intro: It's a frantic chase scene to escape!
70010000087326.name: Arcade Archives City Bomber

70010000087334.description:
In the mystical Ancient Library, a young apprentice named Wright trains under Yuisil, the Witch of Portals. As part of his magical studies, he delves into the stories of four enchanted books, each offering a unique realm to explore. From reclaiming a fallen kingdom to unraveling the mysteries of the underworld, your choices shape the destinies of captivating characters and their intertwining tales.

In this card deck-building roguelite full of pixel artwork, dive into thrilling, turn-based card battles where every decision counts. Build and customize decks across four unique systems, each tailored to the worlds within the books. Collect powerful cards, use Ink to enhance your deck, and adapt your strategy to overcome enemies and unlock special endings. With randomized dungeons and escalating challenges, each run is a fresh test of your skills.
70010000087334.intro: Turn the page and shape destiny in a card deck-building roguelite JRPG!
70010000087334.name: Novel Rogue

70010000087351.description:
Play Time Travel: Escape Room game and unlock secrets of the past and the future with a crystal in your hand! Participate in this escape room game challenge with a twist. This 100 room escape puzzle game enables you to sneak peek through time thanks to its broken time machine. Absurd right? You too can feel the thrill, just solve escape puzzles and find the missing piece for the time machine in 100 world famous locations in different times. The heart of the time machine beats with the power of a rare crystal. Simply play Time Travel: Escape Room game, find the crystal and see what it feels like to be a real time traveler!

What’s the deal with Time Travel: Escape Room game and its broken time machine?!

A revolutionary time machine is developed by a genius doctor in his lab. The main part of the machine that makes travel through time possible is a rare shimmering crystal. As time traveling is a very complex thing, the time machine breaks all the time which makes his time travelings unpredictable. Whenever the time travel machine breaks, the crystal falls out and disappears somewhere in the scene. Be a master of this 100 room escape game, solve demanding puzzles, find the key in the form of a rare crystal and escape the time you got stuck in. Start time traveling with Time Travel: Escape Room game!

TIME TRAVEL: ESCAPE ROOM GAME CHARACTERISTICS

- Exciting puzzles with hidden objects and conundrums to solve
- Cool mechanics: move in time and space, combine objects, play brain games
- Skip the level if you get stuck
- Visit many world's famous locations in different times
- Takes up almost no memory on your device

Time Travel: Escape Room game is a very complex 100 room challenge to be cracked. That’s why Doc needs your help in this time travel escape adventure, so he can find the lost time travel crystal, fix the machine and return to his lab and his time. Doc can’t continue his time travel without you, so help him. Play Time Travel: Escape Room game!
70010000087351.intro: Your help is essential in this time travel machine game!
70010000087351.name: Time Travel: Escape Room Game

70010000087356.intro: Survive in harsh conditions. Help other survivors. Rebuild the city after the war.
70010000087356.name: Survival after War

70010000087361.description: Step into a unique adventure with Twins of Legacy! Play as a talented painter and a skilled musician, combining art and music to navigate through a world full of mysteries and challenges. Together, these two heroes will use their abilities to solve puzzles, overcome obstacles, and uncover secrets across 20 thrilling levels and 3 distinct themes. Whether you play solo or team up with a friend, every stage offers a new test of creativity and skill. Can you harness the power of art and music to triumph in this epic journey? Twins of Legacy awaits your story!
70010000087361.name: Twins of Legacy

70010000087370.description:
Experience the exciting universe of The Expanse like never before in Telltale’s latest adventure, The Expanse: A Telltale Series. Take on the role of Camina Drummer and explore the dangerous and uncharted edges of the Belt aboard the Artemis. From scavenging wrecked ships in a zero-g environment, to surviving a mutiny, to combating fearsome pirates, you make the difficult choices and reveal Camina Drummer’s resolve in this latest Telltale adventure.

A TELLTALE STORY LIKE NO OTHER

Immerse yourself in the role of Camina Drummer, the Executive Officer aboard the Artemis, a scavenging ship hunting for a big score in the outer regions of the Belt. You must corral a crew rife with tense relationships and powerful personalities, and make tough decisions that will decide everyone’s fate.

EXPLORE THE BELT IN ZERO-G

Scour shipwrecks, use mag boots to walk on walls and ceilings, and utilize zero-g thrusters to float through the void. As you fly through sections of ships and the open expanse of space, interact with objects in the world and converse with members of the crew in the largest and most immersive exploration of any Telltale game to date.

DIFFICULT CHOICES, GRAVE CONSEQUENCES

Contend with the unforgiving brutality of space, the politics of a corrupt solar system, the animosities of your crew, and Drummer’s own conflicting responsibilities to the people she cares about and the Belt she has sworn to protect. There is no right or wrong path - only your choices and the consequences they unleash.

THE DELUXE EDITION INCLUDES
Episode 1: Archer's Paradox
Episode 2: Hunting Grounds
Episode 3: First Ones
Episode 4: Impossible Objects
Episode 5: Europa's Folly
Bonus Episode: ARCHANGEL
70010000087370.intro: The Expanse: A Telltale Series Deluxe Edition brings together all five ground-breaking episodes of The Expanse: A Telltale Series along with Telltale’s bonus episode “ARCHANGEL”.
70010000087370.name: The Expanse: A Telltale Series - Deluxe Edition

70010000087372.description:
In the year 2222 A.D., our beloved Earth has been devastated.
In search of a new planet to live on, we embark on an endless journey.

You embark on your journey aboard a spaceship.
The spaceship is evolving and needs space fuel in the form of rings.

Aim for new stars while collecting rings.

■About the rules
The controls are very simple.
Press the button to raise the spaceship.
When the button is released, gravity pulls the spaceship down.
Collect rings while avoiding walls and obstacles.

There are two game modes: “Stage Mode” and “Endless Mode.

Collected rings can be used in the in-game shop. You can customize the game by purchasing “wall colors,” “spaceship types,” and “backgrounds” at the SHOP.

Experience the simple but irresistible world of “2222”.
70010000087372.intro:
It's a casual game—just press a button and you're off!
Collect rings of fuel and travel far and wide!
70010000087372.name: 2222 Abyss of the Universe

70010000087377.description:
"THE OUTFOXIES" is an action game released by NAMCO LIMITED (current Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.) in 1995.
You select one of the world’s top assassins as your protagonist, and under the orders  of a mysterious billionaire, your mission is to eliminate all the others.
Whether for the reward, for pride, or simply for the thrill of combat…
A  no-rules showdown among the world’s  most dangerous professionals is about to begin!

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.

*The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.
70010000087377.intro: Make use of various weapons to eliminate the enemy assassins
70010000087377.name: Arcade Archives THE OUTFOXIES

70010000087394.description:
Powerful beings known as Titans have seized control of Heaven. A makeshift alliance is formed between former angels and demons, who must learn to work together against their common foe.

Now, you must command these clans aboard newly forged trains, and embark on your journey through Hell, Heaven, and the Abyss, to defeat the Titans before they destroy this world.

Chaos awaits beyond the gates!

FEATURES

Powerful New Clans & Enemies
You’re in command! Choose from a selection of five brand new clans, each with its own unique strengths and gameplay to forge strategies fitting your personal playstyle. With three vertical levels to defend against dangerous new enemies, you’ll need to recruit powerful new units, upgrade cards, and experiment to survive. Can you defeat the all-new and ultra-challenging Titans?

New Card Types
Reach your deck’s full build potential with all new Room and Equipment Cards. Room Cards add impressive boosts to your train, allowing you new strategic advantages over your foes. Equipment Cards can be applied to units, giving them a variety of bonuses to aid you in battle!

Dynamic Features & Depth
The Covenant Outpost is the bustling hub that you’ll visit after each run. From here, you’ll have access to Monster Train 2’s core features, as well as experience character interactions that move the story forward.

• Pyre Hearts: Each Pyre Heart brings unique functionality to gameplay. Unlocking them not only provides another way to customize your run before departing, but also plays a key role in advancing the story.
• Dimensional Challenges: Ready for a new twist on your adventure? This mode offers handcrafted challenges, new Mutators, and unique cosmetic rewards to be earned as you complete them.
• Train Customization: Unlock new parts for your train and customize it to suit your personal style.
• The Logbook: In addition to recording completion goals, the improved Logbook also now includes new features, such as enemy information, collection objectives, and more ways to compare your achievements against your friends.
• Daily Challenges: Take on a new challenge every day with a hugely modified run featuring brand new mutators, as well as some returning old favorites. Compete globally and against friends, and climb the leaderboards with a skill-focused scoring system.
• Celestial Alcoves: The rapid expansion of the Rail has attracted many new visitors to Hell. Encounter a wide variety of random events with exciting gameplay and maybe even a few surprises from outside of the Monster Train universe.

Endless Mode
One of the most requested features by Monster Train players is here! Travel the Rails with ever-increasing difficulty to test your skills and see how long you can survive. You can even compare your stats against your friends!
70010000087394.intro: The classic roguelike deckbuilder returns with new clans, challenges and modes!
70010000087394.name: Monster Train 2

70010000087400.description: In this crossing road game, players must navigate through various obstacles, collecting coins and special items along the way. The coins collected can be used to purchase new animals, each with more lives, enhancing the gameplay experience. The game is infinite, becoming more challenging as players achieve higher scores. How far can you go?
70010000087400.name: Frogo Deluxe

70010000087405.description:
Find-o'-lantern is a simple and addictively easy logic game, inspired by the classic star battle puzzle. Your mission is to place jack-o'-lanterns on a square board, following rules that exercise your mind in problem-solving.

With 180 levels ranging in difficulty, Find-o'-lantern offers a perfect blend of simplicity and complexity. Each puzzle requires careful thought and planning as you work to place the lanterns in their correct positions. Its intuitive interface will get you up and running, while increasing difficulty will ensure seasoned puzzle enthusiasts a satisfying challenge.

Key Features:
- 180 levels of logic-based puzzles
- Simple rules with deep strategic potential
- Increasing difficulty to keep you engaged
- Clean and intuitive interface—designed with the puzzle lover in mind

If you love logic puzzles and classic solitaire challenges, Find-o'-lantern is the game to exercise your gray matter!
70010000087405.intro: Solve logical riddles in this simple, yet challenging game based on the classic star battle format.
70010000087405.name: Find-o'-Lantern

70010000087411.description:
From the pen of former Nintendo art director turned manga artist, Takaya Imamura, and developers of the Retro Mystery Club series, Happymeal, comes a 16-bit styled retro-future, adventure, infused with RPG elements: OMEGA 6: The Triangle Stars.

A Turbulent Quest for the Ultimate Treasure
Follow the adventures of Thunder and Kyla on their spaceship, Omega 6: two androids entrusted with discovering a new planet for the human race to inhabit. But before they find mankind's new home, they must locate the ultimate treasure in some ancient ruins to pay off... a planetary loan?! Their quest will take them to three different planets, the first planet is Impostar, a planet filled with aliens from all four corners of space. The second planet is Igni, a fiery planet with a harsh environment. The third planet is Froslara, a planet as frozen as its residents are rich.
And on every planet, new encounters and incidents await!

Over 100 aliens! An adventure combo-meal of mystery & drama!
During your treasure hunt, unexpected encounters await at every turn via random events. You can explore freely while working as a bounty hunter, delivery person, or just shopping for items: how to play is up to you. For the completionists, there's a gallery to record all the intergalactic rogues you meet, sub-missions, and training where you can battle powerful opponents! Contrary to its name, space is very full!

Battle rival treasure hunters and a plethora of aliens in card-based battles!
Treasure attracts trouble, leading to card-based battles with anyone from rival treasure hunters to unknown aliens lurking about. With a set number of cards in your hand, read through your opponent’s strategy and forge a path to absolute victory! Inside your spaceship is a bonsai that bears fruits. Use them to boost your abilities or switch your opponent’s hand with yours. This bonsai also bears Magic Fruits, which will hold tremendous powers, but use them at your own risk!

Story
Earth, somewhere in the distant future.
Thanks to a technology that extends the average lifespan up to about 400 years, humanity lives comfortably, despite the societal problems associated with an aging populace.

Then, one day, a wormhole appeared suddenly near Mars. Via this phenomenon, Earth saw an influx of aliens and, before anybody realized, all the planet’s major cities were occupied by these migratory extra-terrestrials.
Concerned with this situation, Dr Victor Franklin, a leading researcher on longevity, decides to search for a second Earth. In order to that humanity may thrive once again thrive once their new home was found, he creates two androids, Thunder and Kyla, and sends them in on their quest aboard the Omega 6 spacecraft.

And thus began Thunder and Kyla's long and extraordinary adventures.
Creators

Story & Art by Takaya Imamura
Takaya Imamura joined Nintendo in 1989 and worked on the art direction for series like Star Fox™, F-Zero™ and The Legend of Zelda™. He left Nintendo in 2021 to work as a lecturer at the International Professional University of Technology in Osaka. Being an illustrator, he also launched his first manga Omega 6 in France in October 2022, via Omaké Books.

Sound by Shinobu Amayake
Shinobu Amayake composed music for Nintendo games such as Stunt Race FX™, NES™ Open Tournament Golf, Wario’s Woods™ and Pokémon™ Ranger: Shadows of Almia. After leaving Nintendo, she now works as a pianist and a jazz vocalist performing in Kyoto and Osaka.
70010000087411.intro: OMEGA 6 The Triangle Stars is an adventure game with 16-bit styling, based on the manga by former Nintendo® art director, Takaya Imamura.
70010000087411.name: Omega 6 The Triangle Stars

70010000087413.description:
Inside The Crystal Mountain is an action-adventure game where you explore a mysterious world filled with objects to find, enemies to defeat, and characters to meet. You can customize the combat system by discovering new upgrades and enhancements in the small but dense game world. But don't worry, you won't be alone: strange and mysterious characters will ask for your help with bizarre requests in exchange for your freedom.

Do you think you can make it?

One last thing... don't be fooled by the ultra-colorful pixel art: it won't be an easy task.
70010000087413.intro: Explore and fight in a hostile world, filled with enigmatic characters and ruthless enemies.
70010000087413.name: Inside The Crystal Mountain

70010000087418.description:
Play solo, with friends or online multiplayer

This beloved game classic offers even more game options: “Ludo XXL 2” brings the crazy dice-rolling fun straight to your living room – or, with the latest online multiplayer mode, even to Grandma and Grandpa on the other side of the world. This game guarantees laughter, dice-rolling, and (of course!) the occasional friendly flare-up of frustration. Enjoy a colorful mix of unpredictable good fortune and hilarity!

• This evergreen board game has been reissued for those who can't get enough playful frustration in their lives!
• Online dice fun: Play with friends and family around the globe.
• Variety guaranteed: 8 beautifully designed game boards, including 4 new ones.
• Three game modes, heated duels: Classic, Extra, and Extreme.
• Customizable rules: Play anyway you like.
• Up to 6 players: Exciting matches for all ages.
• Maximum flexibility: Locally or online, with real players or against AI.
70010000087418.intro: Prepare to keep (or lose) your temper online!
70010000087418.name: Ludo XXL 2

70010000087420.description:
A legend is born when the stars descend on Kaikala Island and choose a young boy of the Makoa tribe to guide him through the ancient rites. But something out of the ordinary is happening, fewer and fewer young ones pass the rite that allows them to leave childhood behind, and some guiding stars have not returned to the firmament…
Join Kirm and his guiding star Hoku on this adventure full of puzzles, exploration and growth to unveil a beautiful coming of age story with multiple endings. Meet unique supernatural creatures and new companions along the way, cooperate with them and conquer the wisdom, courage and spirit paths!

FEATURES

28 LEVELS IN 3 PATHS WITH DIFFERENT MECHANICS, WILL YOU PASS THE RITE?
•	Wisdom: Solve the puzzles by picking the right items and bring them where they are needed.
•	Courage: Control Kirm and Mirk (his Power Meerkat) at the same time to solve puzzles and navigate a jungle full of dangers.
•	Spirit: Explore The Spirit World and switch between dimensions in a dreamy alternative reality.
•	Over 28 levels and 15+ hours of gameplay!

FUN ACTIVITIES IN A LIVELY, PACKED WITH FUN, BIZARRE YET CAPTIVATING ISLAND!
•	Conduct a singular rock orchestra. Like, composed of literal rocks. Yes. They sing!
•	Play a match of dodgeball against a a crazy monkey armed with coconuts. Be sure to dodge though, or you might die. Oh, also, you can’t throw them back at him. A bit unfair you say? I don’t think so!
•	Escape from a burning ancient temple, take a leap of faith and drift in zero gravity, face a giant snake, play a seagull piano… there is always a new surprise around the corner!

A UNIQUE COMING OF AGE STORY IN A WORLD THAT GRABS YOU FROM THE START
•	6 different endings that will shape Kirm’s journey to adulthood.
•	A lively world full of endearing creatures, fun moments and beautiful scenery.
•	Award winning Original Soundtrack with 2 hours of masterfully composed music.
•	A handcrafted language, the Makoan, present in the dialogs, OST and symbology.

EXTRA CONTENT, SECRETS AND LORE AWAIT!
•	48 in-game achievements. Think out of the box and complete deliriously funny tasks to find them all!
•	20 collectibles to find through exploration and skins for Hoku and Kirm.
•	Unlock secrets, extra mini games and lore by getting achievements.
70010000087420.intro: Join Kirm on a touching tale of wisdom, courage & spirit to become a legend!
70010000087420.name: A Rite from the Stars: Remaster Edition

70010000087428.description:
ABOUT
Welcome to Ocean Keeper, a mining roguelike shooter with a top-down view. Play as a Miner whose spaceship has crashed on a planet, filled with underwater monsters. Find resources and artifacts for purchasing valuable upgrades.

Use the time between each attack to power up your diver, mech, weapon or explore a new dungeon. Build automatic turrets, use drones to collect loot and improve your skills to increase your chances of survival.

ABYSSAL ASSAULTS
Dozens of weapons, upgrades, and monsters are waiting for you. The world here is dangerous, and keeps in unknown threats.
You should be very careful and survive as long as possible. Spider Mech, your faithful companion, is ready to help you with that. Mix different weapons to make your special setup, practice your combat and defense skills.

DIVERSE BIOMES
The underwater world of Ocean Keeper consists of many biomes. You will have to travel through the locations and find the remains of a lost civilization. Discover mysterious locations, from abandoned sci-fi laboratories to mines with artifacts. EACH time you explore the underwater worlds, the layout changes, making every journey unique. You never play the same scenario twice.

FARM RESOURCES
Drill caves in search of different resources to upgrade your equipment, weapons and Mech Spider. It's worth saying that the local fauna didn't like the fact that you want to mine their sources! So don't forget to exit the dungeons, and switch to a dynamic combat mode.

Try to keep a balance between Mech and Digger upgrades as your survival depends on the speed of resource mining. And who knows, maybe you'll get lucky and find unique treasures and artifacts. Some of them will help you to instantly improve your equipment and become as strong as possible.

MASSIVE BOSS FIGHTS
Ocean Keeper is ready to surprise you by massive battles with unique bosses! From a giant crab to the flying mouse, each battle will be a true challenge. We won’t reveal all the cards — there are many more. The other question is, will you have the strength to defeat them? However, don’t be scared and bravely go through all the challenges — your courage will be awarded.

REPLAYABILITY
Forget about monotony - each new game session will open new secrets of the underwater world, and battles with sea monsters will become harder. You can use various meta upgrades and unique types of Mechs to bravely fight with every wave of monsters.

Even if after death the game starts from zero, you still can use all your resources and upgrade your equipment and weapon in the Hub. It will help you to dive again and become much stronger than before.

Are you ready to test how far you can get? Will you reach the final boss in the game?
70010000087428.intro: Explore dungeons, fight hordes of monsters, and survive on a huge map. This is Ocean Keeper — an action roguelike with tower defense elements.
70010000087428.name: Ocean Keeper: Dome Survival Roguelike

70010000087433.description:
In a faraway kingdom in a land of legend, a mysterious plague of unknown origin has rapidly infected the population. Dubbed the "Red Plague", the evil nature of the phenomenon is unmistakable: the dead begin to rise from their graves, and demonic incarnations begin to appear. Within months, the dead form an evil army commanded by the Lords of Darkness. Villages and towns begin to be ravaged, the demonic legions growing with each victory.

Make your way through the 5 levels and many powerful Bosses, kicking the butt of enemies specific to their environment. Use your double jump to dodge enemies and traps, or to reach certain platforms

As in old arcade games, you can only be hit twice before losing a life. The first time, you lose your armor, but you can continue to fight the forces of evil in UNDIES! Get hit again, however, and you'll lose your life miserably. Losing a life takes you back to the beginning of the level, or to the ... checkpoint if you've reached it. Beware of "Game Over"...

The fate of humanity is now in the hands of our anti-hero...
70010000087433.name: GladMort

70010000087440.description:
"FINAL BLOW" is a sports-action game released by TAITO in 1989.
Players choose one of five boxers and compete against the remaining four to become champion.
In addition to weak, medium, and strong punches, you can also use switch between low and high blow to take advantage of your opponent's openings.
Step into the ring and face the most fearsome fighters in the world!

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpiece that built a generation for video games.

The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.
70010000087440.intro:
Jab, duck, and swing!
Land the final blow and become the champion!
70010000087440.name: Arcade Archives FINAL BLOW

70010000087449.description:
Travel back to olden times and become Director of your own city!

Attract new residents and try to become the greatest city in the land! Add buildings like restaurants and teahouses to make your town a place where samurai and commoners alike will want to live.

This is the past, so don't forget to add some touches of traditional culture! Features like temples and gaming halls can give your city a lot of personality, especially when arranged in harmony with the surrounding environment. You might end up attracting tourists to the town, who will move in if they like it enough.

It's not all fun and games in the mists of history. Sometimes ghost, demons, and other baddies will come to attack your city. You'll have to summon your own Guardian Spirits to banish the evil ones and keep your townsfolk safe. Consider your spirits' abilities and placement for the best effects - strategy is the key word!

With a whole host of land expansion options, facilities, and residents to collect and customize, it's never been easier to create a city that will go down in history.
Start building your ancient city today!

Try searching for "Kairosoft" to see all of our games!!
70010000087449.intro: A city-building sim with a historical twist
70010000087449.name: Heian City Story

70010000087454.description:
Step into the bustling world of retail management with Video Game Store! From stocking shelves and managing inventory to navigating customer demands and optimizing store layout, this game puts you in charge of your very own store.

Features:
* Realistic Management: Handle everything from ordering stock to pricing products and managing employee schedules.
* Dynamic Customers: Encounter a variety of customers with unique needs and preferences. Keep them happy and coming back for more!
* Store Customization: Design and upgrade your store layout to maximize efficiency and boost sales.
* Financial Strategy: Balance your budget, set prices, and strategize to grow your business from a small shop to a store empire.
* Tech & Gadget and Games Corner: Incorporate a dedicated section for the latest computer and tech products. Manage inventory for high-demand gadgets, deal with tech-savvy customers, and stay ahead of the latest trends.

Whether you're a fan of simulation games or just looking to test your retail management skills, Video Game Store offers an engaging and immersive experience. Manage your aisles, maximize your profits, and become the ultimate supermarket tycoon!
70010000087454.intro: Video Game Store: Stock, Shop, Succeed!
70010000087454.name: Video Game Store: Supermarket Simulator

70010000087464.description:
Experience the thrill of high-speed competition with Formula Racing: Grand Prix League! Discover adrenaline-pumping world of formula racing as you race against the best drivers in the ultimate Grand Prix showdown.

Features:
* Authentic Racing Experience: Feel the intensity of real-world racing with hyper-realistic physics, detailed car models, and immersive sound effects.
* Dynamic Tracks: Race on a variety of meticulously designed tracks, each with its unique set of challenges and thrills.
* International Tracks: Test your skills on renowned circuits from around the world, including tracks from iconic racing countries.
* Diverse Car Selection: Choose from a wide range of high-performance cars, each with its own unique attributes and customization options, allowing you to tailor your ride to your racing style.

Whether you’re a racing veteran or a newcomer to the track, Formula Racing: Grand Prix League offers an exhilarating blend of speed, strategy, and competition. Strap in, rev your engines, and chase the checkered flag in the race to become the ultimate Grand Prix champion!
70010000087464.name: Formula Racing: Grand Prix League

70010000087470.description:
Car Heist Simulator - Thief Mechanic invites you to test your skills in the world of car theft, where careful planning and agility are the keys to success. In this game, you’ll explore various locations, each with unique features and security levels. You'll infiltrate parking lots, private garages, abandoned warehouses, and elite parking structures to claim a wide range of vehicles—from everyday cars to rare models.

Features:
        Diverse locations for thefts: From bustling city streets to heavily guarded private garages, each location requires a unique approach, strategy, and mastery of bypassing security systems.
        Quests for each heist: To steal a car, players must complete small quests—disable cameras, pick locks, avoid guards, or cut wires. Each quest becomes more challenging as the game progresses, demanding more skills and precision.
         Interaction with guards and security systems: Cameras, patrolling guards, and other protective mechanisms add an extra layer of difficulty, requiring strategic thinking and well-planned actions.
         Challenging missions with escalating difficulty: Every subsequent mission demands more sophisticated methods, with increased security and the introduction of new defensive measures.
         Risk vs. reward balance: Every heist is a risky endeavor, but a successful job rewards players with cash bonuses and valuable resources, allowing them to expand their capabilities and upgrade their equipment.

Complete your heist, make your escape, and rise to the top as the most skilled car thief in the game - are you ready to take the risk?
70010000087470.intro: The city’s most prized cars, waiting for the perfect thief.
70010000087470.name: Car Heist Simulator - Thief Mechanic

70010000087475.description:
Step into the demanding role of a Border Patrol officer in Border Police: Contraband Simulator 2024, an immersive and highly realistic simulation game where the stakes are high and every decision shapes the outcome.Every day brings new challenges, from detecting hidden contraband to engaging in high-speed pursuits, as you work to secure the border against illegal activities. Use advanced equipment, trust your instincts, and make split-second decisions in a world of smuggling, corruption, and high-risk encounters.

Key Features

- Realistic Border Environment: Patrol a meticulously designed border landscape, from remote checkpoints to urban entry points, each presenting unique obstacles and threats.

- Interactive Vehicle Searches: Conduct in-depth vehicle inspections with specialized tools to uncover hidden compartments and concealed contraband, testing your attention to detail.

- Real-time Document Verification: Check visitor documents and spot subtle signs of forgery or expired permits, with increasing pressure as lines grow and tensions rise.

- Diverse Missions: Tackle a variety of tasks—from routine inspections to action-packed chases—as you enforce law and order across multiple terrain types.

- Choice-Driven Outcomes: Every decision you make, from arrests to negotiations, shapes the storyline and the future of your border post.

   Are you ready to uphold the law and face the daily dangers of border control? Border Police: Contraband Simulator 2024 challenges you to outsmart the smugglers and protect the frontier at all costs.
70010000087475.intro: Guard the border - Uncover lies, stop the contraband, and uphold the law.
70010000087475.name: Border Police: Contraband Simulator 2024

70010000087480.description:
Rise to the top of the K-pop charts, become the next sensation, and earn the love of fans. Lead your group to stand out and conquer the hyper-competitive music scene. In this one-of-a-kind idol life simulator, step into the shoes of a powerful manager and shape your girl group’s destiny on their journey to the Hall of Fame.

Step into the spotlight behind the scenes! Build your dream idol group as you scout rising stars, shape their weekly schedules, and guide their journey to fame. Mix work, training, and downtime to help your idols shine their brightest, while you enjoy the thrill of creating a superstar career you can’t experience in real life.

Your decisions extend far beyond management. The relationships you build and the choices you make will define your group’s future. Whether you’re offering unconditional support, navigating rivalries, or representing your group in the public eye, every action has consequences. Randomized events mirror the unpredictable challenges of the real K-pop industry, testing your judgment at every turn.

Your ultimate goal? Debut. Along the way, your trainees will face off against rivals in thrilling, RPG-style battles that will prove whether they have what it takes to shine. Once your group is ready, you’ll choose their signature look, define their fan club identity, and produce a debut album that captures their essence.

The road to debut isn’t an easy path, but it’s where every dream begins, and every step you take becomes a story worth remembering.

- Your Dream K-pop Group: Choose from eight unique trainees, from the cheerful Minji to the shy Ai, the lineup and skillset of your group is in your hands, and it's your job to shape them as stars.
- Plan Their Schedule: As the manager, it's your job to balance stamina, finances, and workload. Push your idols too hard and risk burnout, but pamper them too much and you'll quickly run out of funds!
- Relationships Matter: The bonds you build shape every outcome. Your decisions influence how each character perceives you, unlocking new encounters, storylines and endings.
- Minigames: Scout new idols, hit the right notes during vocal practice, and master dance routines in rhythm challenges. Your performance in these mini-games determines your success as an idol manager.
- Original K-pop Soundtrack: Featuring exclusive music and special vocal tracks for your group's debut, produced just for this game. K-pop fans will be clamouring for the tracklist.
- Visual Adventure: Stunning hand-drawn artwork brings a rich world to life. Beautifully animated emotions and gestures make your idols feel truly alive, letting you connect with them like never before.
70010000087480.intro: Do you have what it takes to debut the ultimate K-pop group?
70010000087480.name: K-pop Idol Stories: Road to Debut

70010000087484.description:
Navigate twisting polygonal tunnels, battle endless waves of enemies, and face off against challenging bosses across infinite sectors. Each run in this game offers a fresh, action-packed challenge.

In a world where all computers have suddenly lost their internet connections, it’s up to you to enter the mysterious UFO looming in the sky, explore its depths, and reclaim digital freedom for all!

This enhanced version of the classic brings improved visuals, reworked difficulty, new game modes, new color schemes, and much more!

- Go through endless sectors that become progressively more challenging.
- Pass through rings to level up your ship, increase your ship's speed, and unleash even more destruction!
- Unlock 64 different color schemes, and 16 unique ship designs to personalize each one of your runs.
- Face off against 3 challenging bosses that will test your reflexes.
- Switch up the action with 7 unique game modes, each delivering its own twist on the game's high-octane action.
- Join forces with up to 4 friends in local co-op, and go against waves of enemies together.
- Jam out to a pulsating, techno inspired soundtrack that will will keep your adrenaline pumping all the way through.

Ready for the challenge? Grab your copy, step into the cockpit, and blast off into the unknown!
70010000087484.intro: Blast off into Operius DX, the ultimate evolution of the popular, retro-inspired, high-speed arcade shooter, Operius!
70010000087484.name: Operius DX

70010000087489.description:
Play casino games, earn chips, and aim to become No. 1!

Share Joy-Con™, and up to 6 players can join in the fun!

[Sugoroku Mode]
Make your way across the Sugoroku board, stockpile more chips than anyone else, and become the Casino King!
Experience all kinds of events and make use of special cards to swing the game in your favor!
Nobody knows who will win until the last moment!

[Minigame Mode]
Pick from 14 casino games, including poker, roulette, and more!
Choose your favorite and play right away!

[Online Mode]
Connect with players from around the world to compete in Sugoroku or your favorite minigames!

<Skin Edit>
Create your own original style with customizable player pieces!
Design unique skins and play with them in-game!
70010000087489.intro:
Get ready for a thrilling adventure of strategy and luck!
Let's play Sugoroku Casino Party!
70010000087489.name: SUGOROKU CASINO PARTY

70010000087506.description:
Do you love pizza as much as we do? Take on the role of a crazy delivery man and supply city residents with hot pizzas. However, be careful! There are gluttons lurking around the corner who will want to pick up and eat your orders and interrupt your route! Become the supplier of the year!

Key words:

10+ characters to choose from
50+ difficulty levels
10+ cities to visit
Challenges, side quests and puzzles
Trophy system with collector's album
70010000087506.intro: Become the best pizza delivery guy in town!
70010000087506.name: The Cheese Chase: Pizza Madness

70010000087511.description:
In Wolf Pack - Howling Spirits, you step into the paws of a young wolf, chosen by the ancient guardian to embark on a profound journey. Your mission is to explore a breathtaking, open-world environment filled with towering forests, shimmering lakes, ancient ruins, and quiet human villages. In this serene yet mysterious landscape, your goal is to locate your slumbering kin—other wolves scattered across the land—and awaken them to form a powerful pack.
But awakening these wolves isn’t as simple as nudging them awake. To awake them from their ancient slumber, you must delve into their dreams, each one a unique world shaped by that wolf’s past experiences and emotions. These dreamscapes offer a variety of gameplay challenges, from navigating perilous platforming sections and solving intricate puzzles to facing intense chase sequences and uncovering hidden spirits. Every dream is a test of your skills and understanding, requiring you to help each wolf confront and overcome the issues that haunt them in their sleep.
As you progress, each awakened wolf joins your pack, bringing new strengths and abilities that allow you to explore deeper into the world.
Wolf Pack - Howling Spirits offers an immersive experience that blends exploration, action, and emotional storytelling. It’s a game about unity, growth, and the powerful bonds that can form between those who journey together. As you explore this rich world, you’ll uncover ancient secrets, confront challenges, and prepare your pack for an epic destiny, all while experiencing the world through the eyes of a wolf.
70010000087511.intro: Embark on a mystical journey in Wolf Pack – Howling Spirits, where you play as a young wolf destined to awaken ancient guardians.
70010000087511.name: Wolf Pack - Howling Spirits

70010000087514.description:
Where a simple visit to a fairground becomes a nightmarish fight for survival. You’ve heard the legends of the haunted mansion and its seven deranged psychopaths, each guarding a floor of the house, but you dismiss the warnings. As soon as you step inside, the door locks behind you. There’s no way out—except through all seven floors.

Gameplay: This is a first-person, single-player horror experience. It begins at an eerie fairground, where an omniscient narrator introduces you to its unsettling attractions. As you explore, you’re drawn to the infamous haunted house. Outside, disturbing exhibits and surreal art hint at the horrors to come. Once inside, your terrifying journey begins. The mansion has seven deadly floors, each ruled by a different psychopath representing one of the seven deadly sins. Each level is a labyrinth filled with traps, puzzles, and unique enemy mechanics. Your goal is to reach the elevator to escape, but first, you must outsmart the psychopaths. The narrator will provide hints about each killer’s weaknesses, but solving the mystery and surviving is up to you. Every floor presents a different challenge, where you’ll need to use strategy and quick thinking to avoid the killer, solve hidden puzzles, and navigate the deadly maze. As you progress, the tension rises, and the puzzles grow more complex, mixing horror, suspense, and puzzle-solving in a chilling game of cat and mouse. Can you survive the madness, outsmart all seven psychos, and escape the haunted mansion? Or will you become just another victim of the mansion’s twisted legacy?
70010000087514.intro: Face seven deadly psychopaths, each guarding a terrifying floor. Solve puzzles, avoid traps, and exploit their weaknesses to escape the nightmare.
70010000087514.name: House of Horror - 7 Psychos

70010000087517.description:
In The Last Light, set off on a moving journey through the memories of a man reflecting on his life, love, and loss. This narrative exploration game invites players to experience how love and vision are deeply connected as you move through the protagonist’s life, encountering moments of joy, sorrow, and introspection.

The story unfolds in the vibrant days of the protagonist's youth, where you relive his childhood memories alongside Emily, the love of his life. Emily isn’t just a companion—she’s his guiding light, illuminating memories and experiences as they journey through life together. But over time, the protagonist’s eyesight begins to fade, altering his world and the gameplay profoundly.

As his vision deteriorates, colors begin to drain from the environment, making it harder to navigate. Yet, Emily’s presence brings light and clarity, representing how love can brighten even the darkest moments.

Experience the stages of life, from the dreams of youth to the bittersweet reality of growing old together. The Last Light is a powerful narrative about love, memory, and time—a touching exploration of how relationships guide us through life’s most challenging passages.
70010000087517.intro: Rediscover a log lost love in a heartfelt journey through life's stages.
70010000087517.name: The Last Light

70010000087520.description:
The craziest race is about to start!

Get in your kart and race through a bunch of levels full of obstacles and other crazy surprises. In this amazing racing game, each new game generates a different track.

Can you conquer the world podium?
70010000087520.intro: Crazy racing game where the tracks change every game.
70010000087520.name: Sinvers on Wheels

70010000087531.description:
Hyper Team Recon is an adorable 3D platformer about three aliens and their adventure across Earth! Three energetic alien slimes, Ember, Penny and Lite, are tasked to travel to Earth in order to learn more about the lifeforms inhabiting the planet, using their species' unique morphing abilities to disguise themselves as girls in order to keep a low profile!

But after their ship crashes after a non-specific captain falls asleep at the wheel - *cough* Ember *cough* - The trio get split up and stranded on Earth, leading them to each traverse through a variety of locations full of platforming, puzzles and combat, meeting a lively cast of friends and foes along the way!

Tracking the slime's progress every step of the way is H.E.R.B, a helpful slime A.I who keeps up-to-date with what's happening on Earth, while using the foil collected to fill out his scrapbook, a special book to fill with foil to unlock goodies, like new outfits, bite-size challenge zones, extra cutscenes, and more!

Features:
Transform into anyone you meet - As shapeshifting alien slimes, morph into friends and foes alike to copy their forms and gain unique abilities!
Mechanics - From platforming, to puzzles, to combat, use the morphing mechanic to gain new abilities to help you in each of these fields!
Travel the world - As the slimes travel across the planet, jump, solve, and fight through various platforming challenges, puzzles and combat encounters in a variety of locations!
Collectables - Pick up foil scattered throughout the levels in order to fill out the scrapbook, as well as break open objects for even more foil! Be on the lookout for rarer collectables too, such as the 5 souvenirs hidden throughout each level!
Charming visuals - Cutesy paper inspired visuals during gameplay are paired up with expressive, animated anime models of the characters during visual novel-style cutscenes to add a further level of charm to the game's world and storytelling!
Lively cast - Meet all sorts of cute and colourful characters on your journey across Earth, from a soda-addicted teen to a jellyfish mage, all with their own forms and abilities to copy!
Unlockable extras - Complete optional goals or spend foil to fill out the scrapbook to unlock different outfits for the slimes, as well as special scenes to watch!
Replayability - Replay old levels and push your abilities to their limits to find hidden routes and collectables to clear optional objectives!
70010000087531.intro: Hyper Team Recon is an adorable 3D platformer about three aliens and their adventure across Earth!
70010000087531.name: Hyper Team Recon

70010000087534.description:
Burger Race is a simple and fun game that anyone can enjoy!
Up to 4 players can race together in local multiplayer by sharing Joy-Con™!

Every machine has a unique set of characteristics!
Will you go with raw speed? Smooth handling? The choice is yours!

Drift and dash to zip around every corner!
Use items to make your opponents slip up and crash!

Expect the unexpected as events occur during the race!
The lights could suddenly go out, or nuggets could fall onto the track!

【Time Attack】
Choose a course and record your best time!
Compete with players from around the world on the online leaderboards!

【Free Race】
Choose a course to run with friends and CPUs!
With items and special events, the racing experience is totally different from Time Attack!

【Grand Prix】
Run through several courses of your choice in order!
Accumulate wins and become the grand champion!

Enjoy playing with up to 4 players!
Challenge friends and family for 1st place and have fun!
70010000087534.intro:
Get ready to race at top speed in Burger Race!
Which machine will be the first to cross the finish line?
70010000087534.name: BURGER RACE

70010000087542.description:
PINEAPPLE spins the tale of a sweet, yet biting, revenge. You’ll devise clever pranks, placing pineapples in the most unexpected and personal spaces of the bully, driving her to the brink. But be warned: she’s not the only one who’ll learn a thing or two.

This unique prank simulator blends a humorous storyline with fun challenges, unraveling a revenge story centered on the quirks of bullying. It’s short and mischievous, but packed with meaning.

In PINEAPPLE, you’ll...
- Investigate the witch and uncover her secrets.
- Use what you’ve learned to prank her by... hiding pineapples everywhere!
- But it won’t be a walk in the park—you’ll face some hurdles if you want to become the school’s ultimate hero.

Features:
- Handcrafted illustrations: Realistic in the way that they mirror the doodles we all scribbled in our teenage notebooks.
- Humor: Bullying is no joke, but PINEAPPLE uses humor to make its message hit home, transcending boundaries.
- Music: A catchy, original soundtrack with lyrics that will have you humming along. Could this be the next summer hit?

Become the ultimate prankster by cleverly stashing pineapples in the most unexpected places until the bully loses her cool!
70010000087542.intro: Become the hero of the school by pulling clever pranks on the class bully — but as the tables turn, you might discover she's not the only one learning a lesson.
70010000087542.name: PINEAPPLE: A Bittersweet Revenge

70010000087552.description:
Welcome to Lofi Chill Sessions: Relax Island, your serene retreat where relaxation meets productivity. Set against a soothing lofi soundtrack, this gamified focus tool is designed to help you unwind, enhance concentration, and manage your real-life tasks effortlessly.

Features:
* Soothing Lofi Soundtrack: Enjoy a calming lofi soundtrack that creates a peaceful atmosphere, ideal for relaxation and improving focus as you go about your tasks.
* Pets Discovery: Explore the tranquil world of Relax Island and discover charming Pets hat add a touch of magic and serenity to your virtual environment.
* Customizable Virtual Space: Personalize your cozy island room with a range of décor options and furnishings. Create a calming and inspiring space that supports your relaxation and productivity needs.
* Task Management Tools: Utilize practical features like to-do lists and timers to help organize and streamline your real-life tasks, enhancing your overall efficiency.
* Stress Relief Features: Engage in activities designed to ease stress and promote mindfulness, helping you maintain a balanced and focused state of mind.
* Gentle Gamification: Experience a smooth and unobtrusive gamified approach that integrates seamlessly with your relaxation and focus goals.
* Beautiful Characters: Meet and interact with charming, beautifully designed characters who add personality and warmth to your virtual island, enhancing your overall experience.

Whether you’re seeking a peaceful escape or a tool to boost your productivity, Lofi Chill Sessions: Relax Island offers the perfect blend of tranquility and functionality. Immerse yourself in a soothing lofi world, customize your island room retreat, and let the calming sounds and features guide you to a more focused and relaxed life.
70010000087552.intro: Escape to serenity with every beat.
70010000087552.name: Lofi Chill Sessions: Relax Island

70010000087557.description:
Get ready for an enigmatic and challenging adventure with O.W.L Projekt, a 3D isometric puzzle game that will test your mind and logic skills. Controlling Elysion, a young being created in a mysterious experiment, you will face the enigmatic Watchers in a journey to escape and uncover secrets.

Armed with the powerful Sanctum Staff, Elysion can move objects and overcome obstacles, offering a unique and immersive gaming experience. Challenge yourself through 50 meticulously designed levels as you manipulate blocks, drag platforms, discover secret passages and climb ladders in rotating dioramas, with new mechanics introduced as difficulty gradually ramps up!

Features:

• Help guide a young experimental being as he is pursued by his mysterious creators!
• Overcome 50 environmental puzzles of increasing complexity and difficulty.
• Clear a path for Elysion using the power of his Sanctum Staff!
• Manipulate platforms, climb ladders and more in rotatable isometric dioramas.
• Enjoy a minimalistic narrative through organic storytelling!
70010000087557.intro: Guide a young being’s daring escape as you puzzle your way through isometric landscapes!
70010000087557.name: O.W.L Projekt

70010000087562.description:
Step into the prehistoric era of dinosaurs and embark on a thrilling evolutionary journey! Dinosaur RPG - Dino Survival Simulator Survivor offers a unique blend of survival, exploration, and RPG elements, all set in lush, dynamic biomes waiting to be explored.

 Here’s what you can expect:

• Evolutionary Gameplay: Experience 10 immersive chapters, each representing a different dinosaur's life. From the nimble Compsognathus to the mighty Tyrannosaurus Rex, relive the awe-inspiring life cycles of iconic dinosaurs.

• Dynamic Biomes: Navigate through dense forests, scorching deserts, roaring waterfalls, and volcanic terrains. Each biome offers distinctive challenges, resources, and secrets.

• Customization & Growth: Upgrade and personalize your dinosaurs! Enhance their speed, strength, and skills. Plus, with unique skins and roars, make your mark in the Dino Survival Simulator.

• Missions & Challenges: Overcome 50+ missions! Hunt, forage, defend territories, and engage in epic duels. Each mission is tailored to test your survival instincts and strategic prowess.

• Community & Trade: Form clans, communicate with players worldwide, and engage in resource trading. Together, dominate the prehistoric lands!

• Authentic Experience: Dive into accurate dino depictions. From their looks to sounds, experience realism like never before!

Unearth the mysteries, face ancient challenges, and rise as the ultimate dinosaur in Dinosaur RPG - Dino Survival Simulator Survivor.
70010000087562.intro: Survive the Past! Unleash prehistoric power evolve, explore, conquer!
70010000087562.name: Dinosaur RPG - Dino Survival Simulator Survivor

70010000087568.description:
SNOW BROS. 2 SPECIAL is a remake of TOAPLAN's 1994 release Snow Bros. 2. The IP license has now passed to TATSUJIN, who will continue its legacy. Enjoy the original storyline of rescuing a princess from the Demon King, but now with four protagonists whose character designs and graphics have been upgraded to fit the remake's new modern style while retaining their unique qualities.

Support for four-player multiplayer has been added, providing a variety of fun along with a number of new modes such as Original Mode, Survival Mode, Time Attack Mode and Sky Run. Players can also experience a new kind of fun by completing the game's stage as one of the many monster enemies in the new Monster Challenge mode. Last but not least, the quality of the game has been improved across the board with the addition of several new stages!

Game Features
- Experience the game in its original 1994 arcade style, or the new remake style
- Improved and modernized graphics
- Local and online co-op play for up to four players
- Exciting challenge modes including Survival, Time Attack, Sky Run.
- Take it to the next level with new stages, monsters, bosses, and more!
- Walk a mile in their shoes! Play as a variety of monster enemies in the Monster Challenge mode!
70010000087568.name: SNOW BROS. 2 SPECIAL

70010000087573.description:
Felinea Tales is a captivating 2.5D platformer where players step into the paws of Bill, a brave and agile cat. After the peaceful village of Felinea falls victim to the sinister experiments of the wizard Abyssius, Bill sets out on an epic journey to restore order and save his home.

Jump, fight enemies, and dodge dangers as you help Bill seek justice. Explore diverse worlds filled with challenges, secrets, and exciting adventures.

Designed to appeal to players of all ages, Felinea Tales offers an unforgettable adventure with nostalgic charm and a modern twist, making it a perfect choice for fans of adventure games and immersive storytelling.

Are you ready to help Bill bring justice to Felinea?
70010000087573.intro: In this thrilling adventure, help Bill, a humanoid cat, restore peace to his village after a devastating attack.
70010000087573.name: Felinea Tales
