To recreate the iconic danmaku battles of Touhou Project as a card game, Touhou: Lost Branch of Legend features more than 200 different danmaku effects.
70010000127704.intro: A Touhou Project deck-building roguelike. Unleash dazzling danmaku and hunt down the culprit who stole the treasured artifact!
70010000127704.name: Touhou: Lost Branch of Legend

70010000127752.description:
Embark on an exciting adventure alongside man's best friends. Explore vibrant new worlds, face dangerous enemies, collect coins to unlock adorable new puppies, and rescue the fourth dog, who has been kidnapped by the evil giant rat.

Play as a Shih Tzu, a Corgi, or a Bulldog, each ready to take on the adventure. Jump across challenging platforms, dodge deadly spikes, defeat both ground and flying enemies, and prove that every dog can be a Super Dog
70010000127752.intro: For those of us who have a dog, every one of them is a Super Dog. A game dedicated to all the dogs in the world.
70010000127752.name: SuperDog

70010000127787.description:
Stunning cel-shaded visuals bring an anime-style world to life, opening the gates to a battlefield that's entirely your own. Fight alongside a squad of girl soldiers on the front lines in a WWII FPS experience found nowhere else. Set against the backdrop of World War II, this story-driven single-player FPS lets you steal weapons from fallen enemies and charge straight through the chaos of war. Whether you're a military history enthusiast or a player who craves breathtaking visuals paired with a gripping narrative, this is the ultimate solo FPS made for you. Amid the gunfire and bonds forged on the battlefield, only one person can rise as the true hero, and that's you.

・Powered by a brand-new engine for smoother, more intense combat, every gunfight now feels more real and more exhilarating than ever
・Cutting-edge cartoon rendering combined with cel-shading technology delivers vivid, anime-inspired visuals, turning every battlefield moment into a work of art
・Includes wildly unexpected alternate world costumes that completely flip the main story's tone on its head. Switch into an entirely different vibe and it'll feel like you're playing a brand new game altogether, a fresh twist you won't see coming.
・A heartfelt story with a full ending sequence, follow a carefully crafted narrative all the way through to an emotional finale you won't forget
・Dialogue events and side quests woven throughout every mission, banter between squadmates and hidden quests deepen your connection to the story
・Steal weapons straight from defeated enemies, build your own unique combat style and unleash spectacular firefights with a huge arsenal at your disposal
・Historically grounded missions inspired by real events, cinematic cutscenes play after every stage clear, and a wide range of authentic WWII era weapons are ready to collect and use
・Immersive 3D audio paired with a 3D physics engine for realistic, high impact gameplay
・A wide range of 3D effects and battlefield graphics that capture the tension of total war
・Cooperative combat alongside AI controlled allied soldiers for deeper tactical play
・Cover based combat using environmental objects for intense, authentic firefight tension

Charge through iconic, historically inspired battles from World War II and take down every enemy in your path. Complete every episode and an unforgettable, emotional ending awaits you at the finish line. A brand new engine combined with cel-shaded visuals delivers an immersive experience like nothing you've played before. Download now and step into a war story that's entirely your own!

Prologue
After the end of World War I, Germany struggled to accept the reality of defeat. Rather than offering reconciliation, the Treaty of Versailles ensured the nation could never rise as a dominant power again. Crushing reparations led to excessive currency printing, triggering runaway hyperinflation that devastated the economy.

Rather than easing the people's suffering, the nation's leaders exploited nationalism to consolidate power. Radical nationalist sentiment spread rapidly as people, humiliated and impoverished, began yearning for a strong leader and a return to former glory. Amid this turbulent atmosphere, a charismatic young girl skillfully harnessed the anger and resentment of the masses, rapidly building her own power base.

Then in 1939, Nazi Germany's invasion of Poland ignited the flames of World War II. Amid the smoke and chaos of the battlefield, a squad of girl soldiers carrying the weight of destiny emerged. A story never told before, one where girl soldiers take center stage in a war unlike any other, is about to begin.
70010000127787.intro: An all-new squad of beautiful girl soldiers rewrites history in this one-of-a-kind World War II universe! A brand-new engine delivers an epic evolution unlike anything you've played before!
70010000127787.name: Girls Wars 1939

70010000127795.description:
Note:
This game focuses on Japanese-style psychological horror and subtle, atmospheric fear.
It is not based on jump scares, action, or chase scenes.
Your task is to observe real-world locations in Japan and report any abnormal phenomena.
Inspired by Japanese urban legends, this experience blends horror with visual attention.
You may find the horror “quiet”—but it lingers in your mind.
If you enjoy subtle, unsettling vibes over gore or action, this game is for you.

ーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーー

To All Employees,
You are a surveillance officer of Japan Stigmatized Property
Operate the security cameras installed throughout the property and monitor for any signs of anomalies
If you discover anything unusual, report it immediately
Failure to report anomalies or repeated mistakes will result in a mission failure
Conversely, if you can maintain surveillance from midnight to 5 a.m., the mission will be considered successful

[Mission Features]
You will be assigned to real-life properties located within Japan
Anomalies will occur randomly
Be aware of phenomena that can only be observed through either the night vision camera or the regular camera

[Examples of Anomalies]
Furniture moving, objects disappearing or appearing
Intrusion by human figures or spirits
Lighting malfunctions, floating orbs
Bloodstains on walls, video distortion
And other phenomena beyond imagination

[Work Hours]
You will be in charge of 4 properties in total
Surveillance duties run from 12:00 a.m. to 5:00 a.m.
Choose between 'Nomal' or 'Special Pay' Assignment difficulty modes

[Other Notes]
Streaming and broadcasting while conducting duties is permitted.
We place no restrictions on monetization or Super Chats.
Submission of permission requests is not required for either individuals or corporate entities.

Please commence your duties.
70010000127795.intro: Can you endure until morning Monitor Japan's stigmatized properties and report any paranormal activity If you miss a report or make repeated mistakes——
70010000127795.name: Japan Stigmatized Property -日本事故物件監視協会-

70010000127799.description:
Japan Stigmatized Property2
To All Personnel:
We appreciate your dedicated efforts in the previous surveillance operation.
Please be advised that the risk level for the current assignment has significantly increased.
You are required to exercise extreme caution while performing your duties.

You are an observer for the "Japan Stigmatized Property Association" (JSP).
Your duty is to monitor surveillance cameras installed in designated properties and check for any anomalies.
Upon discovering an anomaly, you must report it immediately.
Repeated failure to report or excessive false reports will result in "Mission Failure." Conversely, maintaining successful surveillance from 00:00 to 05:00 constitutes "Mission Success."

【Operational Features】
Real-World Locations: You will be assigned to properties that actually exist in Japan.
Randomized Anomalies: Irregularities occur randomly.
Camera Modes: Be vigilant for phenomena visible only through specific equipment (Night Vision or Standard Camera).

【Examples of Anomalies】
Movement of furniture; disappearance or appearance of objects.
Intrusion by human figures or spiritual entities.
Lighting malfunctions; floating orbs.
Bloodstains on walls; video feed noise/interference.
"Something" beyond imagination.

【Shift Details】
Assignment: 4 total properties.
Hours: 00:00 – 05:00 (Midnight shift).
Difficulty: Selectable between "Normal" and "Special Pay" (Hard).

【Others】
Streaming and broadcasting while conducting duties is permitted.
We place no restrictions on monetization or Super Chats.
Submission of permission requests is not required for either individuals or corporate entities.

Please commence your duties.
70010000127799.intro:
Can you survive until dawn?
Monitor real Japanese properties and report every anomaly.
70010000127799.name: Japan Stigmatized Property2 -日本事故物件監視協会-

70010000127825.description:
Jump into a thrilling anti-gravity racing experience with this complete 3D bike game built for fast-paced arcade action. Ride futuristic bikes across challenging tracks filled with sharp turns, ramps, obstacles, and high-speed gameplay designed to keep players engaged from start to finish.

The game includes polished bike controls, responsive movement, smooth camera systems, and immersive visual effects that create an exciting racing atmosphere. Multiple gameplay systems are already integrated, allowing developers to quickly customize tracks, environments, bikes, UI elements, and game mechanics for their own unique project.

Designed with optimization and flexibility in mind, the project is suitable for creating sci-fi racing games, stunt challenges, endless riding modes, or competitive time-trial experiences. Clean project organization and ready-to-use assets help accelerate development while maintaining high visual quality and enjoyable gameplay performance.

Whether you're building a futuristic racing title or expanding your existing arcade game collection, this game provides a strong foundation for delivering intense speed, stylish visuals, and adrenaline-filled bike action.
70010000127825.intro: Race through futuristic tracks and defy gravity in this fast-paced 3D bike racing game.
70010000127825.name: FlipRide Rush

70010000127837.description:
Aircraft are moving one after another. Grant takeoff and landing clearances and direct taxiing and gate routing.
Select approach courses and instruct aircraft to adjust flight speed.
Use a variety of ATC commands to avoid danger and keep the airport safe!
All 40 stages will put your brain to the ultimate test!

This popular simulation series lets you step into the tower and master the art of airport traffic control!
With simple, intuitive controls, anyone can play! Just select the best command for each dynamically changing situation.
Take on 40 challenging stages, including high-stakes scenarios where you are dropped instantly into sudden emergencies and chaotic traffic jams!
The setting is "Centrair" (Chubu International Airport, Nagoya), a real-world Japanese maritime airport operating with just a single runway.
Experience air traffic control like a 3D puzzle while enjoying realistic, high-fidelity scenes of the airport and airplanes!
70010000127837.intro: You are the Air Traffic Controller! Issue commands and ensure airport safety!
70010000127837.name: I am an Air Traffic Controller AIRPORT HERO Centrair EX

70010000127855.description:
Welcome to Make It Cozy!

Create the sweetest little home and share it with the cutest animal friends imaginable!

Step into a charming world filled with soft colors, cozy corners, and adorable companions waiting to move in. Design dreamy bedrooms, sunny living rooms, peaceful reading nooks, relaxing bathrooms, and magical outdoor spaces — then watch them come to life with playful kittens, a curious fox, a cheerful penguin, a tiny hedgehog, and many other fluffy friends.

Every room is a place where memories are made. Arrange comfy furniture, decorate with lovely plants, hang cute decorations, and create warm spaces where your animal companions can feel safe, happy, and loved. Whether you prefer a pastel paradise, a cozy cottage, or something wonderfully unique, your imagination is the only limit.

Relax, decorate, and enjoy the gentle atmosphere as your tiny residents explore the home you've created just for them. Every smile, nap, and playful moment makes your cozy world feel even more magical.

KEY FEATURES:
- Design and decorate adorable cozy homes and beautiful outdoor spaces
- Meet charming animal residents including kittens, foxes, penguins, hedgehogs, bunnies, and more
- Hundreds of cute furniture pieces, plants, and decorations to personalize every room
- Warm pastel visuals and relaxing music that create a peaceful atmosphere
- Endless creative freedom to build your dream cozy retreat
- Watch your lovable animal friends enjoy and explore their new home
- Perfect for players who love cozy vibes, cute animals, creativity, and relaxing gameplay
70010000127855.intro: Unleash your creativity in a cutest possible way!
70010000127855.name: Make It Cozy!

70010000127861.description:
Knot My Job is a 100% touch-controlled puzzle game exclusive to the handheld mode of your Nintendo Switch™. Use your fingers directly on the screen to unplug, move and plug cables into their correct places. Help the neighbors and bring order to the chaos!

Features:
• 100% touch control: Play naturally by dragging cables directly with your fingers.
• 50 brain-teasing levels: Overcome 50 unique puzzles with a perfect difficulty curve for quick sessions.
• Colorful visuals: Enjoy clean, relaxing and highly intuitive 3D graphics.
• A charming story: Accompany a funny technician and his dog through delightful cutscenes.

Get your fingers ready and prove there is no knot you can't handle!
70010000127861.intro: Untangle the chaos in Knot My Job!
70010000127861.name: Knot My Job

70010000127889.description:
Weekend Solitaire: Voyage offers a colorful array of puzzles through a gentle cascade of challenges.
As you navigate through vibrant and dynamically animated levels, your strategic mind is both soothed and tested, immersing you into a relaxed, yet focused state.
With every card turned and each layout solved, the game crafts an inviting and seamless experience, designed to delicately engage and guide you through the subtle mastery of solitaire.

130 Meticulously Designed Levels Across Four Distinct Card Decks!
Weekend Solitaire: Voyage extends an invitation to explore 130 meticulously designed levels, played across four distinct card decks.
The game intertwines obstacles that keenly beckon your tactical insights with bonuses that appreciatively reward your strategic play.
The narrative unfolds where every card and each layout becomes a chapter of a story, melding tranquility and strategy into a singular, engrossing experience.
70010000127889.intro: Embark on a Serene Journey with Weekend Solitaire: Voyage!
70010000127889.name: Weekend Solitaire Voyage

70010000127902.description:
Welcome to the only taxi company where the driving is done for you, and all the action happens in the backseat. Engage the autopilot and prepare to mess with your passengers. Will you be a five-star professional or the ultimate backseat menace? The choice is yours. Each passenger in your cab is a fully interactive, physics-based rag doll that reacts dynamically to your every move. You can tap the glass, poke them, or tease them. Or, you can just sit back and watch them throw a ridiculous, cartoonish tantrum.

Expect the unexpected on every ride. What will you do if a passenger starts dancing wildly, tries to pick a fight, or demands that you pop a giant pimple on their face? Grab your tools and dive into the madness! Turn up the multimedia, blast their eardrums, spray them down, and test out wild new prank items to see how they react. In this interactive playground, you are the director of the chaos. Annoy them on purpose or try to calm them down. How you handle the ride is completely up to you.

The wilder the ride, the better the stories. Earn cash and driver ratings based on how you handle each crazy encounter. Use your hard-earned tips to unlock more ridiculous prank tools, upgrade your cab's interactive features, and purchase supplies to clean the backseat after a disastrous ride.

Jump into a non-stop comedy show where you always deliver the punchline.
70010000127902.name: Mad Taxi Simulator

70010000127910.description:
STREET UNi X is a retro-callback to the extreme sports games that took over during the cusp of the new millennium. Fuelled by a passion for this era of gaming, and an obsession with the burgeoning sport of street unicycling, daffodil & friends have crafted STREET UNi X to cater to classic video game fans and unicycling aficionados alike!

With unique controls that capture the nuanced capabilities of unicycling, and the nostalgic goal oriented gameplay rush of video games past, STREET UNI X is guaranteed to leave you at the edge of your seat and wall-tapping to your next grind!

This new release is fired up with hot-tricks, more music, and a deeper dive into the heart of street unicycling, featuring in-game texts from daffodil and other riders from around the world!

Features

The world's first authentic street unicycling video game! Taking the sport as seriously as the pros with expressive keyboard/gamepad controls, infectious energy, and tricks you didn't even know were possible!

Join the ranks of contemporary pro unicyclists! Hop, grind, wall-tap, footplant, rail-ride, and twist your way through a full career mode with secret riders to unlock and hidden tricks to reveal!

Fresh retro looks! Real-life inspired spots transformed into yester-console playgrounds for you to explore and combo your way to unlocking secrets and besting your high scores!

Off the rails tracks! Featuring 20+ horn-fuelled ska bops and powered up hardcore punk bangers from your new favourite bands that will keep you humming to yourself and bobbing to the beat!

No unicycling experience required! Learn how to ride a virtual unicycle that will have you up and rolling in no time, and unleashing hi heat combos and hot-tricks soon after, even if you question reality itself!
70010000127910.name: STREET UNi X

70010000127926.description:
The witch's cauldron is full of kittens. Drop magic eggs into the cauldron and let them merge. Match two of a kind and something bigger appears, climbing from a tiny caracal all the way up to a golden tiger. Easy to pick up, hard to put down.

Merges score points, points become stars, and stars go into the witch's album to unlock new breeds and awaken new forms. Chain your merges for glowing combos. Clear the cauldron completely for a Perfect Round. And take care with a spell that isn't ready yet — unfinished magic turns your cats to quiet stone.

Every few rounds the witch leans in with a word of advice, a bit of lore, or a small proud smile when you beat your best.

Features
• Cosy merge puzzle — easy to learn, hard to stop
• 11 elemental cat breeds and 33 forms to hatch, grow and collect
• A magical album to fill
• Stars, upgrades and combo chains for players who like to optimise
• A friendly witch companion who follows you through every round
• Storybook art in warm candlelight colours and an original cosy soundtrack
• No timers, no rush — play one round in five minutes, or stay with the kittens all evening

How many kittens can one cauldron hold?
70010000127926.intro: Merge magic eggs, hatch enchanted kittens and fill the witch's album with every form.
70010000127926.name: Magic Kittens Merge

70010000127935.description:
You were just in the wrong place at the wrong time. The justice system threw you away for life for one fatal mistake, picking up the weapon at an active crime scene. However, you refuse to rot in prison for another man's crime. It's time to take your fate into your own hands.

Your grand escape begins beneath the tattered carpet of your solitary cell. Armed with only a metal spoon, slowly carve out a tunnel to freedom. As you dig deeper, you will uncover lost valuables and raw materials buried in the dirt. Sell this contraband to corrupt guards or trade it with fellow inmates on the black market to earn upgrades, energy, and toilet paper, the ultimate prison currency.

But digging is only half the battle. Survival requires perfect timing and nerves of steel. When you hear the guard's heavy footsteps approaching, you must quickly cover your tracks. Flush the loose dirt down the toilet, kick the carpet back over the hole, and hide your spoon under the bed before cell inspections begin. Make one clumsy move and you will lose everything. Manage your stamina, hustle the underground economy, and dig your way back to your old life!

Key features:
• The Great Spoon Escape: Use a simple dining utensil to secretly dig a huge tunnel right under the warden's nose.
• Leave No Trace: Frantically flush dirt, hide your tools, and fix your carpet before the guards spot you.
• Prison Black Market: Scavenge for hidden valuables and trade with inmates or corrupt guards to upgrade your gear.
• Manage your stamina. Digging is exhausting. Spend your hard-earned cash to restore energy and sleep to survive another day.
• High Stakes Stealth: Stay completely under the radar. If you get caught, you will lose your contraband and progress!
70010000127935.name: Dig Out of Prison

70010000127944.description:
From a mountain ambush and a night raid in a border city, to storming an armed stronghold on the Caspian coast and a final push into an underground ICBM silo. Warhead Vanguard puts suffocating tension and full tactical freedom in your hands. Armed militants have crossed the border and seized missiles that were supposed to be long decommissioned. Sending in conventional forces is off the table. Diplomacy has failed. There is nothing left to negotiate. You are the last option.

・Brand-new 3D physics engine with real-time reactions to destruction, ballistics and impact!
・Next-generation shaders deliver cinematic-quality rendering of metal, fabric, dust and steel surfaces!
・Story-driven missions with clear, real-world-style objectives for every operation!
・Go in loud, go in quiet or call in fire support with total freedom to choose your approach!
・Full loadout customisation with weapons, optics, suppressors and tactical gear combinations!
・Four massive combat zones covering mountain terrain, a border city, a Caspian industrial port and an underground ICBM silo!
・Engine optimisation keeps the frame rate rock-solid through massive enemy encounters and explosive set pieces!

Warhead Vanguard was designed and built from day one to deliver hard-hitting action. A physics environment that reacts instantly to everything you do, visuals pulled straight from a blockbuster film, and mission design that punishes every mistake. When all three lock together, you are the operator. The mission clock is ticking. Get in there now.

Prologue
A government convoy is ambushed deep in a mountain range near the border. RPG and machine gun fire hit simultaneously, and the attackers take out the lead and rear vehicles first to seal off any escape. When the shooting stops, they strip the convoy of its military hardware and a classified project known only as "WARHEAD", then disappear across the border. The whole thing is over in under ten minutes. By the time reinforcements show up, there is nothing left but burning wreckage.

Days later, some of the stolen gear turns up on the black market. Equipment that should never have been accessible to any militia. Not long after, government vehicles start getting hit all across the border city. Checkpoints are attacked every night. Patrol units vanish without a trace. Then a video drops showing a government officer being taken captive, and word comes in that a strategically critical port on the Caspian coast has fallen to the armed group. Buried under that territory are ICBM silos that were supposed to have been taken offline years ago, along with a nuclear fuel reprocessing facility that could bring them back up to full operational status.

Intelligence moves to lock down the area, but it is already too late. Drone footage shows armed vehicles rolling into the facility in a steady stream. Mercenaries, insurgents and smuggling networks pour in together, and the entire zone turns into a fortified stronghold almost overnight. Sending in a conventional force is not an option given the global political situation. There is only one play left. Insert a small special operations team to pull out the hostages, take down the leadership and recover "WARHEAD". In the dark, the operators start moving.
70010000127944.intro: Hostages. A stolen top-secret project "WARHEAD". You're the only one going in. Warhead Vanguard is a hardcore tactical TPS with next-gen 3D physics!
70010000127944.name: Warhead Vanguard

70010000127963.description:
A murdered drifter awakens- alive again, seconds before his death. Hunted and haunted, help him untangle a mad web of conspiracy in this fast-paced point 'n click thrill-ride.

FEATURES

• A Pulp Adventure Thriller from the minds that brought you Crawl.
• An engrossing roller-coaster of a story- Drawing on King, Crichton and Carpenter, with a dash of 70s Aussie grindhouse.
• Unique twin-stick controls built ground up for both handheld and couch play!
• Bursting with raw crunchy pixel art and high-impact animation.
• Professionally voice acted, with a brooding dark-synth cinematic score.

SYNOPSIS

Mick Carter's been drifting a while now- moving from job to job, never staying one place long. Jumping a box-car to his old home town, he witnesses a violent murder, is pursued by hi-tech soldiers, thrown in a reservoir and drowned.

And that's just the start of Mick's problems.

His consciousness ripped away, thrust back into his own body seconds before his death...

Framed for the killing he witnessed, tormented by his own past, and haunted by the feeling that something followed him back from the other side...

Follow Mick as he's sucked headfirst into a lunatic web of shadowy corporations, murder, and the thousand-year obsession of a madman.

GAMEPLAY

The Drifter is our take on a classic 2d point and click adventure- with the brake-lines cut. The focus is on fast-paced storytelling, with puzzle-solving being the glue that ties it together. Mick's a practical guy, and so puzzles are down-to-earth too, designed to be unobtrusive, and give an investigative feel.

We're keeping the pacing quick and lean, you'll never be wandering around lost or confused- Mick is propelled through the story at a good clip, from one situation to another, with barely a moment to catch his breath. One minute you'll be crafting a Molotov cocktail from a bottle of over-proof rum, the next interrogating a crooked neurosurgeon before swinging from a high-rise window by a fraying extension lead.
70010000127963.intro: A pulp adventure thriller – Enhanced for Nintendo Switch™ 2
70010000127963.name: The Drifter – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000127965.description:
One day, you suddenly find yourself imprisoned by a clingy menhera girl.
Now trapped, you are forced to play blood-staked Chinchirorin against her.

Before you run out of blood, meet each day’s quota and keep her satisfied.
If you fail to satisfy her, then you...

・Face Menhera-chan’s oh-so-generous rules every day
Menhera-chan’s additional rules will stand in the way of reaching your quota.
Sometimes, you’ll need to predict what rules she might add and plan your build and strategy accordingly.

・Use every cheat you can to survive!
Every day, you must play Chinchirorin and overcome the ever-increasing quotas by making full use of cheats.

Amulets grant effects just by having them.
Items activate their effects when used.
You can even modify the faces of your dice. Want to make every side a "1"? Go right ahead.

Build the optimal setup for each situation and answer Menhera-chan’s impossible demands.

Survive 7 days and see how your story with Menhera-chan comes to an end.
70010000127965.intro:
"Let's play together… forever, okay?"
Survive 7 days and see how your story with the clingy menhera girl (CV: Yuko Natsuyoshi) comes to an end.
70010000127965.name: Menherarium

70010000127971.description:
Descend into a frightful world of action-adventure in Mina the Hollower. Take control of Mina, a renowned Hollower hurtled into a desperate mission to rescue a cursed island. Burrow beneath hazards and monsters, whip foes into oblivion, and gear up with an arsenal of sidearms and trinkets. Explore a vast world filled with pixel-perfect graphics, masterful gameplay, beastly bosses, and infectious music. Encounter a cast of bizarre characters, search out secrets in an array of exotic locales, and illuminate the omnipresent darkness in Mina the Hollower, a brand new game from the developers who brought you Shovel Knight!

Features:
- Hauntingly authentic 8-bit visuals, refined for the modern era.

- Modern touches abound: detailed animation, widescreen visuals, and rock-solid controls!

- Leap, dodge, and burrow through the ground to battle monsters or navigate the world.

- Lash at foes with your trusty whip, Nightstar- or choose from an arsenal of weapons, each with a totally different move set.

- Discover and utilize a reliquary's worth of unusual Sidearms to gain the advantage in combat.

- Collect and equip Trinkets to acquire a variety of exotic effects. Level Mina up to suit your unique playstyle.

- Electrifying 8-bit inspired soundtrack by chiptune virtuoso, Jake Kaufman.

- Descend into the depths of madness with a bone-chilling, yet heartwarming tale inspired by Victorian Gothic horror.

- Explore a huge, dark world brimming with secrets, challenging battles, and interconnected level design.
70010000127971.intro: A bone-chilling 8-bit action-adventure, refined for the modern era and enhanced for Nintendo Switch™ 2.
70010000127971.name: Mina the Hollower - Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition

70010000127986.description:
The year is 2099. The line between reality and the virtual world has disappeared.

Step into a fully immersive virtual world powered by cutting-edge Full-Dive technology. Join investigator Rapid and genius hacker Lena as they uncover the truth behind a mysterious series of incidents.

Veiled Edge is a 2D action-adventure combining fast-paced combat, detailed pixel art, and diverse gameplay styles. Master platforming and intense battles while using hacking abilities to alter the environment, reveal hidden paths, and overcome challenging stages.

Each chapter introduces unique settings and gameplay mechanics, offering fresh experiences throughout your journey. Explore cyberpunk cities, theme parks, research facilities, and more as you battle powerful enemies and bosses to expose a massive conspiracy.

Features
Beautiful pixel-art cyberpunk world
Fast-paced 2D action and platforming
Hack the environment to solve puzzles and progress
Unique gameplay in every chapter
Story-driven sci-fi mystery
Hidden routes and optional challenges to discover
70010000127986.intro: A 2D action-adventure set in a stunning pixel-art cyberpunk world.
70010000127986.name: Veiled Edge

70010000127992.description:
"ACE DRIVER VICTORY LAP" is a racing game released by NAMCO LIMITED (current Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.) in 1996.
The hit arcade racer ACE DRIVER returns with more speed, more excitement, and more competition than ever before!
Race across brand-new tracks, experience fully redesigned machines, and take on thrilling high-impact courses.
With authentic handling and enhanced gameplay, every lap delivers fast-paced arcade racing at its best.
Get behind the wheel and experience the next evolution of ACE DRIVER!

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.

*The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.
70010000127992.name: Arcade Archives ACE DRIVER VICTORY LAP

70010000128023.description:
Classic literature meets classic gaming in Jane Austen's 8-bit Adventure! This 2D platformer stars Jane Austen herself, the beloved English novelist, who finds herself transported into an 8-bit video game.

Explore 8-bit England, battle characters ripped straight from Austen's novels, and defeat enemies the only way a proper author knows how — with a quill. Collect the scattered pages and restore Miss Austen's books to the 8-bit library before it's too late!

- Battle characters from Jane Austen's novels
- Explore 8-bit England
- Defeat enemies with a quill
- Restore Miss Austen's books to the 8-bit library
70010000128023.intro: She wrote the rules. Now she's breaking them — with a quill.
70010000128023.name: Jane Austen's 8-bit Adventure

70010000128029.description:
Turn mixed-up photo panels and complete bright, summer-themed pictures in this casual rotation puzzle.

Look closely at each panel, find how the image connects, and rotate the pieces until the full photo comes together.

How to play:
・Check the direction of each photo panel
・Select panels that are facing the wrong way
・Rotate them to complete the picture

The rules are simple and easy to understand, making it a good choice for short breaks, relaxed solo play, or playing together with family and friends.

If you get stuck, the hint feature helps you keep going, so even puzzle beginners can enjoy each stage at their own pace.

Complete sunny resort-style photos one by one and enjoy a light puzzle experience that tests your observation skills!
70010000128029.intro:
Rotate each photo into place!
A relaxing summer puzzle for quick play
Enjoy solo or solve together with friends
70010000128029.name: Resort Beauties : HENTAI Photo Puzzle

70010000128035.description:
In the far-off future of 20XX, the brilliant roboticist Dr. Otto Matton builds the two most advanced humanoid robots ever created: Zed and Zee. But when they learn that their purpose is to lead Matton's army of super bots to world domination, they rebel against their creator and his sinister ambitions. Now it's up to them to put a stop to Dr. Matton's schemes and prevent the world from falling into his hands!

Run, jump, and stomp through six colorful worlds of fast-paced, arcade-style action! Passwords allow you to pick up where you left off last time! Play solo or cooperatively with a friend, or settle your differences in the two-player Battle Mode!

• Play solo or team up! You can take on Dr. Matton's robotic hordes alone, but teaming up with a friend is even better!
• Six unique worlds! Save the city of Mechtropolis, dodge flying buzzsaws in the Wired Woods, and brave the heat of the Infernal Factory!
• A colorful cast of enemies! Relentless plasma tanks, flying luchador masks, and unpredictable robo-frogs are just some of the threats you'll encounter on your mission!
• Challenging boss encounters! You may be able to defeat Dr. Matton's army of grunts, but can you survive the massive Super Robots waiting for you at the end of each world?
• 2-Player Battle Mode! When you need a break from saving the world, challenge your friend to a match in Battle Mode and determine who the real robot master is!
• Genuine 8-bit action! Zed and Zee isn't just retro-"styled"—it's a real 8-bit game designed for 8-bit console hardware!
70010000128035.name: Zed and Zee

70010000128068.description:
You wake up locked in a single room with three other girls, complete strangers, forced to play a killing game none of you agreed to.

Search every corner, solve twisted puzzles, and win every macabre challenge you come across, because in this game, only one of you walks out alive.

Every girl beside you is hiding something, and figuring out who you can trust matters just as much as any puzzle.

Are you good enough to be the one who survives?


FEATURES:

● A ROOM FULL OF TWISTED PUZZLES: Every corner hides a new macabre challenge you must beat to survive.

● SHE'S ALWAYS WATCHING: The woman behind this killing game controls every rule, and she's never far.

● FOUR GIRLS, FOUR SECRETS: Tense conversations between challenges reveal who you can trust, and who's lying.

● EVERY CHALLENGE COUNTS: Losing isn't an option. Every challenge you beat keeps you in the game.

● MULTIPLE ENDINGS: Only one girl makes it out alive. Your choices decide who it is.


Four girls. One locked room. Only one will survive.
Do you have what it takes to be her?
70010000128068.intro:
Four girls. One locked room.
Only one will survive.
Will it be you?
70010000128068.name: Death Room: A Psychological Horror Killing Game

70010000128076.description:
Step into the role of a truly hands-on mayor and shape your town from the ground up.

Plan neighbourhoods, optimise logistics networks, and help your community grow - all while juggling workers, infrastructure, suspiciously large tools, visiting robots, aliens & dinosaurs, and the general day-to-day chaos of building your dream town.

And when mayoral duties get a little much, take a break with a spot of fishing, have a spin on the Go-Kart track, or even high-five a cow.

Play solo for perfect control, or bring friends for co-op mayhem.

Grow Your Town

Lay down your streets, then place businesses, homes, and services where they’ll thrive. Welcome tourists, keep them happy, and give them plenty of reasons to stick around and make your town their home. Hire workers, keep shops stocked, and make sure the money keeps flowing, then upgrade, expand, and unlock new ways to help your town flourish.

Optimise, Automate, Prosper

Tailor each business, industry zone and building configuration to suit your wants and needs. Assign workers, optimise supply chains, set-up logistics networks and watch your systems flourish. Will you let automation do the heavy lifting, or will you be the Mayor of Micromanagement?

Bring The Style

As mayor, style starts at home, but it doesn't stop there. Dive into immersive house customisation with full 360° placement and a handy colour picker, then take that creative control across your town with recoloured buildings, and plenty of ways to make every street, shop, and neighbourhood feel uniquely yours. Need a new look while you work? Step into the Change-O-Tron and emerge as the mayor you were always meant to be. Your town. Your mayor. Your style.

Chaotic Co-Op

Team-up with up with another mayor, in either local and online play for just the right amount of teamwork and chaos. Build together, manage together, panic together, and discover how quickly a carefully planned town can go sideways when everyone has a different idea of ‘helping’.
70010000128076.intro: Time to roll up your sleeves, Mayor!
70010000128076.name: Go-Go Town! – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000128154.description:
Get ready for a chaotic driving adventure where teamwork means everything!

Drive through massive obstacle-filled tracks across a variety of unique biomes and dangerous locations. From collapsing bridges and deadly traps to crazy jumps and narrow paths, every run is a challenge.

Play solo or with a friend in local split-screen co-op. In Chained Drivers, both vehicles are connected by a chain, meaning every move matters. Pull your partner to safety… or accidentally drag them into disaster!

Looking for a different experience? Try additional game modes without the chain, challenge yourself in hardcore mode with no checkpoints, or relax in Free Drive mode where you can explore the map, hit ramps, perform stunts, and enjoy the satisfying vehicle physics and destruction system.

Watch your truck bend, break apart, lose wheels, and barely survive intense crashes thanks to dynamic vehicle damage and physics-based gameplay.

Every run tracks your completion time, so improve your skills, beat your records, and master every obstacle.

Features:

▶ Local split-screen multiplayer
▶ Unique chained co-op gameplay
▶ Huge obstacle-filled maps
▶ Multiple biomes and locations
▶ Hardcore mode with no checkpoints
▶ Free Drive sandbox mode
▶ Dynamic vehicle damage and destruction
▶ Physics-based driving chaos
▶ Time records and replayability

Can you survive the road together?
70010000128154.intro:
Two cars. One chain. Total chaos.
Drive, survive, and try not to drag your partner into disaster.
70010000128154.name: Chained Drivers

70010000128227.description:
Build your career as a city taxi driver in Taxi Life Simulator. Pick up passengers, navigate through the city, and deliver them safely to their destinations while earning money from every completed trip.

Every passenger brings a new journey and another opportunity to grow. Explore the city streets, manage your time, choose your routes, and work toward earning enough to improve your vehicle or eventually get behind the wheel of a new car.

As your career develops, you can also personalize your driver and give your vehicle a look that suits you. Start with a simple taxi and work your way toward becoming a successful driver known throughout the city.
70010000128227.intro: Pick up passengers, drive, repeat. Your taxi career starts here.
70010000128227.name: Taxi Life Simulator

70010000128260.description:
Enter a dark and dangerous fantasy realm where every battle tests your skill, timing, and courage. In this challenging third-person action RPG, you play as a lone warrior fighting through cursed lands filled with deadly enemies, hidden dangers, and towering bosses inspired by classic soulslike adventures.

Master responsive melee combat, dodge devastating attacks, and strike back with precision as you explore atmospheric environments packed with secrets and rewards. Gather souls from fallen foes to strengthen your character, improve your abilities, and adapt your combat style to survive increasingly difficult encounters.

Use powerful sword-throwing attacks, tactical movement, and careful resource management to overcome relentless enemies and massive boss battles. Your journey culminates in an epic final confrontation against a colossal dragon in a cinematic showdown that will push your skills to the limit.

With stylized visuals, intense combat, rewarding progression, and unforgettable encounters, this adventure delivers a thrilling action RPG experience for players who crave challenge, exploration, and legendary battles.
70010000128260.intro: Forge your legend in a brutal fantasy world inspired by classic action RPGs. Master fast-paced melee combat, dodge deadly attacks, and collect lost souls to upgrade your warrior.
70010000128260.name: Dragon Soul

70010000128276.description:
The city is full of people who need a ride - and you're the one who gets them there.

Take orders, pick up passengers, navigate through city streets, and deliver them to their destinations. Every completed trip keeps you moving and brings a new passenger, a new destination, and a new challenge.

Learn the city, discover new routes, and become more confident behind the wheel as you take on more rides. Keep an eye on your surroundings, choose your routes wisely, and make every trip count.
From your first ride to becoming a trusted driver, every journey is another step forward.
70010000128276.intro: Passengers are waiting, journeys are calling.
70010000128276.name: Taxi Crew Simulator

70010000128321.description:
Tilt The Entire Course
Mini-golf just got flipped on its head. Instead of swinging the club, you tilt the entire course to guide the ball to the hole. Master momentum, angles, and gravity as you roll through tricky hazards, dodge obstacles, and sink the perfect shot.

300 Holes Across 15 Unique Biomes
Tee off across 300 levels spread throughout 15 biomes, each introducing new mechanics, hazards, and twists. From precision putts to gravity-defying trick shots, every course challenges your ability to read the green.

Chase the Perfect Round
Quick-fire levels and instant restarts make it easy to jump back in for just one more putt. Shave seconds off your time, refine your line, and master that “motion-in-one” perfect shot.

A Budget-Friendly Birdie
Packed with hours of gameplay, replayability, and satisfying physics-based challenges, Tilt it! Golf delivers a full round of fun for about the price of a coffee. No expensive country club membership required.
70010000128321.name: Tilt it! Golf

70010000128327.description:
Feel the tires scream, the engine roar, and the asphalt disappear beneath you as you push every corner to the limit! Enter a high-speed world of precision drifting where split-second reactions, perfect control, and fearless driving are the keys to becoming a true drift master.

Choose your favorite car from the very beginning and hit the track with nothing holding you back. Throw your car into every corner, control the slide, balance the throttle, and chase the perfect drift as you take on increasingly demanding challenges. Every turn is an opportunity to prove your skill, and every mistake can cost you the perfect run.

Key Features:
	•	5 Cars Available From the Start: Choose from 5 unique cars and start drifting immediately.
	•	20 Challenging Levels: Master 20 tracks filled with demanding corners and technical turns.
	•	Advanced Drift Physics: Control every slide with responsive handling and realistic weight transfer.
	•	Master Every Curve: Improve your lines and drifting technique across every challenging track.
	•	Immersive Racing Audio: Feel every drift with roaring engines and screeching tires.


Choose your car, fire up the engine, and put your drifting skills to the ultimate test. Hold the slide, conquer every corner, and become the driver everyone remembers!
70010000128327.intro: Choose your car and start your drifting journey.
70010000128327.name: Car Drift Simulator 2027

70010000128339.description:
Help Hazel to renovate a Living Room, Bedroom, Study and Dining Room with real world furniture!
Play lots of hidden object games and loads of mini games.
Earn money to be able to buy nice furniture to renovate the rooms.
Decorate with hundreds of furniture pieces and learn fun facts at the same time.

- Redesign fabulous living spaces
- Over 400 real world furniture items
- Play 25 different game modes
- Learn fun-facts about being a real designer!
- Fun hidden objects scenes and mini games
70010000128339.intro: Help Hazel redesign client homes in this fun Hidden Objects game, "Home Designer: Home Sweet Home".
70010000128339.name: Home Designer: Home Sweet Home

70010000128359.description:
William James Magnus III has been murdered, and you’re the only one with the investigative know-how to interrogate the other passengers and find the true culprit. But, with the train barreling towards the station, you only have so much time to solve the case before the murderer gets away.

Framed as a classic choose-your-own-adventure novel, Murder on the Disorient Express takes the best aspects of your favorite mystery novels and adds an interactive twist. Choose who you speak to, what you investigate, collect evidence, and make your final deduction based on limited information. Choose wisely, or the culprit will get off scot-free.

With only so many possible conversations to have and options to explore, Murder on the Disorient Express can’t be fully experienced in one playthrough. Take different paths and follow different leads to get a complete view of the events in additional playthroughs.

Talk with a cast of colorful characters, collect clues, and manage your time to seek out over a dozen possible endings. Unlock them all to see the full story.
70010000128359.intro:
An interactive murder mystery on the world famous train!
Step into the role of a cunning detective tasked with solving a perplexing murder before time runs out.
70010000128359.name: Murder on the Disorient Express

70010000128361.description:
What started as a late-night dare has turned into a desperate fight for survival. You are trapped in an abandoned school with a demonic entity that has possessed your best friend. Armed with only a flashlight, you must navigate the eerie, pitch-black hallways and classrooms to find a way out. You cannot fight back against the spirit. Your only options are to run, use stealth to stay out of sight, and listen closely for the terrifying sound of her approaching footsteps.

Your survival depends on navigating a dynamic, escalating threat system. The entity knows you are trying to leave. The closer you get to escaping, the more aggressive and enraged she becomes. The hunt intensifies, her patrols tighten, and the pressure mounts. You must time your movements perfectly to slip past her while searching for the exit.

As the spirit's anger reaches its peak, the horror spills over into reality. The environment warps, blood fills your vision, and sinister glitches attempt to trick your mind and break your focus. Maintain your composure, manage your limited visibility, and outsmart the deadly entity hunting you in the darkness. Will you survive the night, or will the school claim another victim?
70010000128361.name: Seishin

70010000128390.description:
In this classic hidden object game, Hazel wants to help her aunt with home refurbishment.
Sell off the old stuff and renovate the empty living room with real world furniture and design the room of your dreams!
Offering tons of Hidden Object modes: Picture, Word, Silhouette, Spot the Difference, and many more!

Play a variety of great minigames like Match-3, Card Memory, Jigsaw Puzzles, or skip them if you're not in the mood.

- A classic HO game with tons of objects to find
- More than 150 choices of furniture to decorate
- Hidden Objects scenes in more than 15 different ways
- 5 different mini-game typs, including Match-3
70010000128390.intro: Great home renovation adventure in cozy atmosphere.
70010000128390.name: Home Designer: Living Room

70010000128413.description:
In Junkyard Builder: King Of Scrap, the ultimate version to experience the game,  you’re the proud owner of a once-forgotten junkyard, now brimming with endless potential. Dive into the satisfying world of restoration, recycling, and raw hustle as you transform trash into treasure and rise to become the ruler of the junk empire!

Hunt for Treasure: Drive to new locations and explore the world for rare finds.

Make Money & Upgrade: Make the most of the items you find and earn money to level up your skills, buy the machines, and unlock better tools to streamline your operations.

Process Trash: Process the junk to make it more valuable. Every bit counts!

Find Rare Items: Search the junk for valuable items like money or gold bars.

Restore & Renovate: Bring old, rusty items back to life—whether it’s an old car or dilapidated furniture, your skills can make them valuable again.

Master the Machines: Operate powerful tools and machinery, from tower cranes to scrap presses that can crush entire cars.

Try Your Luck: Spend your hard-earned cash on mystery containers and uncover the surprises hidden inside. Will you strike it rich or find nothing but junk?

Grab your work gloves, fire up the machines, and get ready to rake in the profits—because in this junkyard, one person’s trash is your ticket to wealth. Build your junk empire and become the king of scrap!
70010000128413.name: Junkyard Builder: King Of Scrap

70010000128415.description:
You've already traveled with us from Portland to Florida, but the adventures don't end here!
This time, the beloved family returns behind the wheel to take part in America's grand motorhome rally.
In Motorhome: Traveling America 4, expect the same warm encounters and cozy evenings, but now the route is full of unexpected twists.
This isn't a race for speed, it's a competition of impressions, where every day brings new stories.

Why you'll love this game:
- Exciting adventures! From everyday moments at the laundromat to thrilling tales of catching thieves.
- The spirit of freedom behind the wheel: join a friendly motorhome race, discovering hidden paths and secret locations along the route.
- Collect memories: Gather unique souvenirs — instead of baseball caps, now you'll find memorable keepsakes from each state.
- Preserve the moments: Take photos for your family album, continuing your personal travel story.
70010000128415.intro: Remember that feeling of wind in your hair and the endless road?
70010000128415.name: Motorhome: Traveling North America 4 Collector's Edition

70010000128429.description:
Charge down endless action-packed tracks in a fast-paced hyper casual runner shooter where every second counts. Blast through waves of enemies using dual guns while constantly sprinting forward, moving side to side to avoid danger, jumping over obstacles, and ducking under deadly hazards.

Each run lasts around 30 to 40 seconds and delivers nonstop arcade action. Enemies block your path and fire back, forcing you to react quickly and shoot accurately to survive. Break through walls by unloading enough bullets to destroy them before impact, and stay alert for dangerous traps including spinning spikes, saw blades, and rotating obstacles designed to stop your run.

As the challenge increases, use the coins earned during gameplay to upgrade your fire rate, shooting distance, and reload timing to become stronger and push further into harder stages. Unlock new character skins and powerful weapon designs to customize your style while taking on increasingly intense runs.

Easy to pick up and hard to put down, this endless runner shooter combines fast reflex gameplay with satisfying upgrades and nonstop action.
70010000128429.name: Blast Dash

70010000128435.description:
System Shock® 2: 25th Anniversary Remaster by Nightdive Studios brings to you the modernized remaster of the FPS/RPG classic, featuring Cross-Play Co-Op multiplayer and more.

It’s the year 2114 and as you awake from cryo sleep on the FTL ship Von Braun, you are unable to remember who or where you are… and something has gone terribly wrong. Hybrid mutants and deadly robots roam the halls while the cries from the remaining crew reverberate through the cold hull of the ship. SHODAN, a rogue AI bent on the destruction of mankind has taken over and it's up to you to stop her.

Delve through the corridors of the derelict ship Von Braun and immerse yourself in the story rich atmosphere and environments. Explore deck by deck and unravel the horrifying fate of the Von Braun and her crew.


System Shock® 2: 25th Anniversary Remaster Key Features:

Cross-Play Co-Op multiplayer.

Choose from 3 branches of the Military; O.S.A, Marines or Navy and experiment with different play styles.

Enhanced Characters, Weapon Models and Animations.

Optimized Controller support.

Quality of Life Improvements.
70010000128435.intro: How can you challenge a perfect, immortal machine?
70010000128435.name: System Shock® 2: 25th Anniversary Remaster - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000128451.description:
As you investigate the mansion and its surrounding laboratories, you’ll uncover cryptic clues, interact with unusual mechanisms, and slowly piece together the story behind the doctor’s terrifying machine. Hand-crafted pixel-art visuals, moody environments, and a haunting soundtrack create an immersive gothic atmosphere that pays homage to classic adventure and horror games while delivering its own unique identity.

Designed for players who enjoy mystery, retro aesthetics, and thoughtful exploration, The machine of madness offers a suspenseful journey through secrets, experiments, and forgotten memories where every room hides another piece of the puzzle.
70010000128451.intro: A dark, atmospheric adventure inspired by classic storytelling, where you explore the eerie mansion of Dr. Jeffrey. Featuring hand-drawn visuals, gothic horror vibes.
70010000128451.name: Machine of Madness

70010000128469.description:
Down Pit is a relaxed mining platform game set across many off-world underground locations. You are a cuboid mining unit with a singular skill set sent out to extract ore from strange underground places.

Dig.
Get Paid.
Upgrade.
Relax, maybe.
Collect.
Go Back Down Pit.
Dig.

Find your favourite location and dig all the ore. Return to Ore Processing and get paid.  All the pit locations from The Depot can be remined infinitely, for free - no unlocks, bail at any time with no penalty. Dig in your favourite mine again and again, and get paid.

Yes to Digging.
Yes to Getting Paid.

No to enemies, combat, secrets, story, unlocks, card games, skill trees, pets, fishing, timers, npc interruptions, never ending dialogue, walls of text, power of friendship, ancient evil force, lost parents, lost items, lost love, missing pets, self-asteem whining, neuroses listing, dot dot dotting, time wasting, anime, pixel art, anime inspired pixel art, faff.

Dig. And Get Paid.

There’s unlimited money to make with just you and all those mining areas to destroy, one block at a time. You arrive ready to mine, all equipment supplied, all ready to work. All the money is yours because only you will mine it out.

Teleport Down Pit is to the left (Dig).
Ore Processing is to the right (Get Paid).

Lots of other utilities are in The Depot but be careful not to get too distracted, some are costly, some will drain your time. Warning: the poker game does not work and never will (it is a long term programming issue caused by a fool).

Dig. And Get Paid.
70010000128469.name: Down Pit

70010000128476.description:
Is your "common sense" really up to global standards?

Which one is the Nile? Who built the pyramids? What's the largest planet in our solar system?
You should know these — but when asked, the answer slips away.
How far does your knowledge really reach?

This game serves up 50 visual quiz questions across 8 categories: nature, geography, astronomy, science, history, sports, food, and art & culture — all rooted in worldwide common sense.

Read the question, then choose the correct answer from 4 images.
"Oh, I know this!" or "Wait, which one is it?"
Compare and decide — a 4-choice visual quiz.

How to play is simple.
・Read the question
・Pick the correct answer from 4 images
・Stuck? Open the hint for a clue
・After answering, learn more from the detailed explanation

Get it right and feel great. Miss it and learn something new.
By question 50, the world feels a little closer.

Squeeze in a quick brain refresh on your commute, on a break, or before bed.
Perfect for sparking "Did you know?" conversations with family and friends.

So — can you make the cut?
Take on the worldwide common sense challenge.

The game supports both button controls and touch controls, allowing you to play in TV mode, handheld mode, or tabletop mode.
70010000128476.intro:
Could you hold your own anywhere in the world?
The global common sense every grown-up should know.
70010000128476.name: Can You Make the Cut? Worldwide Common Sense Check

70010000128483.description:
Discover surprising facts about the human body through fun and engaging quiz challenges!

・How many times do we blink in an hour?
・How many more bones does a baby have than an adult?
・If the Earth were flat, how far could the human eye see?

Learn fascinating trivia about the human body that you'll be excited to share with friends.

The game also includes a helpful Hint feature, making it enjoyable for players of all knowledge levels.

Looking for a fun and easy way to learn about the human body in your spare time? This game is a great place to start.

Recommended for people who:
・Love trivia and fun facts
・Want to expand their knowledge
・Enjoy testing themselves
・Like brain-training games while passing the time
・Dream of working in a medical or healthcare field

※This game is designed to be played on the Nintendo Switch™ in vertical orientation.
70010000128483.intro:
Are Your Bones Really Harder Than Steel?!
Become a Body Expert Through Fun Quizzes
70010000128483.name: Whys & Wonders Secrets of Our Bodies

70010000128489.description:
Discover surprising facts about space through fun and engaging quiz challenges!

・Which planet rotates the fastest?
・What existed before the Sun was born?
・What does outer space smell like?

Learn fascinating space trivia that you’ll be excited to share with friends.

Complete all the quizzes and earn your place as a true space expert!

The game also includes a helpful Hint feature, making it enjoyable for players of all knowledge levels.

Looking for a fun and easy way to learn about space in your spare time? This game is a great place to start.

Recommended for people who:
・Love space and astronomy
・Want to expand their knowledge
・Enjoy testing themselves
・Like brain-training games while passing the time
・Dream of becoming an astronaut

※This game is designed to be played on the Nintendo Switch™ in vertical orientation.
70010000128489.intro:
What Does Space Smell Like?!
Become a Space Expert Through Fun Quizzes
70010000128489.name: Whys & Wonders Secrets of the Universe

70010000128499.description:
■ Build Your Team with Your Favorite VTubers!
Over 350 VTubers from a wide range of genres—including game streamers, singers, ASMR creators, and illustrators—join the battle!

Every VTuber featured in the game can be used as your protagonist. Choose your favorite VTuber and take on the challenge!

■ Extensive Card Collection
Each of the 350+ VTubers has cards with different rarities!
Collect every card featuring your favorite VTubers and complete your collection!

■ Game System
Experience a unique blend of Card Game × Auto-Battle × Roguelite gameplay.
Set five cards and strengthen stats such as HP, ATK, DEF, MAG, MDEF, and SPD to defeat your rivals. Collect stronger cards as you progress and take on increasingly powerful opponents!

■ Skills & Levels — Every Card Has a Chance to Shine!
A card's strength is determined by its level and rarity, rather than the character itself.

Cards featuring the same VTuber can have different levels, while higher-rarity cards come with additional skills.

This means every card has its own potential and can play an important role in your strategy!

■ Estimated Playtime
A single run takes approximately 1–2 hours to complete.

With card and skill collection, you can enjoy 100+ hours of gameplay!

■ Live Streaming
Monetization
Monetization of live streams and videos featuring this game is permitted.

Monetization through video-sharing websites and live-streaming platforms is also permitted.

Streaming Content
You may stream all scenes and content from the game.

Other Guidelines
There are no specific restrictions on streaming the game as long as it is used within the scope of normal gameplay and content creation.

However, the game features many VTubers. Please remember to treat all featured creators with respect.
70010000128499.intro:
Choose your “oshi” from 350+ VTubers!
Battle your way through Roguelike, Card Game, and Auto-Battle gameplay!
70010000128499.name: VTBattle It’s Not About Subscribers! It’s All About Power.

70010000128506.description: Trapped within a decaying asylum consumed by darkness and despair, you must uncover the horrifying truth hidden behind its abandoned halls. In this psychological horror experience, isolation becomes your greatest enemy as disturbing echoes, twisted visions, and unseen threats blur the line between reality and madness. Explore oppressive environments, solve unsettling mysteries, and survive terrifying encounters where every sound could be your last. The deeper you descend into the asylum, the more the past refuses to stay buried.
70010000128506.intro: A psychological horror experience where isolation is your greatest enemy. Explore abandoned asylum, uncover disturbing secrets.
70010000128506.name: Retro Asylum

70010000128534.description:
On a stormy night, guests gather at an old manor.
Use the text and illustrations as clues to uncover the mystery behind a missing invitation.

The rules are simple.
Read each question, observe the people and objects on the screen, and choose the answer that seems most suspicious.
Each correct choice brings you one step closer to the truth.

Explore atmospheric scenes such as the entrance hall, guest rooms, and portrait gallery, each with its own mystery to solve.

No complicated controls are needed, making it easy to enjoy for mystery fans and first-time puzzle players alike.
When you get stuck, hints help you keep going and think through each case at your own pace.

Recommended for players who enjoy:
・Short mystery puzzles
・Reading text and finding clues in illustrations
・Observation, deduction, and brain-training games
・Playing solo or discussing the answer with family and friends
・Classic manor mysteries with invitations, servants, secrets, and suspicious guests

Listen to the rain, examine every clue, and reveal the truth hidden inside the manor.
70010000128534.intro:
A mystery in a rainy manor
Read the clues and observe
Find the hidden truth
70010000128534.name: Mystery at Rainy Night Manor: The Missing Invitation

70010000128546.description:
Take the controls of real JR-West trains in this authentic railway driving game, officially licensed by West Japan Railway Company (JR-West).

■ The exhilaration of the Special Rapid Service

Drive the famous Special Rapid Service non-stop from the very first station of the Keishin Line all the way to the terminus. On quadruple-track sections, blast past local trains one after another for a rush of speed only this train can deliver. Direct Rapid and local services are fully drivable too.

■ Every line, every section, both directions

Three fictional lines inspired by the region — the Ohan East Line, Ohan West Line, and Keishin Line — with every section drivable in both directions. A massive amount of track that rewards every hour you put in.

■ Drivable trains

Drive the 221, 223, 207, and 321 Series, plus the 227 Series appearing as a special test-run train.

■ A series first: the driving score system

Your accuracy behind the controls — departing on time, passing stations on schedule, keeping to speed limits, stopping precisely at the mark — is rated as a score, so you can feel yourself improving with every run.

■ Boost your score with your card deck

Set cards in your deck before each run. Meet the scoring conditions to earn bonus points based on each card's multiplier.

The cards feature a spectacular lineup of 14 train series, including limited express trains: the 223, 221, 321, 207, 227, 287, 283, 289, 281, 271, 683, 225, 115, and 485 Series.

Match cards of the same type to double their values with Chemistry, collect cards of the same station for a station score bonus, and upgrade your cards to build the ultimate deck. New cards are obtained through an in-game gacha — there are no paid purchases.

Struggling with the controls? A clever deck can still carry you to victory. A master driver with a weak deck will find high scores out of reach. Driving skill and deck strategy: two ways to play, one deep experience.

■ Mascon controller support

Compatible with the ZUIKI MasCon for Nintendo Switch™ and the Densha de GO!! One Handle Controller for Nintendo Switch™ (電車でGO!!専用ワンハンドルコントローラー for Nintendo Switch™) for an even more realistic driver experience.

■ Recommended for

- Train and railway fans

- Anyone who loves Japan's Kansai region

- Deck-building and card game enthusiasts

- Owners of a mascon-style train controller

In-game languages: Japanese, English
70010000128546.intro: Drive real JR-West trains! An authentic, officially licensed railway driving game.
70010000128546.name: Train Plus Japan Drive Western Japan Trains! Rapid Service Edition

70010000128587.description:
They took his favorite toy. They picked the wrong monkey.

What was supposed to be the first day of school turns into an all-out rescue mission when a gang of bullies steals Punch Monkey’s most treasured possession.

PUNCH MONKEY REVENGE is a stylish action adventure packed with slow-motion stunts, fast combos, cartoon chaos, and one very determined little primate.

Slow down time in mid-air to dodge attacks, dive through danger, and pull off the perfect comeback. Chain together punches, kicks, spins, tumbles, and environmental attacks as you fight your way through classrooms, hallways, playgrounds, and more.

Turn almost anything into a weapon. Grab slingshots, banana guns, lunch trays, dodgeballs, and whatever else you can get your hands on to send the school’s toughest bullies flying.

Every encounter is built for cinematic action and slapstick comedy. Leap over attacks, improvise with your surroundings, and turn each fight into your own over-the-top action scene.

The bullies have the toy.

Punch Monkey is coming to get it back.

• Stylish slow-motion action
• Fast, expressive combo combat
• Ridiculous weapons and environmental attacks
• Cartoon comedy and cinematic stunts
• Battle through a school full of increasingly tough troublemakers
• One small monkey with a very big reason to fight
70010000128587.intro:
They took his favorite toy.
Now this little monkey is fighting through the whole school to get it back.
70010000128587.name: Punch Monkey Revenge

70010000128603.description:
Get ready for a delicious, fun, and fast-thinking adventure in a world where every delivery needs to be perfect. In Chico’s Delivery, you control an adorable pizza-delivery bird that slides endlessly across the environment, turning every stage into a clever and irresistibly addictive puzzle.

But reaching the destination is only part of the challenge. Every table has a counter that decreases with each movement you make, creating a strategic race against time and against your own mistakes. Carefully plan your route, choose the perfect path, and figure out how to serve every table before the orders expire.

The biggest twist comes from the way Chico moves. Once he starts sliding, he only stops when he collides with a wall, obstacle, or environmental object. This turns every movement into an important decision where predicting trajectories and thinking several steps ahead becomes essential for success.

As the journey continues, new mechanics make the puzzles even more creative. Use pizza teleporters, deal with rising tables, take advantage of directional arrows, and learn how to manipulate the environment to create perfect deliveries. Every level introduces a fresh situation that demands observation, logic, and strategy.

With cute visuals, a cozy atmosphere, and clever challenges, Chico’s Delivery offers the kind of relaxing and satisfying experience that makes you want to play “just one more level.” It is the perfect balance between accessible puzzles and increasingly strategic decisions.

Perfect for fans of logic games, casual challenges, and adventures full of personality, Chico’s Delivery transforms simple pizza deliveries into a fun, charming, and surprisingly strategic journey.

Observe the stage, slide through the perfect route, and make sure no pizza arrives late.
70010000128603.intro: Slide, Deliver, and Save Pizza Day
70010000128603.name: Chico's Delivery

70010000128629.description:
Could your observation and memory rival a master detective's?

"Wait... what color was the sofa?"
"Was there an animal by the window?"
The more you try to recall, the more the scene fades away.

This game is a memory puzzle where you step into a detective's shoes. Memorize each scene for 60 seconds, then answer 4-choice questions about the tiny "evidence" hidden in the details.

Crime scenes, dusty studies, attics, gardens, train compartments…
Burn the details of many different scenes into your memory.

How to play is simple.
・Observe every corner of the screen for 60 seconds
・When the image is masked, answer the 4-choice question
・Get it right and the original scene reappears

The frustration of "I didn't notice that!" and the satisfaction of "Got it!"
Solve the mysteries of all 50 stages with your memory alone.

Quick to play in short sessions, perfect for training observation and memory like a true detective.
Squeeze in some brain exercise on your commute, during a break, or before bed.

Find the missing evidence — in your mind.
Can your memory uncover the truth?

The game supports both button controls and touch controls, allowing you to play in TV mode, handheld mode, or tabletop mode.
70010000128629.intro:
60 seconds to memorize the scene.
Can you find the missing evidence in your mind?
70010000128629.name: Memorize the Evidence.1-Minute Memory Mystery

70010000128636.description:
A time-traveling RPG adventure from Masato Kato, creator of countless classic RPGs
Product Summary
Aldo embarks on an adventure beyond time and space to save his sister, Feinne, from the clutches of the beastfolk.

A richly woven tale by scenario writer and director, Masato Kato, unfolds across the ages, alongside a main theme composed by Yasunori Mitsuda, music incorporating traditional folk instruments and an orchestra by Procyon Studios, and a stellar voice cast.

The strategic command battles, which feature exhilarating actions like chain skills that trigger successive strikes, and Another Force that allows a barrage of attacks, can be fought with original parties composed from a total of 19 characters.

After clearing the main story, New Game+ offers a new adventure filled with new faces and over 10 different endings based on your actions and choices.

◆Strategic Command Battles
The lands of Another Eden are rife with monsters—run into them to initiate a command-based battle and take them down.
Create your own original parties, unleash chain skills, and create chains to trigger successive strikes!
Unleash a flurry of attacks with Another Force to beat your enemy into submission!

◆Befriend and Forge Meaningful Bonds with 18 Allies
18 allies of different races and eras await Aldo on his journey.
Allies' stories are told through various quests. Encounter quests depict their first meeting with Aldo, character quests reveal their past and purpose, and kinship quests explore their relationship with Aldo.

◆Embark on a New Adventure with New Game+
Complete the main story to unlock New Game+ and embark on a new adventure with your allies as they are!
New Game+ also introduces a brand-new character, Ramiu, and features over 10 different endings based on your actions and choices.

◆New Features to Enrich Your Time-Traveling Adventure
Enrich your adventure beyond time and space by logging the feline friends you encounter in the cat catalog, and creating weapons, armor, and food from different eras with the crafting feature.
70010000128636.intro: Now begins an RPG beyond time and space
70010000128636.name: Another Eden Begins Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000128645.description:
"I'm just playing a game, but somehow my workplace English is getting better."
Want to experience this ultimate two-for-one deal?

Enjoy 4-choice quizzes while quickly mastering the "real-life English idioms" that native speakers naturally use in business settings.

Playing is super easy：
・Read the question and the target word carefully.
・Pick your answer from the 4 choices.
・Get it right to unlock detailed explanations you can use right away in your actual business emails and conversations!

No typing or complicated controls needed!
It's totally fine if you're feeling a bit rusty with your English.

If you get stuck, our friendly hint feature has your back. You can soak up knowledge like a fun trivia game, completely stress-free with no ""Game Over"" screens to worry about.

Thanks to the fast-paced, one-question-at-a-time format, it's perfect for sneaking in some playtime during your daily commute or while waiting for a meeting to start!

Turn your daily ""mindless screen time"" into meaningful self-investment. Level up your English skills and seriously impress your coworkers and business partners!
70010000128645.intro:
Master the business English native speakers actually use!
Have fun leveling up your skills through quizzes!
70010000128645.name: Manga English Native Phrase Quiz

70010000128660.description:
The summer roster has one spot left, and every player on the sand wants it just as bad as you do. Off the court, the real competition starts.

One reads every move you make and expects the same back. One only warms up once you've earned it. Another flirts hard until the score gets close, then turns cold and competitive without warning. And the captain trusts no one who hasn't proven they belong.

Say the right thing and the tension breaks. Say the wrong thing and you're benched.

Thirty days until the season opener, and every day you waste, someone else closes the gap.


Features:

● A ROSTER FULL OF COMPETITIVE PERSONALITIES: A deep bench, and every player is a completely different game to win. Some want a rival. Some want a partner. All of them want proof.

● DIALOGUE CHOICES THAT MATTER: Every response you give shifts the dynamic. Push too hard and you lose ground. Read the room right and the walls start coming down.

● CHARACTER AFFINITY SYSTEM: Build real trust through practices, downtime, and late-night talks after the lights go out. The harder she is to reach, the more it means when she lets you in.

● EXCLUSIVE GALLERY IMAGES: Unlock stunning illustrations as each relationship deepens. Every player has her own story waiting past the final point.

● MULTIPLE ENDINGS: Your run through the season is yours alone. Some routes end in romance. Some end with you watching from the bench.

● 30 DAYS TO MAKE THE TEAM: The season opener is locked in and the clock doesn't wait. Every wasted day is a spot someone else claims instead of you.


One roster. One summer. Only one of you makes the team and it might not be you.

Who are you willing to fight for?
70010000128660.intro:
The roster's stacked. One spot left. Win it, and win them.
Think you've got what it takes to make the cut?
70010000128660.name: Beach Volleyball Girls: Hot Spike

70010000128670.description:
Scritchy Scratchy is a super-satisfying scratch card incremental game where luck is your weapon, and glittering riches are just a scratch away.

Dive into a growing collection of scratchers, each with its own quirks, surprises, and sometimes downsides. Rip through tickets, uncover rare symbols, tweak your own luck, and chase absurd payouts.

Unlock Scratch Bot, your tireless mechanical friend who scratches and reveals the rewards for you. Turn your run into a full-blown jackpot engine as your balance shoots through the roof while you sit back and relax.

As you prosper, you’ll unlock upgrades that twist luck in your favor:

• Boosted odds and payouts
• Faster and easier scratching
• New scratch card variants with unique rules

But power always comes with risk. Some cards tempt you with monstrous payouts at the cost of nasty penalties. Some offer steady income… others threaten your entire run. Will you play like a sensible adult or gamble like a degenerate in a neon casino?

When you’re ready for even more madness, Prestige to reset your run, gather Jack Points, and spend them on permanent upgrades that reshape your strategy. Build your own luck engine: Slow and steady, wildly explosive, or pure chaos.

Scritchy Scratchy is a dangerously satisfying progression casino, where every scratch is a little dopamine hit, and every run is one lucky break away from the big jackpot!
70010000128670.intro: Scritchy Scratchy is a super-satisfying scratch card incremental game. Buy stacks of scratch-offs, unlock auto-scratching, and chase massive jackpots. Will you play it safe or go all-in?
70010000128670.name: Scritchy Scratchy

70010000128704.description:
