Whether you want a quick 5-minute mental workout, a deep dive into advanced vocabulary, or a high-stakes run in Streak Mode, this game offers endless hours of educational and addictive puzzle fun. Sharpen your wits, expand your vocabulary, and become the ultimate word champion today!
70010000130052.intro: An addictive Lingo-style word puzzle! Play through the map or start a streak!
70010000130052.name: Lingix Lingo

70010000130082.description:
The resources you collect can be spent in the Skill Tree to unlock permanent upgrades. When it comes to dangerous viruses, you can never be too careful!

Recruit allies from the Deck and create an effective formation where everyone complements each other's abilities.

Need support from a distance? Let your minions handle it. They may be tiny and adorable, but they're more than capable of taking care of the dirty work.
70010000130082.intro: Protect your brain from viruses in Increbraintal, an incremental auto-battler. Build your team to eliminate the infection that's taking over the body.
70010000130082.name: Increbraintal

70010000130091.description:
Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest is an immersive action-adventure game set in the Lake Territories of the beloved Warrior Cats book series.

Embark on a variety of quests to gain favor with your Clan and battle others in turn-based combat to strengthen your cat and grow your legend. Learn new combat moves to take down your rivals. Encounter a wide range of enemies, including mice, squirrels, badgers and more, all leading to epic battles. Forage the land and find materials that can be used to craft items in your den. Travel across iconic territories including ThunderClan’s dense forests, RiverClan’s marshlands, ShadowClan’s dark pine swamps, and WindClan’s open moors. Your adventure will also take you to the famed sacred locations The Moonpool and The Island. Climb trees, pounce through undergrowth, track scents, solve environmental puzzles, and uncover the mysteries of StarClan itself.

AN ORIGINAL STORY
Embark on a brand-new journey with iconic cats and locations from the Warrior Cats franchise.

CREATE YOUR OWN WARRIOR CAT
Using the robust cat creator, name and create your very own Warrior Cat.

GAME FEATURES:
* 3 Game types: Prophecy Mode, Defender Mode, Skirmish Mode.
Prophecy Mode - Four original stories about the trials and tribulations of Clan life.
Defender mode -  Test how long you can last while battling all of the game’s fiercest enemies in a single run.
Skirmish mode -  Battle other players online asynchronously.
* Create your own unique Warrior Cat with millions of possible customization combinations.
* 6 iconic locations from the book series: ThunderClan territory, RiverClan territory, ShadowClan territory, WindClan territory, The Moonpool and The Island.
* Turn-based combat system with up to 3 versus 3 battles.
* 75 unique combat moves to discover and unlock.
* Interact with 9 cats from the beloved book series.
* Battle a large variety of enemies including badgers, vicious foxes, imposing Dobermanns, rival Clan cats and many more.
* Track and hunt birds, rabbits, squirrels and other prey.
* Visit your friend's camp online asynchronously.
* You can also help friends with by crafting items or gifting them necessary resources and materials.
* No two playthroughs are the same as characters, quests and stories are procedurally generated.
70010000130091.intro: Forge your destiny, defend your Clan, and live the life of a true Warrior Cat.
70010000130091.name: Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest

70010000130112.description:
Race against the clock as you rewind tapes, restock shelves, manage impatient customers, and keep the Friday night rush from turning into a complete disaster. Every second counts when there's only one rewinding machine and a store full of people demanding their movies now.

Can you survive three increasingly hectic shifts and become the ultimate VHS clerk, or will your customers leave before the credits roll?

Be Kind, Rewind. The fate of movie night is in your hands.
70010000130112.intro: The fate of movie night is in your hands.
70010000130112.name: Be Kind Rewind

70010000130120.description:
Enjoy a 4-choice quiz game based on the science found in everyday life.

From bubbles in fizzy drinks and photosynthesis in plants to pencil cores and metals used in wires, each question is inspired by familiar things you may see around you.
With 100 questions included, you can check your knowledge at your own pace.

How to play is simple!
・Read the question and look at the illustration
・Choose the answer from 4 options
・Try to clear all 100 questions

Simple controls make it easy for children, adults, and families to enjoy.
Play alone for a quick knowledge check, or discuss the answers with family and friends.

Discover the small science wonders hidden all around you!
70010000130120.intro:
Discover the science hiding in everyday life!
Answer quick 4-choice quiz questions
100 wonders for kids and adults
70010000130120.name: Science Trivia Quiz 100 Wonders

70010000130129.description:
Jump into a fast-paced, endlessly replayable action platformer where precision movement and quick thinking are the keys to survival. In Numerous Ninjas, you guide a growing team of agile ninjas through an ever-changing series of hazard-filled chambers designed to test your reflexes and adaptability at every turn.

Run, leap, and scale walls as your ninja squad navigates dangerous environments packed with traps, shifting obstacles, and unpredictable layouts. Each run pushes you further into increasingly difficult challenges where timing and positioning matter just as much as speed. One mistake can end your attempt—but every new run offers a fresh chance to improve.

Master fluid movement mechanics as you bounce between surfaces, avoid deadly hazards, and chain together precise maneuvers to stay alive longer. The action escalates quickly, demanding focus and rewarding players who learn to read the environment and react with confidence under pressure.

Along the way, discover helpful power-ups that can turn the tide of a run, offering temporary advantages or new survival options. Strategic use of these boosts can mean the difference between an early exit and a record-breaking run.

With its focus on replayability, Numerous Ninjas encourages players to refine their skills over time, chasing higher scores and longer survival streaks. Whether you’re playing in short bursts or committing to mastering its systems, every attempt feels dynamic and unpredictable.

Simple to pick up but challenging to master, Numerous Ninjas delivers an intense arcade-style experience built around momentum, precision, and survival. How far can your ninja team go before the chambers finally defeat them?
70010000130129.intro: Guide a team of ninjas through endless chambers packed with traps, power-ups, and surprises. How long can your clan survive?
70010000130129.name: Numerous Ninjas

70010000130142.description:
At first glance, it looks like an ordinary photo.
But look closer, and something that should not be there may be hiding in plain sight.

This is an observation and deduction game where you search photos for anomalies and unnatural details.
Take your time, compare what you see, and pin down the source of the strange feeling.

How to play is simple!
・Study the photo from corner to corner
・Use the prompt as your clue and look for the suspicious spot
・Choose the point you think is the answer

Odd details blended into everyday scenes, things that do not quite add up, and subtle anomalies are waiting to be found.
Some are easy to notice. Others may only stand out after a careful second look.

No complicated rules needed.
It is easy to enjoy in short sessions, whether you want to focus on your own or talk it through with family and friends.

Recommended for players who like:
・Observation puzzles and visual mystery games
・Strange photos and mysterious situations
・Testing deduction, insight, and focus
・Quick brain-training games for spare moments
・Solving little mysteries with family or friends

Do not let the hidden oddities slip past you.
Find every anomaly concealed in the photos.
70010000130142.name: Do Not Find It: Anomaly Photo Files

70010000130149.description:
Think a simple set of numbers or letters is easy to read?

Those familiar-looking patterns can turn tricky once the hidden rule is just out of sight.

This is a text-based 4-choice logic puzzle game where you observe the question, spot the rule, and choose the answer that fits.

There are 40 stages to clear, built for quick brain-training sessions with number, letter, and reasoning-style challenges.

How to play is simple!

・Read the question carefully
・Look for the hidden rule or shared pattern
・Choose one answer from four options
・Check the explanation after answering

Even when you miss, the explanation helps you see the logic and try the next puzzle with a sharper eye.

Recommended for anyone who enjoys number puzzles, pattern quizzes, quick thinking, and casual brain training.

Use your observation and reasoning skills to clear all 40 stages!

Button controls and touch controls are supported.
70010000130149.intro:
Can you crack the pattern?
Train logic in quick rounds
70010000130149.name: IQ Logic Codes: Number & Letter Puzzles

70010000130163.description:
MUCHI MUCHI PORK! & PINKSWEETS BOOSTED
With this collection, you’re not just getting one fantastic shoot ’em up, but two! This Boosted re-release features a fully arranged soundtrack with brand new tracks from a fresh lineup of arrangers. (These differ from the 2011 console version.) In addition, you get several different game modes, including Arcade and Arrange, Online Rankings that let you compete with players worldwide, and Local Replay Support where you can save your best runs for review. A tasty deal indeed!

MUCHI MUCHI PORK!
The 2007 game Muchi Muchi Pork! is the bizarre story of three females who have been transformed into pig girls. They must now fight back against the nasty alien General Pork Fillet using flying militarized exercise bikes. By collecting pigs descending with parachutes you fill up the special lard meter, and if you destroy enemies with your lard attack, they will drop medals shaped like a pig’s head. Collecting medals is critical for scoring in this intense bullet hell cute 'em up. Bring home the bacon!

PINKSWEETS
The 2006 game PinkSweets is the sequel to the 2005 game Ibara. It features bosses from Ibara as playable characters, which is a cool and interesting twist. What defines Pink Sweets the most, however, is its combat system. If you hold down the fire button you will continuously shoot, but if you release the button you will instead deploy a shield. You can then detonate this when you start shooting again. Oh, and the enemies in the game are named after food. Yum!
70010000130163.intro: Twice the bullets! Double the excitement!
70010000130163.name: Muchi Muchi Pork! & PinkSweets Boosted

70010000130171.description:
Welcome to Parking Problem — a puzzle game about untangling jammed car parks. Slide vehicles in the right order, open up tight lanes, and guide every last car to the exit. It's quick to learn, deeply strategic, and perfect for that "one more puzzle" rhythm.

Tackle 150 handcrafted levels that gradually turn simple jams into clever brainteasers. New twists keep the grid fresh — tight corners, long vans, blocked lanes, one-way spaces, and gates to open — so planning two moves ahead really pays off. Stuck? Take a breath, rethink the order, and savor that sweet "aha!" when the lane finally clears.

Why you'll love it:
- 150 levels of clean, logic-driven parking puzzles
- Smooth slide controls and fast restarts for rapid iteration
- Smart difficulty curve: gentle warm-ups to devious jams
- Minimal, readable visuals that keep the board crystal-clear
- Play at your own pace — no timers, just pure strategy

Beat the gridlock, master the order, and enjoy the calm of a perfectly cleared lot in Parking Problem.
70010000130171.intro:
A slick, satisfying puzzler about untangling jammed car parks.
Slide vehicles in the right order and guide every car to the exit.
70010000130171.name: Parking Problem

70010000130195.description:
Welcome to Hex Park a colorful playground of brainteasers where every move matters. Rotate and align arrow tiles to guide directions, pop obstacles, and clear the board in as few moves as possible. It’s easy to pick up, delightfully tricky to master, and impossible to put down.

Tackle handcrafted levels featuring smart mechanics: keys and locks, mystery tiles, bombs, ice counters, gears, and more. Plan routes, set up neat arrow alignments, and use handy tools like the hammer, dynamite, and drill when you need a nudge. No timers, no stress—just clean, strategic puzzle-solving with that perfect “one more level” feel.

Why you’ll love it:

Keys/locks, mystery tiles, bombs, ice counters, and other clever twists

Fair tools to get unstuck—without breaking the puzzle flow

Play at your own pace with smooth, satisfying controls

Achievements and cloud saves supported

Take a stroll, stay for a challenge—Hex Park is your new daily puzzle routine.
70010000130195.intro: A relaxing puzzle adventure where simple rules lead to surprisingly deep challenges.
70010000130195.name: Hex Park

70010000130201.description:
See the hazard. Time the jump. Reach the flag - then do it faster.

Bright colors. Deadly obstacles. One tiny hero who never gives up. Colorful Boi 2 is a fast, precise arcade platformer built on one simple loop - and 74 handcrafted levels that dare you to master it.

DIE FAST. LEARN FASTER.
Death is instant - but so is the retry. Colorful Boi 2 is built for the "one more try" itch: you fail, you learn the trap, you go again - and the moment it finally clicks feels earned. Checkpoints catch you, instant restarts erase the sting, and nothing ever stands between you and the next attempt.

EVERY LEVEL IS A FRESH PUZZLE
Spikes. Spinning and static saw blades. Conveyor belts that shove you toward the edge. Every level remixes the danger with its own color, its own layout and its own trap you haven't seen yet. Read the pattern, find the timing, thread the gap.

MASTER THE GIMMICKS
Just when you settle into a rhythm, the game changes the rules. Launcher blocks fling you across gaps you could never jump. Wall-climbing opens vertical routes and hidden lines. Each twist is introduced gently, then twisted hard - master one gimmick and the next level is already stacking it with everything you've learned.

CHASE THE PERFECT RUN
You never lose progress - only time. Chain perfect jumps, shave the milliseconds and beat your best time on every level. Anyone can clear the first levels. The best times belong to players who know every pixel.

PURE PLATFORMING - FOR EVERYONE
Colorful Boi 2 is family-friendly and simple enough for a kid to pick up, yet honestly difficult when you push for mastery. 74 levels keep the challenge coming, and every one of them is built to be replayed until it's clean.

KEY FEATURES
- 74 handcrafted levels - each with its own color, layout and hazard mix.
- Tight, reaction-based controls - every jump is on you, not luck.
- Deadly, varied hazards - spikes, spinning saw blades, conveyor belts and launcher blocks.
- Instant retries and checkpoints - fail fast, learn faster, never lose progress.
- Per-level best times - built to be raced and speedrun.
- Easy to learn, tough to master - family-friendly, honestly difficult, endlessly replayable.

One tiny hero. 74 deadly levels. Endless retries. How far can you get?
70010000130201.intro: Get ready for a pulse-pounding platformer in Colorful Boi 2! With 74 levels, vibrant worlds, deadly traps, and tight controls, test your reflexes and speed.
70010000130201.name: Colorful Boi 2

70010000130213.description:
In the year 2063 the evil Kyle Kaboom has begun kidnapping the former members of his band Chainsaw Cannonball and infecting them with deadly viruses! Strapped into the Viral Unit, Bimmy and Octo must fight these infections all while trying to track down Kyle and stop him before he destroys the moon!

- Gameplay -
Blast away at deadly viruses and mechanical hybrids as you fight for the future of mankind! Dash through bullets, lasers, and even enemies to stay alive and rack up points.

- Features -
Story Mode - Defend earth from Kyle Kaboom at your pace: retry stages, practice bosses, and watch the story unfold.

Arcade Mode - Rack up a high score and attempt to clear the game in one complete run! You'll receive extra lives and a shield power-up to help tackle the swarm of viruses. If you can do it once, can you do it 2 or even 3 times in a row?

Boss Rush Mode - Once you've beaten the Story Mode, try your hand at Boss Rush! You'll face every boss back to back in one continuous loop as they become more and more challenging to defeat.

If you're up for some competition, see if you can be the top player in the world on the Online Leaderboard!

Grab a friend and fight for the high score with Alternating V.S. Multiplayer, or carry each other through the story!

Customize your visual experience with a selection of borders, the gorgeous Lottes CRT filter, and full Tate support for your vertical monitor.

Struggling to see bullets against the backgrounds? Hand getting tired from holding down or mashing the fire button? You can customize your experience further with a selection of Accessibility features.

Own an Arcade Cabinet in your home running a PC? Viral Reload can be taken off of Free Play and assigned a credit button for a more authentic arcade experience. (You could even get quarters out of your friends!)
70010000130213.intro: Viral Reload EX is a shoot-em-up with a dash mechanic where you shrink down to fight infections at a microscopic scale! Can you defeat the evil Kyle Kaboom?
70010000130213.name: Viral Reload EX

70010000130236.description:
Get ready to enter a world of clever inventions, smart challenges, and brilliant solutions in Magnetail. In this charming puzzle adventure, you follow an ingenious inventor mouse who transforms workshops, laboratories, and storage rooms into playgrounds of experimentation and discovery.

Each level presents a new challenge where energy, magnetism, and logic work together. Push energy modules, watch them slide across the environment, and use magnets strategically to redirect trajectories, create barriers, and open unexpected paths. It may seem simple at first, but you will quickly discover that every move can completely change the outcome of the puzzle.

The key is thinking several steps ahead. Where will the module stop? Which magnet should be used first? Which route leaves the path clear for the next move? In Magnetail, every decision matters, and finding the perfect solution is as satisfying as powering up a complex machine for the very first time.

Explore 30 carefully crafted levels spread across busy workshops, experimental laboratories, and storage facilities filled with mechanical challenges. New situations constantly emerge, requiring observation, planning, and creativity to master the rules of magnetism and turn obstacles into opportunities.

With charming visuals, accessible controls, and puzzles that reward intelligence and experimentation, Magnetail delivers a relaxing, engaging, and highly rewarding experience. It is the kind of game that makes you stop, study the room for a moment, and then smile when the perfect solution finally clicks into place.

Align the modules, master the magnets, and prove that no invention is too complex for a brilliant mind.
70010000130236.intro: Think Like a Genius, Solve Like an Inventor
70010000130236.name: Magnetail

70010000130246.description:
Dive into a world of stunning, realistic puzzles that captivate your eyes and mind. Piece by piece, reveal breathtaking images of beautiful women — each completed puzzle unlocks a new masterpiece, keeping you motivated to discover what’s next.

Smooth and intuitive touch controls make gameplay effortless and deeply satisfying — you’ll feel like you’re truly shaping every picture with your own hands. Gentle, soothing music sets the perfect mood, helping you unwind while your curiosity pulls you to complete the next challenge.

Relax, enjoy, and let yourself get lost in the details.

Features:
• Addictive, easy-to-play puzzle mechanics.
• Gorgeous, realistic artwork of women.
• Satisfying touch interaction — every move feels natural.
• Unlock new, even more stunning images as you progress.
• Perfect balance of challenge and relaxation.
• Soothing soundtrack that enhances your focus and mood.
• Admire each completed image in full detail.
70010000130246.intro: Every piece brings you closer to perfection!
70010000130246.name: Hidden Girls: Secret Puzzle

70010000130256.description:
Magical Academy, a place that seemed perfect for her... After all, she is a future, great witch! As it turned out, fate willed otherwise and young Nora, after her Grandma's passing, must now go back to Lillyton to clain her inheritance - old Granny's house. But this task may be more difficult than it looks at first glance...

Nora: In Search of Hidden Ingredients is a unique combination of two types of games - kinetic visual novel, in which you will learn the story of a young adept of magic, her relationship with her beloved grandmother as well as a heartwarming tale of where true magic comes from. The second is a classic hidden object game In which you have to show cleverness and resourcefulness.

But be careful! A certain Spirit, has decided to put your skills to the test, and until you pass the obstacles put up by him... Reality is now shifting and your surroundings seem to be subject to some random, variable laws of nature...

Will you help Nora fulfill her destiny?

Game key features:
- Clever combination of kinetic visual novel & hidden-object games
- 29 HO levels in 9 unique locations full of story bits to discover and objects to find
- An inquisitive Spirit decided to make Nora's task, a bit more tricky so...
- ...The levels as well as some of the items you have to find are randomly generated!
- Beautiful, hand-drawn visuals that will enchant you with their style
- Unlimited freeplay mode for HO fans

Start this magical adventure with Nora today!
70010000130256.intro: Help Nora learn about her Grandma’s past and find the magical artifacts hidden in her house!
70010000130256.name: Nora: In Search Of Hidden Ingredients - Director's Cut

70010000130294.description:
In the desolate future of 2042, Earth teeters on the brink of ecological collapse due to relentless climate change. The only hope lies with a visionary who abandoned Earth to start anew on Mars, disgusted by humanity’s negativity and the financial betrayal of his ventures.

“Project Neon” is your top-secret mission to navigate the treacherous cosmos and bring this recluse back from his Martian stronghold, without harming him, to salvage our dying planet. He has fortified Mars with an impenetrable shield, anchored by defenses on four neighboring planets.

Each planet is guarded by fierce enemies and daunting bosses, integral to maintaining the shield. Your task: dismantle this interplanetary defense, planet by planet, in a high-stakes shoot ’em up adventure.

Featuring intense 16-bit action that harks back to the glory days of Japanese arcade shooters, “Project Neon” promises a thrilling challenge.

Are you ready to face the ultimate shmup challenge and save Earth?
70010000130294.name: Project Neon

70010000130309.description:
Survive by maintaining a balanced diet and eat as much as you can. If your stomach gets full, burn off calories with squats to get hungry again!



Who doesn't love yakiniku?



How much can you eat at the BBQ restaurant? How many days can you survive at the BBQ restaurant? How far can your stomach endure? Who grilled this meat anyway? Food waste is a no-go.



Stealing, being stolen from, sometimes giving, and the budding friendships... all with a tear in your eye.



Welcome to Yakiniku Party Survival.



Game Overview:

Survive by consuming a balanced mix of protein, carbohydrates, and fats.

Each ingredient affects your nutritional balance differently.

If you overeat and your calories go overboard, you won’t be able to eat anymore. Burn off those calories with squats!



Game Features:

Online Multiplayer: Play with up to 4 people. Both Quick Matches and Friend Matches are available, and you can freely enter or leave either. In Quick Matches, survivors from around the world play at their own pace. Friend Matches let you easily play with specific friends using a single keyword. Of course, you can also play solo.



Cooperative or Competitive Play: In online multiplayer, you can grill meat for other players or steal their meat instead.



Skills: Learn and upgrade survival skills, such as tableware, rice, stomach expansion, or squat efficiency.



Fever Event: During The Fever event, no matter how much you consume, it’s zero calories! It’s your chance to balance your nutrition in one go.
70010000130309.intro: This is a game where you challenge yourself to survive using only the ingredients from a yakiniku restaurant.
70010000130309.name: Yakiniku Party Survival

70010000130313.description:
A party hall, a park, a train platform — in a scene full of people, only one answer is hidden.

"That person looks suspicious..."
"No, wait — look at those shoes."
The longer you stare, the more you doubt. But the clock won't wait.

This is an observation puzzle where you reason from the clues drawn in a single picture — "Who did it?" "What's off?" — and tap your answer within a 12-second time limit.
Mud on a shoe, a stain on a sleeve, a tool in hand, the spot where someone stands —
every detail is your evidence to narrow down the truth by logic.
50 questions with a twist that first impressions alone won't crack.

The stages are everyday scenes that work anywhere in the world — gardens, plazas, cafés, harbors.
From 6 to 9 people, or rows of look-alike objects, you pick the one and only answer.
The further you go, the smaller and trickier the clues become.

How to play is simple.
・Scan the whole scene quickly
・Reason out the answer from the clues
・Tap that person (or spot) within 12 seconds

Get it right, and you're the detective of the hour.
Miss it, and one more look makes you nod — then you're hooked on the next.
Speed, observation, and deduction — your "smarts" show with every round.

So, can you see the truth in 12 seconds? Give it a try.

The game supports both button controls and touch controls, allowing you to play in TV mode, handheld mode, or tabletop mode.
70010000130313.intro:
In just 12 seconds, your eye for detail is exposed.
Can you read the clues and find the answer?
70010000130313.name: Your Intelligence Will Be Exposed. Mystery Observation Challenge

70010000130326.description:
Your new business is now welcoming you! You have been handed the keys to a modest, empty commercial space, and your goal is simple: turn it into a thriving, highly profitable retail empire.

The success of the store rests entirely in your hands. Begin your day by ordering inventory, unpacking heavy cardboard boxes, and meticulously organizing products on the shelves so that customers can easily find what they need. You control the economy. Analyze market trends and set dynamic prices for each item to maximize profits without losing loyal customers. When the store opens, stand behind the cash register to scan barcodes, process credit cards, and give back change quickly to keep the lines moving.

Reinvest your earnings to expand your floor space, upgrade your lighting, and unlock licenses to sell hundreds of new, diverse products. Once the daily rush becomes too much for one person to handle, hire and train a team of cashiers and stockers to keep the business running smoothly. Customize your layout, paint the walls, and design the ultimate shopping environment. Do you have what it takes to build the greatest supermarket in town?

Key Features:
• Stock the Shelves: Order goods, unpack boxes, and arrange a wide variety of products to create an organized and inviting store.
• Master the Register: Scan items, process card payments, and quickly count out cash change for waiting customers.
• Set the Market: Take control of the economy. Monitor daily market trends and adjust your pricing strategy to balance high profits with happy shoppers.
• Grow Your Empire: Use your profits to unlock new store sections, purchase additional shelving, and expand your product catalog from basic snacks to premium goods.
• Automate the grind by hiring, training, and managing a team of employees to run the registers and restock shelves while you focus on the big picture.
• Total Customization: Design your store's layout, choose color schemes, and place decorations to create a unique shopping atmosphere.
70010000130326.intro: From humble store to retail giant!
70010000130326.name: My Supermarket Simulator

70010000130332.description:
Note: This game is available in Japanese only.

In this version, players can choose between two modes:

・Normal Mode
・Less-Scary Mode, designed for older elementary school children and up

Key Feature 1: Real cleaning products appear in the game

The game features actual Kao cleaning products, including Magiclean and Quickle products. Some hidden techniques even allow players to combine items and clean in ways that reflect the real-life features of the products.

Key Feature 2: Discover hidden mechanisms and codes in each stage

The mansion where the game takes place is divided into several stages. Players must use cleaning items to uncover hidden codes and find the keys needed to advance to the next stage.

Key Feature 3: A mysterious “thing” creeps up on players as they clean

In the game, a mysterious “thing” roams the mansion and gets in the player’s way. It reacts to even the smallest sounds, such as cleaning noises and footsteps, and attacks. Players must clean the mansion and find a way out while avoiding this unknown threat.

Products Featured in the Game

・Magiclean Handy Spray
・Toilet Magiclean No-Scrub Foam Pack
・Bath Magiclean Air Jet Disinfecting EX
・Magiclean EXPOWER Water Stain Spray
・Quickle Wiper 3D Adhesive Wet Sheet STRONG Super Space Deodorizing

Estimated Play Time: Approximately 60–90 minutes

All proceeds from sales of this title will be donated to organizations that support children’s education and related causes.

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Does the game have auto-save, or can players save manually at any point?

A: Progress is saved automatically through auto-save. Even if players quit the game, they can resume from where they left off. However, some minor progress details may not be saved. Players can also restart after a game over without losing their progress.

Q: Can players adjust controller sensitivity, screen brightness, volume, and other settings in detail?

A: Yes. From the in-game settings screen, players can adjust options such as brightness, overall volume, and controller sensitivity using sliders.
70010000130332.intro:
“Clean the house. Stay undetected.“
A 3D horror action game
powered by Kao’s cleaning tools！
70010000130332.name: Silent Cleaning

70010000130424.description:
Start with just a handful of arcade machines and a small budget, then grow your business into the ultimate entertainment destination. Every machine earns money, every upgrade attracts more customers, and every decision shapes the future of your arcade.

Expand your floor with new game cabinets, purchase furniture, and unlock bigger, better attractions as your arcade grows. Manage your profits wisely, reinvest in your business, and transform a tiny game room into a thriving arcade empire.

Features:
> Start with a small arcade and expand over time.
> Buy a variety of arcade machines.
> Earn money from customers and reinvest your profits.
>Purchase furniture to improve your arcade's appearance.
> Build the ultimate arcade and become the best in town!

Will you create the most popular arcade in town?
70010000130424.intro: Build your dream arcade from the ground up!
70010000130424.name: Build My Arcade

70010000130449.description:
Do you know which fruit a cashew grows on — and where?

The moment you think "that's just common sense" is the most dangerous one.
The more familiar something is, the less we actually know its true form.

This game is a common-sense quiz where you pick the "real one" from four very similar images.
How a pineapple actually grows, the red liquid a hippo sweats, the true color of Mars, the inside of a pyramid —
100 questions with a twist, on things you thought you knew but get wrong.

Every theme is the "now that you mention it, I'm curious" kind.
The correct image hides among three look-alike decoys.

How to play is simple.
・Read the question
・Pick the one image of four you believe is real
・Stuck? Narrow it down with a hint
・Check the explanation for why it's the answer

The surprise of "Wait, THIS one is real?!"
The realization of "I really was assuming."
Right or wrong, you gain one new fact — so 100 questions just fly by.

So, the "real thing" 99% can't spot — can you pick it out?

The game supports both button controls and touch controls, allowing you to play in TV mode, handheld mode, or tabletop mode.
70010000130449.intro:
I'm sure I know this" is exactly where you slip.
Can you spot the real thing among four images?
70010000130449.name: 99% Can't Spot It! Common Sense Battle

70010000130461.description:
Move through 3D space to find hints, solve mysteries and escape from the room.
Anyone can play to the end because you can see hints and answers.
70010000130461.name: Escape game R00M16

70010000130467.description: You awaken alone in a deserted hospital, its halls filled with darkness, mystery, and fear. As you search for a way out, you discover that you are not alone. A relentless butcher roams the building, hunting anyone who crosses his path. Explore the hospital, solve puzzles, uncover its disturbing past, and use stealth to survive. Stay quiet, stay hidden, and escape before the butcher finds you.
70010000130467.intro: Run. Hide. Survive. A ruthless butcher stalks your every move in this tense first-person horror experience.
70010000130467.name: Hunted

70010000130490.description: Just what exactly is "Mihashira"? An arcade-style, top-down action shooter that evokes a sense of nostalgia has arrived on the Nintendo Switch™! Freely control one of four playable characters and mow down your enemies! In addition to a multiplayer mode where two players compete for a combined score, the game features Arcade and Exhibition modes that support "drop-in" play, allowing a second player to join the action at any time.
70010000130490.intro: Put enemies into "HEAT" mode and finish them off! Collect items and unleash your Hyper Limit. A retro-style, top-down 2D action shooter!
70010000130490.name: MIHASHIRA

70010000130508.description:
One scene, one suspicious detail—can you spot where the case breaks?

Perfect crimes look flawless at first glance. But if you slow down and really study the picture, something may start to feel off.

This is a casual picture-based mystery quiz where each case is solved by choosing one spot in the illustration.

・Read the prompt
・Inspect the image carefully
・Select the one place that fits the answer
・Move on to the next case

No complicated rules, no long setup—just quick cases that test your eyes, focus, and deduction.

Whether you nail it right away or miss the mark, every attempt helps sharpen your observation skills.

Take on a file whenever you have a few minutes. Can you expose the flaw in the perfect crime?

Button controls and touch controls are both supported.
70010000130508.intro: Can you crack the perfect setup?
70010000130508.name: Perfect Crime Case Files

70010000130515.description:
A quiet hallway. A room that should be empty. Dolls lined up in neat rows.
— And among them, one "thing that shouldn't be there" is hiding.

A pale, translucent figure.
A single "real one" mixed into a row of dolls and mannequins.
You won't catch it at a glance. But once you find it, you'll never unsee it.

This is a horror observation game where you spot the presence that shouldn't be there inside a single dim image, and tap it.
An extra figure in an empty place, a living person among lined-up statues —
you hunt down that spine-tingling wrongness with nothing but your eyes.
No gore, nothing graphic. The only scary things are the "presence" and the "wrongness" — which is exactly why it creeps up on you.

50 scenes in all.
The further you go, the more cleverly it blends in, and the harder it gets to tell.

How to play is simple.
・Scan every corner of the dim picture
・Find the thing that "shouldn't be there," and tap it gently

The instant you spot it, a chill runs down your spine — that's the reward.
Play alone in a bright room, or shout "Where?!" with a friend.

So, the wrongness hidden in this one image — can you find it?

The game supports both button controls and touch controls, allowing you to play in TV mode, handheld mode, or tabletop mode.
70010000130515.intro:
Look closely at this image. One thing doesn't belong.
Once you notice it, you can't look away.
70010000130515.name: Something That Shouldn't Be There Is Visible.

70010000130521.description:
Darkstone Bay is a first-person escape room puzzle adventure where you explore a mysterious island, solve puzzles and search for a lost Spanish galleon.

In 1721, the Spanish ship El Diablo Dormido vanished without a trace. For centuries it was believed to be lost at sea. Now, a forgotten trail leads to Darkstone Bay.

Explore sandy beaches, ancient caves, abandoned mines and dense jungle as you solve puzzles, decode forgotten symbols, discover hidden objects and uncover the truth behind the lost galleon.

Features:
• First-person escape room puzzle adventure
• Solve puzzles to cross the island
• Decode ancient symbols and discover hidden objects
• Explore beaches, caves, mines and jungle environments
• Atmospheric original soundtrack
70010000130521.intro: A first-person escape room puzzle adventure. Explore a mysterious island and search for a legendary shipwreck hidden for over 300 years.
70010000130521.name: Darkstone Bay

70010000130527.description:
The picture is covered—but did the key detail stay in your head?

You had 60 seconds. You were sure you noticed everything... until one small part disappears behind the mask.

This is a casual visual memory quiz where you study an image, then answer a 4-choice question based on what you remember. The mood may feel dramatic, but the rules are simple and quick.

How to play:
・Study the image while it is shown
・After part of the image is masked, read the question
・Choose one answer from four options
・When you are correct, check the original image again

Every round is a compact test of attention and recall. Even a tiny detail can decide whether your memory tells the whole story.

Play a quick round whenever you like, and see if you can catch what was hiding in the final scene.

Supports button controls and touch controls.
70010000130527.name: The Final Scene

70010000130568.description:
On a rainy afternoon, Alicia steps through a freezing Looking-Glass into a fading world that has lost its color and warmth. Alongside two tiny companions, Snugglet and Mira, she journeys through whimsical lands to confront King Cozy, a lonely bear-king who is hoarding the world's sparkles. Ultimately, the smallest hero saves the day, restoring light and joy to the realm.

Features:
• A cinematic visual novel brought to life with feature-film quality 3D animation.
• A fully voiced interactive 3D Video Book for ages 4–8.
• 10 chapters: Over 10,000 words of story.
• Original instrumental soundtrack: 29 cheerful kids' pop tracks.
• Full voice acting for every character and the narrator (17 distinct voices).
• Full color image gallery to use as wallpaper or background.
• Five karaoke songs to enjoy singing about history.
• Short sessions, perfect for one chapter per evening, read together or alone.
• Themes: friendship, kindness, courage, and set in a magical mirror world.
• No ads · No in-app purchases · No frightening content · No sad ending.
70010000130568.intro: A magical interactive 3D video book about friendship, kindness, and courage!
70010000130568.name: Alice and the Looking-Glass

70010000130587.description:
Welcome to Mireglow, a cozy exploration game where the only goal is to wander, discover, and enjoy the journey. Explore a tranquil swamp glowing with magical plants, ancient trees, quiet waterways, and forgotten paths as you search for every unique location hidden throughout the world.

Features
>Explore a beautiful mystical swamp.
>Discover every hidden location and secret area.
>Relax in a cozy, stress-free adventure.
>Wander through glowing marshes, ancient forests, and quiet waterways.
>Enjoy a calm and immersive atmosphere.
>No combat, no timers, and no pressure—just exploration.

Lose yourself in the glow of the swamp and discover every hidden corner of Mireglow.
70010000130587.intro: Step into a peaceful mystical swamp filled with wonder and hidden discoveries.
70010000130587.name: Mireglow

70010000130590.description:
Forget being a peaceful pet; today, you're a destructive intruder. You are a giant rodent breaking into the sheriff's house. Your objective is simple: cause as much property damage as possible without getting caught.

Waddle through a highly interactive house and use your size to your advantage. Push over heavy TVs, break expensive vases, and smash the furniture. Open the refrigerator door to steal food, jump on kitchen tables, and drive the sheriff's guard dog crazy. When the owner walks in, quickly hide in a closet to avoid capture. Then, jump out and continue your rampage! From the backyard to the living room, make the sheriff's home your personal playground.

Key Features:
• Interactive Destruction: Shatter household objects, knock over electronics, and toss furniture with amusing physics-based movement.
• Fridge Raiding: Search the kitchen to steal snacks, sausages, and fresh vegetables directly from the cabinets and refrigerator.
• Evade the Sheriff: Dodge the homeowner and his guard dog by hiding in closets and sneaking through different rooms.
• Explore the house. Run wild from the grassy backyard to the master bedroom and leave a trail of chaos in your wake.
70010000130590.intro: The giant rodent versus the sheriff!
70010000130590.name: Bad Capybara

70010000130596.description:
All Lady Death wants is to mourn a fallen friend in peace. Then an infernal portal rips open and a throng of demon scum storms the cemetery gates. Little does Lady Death know, the most brutal battle of her undead life has just begun.

Malevolent forces tear Lady Death from one realm to another... From the stinking pits of Hell, to an undead heavy metal festival, to a demonic dinosaur catastrophe, to a cannibalistic, industrial nightmare. Through it all, one true ally stands at her side: Ravenheart, a haunted warrior armed with a savage sword and the touch of death, but will even his strength be enough?

Lady Death Demonicron is an all new side-scrolling, sword-slicing, magic-wielding, 15 level co-op hack and slash that takes the best aspects of the 1990s arcade classics all mixed together with a killer industrial-metal soundtrack.
70010000130596.intro: Lady Death Demonicron is a side-scrolling hack and slash for fans of the golden age of arcade gaming.
70010000130596.name: Lady Death Demonicron

70010000130598.description:
Tarot Tokens is a strategic tile game inspired by the Fools journey through the major arcana of the tarot. Placing Tarot Tokens crafts your journey from four key aspects of the major arcana of the tarot: family, morals, conflict, hope.

Win With Virtues
The aim of Tarot Tokens is to build your three virtues up and keep them nicely balanced by making wise, or seemingly foolish choices, along the way. Run out of any virtue and the journey ends. Reach the end by taking all the steps and reflect on your journey - learn to see pass the numbers and embrace your whole journey.

The Fool
Every game starts with The Fool already placed. Your choices between the Tarot Tokens steers your journey, with the help of the Fools Abilities every few turns. Your journey through the life challenges of placing tokens shape the Fools path that is always different, always yours.

Silence Is Golden
Tarot Tokens has no sound of any kind, no music, no effects, nothing. Enjoy the silence or bring your own noise, much like when using real tarot cards for a reading. Feedback is visual only and there are options to tone it down if you find it a bit much.

Not A Deck Builder
You play with all 22 tokens of the major arcana, every game. A randomly selected number of tokens are offered to you each turn, except The Fool who is used only once at the start of every game. All tokens interact with some other tokens on the board. Each token has its own unique effect with most generating virtues in addition to other token interactions.

Follow Your Path
Play your favourite token as often as you want, if it is available that turn. Or play highly tactically to gain maximum virtue and be really efficient, although you might just be missing out. Every token is always unlocked and randomly chosen every turn - no token fixing or token reading goes on (even though it might feel that way if your journey feels off).

A Hex On You!
Tarot Tokens uses a hex grid in shameless violation of the four sided card format of the tarot. The essence of the tarot is faithfully preserved in a hex shape with on-demand help explaining virtues, adjacency information, and a brief description of the significance of that tarot token in the context of the Fools journey. Hex grids are still over rated though!
70010000130598.name: Tarot Tokens

70010000130653.description:
Get behind the wheel and put your racing skills to the test in Ragdoll Kart Simulator 2026, a fast-paced arcade kart racing experience focused on drifting, boosting, and mastering every track.

Choose your driver, customize their appearance with different colors and accessories, select your kart, and get ready to compete across 10 challenging tracks. Each track features its own layout, turns, shortcuts, and racing challenges, giving you new opportunities to improve your control and racing technique.

KEY FEATURES
	•	Master the Drift – Drift through corners, build your boost, and release it at the perfect moment to gain speed.
	•	Race Across 10 Tracks – Take on unique track layouts featuring tight corners, shortcuts, difficult sections, and high-speed areas.
	•	Customize Your Driver – Choose colors and accessories to create your preferred driver look.
	•	Choose Your Kart – Select from a variety of karts and find one that matches your racing style.
	•	Race for Rewards – Compete against AI opponents, improve your times, complete challenges, and earn rewards for additional customization options.

Race, drift, boost, and improve with every lap. Find the perfect racing line, master every corner, and push your kart to the limit in Ragdoll Kart Simulator 2026.
70010000130653.name: Ragdoll Kart Simulator 2026

70010000130673.description:
Get out of the prison and try not to die!

Take advantage of the chaos in the prison to fight your way through 30 levels, testing your wits and reflexes as you face explosions, heavy gunfire and deadly obstacles in a bid to reclaim your freedom!

- Try on Jake's shoes from Team Hot Guns in his famous prison break.
- Solve 30 levels filled with useful items, tricky enemies and puzzles.
- Put your patience, reflexes and ambition to the test.
70010000130673.intro: Shoot your way to freedom through explosive levels and retro gunfire!
70010000130673.name: Prison Run and Gun

70010000130679.description:
You are not just the head chef, but also the manager, cashier, and driving force behind the city's most popular food truck. Bustling sidewalks are filled with hungry customers waiting for you to take their orders, prep the ingredients, and serve them mouthwatering meals that are hot, fresh, and served exactly on time.

Success in the street food business requires more than a great recipe. It demands lightning-fast reflexes and impeccable time management. During the daily lunch rush, you must multitask effortlessly with smooth, intuitive gamepad controls. Juggle multiple orders, keep a close eye on the grill, and ensure nothing burns! Each satisfied customer will leave you with hard-earned cash and a growing reputation. However, if you make them wait too long, they will walk away hungry.

Use your daily profits to transform your modest setup into a world-class culinary enterprise. As you progress, you will unlock a wide variety of new ingredients, allowing you to expand your menu and take on exciting new cooking challenges. Purchase top-tier kitchen equipment to speed up prep time and eventually unlock expanded dining spaces to accommodate larger crowds. Put on your apron, turn on the stove, and see how far you can take your street food empire!

Key Features:
• Sizzle & Serve: Master the daily rush! Cook, assemble, and deliver orders quickly before your hungry customers get impatient.
• Upgrade Your Kitchen: Use your hard-earned profits to invest in high-tech grills, faster fryers, and advanced prep stations to increase your efficiency.
• Expand your menu: Unlock a wide variety of fresh ingredients and complex, high-paying recipes to keep the crowds coming back for more.
• Grow Your Empire: Transform your modest street cart into a top-tier mobile restaurant with expanded dining spaces to host bigger crowds.
• Smooth Console Controls: Seamlessly navigate kitchen chaos with intuitive gamepad controls designed specifically for fast-paced multitasking.
70010000130679.intro: From Corner Cart to Culinary Kingpin!
70010000130679.name: Street Food Simulator

70010000130685.description:
Set in a grim and desolate world overrun by zombies, the game challenges players to fend off wave after wave of increasingly formidable enemies.
With its top-down view and fast-paced action, Zombie War offers an adrenaline-pumping experience that will keep players on the edge of their seats.
Armed with an arsenal of weapons and gear, players must fight tooth and nail to stay alive in the face of overwhelming odds.

Fight and thrive in the endless onslaught of zombies.
Upgrade your gear and weapons and keep up with stronger enemies.
Your main goal in this grim world is survival.

Upgrade your gear and weapons to progress in the game as the difficulty rises.
Pick up useful loot and use your special abilities to survive as long as possible.
70010000130685.intro: Zombie War plunges players into a relentless battle for survival against hordes of the undead.
70010000130685.name: Zombie War

70010000130703.description:
Hotel Empire - Check Inn is a charming management simulation in which you build your own hotel chain step by step. Start with a small, simple hotel and expand your empire into more and more cities – each with its own challenges.

BUILD, EXPAND, AND OPTIMIZE
- Build new hotels, buy building plots.
- Plan rooms with increasingly complex shapes and place them as efficiently as possible.
- Fulfill your guests' wishes: they want specific rooms and parking spaces.

MANAGE STAFF & SERVICE
- Hire enough maids, because every room must be cleaned after check-out.
- Build elevators, upgrade them, and keep them in good condition so guests can quickly reach their floor.
- Build service rooms such as kitchens, laundries, or saunas, and employ porters who transport food, laundry, and other items through the hotel.

EVERY CITY BRINGS NEW CHALLENGES
- Montreal: Cold, snowy weather – insulate rooms so guests don't freeze.
- Miami: Luxury hotels right by the sea with especially demanding room layouts.
- New York: Build several hotels at the same time and use managers who automate check-in.

EASY TO LEARN - HARD TO MASTER
Hotel Empire - Check Inn combines accessible gameplay with a deep management focus. Optimize processes, keep guests happy, and expand your hotel chain into a global empire.
70010000130703.intro: Build hotels, accommodate guests, and expand your hotel business worldwide!
70010000130703.name: Hotel Empire - Check Inn

70010000130713.description:
Your story begins when your mom accidentally throws away your favorite albums. To recover the collection, you haul a massive pile of trash into your backyard and start digging through it piece by piece.

In this game, the card collection lies buried deep within heaps of refuse, dirt, and forgotten items. Your goal is simple yet engaging: find every card and rebuild the collection from scratch. Each dig brings you closer to recovering the cards that once meant the world to you.

As you play, you’ll upgrade your tools, boost your stamina, and manage your energy wisely. Digging consumes energy, so planning is key to saving the collection from being lost forever. Unlock new trash zones, create larger piles, and discover rare items that help you advance your search.

Selling valuable junk is a crucial part of the journey. Old electronics, antiques, and mysterious objects can be sold to fund upgrades and speed up your search. Every upgrade makes it easier to find the cards buried beneath mountains of trash and brings you closer to fully restoring the collection.

The deeper you dig, the more secrets you uncover. Some cards are common while others are incredibly rare; completing the collection requires patience, strategy, and curiosity. Track your progress, organize your finds, and enjoy the relaxing process of searching and collecting.

This game is about nostalgia, exploration, and determination. Can you stay focused, manage your energy, and finally find all the lost cards? Dive into the trash, recover my card collection, and prove that no collection is ever truly lost. Find all the cards, complete my collection, and relive the joy of collecting.
70010000130713.intro: Welcome to My Lost Card Collection, a cozy card-hunting adventure centered on memories, junk, and a passion for collecting.
70010000130713.name: My Lost Card Collection

70010000130716.description:
1. Hatch Eggs: Obtain juvenile monsters of random rarities
2. Raise Monsters: Wait for juvenile monsters to grow up
3. Sell Monsters: Sell monsters after they mature
4. Collect: Complete 100 × 2 monster handbook entries
5. Music: Enjoy relaxing Lo-fi music while idling
6. Offline Progress: Monsters continue to grow and earn income even while you're away
70010000130716.intro: A relaxing idle monster collection game (with offline progress). Features 200 monster entries and 10 Lo-fi tracks.
70010000130716.name: Monster Nursery

70010000130727.description:
Ascent DX is a tiny metroidvania brought to life in glorious 64 x 64 pixel art and soothing chiptune music. Crashed on an unknown planet you have to explore lush jungles, lifeless deserts, and luminescent caves in search of anything that can help you understand what has happened to the planet and how to get off it.

While the game is a bigger version of the original Ascent, with almost twice as many locations to explore, it is still quite a short game. With the same celebrated gameplay and atmosphere, the DX versions also brings more items to find, more platforming puzzles, and more lore to uncover.

Features:
* A world brought to life by tiny but expressive pixel art
* Explore the planet's many biomes in your own pace and direction
* Find new powers and abilities that help you on your way
* Uncover the fate of the planet as well as your own
* Different endings based on how much was discovered

Credits:
Design, code, & pixel art: Johan Peitz
Music & sfx: Brent Houston
Capsule art: Jon Nielsen
Nintendo Switch port: Corey Underdown
70010000130727.intro: Crashed on a desolate but mysterious planet you find yourself eye to eye with an ancient civilisation. Explore the planet, find powerful upgrades and fulfill your destiny
70010000130727.name: Ascent DX

70010000130729.description:
A photo of a hallway at midnight. A door left half open. An empty Ferris wheel.
Where did your eyes go first?

That offhand reaction reveals the true feelings you usually keep hidden.
This game is a psychological test where you look at an oddly raw, candid-style photo and pick "how it makes you feel" from 4 choices.

The moment you choose, a different "true-feelings diagnosis" appears for each option.
And at the end of each one comes a small — chilling — twist.
"You think you're protecting it, but you've locked everyone out, and yourself in."
A truth that makes your spine tingle the moment you notice it — gently spelled out for you.

Hallways, doors, mirrors, clocks, still water, staircases, roads —
50 symbolic scenes that tug at anyone's heart and peer into your deepest psyche.

How to play is simple.
・Look at a photo and pick how you feel from 4 choices
・Read the "true-feelings diagnosis" for your choice
・When the chill hits, move on to the next photo

There are no right answers, so play again and again, with anyone.
Quietly self-diagnose alone, or read them aloud with friends and squeal "that's creepy!" —
light to start, deep when it lands: a creepy-meaning psychological test.

So, the "darkness" hiding deep in your heart — shall we take a peek?

The game supports both button controls and touch controls, allowing you to play in TV mode, handheld mode, or tabletop mode.
※This game is designed to be played on the Nintendo Switch™ in vertical orientation.
70010000130729.intro:
The answer you choose reveals a hidden truth about you.
And the instant you finish reading it — a chill.
70010000130729.name: The Chilling Moment You Realize It: Creepy Meaning Psychological Test

70010000130735.description:
Founding Paws follows Chompy the beaver and Sunny the eaglet through the American Revolution as they help dump tea into Boston Harbor, sound the alarm during Paul Revere's midnight ride, and travel to Philadelphia to witness the Continental Congress and inspire Thomas Jefferson's drafting of the Declaration. Decades later in the modern era, the lifelong friends sit together watching Fourth of July fireworks, proudly reflecting on the incredible nation they helped build.

Features:
• Fully dubbed in English. Characters with their own voices and personalities.
• 10 chapters. A complete story. Above 10,000 words.
• Full-color, professional-quality images.
• Full background music and sound effects throughout.
• Read together or let a child explore alone.
• Short sessions. Easy to pause and pick up anytime.
• Themes: courage, friendship, self-acceptance.
• Ages 4–8.
• No ads - No in-app purchases - All ages.
70010000130735.intro: Relive the American Revolution through the paws of two historical heroes!
70010000130735.name: Founding Paws: How America Began

70010000130743.description:
Plant crops, water your fields, harvest fresh produce, craft useful tools, trade with merchants, and shape your homestead exactly the way you want.

Start with a small piece of land and turn it into a thriving countryside home. Prepare the soil, grow different crops through realistic growth stages, gather resources, and expand your farm with buildings, fences, storage areas, and custom structures. Whether you enjoy peaceful farming, creative building, or managing resources for survival, Farming Homestead gives you the freedom to play your way.

Explore a complete farming experience with dynamic weather, a smooth day-and-night cycle, useful tools, crafting recipes, inventory management, trading, and persistent save progress. Every system works together to create a relaxing yet rewarding homestead adventure. Create the farm you have always imagined. Grow your land, build your home, and enjoy the peaceful life of Farming Homestead.

Features

Grow a wide variety of crops with planting, watering, harvesting, soil preparation, and time-based growth.

Craft tools, items, and equipment using a flexible recipe-based crafting system.

Build and customize your farm with structures, fences, storage, and decorations using free placement.

Manage your inventory and hotbar to quickly access tools, seeds, resources, and crafted items.

Buy and sell goods through merchant NPCs and build your farming economy.

Experience dynamic weather and a beautiful day-and-night cycle that brings your world to life.
70010000130743.intro: Build, grow, craft, and live your dream farm life in Farming Homestead, a cozy farming simulation game where every day brings new opportunities.
70010000130743.name: Farming Homestead

70010000130767.description:
Welcome to Hearthwater, a cozy exploration game where there's no combat, no timers, and no pressure—just a beautiful village waiting to be explored. Wander along sandy beaches, stroll through quiet streets, and venture into forests, hills, and hidden paths as you uncover every location the village has to offer.

Take your time soaking in the relaxing atmosphere while searching for landmarks, secret spots, and scenic viewpoints. Every path leads to something new, encouraging you to explore at your own pace and experience the charm of Hearthwater.

Features
> Explore a peaceful seaside village.
> Discover every unique location and hidden area.
> Relax with a cozy, stress-free exploration experience.
> Immerse yourself in a calm atmosphere.
> Take your time—there are no timers, combat, or pressure.

Every path has a story. Every corner is waiting to be discovered.
70010000130767.intro: Escape to a peaceful seaside village and discover every hidden corner.
70010000130767.name: Hearthwater

70010000130803.description:
Find Eddie Velvet.

Private investigator Red Walker finds himself in Silver Pines, a place half-abandoned, half-forgotten, in the middle of nowhere on a job to track down Eddie Velvet. A musician who has vanished. As the case begins to reveal a dark past, Walker soon slips into a strange and nightmarish descent beyond his control.

The Kind of Moment that Lasts Forever
Embark on a journey filled with dread and atmosphere. Haunted by shadows of the past, Silver Pines is waiting to reveal its dark secrets.

Survival Horror Gameplay
A love letter to classic survival horror. Fight or avoid the horrors of the town as you scavenge for resources and solutions to the puzzles blocking your way.

Metroidvania Navigation
Filled with locked doors and hidden paths, every turn holds an uncovered clue, a resource, or something waiting in the dark. With better tools and weapons more and more of the town becomes accessible.

Visceral and grounded action
The horrors of the town include a large variety of challenging monsters and hulking bosses that keeps every encounter tense and dangerous.

Manage your resources
Inventory space is limited. Search everywhere for items because every bullet, bottle of medicine and upgrade matters.
70010000130803.intro: Silver Pines. The kind of moment that lasts forever.
70010000130803.name: Silver Pines

70010000130813.description:
Jump into a vibrant world of floating platforms, tricky obstacles and fast-paced challenges in this addictive hyper-casual platformer.

Take control of a charming cube and hop your way across a variety of handcrafted levels filled with narrow pathways, moving hazards and clever routes that will put your timing and precision to the test. Every stage offers a new challenge as you leap from block to block, avoid deadly spikes, cross crumbling platforms, dodge fireballs, swing past massive hammers and overcome many more obstacles standing in your way.

Collect coins throughout your adventure and use them to unlock a growing collection of unique cube skins, allowing you to customize your character and show off your style as you progress through the game.

As your journey continues, you'll encounter the Evil Square Ones, powerful rivals that await in exciting boss battles. These action-packed encounters will challenge everything you've learned and reward skillful play.

With simple controls, satisfying gameplay and a steady stream of short, engaging levels, this is the perfect game to pick up for a quick challenge or settle in for a longer session. Easy to learn but difficult to master, every jump counts as you work your way through increasingly demanding stages.

Can you conquer every level, defeat the Evil Square Ones and become the ultimate platforming champion?
70010000130813.name: The Square Ones

70010000130824.description:
Welcome to SuperSharket — the supermarket where fish shop like humans!

Build and manage your very own underwater supermarket, stocked with all the everyday products you would find in a human store. From filling shelves to managing the checkout, every part of the supermarket is in your hands.

Hire a team of sharks to keep your store running, serve different types of fish, manage your money, and keep your customers happy. Expand your supermarket, build new areas, upgrade your facilities, and turn a small underwater shop into a thriving retail empire.

Every customer is different, and every fish has somewhere to be. Keep the shelves stocked, the queues moving, and the cash registers ringing while your shark employees handle the work.

Why do fish need human groceries? Nobody knows. But they clearly love shopping.

Build your store. Hire your sharks. Serve your fish. Become the ultimate underwater supermarket manager!
70010000130824.intro: Welcome to the supermarket where fish shop and sharks work!
70010000130824.name: SuperSharket

70010000130837.description:
Sir, You Are Being Hunted is a procedurally-generated British horror in which tweed-wearing robots hunt you for sport.
Roam the landscape, scavenge for food, hide breathlessly in the undergrowth, flee in terror, and even fight back with stolen weapons.

Sir is a stealth and survival game unlike any other.

Key Features:
- First-person stealth and survival.
- Procedurally-generated British landscape.
- Five biomes to explore: castle, industrial, rural, mountainous, and fenland.
- Infinite replayability in a sandbox world.
- Powerful, brutal AI that becomes tougher as you play.
- Tea and biscuits.
- Foliage-based stealth system.
- Scavenge to survive.
- Play as Sir or Madam.
- Relentless Britishness.

Every Game Unique!
Sir, You Are Being Hunted is set on a mysterious archipelago generated procedurally by you, and therefore unique to each game you play.
You can define your own islands, each one created in moments by our rather clever British Countryside Generator.
These islands are then populated by a raving aristocracy of murderous robots, their robot hounds, and worse. You job is simply to survive, and get home.

You're not entirely alone, though: The disembodied voice of Walters, your butler, will help you and offer advice.

Ultimate AI Threat
Sir's AI is one of the toughest in stealth, and as an open-world game, it's unique in its field.
The robots are some of the most aggressive and intelligent game enemies you will ever experience, and will pursue you even after losing sight of you. Expect to be hunted!

The Most British Of Games
Sir, You Are Being Hunted is set in a parallel Britain, complete with bleak villages, rocky highlands, bramble-filled woodland, decrepit farms, and crumbling post-industrial landscapes.
Made with the remarkable power of our British Landscape Generator, these landscapes are enormously evocative and teeming with detail.
Take time to explore, and find that vital hidden flask of tea!
70010000130837.intro: Escape from these robot-infested islands with violence, trickery and stealth.
70010000130837.name: Sir, You Are Being Hunted

70010000130860.description:
YOUR WORLD, BUT TWISTED
When your best friend vanishes, you must enter the Dark Reflection—a hostile, warped copy of your own reality. Here, familiar places are dangerous, and friendly faces cannot be trusted.

SURVIVE THE NIGHTMARE
The Dark Reflection is a classic side-scrolling pixel-art adventure packed with action, puzzles, and heavy metal energy.

Explore: Search creepy locations and find vital items to survive.

Solve: Use your brain and your inventory to clear obstacles.

Fight: Slash your way through hordes of demons and unique bosses.

DARK HUMOR & HEAVY METAL
Step into a world where dark humor meets a heavy rock soundtrack. Every corner hides a secret, and every choice matters.

Features
Warped World: Explore an unsettling, distorted reality.

Classic Gameplay: Solve puzzles and manage items to progress.

Brutal Battles: Fight aggressive monsters and giant bosses.

Hidden Secrets: Find secret paths and weird encounters.

Your Choice: Make decisions that lead to multiple endings.

Turn up the volume of your doom.
70010000130860.intro: A thrash metal album reveals a ritual that opens a portal to another world.
70010000130860.name: Dark Reflection

70010000130931.description:
Make money from garage sales to buy furniture and new fixtures for their old house!
Home Makeover is a hidden object game that features decoration and match 3 mini games with unlimited levels and gameplay time, all in one package!

- 12 scenes and 10 gameplay modes
- Match-3 mini-games
- Decoration and makeover
- Bonus household tips and facts
70010000130931.intro: Help Emma restore her grandparents' old house back to its former glory!
70010000130931.name: Home Makeover: Hidden Object

70010000130936.description:
Become the Nightmare of All Humanity

Tome of the Damned is a dark and gripping top-down roguelike that tells the tragic story of a mage whose reckless experiments with forbidden magic ended in disaster. Once a powerful sorcerer, you are now a living corpse doomed to endless cycles of reincarnation, inhabiting the bodies of the dead. Your lair lies deep within the castle’s dungeons, surrounded by former allies and castle guards who are determined to keep you locked away to prevent your dark magic from escaping.

Your journey begins in the deepest, darkest corners of the castle. Step by step, you fight your way toward freedom, facing increasingly powerful foes-seasoned warriors, cunning mages, and relentless guards willing to give their lives to stop you.

Along the way, you discover ancient altars that serve as sources of power.

These altars allow you to enhance your weapons, unlock powerful spells, and improve your attributes, offering countless paths to develop your abilities and adapt to the trials ahead.

Choose one of five enchanted weapons and one of four magical grimoires, then grind your enemies to dust. But don’t worry if you happen to die.

After all, you still have plenty of bodies left-you can simply take a new one.
70010000130936.intro: Tome of the Damned - dark top-down roguelike. Cut down the castle guard, upgrade your weapons and spells, battle through dozens of locations, and face ruthless bosses.
70010000130936.name: Tome of the Damned

70010000131010.description:
Have you ever wanted to drink an entire lake through a straw? Well now you can in this cozy incremental fishing game! There's so much to sip in the lake, so upgrade your straw, drink up schools of fish, and maybe find what's at the bottom of the Lake!

Sip Fisher is an incremental fishing game about draining a lake of all its water.

Start out on an old dock surrounded by a vast and daunting lake. Sip up water from the lake, sell the fish you find, and upgrade your equipment to sip up the lake faster. Relax and explore as the lake gets lower. Progress until you have a massive dock and find out what’s at the bottom!
70010000131010.name: Sip Fisher

70010000131030.description:
Enter the arena and prove you're the apex serpent in this fast-paced snake battler. Compete against a swarm of rival snakes for every scrap of food, grow longer with every bite, and force your opponents into deadly mistakes. One wrong move means the end — crash into another snake and it's game over. Only the biggest and smartest survive.
GROW OR CRASH

Start small and chow down your way to the top. The more you eat, the longer and deadlier you become. But size cuts both ways — the bigger you grow, the harder it is to weave through the chaos. Steer clear of every other snake on the field, because a single collision ends your run. Outmaneuver your rivals, cut off their path, and watch them crash so you can feast on what's left.


FEATURES
-Snake Growth & Evolution — Every bite makes you bigger and stronger. Evolve from a tiny worm into a massive, screen-dominating beast.
-Living Food World — A constantly replenishing arena keeps the action non-stop. There's always something to eat — and always someone trying to take it first.
-Survive the Collision — Crash into another snake and you're done. Force your rivals into yours and clear the field of competition.
-Real-Time Leaderboards — Watch the rankings shift live as you and your rivals battle for the #1 spot. Can you hold the crown?
-XP & Progression — Earn experience with every match and level up your way to bigger rewards and bragging rights.
-Game-Changing Boosters — Deploy magnets, speed bursts, score multipliers, and vision boosters to turn the tide in the heat of battle.
-Cosmetic Customization — Make your snake unmistakably yours with a huge range of looks and styles at the skin Shop
-Booster Shop — Stock up on power-ups and head into each match loaded for war.
-Reward Economy — Earn coins through skillful play or Wheel of fortune and spend them on skins, boosters, and more. The grind always pays off.

THE ARENA AWAITS
No two matches play the same. Quick to learn, impossible to put down — Brawl Snakes delivers bite-sized chaos that's perfect for one more round... and then just one more.

Are you ready to become the Final Boss of the arena?
70010000131030.name: Brawl Snakes

70010000131080.description:
Welcome to the night shift! You just got a job running a small, 24-hour shawarma stand on a dark, quiet street. It seems like an easy way to earn some quick cash. Wait for a customer to approach the window, prepare their food, and collect the money. However, as the midnight crowd arrives, you'll quickly realize that this isn't an ordinary neighborhood and that not everyone on the other side of the glass is human.

To survive in this kiosk, you need to be paranoid and have a sharp eye. As each customer approaches to place an order, observe them closely and check the security cameras for anything unusual. Are their voices distorted? Are their facial features morphing into something monstrous? Is there an unsettling shadow lurking just out of sight? Learn to spot these terrifying anomalies hiding in plain sight.

When a guest checks out, treat them to a delicious shawarma and send them on their way. However, if your gut tells you something is wrong, do not hesitate. Hit the red emergency button and slam the heavy metal shutters down immediately. You cannot afford to be careless. You only have five chances to mess up. If you make too many mistakes by feeding a monster or turning away a normal person, you will summon the dreaded Inspector. If he arrives at your window, your shift is over... and your life might be, too.

Do you have the nerve to survive until morning?
70010000131080.name: Scary Shawarma Shop

70010000131097.description:
DopePie Survivors 3D is a third-person shooter that blends survivor-like combat with 3D platforming.

In a vertical city ravaged by a virus, take control of characters with unique abilities and battle waves of infected enemies and gigantic bosses. Collect a wide variety of weapons and skills to create a different build in every run.

Climb buildings, race across rooftops, and glide from the heights while using the city's vertical spaces to your advantage. Pilot tanks, armed helicopters, and other vehicles to break through the horde.

Master each character's talents, adapt your strategy, and lead your allies out of this dangerous city!
70010000131097.intro: Lead the survivors through a vertical city overrun by the infected!
70010000131097.name: DopePie Survivors 3D

70010000131103.description:
The main character of the game, a young and brave soldier, goes on an epic journey to save meme characters.

Players will have to control the soldier, overcoming a variety of obstacles, solving puzzles and fighting enemies that stand in the way of his goal.

Each level of the game offers unique challenges and mechanics, making the playthrough exciting and unpredictable.
70010000131103.intro: Save Memes 2 is an exciting and dynamic shooter game that immerses players in a world of fantastic adventures and challenges.
70010000131103.name: Save Memes 2

70010000131113.description:
Drive around and enjoy the city!

Find parts and upgrade your car!

Fuel is limited, so keep an eye on your levels!

Drifting is your best friend in this game!

Build your car and become the best racer!
70010000131113.intro: Start your journey with a basic car and upgrade to an awesome ride!
70010000131113.name: Build Your Own Car

70010000131121.description:
A game that teaches you about Japan's "Blue Ticket" system!

This game allows you to learn about Japanese traffic laws and the "Traffic Infringement Notification System" (commonly known as the "Blue Ticket" system)—which came into effect in April 2026—through gameplay. In the quiz stage, you can learn the correct rules and interesting trivia via True/False questions. The action stage lets you navigate a city modeled after real Japanese streets, challenging you to reach your destination safely without committing any traffic violations.

Is it okay to ride on the sidewalk? What is the correct way to navigate a T-junction? Can children get a "Blue Ticket"? Is it permissible to hang bags on the handlebars? Find the answers to these questions and more.
Use this game to acquire accurate and proper knowledge.

The game features a bilingual display (Japanese and English), making it a great tool for language study.
It is also designed so that international visitors to Japan—or anyone interested in understanding Japanese traffic laws—can play with ease and confidence.
70010000131121.intro:
A game to learn about the Blue Ticket system
Two gameplay modes: Quiz and Action
Simultaneous Japanese and English display
70010000131121.name: Bicycle Quiz & Riding

70010000131127.description:
Speed is only the beginning. The real challenge starts in every corner.

Push your car to the limit, enter corners at high speed, and control every slide with precision. Chain smooth drifts, maintain your momentum, and chase higher scores while competing in intense street races.

Winning takes more than raw speed. Your entry angle, drift control, racing line, and exit timing all matter. Every corner is an opportunity to gain an advantage, improve your run, and prove your driving skills.

Feel the rush of fast cars, sharp turns, and perfectly controlled drifts as you fight for better results and cleaner runs. Easy to pick up but rewarding to master, every race gives you another reason to come back and improve.

Features:

High-speed drift racing
Skill-based driving and precise car control
Competitive street races where speed and style both matter
Challenging tracks and corners built for drifting
Accessible gameplay with plenty of depth to master
Chase higher scores and improve your best runs
Fast-paced racing atmosphere focused on cars, speed, and drifting

Hit the road, leave your mark on the asphalt, and prove you can master every corner.
70010000131127.intro: Master the streets. Own every drift.
70010000131127.name: Drift Club: Street Legends

70010000131162.description:
Move through 3D space to find hints, solve mysteries and escape from the room.
Anyone can play to the end because you can see hints and answers.
70010000131162.name: Escape game R00M17
