70010000131168.description:
Look at the chessboard and find the one move that delivers checkmate.

Check each piece, the opponent king’s escape routes, and the way the board is defended. Then choose the move that ends the position in a single turn.

How to play:
・Study the whole board
・Think of the move that creates checkmate
・Choose your answer and test your reading

Each puzzle can be played in a short session, making it easy to enjoy as quick brain training during a break.

Recommended for:
・Players who want to practice chess tactics
・People looking for short puzzle challenges
・Fans of logic, focus, and forward thinking
・Anyone who enjoys solving problems alone at their own pace

Read the board, find the key move, and aim for a clean checkmate.
70010000131168.intro:
Find the winning move
Solve checkmate puzzles
Train your chess thinking
70010000131168.name: One-Move Checkmate : Chess Brain Trainer

70010000131218.description:
Take flight in your seaplane on a heartfelt adventure across the tropical Limbo archipelago. After a devastating storm, gather materials with your Swirler, and help the locals rebuild. Can you uncover the truth behind Uncle Lou’s disappearance?

A Seaplane, a Storm, and a Missing Uncle

Take to the skies in your trusty seaplane on a heartfelt adventure across the tropical Limbo archipelago. After receiving a distress call from Uncle Lou, you arrive only to find the islands in disarray and Lou nowhere to be found. Collect resources, help rebuild a community, and unravel the mystery of your uncle’s disappearance.

Collect, Craft, Restore

Harness the vacuum power of the Swirler! — a glorious multi-tool — to collect everything from scrap and native plants to materials dropped by Limbo’s unique wildlife. Use your finds to repair buildings, craft goods, and help the communities thrive again.

Claim your slice of paradise at Lou’s Lagoon. Build your dream beach hut, add your personal touch, and let the island rhythm take over.

Meet the islanders of Limbo

Discover the archipelago’s vibrant islands, each with their own spirited communities, hidden treasures, and unique problems to solve. Get a warm welcome from the Charneys in Tangle Bloom—the archipelago's liveliest town—then head to Gleam Reef to watch the Vooi move to the music of the tides. Lastly, visit Boulderia, home to the grumpy, sugar-crystal-mining Gorplins!

Key Features: 

- Explore the Limbo archipelago, home to vibrant communities and ancient secrets. 
- Pilot your very own seaplane, master ring challenges, and enjoy the freedom of open skies. 
- Upgrade your gadgets to expand your adventures. Scoop, build, glide and fish! 
- Build your island base, decorate it, and make Lou’s Lagoon feel like home. 
- A mystery to unravel. Piece together clues, follow Lou’s trail, and uncover the truth behind his disappearance! 

Whether you’re hot on the trail to solving the mystery of Uncle Lou or just kicking back and enjoying island life, Lou’s Lagoon is your ticket to an exciting adventure.

Ready for takeoff?
70010000131218.name: Lou's Lagoon – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000131251.description: A soundtrack featuring over 30 tracks, including the original music from the 2002 release of "Touhou Koumakyou" and the tracks newly arranged by ZUN for "Touhou Koumakyou: New Classic".
70010000131251.name: Touhou Koumakyou: New Classic Soundtrack Player

70010000131274.description:
Explore a vast urban landscape in this narrative-driven, 2D top-down platforming adventure!

In Pipistrello and the Cursed Yoyo, you're a budding yoyo master facing off against enemies using the weapon you know best: your prized yoyo! As Pippit, you'll be quite literally thrown into the shocking story of your auntie's business empire, a soul-stealing mega-laser, and four dastardly crime bosses!

Each yoyo trick you learn will drastically change the way you look at the cityscape, and the battlefield! By chaining moves together, you'll be able to explore secret areas and teach those baddies a lesson! Many challenges have multiple solutions — so come up with your own novel routes in this mouth-watering adventure!

Features:
• Explore the city's 4 districts with over 1000 screens of challenges and secrets!
• Infiltrate the businesses of the 4 crime bosses! Navigate their labyrinthine buildings, take on foes, and solve action puzzles!
• Learn yoyo tricks and techniques to create your own cityscape yoyo-parkour routes, and make those mob minions pay!
• Collect over 40 ability-enhancing Badges that alter the way you play!
• Unlock over 20 passive Upgrades through a shady loan shark!
• Find over 80 other collectibles throughout town, from life upgrades to precious treasures!
70010000131274.intro: Are you ready for the first Yoyovania?!
70010000131274.name: Pipistrello and the Cursed Yoyo - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000131289.description:
Through Nintendo Switch™ 2, a girl living in another world keeps you company while you work at your desk.

Memory of Memorie : A Chill Story is a work adventure where the story progresses together with the time you spend working, as you share your desk time with Memorie, an apprentice witch.

In a quiet room filled with gentle Celtic music, whenever you sit down to work, Memorie studies magic by your side.

What used to be solitary work time slowly becomes something warmer: time shared with someone.

■ The more you focus, the more the story unfolds

The game features a Pomodoro-based focus timer. As you accumulate focused work sessions, conversations with Memorie and events in her world gradually unlock.

Everyday chats.
Small changes creeping into the village.
And the secret she keeps hidden.

Beyond your work, a new piece of the story awaits.

■ Your focus changes her world

As the story progresses, Memorie's room gradually begins to change.

Her favorite cup.
The glow of magic.
A space growing warmer and richer.

The more you keep going, the more her world moves forward too.

■ Features

・A cozy fantasy workspace with Celtic music and ambient sounds
・A Pomodoro-technique-based focus timer
・Story and world mysteries unlocked through your focus time
・A room that changes as the story progresses
・A calendar system to track your daily focus
・A companion for studying, working, creative projects, and all kinds of desk work

■ The World

The story takes place in Elmana Village, a small settlement not far from the Imperial Capital. It is a peaceful place protected by the sacred Lightroot Tree.

But little by little, a dark presence begins to creep into the world.

Using a spell that connects distant people, Memorie found you. Was it coincidence, or...?

Stay focused, and see the story through to its ending together.
70010000131289.intro:
The more you focus, the more the story unfolds.
A chill work adventure with a girl from another world.
Focus time no longer spent alone, for you.
70010000131289.name: Memory of Memorie : A Chill Story – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000131302.description:
This pack includes the games: WildTrax & Hypercar Racing.

In WildTrax Racing you will enjoy the wildest and most spectacular races in natural environments. You will have several game modes such as Arcade and 4-player multiplayer.

In Hypercar Racing you'll enjoy the dirtiest, fastest, and most spectacular races at speeds over 200 Mp/h, avoiding multiple collisions against 8 adversaries. The game has different modes, such as Championship, Arcade, and 4-player multiplayer.

Features:

- Wide variety of tracks.
- Multi-player with 4 players.
- Races with 12 opponents.
- Realistic driving physics.
- Lots of Rock 'N Roll music.
70010000131302.intro: Enjoy 2 games in 1 with this irresistible speed games pack!
70010000131302.name: WildTrax & Hypercar Bundle

70010000131308.description:
Wobbly Life is a vibrant open-world physics sandbox. Play with your friends online or in local co-op, with exciting jobs, mini games and wacky story missions. Earn cash to spend in the world on clothes, vehicles and houses. There is a whole Wobbly World out there to explore!

Grandma has kicked you out into the big wide Wobbly world demanding you go and GET A JOB! She would be so proud if you could earn some money and get your own house one day!

It's time to start earning and living your best Wobbly Life!

Includes Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition features:
- GameShare: Play Wobbly Life with anyone – even if they don't own the game!
- GameChat: Share audio and video while playing with your friends.
- Start where you left off on Nintendo Switch™ with forwards compatible save game to Nintendo Switch™ 2
- 1-4 players online and local split screen co-op

Open-world sandbox filled with mini-games, toys, secrets and SO MUCH more

+100 unique missions & jobs with exclusive rewards to unlock, alone or with friends

+90 vehicles to ride around (and crash)

+500 clothes items to show-off in your wobbly look

+infinite number of wobbly fun!

FUN, FRIENDS & PHYSICS!

Let's start exploring! Almost everything is interactive – grab, play, and experiment in a world filled with props, mini-games, and surprises.

Experience the joy of individual quests and shared adventures with up to 4 players in online or local co-op, all in one fantastical world.

MYSTERIES AND MISSIONS

Embark on story missions, each offering unique rewards through satisfying puzzles and challenges. Unveil the mysteries of the tropical island, uncover the mountain’s secrets, delve into hidden caves...

The Wobbly Museum has lost all its artifacts! Maybe you can help? Buy treasure maps and solve clues to find all the Museums' lost treasures and unlock fun rewards.

GO GET A JOB!

Make grandma happy and go get that job! Earn money by choosing from +20 exciting jobs, each bringing their new unique challenges. From pizza delivery to firefighting, taxi driver to disco dancer… your wobbly dream job is waiting for you.

LIVE THE HIGH WOBBLY LIFE!

Once you’ve fattened up your bank account why not go on a shopping spree? Visit the Pet Shop to buy a faithful companion, buy and unlock +500 clothes items and choose from +90 different vehicles.

When you’ve really made the big bucks, you can even buy a house: from a wooden shack to a huge fancy mansion, Wobbly Island has a home for everyone whatever your taste!

PLAY YOUR OWN WAY WITH ARCADE MODE

Want to take a break from the Wobbly Island? Try out the Arcade mode! Discover four new game modes: Trash Zone, Hide & Seek, Wobble Run and Sandbox. Each have customizable settings for you to play with, multiple mini-games and new areas to have fun in!

GO TO SPACE! The Wobbly Space Programme is looking for new recruits. Space is a whole new open world, with new jobs, missions, and secrets to uncover. You'll even get to fly your own spaceships too, so what are you waiting for!
70010000131308.name: Wobbly Life - Nintendo Switch™  2 Edition

70010000131361.description:
Domesticated animals get wild in roguelike arena shooter combat where survival is all that matters! Pick 1 of 14 playable pets, each with unique skills and stats, as they face hordes of fantasy monsters like slimes, rock giants, oversized bugs, carnivorous plants and more in top-down retro pixel art style.

Choose wisely from a dozen starting weapons, then select a level from areas you’ve unlocked. Take down waves of enemies while strategically keeping your distance from danger. Level up and choose upgrades mid-battle, all in preparation for a big boss showdown. If you succeed, you’ll bank coins you’ve collected to spend on permanent perks, thus stacking the deck in your favor for the next fight!

• Survive waves of incoming enemies in addictive real-time arena combat!
• Choose from more than a dozen domesticated animals.
• Pick a starting weapon and upgrade on-the-fly as you level up!
• Collect coins to spend on permanent stat boosts between stages.
• Use character-specific skills to turn the tide of battle!
• Enjoy retro pixel art aesthetics and multiple difficulty options!
70010000131361.intro: Fend off waves of monsters as a dog, cat, chicken and other unlockable furry or feathered friends!
70010000131361.name: Pets Survivors

70010000131381.description:
Venture into a realm of towering ice peaks, shimmering frost, and skies so high they brush the stars. As Owlen, you glide above frozen cliffs, drifting clouds, and ancient structures built into the mountain’s heart. Guided by distant spirits, your mission is to restore harmony by flying through magical circles that awaken frozen landscapes, rekindle star-touched flora, and breathe life back into forgotten heights.

Throughout your journey, you will uncover memory shards hidden within icy caverns, wedged between jagged peaks, or floating gently among starlit winds. These fragments reveal long-buried truths about the mountain, its guardians, and Owlen’s purpose. Gather enough shards to ascend into new regions—each with its own atmosphere, light, and mysteries.

Every level begins with a quiet moment in which the spirits share the history of the land and the significance of the paths ahead. As you fly, voices carried by the wind may guide you, warn you, or offer glimpses of their stories. The experience is calm, magical, and reflective as you uncover the mountain’s ancient secrets—one shard at a time.
70010000131381.intro: Take flight as Owlen and explore icy mountains, glowing star paths, and realms above the clouds.
70010000131381.name: Owlen and the Starbound Mountain

70010000131416.description:
In this world, strong and beautiful women compete in a tournament known as the Queen’s Blade. The most powerful warrior will claim the crown and rule over all.

Choose your warrior and embark on a journey to challenge the ultimate ruler, Queen Aldra.
Navigate through randomized choices, defeat your rivals, and collect new cards to strengthen your deck. Unleash devastating combos on your path to becoming the new Queen!

The card battles take place in real time, putting your skills to the test.
(*Turn-based battles can also be selected based on your preference.)

The key to victory is the Armor Break system. Every warrior’s armor is split into three zones: high, mid, and low. Shatter your opponent's armor first—once their defenses are completely stripped away, strike with a decisive blow!

As you progress, you will unlock new warriors, cards, and even tougher rivals.
For those looking to push their limits, a challenge mode called "Path to the Strongest" awaits. Will you be able to defeat the true Queen?
70010000131416.intro: A rogue-lite deck-building game featuring beautiful warriors has arrived!
70010000131416.name: Queen's Blade Re:Build

70010000131451.description:
An insidious warlock has seized control of Victor Graves’ body, manipulating his voice, his actions, and his reputation to infiltrate the Academy’s inner circle. Under the guise of a trusted mentor, the warlock weaves a sinister plan: to bind the next generation of mages into eternal loyalty and raise an unstoppable magical army. Powerless yet conscious, Victor is trapped inside, fighting to reclaim his own mind.

Through classic mahjong gameplay combined with engaging hidden object challenges, players must uncover clues, break enchantments, and weaken the warlock’s hold from within. Each level brings you closer to restoring Victor’s control and exposing the deception threatening the Academy.

With richly detailed environments, immersive magical themes, and a hauntingly beautiful soundtrack, “Mahjongus 2: The Warlock Within” delivers a thrilling continuation of the series—where every move matters, and the greatest battle is for the soul itself.

● 150 Mahjong levels to play!
● 14 extra HOGs!
● Classic Mahjong Gameplay!
● Stunning graphics and immersive music!
● Fascinating story full of twists!
● Dive into a world of magic and intrigue!
● Explore vibrant, mystical environments!
● Save Victor Graves and the Academy from a dark warlock!
70010000131451.intro: Help Victor Graves break free from a warlock’s control and save the Academy of Magic through classic mahjong puzzles
70010000131451.name: Mahjongus: The Warlock Within

70010000131478.description:
Ready to find the mythical creature that matches your vibe?

Answer a few simple questions and enjoy a casual personality quiz that points you toward one of 16 fantasy-inspired types.

You know those little choices that somehow feel very you? This game turns that feeling into a light, easy-to-read result based on the answers you pick.

How to play is simple!

・Read the question
・Choose the answer that feels closest to you
・Check your result

There are no right or wrong answers, so just go with your gut and have fun seeing what type appears.

Play solo and read your result at your own pace, or try it with family and friends to compare everyone’s types.

Recommended for players who like personality quizzes, fantasy themes, quick casual games, or a fun conversation starter.

What kind of mythical creature is sleeping inside you?
Answer by instinct and discover your type from the 16 possibilities!

Button and touch controls are supported.
70010000131478.name: Mythical Creature Personality Quiz: 16 Types

70010000131510.description:
Bitter—a desert planet riddled with the refuse left behind by an interstellar war. 45 years ago, the war suddenly ended when all of the spaceships crashed onto Bitter for reasons unknown. Now, a young salvager named Lukida hopes to escape this planet, but a sudden attack by a giant robot sets events into motion that will change her life—and the face of Bitter—forever.

The Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition features higher framerates and resolution!
70010000131510.intro: Break the barriers and blaze through Bitter!
70010000131510.name: STARBITES - Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition

70010000131517.description:
Burn rubber through endless highways in the ultimate high-speed traffic racer. Weave between oncoming cars, dodge slower traffic, and push your reflexes to the limit as the road never ends.

Features:

23 Sports Cars — Unlock and tune a garage of 23 sports cars, each with its own handling and top speed. Find the ride that matches your driving style.

Infinite Roads — Our procedural road generation system means no two runs are ever the same. The highway stretches on forever, so the only finish line is the one your skills set.

Dynamic Weather & Levels — Race across multiple environments and conditions, from blazing sunshine to treacherous ice. Adapt your driving as grip and visibility shift beneath your wheels.

Multiple Camera Views — Switch between cockpit, chase, and other camera angles to race exactly the way you like it. Go first-person for the adrenaline rush or pull back for total control.

Front Crash Mode — Crave chaos? Flip on Front Crash Mode and embrace the carnage as you barrel head-on into traffic for maximum impact.

Floor it. Dodge everything. Survive the rush.
70010000131517.intro: Outrun the traffic. Outlast the chaos.
70010000131517.name: Xtreme Traffic Racing

70010000131523.description:
Step into a neon-soaked cyber city in this observation-based sci-fi mystery game.
You play as Miyabi, a sharp forensic investigator called to the scene of the crime.
Search each illustration for the clues hidden within — the key to cracking the case.

How to play is simple:
- Read the case briefing carefully
- Scan the scene for anything out of place — a strange detail, a telltale trace
- Once you spot it, move your cursor over it and press the A button

No expert knowledge required.
All you need is a sharp eye for detail and a flash of detective intuition.

Even an ordinary-looking scene might be hiding something off — if you look closely enough...
That rush of ""there it is!"" the moment you spot the clue? It's addictive.

Perfect for anyone who loves mysteries and puzzles,
or just can't resist a good spot-the-difference challenge.

Each case is a quick one-question round, making it perfect for a commute or a short break.
70010000131523.intro:
The evidence is hidden in the artwork.
Find the truth with a keen eye — a cyber sci-fi mystery!
70010000131523.name: Cyber City: Science Crime Mystery

70010000131530.description:
Take on the ultimate takoyaki challenge on Nintendo Switch™!
Add the batter and ingredients, then flip the takoyaki with a pick!
Play with up to 4 players using one Joy-Con™ controller each!

Enjoy a variety of game modes!
Cause chaos with items and random events in Party Battle, test your skills against friends in Battle, or make takoyaki to order in Score Attack!

Become a takoyaki master!

《Rules》
Make takoyaki using a takoyaki maker!
The better they turn out, the more points you earn!
Make as many as you can before time runs out!

《How to Play》
1. Fill each hole in the pan with batter and ingredients.

2. When the takoyaki starts to brown, use a pick to flip it over! Be careful not to act too quickly or too slowly! Once both sides are fully cooked, the takoyaki is done!

[Party Battle]
The feature mode of Super Takoyaki Battle is "Party Battle!"
Chaos erupts as up to 4 players compete on one giant grill!
Unique events occur to change the flow of the match!
Use items to gain the advantage over your opponents!
It's anyone's game until the very last second!

[Score Attack]
Master 3 different makers—home, food stall, and commercial—each with its own unique challenges!
Cook up as many takoyaki as you can, fill orders, and aim for a high score!

[Battle]
Compete with up to 4 players to see who's the ultimate takoyaki chef!
You can also challenge CPU opponents!

[Rankings]
Compete for high scores against players from around the world!
Become a takoyaki master!
70010000131530.intro:
Experience takoyaki-making like never before!
Make as many as you can in an all-out battle!
70010000131530.name: Super Takoyaki Battle

70010000131578.description:
You are one of the last flying drones, untouched by the virus.
You are faced with a quiet but crucial mission: penetrate the depths of the infected bunker and find what remains hidden within its sections. Something that will later play a key role in the fate of the entire complex.

With each level, the corridors become more dangerous: external mechanisms, security traps, closed blocks that are easy to crash into—all hidden in the darkness. But the drone has a special vision; it can see what is normally invisible, and sometimes there's a chance that it can protect you from range.

Along the way, you'll have to deal with epic bosses—malfunctioning security machines and twisted structures, whose virus has transformed into something unpredictable.

To the Basement: Before is a side-scrolling arcade game where flight, maneuvering, devastating humidity, traps, and boss fights intertwine in a single, grim journey through a contaminated area.
Test your resilience and willpower in these challenges!
70010000131578.intro:
Perform precise movements
Defeat the bosses
Complete the levels
70010000131578.name: To the Basement: Before

70010000131590.description:
Ready to pop some bubbles? Match colors, trigger exciting combos, and clear challenging puzzles one shot at a time.

Enjoy intuitive controls, satisfying gameplay, and hundreds of relaxing moments as each level brings new challenges and colorful fun.
70010000131590.name: Bubble Shooter: Color Splash

70010000131596.description:
Forget slow, methodical flight sims—Drone Attack unadulterated, fast-paced aerial carnage. You’re tossed into the digital cockpit of a heavily armed drone and tasked with one simple objective: absolute devastation. The controls are razor-sharp, letting you scream across the terrain, thread the needle through a storm of anti-air fire, and strike with lethal precision.

But what truly elevates the power fantasy is how incredibly heavy the destruction feels. Powered by gorgeous, impactful 3D graphics, every strafing run and missile strike lands with a satisfying, visceral crunch. It’s loud, it’s chaotic, and it’s beautifully explosive.

KEY FEATURES:

-Fast-Paced Aerial Carnage: Master the flight mechanics of an agile combat drone. The combat demands aggressive speed and precision, letting you dodge, weave, and return fire without breaking a sweat.
-Total Base Destruction: Leave nothing standing. Wipe out radar towers, SAM sites, and sprawling military compounds. Dropping a full missile payload sends stunning shockwaves through the battlefield, reducing towering bases to ash in seconds.
-Visceral 3D Graphics: Experience the heat of battle with gorgeous visual effects. Every time your rotary cannons shred enemy armor, you'll feel it through highly detailed, physics-heavy explosions.
-Deep Hangar Customization: Between white-knuckle sorties, hit the Hangar to cash in your hard-earned Command Points. Bolt on thicker armor, overclock your engines, and unlock weapon tiers that border on war crimes.
-Tactical Resource Management: Aggression is rewarded, but carelessness gets you killed. Knowing exactly when to vent your weapon heat and when to unleash a lethal barrage is the difference between victory and becoming scrap metal.
70010000131596.intro: Rain hell. Leave ash. Master the ultimate drone.
70010000131596.name: Drones Attack

70010000131649.description:
Can your child build English confidence one word at a time?

Words learned early can make school feel a little easier. This quiz game helps kids practice basic English vocabulary in a fun, low-pressure way.

How to play:
・Look closely at the picture
・Pick the matching English word from 4 choices
・Get it right to read a detailed explanation

Even when a word feels new, each question is simple to try, so kids can learn by playing again and again.

Aim for a perfect score and give English study a fun head start!

Perfect for kids who dream of using English someday, and for anyone who wants school practice to feel more like play.

Supports button controls and touch controls.
70010000131649.name: Palabras en inglés para aprender en la primaria

70010000131662.description:
You've overslept, missing the first lecture of the day! Your class assignment is due, but what time were you supposed to meet your study group again? These are everyday little problems that require some problem-solving, minor sleuthing, and resolution!

Little Problems is a refreshing departure from the typical narrative of grandiose conflicts and complex villainy. It invites players to delve into a world where detective work is about connecting with friends, understanding the small yet significant issues of daily life, and finding joy in the simplicity of resolution. This game isn't about saving the world; it's about enriching it, one little problem at a time.

This charming title, challenges players to solve mysteries around minor inconveniences, everyday misunderstandings, and of course, little problems.

Key Features:
• Cute, hand-drawn art by an Indonesian illustrator, Melinda.
• Solve Life’s Little Problems: Help Mary through life’s little challenges, small in scale, big in charm.
• Handcrafted Puzzles: Each level is a unique scenario, lovingly designed to be clever, approachable and satisfying.
• 10 Distinct Cases: Each case presents a different scenario with its own set of puzzles and surprises.
• Helpful Hints When You Need Them: If you get stuck, you can see where mistakes are, keeping the challenge fun, not frustrating.
• Easy to Pick Up, Hard to Put Down: Simple mechanics that grow into playful twists and surprising solutions.
70010000131662.intro: Solve minor inconveniences, everyday misunderstandings, and of course, little problems. This game is not about saving the world; it's about enriching it, one case at a time.
70010000131662.name: Little Problems: A Cozy Detective Game

70010000131668.description:
The cursed tower rises before you: a colossus whose walls pulse with neon light and echoes of ancient battles. Deep within await the 5 Generals of the Demon King, surrounded by their infernal hordes. They have kidnapped the Saint to offer her as a sacrifice and open a portal that will allow their master to return to this world. Your mission is to plunge into the unknown and rescue her before the Dark Lord’s plans come to pass.

Control your flippers, keep the ball in play, and ascend a tower filled with enemies, secrets, and increasingly intense challenges.

Each room presents a new challenge: destroy enemies, activate powers through cards, and manage your resources to survive. As you progress, you’ll master the physics, discover hidden mechanics and secret routes, and find the keys needed to reach the true ending. Only those who explore carefully, adapt their strategy, and perfect their technique will unravel the secrets of the tower. How far can you go?

- Two game modes: Arcade Mode for quick sessions, and Adventure Mode, where saved items allow for progression.
- Co-Op Mode: Play with the help of a friend. Using the target cursor, they can select cards, defeat enemies, destroy attacks, and collect upgrades.
- Enter 10 challenge stages featuring bosses that will test your precision and skill as you discover their weak points.
- Defeat enemies as you ascend the tower’s 5 floors and uncover all its mysteries.
- More than 15 Power Cards scattered throughout the tower, allowing you to build your own strategy.
- Earn points and climb the online leaderboard.
- Unlock collectible visual filters and customize the game’s appearance.
70010000131668.intro: In Pinballoid Crush, classic pinball evolves into an arcade experience with adventure and strategy elements.
70010000131668.name: Pinballoid Crush

70010000131683.description:
■About This Game
Hololive Fantasy, the unit featuring 〈Houshou Marine〉〈Shirogane Noel〉〈Shiranui Flare〉 and 〈Usada Pekora〉, enters the biggest free-for-all battle of the century in pursuit of the wish-granting “Queen’s Throne”!
Experience “oshi victory” by winning with your oshi in this 2.5D versus action game for up to four players!
That's ‘Hololive Fantasy Battle’ #HoloBattle

■How to Play
・[Move] → [Attack] That’s it!
・Use unique attacks to stagger opponents, knock them back, and gain the upper hand!
・Obtaining a Red Super Weapon drastically changes your attacks!
・Launch the game-changing “Solo Live,” and let your oshi dominate the stage!

■Costume Change
・Your oshi is already cute enough, but now they’ll become even cuter. Can you darlings handle it?!

■Versus Mode: "Online Battle"
・Up to 4 players clash in an all-out brawl to decide the winner!
・Expand your strategy with combinations of [Each Talent's Unique Ability] × [Field Gimmicks]!

■Solo / Co-op Mode: "Fake Hunter"
・For one reason or another, fake 3rd Gen members and fake 3rd Gen fans have appeared all over the place and are causing chaos. Time to make them reflect… ORAA!!
・Fight solo with NPC allies, or team up with friends and other players online!
・No worries if an ally goes down! With the "Rescue Totsumachi" feature, you can rescue fallen teammates—or have them rescue you.
70010000131683.intro:
【Breaking News】
Hololive 3rd Generation Members Unleash Chaos in Battle
70010000131683.name: Hololive Fantasy Battle

70010000131689.description:
You’re the night-shift worker at a run-down kiosk. Prepare shawarma, serve creepy customers, and try not to lose your mind. Each night is scarier than the last: shadows shift, ingredients vanish, and what lies outside the window is far worse than mere darkness.

Can you survive the shift and earn enough for upgrades? Or will you become the next item on the menu?

- Make shawarma
- Work through the fear
- Unlock new recipes
- Survive until dawn
70010000131689.intro: Welcome to Scary Shawarma: Kiosk—the strangest place to get shawarma... seasoned with fear!
70010000131689.name: Scary Shawarma: Kiosk

70010000131691.description:
Put your mind and reflexes to the test!
Dive into Pattern Pulse, a retro-futuristic skill game ideal for quick gaming sessions. The title includes two game modes:

♠ Memory Mode (Pattern): Memorize and repeat increasingly long and complex sequences of lights on the color buttons.
♥ Speed Mode (Follow Mode): Test your reflexes by pressing the buttons instantly as they light up, accompanied by a fun animated character.

Features:
♦ Two distinct experiences: mental training and pure reflex action.
♣ Arcade aesthetic with vibrant neon lights.
♠ High score tracking to push your limits.
70010000131691.intro: Put your mind and reflexes to the test in a retro-futuristic challenge!
70010000131691.name: Pattern Pulse

70010000131699.description: After a powerful cyclone transports Dorothy and her dog Toto from Kansas to the magical land of Oz, they set off down the yellow brick road toward the Emerald City. On her quest to find a way back home, she teams up with a Scarecrow, a Tin Man, and a Cowardly Lion, who are all seeking the great Wizard to grant their deepest wishes. Together, this unlikely group of friends must navigate unfamiliar lands and face the perils of Oz to reach their destination.
70010000131699.intro: A magical journey of friendship, courage, and finding your way home!
70010000131699.name: Dorothy's Magical Journey in Oz

70010000131704.description:
The cave ranger returns with his lady by his side in this treasure-hunting adventure!

Journey underground is search of long lost loot. Face down giant bug, snakes, and rival looters. Crack your whip, fire your pistol, and toss some TNT in this lighthearted, laid-back western, full of platformer fun.
70010000131704.intro: Chill co-op cowboy adventure. Up to 2 players!
70010000131704.name: Cave Looters

70010000131706.description:
Crafted with passion by the dream team that redefined side-scrolling beat 'em ups, Absolum mixes top-of-the-class combat action with modern roguelite elements, bringing all the vibes of the fantasy arcade hits of the past into an immersive adventure set in the original world of Talamh.

AN EPIC ADVENTURE IN AN ORIGINAL FANTASY WORLD

Talamh has been shattered by a magical cataclysm caused by ambitious wizards, leaving magic mistrusted by the common folk. Sun King Azra took advantage of this panic, enslaving wizards through his Crimson Order and placing loyal princes to rule over the conquered realms.
As Azra’s forces claim more and more lands, the high enchantress Uchawi and a small group of rebels rise from the shadows, wielding forbidden magic to challenge his oppressive regime and defy his absolute magic power.

FROM THE DESTRUCTION, NEW HEROES RISE

Meet the outcast heroes of Talamh, each with their unique fighting style.
From the shadows of Yeldrim, Galandra emerges as an unstoppable force of nature. Her colossal sword strikes with deadly precision, combined with chilling, destructive necromantic powers. Her calm demeanor is a thin veil, barely concealing the furious anger brewing inside her.
Karl is the last free dwarf of Talamh. Armed with an ancestral blunderbuss and his bare fists, he’s a master of close-range brawls and explosive tactics. What he lacks in reach at mid-range, he makes up for with raw strength and quick thinking, making him a stalwart ally in the revolt against Azra's oppression.
During their ordeals, two mysterious heroes will join them on a quest to overthrow the Sun King: Brome, a wizard prodigy on a mission to preserve the future generations of his people, and the enigmatic Cider, a nimble skirmisher in search of answers among the scattered fragments of their own soul.

THE ROGUE ‘EM UP ORIGINAL BY DOTEMU

Absolum combines Dotemu and Guard Crush’s mastery in beat ‘em up gameplay with Supamonks' best-in-class art and animation. With its fast-paced action and endless replayability, Absolum will challenge you with multiple paths to explore and unpredictable encounters for a new experience each time you play.

A NEW THRILLING GAMEPLAY TO MASTER

Take down Azra’s elite guard with a mix of rapid combo chains and spellcasting powers, unleashing moves that feel as raw as they are strategic. Use magical counters and rare items to turn the tide in your favor and experience a combat system that demands skill and timing, pushing you to craft new strategies at every run to wreak havoc among the enemy ranks.

THE BEAT ‘EM UP GENRE AT ITS VERY BEST

Lead the uprising against Azra's regime as a lone hero, or team up with a friend on your couch or online. Combine your elemental powers and synchronize your attacks into incredible chained combos!
The world of Talamh is an intricate tapestry brimming with secrets, stories, and betrayals. From the majestic mines of Grandery to the lush forests of Jaroba, every step of your odyssey will be accompanied by a magnificent soundtrack by composer Gareth Coker (Ori, Halo Infinite, Prince of Persia), with collaborations from Yuka Kitamura (Dark Souls, Elden Ring), Mick Gordon (Doom Eternal, Atomic Heart), and more!
70010000131706.intro: An original roguelite beat ‘em up by Dotemu!
70010000131706.name: Absolum - Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition

70010000131708.description:
Dive into a world of stunning, realistic puzzles that captivate your eyes and mind. Piece by piece, reveal breathtaking images of beautiful women — each completed puzzle unlocks a new masterpiece, keeping you motivated to discover what’s next.

Smooth and intuitive touch controls make gameplay effortless and deeply satisfying — you’ll feel like you’re truly shaping every picture with your own hands. Gentle, soothing music sets the perfect mood, helping you unwind while your curiosity pulls you to complete the next challenge.

Relax, enjoy, and let yourself get lost in the details.

Features:
• Addictive, easy-to-play puzzle mechanics.
• Gorgeous, realistic artwork of women.
• Satisfying touch interaction — every move feels natural.
• Unlock new, even more stunning images as you progress.
• Perfect balance of challenge and relaxation.
• Soothing soundtrack that enhances your focus and mood.
• Admire each completed image in full detail.
70010000131708.intro: Every piece brings you closer to perfection!
70010000131708.name: Hidden Girls: Private Nights

70010000131734.description:
Welcome to Fernkeep, a cozy exploration game set within the walls of a peaceful medieval stronghold. Wander through towering castles, bustling courtyards, narrow cobblestone streets, hidden gardens, and ancient towers as you search for every unique location throughout the town.

Features:
>Explore a handcrafted medieval castle town.
>Discover every hidden location and secret area.
>Wander through castles, courtyards, markets, gardens, and towers.
>Enjoy a relaxing, stress-free exploration experience.
>Immerse yourself in a peaceful medieval atmosphere.
>No combat, no timers, and no pressure—just exploration.
70010000131734.intro: Discover the quiet charm of a medieval castle town.
70010000131734.name: Fernkeep

70010000131749.description:
What makes one tiny detail turn into a big online moment?

Everyone has wondered why some things catch fire while others get ignored. If you have ever dreamed of growing from an unknown creator into someone people notice, this is your chance to test that instinct.

Aim for 1 Million! Influencer Dream is a casual picture-solving game where you read the prompt, scan the image, and choose the single spot that best matches. Clear stages as you chase the feeling of climbing toward influencer fame.

How to play:
・Check the prompt
・Look carefully across the image
・Select the one matching spot

Some stages are easy to read at a glance, while others reward a sharper eye and a little social-media sense. Each round is quick, but finding the right detail can feel surprisingly satisfying.

Play a stage whenever you have a moment, or take on all 150 at your own pace. Start your influencer dream and see how far your instincts can carry you.
70010000131749.name: Aim for 1 Million! Influencer Dream

70010000131761.description:
Word Hive is a word puzzle game where each puzzle gives you seven letters: six outer letters and one required center letter. Create as many words as possible using the available letters, but remember—every word must include the center letter.

Letters may be reused, and each word must contain at least four letters. Longer words earn more points, while special words that use all seven letters award bonus points.

Progress through the ranks as your score increases, challenge yourself to uncover every hidden word, and become the ultimate word master.

Challenge your mind, discover new words, expand your vocabulary, and enjoy a rewarding word puzzle experience with every level.

Word Hive uses an American English dictionary.

Features:
• Play through more than 2,000 word puzzle levels
• Create words using seven letters, including the required center letter
• Discover pangrams by finding words that use all seven letters
• Learn and discover new English words as you play
• Compete with other players through the online leaderboard
• Resume your last game and continue from where you left off
• Supports the Nintendo Switch™ Pro Controller
• Play in Handheld Mode, Tabletop Mode, or TV Mode
• Spin the daily wheel to earn coins and redeem them for hints whenever you get stuck
• Switch between light and dark themes
• Enjoy professional sound effects and atmospheric background music
70010000131761.intro: Build words, score points, and master the hive.
70010000131761.name: WordHive

70010000131764.description:
Peaceful, atmospheric exploration experience set in a dense, mysterious forest. Players are invited to wander through a quiet natural world filled with subtle details, hidden routes, and environmental storytelling. Rather than focusing on action or pressure-driven objectives, the experience emphasizes curiosity, discovery, and immersion in a calm, handcrafted setting.

As you move deeper into the woods, you gradually uncover the secrets woven into the landscape. Every path can lead to something new—whether it’s a hidden clearing, an unusual landmark, or a quiet moment that adds to the sense of mystery. The game encourages slow exploration and observation, rewarding players who take their time to look closely at the world around them.

Designed with a minimalist and relaxing approach, Green Thicket aims to create a soothing experience suitable for short sessions or longer, more meditative play. Its focus on atmosphere and exploration makes it ideal for players who enjoy discovery-driven games and tranquil environments.
70010000131764.intro: Relaxing exploration game where you wander through a mysterious forest, uncover hidden paths, and interact with the world at your own pace.
70010000131764.name: Green Thicket

70010000131772.description:
Can you spot what does not belong?

Chameleon Dummy Hunt is a colorful first-person hidden-object action game where sneaky dummy characters are hiding in plain sight. They are painted to blend into walls, floors, furniture, props, shadows, patterns, and bright environments.

Your mission is simple: search the level, find every camouflaged dummy, and blast them with your paint gun before time runs out.

Look closely. A strange shape on the wall, a color that feels slightly off, a dummy sitting like a decoration, or a suspicious object in the corner could be your next target. Some dummies stand still, some sit, some crouch, some lie on the floor, and some are hidden so well that you may walk right past them.

But be careful. Shooting the wrong object can cost you time and score. Use your scanner wisely when you are stuck, stay focused, and clear each level as fast as possible.

With 20 levels, multiple dummy poses, tricky camouflage, time-based challenges, score rewards, and controller-friendly gameplay, Chameleon Dummy Hunt turns every environment into a playful test of attention, speed, and visual skill.

Find them. Paint them. Hunt them.
70010000131772.intro:
Can you spot what does not belong?
Chameleon Dummy Hunt is a colorful first-person hidden
70010000131772.name: Chameleon Dummy Hunt

70010000131803.description:
Tamarack Narrows is a town running out of time - fading industry, mounting resentment, and a blood-red aurora bleeding across the sky. On the night of a centennial celebration meant to save it all, an unknown visitor arrives promising salvation, and brings something far older instead.

Play through the interwoven perspectives of Sarah Walker, her sister Bree, and the townsfolk caught in the town's final, unraveling night. Blending retro-style visuals, VHS-style distortion, and fixed-camera exploration, Act 0 stands on its own - no prior knowledge of the series required.

This is the night the story begins. This is the night Tamarack Narrows changed forever.

Features:
- Multi-perspective narrative following Sarah, Bree, and the townsfolk of Tamarack Narrows
- Analog-horror visuals: CRT distortion, VHS noise, and retro-style art
- Fixed-camera exploration through a collapsing prairie town
- A standalone prequel that expands the Boreal Tenebrae universe
- Atmospheric soundtrack shifting from nostalgia to dissonance
70010000131803.intro: A prequel narrative adventure set the night a dying prairie town collapses into fire, static, and cosmic horror.
70010000131803.name: Boreal Tenebrae Act 0

70010000131809.description:
Slime Rebellion! Small and adorable slimes have started a bouncing rebellion, filling up the entire screen. Dive right into this unstoppable commotion!

◆ Unstoppable Addiction
With simple and intuitive controls, anyone can easily jump in, but once you're hooked, there's no way out.

◆ The Fun of Growing with Various Elements
Build diverse skill trees using the loot you earn from battles. Add special abilities like striking lightning with cards and relics or summoning a bouncing boomerang that deals damage off walls, and grow in your own unique way!

◆ Diverse Skills and Refreshing Impact
Experience the thrill of wiping the screen clean with mercenary skills! Freeze enemies, drop meteors to defeat them, and use special weapons that deal massive Area of Effect (AoE) damage to feel an incredibly satisfying impact.

※ Caution ※
Be careful, your time might just vanish!
70010000131809.intro: The World's Cutest Chaos, Squishy Slime Commotion!
70010000131809.name: No More Slimes!!

70010000131830.description:
A tactical 2D top-down puzzle game inspired by the mechanics of 2048. Instead of numbers, you combine survival resources: food increases health, weapons enhance attack, and armor increases defense.

By merging identical items, you create stronger versions and decide what to develop next. Your goal is to strategically combine resources and prepare your heroes for the upcoming night, where any mistake could cost them their lives.

It's not about armor or crests anymore. The hour has come for those whose power is born of the very nature of rage and magic. It's time for new heroes to take up what has become their continuation: a jagged staff that has absorbed the wrath of the earth; a taut bow singing the songs of the wind; a battered grimoire in which the souls of forgotten gods whisper. Their battle is not a battle pattern, but a ritual.

Everything happens in a tense rhythm of day and night. During the day, you can combine items on the field and collect ready-made supplies in your supplies. At night, when the world is frozen in terror, all you can do is desperately try to put the pieces together.
70010000131830.intro:
Merge cards to upgrade
Upgrade your character
Defeat all monsters
70010000131830.name: Bone Marrow 2

70010000131837.description:
Save the music of the ocean alongside Doria, a little mermaid with a wobbly voice but a brave heart! When a freezing threat known as "The Silence" threatens to quiet her home, Doria must embark on a secret quest through kelp forests and dark canyons to assemble a mismatched choir of sea creatures and restore harmony to the reef. Experience a heartwarming story about friendship, resilience, and the power of finding your own voice!

Key Features:
• An Epic Tale: Dive into a rich narrative spanning over 10 chapters with a script of more than 10,000 words.
• Cinematic Visuals: Immerse yourself in spectacular 3D graphics in the style of a modern animated movie.
• Full Voice Acting: Experience the journey to the fullest with a game fully voiced in English.
• A Safe Experience: Perfect for the whole family, as the game contains no ads and no in-app purchases.
70010000131837.intro: Save the music of the ocean and help a brave little mermaid find her voice!
70010000131837.name: Doria & the Tide Song

70010000131841.description:
Join Loree, a brave and curious penguin, on a colorful 3D platforming adventure! Wearing his signature red propeller hat and cozy green scarf, Loree waddles, jumps, and glides his way through dozens of imaginative levels packed with challenges, secrets, and surprises.

Features:
• Dozens of levels spread across vibrant, themed worlds
• Collect coins to unlock new playable characters
• Race against the clock and earn up to 3 stars per level for a perfect run
• Simple, intuitive controls — easy to pick up, fun to master
• Charming low-poly art style paired with a cute pixel-art interface
• Explore everything from frosty mountain peaks to mysterious ruins

Whether you're chasing perfect star times on every level or just looking for a relaxing hop through cute, colorful worlds, Loree 3D offers approachable, family-friendly platforming fun for players of all ages.

Grab your propeller hat and start waddling — adventure awaits!
70010000131841.intro: Waddle into adventure with Loree, a fearless penguin explorer! Race through colorful 3D worlds, dodge obstacles, and collect coins for family fun.
70010000131841.name: Loree 3D

70010000131850.description:
STORY

Five years.

Five years on the run, spent hiding from surveillance cameras, police checks ... and friends.

In an attempt to elude the cult that's been chasing him, former Miami detective Lazarus “Lars” Bundy is in Italy working incognito for a security agency when his client is murdered in cold blood by a sharpshooter. As the blood stain slowly spreads on the victim's clothes, Lars realizes there is only one way to keep his past from catching up with him: solve the case before the police and bring the perpetrator to justice as quickly and silently as possible.

A senseless murder, conflicting clues and an indistinct lead will thrust the former detective on another thrilling journey around the world, from majestic Rome to the Land of the Rising Sun by way of Jordan and India. With help from an old ally he thought he’d left behind for good, Lars finds himself swept up in a case far more complex and dangerous than he ever could have imagined, filled with international mystery and mysticism. And all the while, a much more personal danger lurks close at hand, one that Lars is determined to suppress and keep hidden from the world.

FEATURES

> A new point-and-click adventure game inspired by the golden age classics
> Compelling blend of comedy, supernatural mystery, and conspiracy-steeped intrigue
> Alternate control between Lars and his returning cohort Alice
> Challenging but logical puzzles seamlessly integrated into the story
> Explore more than 50 stylish hand-drawn HD locations across Rome, Jordan, India and Japan
> Original atmospheric soundtrack and full English voice-overs (with German and Italian subtitles)
> Sequel to the acclaimed "The Hand of Glory" (95% positive reviews online), though no prior familiarity is necessary
70010000131850.intro: After five years in hiding, detective Lazarus “Lars” Bundy is swept up in another globe-trotting supernatural mystery whose origins trace back to a legend about the creation of Earth itself.
70010000131850.name: Roots in the Sky - The Hand of Glory 2

70010000131868.description:
In the world of Caelis, young unicorns receive a colorful coat pattern called a "weave" that grants them their magical gifts. When Posy is left completely plain on her Weave-Day, she sets off on a journey across the world to find where she belongs. Accompanied by her big-eared friend Tindle, she visits the six proud elemental keepers of Caelis. By using her unique talents of listening and kindness, Posy helps the guardians with their domains, ultimately uncovering a way to save the world's fading magic.

Features:
• Stunning Visuals: Beautifully presented with ultra-cute 3D animation style graphics.
• Engaging Length: The story spans 10 chapters totaling more than 10,000 words, offering a rich and immersive reading experience.
• Kid-Friendly Experience: It contains no ads or in-app purchases, ensuring a completely safe space for children.
• Self-Paced Reading: The layout and design are ideal for children to read and enjoy the story at their own pace.
70010000131868.intro: A magical journey of kindness and discovery!
70010000131868.name: The Unwoven Unicorn

70010000131876.description:
Welcome to Ironford, a cozy exploration game where adventure is all about discovery. Set in a quiet medieval fishing village along the coast, you'll wander through winding streets, wooden docks, market squares, forests, and hidden paths in search of every rare gem scattered throughout the world.

Features:
>Explore a handcrafted medieval seaside village.
>Search for and collect every rare gem.
>Wander through docks, markets, forests and village streets.
>Enjoy a relaxing, stress-free exploration experience.
>No combat, no timers, and no pressure—just exploration and collecting.

Can you uncover every rare gem hidden within Ironford?
70010000131876.intro: Search a peaceful seaside village for every hidden gem.
70010000131876.name: Ironford

70010000131881.description:
Project City is a top-down open-city action game inspired by the chaotic feel of classic arcade crime sandboxes. Hit the streets in a drivable city full of traffic, pedestrians, shops, police, gangs, odd jobs, and escalating trouble.

Earn cash by running taxi fares, package drops, food deliveries, and risky crew work, or push your luck with ATM hacks and weapon shop visits. Slide into drift challenges, dodge police heat, avoid spike strips and roadblocks, and keep moving when the city turns against you. Every run is about choosing how far to hustle, how much chaos to cause, and whether you can survive long enough to cash out.
With fast driving, on-foot exploration, wanted levels, city events, weapons, interiors, leaderboards, and a sharp street-comedy tone, Project City is a compact urban mayhem sandbox built around simple controls and constant trouble.
70010000131881.intro: Drive, drift, hustle, and survive a city that reacts to every bad decision.
70010000131881.name: Project City

70010000131912.description:
Step into the chaotic world of Rasterfire, a fast-paced top-down shooter inspired by the golden age of arcade action.

Fight your way through dangerous environments filled with hostile enemies, incoming projectiles and deadly obstacles. Keep moving, aim carefully and use your limited space to avoid attacks while returning fire. Every encounter tests your reactions, positioning and ability to survive under pressure.

The battlefield is viewed from above and presented in a distinctive retro pixel-art style, enhanced by CRT scanlines, vivid effects and an energetic arcade atmosphere. Enemies can attack from multiple directions, so staying alert is just as important as having a quick trigger finger.

Clear each area, survive increasingly intense battles and push forward through waves of opposition. Whether you are chasing a higher score or simply trying to reach the end, every round offers a compact dose of old-school shooting action.

Features:

Fast-paced top-down shooting gameplay
Retro pixel-art graphics with CRT-inspired effects
Multiple enemy types and dangerous attack patterns
Responsive controls designed for quick arcade action
Increasingly intense combat encounters
A dark, energetic soundtrack and classic shooter atmosphere

Load your weapon, enter the crosshairs and see how long you can survive in Rasterfire.
70010000131912.intro: Enter a fast-paced retro shooter filled with pixel-art action, dangerous enemies and relentless gunfire. Aim carefully, survive each encounter and clear your path through the battlefield.
70010000131912.name: RasterFire

70010000131937.description:
THE ARCADE CLASSICS YOU GREW UP WITH. REBUILT FOR TODAY.

The year is 2085. A runaway mega-intelligence called the Algorithm has decided humanity is obsolete, and unleashed millions of networked humanoid robots to make sure of it. You are one of the anomalies: minds the Algorithm could never map, predict, or control. Grab a controller and start fighting back.

RETROBOT: 2085 is a fast, frantic twin-stick shooter made in the style of a spiritual successor to one of your arcade favourites - a love letter to the golden age of the arcade, modernised with a fully 3D retro art style and that unmistakable 8-bit bleep-and-bloop soundtrack.

• ENDLESS ROBOTIC HORDES - Dismantle wave after wave of humanoid robots across dozens of levels, each one more relentless than the last.
• RESCUE THE LAST HUMAN FAMILY - Find every survivor scattered through the level. Reach them and they're rescued instantly for huge bonus points.
• CHASE THE HIGH SCORE - Classic arcade scoring, extra lives, and a leaderboard to settle who's the best, once and for all. Earn your spot - and your initials - at the top of the table.
• 4-PLAYER LOCAL MULTIPLAYER - Connect extra controllers and team up with up to three friends for chaotic local multiplayer action.
• TUNED FOR THE PAD - Precision twin-stick controls built around a controller, the way modern arcade action is meant to be played.
• A SECRET WORTH FINDING - Enter a classic secret code (remember these?) to unlock the hidden Service Menu, where you can switch on classic-style waves and controls for the original arcade experience.

Everything is playable from the start - no purchases required to unlock content, no forced progression systems gating your progress. Just you, an endless robot horde, and a high score table calling your name. How far can you get? Grab a friend (or three) and find out.
70010000131937.name: Retrobot: 2085

70010000131958.description:
Klondike Classic is the perfect solitaire experience for players who enjoy classic card games and relaxing puzzles.

Choose your favorite card back and enjoy a clean, elegant design focused on the classic Klondike experience.

Play at your own pace, sharpen your mind, and enjoy the timeless appeal of classic Solitaire!
70010000131958.intro: Relax and enjoy the timeless classic. Challenge yourself with the world's most beloved solitaire card game!
70010000131958.name: Klondike Classic

70010000131974.description:
When two of the same dog touch, BAM! You get a BIGGER dog. With careful placement, some clever purchases, and a can-do attitude, you can merge pups strategically and achieve the biggest dogs imaginable.

You really shouldn't adopt a dozen dogs, but now you can! Dogpile gets you to wrangle a cute collection of canines into the perfect deck, customize them, and play them expertly. Manage the clutter, upgrade and improve your cards as you go, and strive for the BIGGEST dogs.

Like in real life, dogs come with quirks and untapped potential! You’ll discover any variety of weird traits such as Barky, Sleepy, Timid, Cool and more. Take your dogs to the Dog Wash to add even more traits, and find Dog Tags that bolster and benefit from Trait synergy!

Utilize a clever array of powerful Dog Tags to modify how your dogs and their Traits function. Find interesting synergies and unique combos to aid you in all of your merging endeavors. And always remember your ultimate goal: BIGGER!
70010000131974.intro: Dogpile is a roguelike deck builder about merging cute dogs into bigger dogs. Play dogs, get money, customize your dogs with special Traits, refine your deck, PLAY MORE DOGS! DOGS!
70010000131974.name: Dogpile

70010000131989.description:
Step into the shadows and put your stealth skills to the test in a tense game of infiltration, timing, and escape.

Explore guarded buildings filled with valuable items while police officers patrol the corridors. Observe their movements, learn their routes, and wait for the perfect moment to sneak past them. One careless step can expose your position and turn a carefully planned robbery into a desperate attempt to escape.

Stay out of sight, use corners and rooms to avoid detection, and collect as much loot as possible before making your way to safety. Every corridor presents a new risk, forcing you to decide whether to grab another valuable item or leave before the patrol returns.

Success depends on patience, awareness, and smart movement. Study your surroundings, adapt to changing situations, and avoid rushing into danger. The more confident you become, the more daring your robberies can be.

Can you take the loot, avoid every patrol, and escape without getting caught?
70010000131989.intro: Sneak through guarded corridors, avoid police patrols, and steal valuable loot without being detected. Study their routes, stay out of sight, and escape before the law catches up with you.
70010000131989.name: Loot Before the Law

70010000131997.description:
Move through 3D space to find hints, solve mysteries and escape from the room.
Anyone can play to the end because you can see hints and answers.
70010000131997.name: Escape game R00M18

70010000132015.description:
Jump into the colorful world of Aetherfall - a 3D platformer packed with precise jumps, evolving mechanics, and challenges suspended high above the abyss.

Explore a variety of levels, leap between floating platforms, collect coins, and use the environment to open new paths forward. Buttons, crates, moving obstacles, and new mechanics keep each stage fresh and introduce new ways to overcome challenges.

Each chapter brings its own set of ideas and obstacles, ending with a unique boss fight that puts everything you’ve learned along the way to the test.

In Aetherfall, you’ll find:
- Dynamic 3D platforming
- A variety of mechanics
- Secrets and coins to collect
- Environmental puzzle elements
- Diverse locations and challenges
- A boss fight at the end of every chapter
70010000132015.intro: Jump, explore, and master new mechanics as you make your way deeper into the world of Aetherfall.
70010000132015.name: Aetherfall

70010000132021.description:
A deadly outbreak has turned the city into a territory of the infected. Follow the trail of Dr. Varga and Project Lazarus — humanity's last chance to stop the infection.

Fight through a full mission-based zombie survival campaign spanning 15 chapters and 29 missions. Explore ruined hospitals, contaminated sewers, abandoned farms, industrial zones, railways, underground stations and devastated city streets while uncovering the truth behind the outbreak.

Your mission is more than simply staying alive. Restore generators, activate communication relays, defend strategic positions, escort Dr. Varga, protect the mobile laboratory and hold back increasingly dangerous waves of infected.

Build your arsenal and prepare for different threats as every new area pushes the operation closer to its final objective.

Project Lazarus may contain the key to a cure — but the data must survive long enough to be transmitted.

Features:

Mission-based first-person zombie survival action
15 chapters and 29 campaign missions
Multiple environments and combat scenarios
Escort and protection objectives
Generator and power restoration missions
Relay activation and defense objectives
Mobile laboratory escort missions
Multiple weapons and equipment
Different infected enemy types
Story-driven campaign centered on Project Lazarus
Final extraction and last-stand battles

Find Dr. Varga. Protect the Lazarus data. Fight through the outbreak and make sure humanity's last hope reaches extraction.
70010000132021.intro: Complete the mission. Protect the cure. Survive the outbreak.
70010000132021.name: Zombie Outbreak: Last Stand Survival

70010000132027.description:
"Mr.Do!'s Castle" is an action game released by UNIVERSAL in 1983.
Take control of a clown character and defeat the unicorns. Use your hammer to knock blocks down and crush the unicorns to defeat them.
Make clever use of the stage mechanics by changing ladder directions to alter your path or trapping unicorns in holes to immobilize them!

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.

*The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.
70010000132027.name: Arcade Archives Mr.Do!'s Castle

70010000132041.description:
You've just become the manager of the rookie idol group, "♡Melonchu♡"!
To make their debut concert a roaring success, dating any of the active idols is absolutely, 100% off-limits...!
And yet, romance flags keep popping up left and right, and the members' affection levels are already at MAX from the very start!
How on earth will you navigate this crisis?!
An otome game industry first (!?)—a slapstick rom-com where romance is strictly forbidden!

■ Story & Art (Scenario/Illustration): MikiMaki
【Game Features】
Fully voiced (excluding the protagonist)
Customizable protagonist name
8 unique endings
70010000132041.intro: Trigger a romance flag with an idol, and it’s a BAD END!
70010000132041.name: Can I Not Fall for Idols?

70010000132049.description:
From the team that brought you STAR WARS™: Dark Forces Remaster comes the return of the 1997 western FPS classic, Outlaws!

Saddle up and ride back into the Wild West with the gunslinging ex-Marshal, James Anderson, and face off against the good, the bad, and the even worse this side of the Mississippi as you work to uncover a twisted plot of greed and corruption. With your trusty six-shooting .45 Revolver, Scoped .44 Rifle, 10-Gauge Shotgun, and good ol' Sawed-Off 12-Gauge Shotgun, you'll be packin' plenty of firepower to take out all manner of outlaw varmints.

Outlaws + Handful of Missions features high-resolution, uncompressed cutscenes and updated visuals for weapons, characters, and enemies, all fully recreated from archived art and stylized to match the original look with full color palettes. Outlaws + Handful of Missions also offers Cross-Play Multiplayer with game modes including Deathmatch, Team Play, Capture the Flag, and Kill The Fool With The Chicken!

It's Payback Time.

Outlaws + Handful of Missions Remastered Key Features:
- Engaging first-person ground combat featuring five weapon types.
- Modernized Joy-Con™ and Pro Controller™ support, adding a new weapon wheel.
- A Vault filled with a treasure trove of behind-the-scenes gold nuggets.
70010000132049.intro: The Most Dangerous Man is the One with Nothing Left to Lose.
70010000132049.name: Outlaws + Handful of Missions: Remaster - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000132077.description:
Ready to slow down and compare every detail?

Enjoy a laid-back spot-the-difference game set in ukiyo-e scenes of post towns and famous views along the road from Edo to Kyoto.

Look closely at two similar prints and search for the one place that has changed. A person’s pose, an item, a building, or a bit of scenery might be the clue.

How to play is simple!
・Compare the two ukiyo-e pictures
・Look for the changed spot
・Select the area you think is different

Take in the beautiful landscapes and travelers while putting your focus and observation skills to work. It is great for a quick break or for taking your time with each picture.

Recommended for players who:
・Like spot-the-difference and visual puzzles
・Are curious about ukiyo-e and Japanese scenery
・Want a calm brain-training game
・Enjoy talking through the answer with family or friends

Look into every corner of the artwork and find the hidden change!

Button controls and touch controls are both supported.
70010000132077.name: Spot the Difference Ukiyo-e: Fifty-Three Stations of the Tōkaidō

70010000132098.description:
Dredgeport is spiralling out of control. Gangs rule the slums, corruption trumps the law, and corpses of the war-dead are burned daily for fuel. You are an ex-soldier, mistaken for dead and shipped back to Dredgeport for processing. After a narrow escape, you find yourself alone in the guts of the city, with only two things to your name: your life and your sanity. Keeping both will prove a challenge.

Inspired by tabletop RPGs and narrative adventure games, Duskpunk finds a balance between challenge and freedom, tracking your health, energy and stress as you try to survive. Make lasting choices that determine the city's fate. Develop skills to distinguish yourself in your chosen field of work. Earn a crust, explore the city, make alliances and escape your traumatic past.

Dredgeport plays host to characters with rich backstories and murky motivations. Some care for you or the city; others are in it for themselves, but will pay well. Choose your allies wisely. They will be part of your fate whether you like it or not.
70010000132098.intro: A gritty dice-driven RPG, in a steampunk city. You escaped the War, but how to survive? Explore the city. Decide who you trust. Choose carefully: you might just spark a revolution!
70010000132098.name: Duskpunk

70010000132104.description:
Your worst nightmare has become your reality. You are the latest captive of a notorious, masked serial killer, imprisoned in his grim subterranean dungeon. Through the cracked walls, you can hear the horrifying screams of other victims meeting gruesome ends. Your cell door is just the first obstacle. To survive, you must navigate a house of horrors, solve twisted puzzles, and find a way out before the killer starts up his chainsaw.

Your captor is highly observant and constantly patrols his territory. Stealth and meticulous attention to detail are your only hope. If you open a drawer, pick a lock, or move an object, you must return it exactly as you found it. If he notices even a trace of your escape attempt, he will hunt you down with relentless fury. Navigate the claustrophobic brick hallways by the dim light of your lantern. Squeeze through tight vents and witness the grim machinery of his torture chamber from the shadows. Stay quiet, think logically under pressure, and cover your tracks perfectly. Can you outsmart the ultimate predator, or will you become just another voice screaming in the dark?
70010000132104.intro: Leave No Trace. He is Always Watching.
70010000132104.name: Captive

70010000132111.description:
SOMA is a horror and science fiction video game from Frictional Games, the creators of Amnesia: the Dark Descent. It is a haunting story about identity, consciousness and what it means to be human.

The radio doesn't work, food is scarce and machines have begun to believe they are people. The submerged PATHOS-II facility has suffered terrible isolation and difficult decisions will have to be made. What to do? What makes sense? What is left to fight for?

Enter the world of SOMA and confront the horrors submerged in the depths of the ocean. Rummage through locked terminals and secret documents to uncover the truth behind the chaos. Search for the last inhabitants and take part in the events that will ultimately shape the fate of the station. But beware, danger lurks around every corner: corrupt humans, twisted creatures, mad robots and even an inscrutable and omnipresent A.I..
You'll need to figure out how to deal with each one. Just remember there's no turning back, either you defeat your enemies or get ready to run.
70010000132111.intro: A masterpiece of psychological horror. Fight to survive in a hostile world that will make you question your own existence.
70010000132111.name: SOMA - Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition

70010000132123.description:
At first glance, it looks like an ordinary day at school.
But look closer, and a small sense of unease may point to a chilling truth.

Use the question as your guide, study the illustration carefully, and find the suspicious spot that leads to the truth in this visual deduction quiz.

How to play is simple!
・Read the question
・Take a close look at the school illustration
・Choose the place you think is suspicious

Classrooms, hallways, club activities, and after-school scenes set the stage for strange moments hiding inside familiar school life.

A scene that seemed normal at first might feel completely different once you realize what it really means.

No complicated steps—just observation and a flash of insight. Take your time solo, or play with family and friends while asking, Which part looks off?

Recommended if you like:
・Stories that turn creepy once you understand them
・Horror and mystery
・Illustration observation quizzes
・Testing your deduction and attention to detail
・Quick quiz games you can enjoy in short breaks

Can you notice every uneasy detail hidden at school?
70010000132123.intro:
Can you spot the unease
hiding in class?
70010000132123.name: Classroom Mystery Secrets Behind the Lessons

70010000132129.description:
Something is wrong at the scene.
Take a close look at the place where a strange phenomenon occurred, then figure out which cursed object caused it.

Check the objects that feel out of place and the visual clues left behind.
Read the situation carefully, trust your deduction, and choose the object behind the haunting.

How to play is simple!
・Observe the scene where the incident happened
・Look over anything suspicious or clue-like
・Find the cursed object you think is the cause and seal it

Even an ordinary-looking item may be hiding a secret that brings a terrifying phenomenon to life.

Use your observation and reasoning to uncover the truth one case at a time.
Each puzzle is quick to play, so you can think it through solo or talk it over with family and friends.

Recommended for players who enjoy:
・Ghost stories and uncanny tales
・Mystery games and visual puzzles
・Searching illustrations for tiny details
・Quick brain teasers in short breaks
・Solving spooky cases with family or friends

Can you see through the cause behind each strange event and seal every cursed object correctly?
70010000132129.intro:
Can you spot the curse?
Observe the scene
Seal every object
70010000132129.name: Cursed Objects: Find and Seal

70010000132170.description:
BLOCKY POWERS is a fast-paced physics-based party game where every block matters! Grab a controller, challenge a friend, and build the tallest tower before everything comes crashing down.

Real Physics & Powerful Winds

Forget predictable block stacking. Every piece has real weight and balance, making each tower sway under dynamic physics. Powerful gusts of wind can strike at any moment, turning even the strongest structures into a challenge.

Sabotage Your Opponent

Building is only half the battle. Drop extra blocks directly onto your rival's tower to throw off their balance and ruin carefully planned structures.

Send awkward or heavy blocks
Disrupt your opponent's tower
Strike at the perfect moment to trigger a collapse

Perfect timing can change the outcome of every match.

2-Player Local Multiplayer

Plug in a second controller and enjoy instant head-to-head battles on the same screen.

Fast local multiplayer action
Customize wind strength and block speed
Perfect for parties, families, and friendly rivalries
Game Modes

Race Mode

Build to the target height before your opponent. Speed is important, but poor balance can bring everything down.

Survival Mode

Protect your limited lives by stacking carefully. Survive the wind, avoid losing blocks, and withstand your opponent's sabotage.

Features
Real-time physics-based block stacking
Direct block sabotage mechanics
Dynamic wind effects
Local 2-player multiplayer
Race and Survival game modes

Master real physics, outsmart the wind, sabotage your rival, and build your way to victory in Blocky Powers!
70010000132170.intro:
Stack blocks to reach the sky!
Master real physics as towering structures sway!
Use crazy powers, cause epic crashes, and outplay your friends!
70010000132170.name: Blocky Powers

70010000132193.description:
Welcome to Suncroft, a cozy exploration game where every street and hidden corner invites you to slow down and enjoy the journey!

Take your time strolling through the town, discovering hidden paths, relaxing by fountains, and uncovering charming landmarks scattered throughout the world. With no combat, no timers, and no pressure, Suncroft is all about exploring at your own pace and soaking in its warm, welcoming atmosphere.

Features
>Explore a handcrafted sunny town.
>Discover every unique location and hidden area.
>Enjoy a relaxing, stress-free exploration experience.
>Immerse yourself in a warm and peaceful atmosphere.
>No combat, no timers, and no pressure—just exploration
70010000132193.name: Suncroft

70010000132198.description:
Can you spot the trace that should never be left behind?

In this mystery puzzle game, you clean up evidence left at a scene and help turn a risky case into the perfect cover-up.
You are not the detective. You are the fixer hired to erase the evidence.
Read the prompt, study the illustration, and find the piece of evidence that needs to be removed.

How to play:
・Read the case prompt
・Observe the illustrated scene
・Select the matching evidence

Choose the right evidence, and the scene changes as that trace is cleared away.
Look closely for visual clues, suspicious details, and odd inconsistencies, then recover anything that could work against your client.

Each case has its own situation and request.
Think through what should be erased in each scene, using observation and deduction to make the call.
Since each question is self-contained, it is easy to play in short sessions while still enjoying a satisfying mystery.

Recommended for fans of mysteries, deduction, illustration-based puzzles, and quick brain-teasers.
Collect every piece of evidence and lead the case into the unknown.

Supports button controls and touch controls.
70010000132198.name: Vanishing Evidence: Mystery Cases

70010000132204.description:
A plain black-and-white photo... until something from the future seems to be sitting right there.

People holding objects that should not exist in the era when the picture was taken. If time travel has already been developed somewhere beyond our knowledge, why did these visitors choose these moments to appear?

Follow the clues hidden in each eerie scene and trace the truth behind the photo. The more you understand what is wrong, the closer you get to a chilling answer.

・Read the scenario for the scene
・Study the black-and-white image carefully
・Select the piece of evidence that feels out of place
・Check why that clue leads to the truth

Even a normal-looking photo can turn unsettling once you notice the detail that should not be there. Perfect for fans of urban legends, mystery puzzles, slow-burn horror, and solo brain teasers.

Take your time, look closer, and see if you can uncover the truth behind the picture.
70010000132204.intro: What doesn't belong in the photo?
70010000132204.name: Hidden Photo Mysteries: The Truth Gets Scary

70010000132215.description:
Learn Japanese hiragana with simple picture-based word puzzles!

Look at the picture and the incomplete Japanese word, then choose the correct hiragana from four options. Familiar objects and clear illustrations make the questions easy to understand, even for beginners.

How to play:
・Look at the picture and the word with a missing character
・Choose the correct hiragana from 4 options
・Try to complete all 120 questions

Simple button controls make it easy to start playing right away. If you get stuck, hints are available so you can keep learning at your own pace.

Recommended for:
