Horror That Feels Real - The scariest thing isn't ghosts—it's the feeling that it could really happen. Experience a creeping sense of dread that slowly tightens its grip within familiar places.

Anthology Format - A collection of short, intense ghost stories. Enjoy each story at your own pace, anytime and anywhere, with every tale delivering a different flavor of horror.

Paranormal Photo-Inspired Visuals - Aged film photography, heavy noise, and low-light cinematography. Designed to recreate the disturbing realism of browsing paranormal photo archives and ghost story forums late at night.

Immersive Sound Design - Every breath, every creak, every distant sound is crafted to keep you on edge. Atmospheric music and unsettling sound effects bring each story vividly to life.

Things Left Unexplained - Not every mystery is solved when the story ends. What did you really see? What was actually there? The answer is yours alone.
70010000134087.intro: A short horror visual novel inspired by internet ghost stories and urban legends, where familiar places become home to inexplicable and disturbingly real horrors.
70010000134087.name: Scary Stories Grotesque

70010000134091.description:
WordBuzz 4 is a word puzzle game where each puzzle gives you eight letters: seven outer letters and one required center letter. Use them to create as many words as possible. Every word must include the center letter.

Letters may be used more than once, and each word must contain at least four letters. Longer words earn more points, while special words that use all eight letters, known as pangrams, award bonus points.

Put your mind to the test with every puzzle, discover new words, expand your vocabulary, and enjoy a rewarding word puzzle experience.

Increase your score to climb the global rankings, uncover every hidden word, and become the ultimate word master.

WordBuzz 4 uses a British English dictionary.

Features
• Play through 5,000 all-new word puzzle levels
• Discover special words called pangrams by using all eight letters
• Learn new English words and expand your vocabulary as you play
• Compete with players around the world on the online leaderboard
• Resume your last game and continue where you left off
• Skip to the next level after 24 hours
• Play in Handheld Mode, Tabletop Mode, or TV Mode
70010000134091.intro: Build words, score points, and master the hive.
70010000134091.name: WordBuzz 4

70010000134094.description:
Embark on a journey to a mysterious alien planet filled with breathtaking landscapes, abandoned research facilities, and the remnants of a forgotten civilization. Every location holds clues to the planet's past, inviting you to uncover the secrets hidden beneath its surface.

Explore vast sci-fi environments at your own pace, from towering structures and mysterious outposts to rocky valleys and futuristic complexes. Search every corner, discover hidden areas, and piece together the story of a world left behind.

Immerse yourself in an atmospheric adventure where curiosity is your greatest tool. Observe your surroundings, uncover ancient technology, and experience the wonder of exploring an unknown planet far from home.

Every discovery brings you closer to understanding the mysteries of Astrava.

Features:

First-person sci-fi exploration adventure.
Explore a mysterious alien planet filled with unique environments.
Discover abandoned facilities and futuristic structures.
Uncover hidden secrets and learn the story of a forgotten civilization.
Atmospheric exploration focused on discovery and immersion.
Beautiful science-fiction landscapes inspired by distant worlds.
Relaxing gameplay that rewards curiosity and exploration.
70010000134094.intro: Explore a mysterious alien planet filled with abandoned facilities, breathtaking landscapes, and hidden secrets waiting to be discovered.
70010000134094.name: Astrava

70010000134140.description:
The badger Dax, who has secretly maintained and cared for Zooville by night for years, finds himself longing for recognition, prompting a young hedgehog named Nell and her companions to uncover the truth and guide him out of the shadows.

♣ Format: A visual novel for kids.
♣ Word Count: Featuring more than 10,000 words.
♣ Target Audience: Ideal for children between 5 and 10 years old.
♣ Experience: Completely free of ads and in-app purchases.
♣ Pacing: Allows you to read at your own pace without any rush.
70010000134140.intro: Discover the secret guardian of Zooville in this heartwarming visual novel.
70010000134140.name: Zooville Detectives: A Read-Along Mystery

70010000134142.description:
Ride into the Valley

Horse Spirit Valley 2 is a peaceful open-world horse adventure. Gallop across rolling meadows, autumn woods, winter frost, lilac dusk and emerald night — five distinct worlds waiting for your next ride.

Befriend wild horses, collect sparkling gems, and build the stable of your dreams in the Horse Boutique. Soft exploration, beautiful nature, and the freedom to ride wherever the trail leads.
Explore Five Worlds

Every level has its own mood, light and terrain:

Meadow— sunlit hills, wildflowers and open trails
Autumn Forest— warm earth, birch trees and golden light
Winter Frost— snowy fields under a quiet sky
Lilac Dusk— soft evening colours and calm paths
Emerald Night— deep forest atmosphere after dark

Unlock new worlds in the shop, select your favourite, and ride straight into it.
Tame & Ride

Wild horses roam the valley. Approach gently, earn their trust, and welcome them into your stable. Switch mounts in the Horse Boutique — your friends are always waiting.
Horse Boutique

Make every horse your own:

Coats and spirit colours
Mane styles and mane colour
Saddles and reins
Horns and size option
Your collection of tamed horses

Try looks on a live preview, buy with gems, and save the style you love.

Collect, Discover, Relax
Gather gems across the valley
Follow the compass to points of interest
Capture beautiful moments with Photo Mode
70010000134142.intro: Ride free through a living valley of meadows, forests, frost and dusk. Tame wild horses, style them in the Horse Boutique, collect gems.
70010000134142.name: Horse Spirit Valley 2

70010000134173.description:
The truth about Stonehenge is buried far too deep… It’s time to dig it up! Grab your shovel, stock up on dynamite, and embark on a thrilling underground adventure. Blast through layers of rock, collect gold, upgrade your gear, and uncover the ultimate mystery. But tread carefully: deep beneath the earth sleeps something that should have never been awakened...

Game Features

    Addictive Gameplay: Dig, blast, gather gold, and head back to the surface for brand-new upgrades!

    Powerful Upgrades: Level up your shovel for faster excavation, boost your stamina for longer expeditions, and buy a jetpack to swiftly escape danger.

    Explosive Arsenal: Shatter the toughest rock layers with dynamite, carving out the quickest path into the depths.

    The Ultimate Underground Secret: Every gold vein brings you one step closer to the answer—why was Stonehenge really built?

    A Deadly Inhabitant: An ancient monster lurks in the abyss. Every detonation stirs it from its slumber… Will you uncover the truth before the beast catches up to you?
70010000134173.intro: Unearth the truth about Stonehenge: dig with your shovel, blast through rock layers with dynamite, and grab all the gold!
70010000134173.name: Deep miner

70010000134220.description:
Build a peaceful farm by day and defend everything you have created when night falls!

Farming and tower defense come together in a charming strategy experience. Plant crops, feed your animals, collect coins and expand your homestead with new structures. Every decision matters, so carefully plan where to place your crop fields, animal pens, storage buildings, defensive walls and barracks.

Your farm animals are more than just friendly residents—they can also become brave defenders! Recruit chickens, pigs, cows and goats, each offering different levels of speed, health and attack power. Position your animal army, strengthen vulnerable areas and prepare for the next enemy invasion.

Different crops are needed to care for different animals. Grow sunflowers for chickens, wheat for cows and sheep, and carrots for pigs and goats. Place structures close together to unlock useful bonuses, improve harvests, reduce feeding requirements and lower the cost of recruiting defenders.

As the seasons change, new dangers arrive. Wolves hunt your animals during spring, raccoons target valuable resources in summer, boars smash through defenses in fall and powerful bears attack your buildings in winter. Construct hay bales, wooden fences and stone barriers to slow them down before they reach the heart of your farm.

Balance expansion with preparation, improve your farm’s layout and survive through every season. A beautiful homestead can quickly become a battlefield, so grow wisely, build carefully and keep your animal defenders ready.

Can your cozy little farm survive an entire year?
70010000134220.intro: Build your farm by day and defend it by night! Grow crops, raise animals, recruit farmyard defenders and build walls to stop hungry enemies.
70010000134220.name: Cozy Farm Defense

70010000134232.description:
What will appear when every panel falls into place?

You know that feeling when a picture is almost complete, but something is out of place? This casual puzzle game invites you to assemble colorful illustrations of unique monster girls from around the world.

Each stage gives you a character to complete. The artwork is divided into three horizontal panels, and each panel can be slid sideways.

• Read the prompt carefully.
• Slide the three panels horizontally.
• Line up the artwork so the illustration connects.
• Complete the requested monster girl to clear the stage.

The rules are easy to pick up, making it welcoming for puzzle beginners. Matching every panel and seeing the character come together is satisfying, while the cute designs make each attempt a delight.

Enjoy a focused solo session, share the fun with friends, or fit in a quick brain-teasing break. How many can you complete?
70010000134232.intro: Can you piece together every monster girl?
70010000134232.name: Monster Girl Montage Puzzle

70010000134252.description:
Help the Queen and her loyal assistant Jack decorate the palace garden in time for the Halloween celebrations.
Customize your garden, and unlock delightfully eerie new items to place within it.

Play over 130 levels, collect special jewels and purchase plants and decorations to design the spookiest Halloween garden ever!

Night fell, sending shivers down your spine. Will you persist? The Queen counts on your Match 3 bravery!

- Fully customizable gardens
- Many Halloween decorations to choose
- Visit your garden at night!
70010000134252.intro: All Hallow’s Eve is upon us, and the royal court is eager to celebrate!
70010000134252.name: Queen's Garden: Halloween

70010000134284.description:
Embark on an unforgettable journey through the enchanting world of Teradea, where peaceful farm life meets thrilling adventure!

Raised in the quiet comfort of Bloomfield Village, your life is about to change forever. A mysterious mist creeps from the Forest of Echoes, wild beasts roam under the cover of night, and strange disasters threaten villages across the land.

Venture across a vast, living landscape filled with hidden caves, remote islands, lively towns, and long-forgotten secrets. Between your travels, cultivate your farm, raise animals, harvest crops, and build a place to call home. Guided by the Harvest Goddess and aided by the friends you'll meet along the way, you’ll find new ways to grow, explore, and lend a hand wherever it’s needed.

As friendships deepen and the seasons pass, the truth behind the mist will slowly begin to unfold. With the support of those you’ve helped — and those who stand beside you — you may discover a way to lift the veil from the Forest of Echoes and let Teradea flourish once more!

• Romance & Relationships: Meet 10 unique romance candidates—5 bachelors and 5 bachelorettes. Build meaningful relationships, experience heartfelt events, and find your perfect partner to share your life with.

• Animal Companion System: Befriend a variety of animal companions, each with unique abilities that help you explore. Break obstacles, reach hidden locations, and uncover secrets throughout Teradea together.

• New Exploration Abilities: Jump, climb ladders, and scale vines to discover previously unreachable areas. Combine your movement skills with your animal companions to fully explore every corner of the world.

• Make Everyone Happilia: Help villagers, complete requests, and contribute to Teradea's growth to earn precious Happilia. The more Happilia you gather, the more the Harvest Goddess can help restore the land.

• Island Life: Discover remote islands by collecting nautical charts. Hunt for hidden treasures, uncover new locations, and befriend rare animals found nowhere else in Teradea.

• Untamed Wilderness: The wilderness is home to wolves, bears, tigers, and other wildlife. Stay alert and avoid being caught, or you'll lose your collected items and wake up back at your farm.
70010000134284.name: Harvest Moon®: Echoes of Teradea - Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition

70010000134327.description:
In that village, no one questioned the rules.

At first glance, each illustration looks like an ordinary scene from everyday life. But take your time, look closer, and something unnatural should start to stand out.

Find the evidence hidden on the screen and uncover the dark tradition rooted in that place, along with the truth it was meant to hide.

How to play:
・Study the illustration carefully
・Find the suspicious clue hidden in the scene
・Select the spot you think is the answer

The moment you notice the answer, the same harmless view may feel completely different.

Can you catch every unsettling detail?
70010000134327.name: Look Closer Dark Traditions

70010000134339.description:
Can you catch the one detail that changed?

Cute cosplay girls bring a playful twist to a classic pastime, with side-by-side illustrations waiting for your sharp eyes.

How to play:
・Compare the two illustrations
・Find the one spot that differs in the image on the right
・Tap the correct spot to clear the puzzle!

Perfect for a quick break or a little brain training. The simple rules make it easy for anyone to jump in and play.

Recommended for:
・Fans of cosplay illustrations
・Players who enjoy spot-the-difference games
・Anyone looking for a short game session
・Players who want to sharpen their observation skills
・People looking for a fun game to enjoy solo or with friends

Take your time admiring each cosplay look, or race to find the difference as quickly as possible. Play at your own pace, or get your viewing crew involved and enjoy the challenge together.
70010000134339.name: Cosplay Waifus Treats: Spot the Difference

70010000134348.description:
WordBuzz 5 is a word puzzle game where each puzzle gives you eight letters: seven outer letters and one required center letter. Use them to create as many words as possible. Every word must include the center letter.

Letters may be used more than once, and each word must contain at least four letters. Longer words earn more points, while special words that use all eight letters, known as pangrams, award bonus points.

Put your mind to the test with every puzzle, discover new words, expand your vocabulary, and enjoy a rewarding word puzzle experience.

Increase your score to climb the global rankings, uncover every hidden word, and become the ultimate word master.

• Play through 5,000 all-new word puzzle levels
• Discover special words called pangrams by using all eight letters
• Learn new English words and expand your vocabulary as you play
• Compete with players around the world on the online leaderboard
• Resume your last game and continue where you left off
• Skip to the next level after 24 hours
• Play in Handheld Mode, Tabletop Mode, or TV Mode
70010000134348.intro: Build words, score points, and master the hive.
70010000134348.name: WordBuzz 5

WordBuzz 6 is a word puzzle game where each puzzle gives you eight letters: seven outer letters and one required center letter. Use them to create as many words as possible. Every word must include the center letter.

Letters may be used more than once, and each word must contain at least four letters. Longer words earn more points, while special words that use all eight letters, known as pangrams, award bonus points.

Put your mind to the test with every puzzle, discover new words, expand your vocabulary, and enjoy a rewarding word puzzle experience.

70010000134358.intro: Build words, score points, and master the hive.
70010000134358.name: WordBuzz 6

70010000134362.description:
Take a good look at photos set in a relaxing Japanese hot spring inn and try to remember every detail before time runs out!

From open-air baths and cozy guest rooms to elegant lounges and peaceful gardens, each scene is packed with details worth remembering.

How to play:
・Study the photo before time runs out
・Remember the people, poses, clothing, and objects around them
・Use your memory to take on the challenge

The simple gameplay makes it easy to jump in for a quick session. Enjoy the photos at your own pace while putting your memory and observation skills to the test.

Recommended for players who:
・Enjoy photo and memory games
・Like testing their observation skills
・Love Japanese inns and hot spring scenery
・Want something easy to play in short sessions
・Enjoy relaxing, glamorous photography

How much of each scene can you remember?
70010000134362.intro:
Memorize the perfect ryokan moment!
A quick photo memory challenge
How many details can you remember?
70010000134362.name: Hot Spring Beauties Japanese Inn Date Memory

70010000134369.description:
Your journey begins with a single roll of the dice.
A board game-style adventure where heroes journey through the miniature world of “Viractalia.”
Your movement depends on the roll of the dice—but the key to victory lies in your hand and how you build your deck!

Embark on your own unique adventure in a world where strategy and luck are perfectly intertwined!

＜Features＞
Explore a charming miniature world
Each time you play, the whimsical yet intricate world transforms before your eyes!
With limited time to explore, every step is full of excitement: What will happen next? What will I find?

A fusion of card battles and board game strategy
Use a wide variety of cards to defeat your enemies!
Collect countless cards and build your own custom deck and powerful combos!

Dice-based movement with the DP system
“I rolled a big number... but I only want to move one space?”
Don't worry—no roll is ever wasted!
Unused movement points are converted into DP, a special resource that can be spent to power up events or give you the edge in battle.

Dynamic events and meaningful choices
On your journey, you'll encounter unique and colorful events.
Your decisions may grant you powerful abilities... or change the course of your adventure entirely!

Play solo or with friends
Whether you're diving in solo or adventuring with others, you're in for a good time!
Online multiplayer is supported—and who knows? Something special might happen just for you when you're playing online...

<Where strategy and fate collide>
The fate you entrust to the dice, and the cards you choose with care—
Every move you make weaves your story.
A fresh adventure awaits board game lovers, card game fans, and strategy enthusiasts alike.
70010000134369.intro: A highly replayable board game RPG powered by dice and cards.
70010000134369.name: Viractal: Will You Trust Your Party? Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000134378.description:
Build your ramen rep by fashioning the ultimate bowl from a vast assortment of noodles, soup, and toppings. From roast pork to miso, mackerel, and more--the only limit is your imagination, meaning you'll need to use your noodle to nail the right recipes and bring hungry customers in by the crowd!

Enter contests and see how you size up against rivals, thus cementing your standing as superlative sensei of the savory! Succeed--and one day you might even have your own ramen theme park!
70010000134378.intro:
Build the ultimate bowl to leap past your
ramen rivals and achieve greatness!
70010000134378.name: The Ramen Sensei – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000134384.description:
hololive members transform into adorable treasures!
Stack the 3D hololive members without letting them overflow to create your very own mountain in this must-play 3D puzzle game for hololive fans!


How to Play
Just toss the treasures and stack them on the island!
Combine identical treasures to transform them into larger ones!
The game ends when a treasure falls off the island!

Create bigger treasures and make consecutive combinations to boost your score through chain reactions!
And when you create the largest treasure, something amazing happens…!?


Treasure Exchange
The treasures that appear in the game can be swapped with other members!
Customize to your liking and create your own unique mountain of favorite members!


Rankings
Compete with players from around the world and test your skills.
Aim for the high score and keep challenging yourself!


New Features for the Nintendo Switch™ Version
This version includes all three DLC packs previously released for the PC version!
By completing newly added in-game missions, you can unlock a total of four commentators and music tracks by talents!

Additionally, a new BGM customization feature has been added!
Combine your favorite BGM with your favorite commentator to create your very own Treasure Mountain and enjoy the game even more!
70010000134384.intro: Stack the Love of Captain Marine!
70010000134384.name: hololive Treasure Mountain MegaPack – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000134408.description:
2048 Battles – Sylvan Sirens puts an enchanting spin on the classic 2048 puzzle formula! Slide tiles to combine matching numbers and launch devastating attacks against a coven of woodland foes. Fight your way through alluring sirens, spell-weaving forest witches, and majestic fae queens—each wielding wild nature magic and a flair for the dramatic.

Strategically smash high-value tiles into your foes to deal damage and disrupt their sylvan spells. Each enemy brings unique abilities to the battle: some ensnare your tiles in thorns, others drain your power, and a few can twist the grid with tangling roots. With five difficulty levels, the challenge adapts to your skill.

Once you've tamed the wildwood, take on Infinite Mode for a pure puzzle experience. Combine tiles, stack up high numbers, and see how long you can flourish in the ever-growing forest.

Will you master the wilds and become the ultimate puzzle champion?
70010000134408.intro: Combine tiles and battle cute elves in a realm of fae!
70010000134408.name: 2048 Battles – Sylvan Sirens

70010000134423.description:
Humanity had a good run, Now it’s time to take back what’s yours. Dive into a dice-based roguelike deckbuilder where your tactical decisions, not luck, determine the fate of the planet.

Build your own Invasion

Build a growing alien force on a turn-based grid where every placement matters. Each turn you can acquire different units, artifacts, budges and chrono. Place your invaders strategically in the grid to enhance your scoring potential.

Manipulate the Dice

Dice aren’t a game of chance here, they’re your most powerful tool. With ‘Chrono’ you can strategically reroll your dice and restock the shop to draft your most vital units.  You can transform a bad roll into an unstoppable chain reaction. Use ‘budge’ to  manipulate your dice throw to build the exact combo you want. Even, align your dice in pairs, triples or quadruple to ignite devastating combos.

Be the Commander

Each commander brings a distinct strategic approach, specialized synergies and XP scaling possibilities unlocking new ways to dominate. Each equipped with unique perks and artifacts so each run gives you new ways to send your attack score into the stratosphere.

Earth won’t be destroyed without a fight. Beware, the legendary Pilots from StarVaders will show up to protect the planet, each armed with unique abilities designed to disrupt your invasion.

Break the game

Experiment with absurd synergies and push the game’s systems to their absolute limit. Discover a broken combo that launches your score into orbit and out smarts the pilots.
70010000134423.intro: Lead the Invasion. Master the Dice. Break the Game.
70010000134423.name: Dicevaders

70010000134447.description:
Quiz Challenge Multiplayer is the quiz game that turns your couch into a game show stage.

Answer questions across two great fields of knowledge — History and Science — each split into a wide range of themes. From ancient civilizations to modern events, from astronomy to chemistry, every session mixes things up so no two games feel the same.

GRAB A CONTROLLER, GRAB YOUR FRIENDS
Play solo to train at your own pace, or gather up to 4 players in local multiplayer. No account, no connection, no waiting — just pass the pad or take a controller each and start.

TWO WAYS TO PLAY

STANDARD — Classic quiz rules. Take your time, think it through, and answer correctly to score.
BATTLE — Speed is everything. The faster you lock in the right answer, the more points you take. Hesitate, and your opponents leave you behind.

LEARN WHILE YOU PLAY
Every question is a chance to pick something new up. History and Science are only half of it: the game is fully playable in English, French, German and Spanish, so you can switch to the language you're learning and train your vocabulary while you play. It's a quiz night and a language lesson in one.

FEATURES

Hundreds of questions across History and Science
Multiple themes within each category
1 to 4 players, local multiplayer
Standard and Battle modes
4 fully localized languages: English, French, German, Spanish
Pick up and play — perfect for family evenings and party sessions

How much do you really know? Time to find out.
70010000134447.intro: History & Science quiz, 1 to 4 players, in English, French, German, Spanish.
70010000134447.name: Quiz Challenge Multiplayer

70010000134464.description:
Mushroom Tower is an delightfully addictive physics-based balance puzzle game where you drop and stack all sorts of mushrooms to see how tall and high you can build!

【Game Features】
◆ Simple Controls, Deep Strategy
Adjust your position, rotate, and time your drop with easy-to-pick-up controls! From shiitake to enoki and king oysters, you’ll encounter mushrooms of all shapes and sizes.

◆ Wobbly Physics & Thrilling Action
Your mushroom tower gets wobblier with every single layer! Figuring out where to place awkward, uneven mushrooms is the key to breaking records. Feel the excitement as you save your stack from sliding off the edge!

◆ Aim for the Ultimate High Score!
Keep track of both your total count and maximum height (mm). Challenge yourself over and over to beat your personal best and create the tallest mushroom tower imaginable!

Perfect for quick gaming sessions or a fun brain break. How high can your tower grow?
70010000134464.intro:
Stack mushrooms on a wobbly base for new heights!
Drop wacky mushrooms to score big!
How high can you go in this addictive puzzle?
70010000134464.name: Mushroom Tower

70010000134488.description:
Step into the spotlight with 10 unique K-Pop idols, each ready to perform their own signature track in a vibrant karaoke mode. Whether you want to master the rhythm or just sing along at the top of your lungs, every idol brings their own style, energy, and charm to the stage.

Key Features:
• 10 Idols: Choose your favorite star from a diverse roster of talented performers, each featuring their own dedicated karaoke track and distinct visual aesthetic.
• Exclusive Music Gallery: Take a break from performing and relax with a dedicated Music Gallery featuring 17 original K-Pop instrumental and vocal tracks to listen to anytime.
• Stunning Visuals & Neon Aesthetics: Enjoy eye-catching stage designs, colorful lighting, and polished interfaces inspired by the best of the K-Pop industry.

Are You Ready to Shine?
Pick your star and experience the energy of the biggest stages.
70010000134488.intro: Sing your heart out with 10 unique K-Pop idols in this vibrant karaoke experience!
70010000134488.name: K-Pop Karaoke Party

70010000134495.description:
Can love survive when you can no longer trust reality?

Emily and Ethan leave the city behind to rebuild their relationship in a quiet countryside home. Far from the noise of everyday life, they hope for a fresh start.

Instead, they find whispered messages, impossible events, and a growing feeling that someone—or something—is watching.

As Emily searches for answers, every conversation, every clue, and every decision pulls her deeper into a mystery where appearances can be deceiving. Is the house truly haunted, or is there a far more disturbing truth hidden behind every strange occurrence?

Explore a suspenseful psychological horror visual novel where romance, mystery, and emotional tension intertwine. Investigate unsettling events, solve puzzles, discover hidden collectibles, and uncover multiple endings shaped by your final choices.

Will you trust the people around you... or your own instincts?

Features
- Psychological horror story with romance and mystery.
- Meaningful choices leading to multiple endings.
- Solve puzzles to uncover new clues.
- Unlock collectibles and bonus content.
- Beautiful anime-inspired artwork and atmospheric environments.
- Memorable characters, each hiding secrets of their own.

Every answer uncovers a new question.

Every choice brings you closer to the truth.

Or further away from it.
70010000134495.name: False Love: Ghost or Not?

70010000134520.description:
TCG Card Shop Simulator is a trading card shop simulation where you sell card booster packs to earn money and build your card shop business.

Manage Your Shop:
Design your own TCG shop. Organize shelves and card packs to make the customer shopping experience smooth and easy. "

Card Collection:
Open the booster packs yourself and collect the cards. Find rare cards and sell them to make a fortune, or keep them to complete your card collection.

Host Game:
Set your card game format and fee, invite players to play card games in your shop. Be sure to keep your store clean and hygienic for the players or they might leave!"

Order Products:
Stock up on different booster card packs and card game products. Keep track of popular trends and adjust your inventory to cater to the ever-changing demands of your customers.

Expand Your Business:
Earn profits to reinvest in your shop. Expand your space, unlock new card sets, and upgrade your facilities to attract even more customers and increase revenue.
70010000134520.intro: Sell cards, build your collection, run tournaments and earn money and build your card shop business.
70010000134520.name: TCG Card Shop Simulator

70010000134526.description:
Does your answer seem as ordinary as you think?

Take on a slightly dark psychological quiz built around chilling situations. Study each image, choose from the options, and try to spot the line of thought that feels just a little different from the usual response.

Playing is easy!
・Study the image
・Think about what you would do
・Choose one answer from four options

“Why would someone act like that?”
“What were they thinking in that moment?”
The reveal behind each answer may give you a little shiver.

No complicated steps needed. It is quick to play in short sessions, great for thinking things through on your own or guessing with friends by asking, “Which one would you pick?”

Recommended for anyone who likes:
・Psychology quizzes and mind teasers
・Unexpected answers and tricky questions
・Testing deduction and intuition
・Quick quizzes for spare moments
・A slightly dark theme

Are you with the majority?
Or will you land on the answer no one else saw coming?
Think it through and challenge every question.
70010000134526.intro:
Can you pick the “normal” answer?
Dark mind teasers await
Unmask the hidden choice!
70010000134526.name: Psychopath Mind Quiz: Unmask Their Dark Nature

70010000134550.description:
Take a close look at illustrations depicting crime scenes and puzzling situations.
Use each question as your clue, then search the image for the spot that leads to the answer in this mystery deduction game.

Even an ordinary-looking scene may hide an important hint that points to the truth.
Pay attention to the people, the objects around them, and even the smallest detail that seems out of place. When you think you've found something suspicious, select that spot.

Examine the information in front of you, think carefully, and enjoy the flash of insight when scattered clues suddenly come together.
The more closely you observe each scene, the more details you may notice that escaped you at first.

Recommended for fans of mysteries and deduction puzzles, as well as players who enjoy observation quizzes, searching illustrations for answers, and brain-teasing games that reward careful thought.

Can you spot the subtle clues and uncover the truth behind each case?
70010000134550.intro:
Don't miss a single clue left at the crime scene!
Study the illustrations and uncover the evidence in this mystery deduction game.
70010000134550.name: Mystery Time: Case Files

70010000134556.description:
What piece is missing from this flag?

Put flags from around the world back together in a visual matching puzzle where you identify the missing part and drag the correct piece into place.

Study each flag carefully, then compare four possible pieces. Look at its colors, patterns, and distinctive symbols to figure out which one belongs in the blank.

Some flags may look familiar right away, while others make you stop and examine every detail. Recall what you know or compare the designs closely until you get that satisfying moment when the right piece clicks into place and the flag is complete.

From simple designs to flags featuring suns, trees, emblems, and other recognizable symbols, every stage gives you a new visual challenge.

Challenge yourself across 50 stages and see how many flags you can complete!

A fun pick for flag fans and anyone who enjoys geography, visual puzzles, and testing their knowledge of the world.
70010000134556.intro:
Find the missing piece and complete flags from around the world!
Compare colors, patterns, and symbols to spot the right
70010000134556.name: Complete the Flags! World Flag Matching Quiz

70010000134562.description:
Ready to take your first steps into kanji? Pictures and familiar words make each question easy to approach.

Fill in the blank with the kanji that completes the word. This quiz is a fun way to get comfortable with kanji used in everyday language.

How to play:
• Look at the illustration and the word on screen
• Think about which kanji belongs in the blank
• Choose the correct answer from four kanji

There are no complicated controls—just choose an answer and move on to the next question. With 120 stages, you can learn a little at a time, review in short sessions, and enjoy steady progress.

Great for anyone who wants to:
• Get familiar with kanji for the first time
• Practice kanji and vocabulary through play
• Find an approachable quiz for young learners
• Think through questions together with family
• Enjoy a learning game in short bursts

Use the illustrations as clues and see which kanji fits. Take on all 120 stages and discover a variety of kanji and words!
70010000134562.intro:
Can you pick the right kanji?
Make learning kanji fun!
A great first step into kanji!
70010000134562.name: Play & Learn My First KANJI

70010000134568.description:
Look at the picture and choose the katakana that completes the word!

This simple learning game challenges you to find the missing katakana from four choices.

Use familiar objects and illustrations as clues as you work out which character belongs in each word. Recognizing the picture, thinking about the word, and finding the right letter make each question a quick and satisfying challenge.

How to play:
• Check the picture and word
• Think about the missing katakana
• Choose the correct letter from four options

With simple rules, the game is easy to pick up for anyone starting to learn katakana. If you get stuck, hints are available so you can keep learning at your own pace.

Take on a total of 120 stages featuring familiar everyday words.

Recommended for:
• Players learning katakana for the first time
• Beginners who want to recognize more characters
• Anyone who wants to practice Japanese words through play
• Parents and children who want to solve questions together
• Quick study sessions in spare moments

Look, think, and choose the right character.
Enjoy working through katakana questions one stage at a time!
70010000134568.intro:
Look at the picture. Pick the katakana!
Learn familiar words through play
A fun first step into katakana!
70010000134568.name: Play & Learn My First KATAKANA

70010000134580.description:
Mysterious cases are unfolding on the streets of 18th-century London.
Study each crime-scene illustration for 60 seconds, then rely on your memory to solve the case in this observation and memory game.

Playing is easy!
・Study the crime-scene illustration for 60 seconds
・Memorize the people, belongings, and places as much as you can
・Answer each question using what you remember

“What was that person holding?”
“What was placed over there?”
“What’s different from the scene you just saw?”

The key to solving each case is hidden in the scene you already witnessed.

The setting is 18th-century London.
Take on mysterious cases set around street corners, homes, and other atmospheric locations while testing your observation skills and memory like a true detective.

Each round is quick and easy to enjoy in short bursts, making it a great brain-training pick for spare moments.
Focus on the challenge solo, or have fun with family and friends as you ask, “What was there?” and compare memories.

Recommended for players who like:
・Memory-testing games
・Brain training that uses observation and focus
・Detective stories and mystery atmospheres
・Quick quizzes that are easy to play anytime
・Solving questions together with family or friends

Can you memorize every clue needed to solve the case in just 60 seconds?
70010000134580.intro:
Memorize the scene in 60 seconds!
Recall the clues and crack the case
Feel like a master detective!
70010000134580.name: The Master Detective’s Eye -Memorize the Scene in 60 Seconds! Case Files from the Streets of 18th-Century London-

70010000134629.description:
Can you make it through school’s toughest moments without changing who you are?

We’ve all been there: being too serious for our own good, or wishing we had spoken up when it mattered.

This is a four-choice game where you change your personality to face one school crisis after another. Dive into a classmate’s mind through mental hacking and choose one of four options. Each choice shifts four personality gauges: introversion and extroversion, sensing and intuition, thinking and feeling, and judging and perceiving. Get three gauges into their target zones to successfully transform and solve the crisis with that personality type’s strengths.

Getting started is easy.
• Read the crisis
• Choose one of four options
• Watch the four gauges and aim for the target zones

Your survival level drops with every choice. If it reaches zero, you’re out. A successful transformation restores a large amount, and every type you awaken for the first time is recorded.

There’s no single best personality. Careful thinking can save the day in one crisis, while bold action is the answer in another. The best part is transforming into the type you need most right now.

With 48 crises and 320 sync questions, the combinations change from playthrough to playthrough. Awaken all 16 types to clear the game. How many types can you become?

Play through one crisis during a quick break, or take your time trying to awaken all 16 types. Today, why not become someone a little different?
70010000134629.intro: How many types can you become?
70010000134629.name: 16 Faces: School hp!

70010000134647.description:
The island is empty, but not abandoned. Someone worked here, and left behind their notes, their machines and their questions.

Quern - Undying Thoughts is a first-person puzzle adventure about exploring a place and slowly coming to understand it. The puzzles are not isolated boxes to tick off. A mechanism you learn in one building turns up again somewhere else, and the island rewards you for thinking about it as a whole rather than one room at a time.

Explore at your own pace, keep your own notes, and work out why you were brought here.

- Hand crafted environments and environmental storytelling
- Puzzle mechanics that reappear and build on each other
- English voice over, with text in nine further languages
- Single player
70010000134647.intro: You step through the portal onto the island of Quern. It closes behind you.
70010000134647.name: Quern - Undying Thoughts

70010000134652.description:
Ready to make your next trip to Korea feel more natural?

You may have learned the basics before, but using Korean in the moment is a whole different challenge.

Look at manga scenes set during travel and choose the phrase that best completes the blank speech bubble. With four choices in each question, you can quickly learn practical Korean phrases that native speakers use in everyday travel situations.

How to play:
• Look at the travel scene in the manga panel
• Choose the phrase that fits the blank speech bubble from four choices
• Read the detailed explanation after answering correctly

Not sure which answer to pick? A friendly hint can help you move forward, so you can enjoy learning without the pressure of getting every question right.

The one-question-at-a-time format keeps things moving, making it great for a quick session before a trip or whenever you have a few spare minutes.

Turn casual game time into preparation for a more enjoyable journey. Build the confidence to communicate more naturally with people in Korea through manga and quizzes!
70010000134652.name: Manga Korean One-Phrase Quiz

70010000134658.description:
Eight unique characters face off
in an exciting card-flipping showdown!

Flipi Rivals!

Follow the story through the eyes of Panda
in Story Mode.

Discover the stories of all eight characters
and take on a series of battles in Arcade Mode.

Challenge a friend right beside you
in Local Battle Mode.

Enjoy the game's beautiful music anytime
in the Music Room.

Plus, discover a variety of game-changing items
and unique battle arenas!

Simple controls, intense competition!
Test your reflexes and memory!

Use quick thinking and strategy
to become the ultimate Card Master!

An exciting card battle with adorable rivals!

Flipi Rivals!

Flip the cards. Turn the tide!
70010000134658.intro:
Flip the cards. Turn the tide!
An exciting card battle with adorable rivals!
70010000134658.name: Flipi Rivals

70010000134664.description:
A spooky, cosy 2.5D Platforming Halloween Adventure

It was supposed to be a normal halloween eve, but when 2 brother find an old spellbook, things turn chaotic as one gets turned into a Mummy and runs away. Time for a rescue missions.

Grab your magic wand and wizard costume to embark on a quest across 14 vibrant, action packed levels to break the curse and bring your brother home in this short but charming all hallows eve game.

Key Features

14 handcrafted levels. Dash through neighbourhood streets, graveyard, eerie forests and more pack with spooky platforming hazards.

Magical Combat. Blast spooky creatures with your magic or use your slide or double jump to get past the monsters.

Fun mini games. Take a break from the main road to beat the mini challenges like a haunted volleyball match as you continue your journey.

Collect sweet treat to unlock stylish new hats and wands.

Cosy and Spooky aesthic. Enjoy a charming, non scary  Halloween game that's great for all ages.

Short and sweet. This game wont take hundreds of hours to beat.
70010000134664.intro: It's Halloween and two brothers wrongly read a cursed spellbook and one is instantly turned into a Mummy. Run, cast magic, win mini games and rescue your brother
70010000134664.name: Spooky Tales and Mummy Trails

70010000134670.description:
How much can you remember from a single moment on campus?

Take one minute to carefully study an image of beautiful girls enjoying everyday school life. Then, after part of the scene is hidden, choose the correct answer from four options.

What was there before?
What did that part of the scene look like?

You never know which detail the question will focus on, so pay attention to the characters, objects, and surroundings.

You may feel certain you remember something, only to hesitate when the choices appear. Follow your memory, spot the detail you saw before, and enjoy that satisfying moment when the answer comes back to you.

Take in the youthful campus atmosphere, remember every detail you can, and see how much of each scene stays in your memory!
70010000134670.intro:
Memorize a snapshot of school life in just one minute!
Study every detail, then put your memory to the test.
Can you recall what was there?
70010000134670.name: Beautiful Girls on Campus: Memories of Youth

70010000134704.description:
Enter the ruins of a long-fallen kingdom and uncover the dangers hidden within its forgotten dungeon.

You take control of a mysterious masked adventurer on a journey through an interconnected world filled with hazardous passages, challenging platforming sections and hostile creatures. Explore the dungeon in your chosen order, discover new paths and prepare for an inevitable confrontation with the nameless king.

Master a responsive set of movement abilities, including double jumps, rapid dashes and wall-climbing. Combine these skills to cross dangerous gaps, climb towering chambers and reach areas hidden throughout the kingdom.

When enemies stand in your way, fight back using quick combo attacks or charge a powerful special move that unleashes explosive damage across the surrounding area. Choose the right moment to strike, avoid incoming attacks and survive each encounter.

Rest at bonfires to restore your strength and establish new checkpoints as you descend deeper into the ruins. Every chamber brings you closer to the ruler waiting at the end of your journey.

Features:

• Explore an interconnected 2D dungeon
• Run, double-jump, dash and climb walls
• Battle enemies using combos and special attacks
• Rest at bonfires to heal and save your progress
• Discover multiple routes through the fallen kingdom
• Face the nameless king in a final boss battle

The kingdom has fallen, but its ruler remains. Will you survive the descent?
70010000134704.intro: Explore a fallen kingdom as a masked adventurer. Master jumps, dashes, wall-climbing and powerful attacks as you battle through the dungeon and confront the Nameless King.
70010000134704.name: King's Descent

70010000134721.description:
"Adventure of Kanjiro" is a game of kanji learning, so that children who are not good at kanji or dislike practicing kanji can learn kanji while having fun.

As Kanjiro, the main character of this work, you will discover kanji stolen by monsters by writing kanji, looking for kanji, and looking for reading. By discovering kanji, you can raise your level and earn coins.
You can use coins to buy items such as equipment and potions at the shop to prepare to fight monsters.
In battles with monsters, the faster you remember the kanji you find, the more damage you can do. However, if you remember incorrectly, you will be damaged instead.
In order to defeat monsters, it is important not only to have good items, but also to remember the kanji well.

Let's enjoy the game and memorize the kanji so that we can defeat all the monsters and get back the kanji!

Features Kanji taught in 2nd grade of Japanese elementary school.
70010000134721.intro: Let's go on an adventure for those who have lost their kanji!
70010000134721.name: Adventure of Kanjiro Chapter 2

70010000134732.description:
Ready to take a trip around the world with charming travel snapshots?

This casual puzzle game brings together girlfriend-style photos of beautiful women traveling through destinations around the globe.

The rules are simple:
• Study the photo panels, each turned in a different direction
• Tap a panel to rotate it into the correct orientation
• Line everything up to complete the full photo

As you progress, the number of slices increases for a more satisfying challenge. Feeling stuck? You can use a hint up to three times to automatically align one row that is not yet complete, making it welcoming for puzzle beginners.

Take your time to judge each angle or rely on quick instincts to solve the picture. Play solo at your own pace, or get viewers involved and enjoy the excitement together during a stream.

A great pick for fans of travel snapshots, beautiful scenery, cute characters, quick casual games, and brain-teasing puzzles.
70010000134732.intro: Can you spin every scene into place?
70010000134732.name: World Waifus: Spin & Snap Puzzle

70010000134754.description:
Strap on your jet pack and prepare for a high-speed journey through twisting tunnels and dangerous caves!

Each level starts at a manageable pace, but the longer you survive, the faster you go. Dodge the tunnel walls, react quickly and keep your flight under control as the speed continues to increase.

Take on 50 increasingly challenging levels across 5 unique worlds. Early levels are short and simple, but the tunnels become longer, faster and more difficult as you progress.

Complete levels to earn coins, then spend them to unlock new characters and take them along for the ride.

Master your jet pack, survive the speed and make it through every tunnel!
70010000134754.name: Dodge Mayhem

70010000134788.description:
When best friends Colby and Jack find a forest of candy, they're ready to munch! But while the boys selfishly sample the sweets, Colby's little sister is abducted by a monstrous owl! Now they must navigate a world of confections as they learn to pay attention to what matters most.

Featuring a wide range of obstacles, enemies, and levels to explore, Sugar Rush Rescue is a tasty, retro co-op adventure.
70010000134788.name: Sugar Rush Rescue

70010000134797.description:
There are no rescue teams. There is no medicine. Your only goal is to survive an endless wave of ruthless zombies. Starting with only the bare essentials, you’ll have to think fast and act even faster as the daily hordes gather. Every second on the battlefield is a test of your reflexes, where the rational use of ammunition, maintaining distance, and keeping your weapon ready at all times are the only keys to survival.

The struggle is simple yet intense: survive the day to make it to the next. At the end of each day, the environment changes, transporting you to new locations. This constantly forces you to adapt your actions and strategies to entirely new conditions and challenges. To help you face the increasingly faster, stronger, and more aggressive mutants the next morning, after each day you successfully survive, you’re rewarded with a set of random upgrades. Boost your weapon’s power, improve your stats, and see how many days you can hold out against the relentless horde.
70010000134797.name: Dead Seek

70010000134803.description:
YOU ARE THE CONTROLLER. JUST MOVE.

Use your smartphone camera as a motion controller for Nintendo Switch™. Your body movements control the action in real time - no wearable controllers or extra motion hardware required.

MotionPlay Sports features two easy-to-play motion-controlled games: Bowling and Table Tennis.
Using the free MotionPlay app on a compatible smartphone, simply position your phone in front of you and move. Your phone camera tracks your movements and turns them into game controls.

BOWLING

Move your bowling hand left or right to line up your shot, then swing your arm forward just like bowling a real ball.
Play solo against the AI or go head-to-head with a friend or family member in 2-player local play as you chase strikes, spares and the high score.

TABLE TENNIS

Move your hand left and right to position your bat and line up with the ball.
With automatic hit and serve, there is no need to swing — simply move into position and keep the rally going.
Take on the AI across multiple difficulty levels, from an easy-going opponent to a more serious challenge.
Powered by patent-pending MotionPlay technology, setup is quick and simple. No additional camera accessory or wearable controller is required — just your compatible smartphone and Nintendo Switch™.

Camera images are processed on your phone and are never recorded or shared.
70010000134803.name: MotionPlay Sports

70010000134810.description:
Step into a colourful woodland filled with animals, hidden discoveries and mysterious creatures.

Mathias has ventured deep into the forest, where every path offers something new to investigate. Guide him through peaceful meadows, dense woodland trails, flowing rivers and dark caves as you search for interesting objects and uncover the secrets of the wilderness.

Pay close attention to your surroundings. Follow scattered feathers, inspect abandoned campsites, examine unusual plants and mushrooms, and interact with the animals you meet along the way. Some creatures may need your help, while other encounters will test whether Mathias is brave enough to continue.

Every discovery shapes Mathias’s personality. Exploring unfamiliar places increases his curiosity, facing frightening creatures develops his bravery, and experiencing the peaceful side of nature brings him happiness. The qualities you develop during your journey will influence how Mathias handles the greatest mystery hiding within the woods.

Deep inside the forest lives a legendary Yeti. Will Mathias frighten the creature away, become trapped in its cave or discover that the mysterious beast may not be an enemy after all? His final fate depends on the experiences collected throughout the adventure.

Explore at your own pace, enjoy the charming low-poly environments and see where your journey through the forest will lead.

Features:

• Explore a colourful 3D woodland environment
• Discover hidden locations and mysterious caves
• Interact with animals, plants and unusual objects
• Develop bravery, curiosity and happiness
• Help creatures you encounter during your journey
• Uncover the mystery of the legendary Yeti
• Experience multiple endings based on your actions

The forest is waiting. Follow the trail, embrace the unknown and discover what lies deep within the woods.
70010000134810.intro: Explore a mysterious forest, uncover hidden paths, discover forgotten secrets and survive the dangers lurking among the trees.
70010000134810.name: Evergreen Quest

70010000134852.description:
Discover iconic landmarks, hidden courtyards, and the unique charm of European cities, all from the comfort of your home.

What's new in Trip to Europe 13:
- Every scene is crafted with meticulous attention to architectural authenticity and cultural context. Dozens of carefully hidden objects await your sharp eye.
- Enhanced search modes — Expanded task types, dynamic hints, and interactive elements breathe life into every image and keep gameplay engaging.
- Mini games and puzzles — Logic, observation, and memory challenges are seamlessly woven into your journey for a satisfying change of pace.
- Souvenir collection — Purchase memorable keepsakes that reflect the traditions, crafts, and spirit of each country you visit.
- Postage stamps — A commemorative stamp awaits you on every location. Fill your album to unlock exclusive bonuses.
70010000134852.intro: Pack your bags, it's time to travel!
70010000134852.name: Big Adventure: Trip to Europe 13 Collector's Edition

70010000134857.description:
A quiet tatami room can hide more than it seems.

This is a mystery puzzle game where you examine illustrated Japanese-style rooms and tap the odd or suspicious detail pointed out by each question.

Tatami mats, shoji screens, hanging scrolls... Can you catch the tiny sense that something is off inside an otherwise calm room? Use your instinct and observation skills to uncover traces, strange details, and visual clues hidden in the scene.

How to play:
・Read the situation and question
・Study the illustration carefully
・Tap the spot that seems suspicious
・Check the hint-style explanation to understand the clue

That “Wait, that was the clue?” moment makes it fun on your own, and even better when friends compare answers and notice completely different things.

Easy to pick up and great for short breaks or livestream play, this is a casual picture mystery for anyone who likes Japanese atmosphere, detective puzzles, and suspenseful little brain teasers.
70010000134857.intro: Can you spot the hidden clue?
70010000134857.name: Tatami Crime Scenes What’s Wrong?

70010000134869.description:
In 2001, development began on an ambitious Game Boy Advance game that would have shown the full potential of the handheld console with its unique 3d voxel engine. Based on a hugely popular science fiction franchise, the game was unfortunately cancelled before it could be fully completed. Now, experience this enhanced revival of this forgotten game.

Elland, a harsh desert world on the outskirts of the Galaxy. With nothing but scant indigenous life, the planet is controlled by the cooperative Elland Inc., which mines the abundant minerals and crystals used in the construction of galactic star cruisers. The mining operations and the abundance of Brem-Nar crystals have transformed Elland from a dusty wasteland into a glittering and much envied prize. Notorious for its precipitation, the neighboring world of Mank is home to the headquarters of the Trafford Corporation, the largest constructor of space cruisers and weapons in the Galaxy. Trafford is infamously aggressive, using its financial muscle and military power to always get what it wants. At this moment in time it wants to control Elland and it will use all and any resources to get what it wants.

You are Ethan Lancashire, one of the finest of Elland Inc.’s fighter pilots. Across more than 20 dangerous missions you will pilot advanced flying machines that can move, turn and hover, and come equipped with a variety of weapons and utilities, fitted as the mission requires. Weapons can be set to lock-on or aimed manually. Earn commendations and trophies, displayed in your personal room, and climb the ranks from lowly Cadet all the way up to Air Force General.

This enhanced version introduces a number of modern features to this emulated game, including:
• An LCD filter option for an authentic GBA experience
• Rewind live gameplay at any time
• A virtual interactive instruction booklet
70010000134869.intro: Experience a unique revived GBA 3D flight game. Become an ace pilot on a harsh, unforgiving desert planet.
70010000134869.name: Elland: The Crystal Wars

70010000134937.description:
Ever get stuck when a Korean word looks familiar but its spelling feels tricky?

If you have studied Hangul before, you may know the sounds yet hesitate over similar letters or final consonants.

This learning game focuses on more challenging Korean vocabulary and spelling through fill-in-the-blank puzzles.

How to play:
• Look closely at the word’s meaning and illustration.
• Choose the matching piece from four options.
• Grab the correct piece with the finger icon and fit it into the blank.
• If you’re unsure, use the hint button to see how the word is read.

Practice distinguishing easily confused final consonants and words that use different letters with similar sounds, all in a playful way.

A friendly starting point for Hangul beginners—and a simple way to begin studying Korean. Give it a try and learn one word at a time!
70010000134937.name: Slot & Learn HANGUL: Intermediate

70010000134947.description:
A Guitar Controller included with HORI's "GUITAR LIFE -LESSON1-" is required to play this game.

Grab your shovel and start digging!

Hold the Guitar Controller like a real shovel, scoop away the dirt, and uncover hidden relics buried beneath the surface.

Grip, thrust, and dig your way to discovery in this unique physical action game that puts your muscles to work!
70010000134947.intro: Hold a Guitar Controller Like a Shovel and Unearth Ancient Relics!
70010000134947.name: Unearth Relics

70010000134952.description:
Dive into a world of stunning, realistic puzzles that captivate your eyes and mind. Piece by piece, reveal breathtaking images of beautiful women — each completed puzzle unlocks a new masterpiece, keeping you motivated to discover what’s next.

Smooth and intuitive touch controls make gameplay effortless and deeply satisfying — you’ll feel like you’re truly shaping every picture with your own hands. Gentle, soothing music sets the perfect mood, helping you unwind while your curiosity pulls you to complete the next challenge.

Relax, enjoy, and let yourself get lost in the details.

Features:
• Addictive, easy-to-play puzzle mechanics.
• Gorgeous, realistic artwork of women.
• Satisfying touch interaction — every move feels natural.
• Unlock new, even more stunning images as you progress.
• Perfect balance of challenge and relaxation.
• Soothing soundtrack that enhances your focus and mood.
• Admire each completed image in full detail.
70010000134952.intro: Every piece brings you closer to perfection!
70010000134952.name: Real Girls: Forbidden Glow

70010000134963.description:
Ready to build Japanese words one character at a time?

HIRAGANA Word Challenge is a casual quiz game where you use the illustration as a clue and choose the hiragana that completes the word. It’s a fun way to connect pictures, words, and kana while building the basics of Japanese.

How to play is simple:
・Look at the illustration
・Check the word with one missing hiragana
・Choose the right answer from four options
・Read the explanation to learn more

After each question, you can review helpful notes about meaning, usage, related expressions, and bits of Japanese culture connected to the word.

The short, quick questions make it easy to play during a break. Great for beginners, anyone brushing up on hiragana, and families who want to enjoy Japanese language and culture together.
70010000134963.name: HIRAGANA Word Challenge

70010000134976.description:
In a strange parallel galaxy, every fruit shares the same dream — to become a Big Watermelon.

Drop fruits onto a 360-degree planet and combine matching fruits to evolve them into bigger and bigger forms. Two cherries become a strawberry, two strawberries become grapes, and the evolution continues until you finally create a giant watermelon.

But be careful — the planet can only hold so much. As more fruits pile up, they may begin to push beyond the planet’s safe boundary. A red warning ring appears when fruit move too far outside the planet. You still have a chance to knock them back into orbit, but if they drift completely beyond the boundary, they will fly off into the vacuum of space.

Plan every drop, create chain reactions, and aim for the highest score possible.


Game Modes:
• Time Mode
You have 5 minutes to score as many points as possible.
Create a Big Watermelon and a bonus pickup will appear, giving you extra time. The more watermelons you create, the more chances you have to extend the match. Merge two Big Watermelons to trigger a Super Big Bang and earn a huge score bonus. Each game session is recorded so you can review your results after the match.

• Infinity Mode
Play without a time limit and see how long you can survive.
There is no clock. Your skill, strategy, and ability to keep the planet under control will determine how long you can keep playing and how high you can score.

• Versus Mode
Challenge another player in local split-screen multiplayer, or compete against an AI opponent. A second player can join using an additional paired controller. If no human player joins within 5 seconds, the AI automatically takes control of Player 2. Build bigger fruits, manage your planet, and try to outscore your opponent.


Features:
• Three game modes: Time, Infinity, and Versus
• Single-player gameplay
• Two-player local split-screen multiplayer
• Play against another human player or an AI opponent
• Unique 360-degree planetary fruit-merging gameplay
• Evolve fruits all the way into a Big Watermelon
• Trigger the Super Big Bang for huge bonus scores
• Review your recorded post-game results
• Compete with players around the world through online leaderboards
• Play in Handheld Mode, Tabletop Mode, or TV Mode
• Colour-ful space-themed graphics
• Professional background music and sound effects

How big can your watermelon become before everything flies into space?
70010000134976.intro: Merge fruits, grow giant watermelons, and conquer the galaxy!
70010000134976.name: Big Watermelon Galaxy

70010000134979.description:
At first glance, it looks like just another ordinary school scene.
But look closer, and you may find something unsettling hiding in plain sight.

Use the question prompt to study each illustration carefully, then figure out the suspicious spot that leads to the truth.
This is a casual deduction quiz where observation and a quick spark of insight are the key.

How to play:
・Read the question
・Examine the school illustration closely
・Select the place you think looks suspicious

A scene that seemed normal at first can feel completely different once you understand what it really means.

No complicated rules are needed. Take your time alone, or talk it over with family and friends as you ask, “What feels off here?”

Recommended for players who like:
・Scary stories that click once you understand them
・Horror and mystery
・Illustration-based observation quizzes
・Testing deduction and attention to detail
・Quick quizzes for short play sessions

Can you uncover every strange detail hidden at school?
70010000134979.intro: Can you spot the unease at school?
70010000134979.name: Once You Get It : The Scary School

70010000134989.description:
Dive into a world of stunning, realistic puzzles that captivate your eyes and mind. Piece by piece, reveal breathtaking images of beautiful women — each completed puzzle unlocks a new masterpiece, keeping you motivated to discover what’s next.

Smooth and intuitive touch controls make gameplay effortless and deeply satisfying — you’ll feel like you’re truly shaping every picture with your own hands. Gentle, soothing music sets the perfect mood, helping you unwind while your curiosity pulls you to complete the next challenge.

Relax, enjoy, and let yourself get lost in the details.

Features:
• Addictive, easy-to-play puzzle mechanics.
• Gorgeous, realistic artwork of women.
• Satisfying touch interaction — every move feels natural.
• Unlock new, even more stunning images as you progress.
• Perfect balance of challenge and relaxation.
• Soothing soundtrack that enhances your focus and mood.
• Admire each completed image in full detail.
70010000134989.intro: Every piece brings you closer to perfection!
70010000134989.name: Real Girls: Silent Heat
