70010000134998.name: Puzzle X: Model Girls

70010000135011.description:
Walk The Frog is a cozy, heartwarming point-and-click adventure with simple, unique drag-and-drop puzzle mechanics. Your task is to correctly assemble Froggo’s world on sticky notes. You can solve the puzzles at your own pace and enjoy a gentle narrative journey with no stress or pressure.

Head home for the Froggapalooza festival
Froggo only wants one thing: to be back home at his pond so he can celebrate the start of spring with his friend Buddy. But along his path, he will encounter a lot of funny, sassy, and quirky characters who want his time and attention. Maybe they’ll help him, too? Will he make it to the festival on time?

Sort the world out
Each level consists of an assortment of hand-drawn sticky notes. Your task is to piece them together correctly to create a path so Froggo can continue his journey and set his world to rights.
Every puzzle you solve is like a little moment of clarity; the mechanics are intuitive and accessible.

Get cozy
The lovingly hand-drawn 2D style and ambient soundtrack create a heartwarming world where you can immerse yourself and relax.

Friendship and hope
Snuggle up in your coziest blanket, brew a cup of your favorite tea, and get to know Froggo and his quirky new friends. Talk to each other, help one another, and work together to overcome an array of obstacles.
Walk The Frog invites you into a hopeful, emotional story of homecoming, friendship, and connection.

No timer, no stress
You can take your time solving the puzzles on Froggo’s journey home. Some encounters are optional, and some dialogues change nuances of the story.

A narrative game that helps you unwind
Take a break from your day-to-day and immerse yourself in a cozy puzzle adventure that doesn’t push you; it gently takes you along on a journey.

Froggo is here to cheer you up when things get tough.

FEATURES:
- Enjoy a touching story and humorous dialogue.
- Assemble a world out of sticky notes and create the right path for Froggo and his friends.
- Unique, hand-drawn 2D visual style.
- A story for young and old alike; the whole family can play together.
- Join Froggo as he meets funny, quirky friends, and work together to overcome obstacles.
- Finally, a fun use for sticky notes! No more boring to-do lists.
- Three different chapters: 1. The Forest, 2. The Insect City, 3. Fields and Meadows.
- A total of 18 levels made up of lots of lovingly illustrated sticky notes.
- Intuitive drag-and-drop and point-and-click controls.
70010000135011.intro: Help Froggo solve cozy sticky note puzzles and find his best friend Buddy!
70010000135011.name: Walk The Frog

70010000135021.description:
Dice A Million is a roguelike deckbuilder about rolling dice to try and get to a million points. That's the whole point. (get it?!)

You're trapped in this dice rolling facility, so let's get rolling and try to escape. Combine the effects of more than 120 different dice and discover powerful synergies. Get through ever-increasing debts and challenging bosses that will require perfect symbiosis in your bag in order to be beaten.

Will you be able to push luck to your side?
70010000135021.intro: Have you ever tried to roll 1,000,000 on a set of dice? No? Build the right bag of die, and you might just pull it off.
70010000135021.name: Dice A Million

70010000135036.description:
KEEP YOUR CAT EYES SHARP
Step into a cozy world of colorful rooms, adorable cats, and little details waiting to fool your eyes. Compare rooms carefully and find everything that has changed. Objects may move, disappear, rotate, change color, or hide somewhere you least expect!

TRUST YOUR MEOWMORY
Think you can remember every little detail? Study a room carefully, keep its layout in mind and then find what has changed without a side-by-side comparison. If things get tricky, use helpful boosters such as Highlight, Peek and Freeze to give yourself a little extra help.

CREATE YOUR PURR-FECT ROOM
Take a break from puzzling and become an interior designer! Build your own cozy rooms from scratch and make them truly yours with over 870 customization items, including furniture, decorations, plants, floors, walls and more! Arrange everything just the way you like, experiment with colors and create a cozy space for your feline friends. Collect 2 adorable kitties and watch them wander around the room as you enjoy your creation.

TWO PLAYERS, TWICE THE PURR
Challenge a friend in local multiplayer and see who can spot the differences faster! Play together on one screen, put your observation skills to the test and turn every cozy room into a little friendly competition.

FEATURES:
• Spot the Difference - Compare 2 rooms and find objects that have moved, disappeared, rotated, changed color or been replaced
• Memory Rooms - Study a room carefully, remember every detail and then find what has changed
• Cozy Room Editor - Build and decorate your own cozy rooms from scratch!
• Over 870 Customization Items - Choose from furniture, decorations, plants, floors, walls and more to create your perfect cozy space
• Local Multiplayer - Challenge a friend and see who can spot the differences faster
• Cute Kitties - Collect 2 adorable feline friends that wander around the room
• Custom Memory Challenges - Choose the number of differences, Time to Look, Time to Spot and Allowed Mistakes
• Helpful Boosters - Use Highlight, Peek and Freeze when you need a little help

Spot the little things, create cozy spaces and enjoy every meow-ment!
70010000135036.intro: Build the purr-fect room and spot what’s out of place!
70010000135036.name: Cozy Meowmory

70010000135048.description:
Welcome to Hotel Tycoon, a fun and relaxing hotel management game where every happy guest brings you closer to building the ultimate hotel empire!

Start with a small hotel and transform it into a thriving business. Clean rooms, welcome new guests, collect money, upgrade furniture, unlock stylish decorations and expand your hotel floor by floor.

Hire helpful employees to speed up your business, improve every room and keep your guests satisfied while your hotel grows bigger than ever.

Unlock new character skins with unique bonuses to customize your manager and improve your gameplay.

Meet all kinds of funny visitors along the way. Most guests are ordinary travelers, but don't be surprised when strange visitors check in too. Skeletons, aliens and other unexpected characters can appear and make every session more entertaining.

Once you've mastered your first hotel, move on to an even bigger location with new opportunities and continue growing your hospitality empire.

Whether you enjoy relaxing simulation games, casual tycoon experiences or management games, Hotel Tycoon offers several hours of satisfying progression that's easy to learn and rewarding to master.

Features

• Build and manage your own hotel

• Clean rooms and prepare them for new guests

• Welcome a variety of visitors

• Upgrade rooms with better furniture

• Expand your hotel with new areas

• Hire employees to automate your business

• Unlock character skins with unique bonuses

• Earn money and grow your hotel empire

• Discover funny special guests including skeletons and aliens

• Unlock a second hotel with new challenges

Become the ultimate Hotel Tycoon!
70010000135048.intro: Welcome guests, upgrade rooms, hire staff and build the hotel empire of your dreams!
70010000135048.name: Hotel Tycoon

70010000135054.description:
Enemies? Allies? Kill Kill Kill! The more death you bring, the stronger you become! Stat-Raising Strategy RPG is here!

Based on classic grid-based strategy games, this entirely new SRPG features the Peon Exploitation System—a brutal combat mechanic where you mercilessly sacrifice your own allies.
The more misdeeds you commit, the more vicious your army becomes, and the greater your advantage in battle!
Regain the lost power of the Devil, Giga Super Death, who was transformed into a baby, and crush the false god wearing a mask of justice!

■STORY
This is a story of another Earth, different from the one we live on.
Giga Super Death, the most wicked Devil of all, was just one step away from killing God…
when suddenly, he was transformed into a helpless baby.

Anticipating such a crisis, he had been working through the night to develop the ""DEMONS' NIGHT FEVER"" resurrection program—and finally, it was time to activate it.
Was it a prank of fate, or inevitable destiny?
The one ensnared in this suspicious ritual was Killshiro Katanaka, a gloomy young man who despises the world.

Due to their aligned interests, a bizarre pact was formed.
This is the story of pure EVIL, starring the Devil himself and his newfound disciple, Killshiro.

■Kill, kill, kill both enemies and allies! An unconventional strategic battle!
Exhaust all forms of evil using the Peon Exploitation System which sacrifices your allied Peons during battle!
Brutal tactics such as Kill Skills and Sacrifices that detonate your underlings with your own hands are the shortest route to victory.

■The more you sin, the stronger you become! Master your base to unleash pure chaos.
Pour in the Perverse Points earned through misdeeds to build your own ultimate evil army!
Within the limited time, make full use of suspicious Abductions and Pillaging to strengthen your characters to their absolute limits.

■A world that warps with every chapter! Dive into a story where no act of evil is off-limits!
Every time you defeat a chapter's boss, the game's situation completely transforms!
Experience the full thrill of diverse misdeeds, such as be a monster to defeat Super Rangers, be a witch to crush Magical Girls, or others!
70010000135054.intro: Exhaust all forms of evil by fighting with the brutal Peon Exploitation System!
70010000135054.name: DEMONS' NIGHT FEVER

70010000135059.description:
Meet Pikmin, small, plantlike creatures you can grow, pluck, guide, and send into battle with enemies multiple times their size! These loyal, curious helpers come in different types, including fire-resistant Red Pikmin, Ice Pikmin that can freeze bodies of water, and Glow Pikmin that can light the way forward at night. The fate of your Pikmin is yours to decide!

Create and customize your own pint-sized explorer and traverse a world that is teeming with life—and visually enhanced with high-resolution graphics for the Nintendo Switch™ 2 system!

Partner with Oatchi, your dependable space dog, and give him voice commands

Oatchi (pronounced oat-chee), resident good boy and dependable partner, can help with things like smashing obstacles and carrying you and your Pikmin throughout your adventure. With the miniscule Pikmin and a capable canine in tow, no challenge is too big—and you can even give him voice commands via the Nintendo Switch 2 system microphone as you play!

Test your skill at Dandori Academy, and go explorer vs. explorer in Dandori Battles

Dandori is the art of commanding your Pikmin effectively, and in the world of the Pikmin™ 4 game, explorers like to get in on some friendly competition. Throughout the story you’ll encounter characters itching to compete in Dandori Battles, where you’ll need to gather plenty of Pikmin fast to collect the most objects within the time limit.

That’s where the Dandori Academy comes in. Pikmin™ 4 – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition + Dandori Academy adds a series of Dandori exams for you to train your skills on. And when you’re ready to take on your fellow explorers in Dandori Battles, you can even do so with a friend on the same system*—or via GameShare** locally or online via GameChat, even if they don’t have the game!

Already have Pikmin™ 4 for Nintendo Switch? Purchase the upgrade pack!

If you already have the game for the Nintendo Switch system, you can purchase the upgrade pack*** separately to enjoy all the performance enhancements and additions of the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition, including Dandori Academy.

Explore more Creature Activity Level options and discover Decor Pikmin!

New to Pikmin? Try the Relaxed Creature Activity Level, where enemies take more damage and will never attack you first. If you’re a veteran player looking for true test, take on Fierce Creature Activity Level to face down tougher enemies with fewer Pikmin.

Keep your eyes peeled for Decor Pikmin wearing special outfits, and use the Field Camera to take photos of them. Not only will you add these special Pikmin to your squad, but you can also edit your photos with stamps, filters, and more for maximum style!
70010000135059.intro: Guide plantlike Pikmin on an enhanced expedition for Nintendo Switch™ 2!
70010000135059.name: Pikmin™ 4 – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition + Dandori Academy

70010000135115.description:
In RESONANT BLADE, sound itself becomes your weapon. The Dark Synths have overrun a world once protected by domed cities, turning them into cages for an ever-growing army of hostile machines.

You play as Atlas, a scientist forced to become a fighter after his home is destroyed. Armed with the Resonant Blade, he channels sonic energy into devastating attacks - and uses that same resonance to uncover hidden paths, solve environmental puzzles, and expose secrets buried in the ruins.

Dash, parry, and tune your blade's frequency to break through enemy defenses in fast, precise 2D combat that combines intense action, exploration, and environmental puzzles. As the Synths adapt and grow stronger, only careful timing and clever use of sound will keep Atlas - and what's left of Terra - alive.

Features:
- Sonic-powered combat: slash, dash, and modulate frequencies to break enemy defenses
- Explore the ruins of Terra and uncover secrets through sound-based puzzles
- Fast, precise 2D action combining combat, exploration, and environmental challenges
- Face an ever-evolving army of Dark Synth machines and challenging bosses
- Single-player sci-fi adventure in a dystopian, atmospheric world
70010000135115.intro: Wield sonic power to slash through an army of machines in a fallen world.
70010000135115.name: Resonant Blade

70010000135128.description:
A young cleric named Verselio once devoted his life to serving the deity Treises—until the truth shattered everything he believed. When the divine is revealed to be a lie, faith turns into fury, and a journey of rebellion begins. Joined by a mysterious maiden, a disciplined vigilante chief, and a self-proclaimed deity, Verselio sets out across a vast fantasy world in search of answers. As their paths intertwine, each carries their own burdens, beliefs, and secrets, in a story of betrayal, redemption, and the meaning of faith in a deityless world.

Asdivine Knot is a classic turn-based JRPG that blends strategic command battles with modern systems and deep customization. Master the shared Nexus Gauge to control the flow of combat, unleash powerful Nexus Skills, and summon devastating entities to turn the tide. Explore a wide world with your fully customizable airship, craft and upgrade equipment using collected materials, and shape your adventure with side quests, crew recruitment, fishing, and puzzle dungeons. Packed with rich content and designed for a complete single-player experience, this is a must-play fantasy RPG for fans of traditional Japanese role-playing games.
70010000135128.intro: Tie the knot of fate in a skybound fantasy RPG!
70010000135128.name: Asdivine Knot - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000135134.description:
Ready to examine the scene carefully and find the evidence that leads to the truth?

Even an ordinary-looking location can hide an important clue that points back to the culprit. Read the situation, stay sharp, and keep the investigation moving without overlooking suspicious spots.

How to play:
・Read the case setup and question
・Study the scene illustration carefully
・Select the place you think is evidence

The key to solving each case is a small oddity or unnatural detail left at the scene. Your observation skills and your ability to reason from clues will be put to the test.

No complicated steps are needed, so you can jump in casually and investigate one question at a time. It is also a great little brain workout when you have a few minutes to spare.

Search for evidence on your own, or talk it over with family and friends as you ask, “What looks suspicious?”

Recommended for players who:
・Like deduction and mystery games
・Enjoy searching for evidence and clues
・Want to test observation and reasoning skills
・Want a quick puzzle game for short breaks

Examine every corner of the scene, find the decisive evidence, and uncover the truth behind the case!
70010000135134.intro:
Can you spot the clue?
Observe every odd detail
Solve the forensic mystery
70010000135134.name: Forensic Mystery — Crime Scene Tap Detective —

70010000135155.description:
Take control of an owl named Lief as they make a pilgrimage skybound to the forsaken Isle of Reveries, where it's said that any wish can be granted. Players will fight through six mysterious dungeons, each with their own unique themes and puzzles, and meet charming anthropomorphic characters along the way in this retro-inspired adventure.

Use your fairy companion's magic to duplicate and spawn a variety of objects in the world, and discover how they interact with your robust set of items to solve head-scratching puzzles.

* EXPLORE A VAST OVERWORLD & CONQUER DUNGEONS
Eight different biomes in the overworld. Six different dungeons, each with their own unique theme, mechanics, and key item.

* COPY & SPAWN OBJECTS
Use Lief's fairy companion to copy and spawn a myriad of objects, using them to fight puzzles and fight terrifying enemies.

* FORGE A COMMUNITY
Construct various buildings and forge a township. Characters that Lief saves throughout the game will move to the township, offering new quests and stories.

* DUNGEON CRAWL WITH A FRIEND
Play through separate multiplayer stages with a friend in local co-op.
70010000135155.intro: Make a pilgrimage skybound to the Isle of Reveries, where any wish can be granted.
70010000135155.name: Isle of Reveries

70010000135224.description:
This game combines timeless Solitaire gameplay with a warm, charming presentation filled with soft colors, cozy scenes, and adorable cats.

Play classic Klondike Solitaire in 1-card or 3-card draw mode, focusing on clean moves, smart decisions, and a satisfying flow. Each completed game rewards you with score and experience, based on how efficiently you play.

As you gain experience, you level up and unlock cosmetic rewards. These include beautiful cat-themed card skins, serene backgrounds inspired by sunny windowsills, cozy living rooms, and blooming gardens, and stylish card backs. Every single card has multiple skins and can be customized individually.

Before each match, you can freely adjust your deck and table to match your mood. Whether you prefer soft pastel tones, playful feline illustrations, or a more minimal look, every game feels personal and relaxing.

With no time pressure and a steady sense of progression, the game offers hours of soothing gameplay and a constantly growing collection of beautiful cards.
70010000135224.intro:
A classical Solitaire game with a purr-fect twist.
Play classic Solitaire in a cozy, cat-filled world.
70010000135224.name: Solitaire Companions - Cats

70010000135227.description:
Hello fashion lover, are you ready to step into the spotlight? In Kpop Idol Dress Up, the stylish K-pop dress up game for Nintendo Switch™, you become the fashion stylist behind your very own idol. Create dazzling looks, mix trendy outfits, customize hairstyles and add eye-catching accessories to make your star shine on every stage.

Explore a colorful world of K-pop fashion and unleash your creativity with modern clothes, glamorous details and endless style combinations inspired by pop idols. Design your outfit for the stage as you create bold, energetic and fantasy-inspired looks.

Featured Features:
Endless K-pop outfit combinations: Mix and match stylish outfits, hairstyles and accessories to create unique looks for your K-pop idol.
Become a true fashion stylist: Design stage-ready looks, concert outfits and standout styles inspired by the exciting world of K-pop.
Photo Mode: Capture your favorite creations, save your best looks and share your pop star fashion moments with friends and family.
Full customization: Change hairstyles, hair colors and accessories to create the perfect makeover for every performance.
Made for fashion lovers of all ages: Whether you love dress up games, fashion games or creative styling, this game is made for you.

Don’t wait any longer! In Kpop Idol Dress Up, your creativity has no limits. Create the ultimate K-pop idol, discover your signature style and become the fashion stylist you’ve always dreamed of.
70010000135227.intro: Become the ultimate K-pop fashion stylist in this colorful dress up game and create stunning looks for your singer with endless combinations of trendy outfits, hairstyles and accessories.
70010000135227.name: Kpop idol Dress Up

70010000135238.description:
Opening your own clothing boutique means managing more than just racks of fabric. In this simulation game, you oversee all aspects of a retail space, transforming a modest shop into the city’s premier fashion destination. Every detail depends on your business decisions. Take your place at the helm. Browse seasonal catalogs to order trendy casual wear and elegant garments. Then, unpack and display your merchandise to catch the eyes of passersby.

Curating the perfect inventory is only the first step. You must also manage your prices strategically to keep your stock moving while ensuring your profit margins allow for future expansion. When the doors open, interact directly with your customers at the register while scanning clothes and processing physical cash and digital cards. Keep a close eye on the store for potential shoplifters and reinvest your profits in high-tech security systems, fresh paint, modern lighting fixtures, and decorative displays that enhance the shopping experience. As your customer list grows, unlock new apparel licenses, expand your store’s physical footprint, and hire cashiers to automate the daily routine.

Key Features:
★ Shop Management: Order diverse styles directly from wholesale catalogs, coordinate seasonal displays, and set prices to balance customer satisfaction with profit.
★ Interactive Checkout: Ring up shoppers at the register by scanning barcodes, handling cash, and processing card transactions, all while keeping wait times low.
★ Loss Prevention: Monitor the sales floor closely to deter shoplifting and install robust security measures to protect your stock.
★ Bespoke Customization: Personalize your interior with fresh wall paint, tailored lighting setups, and elegant clothing racks to create an inviting space.
★ Business Growth: Expand your physical storefront to unlock new garment licenses, add high-fashion sections, and hire cashiers to handle the increased customer volume.
70010000135238.intro: Set the trends and grow your boutique!
70010000135238.name: My Clothing Store Simulator

70010000135267.description:
This game combines timeless Solitaire gameplay with a dark, atmospheric presentation filled with rich colors, moonlit scenes, and creatures of the night.

Play classic Klondike Solitaire in 1-card or 3-card draw mode, focusing on clean moves, smart decisions, and a satisfying flow. Each completed game rewards you with score and experience, based on how efficiently you play.

As you gain experience, you level up and unlock cosmetic rewards. These include striking vampire and werewolf card skins, breathtaking backgrounds inspired by gothic castles, moonlit forests, and candlelit crypts, and stylish card backs. Every single card has multiple skins and can be customized individually.

Before each match, you can freely adjust your deck and table to match your mood. Whether you prefer deep crimson tones, detailed gothic illustrations, or a more minimal look, every game feels personal and relaxing.

With no time pressure and a steady sense of progression, the game offers hours of soothing gameplay and a constantly growing collection of beautiful cards.
70010000135267.intro:
A classical Solitaire game with a gothic twist.
Play classic Solitaire in a world of vampires and werewolves.
70010000135267.name: Solitaire Realms - Vampires & Werewolves

70010000135273.description:
This game combines timeless Solitaire gameplay with a dark, atmospheric presentation filled with moody colors, haunting scenes, and creatures that lurk in the shadows.

Play classic Klondike Solitaire in 1-card or 3-card draw mode, focusing on clean moves, smart decisions, and a satisfying flow. Each completed game rewards you with score and experience, based on how efficiently you play.

As you gain experience, you level up and unlock cosmetic rewards. These include chilling horror-themed card skins, atmospheric backgrounds inspired by abandoned mansions, foggy graveyards, and candlelit crypts, and stylish card backs. Every single card has multiple skins and can be customized individually.

Before each match, you can freely adjust your deck and table to match your mood. Whether you prefer eerie dark tones, detailed gothic illustrations, or a more minimal look, every game feels personal and relaxing.

With no time pressure and a steady sense of progression, the game offers hours of soothing gameplay and a constantly growing collection of beautiful cards.
70010000135273.intro:
A classical Solitaire game with a spine-chilling twist.
Play classic Solitaire in an eerie, haunted world.
70010000135273.name: Solitaire Realms - Horror

70010000135289.description:
A wild new "RABBIT AND TURTLE HARSH JUMP RACE" has begun!

Rabbits can move quickly, but they can only jump. On the other hand, turtles move slowly, but they take the safest and shortest route towards their goal. As a rabbit, can you skillfully jump over the various challenging and difficult courses and reach the finish line before the turtle?

There are all sorts of stages, from turtles pulling out strange machines to crows suddenly becoming allies, to races taking place during heavy snow with frozen platforms—it's a truly chaotic race!

While the simultaneous display of Japanese and English can be educational, it might be more suitable for mental training.
70010000135289.intro:
The World of Japanese Fairy Tales
Simple Jumping and harsh Races
The appeal of simultaneous Japanese and English display
70010000135289.name: RABBIT AND TURTLE HARSH JUMP RACE

70010000135295.description:
Valkyrie Saga is an indie, retro platformer styled after 1994 3D platformer classics, giving you a chance to embark on an epic odyssey! Play as Roll the Valkyrie, a divine warrior tasked by the gods with one mission: Stopping a floating island from crashing into the earth. Ascend the ancient skyborne land, explore ancient ruins, unlock their secrets - and stop the cataclysm!

* PLAY A TRUE RETRO GAME

Valkyrie Saga captures the original 1994 3D platformer gamefeel with era-authentic visuals, a deeply immersive soundtrack, and gameplay that recreates the magic that defined a generation.

* EXPERIENCE A VALKYRIE'S LIFE

As the divine warrior, you'll have to master both the art of soaring across the skies across the plummeting island, and the way of the spear, confronting otherworldly foes!

* DISCOVER COMPLEX LORE

Hidden among the ruins, cryptic scribblings, and odd twists of the world is a complex story to piece together, detailing what happened to the civilization that once occupied the island. Can you find out the truth before it is too late?
70010000135295.intro: Join Roll the Valkyrie as she subverts fate. Climb, dash, jump, and glide your way up a falling sky island, to stop it from destroying the world below.
70010000135295.name: Valkyrie Saga

70010000135316.description:
<How to Play>
◆ Turn your drawings into puzzles!
Draw freely using pens, watercolors, crayons, stamps, and more. Once your picture is finished, transform it into a one-of-a-kind jigsaw puzzle.
◆ Enjoy beautiful 3D puzzles!
Alongside your own drawings, you’ll find a variety of pictures featuring scenery, animals, food, and more. Choose from 12 to 84 pieces, turn piece rotation on or off, and play at your preferred difficulty.
◆ Play alone or with up to four players!
Take your time playing solo, or enjoy drawing and solving puzzles together with family and friends.
◆ Play and collect new items!
Complete puzzles to earn coins. Exchange them for new pictures, stamps, and tables.
70010000135316.intro: Turn your drawings into puzzles! Enjoy gorgeous graphics and local multiplayer in this feature-packed puzzle game.
70010000135316.name: Canvas Puzzle

70010000135351.description:
Feel the rhythm and let the music guide every move in this exciting rhythm game where precision, timing, and quick reflexes are the keys to success. Follow the beat, hit every note with perfect accuracy, and challenge yourself across a variety of energetic tracks.

Each song offers a unique rhythm pattern designed to test your coordination and sense of timing. As the music becomes faster and more complex, you'll need to stay focused, maintain your combo, and strive for the highest score.

Whether you're a newcomer to rhythm games or a seasoned music game fan, intuitive controls and progressively challenging songs make every performance both fun and rewarding.

Master every track, improve your accuracy, and become the ultimate rhythm champion.

Features:

Fast-paced rhythm gameplay focused on timing and precision.
A variety of energetic music tracks to master.
Challenging note patterns that test your reflexes.
Build combos and achieve high scores with perfect performances.
Easy-to-learn controls suitable for players of all skill levels.
Replay your favorite songs to improve your timing and beat your best scores.
70010000135351.intro: Feel the rhythm and hit every beat as you test your timing across a variety of energetic songs in this fast-paced music game.
70010000135351.name: Rhythm Flow

70010000135363.description:
If it's a multiple of 3 or 4,
YES!

If it's not a multiple of 3 or 4,
NO!

Count to 100 to
CLEAR THE GAME!
Let's get started!
70010000135363.intro:
Let's play with multiples of 3 or 4
together with Shuri!
70010000135363.name: 3OR4

70010000135373.description:
When you finally expose the truth behind the story, can you handle what it reveals?

Some scares hide in plain sight.
Read eerie situations, study the illustration, and solve each mystery like a detective in a horror tale.

How to play is simple:
・Read the question carefully
・Find the matching clue hidden in the illustration
・Tap the spot you think answers the prompt
・With each correct answer, the story’s truth comes into clearer focus

Perfect for fans of horror, mystery games, and quick deduction puzzles.
Step through the doorway, follow the clues, and see what is waiting in the dark.
70010000135373.intro:
Chilling tales await.
Uncover fear in the art.
70010000135373.name: Doorway to Nightmares: Terrifying Tales

70010000135411.description:
You are a curious child with a house full of interactive objects and a list of simple missions to complete. This level-based simulator is designed for straightforward, relaxed gameplay from a child's perspective on the floor. You have complete freedom to crawl, walk, and climb through cozy indoor rooms and sunny backyard gardens, transforming everyday domestic spaces into your personal playground.

This puzzle adventure offers unique and lighthearted challenges at each level. Some missions have you hunting down hidden toys, while others require you to use your wits to reach high places. Use smooth controls to navigate the stylized 3D environment and complete objectives such as finding hidden toys, solving simple puzzles, and setting up harmless, funny pranks to surprise your mom.
70010000135411.name: Naughty Baby

70010000135438.description:
A thrilling vertical-scrolling shooter set at the far reaches of the galaxy.

ASTERANOVA is an arcade-style vertical-scrolling shooter set across the vastness of space.

Humanity stands on the brink of extinction after an invasion by a mysterious alien force.
As humanity’s last hope, take control of a powerful fighter, destroy the enemy fleets closing in, and venture deeper into the galaxy.

Each stage throws you into intense battles against waves of enemy fighters and warships.
Dodge incoming fire, keep shooting, and fight your way through the battlefield.

At the end of every stage, a massive and powerful boss awaits.
Study its movements, survive its relentless attacks, and strike when an opening appears.

From deep space to distant planets, each stage features a different battlefield.
Take on a wide variety of enemies and environments as you uncover the truth hidden within the galaxy.

ASTERANOVA also features score attack gameplay for players aiming for higher scores.
How efficiently can you destroy your enemies?
How much risk will you take to earn more points?
Hone your skills and aim for an even higher score.

Relentless enemies, intense bullet patterns, and massive bosses stand in your way.
Use your piloting skills to break through an overwhelming battlefield.

The future of the galaxy is in your hands.
70010000135438.intro: Race through space and destroy the enemy fleet closing in!
70010000135438.name: Asteranova

70010000135446.description:
Very Scary Game is a horror game where your decisions determine the story's development and ending.

Explore mysterious locations, solve puzzles, talk to strange characters, and make choices in the most unexpected situations. Don't trust everything you see, and pay close attention to details—sometimes the most obvious solution isn't the right one.

The game offers a variety of story paths and endings, from the truly terrifying to the downright crazy and humorous. Some are easy to find, while others will require you to make far more unobvious decisions.

Game Features:

• Multiple choices and unique endings
• Non-linear story progression
• Psychological horror atmosphere
• Puzzles, riddles, and hidden clues
• Unexpected plot twists
• Secret and humorous endings
• Dark humor and absurd situations

Can you find the real exit?
70010000135446.intro: Your choice. Your fear. Your ending.
70010000135446.name: Very Scary Game

70010000135458.description:
Grab your biggest gun and help one fearless squirrel collect every nut! Shoot, jump, use weapon recoil to launch yourself through obstacles, and blast enemies with nut-shaped heads.

Every level brings new traps, crazy situations, and fresh challenges. Unlock even bigger weapons, master chaotic physics, and turn every firefight into explosive fun.

Features:

- Fast-paced 2D action with ragdoll physics
- A crazy arsenal of powerful weapons
- Use weapon recoil to reach new places
- Nut-headed enemies and deadly traps
- Dozens of action-packed levels
- Easy to learn, endlessly fun to master
70010000135458.name: Nutty Gunner: 2D Squirrel Shooter

70010000135480.description:
The light is fading—and a small owl is about to begin a very big adventure.
Nocto and the Ray of Light is a colourful 3D platforming adventure inspired by the golden age of collectathon platformers. Take flight as Nocto, a spirited young owl, and journey across enchanted realms filled with soaring routes, ancient ruins, strange creatures, hidden treasures, and secrets waiting beyond the beaten path.
Master Nocto’s movement, glide between distant platforms, unleash a powerful sonic screech, and gather relics and essence as you work to return the stolen light to Gaia. From misty swamps and frozen bluffs to coral depths, crystal castles, and islands suspended among the stars, every realm brings a new place to explore.
Take Flight Together
Adventure alone or bring a friend along in local two-player co-op. Player One takes control of Nocto while Player Two joins as Bea, flying alongside you with her own movement and abilities. Explore in split-screen, tackle challenges together, hunt for collectibles, and reunite when the path carries you apart.
Whether Bea joins from the main menu or drops into an adventure already in progress, the journey is better with a friend.
Features
    A colourful 3D platforming adventure inspired by classics of the genre.
    True local co-op: play as Nocto and Bea together with a dynamic split-screen view.
    Freedom in the air: run, jump, glide, and fly through layered fantasy environments.
    A world full of discoveries: collect relics and essence, seek out hidden routes, and unlock the way forward.
    Sonic owl power: use Nocto’s screech to strike enemies and interact with the world.
    Distinct magical realms: explore forests, swamps, frozen heights, underwater depths, crystal kingdoms, and cosmic ruins.
    Solo-friendly from start to finish: experience Nocto’s journey on your own whenever a second player is not present.

Spread your wings. Find the lost light. And discover how brightly two heroes can shine.
70010000135480.intro: Soar through magical realms in a colourful 3D platforming adventure inspired by classics. Play solo as Nocto or team up in local split-screen co-op as Nocto and Bea to explore.
70010000135480.name: Nocto And The Ray Of Light

70010000135514.description:
Discover a fresh take on mini golf where the course is just as important as the ball. Instead of swinging a club, you'll tilt the entire level to guide your golf ball through creative courses filled with ramps, moving platforms, narrow pathways, and clever obstacles.

Use gravity to your advantage as you carefully control the ball's movement, avoid dangerous hazards, and find the perfect route to the hole. Every level introduces new challenges that require precision, timing, and strategic thinking to master.

Easy to pick up but difficult to perfect, each course rewards careful control and experimentation. Learn how every tilt affects the ball's momentum and overcome increasingly complex layouts as your skills improve.

Can you conquer every course and become the ultimate master of gravity-driven mini golf?

Features:

Unique gameplay where you tilt the entire course instead of hitting the ball.
Creative levels filled with ramps, moving platforms, and challenging obstacles.
Physics-based gameplay that rewards precision and careful timing.
Increasingly difficult courses that test your skill and strategy.
Simple controls that are easy to learn and satisfying to master.
Relaxing mini golf experience with a fresh and original twist.
70010000135514.intro: Tilt the entire course to guide your golf ball through creative obstacles, avoid hazards, and sink the perfect shot across challenging levels.
70010000135514.name: Roll Golf

70010000135526.description:
Get ready for a heartwarming visual novel for kids that offers a rich reading and gaming experience. Join Bea, a small wickling with a dim flame, and her band of unexpected outcasts including a shy gargoyle, a loud bat, and a chaotic gremlin as they get ready for the legendary Grand Howl.

• Extensive Story: Featuring over 10,000 words distributed across multiple engaging chapters.

• Format: An immersive visual novel designed specifically for kids.

• Educational Values: Transmits powerful educational values about friendship, self-acceptance, and empathy, showing that true strength comes from being a gentle light that helps others stop hiding rather than trying to blind the world.
70010000135526.intro: A heartwarming visual novel for kids with a rich story and engaging gameplay.
70010000135526.name: Monster Academy: An Interactive Story

70010000135561.description:
Dive into a world of stunning, realistic puzzles that captivate your eyes and mind. Piece by piece, reveal breathtaking images of beautiful women — each completed puzzle unlocks a new masterpiece, keeping you motivated to discover what’s next.

Smooth and intuitive touch controls make gameplay effortless and deeply satisfying — you’ll feel like you’re truly shaping every picture with your own hands. Gentle, soothing music sets the perfect mood, helping you unwind while your curiosity pulls you to complete the next challenge.

Relax, enjoy, and let yourself get lost in the details.

Features:
• Addictive, easy-to-play puzzle mechanics.
• Gorgeous, realistic artwork of women.
• Satisfying touch interaction — every move feels natural.
• Unlock new, even more stunning images as you progress.
• Perfect balance of challenge and relaxation.
• Soothing soundtrack that enhances your focus and mood.
• Admire each completed image in full detail.
70010000135561.intro: Every piece brings you closer to perfection!
70010000135561.name: Puzzle X: Fashion Girls

70010000135567.description:
Dive into a world of stunning, realistic puzzles that captivate your eyes and mind. Piece by piece, reveal breathtaking images of beautiful women — each completed puzzle unlocks a new masterpiece, keeping you motivated to discover what’s next.

Smooth and intuitive touch controls make gameplay effortless and deeply satisfying — you’ll feel like you’re truly shaping every picture with your own hands. Gentle, soothing music sets the perfect mood, helping you unwind while your curiosity pulls you to complete the next challenge.

Relax, enjoy, and let yourself get lost in the details.

Features:

• Unlock new, even more stunning images as you progress.
• Perfect balance of challenge and relaxation.
• Soothing soundtrack that enhances your focus and mood.
• Admire each completed image in full detail.
70010000135567.intro: Every piece brings you closer to perfection!
70010000135567.name: Puzzle X: Elegant Girls

70010000135573.intro: Every piece brings you closer to perfection!
70010000135573.name: Puzzle X: Luxury Girls

70010000135625.description:
Welcome to the ultimate playground of cute chaos. You step into the soft paws of a mischievous little kitten with one clear objective: turn every room into your personal playground of total destruction. From sprawling suburban houses to sunny yards across three unique locations, you have complete freedom to jump, explore, and knock over every fragile object in sight just for the fun of it.

Being a cat is a busy job. To complete your daily missions, you will need to hunt down sneaky mice, scratch up the carpets, and pull off funny, harmless pranks to keep your humans on their toes. As you explore, you will collect hidden stars and earn coins to unlock new, highly detailed rooms to expand your territory. To make the adventure even more playful, you can unlock and play as a variety of other adorable animal companions, and customize them all with a wardrobe of silly, stylish hats. Grab your controller, ignore the house rules, and show the world how much trouble one little kitten can make!
70010000135625.name: Cat Simulator

70010000135659.description:
Chart your fortune across a living galaxy. In 4096 Space Traders Era, you are a trader-pilot working your way from star to star, hunting the best deals the universe has to offer.

Explore a fully 3D galaxy: scroll through star systems, dive into each system to inspect its planets, and pick your next destination from a sprawling map where distance and reachability matter. On every world, the trading and stock screen puts a live market at your fingertips — buy commodities cheap on one planet, haul them across space, and sell them dear. Track your cargo, your positions, and your profit and loss in real time, because your one true goal is to grow the combined value of your cash and stock to the very top.

But the void is not empty. Every journey to a planet can drop you into a dogfight against alien fighters — dodge, out-fly and out-shoot them with guns and missiles while your Quantum Energy and ammo drain away. Whether you're winning or losing the battle, you can open comms and negotiate with the aliens to settle the fight and finish your journey on your own terms.

Trade, fly, fight, and deal your way to the richest hold in the galaxy.

- Deep 3D exploration — Scroll a detailed, navigable star map, jump between systems within your hyperdrive's range, and drop into any system to survey its planets before choosing where to trade next.
- Living market & stock screen — Buy low, sell high across thousands of worlds. A real-time trading board and inventory screen track your cargo, average cost, current market value and profit/loss, with prices that drift and evolve as the galactic economy simulates day by day (complete with price history and sparklines).
- One goal: build your fortune — Your net worth is the combined value of your cash + stock. Grow it as high as you can, chase the top "Stock and Cash Value," and beat your own peak.
- Alien dogfights — Every trip to a planet can erupt into combat. Pilot your fighter, manage Quantum Energy and ammo, and fight off alien waves with guns and missiles.
- Negotiate your way out — Win or lose, open comms with the aliens to settle any battle and continue your journey on your terms.
- Risk & permanence — Manage fuel, hull damage and cargo weight between trips, repair at station, and play with optional permadeath for a true high-stakes run.
70010000135659.intro: Trade the galaxy. Fight for it. Rule it.
70010000135659.name: 4096 Space Traders Era

70010000135665.description:
DOTI GOLF turns classic mini golf into a playground of chaos. Every hole hides its own trick - sand traps to slow you down, boost pads to send your ball flying, buttons and rotating bars that shift the course mid-swing, swamps that swallow a bad shot, and even pinball-style bumpers that send you ricocheting toward (or away from) the cup.

Rack up stars on every hole, chase the best par, and work your way through World after World of increasingly devious course design. Whether you're lining up a careful three-putt or gambling on a boost-pad bank shot, DOTI GOLF keeps every hole unpredictable.

Features:
- 5 Worlds featuring 15 holes each - 75 mini golf courses in total
- Wildly varied obstacles: sand, boost pads, buttons, portals, swamps, spikes, and pinball bumpers
- Star rating and par system on every hole
- Solo play, at your own pace
- Sleek, minimalist course design
70010000135665.intro: Putt, bounce, and boost your way through a wildly inventive mini golf adventure!
70010000135665.name: Doti Golf

70010000135691.description:
Color Lines is a classic and addictive puzzle game where every move matters. Arrange colorful balls on the board, create lines of 5 or more matching colors, and clear them to keep the board from filling up.

Think ahead, plan your moves, and build clever combinations. New balls appear as you play, making every turn a new challenge. Easy to learn but hard to master, Color Lines is perfect for both quick puzzle sessions and longer strategic play.

Game Features:

-Classic Color Lines gameplay
-Simple and intuitive controls
-Strategic and rewarding puzzles
-Clean and colorful design
-Relaxing gameplay with a real challenge
-Easy to learn, hard to master
-Suitable for all ages

How long can you keep the board clear and beat your best score?
70010000135691.intro: Plan your moves, line up the colors.
70010000135691.name: Color Lines

70010000135697.description:
A first-person game about tending a graveyard with a hole in the middle that eats.

What you do. Plant beds. They grow gourds on their own and level up as they grow. Pick a gourd up, carry it to the pit in the middle of the yard, and throw it in. Every one pays coins, and a long throw pays a bonus.

What is pushing you. The day runs on a timer. When it ends, night falls and you sleep in the bed to bank your coins. Fall in the pit yourself and the day ends there. You keep half of what you were carrying.

What you spend it on. The shop opens at nightfall. Money buys more ground to plant on. Sigils buy the upgrade tree: a vacuum that pulls gourds to you, a broom that blasts loose the heavy props lying around the yard, which the pit eats too, and eventually the pit itself, which you can drive across the yard instead of carrying everything to it.

What you are working towards. Everything you feed it makes it bigger. At rank eight the pit is full, and you climb in yourself to end the run. Or restart before that and keep your companions and a permanent growing-speed bonus.
70010000135697.intro: Grow gourds in a graveyard, carry them to the pit in the middle, and throw them in for coins before the day runs out.
70010000135697.name: The Pit Is Hungry

70010000135726.description:
From the creators of Nidhogg comes a game about 2D platforming survival. You'll have to parkour your way around treacherous dungeons to kite monsters while gathering blood and powerups.

Survive a run, take the bones you’ve earned to the Bone Shop, and get stronger.

Complete quests to unlock upgrades, arenas, skins, and more.

Features:
- 9 unlockable playable characters with different traits and weapons
- 6 unlockable unique survival arenas
- Over 100 enemy types
- Over 100 quests to complete
- Over 100 unlockable weapons and upgrades
- Dynamic “dungeon dnb” soundtrack by Thomas Hooey
70010000135726.intro: These dungeons are full of monsters. The blood is there. Take it!
70010000135726.name: Blood Dungeon - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000135768.description:
<Modern Forces> is a next-generation tactical FPS game where you transform into an elite special agent to confront the worst global threats that threaten the fate of the world.

Prove your overwhelming tactical prowess and physical prowess amidst the world's elite agents in the heart of high-risk, volatile battlefields and within the suffocating environment of the red desert.

・Ultra-realistic visuals that defy visual limits
The brutality of modern warfare, where artillery shells tear through everything, unfolds spectacularly before your eyes. Experience breathtaking, overwhelming immersion with your whole body within the dense battlefields perfected by a next-generation graphics engine.

・Infinite open world and unstoppable tactical freedom
The vast stage becomes a massive tactical board created exclusively for you. There are no fixed infiltration routes. Break and carve out your own paths, and completely dominate the initiative of engagements with cold-blooded play that exploits weaknesses.

・Ultra-high-speed mobile strikes to shatter the front line in an instant
Board high-performance mobile gear and ruthlessly traverse the unstoppable battlefield. Seize tactical strongholds with lightning-fast maneuverability and showcase the essence of dynamic vehicle combat, turning the tide of battle in a single assault.

・4 Class Synergies to Perfectly Control the Front Line
Assault, Engineer, Support, and Recon—providing an elite class system, each armed with unrivaled, cutting-edge tactical gear. Impeccable role assignments and tight coordination among squad members are the only keys to victory.

・Top-tier modes that perfectly embody the essence of squad tactics
From Deathmatch and Conquest to Rush, legendary modes that have captivated gamers worldwide will test your limits. From fierce capture battles to split-second skirmishes, prove the pinnacle of your strategic spectrum.

・Absolute Iron Firepower to Annihilate Enemy Defenses
Take direct control of the main gun of a next-generation tank and become the master of the battlefield. Shatter the enemy's impregnable defenses with a single shot, or seize victory by becoming an absolute iron wall protecting friendly infantry on the front lines.

<Synopsis>
The entire world is being eroded by the shadows of a transnational private military and technology organization known as the 'Iron Grid.' They are manipulating conflicts between nations behind the scenes, distributing forbidden high-tech weapons on the black market, and collapsing the global order. As a key agent of the world's elite special operations team, you must track down the leader hiding in the shadows and neutralize their ultimate weapon.

A deadly desert where red sandstorms and deadly fire rain down. Infiltrate deep into the enemy's core energy weapon production infrastructure and ruthlessly stop the activation of the 'Armageddon Protocol,' the ultimate next-generation weapon that will plunge the world into catastrophe!

Dive into the red storm and become the protagonist of a legendary special operations mission. The most brutal mission begins. Strike the heart of the enemy alongside proven comrades.
70010000135768.intro: Experience the pinnacle of the most tactical and innovative modern warfare FPS.
70010000135768.name: Modern Forces

70010000135784.description:
Where It All Began
Before smartphones. Before app stores.
ZENONIA set the foundation for mobile RPGs.

Now, this iconic action RPG returns in its original form.

A Classic, Reimagined
Bringing back the original charm
while adapting seamlessly to today’s platforms.
Whether you're here for nostalgia
or a brand-new adventure—
ZENONIA is ready.

Classic RPG, Timeless Depth
Choose your path from three distinct classes:
Warrior – Balanced and resilient
Paladin – Defensive and reliable
Assassin – Fast and lethal
Customize your stats and gear
to build a playstyle that’s truly yours.

A Journey Driven by Choice
In a world where light and darkness collide,
every decision matters.
Unfold a rich story filled with unexpected events,
and shape your path between good and evil.

Endless Progression
- Hundreds of items across multiple tiers
- Deep systems combining skills, gear, and character growth
There is always more to discover.
70010000135784.intro:
Remember the RPG that defined a generation?
ZENONIA is back—faithfully restored.
Relive the adventure that kept you playing for hours.
70010000135784.name: ZENONIA

70010000135813.description:
Expand and Customize Your Farm

Decorate your farm however you like, creating your own unique place to grow and thrive.


Manage Your Store

Buy a small, run-down shop and transform it into a successful business.
Increase the variety of items you sell as you produce new goods on your farm.
Expand and decorate your store to attract more and more customers.
Hire and train employees to help you run the business and increase your sales.


Expand the Market

Located along a road connected to an important trade route, this is the perfect place for a thriving market. Watch a small marketplace gradually grow into a wealthy and important trading hub.
Help construct new buildings.
Sell your products at the market.


Explore a Vast World

Gather resources to craft items and expand your farm.
Explore different environments in search of rare items.
Hunt animals and fight monsters to obtain valuable resources.
Explore caves in search of precious ores, but be careful! The deeper you descend, the more dangerous it becomes.


Build Your Dream Home

Expand and furnish your house to create the home of your dreams.


Seasonal Events

Seasonal events last for an entire season (28 days) and can either help or challenge the player. These events affect the world around you and can have a major impact on your business.
Financial Crisis: Product prices can drop significantly, making it harder to turn a profit.
Prosperous Season: During prosperous times, prices rise, allowing you to earn much more from the products you sell.
70010000135813.intro:
A game created by Coliseum Studio.
Plant a variety of seasonal crops, harvest them, and sell your produce to customers or directly at the local market.
70010000135813.name: Sunshine Farm

70010000135864.description:
Yes, Your Grace: Snowfall is a cinematic kingdom management game. Take on the role of a King, manage resources, support your loved ones, and make difficult decisions to see your kingdom prosper or fail. Dive into a Slavic-folklore inspired world and deal with a queue of petitioners who will bring trouble, help, or laughter into your throne room. Decide whether to help them with their problems, or conserve resources for more important matters.

- Tend to petitioners
Balance your resources wisely to help those truly in need. Send your agents to aid the petitioners and decide who receives valuables from your treasury. As a Royal Monarch, you may demand taxes and pass laws but tread carefully, as each decision bears consequences.

- Hire Agents
Each agent brings a unique and invaluable skill set, alongside their distinctive personalities. While they can aid in resolving courtly matters, be wary, some may stir trouble with personal or romantic entanglements. Follow the agents’ stories, assisting them in resolving complex dilemmas, as you carefully select who will stand by your side in the impending war.

- Care for your family
Watch your children grow as you try to keep the kingdom together. Taking care of your family will always take precedence - after all, their support can be the strongest pillar in rebuilding the safe home Davern once was.
70010000135864.name: Yes, Your Grace 2: Snowfall

70010000135872.description:
Sparkling water, colorful water-park scenery, and charming moments with beautiful women.

Set in a lively aqua park, this photo rotation puzzle game lets you enjoy casual expressions and natural poses in every completed image.

Spin the scrambled panels and bring each appealing photo back together.

・Look closely at how the panels connect
・Rotate each panel to restore the picture
・Clear stages that get trickier as you go

The rules are simple, but spotting the right flow of the image takes observation and a little spark of intuition.

Finish each puzzle and enjoy a quick, heart-fluttering moment by the water.
Ready to relax at the aqua park and put the photos back in place?
70010000135872.intro: Can you complete the aqua park photo?
70010000135872.name: Match & Crush! Aqua Park Beauties

70010000135898.description:
You found an abandoned prison.

Naturally, you decided to explore it.

Rusty Prison: Horror is a creepy exploration game where you wander through a forgotten, rust-covered prison looking for something cool to find. Explore dark cells, strange rooms, broken hallways, and places that probably should have stayed locked.
70010000135898.name: Rusty Prison: Horror

70010000135946.description:
Meet our little friend Sputnik. Help its journey to become the greatest star in the solar system - the Sun!

Cosmic gravity is applied to the planet, which makes it different from the classic physics-based merge game.
The ability to target the other side of the planets adds much more strategy and depth to the game!
70010000135946.intro: A Cosmic twist on a physics-based merge game with space gravity. Help our little friend Sputnik on his journey to become the Sun.
70010000135946.name: Sputnika Game

70010000135956.description:
Enter a dangerous world where every room brings a new challenge. Fight your way through waves of enemies, avoid deadly traps, and survive intense encounters as you explore a fast-paced 2D roguelike adventure.

Use a variety of weapons and abilities to defeat increasingly powerful foes. Stay on the move, dodge incoming attacks, and learn enemy patterns as the action becomes more demanding with every battle. Each room tests your reflexes and your ability to adapt to constantly changing situations.

Your journey eventually leads to a powerful multi-stage boss encounter that will push everything you have learned to the limit. Dodge relentless attacks, find openings, and survive long enough to claim victory.

Game Features:

• Fast-paced 2D roguelike combat
• Rooms filled with enemies, hazards, and traps
• Different weapons and combat options
• Intense bullet-hell-inspired encounters
• Increasingly challenging enemy waves
• Multi-stage boss battle
• Simple controls with action-focused gameplay
• Test your reflexes, timing, and survival skills

Enter the Rogue Vault, survive its dangers, and see if you have what it takes to reach the end.
70010000135956.intro: Fight your way through dangerous rooms filled with relentless enemies, deadly traps, and intense bullet-hell action.
70010000135956.name: Rogue Vault

70010000135981.description:
The Azure Striker Gunvolt Trilogy Enhanced is a collection of three traditional 2D action platformers,
“Azure Striker Gunvolt” (2014), “Azure Striker Gunvolt 2” (2016), and “Azure Striker Gunvolt 3” (2022)
together in one release, complete with all DLC.

The Gunvolt series boasts a rich story, played out with real-time dialog during missions, and an vast catalog of music, with over 37 songs performed by the games' characters.

Plus, this special Trilogy comes with exclusive features: action revisions from the series director, revised voices and songs, and once Japan-exclusive CD dramas included in the game. This collection strives to be as complete as possible!

*Included Games
Azure Striker Gunvolt:
Dash through stages at high speed and take down enemies with your "Flashfield" in this satisfying action platformer.
Players control Gunvolt, a superhuman (known as an Adept) with the power of lightning who must confront the oppressive Sumeragi Group in a battle for freedom.
The Trilogy Enhanced version adds new Skills to Gunvolt's arsenal.
Unleash overwhelming power like never before!

Azure Striker Gunvolt 2:
Gunvolt's rival, Copen, becomes a new star and playable character alongside the Azure Striker.
Copen uses his dash to tackle and lock onto enemies before unleashing a devastating homing laser barrage.
Master his aerial "Bullit Dash" to gracefully fly through stages and destroy enemies from above, unlocking new weapons from the abilities of defeated bosses.
Copen and Lola's voices have been re-recorded for the Trilogy Enhanced edition of the game.

Azure Striker Gunvolt 3:
A new style of action arrives with the new heroine "Kirin" who can swap with Gunvolt to overcome any situation.
Kirin has the power to teleport instantly to strike down enemies with her "Arc Chain" ability for melee action of unprecedented speed. Or switch to Gunvolt, whose tag and electrify style has leveled up to allow him to dash through enemies while striking them down, teleport, and unleash other new "Voltaic Arts".
The Image Pulse system brings characters from the series as buffs and attacks, with over 150 varieties to collect.

*Cast:
 Gunvolt - Kaito Ishikawa
 Lumen/Joule - Megu Sakuragawa
 Nova - Ayumu Murase
 Copen - Yuma Uchida
 Lola - Mayu Mineda
 Zonda - Sho Nogami / Kaori Nazuka
 Kirin - Yu Sasahara
 ZedΩ - Shun Horie
 Layla/Luxia - Rico Sasaki
70010000135981.intro: The Azure Striker's journey, all 3 games in one collection!
70010000135981.name: Azure Striker Gunvolt Trilogy Enhanced Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition

70010000136007.description:
Break bricks by using the ball. Get items like bonus, speed and multiple balls to make the game more challenging. If you hit the force wall multiple times it will be destroyed so you can reach the next stage. If you miss a ball you go back to the previous stage. But hurry up, you only have seconds before the ball explodes.

Radon Blast 2 is full packed with randomly sorted stages. An increasing ball speed makes it even more challenging. Jump between stages, collect bonus multipliers to get higher scores.
70010000136007.intro: Break bricks by using the ball.
70010000136007.name: Radon Blast 2

70010000136036.description:
The city is under siege, and an unstoppable horde of zombies is closing in. Build your defenses, upgrade your firepower, and hold the line in Zombie Siege, a fast-paced tower defense game where every round brings a greater threat.

Strategically place turrets around the city to stop waves of undead before they overwhelm your defenses. Every zombie you eliminate earns valuable coins that can be used to strengthen your position and prepare for increasingly dangerous attacks.

Surviving is about more than simply destroying the horde. The infection is spreading through the city, putting innocent civilians at risk. Choose your defenses carefully, manage your resources, and prevent the outbreak from taking over.

Battle through 10 escalating rounds as stronger enemies push your defenses to their limits. Upgrade your turrets, adapt your strategy, and prepare for the ultimate challenge waiting in the final wave—a powerful boss that will require everything you have built to defeat.

Game Features:

• Defend the city against 10 waves of zombie attacks
• Strategically place and upgrade defensive turrets
• Earn coins by eliminating enemies
• Manage your resources and strengthen your defenses
• Protect civilians from the spreading infection
• Face increasingly dangerous waves of undead
• Battle a powerful boss during the final round
• Easy to understand tower defense gameplay with strategic choices

The undead are coming. Build your defenses, protect the city, and survive the Zombie Siege.
70010000136036.intro: Defend the city from relentless zombie waves!
70010000136036.name: Zombie Siege

70010000136071.description:
Princess Lucia lost her homeland to the Demon Lord's army. Soldier Yuna survived a war with no end in sight. Swept up in a mysterious light, the two land in a strange isekai world and must fight monsters to get back to the places they call home. Both heroines battle with real-world rifles and pistols, but each has her own style. Pick your favorite and take on the stages. Your loyal pet dragon is always ready to unleash a special attack and turn a desperate moment around.

・Two heroines with plenty of personality. Play as Lucia or Yuna.
・Blast through monsters with rifles and pistols in fast, satisfying shooting action.
・Hunt for hidden survival items tucked away in every stage.
・Spend the cash you collect at the shop to buy new weapons and upgrades.
・Count on your pet dragon for special attack support.
・Grow stronger with every stage you clear.
・Upgrade weapon power, health, attack range, and more to build a strategy that's all yours.
・Face tougher enemies and fiercer bosses the deeper you go.
・Enjoy story scenes in every stage and a heartfelt ending.

The controls are easy to learn but deep enough to master, and the tension will have your palms sweating. Add the thrill of wiping out a swarm in one blast, and you get a "just one more run" kind of addiction. Reach the final stage and an emotional ending awaits, one that decides the fate of Princess Lucia and Soldier Yuna. Will the two make it home safely? Only you can find out. Defeat the final bosses of this other world and write the end of their story!

Prologue
Princess Lucia was driven from her homeland when the Demon Lord's monsters invaded. Meanwhile, in the real world, soldier Yuna fought to survive a war with no end in sight. Two women who were never meant to meet found their fates joined by a sudden, unexplained power. Swallowed by a blinding light, they arrived somewhere that was home to neither of them, an unknown isekai world.

Lucia and Yuna came face to face in a strange land. But before they could catch their breath, a fresh wave of enemies attacked. With no way home and no idea why they had been brought here, the two joined forces to survive. They came from different worlds and fought for different reasons, yet one shared wish bound them together. Both longed to return to the places they call home and bring peace back to their lives.

Enemies of this other world keep blocking their path. Will there be a clue to getting home beyond them? Lucia fights to take back her stolen kingdom, and Yuna fights for a life untouched by war. Trusting each other, they step into the unknown. Can you lead them both safely home? Their fate is now in your hands.
70010000136071.intro: A princess and a soldier who were never meant to meet team up in another world! An arcade-style 2D side-scrolling shooter you can't put down.
70010000136071.name: Isekai Princess: Monster Siege

70010000136095.description:
Game Overview
Do you love French fries? Then this game is for you! A game where you push out fries with French fries to create a set of a burger, fries, and a drink. The goal is to fulfill as many orders as you can before you run out of HP. It's a challenge you wouldn't want to miss!

Stick to sound effects
We have recorded the actual sounds of fries from a famous fast food joint to use as sound effects in the game. You can enjoy a realistic and immersive potato sound experience.

Online Multiplayer
Enjoy both random and friend matching. You can experience a once in a lifetime meet in a random match, get excited with inside jokes in friend matching, and of course, it's also possible to play solo. Play as you prefer, and you can play with up to 4 people at the same time.

Leaderboard
Compete for scores with French fries lovers all over the world.

Upgrade
You can enhance various abilities using the money earned from playing the game.
70010000136095.intro: Do you love French fries? Then this game is for you! A game where you push out fries with French fries to create a set of a burger, fries, and a drink.
70010000136095.name: French Fries Pusher Friends

70010000136111.description:
Could a surprising piece of history be true—or just a myth? If you learned it in school, you might remember the basics. But world history is packed with facts that sound almost unbelievable.

This casual true-or-false quiz brings fascinating world history trivia to life in a simple, fun format. Explore stories from ancient civilizations, cultures, and remarkable people from across the ages.

• Read a statement about world history
• Choose true or false
• Check the result and learn something new

Get fun facts right and discover you know more than you thought. Even a wrong answer can teach you something worth sharing.

Perfect for history fans, trivia lovers, families, and anyone looking for a quick brain break. Challenge yourself, compare guesses with friends, and enjoy a lively quiz whenever you have a few spare minutes.
70010000136111.intro:
Truth or myth?
Explore history's surprises!
70010000136111.name: Kids' World History: Which Side Are You On!?

70010000136134.description:
Ready for a puzzle with a glamorous twist?

Set in lively Asian streets and seaside scenes, this casual puzzle game invites you to complete captivating photos by rotating mixed-up panels into place.

How to play:
- Check the panels, each turned in a different direction
- Spin each panel with a quick touch
- Line them all up to complete the photo

As you progress, each image is divided into more panels, gradually increasing the challenge. If you get stuck, use one of up to three hints to align a row and get back on track.

Take your time to study each shape, or trust your instincts and make quick rotations. Enjoy glamorous photos, satisfying puzzles, and moments of discovery as you bring every image together.

Play solo for a focused challenge, or share the fun with your audience during a stream. Give it a spin and see how quickly you can complete each picture!
70010000136134.intro: Spin your way to picture-perfect beauty!
70010000136134.name: HENTAI Match! Asian Beauties

70010000136165.description:
Millions have played the previous games in the "Croc's World" series – now it's time for "Croc's World 5"!

Run, jump and swim your way through swamps, ancient Greece, Egypt and the world of the Maya. Whole sections of the levels are constantly on the move, so you have to time your jumps carefully – and in the gravity zones Croc simply carries on running along the ceiling.

Features:
– 60 varied levels across 4 islands
– NEW: Gravity zones – walk on the ceiling in certain sections
– NEW: Constantly moving sections of the level – time your jumps
– Vastly improved graphics
– 4 different worlds: swamp, Greece, Egypt and Maya
– 4 wicked boss enemies
– Collect up to 3 stars in every level
– Retro mode with CRT screen effect for a true 80s feeling
– Lots of challenging enemies
70010000136165.intro: Croc is back for his fifth adventure! 60 hand-crafted levels across 4 islands, packed with new enemies, huge boss fights and two brand new mechanics.
70010000136165.name: Croc's World 5

70010000136171.description:
Four objects appear in each puzzle—but one of them doesn't belong.

Figure out what the other three have in common, spot the odd one out, and drag it into the trash bin.

The answer may seem obvious at first, but the key is figuring out how the objects are connected. Look closely, think about what links them together, and enjoy the satisfying moment when the answer clicks.

Take on 40 odd-one-out puzzles and see how many you can sort out!
70010000136171.intro:
Spot the odd one out!
Drag it to the trash bin
Solve all 40 puzzles!
70010000136171.name: Sort It Out! Odd-One-Out Puzzles

70010000136179.description:
Suit up, put on your sunglasses, and get ready for the most stressful job on the planet! In Save The President, you are a bodyguard tasked with protecting the President from imminent threats during public speeches and official events.

But be careful: react too soon and you could cause a national scandal. Hesitate for even a second, and the consequences could be fatal!

When a gunman’s laser sight appears in the crowd, the clock starts ticking. You’ll have only seconds to make the right move: leap heroically toward the podium, neutralize the gunman hiding in the crowd, or put yourself directly in the line of fire and take the bullet to save the President.

The future of the nation depends on your reflexes.

Save the President at any cost!
70010000136179.intro: The bodyguard has only a few seconds to save the most important man in the world. Does he have what it takes?
70010000136179.name: Save The President

70010000136205.description:
You wake up in a collapsing underwater military base. You don’t know who you are, or why you’re here. The only thing you do know – time is running out. Steel creaks. Water breaks in. Shadows move in the dark corridors. Every corner hides danger, and every decision can be your last.

In Escape: Immersion survival is about reacting fast, adapting, and pushing forward. The environment is unpredictable, the threats are real, and your past will haunt you.

Key features:
• Classic linear adventure game.
• Unique VHS-styled visuals create unfriendly, oppressive atmosphere.
• Intense gameplay full of dynamic and unpredictable events.
• Every mistake can be fatal, danger lurks at every step.
• A variety of situations and countless ways they can unfold.
• The base is almost completely absorbed by the ocean. Discover the secret of your past and try to escape before it’s too late.
• Water is not your worst enemy. Darkness hides more than you can imagine.
70010000136205.name: Escape: Immersion

70010000136294.description:
Inherit your grandma's beloved recipe book and rediscover all her favorite dishes - one delicious page at a time. Pick your favorite animal chef, from a curious rabbit to a cheerful bear, and step into a cozy kitchen full of charm.

Mix ingredients by hand, time your baking just right in the oven mini-game, and level up to unlock new recipes, ingredients, and upgrades. From pizza and bread to cakes and cinnamon rolls, every recipe adds another page to your own cooking story.

Features:
- Choose your favorite animal chef, each with their own personality
- Cook and bake a variety of recipes: pizza, bread, cake, and pastries
- Hands-on mixing and baking mini-games
- Level up to unlock new recipes, ingredient slots, and kitchen upgrades
- Relaxing solo gameplay
70010000136294.intro: Bake, mix, and level up in this cozy kitchen adventure inspired by grandma's recipe book!
70010000136294.name: Yummy Yummy Cook Book

70010000136318.description:
Everyone's favorite radish dad is back, but this time the story is up to you! DIY Dadish gives players the ability to design any Dadish level they can imagine, while remaining easy and simple to use for younger players. Share your creations with the world, or check out other levels from around the world. The adventure never ends!

• Craft your own action packed platforming adventure
• Deploy exploding soda cans, hostile hamburgers, spikes, saws, cannons and a whole lot more!
• Create your own funny dialogue between Dadish and his kids
• Share your creations with your friends and the world
• Over 100 placeable game objects
• 15 different level themes
• 12 playable characters
• Fun for new players and long time Dadish fans
• Easy to use for younger players
• Some levels will be amazing! Others will be terrible!
70010000136318.intro: Create your own adventure and share it with the world!
70010000136318.name: DIY Dadish

70010000136350.description:
Woodo is a cozy diorama puzzle game where you assemble wooden scenes piece by piece. As you place objects in their correct spots, each scene slowly fills with color and comes to life, revealing charming animations and small surprises. Follow the story of Foxy and Ben the frog through a series of interconnected dioramas, each capturing a unique moment from their shared adventure.

Tactile Satisfaction
Feel like you’re assembling a real toy, with each piece clicking into place with a satisfying, tactile sensation, as if it’s right in your hands.
Assembling objects isn’t linear—you have to turn and explore the 3D space to reveal hidden pieces. Watch as each piece transforms the world around you, with playful animations that react to your placements, bringing the diorama to life.

A Warm Companion
With a friendly narrator's voice, immerse yourself in a world when time was plentiful and much of it was spent outdoors, when the simplest things surprised and when every day promised great adventure. Feelings that were more present in childhood and are often missed or even forgotten with time passing.

Feed Your Inner Child
The game features funny and charming characters that create an atmosphere of carefree joy and humor, reminding you that happiness is what your inner child needs.

-Assemble beautiful dioramas piece by piece with a unique puzzle mechanic
-The game adapts to your pace, providing assistance when you need it
-Gameplay changes to adapt the narration
-Simple but deeply meaningful story
-The comforting voice of the narrator keeps you company
-Get carried away by nostalgic feelings of when things were simple
-Plenty of funny characters and silly animations make you smile
70010000136350.intro: Woodo is a cozy 3D puzzle matching game
70010000136350.name: Woodo - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000136362.description:
Ever dreamed of running the coziest cat shop in town?

Welcome to Cozy Cat Shop, where adorable cats, happy customers, and endless possibilities come together! Build your dream store, discover a variety of charming cat breeds, and create a cozy place where every customer can find their perfect furry companion.

Start small and grow your shop into a bustling cat paradise. Expand your space, customize the interior, build up your business, and surround yourself with more and more adorable cats along the way!

Key features:
- Discover a variety of cat breeds
- Grow your cozy cat shop
- Customize your store
- Expand your business

Meet lots of adorable cats!
70010000136362.name: Cozy Cat Shop

70010000136405.description:
Dream Hike is a relaxing walking simulator where you explore a beautiful, colorful world in search of hidden melons. Wander through forests, valleys, mountains, and mysterious paths as you discover new places and see what the world has to offer.

There’s no rush and no danger. Just put on your hiking boots, enjoy the scenery, and keep your eyes open.

How many melons can you find?
70010000136405.intro: A peaceful adventure through a beautiful world.
70010000136405.name: Dream Hike

70010000136426.description:
Can you catch the tiny detail that does not match?

You may have seen it before—but can you really spot every difference? Adorable animal-eared heroines, from fluffy cats and dogs to fox spirits and dragonfolk, appear in charming illustrations.
