Compare the two pictures and find the one place where they differ.

• Study the illustrations side by side
• Look for the single difference on the right
• Tap the spot you found to clear the puzzle

Perfect for a relaxing break or a little brain training. Take your time admiring the cute animal-inspired characters, or turn each puzzle into a race against the clock. The simple gameplay is easy to enjoy, even if you are not usually a gamer.

A cozy choice for fans of animal-eared characters, spot-the-difference puzzles, cute artwork, and quick games. Play at your own pace or share the fun with others as you search.

Ready to put your observation skills to the test?
70010000136426.name: Twitch! Kemomimi Spot the Difference

70010000136439.description:
Step into a warm and welcoming teahouse where every customer is waiting for the perfect cup. Take orders, prepare delicious teas, and serve your guests as you experience the relaxing routine of running a cozy tea shop.

Pay attention to what each customer wants and carefully prepare their order. Keep up with incoming guests, serve the right drinks, and make sure everyone leaves satisfied. As the day continues, you'll need to balance speed and accuracy while maintaining the peaceful atmosphere of your teahouse.

With simple and accessible gameplay, Cozy Tea House offers a relaxing experience centered around preparing drinks, serving customers, and enjoying the everyday life of a charming little teahouse.

Take your time, brew the perfect cup, and enjoy another cozy day behind the counter.

Features:

Prepare and serve tea to your customers.
Take orders and make the correct drinks.
Manage multiple customers as your teahouse gets busy.
Simple and accessible tea-serving gameplay.
Relaxing and cozy atmosphere.
Charming casual experience focused on serving customers.
Enjoy the peaceful routine of working in your own teahouse.
70010000136439.intro: Run a cozy teahouse and serve delicious tea to your customers. Prepare each order carefully, keep everyone happy, and enjoy a relaxing tea-serving experience.
70010000136439.name: Cozy Tea House

70010000136473.description:
Would you have the nerve to patrol a haunted facility after dark?

Your company went under, leaving you with debts worth tens of millions of yen. To pay them back, you reluctantly take a night security job. Your equipment: spirit-seeing goggles and an exorcism flashlight.

The rules are simple:
• Look carefully around each facility
• Search for eerie anomalies that have slipped into the scene
• Aim at what you find and flash it with the exorcism light

The prankish spirits appear in different places each time you play, so you can’t rely on the same strategy forever.

You have five minutes to find every anomaly and clear the stage. Run out of time, and you’ll face a terrifying bad ending. The longer you stare into the darkness, the more you may feel that something is staring back…

Every stage takes you to a completely different everyday location:
• A school after midnight
• An unattended convenience store
• A general hospital
• A shopping mall

Familiar places gradually transform into abnormal spaces. Fans of horror and observation games will love the tension, while the brisk five-minute stages are perfect for quick sessions and entertaining gameplay videos.

Can you survive the patrol, pay off the debt, and discover how the story ends?
70010000136473.intro:
What should never be seen?
Find it if you dare.
70010000136473.name: Anomaly Space Patrol: Find the Unseen

70010000136490.description:
Things are everywhere. The bathroom is a disaster, the desk has disappeared under a mountain of stuff, and the kitchen? Let's not even talk about it.

The mission is simple: pick it up, figure out where it belongs, and make the chaos disappear!

Sort toiletries, stationery, plants, kitchenware, toys, and all kinds of wonderfully weird household items across a variety of colorful rooms. Find the right spot for every object and watch each messy space transform into a perfectly organized one.

With bold cartoon visuals, playful details, and a lighthearted sense of humor, every room is packed with little surprises to discover. No timers. No pressure. Just pure organizing satisfaction.

Whether you love cozy games, satisfying puzzles, or simply enjoy turning complete chaos into glorious order, Neatly Organized is ready to make a mess of your day - and then help you clean it up.

Features:
- A variety of colorful, delightfully chaotic scenes to tidy and organize
- Relaxing, no-pressure organizing gameplay
- A wide variety of household items across different rooms
- Bold, charming cartoon art style with playful little surprises
- Simple, satisfying mechanics - perfect for quick sessions or long relaxing play
70010000136490.intro: A colorful, chaotic, and ridiculously satisfying organizing puzzle!
70010000136490.name: Neatly Organized

70010000136496.description:
Ready for a slightly thrilling day at the office in a casual rotation puzzle?

On the clock or on a break, somehow your boss is always setting the pace! Enjoy a casual game full of heart-pounding office situations as you work through image-based puzzles.

The rules are simple!
・Study the picture carefully
・Rotate the sliced pieces into the right direction
・Complete the image and move on to the next situation!

No complicated steps are needed, so it is great for anyone who wants an easygoing puzzle game. Take your time on your own, or play with friends and family while talking through each move together.

Recommended for players who like:
・Casual puzzles
・Romance and office-themed situations
・Quick play sessions
・Observation and clever thinking

Step into an office with just a little tension, and take on the situations waiting one after another!
70010000136496.intro:
Can you keep up
with your strict boss?
70010000136496.name: Heart-Pounding Office Puzzle with My Boss

70010000136586.description:
Build, upgrade, and evolve your defenses as endless waves of enemies close in.

Create a powerful network of futuristic defensive structures and use advanced technology to keep your base standing. Every wave brings new pressure, forcing you to improve your towers, manage your resources, and decide where your upgrades will have the greatest impact.

Generate Energy and Science as you fight, then invest them into permanent improvements that make your defensive system stronger and more efficient. Increase resource production, improve your towers, unlock powerful skills, and unleash abilities such as Overcharge and EMP Shockwave when your defenses need an extra boost.

Balance your resources carefully and develop your own strategy as the enemy forces become increasingly difficult to stop.

**Features:**

* Futuristic tower defense gameplay
* Increasingly challenging enemy waves
* Multiple defensive structures with different capabilities
* Energy and Science resource systems
* Extensive tower and resource upgrades
* Powerful unlockable combat skills
* Active abilities including EMP and Overcharge
* Idle-inspired progression and resource generation
* Strategic decisions that become more important with every wave

Upgrade your technology, strengthen your defenses, and see how long your base can survive.
70010000136586.intro: Defend your base against relentless waves in a futuristic tower defense game.
70010000136586.name: Quantum Defense

70010000136622.description:
Lordcraft is a medieval fantasy kingdom-building RPG where you begin with a small settlement and grow it into a mighty realm. Gather resources, construct and upgrade buildings, expand your territory, and strengthen your castle.

Train settlers to become skilled warriors and build an army capable of defending your lands from orcs, skeletons, giants, dragons, and other dangerous enemies. Upgrade your heroes, craft powerful weapons and equipment, and shape the development of your kingdom as it grows.

Build your realm, lead your army into battle, conquer new lands, and become the most powerful lord in the kingdom!
70010000136622.intro: Build your kingdom, raise an army, and conquer the realm.
70010000136622.name: Lordcraft

70010000136642.description:
Obby Sword Master — from rookie with a stick to legendary blade master.

You step onto the arena holding the weakest sword in the game. Ahead of you: crowds of enemies, piles of rewards and one goal — become the strongest swordsman in this world.

Every hit earns experience. Every enemy drops resources. Every upgrade makes the difference you can actually feel. This is that addictive loop: swing, get stronger, swing harder, get stronger still. The progress never stops.

Endless sword upgrades
Build an arsenal of legendary blades and pour everything into raw power. The gap between your first sword and your tenth is the gap between a scratch and a lightning strike.

Loyal pets
Recruit companions that fight at your side. Each one has its own upgrade path and adds real weight to your total damage.

Strength training
Level up your character between fights. The more you invest, the bigger the damage numbers flying off the screen.

Varied enemies
From easy fodder to genuinely dangerous bosses. Every new tier tests whether you have upgraded enough to keep up.

Daily quests and events
Complete missions for rare resources, join special events and claim exclusive weapons and pets.

Adventure atmosphere
Detailed locations, epic music and a busy arena full of other swordsmen going about their business.

Simple controls, instant pick-up-and-play and progress that always moves forward. Grab your sword — the legend will not write itself.
70010000136642.intro: Upgrade your blade, cut down endless enemies and collect loyal pets. An incremental action game where every swing makes you stronger. Become the Sword Master!
70010000136642.name: Obby Sword Master

70010000136669.description: You are Eli — Tether on the radio — and the only person in the city who can be on any roof in ninety seconds. Ride a line that catches anything above you, run up sheer glass, and get to the people the city has already crossed off a list. Thirteen missions carry you from eight runaway goods wagons over a market street to the top floor of the company bringing the houses down, past six people who each believe they are the one doing the right thing. Twenty more jobs wait on street corners for whoever has the time: a cat up a water tower, a locker key, a name nobody wants said out loud. Speed is the whole fight. Arrive fast and it hurts. Arrive slowly and it hurts you. A city of rooftops, viaducts, alleys and a harbour, in the low-poly look of a 1998 disc Web swinging, wall climbing, and a straight pull to any anchor 13 story missions across four acts 20 side jobs, each with its own person and its own turn 6 boss fights, three phases apiece An upgrade tree paid for with the city's trust
70010000136669.intro: New Haven City is losing a building a week. The paperwork says they were empty. They weren't.
70010000136669.name: Swing Shift

70010000136693.description: Explore ancient pyramids with Mel in this cute and challenging 2D platformer! Conquer 40 handcrafted levels, dodge deadly traps, escape the mummy Theo, and uncover hidden treasures.
70010000136693.intro:
Complete Levels
Survive Traps
Stategic moves
70010000136693.name: Mel The Pyramid Cat

70010000136699.description: Help Mel survive her cosmic journey in this cute and challenging 2D platformer! Explore 40 handcrafted space levels, dodge alien traps, escape Theo, and overcome dangerous planets.
70010000136699.intro:
Complete Levels
Survive Traps
Stategic moves
70010000136699.name: Mel The Space Cat

70010000136705.description: Help Mel find her way home in this cute and challenging 2D platformer! Run, jump, dodge deadly traps, escape Theo, and conquer 40 handcrafted levels across colorful and dangerous worlds.
70010000136705.intro:
Complete Levels
Survive Traps
Stategic moves
70010000136705.name: Mel The Cat

70010000136737.description:
Dive into a captivating world of stunning jigsaw puzzles featuring beautiful catgirls with charming feline ears and tails. Piece by piece, reveal gorgeous, realistic anime-inspired artwork, explore unique characters and unlock breathtaking new images as you progress.
From glowing neon nights and luxurious pools to charming cafés, every puzzle brings a new scene to discover. Enjoy beautiful characters, vibrant colours and intricate details that make every completed picture a rewarding experience.
Simple, intuitive controls and soothing music create the perfect atmosphere to relax, unwind and enjoy every moment.
Features:
- Addictive and easy-to-play jigsaw puzzle gameplay.
- Gorgeous, realistic anime-inspired artwork featuring beautiful catgirls.
- A variety of charming characters, outfits and stunning locations.
- Unlock beautiful new images as you complete puzzles.
- Smooth, intuitive controls for effortless gameplay.
- A perfect balance of challenge and relaxation.
- Relaxing music to enhance your experience.
- Admire every completed masterpiece in stunning detail.
Piece by piece, discover a world of beauty, charm and delightful puzzles!
70010000136737.intro: Every piece brings you closer to a beautiful masterpiece!
70010000136737.name: Catgirls: Hentai Puzzle

70010000136751.description: Make learning English feel easy, structured, and fun. With 7 lovable characters, kids explore the full Grade 1 curriculum through guided lessons, interactive quizzes, and friendly explanations. Smart progress tracking and spaced repetition help strengthen long-term memory. Perfect for parents and children learning together — or for confident young learners practicing independently.
70010000136751.intro: A full year of English adventures! Join 7 lovable characters, blast through countless topics, ace every quiz and become an English superstar.
70010000136751.name: Primary School – English Grade 1

70010000136772.description:
Get ready for an all-new sequel to the party game that anyone can enjoy on Nintendo Switch™ 2!
Up to six players can join the fun with one Joy-Con™ per person!

Enjoy a collection of 30 intuitive and easy-to-play minigames!
Spend quality time with friends and family and have a blast!

The Nintendo Switch 2 Edition features 2 exclusive new minigames!
Enjoy new party games, "Cave Race" and "Stealth Hunter," along with improved frame rates and faster loading times for a smoother gaming experience!

[Free Mode]
Pick a game freely and play!
With both competitive and cooperative games, there are lots of ways to play!
In single-player mode, record your high scores and compete against players from around the world!

[Party Mode]
Choose a selection of games to play in order, and compete to become the champion!
You can select the option to double the points in the last game!

[Online Mode]
Play together with players from around the world!
Hop in a Quick Match to start the fun right away!

<Character Edit>
Make your own special character with further enhanced customization features, and watch as they join the party!
70010000136772.intro:
It's time for a new and improved party time!
Compete or cooperate—there's no limit on the fun when everyone's together!
70010000136772.name: Party Party Time 3 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000136878.description:
After a shipwreck, you find yourself on a strange island ruled by the mysterious ChungaChanga.

Explore jungles, beaches, and abandoned structures. Gather resources, craft useful items, solve puzzles, and search for a way to escape the island.

Use your wits to outsmart ChungaChanga, avoid his tricks, uncover hidden locations, and experiment with the world around you. You never know what will happen next or what surprise this crazy island has in store.

The first rule of survival: never trust ChungaChanga. Ever.
70010000136878.intro: Don't let ChungaChanga convince you that living on this island is a good idea.
70010000136878.name: Escape from ChungaChanga: Island Survival

70010000136884.description:
Everything feels safe and ordinary at first. Pristine showroom floors, orderly shelving, and familiar home decor stretch out before you. But as you step deeper into the endless corridors, you will quickly realize that repetition is your enemy in this first-person psychological horror anomaly game.

Every room you enter is either right or wrong. Inspect the scenery and listen closely to the audio. If you notice even the subtlest anomaly, turn back immediately. If the room is completely normal, press forward. Make a single mistake, and the entire loop resets.

But escaping isn't just about choosing the right door. Scattered throughout the showrooms are items from a shifting shopping list. You must locate and collect every item while navigating the endless maze. Miss a single item, and the checkout exit will lock you inside forever. There are no weapons, no map, and no UI hints. Your memory is your only lifeline.

Key Features:
• First-Person Anomaly Hunt: Test your memory and attention to detail. Search for subtle audio, visual, and environmental anomalies hidden across repeating rooms.
• The Endless Liminal Superstore: Explore an infinite 3D labyrinth of modern furniture displays, creepy showrooms, and disorienting corridors.
• Shifting Shopping List: You must find and collect specific grocery and home items. Only then can you unlock the final checkout exit.
• Pure Psychological Horror: No weapons, no radar, and no UI hints. Your observation skills and quick decisions are your only weapons against the loop.
• Unpredictable Showrooms: Each run mixes up item locations and anomaly events. This keeps the gameplay tense and ensures new scares with every try.
70010000136884.name: SCP-3008: Infinite Store

70010000136890.description:
CAT MAGNIFIER

Two cats sit side by side. One is correct. The other has been stretched, swollen, twisted, flattened, or bent in ways that should not be possible.

Your job is simple: make them match.

Use twelve different lenses to reshape the specimen in real time. Magnify, shrink, widen, flatten, swirl, bulge, pinch, shear, ripple, or erase distortions completely. Move, rotate, and resize each lens until the two cats line up perfectly.

FIFTY CATS

Across fifty handcrafted puzzles, the distortions become stranger and more complex. Later levels may even reverse the rules—the cat you thought was correct may be the distorted one.

Twenty different cat breeds appear along the way, from tabbies and ragdolls to sphynxes, chonks, and something the files simply call “eldritch.”

There is no fail state and no pressure. Take your time, study the cats, and solve each puzzle in as few moves as possible to earn up to three stars.

CREATE YOUR OWN

Build your own distorted cats using the same lenses as the main game. Bend them, test whether the puzzle can be solved, choose the difficulty, and create your own collection of strange feline experiments.

Fifty cats. Twelve lenses. One question:

What happened to this cat?
70010000136890.intro: Fix distorted cats with the right lenses. Fifty specimens, twelve lenses—and some “correct” cats may be lying.
70010000136890.name: Cat Magnifier

70010000136903.description:
Short matches. Big personality. Zero friction between you and the next goal.

Super Arcade Soccer 2026 is a love letter to the arcade soccer classics of the 90s, rebuilt from the ground up with a custom physics engine and a fresh cartoon look.

PINPOINT ARCADE CONTROL
One button to pass. One to shoot. Everything else is timing: through balls, volleys, headers, sliding tackles, lobs and finesse shots. No skill moves, no hidden cooldowns.

CALVARY PHYSICS
A custom engine built for fun rather than simulation: shots that curl and swerve, goal nets that ripple with real string simulation, and full player ragdolls on every tackle.

48 NATIONAL TEAMS
Every qualifying nation, with squads inspired by real-life stars and authentic kits. Take yours through the International Showdown: group stage, knockouts and the final.

FOUR PLAYERS, ONE CONSOLE
Split-screen for up to four players on a single Nintendo Switch™, head to head or side by side in co-op.

BUILD YOUR TEAM
Edit line-ups, tactics and formations. Customize your players - hair, beard, physique and skin tone - across seven skills: shooting, passing, aerial ability, strength, control, stamina and speed.

GAME MODES
Quick Match - pick a team and play.
Cups & Leagues - domestic seasons and tournaments.
International Showdown - the full campaign.
Local Showdowns - 1v1, 2v2 and four-player matches.
70010000136903.intro: Fast-paced arcade soccer with pinpoint control. The 90s feel you loved, rebuilt with modern physics and a fresh cartoon style.
70010000136903.name: Super Arcade Soccer 2026

70010000136920.description:
When a young game developer is unexpectedly pulled into one of his own creations, he must survive a dangerous game-inspired world filled with traps, enemies, and challenging obstacles.

Use your agility and platforming skills to explore vibrant levels, defeat enemies by jumping on their heads, and collect enough coins to unlock portals to the next stage. Master advanced movement abilities like Wall Jump and Wall Slide to overcome difficult obstacles and reach new areas.

With fast-paced gameplay, colorful environments, and smooth, responsive controls, **Super Dev Quest** delivers a fun and rewarding platforming experience for fans of classic 2D adventures.

Features:
- Fast-paced and fun 2D platforming gameplay
- Master Wall Jump and Wall Slide abilities
- Defeat enemies by jumping on their heads
- Collect coins to unlock portals and progress through stages
- Explore colorful worlds filled with challenging obstacles
- Enjoy smooth, responsive controls
- Play through multiple levels with progressive difficulty
- Experience an adventure inspired by classic platform games
70010000136920.intro:
Complete Levels
Survive Traps
Stategic moves
70010000136920.name: Super Dev Quest

70010000136926.description:
When polluting sea creatures fill the ocean with trash, it’s up to the Seahorse
Soap Patrol to clean things up! Float through different underwater biomes,
blowing sud bubbles at naughty nautiluses, smelly sharks, and more! Pick
up the trash and make the ocean a fresh, clean home for all to enjoy.
70010000136926.intro: A squad of seahorses must send polluters packing!
70010000136926.name: Seahorse Soap Patrol

70010000136929.description:
Ready for a charming outfit challenge?

Put together a colorful lineup of stylish women in eye-catching work outfits. This easygoing montage puzzle turns three sliced illustration panels into one polished look.

How to play:
• Read the prompt carefully
• Slide the three panels horizontally until the illustration lines up
• Clear the stage when the featured look is complete!

The simple controls make it welcoming for puzzle beginners, while matching every panel delivers a satisfying sense of accomplishment. Take your time alone, or share the fun with your viewers during a gameplay stream.

It is great for a quick break, casual brain training, or anyone who enjoys cute character art and short puzzle sessions. When the panels click perfectly into place, you may want to try just one more!
70010000136929.name: HENTAI Puzzle: Doki Doki Dress-Up

70010000136954.description:
Pick up retro game cartridges spanning three generations—8-bit, 16-bit, and 32-bit—stacked high on the floor, one by one, and place them manually onto the shelves of the correct genre.

No flashy effects, no time pressure. Just a quiet tidying-up game where you can organize at your own pace inside a small store.

As you quietly keep working, you might pick up a few oddly specific, slightly useless skills along the way—think of them as small rewards for a job well done.

● Basic Rules
Put all the game software onto the correct shelves. That’s literally it.

● Save Slots
You can create up to 9 save files for each stage.

● Skills
You can acquire somewhat subtle skills that might not be very useful.

● BGM
You can choose a playlist, but there are only 3 tracks available.
70010000136954.intro: You are just a store clerk. No magic, no skills, no cooldowns. The only thing that can clean up this messy store is your own two hands.
70010000136954.name: Game Shop Panic

70010000137037.description:
Grab your spyglass and set sail for Pirate Island - the newest hide-and-seek adventure in the Where are Leo and Mia? series!
Somewhere in these busy, hand-drawn harbors, two little adventurers are playing the world's best game of hide-and-seek. Leo is crouched behind a barrel, watching pirates haul their treasure. Mia is tucked away somewhere in the crowd. Can you and your child spot them both?
Every scene is packed with life and tiny stories to discover together: pirates counting their gold, monkeys swinging from the rigging, parrots gliding overhead, crabs scuttling across the sand. Slow down, point at the screen, laugh at the details - and cheer when you finally find Leo and Mia hiding in plain sight.
Designed from the ground up for little ones and the grown-ups searching alongside them:
• Gentle, no-pressure gameplay - no timers, no losing, no scary bits
• Big, cute, colorful scenes made for pointing and exploring together
• Rewarding star animations and happy sounds every time you find someone
• Simple controls small hands can manage
• The perfect calm co-op moment for parent and child
Made for that special "I found them!" moment - and all the giggles that come with it. Welcome to Pirate Island. Leo and Mia are already hiding.
70010000137037.intro: Find Leo & Mia among pirates, parrots and buried gold!
70010000137037.name: Where are Leo and Mia? Pirate Island

70010000137055.description:
Have you ever had an experience where a door looked just like a face? Perhaps it was a "The Face Door."

To clear the game and advance the story, you must find the key, identify the correct The Face Door, and open it to proceed. But where is the key? Which is the right door? The game tests not only your role-playing skills in searching for these elements but also your powers of deduction—and, above all, your memory.

With its light horror elements, the game is accessible even to those who aren't fans of the genre. It supports both Japanese and English for text and audio, offering a chance to learn interesting turns of phrase along the way.

But what exactly *is* a The Face Door?
70010000137055.intro:
A strange and mysterious story.
Light horror and eerie presentation.
Japanese and English display and audio.
70010000137055.name: The Face Door

70010000137086.description:
Enjoy a photo rotation puzzle themed around exciting everyday moments with charming neighbors!

Each photo has been split into panels facing different directions. Rotate the panels and restore the original picture.

Look closely at each part of the image and compare it with the panels around it. A section that seems difficult on its own may become clear once you see how the whole picture connects.

How to play:
・Study the scrambled photo
・Rotate each panel to find the correct orientation
・Use the connections between panels to complete the full image

The more panels you put into place, the clearer the picture becomes. Enjoy the satisfying moment when every part finally lines up and the complete photo is revealed.

Recommended for players who:
・Enjoy games featuring beautiful women
・Like photo puzzles and rotation puzzles
・Enjoy observing details and thinking carefully
・Want a casual puzzle game for short play sessions

Rotate each panel and complete a tempting snapshot of life with your neighbors!
70010000137086.intro:
Turn everyday moments with charming neighbors into a complete picture!
Rotate the panels to solve tempting photo puzzles
70010000137086.name: A Tempting Life with My Neighbor

70010000137104.description:
An explosive mix of action and mystery, seasoned with black humor and a sinister atmosphere. Journey into Hell alongside a brave boy named Blizzy and defeat Evil itself. Save the world and become a hero. But at what cost?

PUZZLES, MYSTERIES, AND ACTION

Step into the twisted, magical universe of Creepy Tale—a world packed with eerie secrets, original brainteasers, and minigames that'll test your wits, agility, and stealth. To survive, you'll need to leap over deadly traps, dodge sinister foes, and crack puzzles like they're no big deal.

Meet the mysterious—and downright dangerous—inhabitants of the otherworldly realm in this thrilling adventure where questing collides with action, and a gripping story ensures boredom stays far, far away.

INTERACTIVE ANIMATION

Creepy Tale isn't just a game; it's a haunting story for everyone. Lovingly crafted graphics summon memories of childhood tales—only darker, stranger, and far more twisted. Whether you dive deep into the narrative or just want a creepy little diversion, this game's designed to be enjoyed by the whole family.

A TWISTED TALE YOU WON'T FORGET

Blizzy has always craved adventure—the more dangerous, the better. Becoming a hero and saving the kingdom? That's the stuff of dreams. But a trip to Hell? Now that's a real opportunity to stretch his legs and prove his mettle. An ancient evil trying to break free? Child's play! The young and fearless Blizzy can handle anything!

Your guide through Hell will be Molek, a tiny imp whose greatest joys in life are candy and children. If you're lucky enough to become one of his favorites, you'll get more than just cruel jokes—you might even get some genuinely helpful advice. After all, watching a child sow chaos is the most entertaining pastime Hell has to offer.

FEATURES:
- Befriend hellish denizens of the underworld—and slip away just before they decide you're dinner.
- Tame enchanted butterflies to bring pictures to life.
- Uncover loads of eerie nods to classic fairy tales... and much, much stranger things.
- Take control of Furry: fight off a monstrous spider and escape a poisonous tower.
- Shatter an ancient seal, unleash the darkness within, and try desperately to set things right.
- Play with Adele—a girl with bipolar personality disorder.
- Lose yourself in the handcrafted animation for dozens of bizarre characters.
- And all of this is wrapped up in a haunting soundtrack and professional voice acting that'll creep under your skin.

Creepy Tale is the brainchild of a small but obsessed trio, pouring every ounce of passion and dark creativity into this chilling project. Prepare yourself for a tale as unsettling as it is unforgettable.

Playing the previous Creepy Tale games is not necessary to understand the story of Snow Child.
70010000137104.intro: Save the world and become a hero. But at what cost?
70010000137104.name: Creepy Tale: Snow Child

70010000137128.description:
Which heroine will make your heart skip a beat?

Remember those school days filled with sweat, tears, and unforgettable friendships? Take a nostalgic trip through snapshots of heroines devoted to their clubs, from tennis and rock bands to archery and cheerleading.

Compare the two illustrations and find the one difference hiding on the right side.

How to play:
• Study both illustrations closely
• Find the one spot on the right that differs from the left
• Tap the difference to clear the scene

Enjoy a bittersweet, dazzling feeling, as if you had returned to the days when you gave your all to a school club. With simple gameplay, it is easy for anyone to pick up and play.

Recommended for:
• Fans of youthful romance and heroine stories
• Players who love school club scenes and coming-of-age drama
• Fans of spot-the-difference games
• Anyone looking for a quick game
• Players who want to sharpen their observation skills

Take your time admiring these heroines, or race to find every difference. Enjoy a nostalgic moment on your own, or bring viewers together for a fun game-streaming challenge.
70010000137128.intro: Fall for a heroine of sweet youth!
70010000137128.name: Sweet Youth! Heroine Spot the Difference

70010000137145.description:
Welcome to the toy room! In Toy Rhythm Beat the arrows climb toward the rings and you mark each one right on the beat: hold one Joy-Con™ controller in each hand and turn your wrist in the direction of the arrow, or play with the control sticks. Simple to learn for little ones, and with a speed slider that turns it into a real challenge for the grown-ups.

10 LEVELS, 10 ORIGINAL SONGS
• Ten corners of a cozy bedroom: Bunny's Bedroom, Plushie Playroom, Penguin Parade, Pool Party, Plushie Disco, Arcade Corner, Movie Night, Toy Jamboree and more.
• Every level has its own upbeat song.
• Keep the progress bar up, clear the level and go for the PERFECT!

TOYS, NUMBERS AND LETTERS
• Every arrow carries a rider: toys join your collection.
• Numbers set your score multiplier.
• Letters spell the secret word of the level. Complete the word and fill the bar to unlock the PERFECT rating.

COLLECT 200 TOYS
• Bears, dinosaurs, robots, rockets, ice cream cones... discover all 200 toys in the gallery.
• Got duplicates? Sell them for coins.

THE JUKEBOX
• Spend your coins in the jukebox and enjoy more than 80 extra songs.
• Four crates: Animal Friends, Mixtape 1, Mixtape 2 and School Pop.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Solo: one Joy-Con controller in each hand, and swing to the beat.
• 2-player co-op: one Joy-Con controller each. The left Joy-Con controller plays the arrows on the left, the right one the arrows on the right.
• Or use the control sticks: in handheld mode or with a Nintendo Switch™ Pro Controller.
• Adjustable difficulty and arrow speed, even while you pause.
• Level up your player profile and beat your best score in every level.
• Available in English, Spanish, French, German, Italian and Portuguese.

Put on your dancing shoes: the toys are waiting!
70010000137145.intro: Dance, swing your Joy-Con™ controllers and catch every toy! A cheerful rhythm game for the whole family, solo or in 2-player co-op.
70010000137145.name: Toy Rhythm Beat

70010000137159.description:
Build, manage, and defend your settlement against relentless waves of enemies. Every successful defense begins long before the next attack arrives, so gather valuable resources, construct essential buildings, and carefully prepare your defenses.

Develop your settlement by creating structures that provide the materials you need to survive. Balance your available resources between expanding production and strengthening your defensive positions. Every decision matters as the countdown to the next enemy wave continues.

Adapt your strategy as the challenge grows. Improve your economy, expand your settlement, and create stronger defenses capable of surviving increasingly dangerous attacks. Careful planning and efficient resource management can make the difference between building a thriving stronghold and watching everything fall.

How long can your settlement survive?

Features:

Strategic tower defense gameplay combined with resource management.
Gather different resources to support your settlement.
Construct production buildings and defensive structures.
Prepare your defenses before each incoming enemy wave.
Balance economic development with the need for protection.
Expand and strengthen your settlement as you progress.
Face increasingly challenging waves that test your strategy.
Build your own approach to surviving each attack.
70010000137159.intro: Turn a small settlement into a fortified stronghold. Collect resources, construct buildings, and strategically prepare for relentless waves of enemies.
70010000137159.name: Settlement Defense

70010000137176.description:
How much can you really remember when every detail counts?

A complex illustration packed with items appears before you. Study its placement, colors, shapes, and tiny details, then commit as much as possible to memory.

Once the image is covered, only your memory can help you. Questions about subtle details are waiting to test how carefully you observed.

The rules are simple.
• Study the illustration closely
• Memorize as much information as you can
• Answer a four-choice quiz using memory alone

From mysterious rooms and unusual research facilities to floating worlds and snowy mountain bases, a variety of imaginative scenes await. Put your observation and memory skills to the test as you try to recall every detail.

Remembering only the most noticeable objects may not be enough. Look closely, trust your memory, and take on every challenge.

Can your memory keep up with these demanding questions?
70010000137176.intro:
Can you conquer
memory’s toughest quiz?
70010000137176.name: Break Your Limits! Ultimate Memory Quiz

70010000137186.description:
A crime scene can hide the smallest detail. Do you have what it takes to notice what feels out of place?

Take a close look at illustrated crime scenes and tap suspicious locations to uncover clues. This casual mystery game challenges your observation and deduction skills as you work toward the truth.

Getting started is easy!
• Read the situation and question
• Examine the scene illustration carefully
• Tap the location that seems suspicious

Where is the clue that connects everything? Ordinary objects, unusual behavior, and subtle details may all hold the key to solving the case.

You only need to choose the spot that catches your attention, so anyone can enjoy the challenge—even if you do not usually play detective games.

Think through each scene on your own, or compare theories with family and friends. The quick-to-play format is perfect for a short break whenever you want to test your powers of observation and deduction.

Can you uncover the decisive clue hidden at the scene? Solve every mystery and get closer to the truth!
70010000137186.intro: Can you spot the hidden clue?
70010000137186.name: Mystery Room — Crime Scene Tap Detective —

70010000137209.description:
A breezy photo puzzle where you restore adorable maid snapshots and enjoy each completed scene!

Take a close look at the mixed-up slices, then rotate and line them up until the picture feels just right. The rules are simple, so even if you are new to puzzles, it is easy to jump in for a quick try.

How to play:
・Look closely at the maid photo
・Rotate each slice to the correct direction
・Line up every slice to complete the picture!

As you clear puzzles, you can enjoy a variety of sweet maid scenes, one photo at a time. It is great for a relaxed solo session or a quick little reset during a break.

Recommended for players who:
・Like cute maids
・Enjoy photo-based puzzles
・Want a simple, easy-to-play game
・Prefer relaxing solo play
・Want something light for spare moments

Rotate the slices one by one and complete a heart-fluttering photo!
70010000137209.intro:
Can you complete
the cutest maid photo?
70010000137209.name: Kyun-Cute Maid Puzzle! ~ Heart-Fluttering Maid Service Time ~

70010000137260.description:
※ IMPORTANT: This game is available in Korean and Japanese only. There is no English text in the game.

—That spring, from a song drifting through the air, a year between two girls began.
The Sound of Spring Is Like You is a yuri kinetic novel set in a modern Japanese girls' school, tracing the love and growth of two girls through spring, summer, autumn and winter.

[STORY]
Airi Aihara had lost sight of the road ahead, and had come to a standstill.
One day, by chance, she hears Aoi singing.
Drawn to that voice, their story begins.
They meet in spring, spend the summer, greet the autumn, and then comes winter.
Little by little they come to know each other, to understand each other, and to be drawn to each other.
Facing themselves through one another, Airi and Aoi each find the road they want to walk, and begin to move forward one step at a time.
A year in the lives of two girls who meet, fall in love, and grow together.

[FEATURES]
・A yuri kinetic novel set in a modern Japanese girls' school
・Spring, summer, autumn, winter — a relationship that changes through the seasons
・Character art and event scenes that shift as the seasons turn
・A story that follows Airi Aihara and Aoi's love and growth to the very end
・Includes a new side story added in the renewal edition
・Includes a digital art book and the original soundtrack

[NEW SIDE STORY]
A new episode starring Akari, depicting a past the main story never told.
Whether you already know the original or are meeting these two for the first time, we hope you enjoy the newly reborn The Sound of Spring Is Like You.

[DELUXE EDITION CONTENT]
This version comes with digital bonus content at no extra cost — no separate purchase is needed.
・Digital art book — illustrations from the game, plus development artwork
・Original soundtrack — the music from the game
Both can be opened from the in-game menu.
70010000137260.intro: From spring to winter — a year of first love and quiet growth between two girls.
70010000137260.name: The Sound of Spring Is Like You

70010000137284.description:
Take command of the frontline and defend your territory against relentless enemy assaults in this military-themed tower defense strategy game. Deploy defensive units, secure key positions, and build a powerful defense capable of stopping increasingly dangerous waves of attackers.

Every battlefield presents new tactical challenges. Carefully choose where to place your units, strengthen vulnerable areas, and adapt your strategy as enemy forces grow larger, faster, and more resilient. Efficient planning and smart deployment are essential for survival.

Progress through multiple battlefields and face an endless stream of enemies designed to test your tactical skills. Whether you prefer building an impenetrable defensive line or adapting to threats as they appear, every decision can determine the outcome of the battle.

Hold the line, protect your defenses, and prove your strategic abilities against overwhelming odds.

Features:

Military-themed tower defense gameplay.
Deploy defensive units to stop advancing enemies.
Defend strategic routes across multiple battlefields.
Face increasingly challenging waves with stronger enemy forces.
Plan unit placement and adapt your tactics to changing threats.
Multiple maps with unique defensive opportunities.
Endless scaling waves for long-term strategic challenges.
Easy to learn, challenging to master.
70010000137284.intro: Hold the line against an advancing enemy force! Place defensive units, plan your strategy, and survive escalating waves across multiple battlefields.
70010000137284.name: Battlefront Defense

70010000137317.description:
What makes a handsome guy look even more irresistible? Maybe it’s the moment water glistens on his skin and a shirt clings just right.

Spin & Drip! Wet Guy Puzzle is a casual photo puzzle featuring charming guys in refreshing water-themed scenes—from pools and beaches to waterfalls and showers.

How to play:
• Check the panels, each turned in a different direction
• Spin each panel until it faces the right way
• Line everything up to complete the photo

As you advance, the photos are divided into more panels, gradually raising the challenge. If you get stuck, a hint can straighten out one uncertain row. You can use up to three hints, making it easy to enjoy even if puzzles aren’t your specialty.

Perfect for anyone who enjoys handsome, muscular guys, romantic vibes, refreshing scenes, quick casual puzzles, or testing their observation and intuition. Focus on the details at your own pace, or make quick turns based on instinct. Enjoy it solo, or share the excitement with your audience through gameplay videos and livestreams.
70010000137317.intro: Can you complete the perfect snapshot?
70010000137317.name: Spin & Drip! Wet Guy Puzzle

70010000137323.description:
A two-player game about collecting as many apples as you can:
ShuriRingo

Collect the most apples
within the time limit to win!

Big sister Meika and little sister Shuri—
this cute duo competes to gather as many apples as they can!

Have fun and hype up the excitement with your family, friends, or partner!
70010000137323.intro:
Collect as many apples
as you can with Meika and Shuri!
70010000137323.name: ShuriRingo

70010000137336.description:
“I’m working as a maid… but it’s a secret.”

Follow the everyday life of a sweet, slightly clumsy boy who dresses up as a maid and does his best to serve others. Each illustration contains one hidden difference on the right half.

How to play:
• Carefully compare the illustrations on the left and right
• Find the one spot on the right that differs from the left
• Tap it to clear the stage!

His earnest efforts, even after making a little mistake, are sure to make you want to cheer him on. Enjoy warm, heart-melting everyday scenes while searching for each difference.

Recommended for anyone who enjoys:
• Unusual cute characters and themes
• Heartwarming maid and clumsy-character illustrations
• Spot-the-difference puzzles
• Short, easy-to-pick-up games
• Games that test observation skills

Take your time admiring every little move, or race to find the difference as quickly as possible. It’s perfect for a relaxing solo session—and a fun choice for sharing with viewers during a game stream.
70010000137336.name: Me in a Dress!? Femboy Maid: Spot the Difference

70010000137365.description:
Salcy and Cockapoo are trading their chaotic rescue mission for a much calmer pastime. Grab a puzzle box, pick a themed pack, and start snapping pieces into place.

Choose from a growing lineup of themed puzzle packs - Pool, Fall, Winter, Camp, Garden, Space and more - each filled with hand-drawn scenes pulled straight from the Freaky Trip world, from building snowmen in the snow to floating around on pool rings under the palm trees. Pick your difficulty - Easy, Medium, or Hard - and enjoy the same oddball humor and cartoon charm fans know from the original game, now in a slower, cozier format. Completed puzzles are rated with stars, so you can track your progress pack by pack.

Features:
- Relaxing jigsaw puzzles starring Salcy and Cockapoo from the Freaky Trip universe
- Multiple themed puzzle packs (Pool, Fall, Winter, Camp, Garden, Space, and more)
- Three difficulty levels (Easy, Medium, Hard) for casual and dedicated puzzlers
- Star-rated completion tracking for every puzzle
- Charming, colorful art style true to the Freaky Trip world
70010000137365.intro: A cozy jigsaw puzzle game set in the world of Freaky Trip - piece together colorful, hand-drawn scenes starring Salcy and Cockapoo.
70010000137365.name: Freaky Trip: Puzzled

70010000137406.description:
Welcome to Woodland Trail, a relaxing walking simulator where the journey is just as important as the destination.

Explore a calm woodland filled with hidden paths, quiet corners, and collectible melons waiting to be discovered. Take your time, wander wherever you like, and see if you can find every single melon.

Features:
>Explore a peaceful woodland at your own pace.
>Collect all the hidden melons.
>Search every path and secret spot.
>Relax and enjoy a simple, cozy adventure.
70010000137406.name: Woodland Trail

70010000137464.description:
Adventurers, your next mission awaits!

Lately, Monster Girls have appeared across the land, captivating people with their irresistible charm.

There is only one way to defeat them: find the Heart Core hidden somewhere on their bodies!

【Hunting Guide】

Study every detail of each Monster Girl.

The Heart Core may be hiding in an unexpected place.

It could be blended into an outfit or accessory. Some may even have a deceptive fake heart to throw you off...

Take your time, observe carefully, and tap when you find the real Heart Core!

You won't need weapons or magic. Your greatest asset is your own eye for detail.

【Wanted: Skilled Adventurers】

• Those who are good at finding hidden objects
• Those who never miss a subtle oddity
• Those who trust their powers of observation and intuition
• Those who can resist the allure of Monster Girls

Spot a suspicious location? Tap it without hesitation!

Adventurer, use your eyes to uncover every genuine Heart Core and defeat the Monster Girls one after another!
70010000137464.name: Monster Girls: Alluring Heart Catch

70010000137470.description:
What would you do if a girl in uniform suddenly caught your attention?

From the walk home after school to the bustle of the office, everyday moments take on a thrilling twist.

Meet charming characters in school uniforms, work outfits, and all kinds of stylish attire in this heart-pounding montage puzzle.

Putting the look together is easy!
・Study the character's appearance
・Compare the mixed-up outfit strips
・Choose the right combination and complete the look!

A student in a school uniform. A confident professional in office wear. Each completed montage brings a fresh, exciting encounter.

“Is this the right piece?”
“Maybe this one fits better…”

Compare the details and find the perfect match. Completing the look is incredibly satisfying!

With intuitive gameplay and no complicated controls, it's perfect for a quick break or a little time-killing fun.

Recommended for players who enjoy:
・Illustrations of women in uniforms and workwear
・A slightly daring atmosphere
・Character-focused puzzle games
・Observation and matching games
・Easy games for short play sessions

Who will catch your eye next? Complete every montage and enjoy a series of heart-pounding encounters!
70010000137470.intro:
Hey, got a minute?
A girl in uniform stops you cold.
A heart-pounding montage puzzle
70010000137470.name: Heart-Pounding! Uniform Montage Puzzle ~From After School to the Office~

70010000137476.description:
From folding clothes into a suitcase to setting up a campsite, arranging a bakery display, building a cheese board, slicing a pizza, matching tulip colors, or piecing together a stained glass window, every scene turns everyday travel tasks into a soothing puzzle. Relax, take your time, and enjoy the little details of life on the road with the ones you love.

Key Features:
- A variety of cozy packing and sorting puzzles, from suitcases to bakery boxes and beyond
- Follow a couple and their pets through charming travel-themed scenes
- Hand-painted, warm and pastel art style
- Relaxing, no-pressure gameplay perfect for unwinding
70010000137476.intro: Pack your bags and grab your furry companions for a cozy trip!
70010000137476.name: Cozy Packing

70010000137482.description:
Just starting to learn English?

This easygoing learning game helps beginners practice familiar English words in a fun, game-like way.

Look at each question and discover how to say everyday things and commonly used words in English.

Playing is simple!
• Read the question carefully
• Think of the right English word
• Choose an answer and take on the question

Start with basic vocabulary instead of difficult material. It’s a friendly first step for anyone who wants to begin learning English.

Ever seen a word and thought, “I know that—but how do you say it in English?” Check words one at a time and get comfortable with English while you play.

Easy to pick up in short sessions, it’s great for a little daily practice, as well as previewing and reviewing English vocabulary.

Recommended for people who want to:
• Start learning English
• Build a foundation with basic words
• Find a game that’s an easy introduction to English study
• Practice English in a relaxed, game-like way
• Learn a little at a time

Make your first English words easy and fun. Give it a try!
70010000137482.name: Slot & Learn Easy English Words

70010000137488.description:
Assemble vibrant puzzles featuring animated anime-style images of beautiful girls. Each image is divided into small diamond-shaped pieces—find the right spot for each one and reconstruct the picture step by step.

Completing puzzles unlocks new images, while the gradually increasing difficulty keeps the gameplay engaging. Simple, intuitive controls make it easy to select a piece and place it in the correct position.

Once a puzzle is finished, the image comes to life, allowing you to admire the animated scene in full detail. Relaxing music enhances the atmosphere, letting you play at your own pace.

Features:

• Unique puzzles made of diamond-shaped pieces.
• Beautiful animated anime-style images of girls.
• New images unlocked as you progress.
• Simple and intuitive controls.
• Gradually increasing difficulty.
• Ability to view completed animated scenes.
• Soft, relaxing music.
70010000137488.intro: Relaxing puzzles with beautiful animated anime girls.
70010000137488.name: Yummy Girl: Cherry Glow

70010000137512.description:
How many discs can you flip with a single move?

Take a close look at the board and find the spot that lets you flip the most discs in this Reversi-inspired brain teaser.

The rules are simple!
• Study the board
• Check the available spots
• Choose the spot where you think you can flip the most discs

Look in every direction—vertical, horizontal, and diagonal—to find the best move.

You may think, “This is it!” But a closer look could reveal another spot that flips even more.

Enjoy the fun of reading the board in a Reversi-style thinking puzzle designed for quick, casual play.

Recommended for players who enjoy:
• Reversi and board games
• Brain teasers and logic puzzles
• Testing observation and intuition
• Quick games
• A little mental exercise during spare moments

Don’t miss a spot on the board. Find the one move that brings the biggest haul!
70010000137512.intro: Where can you flip the most?
70010000137512.name: Reversi Brain Quiz! - Spot the Max Flip in 1-Move -

70010000137518.description:
Can you spot the hidden rule?

Have you ever looked at a sequence and wondered, “Why does it go this way?” Put your observation skills to the test with IQ pattern quizzes inspired by logical thinking and beginner-friendly programming concepts.

Study numbers, shapes, and arrangements carefully, then figure out what connects them. No complicated programming code is required. Just look closely, organize the order, find the common rule, and predict what comes next.

How to play:
・Examine the question image
・Think about the hidden rule or pattern
・Choose the answer you think is correct

The key to solving each puzzle is not memorizing facts—it’s noticing what others might miss. Every solution can bring that satisfying “aha!” feeling, whether you solve it quickly or take your time.

Great for anyone who:
・Wants to explore programming-style thinking
・Enjoys IQ quizzes and logic puzzles
・Likes finding patterns and sequences
・Enjoys thinking, guessing, and making discoveries
・Wants to challenge themselves with family
・Wants a quick and fun mental workout

How many rules can you uncover? Use intuition and logic to take on a variety of pattern quizzes!
70010000137518.name: For Ages 10 and Up! My First Code Logic Quiz ~ IQ Pattern Quizzes to Train Logical Thinking ~

70010000137537.description:
What looked ordinary a moment ago may not stay that way.

You know that feeling: something seems off, but you cannot quite say what it is. At first, noticing the change feels satisfying. Then the meaning sinks in—and a chill runs down your spine.

This is an Aha-style visual horror puzzle built around subtle changes in everyday photographs. Watch closely as a familiar scene slowly becomes something else. The further you go, the more unsettling the world around you may feel.

How to play:
・Watch the photograph carefully
・Notice the area that gradually changes
・Tap the spot where the change occurred

No complicated controls—just your eyes, your instincts, and the courage to keep looking. Each discovery brings a small rush of insight, followed by the uneasy feeling that you may have been better off not knowing.

Perfect for a quick scare during a spare moment, whether you enjoy visual puzzles, eerie games, or that irresistible “just one more” feeling. Test your powers of observation and see if you can handle what you uncover.
70010000137537.intro: When the truth clicks, the chills begin.
70010000137537.name: Aha... Oh No.

70010000137545.description:
Can you restore the flow?

Remember those puzzles that looked simple until every piece mattered? Turn scattered pipe panels and build a complete route in this approachable logic puzzle.

How to play:
・Check the panels with pipes
・Rotate each panel to adjust its direction
・Create a route where the flow connects correctly

Early stages are easy to read, but later layouts add more pipes and increasingly complex routes. Look at the whole board and think through each move: one turn can change everything that follows.

Whether you enjoy pipe puzzles, rotation puzzles, or thoughtful logic games, there is a challenge waiting for you. Test your insight and problem-solving skills, play a few stages during a short break, or take your time with tougher layouts.

Read the tangled routes, complete every connection, and get the flow moving!
70010000137545.name: FLOW PIPE CODE 〜Connect the Pipes Logic Puzzle〜

70010000137640.description:
Take control of a crazy toy trike and put your driving skills to the test with realistic physics and fast-paced RC racing.

Race against opponents, beat your best times in Time Trial, or explore freely in Free Roam. Play with a friend in 2-player split-screen or challenge them through Wireless Play!

Get behind the handlebars and let the crazy RC racing begin!
70010000137640.intro: A wild RC racing adventure with a lamb behind the handlebars!
70010000137640.name: Crazy Lamb RC

70010000137658.description:
Parkour Obby: Food Escape is a fast-paced obstacle course where every level is made out of delicious food. Jump across giant burgers and parkour your way to the finish!

FEATURES:
>Food-themed parkour levels
>Checkpoints to help you keep progressing
>Hardcore Mode with all checkpoints disabled
>Challenging obstacles and levels
70010000137658.name: Parkour Obby: Food Escape

70010000137664.description:
Stock Cars Racing is pure adrenaline from the first corner to the finish line.
Race across a range of tracks set in different environments and weather conditions — dusty dirt roads, green forest trails and snow-covered circuits, each with its own grip and challenges.
Choose from a varied line-up of vehicles: old classic cars, fast and agile buggies, and heavy vans. Every one handles differently, so pick the ride that fits your style.
The AI opponents race hard and won't let you through. Save your boost for the right moment, hit it on the straights, and take the position.

Features
-Multiple tracks across dirt, forest and snow environments
-Varied vehicles: classic cars, buggies, vans
-Boost system for overtaking
-Fierce AI opponents
70010000137664.intro: Boost. Overtake. Win. Pure adrenaline racing.
70010000137664.name: Stock Cars Racing

70010000137719.description:
Prepare your defenses and protect the realm from relentless waves of enemies in this strategic tower defense adventure. Every battle challenges you to think carefully, position your towers effectively, and stop the advancing forces before they reach their destination.

Build a strong defensive line by placing towers at strategic locations across the battlefield. Consider the paths your enemies will take and use your available defenses wisely to create an effective strategy capable of handling each incoming wave.

As the battle continues, the challenge grows and your defenses will be put to the test. Adapt your strategy, strengthen your defensive positions, and prepare for increasingly dangerous assaults.

Can you hold the line and protect the realm from the invading forces?

Features:

Classic strategic tower defense gameplay.
Place towers to stop waves of advancing enemies.
Plan your defenses and choose effective tower positions.
Face increasingly challenging enemy waves.
Adapt your strategy as new threats arrive.
Defend your territory and prevent enemies from reaching their destination.
Accessible gameplay that's easy to learn and challenging to master.
Test your strategy and become the ultimate defender.
70010000137719.intro: Defend your realm against relentless waves of enemies! Place powerful towers, plan your strategy, and stop every threat before it reaches your defenses.
70010000137719.name: Realm Under Siege

70010000137757.description:
What does a perfect day off look like?

A girlfriend's laid-back weekend photos have been split into puzzle pieces! Restore each picture by rotating and returning the pieces to their proper positions in this simple, relaxing photo puzzle.

Take your time with scenes of relaxing at home, unwinding on the bed, or taking a quiet break with a drink in hand. Enjoy each unhurried moment as the picture gradually comes together.

How to play:
• Study the scattered photo pieces
• Think about where each piece belongs and rotate it into place
• Restore the entire picture to clear the stage!

The early stages are easy to pick up with only a few pieces. As you progress, the photos are divided into finer pieces, putting your observation skills to the test.

With no complicated rules to learn, this is a great choice for puzzle newcomers. Play for a few minutes when you have time to spare, or settle in and carefully complete each picture at your own pace.

Recommended for players who:
• Enjoy photo puzzles
• Want a simple puzzle to pick up and play
• Like games that test observation
• Are looking for something to play alone or during a spare moment
• Want a calm, easygoing day-off atmosphere

Can you put these scattered moments of her day back together, one picture at a time?
70010000137757.intro: Can you complete her lazy day?
70010000137757.name: Lazy Day Girlfriend Observation Puzzle

70010000137763.description:
Olive’s situation is dire. They're on the verge of being thrown out of college unless they can salvage their GPA, and their only chance rests on classes they know next to nothing about.

Their lifeline: two club leaders who are more than willing to help them succeed. However, no solution is that easy. Olive soon finds themself in the middle of a conflict between these two friends that threatens to undo their long-standing love for each other.

Twofold is a story about love, family, and connection. It celebrates family of all kinds, and explores the strength (and fragility) of bonds between people.
70010000137763.intro: In a bid to avoid failing out of college, Olive Penn inadvertently finds themselves caught in the middle of a feud between two campus club leaders.
70010000137763.name: Twofold – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000137830.description:
Let's make karaage on Nintendo Switch™!
Marinate the meat in sauce, coat it in batter, and fry it until crispy!
Pack up the finished karaage and add toppings to match each order!
Share Joy-Con™, and up to 4 players can play together!
Reach for the ultimate high score!

《Rules》
Make karaage to order!
Keep cooking until time runs out!

《How to Play》
1. Marinate the meat in sauce

2. Coat it in batter, then fry until crispy!

3. Pack the right number of karaage and choose the correct topping!

4. Serve the order to the customer! The more closely you match the order, the more points you get!

[Score Attack]
Fill orders one after another and aim for a high score!
Make as much karaage as you can and climb the leaderboards!

[Battle]
Compete in karaage-making battles with up to 4 players!
Aim for the highest score and put your skills to the test!
70010000137830.intro:
Get ready for a delicious karaage-making challenge!
Make tons of karaage and watch your food cart prosper!
70010000137830.name: Make it! Karaage

70010000137847.description:
Travel through beautiful environments, explore unfamiliar places, and follow the light as it guides you along your path. Pay attention to your surroundings, overcome the obstacles that stand in your way, and discover what lies beyond each new area.

As your journey continues, uncover the secrets hidden throughout the world and experience an adventure where exploration and atmosphere are at the heart of the experience.

Follow the light, continue your journey, and discover what awaits at the end of the path.

Features:

Atmospheric adventure focused on exploration and discovery.
Journey through a mysterious world guided by light.
Explore a variety of environments and hidden areas.
Overcome obstacles and challenges along your path.
Discover secrets scattered throughout the world.
Immersive atmosphere designed around light and darkness.
Accessible adventure gameplay focused on the journey.
70010000137847.intro: Embark on a mysterious journey through a world shaped by light.
70010000137847.name: Lightbringer's Journey

70010000137869.description:
Ready for a puzzle with a wild side?

Meet fierce, charismatic male furry characters inspired by wolves, tigers, lions, bears, and more. Rotate the panels until each illustration comes together in this easy-to-pick-up puzzle game.

How to play:
・Check the panels, which are turned in different directions
・Rotate each panel with a quick swipe of your finger
・Line everything up to complete the full illustration

As you advance, the images are divided into more panels, gradually raising the challenge. Take your time to study each shape, or trust your instincts and make quick rotations.

Fans of bold furry artwork, rugged charm, and short, satisfying puzzle sessions will find plenty to enjoy. Focus on a stage by yourself, or share the excitement with viewers during a stream.

Can you bring every wild scene back into perfect alignment?
70010000137869.intro:
Feel the primal thrill!
Rotate your way to the perfect picture!
70010000137869.name: Spin & Howl! Wild Furry Puzzle

70010000137929.description:
When Moomintroll unexpectedly wakes up early from his winter hibernation, he finds himself completely alone for the first time, in a world he barely recognizes. The familiar landscape of Moominvalley is now cloaked in the frosty veil of the Lady of the Cold. Initially seeking someone to care for him and longing to banish winter, young Moomintroll reluctantly embarks on a journey into the unknown, learning to forge new friendships and help those in greater need than himself.

- Wander through the beautiful landscape inspired by Nordic nature, exploring Moominvalley and the nearby forests and mountains.
- Meet many of Moomintroll’s old and new friends, and help them out by solving quests and puzzles.
- Re-imagine Tove Jansson’s Moominland Midwinter. A trove of nostalgia for fans of Moomin, and an approachable starting point for those experiencing this wonderful world for the first time.

While not a direct sequel to Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley, it is a spiritual successor with many similarities. You can enjoy both games on their own, and in any order you’d like.
70010000137929.intro: From the creators of Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley comes a heartwarming new adventure inspired by the beloved Moomin stories by Tove Jansson.
70010000137929.name: Moomintroll: Winter's Warmth – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition

70010000137935.description:
One small boat. One simple rod. A whole valley waiting beyond the next haven.

Fishing Valley Remastered is a quest-driven fishing journey where every trip takes you a little farther. Travel from haven to haven, meet new characters, take on quests, and unlock new waters filled with new species and challenges to discover.

Every catch can move your journey forward. Sell your haul to upgrade your fishing gear and boat, opening the way to more distant waters and tougher catches — or keep your favorite fish and give them a home in your own aquarium.

Some species are easy to find. Others may take the right location, the right equipment, and a little more skill. Chase rare catches, complete your collection, follow the story, or simply take the boat out and enjoy the peaceful rhythm of fishing at your own pace.

• Travel from haven to haven and take on quests along the way
• Discover and collect a variety of fish species
• Upgrade your fishing gear and boat to reach new waters
• Keep your favorite catches and grow your own aquarium
• Follow the story or simply enjoy fishing at your own pace

Fishing Valley Remastered brings the original adventure back with refreshed presentation, refined gameplay, and a renewed focus on exploration, progression, and the satisfaction of one more cast.
70010000137935.intro: A fishing adventure where every cast takes you further.
70010000137935.name: Fishing Valley Remastered

70010000138000.description:
Can you bring every piece of the picture into focus?

You know that feeling when a great photo is almost complete? Now it is time to put your observation skills to work.

Piece together striking cosplay photos featuring beautiful characters in angelic, fairy-inspired, maid-style, futuristic, and other eye-catching outfits. Rotate each piece until the picture comes together as one perfect shot.

How to play:
・Check the photo pieces
・Select a piece with the wrong orientation and rotate it
・Align every piece correctly to complete the picture

The simple rules make this puzzle easy to pick up, even for beginners. Watch the image gradually take shape and enjoy the satisfaction of completing each stage.

Play at your own pace when you want a focused solo challenge or a quick way to relax. Can you complete every stage and build the entire collection of best shots?
70010000138000.intro:
Can you spin the pieces
into the perfect shot?
70010000138000.name: Cosplay Beauties Best Shot Puzzle

70010000138006.description:
How much can you recall after just one minute?

From waking up in the morning and commuting through a crowded train to working at the office, enjoying lunch, and relaxing at home in the evening, observe a day in the life of a beautiful office worker.

This easy-to-play memory game challenges you to remember what you saw in each scene.

• Study the image carefully for one minute
• Remember the person, her belongings, and the surrounding details
• Answer four-choice questions using your memory

You may think you were paying attention, only to wonder, “Wait, what was that again?”

Enjoy scenes from the commute, the office, lunchtime, and a quiet evening while putting your memory to the test.

Each session is short and easy to fit into a break or a few spare minutes. Look closely at every corner of the image and see how accurately you can remember her day!
70010000138006.name: A Day in the Life of a Beautiful Office Lady Follow Her from Morning to Night

70010000138059.description:
Ever recognize a word but forget how it looks in Hangul?

Turn the words you see in your fan life into a fun way to learn Korean!

This fill-in-the-blank Korean quiz game uses illustrations to help you complete Hangul words. Start with words connected to the things you love and get familiar with Korean one letter at a time.

How to play:
• Look at the illustration and the partially completed word.
• Choose the Hangul character that fits from four options.
• Place the character in the blank to complete the word.
• Compare similar-looking characters and find the perfect one.

Scenes from cheering at a live show, fan events, and dance choreography bring each word to life. Even familiar words can feel fresh when you see them written in Hangul.

Whether you love K-pop or are just starting to explore Korean, each question is easy to try in a spare moment. Turn “I’ve seen that!” into “Now I get it!” and add a little Korean learning to your fan time.
70010000138059.intro: Can you place the right Hangul?
70010000138059.name: Slot & Learn My Faves Hangul

70010000138071.description:
What would you discover on a relaxing walk through town with an adorable Shiba Inu?

Explore charming scenery inspired by every season, from old-fashioned streets and waterfront neighborhoods to lively nighttime lanes, snowy views, and valleys filled with fall colors. Somewhere in each scene, your Shiba companion is waiting for you.

This is a picture puzzle where scattered pieces must be returned to their proper positions to complete the view.

How to play:
• Study the scattered pieces carefully
• Look for connections between buildings, roads, and the sky
• Rotate and arrange the pieces to complete the picture

Which roof connects to the next one? Where does the rest of the Shiba's body continue? Look closely at each detail and use your powers of observation to find the solution.

Every completed scene brings a small moment of discovery. Take your time, enjoy the changing seasons, and earn stars based on how quickly you finish each puzzle.

Perfect for dog lovers, fans of picture puzzles, and anyone who enjoys peaceful scenery and short, easygoing challenges. Take a little journey with your Shiba and see if you can complete every view!
70010000138071.intro: Take a stroll with a clever Shiba!
70010000138071.name: Shiba Stroll: Brain Puzzles Around Town

70010000138077.description:
Rows and columns of numbers may look random, but hidden rules are waiting to be found. Can you identify the number piece that satisfies both patterns?

This reasoning puzzle is easy to learn and satisfying to solve. Study the arrangement and use the numbers and their positions as clues.

How to play:
• Work out the pattern across the row
• Work out the pattern down the column
• Choose the piece that matches both conditions and move it to the crossing square

Knowledge is not the key—observation and insight are. Begin with two-digit numbers, then take on three-digit challenges as the stages progress.

There are 40 stages to complete. Think through each puzzle at your own pace and ask yourself: what rule is hiding in this sequence?

Stuck on a puzzle? Use a hint to keep moving, even if logic puzzles are new to you.

Perfect for anyone who enjoys number puzzles, logic challenges, pattern spotting, brain training, or a quick solo game for a spare moment.

The answer cannot be found by looking across or down alone. Can you uncover the solution where both patterns meet?
70010000138077.name: IQ Cross Logic: Spot the Pattern, Solve the Puzzle

70010000138108.description:
Become a fabulous supermom in this funny 3D family life and farming game! Can you manage a busy home, run a backyard farm, and stay stylish daily?

Balance the ultimate daily routine! From dressing yourself and your three energetic kids to babysitting a lazy husband who refuses to get off the couch, your hands are always full. Cook meals, clean messes, soothe crying babies, and then head outside to milk the cows and tend your farm animals. Can you survive the daily rush?

Key Features:
• Hilarious 3D Family Simulator: Experience a fast-paced, comedic life sim. Juggle non-stop chores, cook family meals, change dirty diapers, and keep your home in order.
• Manage Your Lazy Husband: He needs constant supervision! Turn on his favorite TV shows, hand-deliver his snacks, and clean up his messes before chaos breaks out.
• Backyard Homestead & Farming: Step outside to run your personal mini-farm. Feed the animals, milk the cows, and manage your outdoor chores to keep supplies stocked.
• Fashion, Makeup & Dress-Up: Looking fabulous is half the battle! Customize your supermom with a huge wardrobe of chic dresses, trendy hairstyles, and stylish accessories.
• Addictive Time Management: Upgrade your tools, unlock new rooms, and challenge your multitasking skills. Face an endless, unpredictable daily schedule.
70010000138108.intro: Rule the house and become Super Mom!
70010000138108.name: Mother Simulator

70010000138150.description:
Sharpen your eye for detail across 60 beautifully crafted hidden object scenes, each inspired by real-world cities and iconic landmarks.
Take a break from searching with 12 delightful mini games and brain teasing puzzles that the whole family can enjoy together.
This Collector's Edition is packed with exclusive extras, enjoy bonus levels, a music player and achievements to keep the adventure alive.
Personalize your experience in a special interior scene where you can buy furniture, and test your skills to unlock 10 unique achievements.

Family Journey is the cozy world tour you have been waiting for.
Ready to explore?

The collector's edition includes:
- 60 stunning hidden object scenes across the globe!
- 12 creative mini-games and brain-teasing puzzles.
- A heartwarming family story of world travel.
- Collector's Edition with exclusive bonus chapter.
- Cozy gameplay the whole family will love.
70010000138150.intro: Pack your bags and join a loving family on a heartwarming journey around the world!
70010000138150.name: Family Journey: Hidden Across the World Collector's Edition

70010000138207.description:
Keep it on your desk or bedside table as a living art display, set a gentle ambiance with soundscapes, and keep track of your daily tasks with reminders.

■ Make your Nintendo Switch™ a part of your space

Turn your Nintendo Switch into a digital art frame. Explore included pixel-art illustrations and animations, or create your own with the built-in editor. Add ambient sounds while you work, focus, or relax.

■ Keep your day close

Make task lists to track daily routines and upcoming goals. Use the customizable focus timer to shape your work and break sessions around the way you like to concentrate.

■ Wake up gently

When the day winds down, turn your Nintendo Switch into a bedside clock. Set an alarm, settle in, and start tomorrow feeling ready.

Welcome to SOMEWHERE SMALL, a quiet place for your Nintendo Switch, and for you.
70010000138207.intro: Turn your Nintendo Switch™ into a cozy pixel-art desk companion.
70010000138207.name: SOMEWHERE SMALL

70010000138252.description:
ERF + The Year After is part of the GB Archive, a curated initiative focused on the technical preservation and distribution of homebrew games.

Experience two atmospheric narrative adventures, each using the classic handheld’s limitations to tell a deeply human story.

In The Year After, follow an invisible stranger through the life of a family facing a brutal winter. Watch seasons change, years pass, and the people around you grow older as you uncover a story about love, loss, and the moments that remain with us.

In ERF, Earth has become a tourist trap. Two strangers cross paths in a distant sci-fi future, searching for connection in a world that feels both alien and familiar. Explore colorful environments, meet its inhabitants, and discover a story told through sparse dialogue, pixel art, music, and the world itself.

Both games use exploration and environmental storytelling to let their characters and surroundings carry the narrative. Look closely to find small secrets, and experience each compact adventure from beginning to end in a single sitting.

A nostalgic experience, two full-color journeys that can also be played in vertical mode with touch controls to match the '90s feeling!
70010000138252.intro: Two strangers, two worlds, and two intimate stories about connection, loss, and the passage of time.
70010000138252.name: ERF + The Year After

70010000138254.description:
Bring the world around you to life with the power of color in Colorbound, a vibrant palette-platformer. Join Anku on a heartfelt journey to reunite his late grandfather’s band by using color to shape the world around you. As you journey, you’ll solve puzzles, uncover secrets, and help a family of musicians come together one last time.

A Farewell Tour For Your Grandfather
Anku’s grandfather was a beloved musician to his people, but his band has long since scattered/  Now, with only memories and a special gift, Anku must journey across diverse landscapes to find the missing musicians, reignite their passions, and give his grandfather the farewell he deserves. Along the way, you’ll use color to brighten the canvas, turning obstacles into opportunities, and puzzles into music!

Change Colors to Change The World
