In Colorbound, you will collect colors onto your palette which can be used to overcome logic and light platforming puzzles. From lush forests to forgotten cities, Colorbound’s overworld offers a variety of mind-bending puzzles that span a variety of locations and aesthetics.

Finding Balance
Not all colors behave the same way. Some may be lighter, allowing objects to float away once painted, while other colors are heavier and may drop down. Using this to your advantage can help Anku cross the treacherous terrain to reach his destination.

Rooted in Culture
Colorbound draws inspiration from the Aymara culture of the Andes, blending traditional music and art styles with an indie-gem-inspired puzzle platformer experience. Informed by Panpipe Studio’s Chilean culture and heritage, Colorbound celebrates the rich culture of South America while delivering a universal story of love, loss, and the power of art.
70010000138254.intro: In Colorbound, color is more than just hue.
70010000138254.name: Colorbound – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition

70010000138274.description:
Enter a dangerous pixel-art world where survival depends on how far you are willing to transform. Take control of a strange creature and fight through relentless waves of enemies in a fast-paced 2D roguelite where every run brings new dangers, new choices, and new opportunities to evolve.

Collect experience, discover powerful mutations, and reshape your creature with every decision you make. Combine passive effects, active abilities, and physical mutations to create unique builds that can completely change the way you fight and survive. Experiment with different combinations, adapt to unexpected challenges, and find the mutations that turn your creature into an unstoppable force.

Key Features:
	•	Powerful Mutations: Combine 60+ passive, 30+ active, and 30+ physical mutations to create unique builds.
	•	Transform Your Creature: Physical mutations change your character's appearance and shape the way you play.
	•	Fast-Paced Roguelite Action: Fight through intense enemy waves in challenging 2D survival runs.
	•	4 Unique Maps: Explore dangerous pixel-art environments filled with different enemies and challenging encounters.
	•	Every Run Is Different: Adapt to random mutation choices and experiment with new builds every run.


Evolve with every battle, discover powerful combinations, and push your mutant beyond its limits. Adapt to the chaos, embrace the mutations, and survive long enough to become the ultimate creature.
70010000138274.intro: Can you build the perfect mutant and survive every dangerous stage?
70010000138274.name: Crab Evolution Roguelite

70010000138314.description: X-Force Genesis 2 is a fast-paced space shooter that follows the story of four pilots on a mission to stop General Lava from invading Planet Genesis.
70010000138314.intro: In this thrilling vertical scrolling game, you will revisit the great classics from the golden age of 8 and 16-bit gaming.
70010000138314.name: X-Force Genesis 2

70010000138341.description:
Jhow is a brilliant, tech-obsessed piglet whose peaceful farm life is shattered when an ominous corporate truck kidnaps all his friends.

Refusing to be tomorrow's breakfast, Jhow heads to his secret workshop, fires up his custom-built jetpack, and takes to the skies as the ultimate high-speed hero: Big Jhow Jet!

In this frantic, physics-driven action-arcade game, momentum is everything. Blast out of a cannon and navigate a sky filled with targeted missiles, pigeon bombers, and ground-patrolling Bacon-Bots.

Manage your fuel, bounce off the asphalt, and master aerodynamics to reach maximum velocity.

Out of gas? The run isn't over! Use your last breath to initiate a heroic on-foot Sprint Dash, or rely on crazy power-ups and loyal helpers to keep the flight going!


Key Features:

Insane Power-Ups: Transform into an unstoppable wrecking ball with the Bacon-Ball, or drink the Oink-Bull to grow energy wings and zigzag through enemies at supersonic speeds!

The Ultimate Upgrade Machine: Collect coins and gear to unlock over 140 upgrades! Improve your jetpack thrust, ground friction, crash resistance, and summon friendly birds and balloons.

Cinematic Rescues: Perform mid-air skill shots to shatter Hover-Cages, rescue your kidnapped piglet friends, and earn massive bounties.

Beware the Skies: Fly too high and an Alien Ship will zap your speed! Balance your altitude to survive.

Feel the Impact: Fully optimized for Nintendo Switch! Experience every blast, bounce, and supersonic warp with high-definition, custom-tuned HD Rumble.

A pig, a jetpack, a factory. The rest is chaos!
70010000138341.intro: Prepare for takeoff! Strap on your homemade jetpack, defy gravity, and unleash total chaos to save your friends from the dreaded Bacon Factory!
70010000138341.name: Big Jhow Jet

70010000138357.description:
Guide a clever snail through a series of challenging puzzles where careful planning and smart decisions are the keys to success. Find the correct path through each level and overcome increasingly tricky obstacles as you put your problem-solving skills to the test.

Every puzzle presents a new challenge. Think ahead, study your surroundings, and choose your moves carefully to help the snail reach its destination. What begins as a simple journey soon becomes a demanding test of logic and patience.

Take your time, experiment with different approaches, and discover the solution to every puzzle. Can you master every challenge and complete the journey?

Features:

Challenging puzzle gameplay focused on logic and planning.
Guide a snail through a variety of tricky levels.
Overcome obstacles and discover the correct path.
Puzzles that become increasingly challenging as you progress.
Simple gameplay that's easy to understand but difficult to master.
Test your patience, strategy, and problem-solving skills.
Replay levels and search for the perfect solution.
70010000138357.intro: Guide a clever snail through challenging puzzles where every move matters. Find the right path, overcome tricky obstacles, and put your problem-solving skills to the test!
70010000138357.name: Snail Puzzle Quest

70010000138412.description:
How many club stars can you bring together?

Remember those school days when every team had its own style? This charming montage puzzle brings the energy of high school activities to life with colorful illustrations of girls devoted to their clubs.

Each picture is split into three horizontal panels. Slide the panels into place and assemble the club girl shown by the prompt.

How to play:
• Check the prompt
• Slide the three panels horizontally until the picture connects
• Complete the club girl shown to clear the stage

The simple controls are easy to pick up, even if you are new to puzzle games. Matching the mixed-up panels and seeing the picture snap together is wonderfully satisfying.

Play on your own at your pace, or share the fun with viewers during a gameplay stream. It is also a great choice for a quick break or a little brain-training time.

Perfect for fans of school-life club themes, cute illustrations, puzzle games, short play sessions, and observation challenges.

How many different club girls can you assemble? Give it a try and enjoy that satisfying moment when every panel falls into place!
70010000138412.intro: Can you line up every team?
70010000138412.name: Youth Assemble! High School Girl Montage

70010000138418.description:
Ready for a relaxing little puzzle break?

Enjoy charming illustrations of laid-back girls who look great in glasses, from quiet reading time to relaxing at a café or taking a nap. Compare the two pictures and find the subtle difference hiding among the details.

How to play:
・Look closely at the two pictures side by side
・Find one spot in the picture on the right that differs from the left
・Tap the difference to clear the puzzle

The simple rules make it easy to enjoy, even if you are new to puzzle games. It is perfect for a quick break, a little downtime, or whenever you want to slow down and relax.

A great fit for:
・Players who love cute girls with glasses
・Fans of cozy, soothing illustrations
・Spot-the-difference fans
・Anyone looking for a quick casual game
・Players who want to test their observation skills

Take your time admiring each girl’s expressions and gestures, or race to find the answer as quickly as you can. Enjoy a relaxing solo session, or turn the search into a fun challenge for a livestream audience.
70010000138418.intro: Take a cozy break with cute glasses girls
70010000138418.name: Glasses Waifu: Cozy Spot the Difference

70010000138425.description: You were once a dedicated toycrafter, spending hours working alone in your workshop. But recently you lost your passion for your trade. Working on small toys no longer satisfies you. You shifted your focus towards something more grand, more robust. Grab a doll, grab your tools, and get to work. Cut doll parts, paint them and attach them to build unique and unsettling sculptures. In your workshop, you are alone, you are safe. No need to look over your shoulder. Any anomalies you see or hear are just your imagination. Also: Lock the door before leaving. There are no abominations chasing you. No monsters screaming in your ears. Nothing can even hurt you. This is simply... an experience. A study of isolation. What does it feel like to be an artist so consumed by your craft that you lose your grip on reality. While working, you will: Interact with the environment. Pick up, drop, move things around. Use tools to cut, paint and attach doll parts. Build a collection of unique and unsettling sculptures. Keep your workshop tidy and organized. Not engage with any anomalies. Lock the door before leaving.
70010000138425.intro: You lost your passion for crafting small toys. You shifted your focus to working on larger dolls.
70010000138425.name: TOYCRAFTER

70010000138430.description:
It is Halloween night and you have the good chair. A candle burns on the desk, rain drums outside, and every so often lightning throws the whole room white. In front of you: a grid with numbers along its edges. Fill in the right squares and a shape shows through, like frost wiped off a picture. If you know these as picture cross or griddlers, you already know the dance.



Every grid you crack hands you a piece of a bigger picture. Set it on the paper, turn it until it fits, press it home. A gentle tutorial teaches the rules from nothing. No timers, no lives, nothing to lose but the evening, and your progress is saved wherever you stop, so play for five minutes or stay until the candle is out.
70010000138430.intro:
Light a candle, solve a nonogram, and watch the picture come alive.
Fifteen haunted scenes are waiting to wake up.
70010000138430.name: Solid Void - Halloween Nonograms

70010000138473.description:
Embark on a colorful pixel-art adventure where platforming, exploration, and puzzles come together. Make your way through challenging levels, collect the fruits you need, activate levers, and open the doors blocking your path.

Every level is filled with obstacles that will put your timing and precision to the test. Jump across platforms, avoid sharp spikes, escape deadly saws and fire traps, and watch out for enemies as you search for a safe route to the finish.

Use trampolines and moving platforms to reach new areas, collect the required items, and figure out how to progress through each stage. As you advance, the challenges become more demanding and require increasingly careful movement.

Features:

Colorful 2D pixel-art platforming.
Explore levels filled with puzzles and obstacles.
Collect fruits to activate mechanisms and progress.
Use levers to unlock doors and discover the path forward.
Avoid spikes, saws, fire traps, enemies, and other hazards.
Navigate moving platforms and use trampolines to reach new areas.
Test your timing, precision, and problem-solving skills.
Complete each level by finding your way to the endpoint.
70010000138473.intro: Embark on a colorful pixel-art adventure filled with puzzles and platforming challenges!
70010000138473.name: Pixel Path Quest

70010000138479.description:
The Fountain of Youth was hidden away. Nonetheless, it is fated that a Usurper will slay the Ageless and unearth it once more.

FOUNTAINS is a soulslike action-RPG built around fighting your way through a maze-like interconnected, seamless world. You'll take the role of a hooded stranger, recently imprisoned by a tyrannical regime. Will you escape and uncover the mysteries of this war-torn empire?

Demanding, but fair combat
Tight, responsive combat puts every tool and tactic in your arsenal to the test, rewarding precision and quick thinking. Your enemies will hit hard and punish hesitation, turning each fight into an intense back-and-forth where the tide of battle can shift in an instant. Adjustable difficulty settings let you feel that thrill at exactly the intensity you crave, no matter your experience.

Exploration that rewards curiosity
The world of FOUNTAINS is one, seamless, giant dungeon. It is a tightly packed labyrinth which twists and loops back on itself. You'll always discover something new:  items, powers and upgrades to unlock new parts of the world.

Leave Your Mark
FOUNTAINS features an online message system. Leave hints throughout the world to help out your fellow players, or trick them into doing something foolish!

- Souls-like action combat set in a metroidvania-style interconnected world.
- Find new abilities and tools to help you to defend yourself and to traverse the world.
- Rich dark fantasy lore told through exploration and environmental storytelling.
- Online message system for community interaction.
- Secrets are everywhere, so always keep an eye out!
70010000138479.intro: Master high-skilled combat and explore a vast, interconnected world.
70010000138479.name: FOUNTAINS - Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition

70010000138517.description:
Cute or creepy, nature can be full of surprises. Can you tell what may be poisonous and what is safe?

This casual two-choice quiz challenges your knowledge and instincts with images inspired by animals, plants, mushrooms, and other natural curiosities.

・Look closely at each image
・Choose whether it is poisonous or not

Don’t let a cute appearance or a scary look fool you. Every question is a chance to test what you know, discover surprising facts, and sharpen your nature knowledge.

It’s easy to pick up for a quick mental refresh, and fun to play with friends or an audience by guessing the answer together. Ready to become a poison expert?
70010000138517.name: Toxic or Safe? Dr. Poison's Dangerous Quiz

70010000138528.description:
Speed across sun-soaked island resorts in this fast-paced top-down rally racer. Tear through coastal roads, palm-lined circuits, and resort backstreets as you climb the ranks to become the ultimate rally champion.

Features:

- Island Resort Circuits – Race through vibrant tropical courses inspired by beautiful island resorts
- Full Car Roster – Choose your ride from a selection of unique vehicles
- 3 Game Modes – Compete in multiple ways to prove your skill
- Garage Customization – Personalize your car to match your style
- Podium Finishes – Battle for the top spot after every race
- Local Leaderboard – Chase the best times and challenge your friends
- Save System – Jump back in anytime, right where you left off
- French & English Language Support

Grab the wheel, hit the coast, and race your way to victory in the most scenic rally on the island!
70010000138528.intro: Race through paradise. Own the podium.
70010000138528.name: Top Down Rally Racing

70010000138546.description:
Unlock total puppy mayhem in this hilarious first-person 3D dog simulator! Forget being a "good boy" - let's create chaos! Pull off wild pranks and turn Granny's calm home into a disaster zone!

Take control of a mischievous hound from a dog’s-eye perspective. Your goal? Cause non-stop chaos without getting caught! Shred couch cushions. Snatch sausages from the kitchen counter. Knock over pricey TVs. Terrorize the spoiled cat. Earn chaos points, explore the neighborhood, unlock cute puppy breeds, and prove you are the ultimate troublemaker on four legs.

KEY FEATURES:
• First-Person 3D Dog Simulator: Experience the world from a floor-level puppy perspective. Run, jump, bark, bite, and cause havoc with playful physics!
• Funny Home Mayhem: Break pottery, rip furniture, spill drinks, and create a mess in every room.
• Prank Granny: Execute sneaky pranks, grab tasty food from the table, set off noisy traps, and outwit the furious household.
• Suburban Sandbox Exploration: Step out of the living room and into the backyard or city streets. You’ll find hidden secrets, fun mini-games, and new places to dig.
• Unlock Cute Breeds & Custom Styles: Use your chaos points to unlock various dog breeds, quirky accessories, unique fur patterns, and awesome puppy bonuses!
70010000138546.name: Bad Dog

70010000138570.description:
The protagonist, Seiichi Makita, suddenly finds himself lost in an unknown world—a mysterious place free from all the injustices of ordinary life. Humans, animals, and plants alike are free to live as they wish in this seemingly ideal world.

Having lost most of his memories, Seiichi sets out in search of a way back to his own world alongside Yuki, a cat-eared girl he meets there. As their journey continues, fragments of his lost memories gradually begin to return. And beyond them lies a truth Seiichi could never have imagined...

Includes Japanese voice acting.
70010000138570.intro: Beyond lost memories, I find you.
70010000138570.name: Innocent Memory

70010000138598.description:
Cargo Rail Tycoon is a trading and train-driving game set on the railways of Michigan. You are a freight entrepreneur with one simple goal: turn a small convoy and a modest bankroll into a rail empire. Buy goods where they are cheap, load your wagons, and haul them across the map to the towns that need them most — profit is made on the journey, not on the spot.

But this isn't a game you play from a spreadsheet. Every trip puts you in the cab. You drive the train yourself: open the throttle on the straights, ease off through the curves — brake too late and you derail — and read the signs at each switch to reach the right town. Bandits may block the tracks; stop and haggle the ransom down, or pay the price. Arrive fast for a bonus, but arrive at the right destination or lose out.

Between journeys you negotiate face-to-face with each town's station master. Haggle their margin down before you trade — offer low, and watch them squirm — then choose your next destination wisely and roll out again. Twenty-six towns are waiting, and the farther north you push, the bigger the rewards for those willing to travel.

Turn cargo into cash, cash into a bigger convoy, and a bigger convoy into a fortune — just don't go bankrupt on the way.

Key features

-Trade across 26 towns — a living supply-and-demand economy where prices rise and fall. Find the routes, corner the goods, grow your cash.
-Drive every train — first-person rail journeys where speed, curves, braking and route choices are all yours. Go too fast and you derail; take the wrong turn and you arrive at the wrong town.
-Haggle every deal — negotiate the station master's margin down with a multi-round back-and-forth. Push too hard and he'll dig in.
-Bandit roadblocks — stop and negotiate the ransom, or plough through and pay for it.
-Build your convoy — buy wagons matched to your cargo and expand your train as your business grows.
-A fresh route every trip — procedurally generated railways with curves, bridges, rivers and scenery, and a destination that can lie straight ahead, left or right — follow the signs.
-Explore the whole map — the far-north towns pay the best prices, rewarding the boldest hauls.
70010000138598.intro: Drive the train. Build the empire.
70010000138598.name: Cargo Rail Tycoon

70010000138630.description:
Humans invaded a massive galactic ship and nearly wiped out an ancient arachnid species. But one hatchling survived...

Now you are the last hope of your kind.

Explore the abandoned sections of the colossal spacecraft, hunt space insects and invaders, consume your prey, and evolve from a helpless creature into a deadly predator.

Each level takes you to a new part of the ship, featuring unique environments, biomes, traps, and enemies. Use your surroundings to survive, grow stronger, and unlock new abilities.

Features:
- Play as a unique alien arachnid creature.
- Feed on space creatures to grow and evolve.
- Explore a vast abandoned galactic ship filled with diverse biomes.
- Experience fast-paced 2D side-scrolling action with continuous evolution.
- Fight those who exterminated your species and reclaim your home.
70010000138630.intro:
strategic moves
eat everyone
use tentacles
70010000138630.name: Omni Growth

70010000138663.description:
Korean Rail Celesti Express KTX Seoul–Busan is a railway simulation game built on real cab-view footage of Korea's high-speed rail.
Take the driver's seat of a KTX and run the Gyeongbu High-Speed Line from Seoul Station to Busan Station — about 417 km at up to 300 km/h — plus a bonus course on the newest Suseo high-speed route from Daejeon to Dongtan.
The second title in the Korean Rail Celesti Express series, following ITX-MAUM Taebaek Line.
________________________________________
Key Features
• Korea's flagship high-speed line, filmed for real
o About 3 hours 6 minutes of driving filmed from an actual KTX cab: Seoul – Gwangmyeong – Osong – Daejeon – Dongdaegu – Busan, and Daejeon – Osong – Pyeongtaek-Jije – Dongtan.
o 8 courses split by station, or run the whole line in one sitting.
o Tunnels, viaducts, the Han River crossing and Korea's countryside at 300 km/h.
• Control System
o Accelerate, cruise, brake and stop like a real driver. On-time arrival and precise stopping position decide your rank.
o Section Driving Mode, Full Driving Mode and View Mode.
o Supports Zuiki's Mascon for Nintendo Switch controller.
• Real scenery, real speed
o Speed data is derived from the footage itself, so every acceleration and every braking curve matches what the camera saw.
________________________________________
Recommended for:
• Fans of railways and train driving
• Players who want to travel across Korea from Seoul to Busan in a game
• Users who prefer realistic simulations
70010000138663.intro: Drive a real KTX from Seoul to Busan! A simulation game built on actual cab-view footage — just work the accelerator and brake levers and cross Korea at 300 km/h in high definition.
70010000138663.name: Korean Rail Celesti Express KTX Seoul-Busan

70010000138777.description:
Turn your zoo enclosure into the ultimate comedy stage in this hilarious first-person 3D panda simulator! Forget sleeping all day - take control of a mischievous bear, prank unsuspecting tourists, and create playful physics sandbox chaos!

You might be behind the exhibit glass, but that won't stop the fun! Fling bamboo at surprised zoo visitors, shake the viewing barriers, tumble across the yard, and complete funny quests for quirky animal neighbors like a grumpy rhino. Solve escape-style mini-games, unlock silly tricks, and keep the zookeepers completely baffled!

KEY FEATURES:
• First-Person 3D Panda Simulator: Experience life from a playful bear’s eye level. Watch your fluffy paws grab items, push obstacles, and roll around your 3D enclosure!
• Prank the Zoo Tourists: Keep the crowds laughing and startled by tossing food, making funny gestures, and pulling off goofy stunts right at the viewing glass.
• Quirky Animal Neighbor Quests: Talk to and help your neighboring exhibit buddies, including running funny errands for a grumpy, demanding rhino.
• Fun Physics & Escape Minigames: Tackle lighthearted obstacle challenges, goofy enclosure breakout attempts, and interactive sandbox puzzles.
• Unlock Silly Abilities & Tricks: Earn points from your daily mischief to unlock ridiculous moves, funny animations, and new ways to cause zoo anarchy!
70010000138777.intro: Bamboo is Gone. Panda is Here.
70010000138777.name: Angry Panda

70010000138853.description: DEEP ROCK GALACTIC: SURVIVOR is a single player survivor-like auto-shooter. Take on hordes of lethal aliens, mine riches, and unlock powerful upgrades to survive, as you wield the full arsenal of Deep Rock Galactic. It's one dwarf against all of Planet Hoxxes!
70010000138853.name: Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor - Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition

70010000138889.description:
From Nightdive Studios, SiN: Reloaded is a completely remastered experience of the 1998 shooter from Ritual Entertainment. This diamond-in-the-rough, story-driven FPS features memorable characters, horrific enemies, and a devastating arsenal that pushed the Quake II Engine to its limits.

Enter a near-future dystopian world as security consultant Colonel John R. Blade as you take on the seductively evil Doctor Elexis Sinclaire. When Elexis, the CEO of SinTEK Industries, begins injecting the streets with a DNA-altering drug, it's time to reassess the laws of morality. As Blade, you've made a religion out of fighting crime. Now you're going to make Elexis pay for her sins by taking on her unholy army of genetically-engineered mutants.

SiN was celebrated for introducing a groundbreaking amount of interactivity in every level. Hack your way into computer terminals using DOS-style code, use  elevators and security cameras to wreak havoc, you can even zip around in a forklift, patrol boat and a helicopter. Your actions have consequences, creating  branching paths as the game progresses. SiN also helped to pioneer the ability to knock weapons out of an opponent's hands and take area-specific damage from their attacks.

SiN: Reloaded includes the Wages of SiN extra mission pack, where you take on a diabolical mafia boss with a new army of dangerous mutants. Both games have been optimized using the KEX Engine to play on modern systems. The graphics throughout have been beautifully remastered with new textures, control schemes have been modernized, and maps have been improved with Nightdive’s established precision.

Features
Play the original SiN and the SiN: Wages of Sin extra mission pack, optimized using the KEX Engine.
Beautifully remastered graphics with HD textures and models, (up to) 60 FPS, anti-aliasing, and upgraded 2D screens and menu art.
Overhauled control schemes and modernized UI.
Improved maps throughout the game.
Swap between remastered visuals and the original SiN Gold version.
Higher resolution Zak Belika tracks mixed/engineered by Chris Mock.
70010000138889.name: SiN Reloaded: Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000138941.description:
Deliver packages across the African savanna in a charming puzzle adventure where every move matters. Take control of a hardworking rhino courier and find the right way to deliver each package to its destination.

Push packages through carefully designed stages, navigate around obstacles, and think ahead before making your next move. A simple decision can determine whether you successfully complete the delivery or need to reconsider your strategy.

With no need to rush, you can take your time studying each puzzle and searching for the perfect solution. The challenges become increasingly demanding as you progress, putting your logic, planning, and problem-solving skills to the test.

Explore a colorful pixel-art world, master over 100 handcrafted puzzles, and prove that even the trickiest deliveries can reach their destination!

Features:

Sokoban-inspired puzzle gameplay focused on careful planning.
More than 100 handcrafted puzzles to solve.
Deliver packages as a determined rhino courier.
Explore a colorful African savanna setting.
Increasingly challenging puzzles that test your logic.
No timers — solve every puzzle at your own pace.
Simple mechanics that are easy to understand and challenging to master.
Charming pixel-art presentation and relaxing puzzle experience.
70010000138941.intro: Deliver packages across the colorful savanna in a charming puzzle adventure! Plan every move carefully, overcome tricky obstacles, and help a determined rhino complete each delivery.
70010000138941.name: Rhino Delivery

70010000138960.description:
Golf Up Oasis is a fun-loaded golf game you can play with up to 4 friends in several game modes. In Tournament mode, you can pick between the Classic or Points options, in which you earn points by getting good results in the Holes and making quick decisions for bigger bonuses.

You will also be able to play solo in Arcade mode and compare your score in the online ranking with that of your friends and players from around the world.

Features:
-A variety of holes and game modes.
-Take the wind into account when hitting the ball with effects.
-Easy to play, hard to master.
-Online Ranking.
70010000138960.intro: Enjoy Golf Up Oasis with friends and family!
70010000138960.name: Golf Up Oasis

70010000138969.description:
Dive into a colorful and relaxing puzzle game where every move counts! Sort colorful liquids between bottles until each bottle contains just one color. Plan your moves carefully, think ahead, and enjoy the satisfaction of solving each puzzle.
With charming hand-drawn backgrounds, vibrant colors, and increasingly challenging levels, Bottle Logic Puzzle offers a delightful way to unwind while putting your logical thinking to the test.
Game Features:
- Colorful liquid-sorting puzzles that are easy to learn but challenging to master.
- Increasingly challenging levels that test your logic and planning skills.
- Beautiful hand-drawn backgrounds and charming visual themes.
- Simple, intuitive controls for a smooth puzzle-solving experience.
- Helpful hints when you need a little guidance.
- Relaxing gameplay with no rush — solve puzzles at your own pace.
Whether you have a few minutes to spare or want to enjoy a longer puzzle session, Bottle Logic Puzzle is a colorful little challenge for your brain!
70010000138969.intro: Pour, sort, and solve in Bottle Logic Puzzle!
70010000138969.name: Bottle Logic Puzzle

70010000138987.description:
Astral Ascent is a 2D platformer rogue-lite game set in a modern fantasy world. As one of 4 Heroes with very different personalities, you must escape from the Garden, an astral prison guarded by 12 powerful and vicious bosses, the Zodiacs.

CREATE YOUR OWN PLAYSTYLE
Unlock dozens of unique spells for your 4 distinct characters. Optimize your own build or try out new ones to take down 12 powerful bosses. Get stronger with time to match up with your foes. Each run will test your skills and your reactivity.

TWELVE ALMIGHTY BOSSES TO FACE
The Zodiacs are 12 experienced guardians dispatched over 4 gorgeous worlds. They’ll bring to the battlefield unique attacks, abilities, and patterns, backstories to uncover, and reasons to be fighting you. Get yourself warned!

FOUR PLAYABLE CHARACTERS
Unique characters. Unique weapons. Unique ways to play.
Ayla: The sole survivor of her guild of assassins, she uses her twin daggers to eliminate her enemies before they can react. Her speed and proficiency are unmatched.
Kiran: This orphan learned life the hard way. He uses his strength to deliver attacks powerful enough to create shockwaves. Brutal.
Calie: This talented sculptor wants her freedom back. She will use her magical gemstones to pierce enemy defenses and shred them to bits. She is unforgiving.
Octave: Trained by a powerful witch, this young fighter summons ethereal guns to attack his foes. When needed, he can conjure bigger weapons as well. Lethal in all cases.

A STORY THAT OPENS UP, ONE PIECE AT A TIME
Astral Ascent is a rogue-lite infused with narration. Replayability is part of our story which will be unraveled piece by piece. As you get stronger, you will discover more about the characters, their motivations, and the secrets of the world they’re trapped in.

LOCAL CO-OP
The weight of destiny is too heavy to carry by yourself? Don’t worry and bring a friend to play in our two-player co-op mode. Fight and crush your enemies together in local co-op!

A VAST, COLORFUL FANTASY WORLD WAITING TO BE EXPLORED
Dash across gigantic landscapes. Explore original and hand-crafted areas. Discover the world created by our artists, with a gorgeous art and frame-by-frame animation.
70010000138987.intro: Face the almighty Twelve Zodiacs in this lightning fast rogue-lite!
70010000138987.name: Astral Ascent – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000139021.description:
Think you know classic art? There is always another fascinating detail waiting to be discovered.

Explore the world of 19th-century French painting through a fun four-choice quiz. Learn about the stories, ideas, and surprising trivia behind masterpieces familiar from art books and museums.

How to play:
・Read each question carefully
・Choose an answer from four options
・After a correct answer, read a detailed explanation about the painting's background

No art history degree is needed. Hint features make it easy for beginners to join in, while every question offers a chance to learn something new.

Perfect for art lovers, museum fans, trivia enthusiasts, and anyone who enjoys a quick four-choice quiz. Challenge yourself, build your art knowledge, and enjoy sharing the fun with friends or a livestream audience!
70010000139021.intro: What secrets hide in famous paintings?
70010000139021.name: Masters of Art: 19th-Century French Painting Quiz

70010000139030.description:
Guide Medusa through a strange and minimalist world where platforming and puzzle-solving come together in an emotional journey about isolation, identity, and escape.

Manipulate falling blocks, create new paths, and use the environment to overcome obstacles as you move through a series of carefully designed stages. Each puzzle requires observation, timing, and thoughtful positioning to reach the way forward.

As the journey unfolds, short story moments reveal more about Medusa’s inner thoughts and the sadness she carries. The simple visual style keeps the focus on the puzzles, the atmosphere, and the character’s struggle to find freedom.

Features:

Minimalist 2D puzzle-platforming gameplay.
Manipulate falling blocks to create paths and solve challenges.
Guide Medusa through increasingly demanding stages.
Combine timing, movement, and logical thinking.
Short narrative moments that reveal an emotional story.
Distinctive black-and-white visual style with selective color.
A compact, atmospheric adventure focused on puzzles and mood.
70010000139030.intro: Guide a lonely Medusa through minimalist platforming puzzles, manipulate falling blocks, and find a path forward in a strange, emotional journey about isolation and the hope of escape.
70010000139030.name: Cursed Gaze

70010000139108.description:
Get ready to experience a new fast food sensation! Create your own diner and grill your way to success. Create different recipes and offer your patrons a truly customized experience!

Think outside the box and experiment in the kitchen. Replace your meat patty with a fish fillet and tartare sauce, or a bacon, lettuce, and egg combo. You're limited only by your imagination!

And the fun doesn't stop with burgers. Create menus for side dishes, drinks, and desserts to really capture the hearts of your customers!

Just don't let your popularity go to your head. You'll need to manage your staff and train them to improve their skills. Before you know it, you'll be offering world-class customer service even during the lunchtime rush!

Keep the cash flowing, and you'll be able to open extra branches of your restaurant. Can you handle running several stores at once? Will you crush your rivals and take their territory for yourself?

Open your restaurant today and take the food industry by storm!
70010000139108.intro: Open your own diner and create custom burgers in this management sim game.
70010000139108.name: Burger Bistro Story – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000139136.description:
Marble FX is a match-3 bubble shooter game with a deliberately minimalist design. Simple, modern graphics keep the focus on the gameplay itself.
Unlock the shuffle gaming mode and generate your own levels with random calculated difficulty, marble waves, length and number of colors.
70010000139136.name: Marble FX

70010000139197.description:
You weren’t supposed to end up here.
One wrong step and reality is gone. Now you’re trapped inside the Backrooms — an endless maze of empty rooms, buzzing lights, dark corridors, and places that feel disturbingly familiar.
There is a way out. Somewhere.
Explore unsettling environments, search for clues, navigate confusing corridors, and stay alert. The deeper you go, the less you can trust what you see — and you may not be alone.
ESCAPE THE BACKROOMS
Find your way through a labyrinth where every corridor can lead deeper into the unknown. Pay attention to your surroundings and search for the path forward.
SURVIVE THE UNKNOWN
Silence doesn’t mean safety. Strange entities may be closer than you think. Know when to move, when to hide, and when to run.
EXPLORE LIMINAL WORLDS
Wander through eerie rooms, endless hallways, abandoned spaces, and surreal environments inspired by the unsettling atmosphere of the Backrooms.
STAY ALERT
Every corner can hide a clue, a new path… or something you wish you hadn’t found.
CAN YOU FIND THE EXIT?
Enter the Backrooms and discover how far you’re willing to go to escape.
70010000139197.intro:
Trapped. Alone. And something is watching you.
Explore the endless Backrooms, survive what lurks inside,
and find a way out before it finds you.
70010000139197.name: Backrooms: Escape

70010000139293.description:
Easy Fishing Simulator invites you to unwind by the water with the most accessible fishing experience yet.

Cast your line, wait for a bite, and reel in your catch - every step is designed to feel intuitive and rewarding, whether you're a fishing veteran or picking up a rod for the first time.

Simple, satisfying gameplay:
Cast, hook, and fight fish with easy-to-learn controls. Feel the tension on your line as you reel in everything from tiny minnows to trophy-sized catches.

Living waters:
Fish behave naturally - swimming, exploring, and reacting to your bait. Every species has its own personality, from cautious bottom feeders to aggressive predators chasing your lure.

Progress at your own pace:
Sell your catch, earn money, and upgrade your gear to reach new fishing spots and land bigger fish. Keep your favorites or release them back into the water - the choice is yours.

Relaxing by design
No pressure, no timers, no stress. Just you, the water, and the next big catch.

Grab your rod and cast your first line today.

Key features
- Easy-to-learn fishing controls, perfect for all ages
- Realistic fish behavior and multiple species to discover
- Catch, sell, and upgrade your equipment
- Relaxing, low-pressure gameplay
- Save your progress and keep building your collection
70010000139293.intro: Cast, catch, relax. Easy fishing fun for everyone.
70010000139293.name: Easy Fishing Simulator

70010000139412.description:
You are trapped in a place that looks familiar—but something is wrong.

Walk through a series of mysterious corridors and search for anomalies hidden in the environment. A painting may change. A door may appear where it shouldn't. A light may behave strangely. Something that was there before may suddenly be gone.

Pay attention to every detail.

If you spot an anomaly, turn back. If everything looks normal, keep moving forward. One wrong decision could send you deeper into the loop.

No Exit 9 features nine challenging levels, each filled with subtle changes, unsettling details, and unexpected events. The deeper you go, the harder it becomes to tell what is real and what has changed.

There is no map. No guide. No second chance to ignore what you see.

Observe your surroundings, remember what was there before, and trust your instincts.

Can you identify every anomaly and find your way out?

**Nine levels. Countless changes. One way out.**

Welcome to No Exit 9.
70010000139412.intro: Something has changed. Find the anomaly before it finds you.
70010000139412.name: No Exit 9

70010000139423.description:
Step into a city steeped in jazz-era glamour, where every room tells a story. Richly detailed interiors, cinematic camera angles and period styling bring each location to life, as if you've walked straight into a classic film.
Every scene is a puzzle waiting to be cracked. Search for cleverly hidden objects, follow chains of logic and interact with your surroundings. Any detail could be the key that unlocks the mystery.
At its heart lies a moving story of family, music and memory. Piece by piece, uncover what really happened to a legendary singer whose voice once filled the city's clubs.
Talk to a colourful cast of locals, weigh their conflicting accounts and slowly rebuild the truth about the past.
And you won't be searching alone. Your loyal dog is always by your side, sniffing out hidden clues, helping with the hunt and guiding you through the trickiest scenes.

The Collector’s Edition includes:
- 18 exclusive locations — unique levels with special sets of items and atmospheric retro-era details.
- 12 mini-games + 18 puzzles — balanced content for fans of detective riddles and hidden object searches.
- Music player — enjoy your favorite melodies anytime.

The Family Detective brings a gentle intellectual challenge, and gripping stories that stay with you.
No rush or stress, just a warm atmosphere, a loyal companion, and a mystery you’ll want to solve.
It’s the perfect format for a quiet evening alone or a leisurely family pastime.

Hidden Legacy is your personal retro-detective in the hidden object format, where every detail you find brings you closer to the main revelation.

Start your investigation today! The magnifying glass, notebook, and faithful dog are waiting for you!
70010000139423.intro: Grab your notebook and dive into the investigation!
70010000139423.name: The Family Detective: Hidden Legacy Collector's Edition

70010000139534.description:
Run, jump, dodge and push your speed to the limit!

In +1 Speed Cat, every step makes you faster! Race through colorful worlds, overcome tricky obstacles and build your speed as you play. The faster you run, the bigger your +Speed becomes!

Collect 10 unique Trails and discover their bonuses, or visit the Cat Shop to unlock 10 adorable cats with different colors and special speed bonuses. Find your favorite combination and see how fast you can go!

Your journey takes you across 3 exciting worlds, each with 5 challenging stages. Explore sweet candy hills, leap between floating islands and race across a neon city rooftop!

But how far will you go?

After each stage, you can take your hard-earned reward and return safely to the hub—or keep running and risk it all for a much bigger reward. The further you go, the greater the challenge and the greater the prize!

Build your speed. Master the obstacles. Collect them all. And never stop running!
70010000139534.intro: RUN, GET FASTER, RISK IT ALL!
70010000139534.name: +1 Speed Cat

70010000139627.description:
Open a new chapter in your favorite series and once again immerse yourself in an atmosphere of warmth, comfort, and relaxed item searching.
Sweet Home Look and Find 7 is a rest for the soul, attention to detail, and joy in every found object.

The series welcomes you with updated graphics and fresh artistic direction. Each location has become brighter, more volumetric, and more detailed, while preserving that warm aesthetic you love so much.

18 main hidden object locations and 18 bonus ones await you – cozy houses, gardens, verandas, and lively interiors filled with details and mood. Each scene is handcrafted and gives a sense of true home warmth.
The classic item search has become even more comfortable and diverse. A cute raccoon replaces the usual dogs and cats, becoming your new fluffy guide through cozy interiors.
Relax, explore, and enjoy the process without rush or stress.

The game features 12 mini-games and 12 bonus mini-games that gently train your attention and logic.
The perfect balance between relaxation and an engaging challenge.

Every moment matters here: the morning light in a room, neatly arranged items, and a sense of harmony.

Collector’s Edition includes:
-18 bonus hidden object scenes
-12 additional mini-games
-Exclusive content for deeper immersion
-Pleasant bonuses for true fans of the series
70010000139627.name: Sweet Home: Look and Find 7 Collector's Edition

70010000139720.description:
Kids Sudoku is a simple Sudoku-style puzzle game designed for children.

Instead of numbers, you can fill the grid with five different symbols.
Choose from fruits, animals, and more. You can also play using numbers.

◆ Rules
Complete the entire grid while making sure the same symbol does not appear more than once in the same row or column.

◆ Easy Controls
Simply select a cell and choose the symbol you want to place.
The simple controls make it easy for anyone to pick up and play.

◆ Choose Your Design
You can choose from different game designs.
Pick your favorite design and enjoy solving puzzles your way.

◆ Difficulty Levels
Choose from three difficulty levels: Easy, Normal, and Hard.
Start with Easy and work your way up as you get more comfortable.
The Hard level offers a satisfying challenge even for adults.

◆ Endless Puzzles
A new puzzle is automatically generated every time you play, so you can enjoy countless puzzles without running out.

Perfect for a quick break or a little time to spare.
Play together with your family, or take your time and solve puzzles at your own pace.
Enjoy a fun and relaxing Sudoku-style puzzle game for everyone.
70010000139720.intro:
5×5 Sudoku Puzzles for Kids
Endless puzzles generated automatically
Just the right level of challenge for kids and adults
70010000139720.name: Kids Sudoku

70010000139872.description:
High above the stars, an angel and a devil circle a gleaming board and fight the oldest argument there is — with clouds.

Take turns flying around the board's edge, pick a row or a column, and hurl your cloud in from either end. Your cloud lands on the first square and everything in its path slides along one place. Run out of room and the cloud at the far end is shoved clean off the edge, where it bursts in a shower of light.

Make a full line of your own clouds — across, down or corner to corner — and you win.

The catch is that nothing ever stays where you put it. Every throw your opponent makes can push your careful row apart, or nudge one of your own clouds into a line you never planned. A board that looks lost can turn in a single shove. There are no safe squares, only the ones your rival hasn't reached yet.

Two house rules keep the fight moving: nobody may play the same throw three times running, and nobody may answer a throw by shoving the same line straight back. No stalemates, no endless tug of war — just position, pressure and the nerve to commit.

Play your way

Set the board up how you like it before each match:

- Grid size — 3×3 for a quick knife fight, 4×4 and 5×5 for real strategy, or 6×6 for a long war of attrition
- Board starting fill — begin on an empty board at 0%, or dive straight into the chaos at 30%, 60% or 90% full
- Pick your side — take the angel's white clouds or the devil's thunderheads; your opponent takes the other
- Who plays — each side can be a player or the console, so play head to head, take on the machine, or sit back and watch two AIs fight it out
- Four levels of opponent

Beginner, Rookie, Experienced and Expert. Even the gentlest opponent thinks several moves ahead and sets traps of its own — the harder levels simply stop making mistakes. The Expert sees six moves deep and does not forgive a loose cloud.

Features

- One or two players, side by side on the same console
- Four board sizes and four starting fills — sixteen ways to set up a match
- Four difficulty levels with a genuinely thinking opponent
- Diagonals count, on every board size
- Your record against the console is kept for each board size
- Instant rematches — win, watch the board clear, and go again
70010000139872.name: Devil & Angel Sky Battle

70010000139902.description:
Welcome to the perfect early learning educational game for little kids, a colourful early learning Halloween game made especially for babies, toddlers and preschool children.

In this lovingly designed educational Halloween game, young children can discover the numbers from 1 to 10 through playful mini games that are simple, cheerful and easy to understand. The game features funny Halloween content, but that does not mean kids will not love to play and learn all through the year. Children can learn numbers, practise counting and hear spoken numbers in 14 selectable languages. They can listen, recognise the numbers on screen and say them out loud while playing.

All learning Halloween games can be played in different difficulty levels, making the experience suitable for young children, toddlers and preschoolers. As your child grows and becomes more confident, the game can grow with them, offering new challenges and keeping the learning experience fun, gentle and motivating for a longer time.

Pop the correct balloons in a funny balloon popping game, solve a farm conveyor-belt peg puzzle, roll the dice, find matching number cards, count cute animals and objects, and enjoy classic memory card games with charming motifs.

In the special number memory game, children can play against a funny animal opponent. The opponent’s skill automatically adapts to the child’s performance, keeping every match fair, friendly and fun.

There is also a playful side-scrolling truck game! Children drive a transport truck, collect numbered crates and jump over objects on the road. This turns number learning into a small action adventure that is easy to play and exciting for young children.

The different activities help children practise number recognition, counting, memory, first maths, concentration, hand-eye coordination and early logical thinking. Because every mini game teaches numbers in a different way, kids can repeat and strengthen what they learn without it feeling like homework.

Perfect for babies, toddlers, preschoolers and kindergarten children who want to learn numbers and different languages in a playful way on Nintendo Switch™.

Features:
Learn the numbers from 1 to 10
Spoken number learning in 14 selectable languages
Different difficulty levels for long-lasting learning fun
Grows with your child from baby and toddler age to preschool
Fun balloon popping game
First counting and maths activities
Farm conveyor-belt peg puzzle
Dice game, counting game and number memory
Classic memory card game with cute Halloween motifs
Adaptive animal opponent for friendly memory matches
Side-scrolling truck game with numbered crates
Playful practice for babies, toddlers, preschool and kindergarten children
Colourful, cheerful and child-friendly design

Thanks to the touchscreen controls of Nintendo Switch™, the game is simple, direct and child-friendly.
70010000139902.intro: A cheerful Halloween learning game for little kids with numbers 1 to 10. Count, balloons, play memory, solve farm puzzles and hear spoken numbers in 14 languages
70010000139902.name: 123 Halloween Early Learning Games for Kids, Toddlers, Babies 1+

Because every mini game teaches numbers in a different way, kids can repeat and strengthen what they learn without it feeling like homework.

70010000140002.description:
Welcome to MomoLAB, a mysterious facility where adorable creatures called Momolitos are born!

Explore seven colorful areas, gather different foods, and bring them back to the lab to feed your Momolitos. What they eat determines how they evolve, with more than 600 different forms waiting to be discovered.

Every Momolito begins as one of 14 different eggs, but what happens next is up to you. Experiment with different foods and combinations to discover cute, strange, wild, and unexpected evolutions.

Search each area for hidden resources, collect food through exploration and minigames, and return to MomoLAB to continue your research. Interact with your Momolitos, watch them grow, and record every new form you discover.

Can you uncover them all?

Features:
• Discover over 600 different Momolito forms
• Hatch Momolitos from 14 different types of eggs
• Explore seven unique areas filled with food, secrets, and surprises
• Collect ingredients through exploration and minigames
• Experiment with different foods to influence each Momolito's evolution
• Record your discoveries and work toward completing your collection
• Enjoy a colorful, cozy, and mysterious creature-collecting adventure
70010000140002.intro: Feed, evolve, and discover over 600 adorable Momolito forms!
70010000140002.name: Momolitos

70050000000183.description:
DLC Pack 1 "The Master Trials" includes the following:

Trial of the Sword

Visit a certain location to challenge the Trial of the Sword, where you must vanquish waves of enemies to progress from one room to the next. You will start this challenge completely bare, without any armor, equipment, or food items to aid you. Once you defeat all the enemies in a room, you can advance to the next. If you complete all 45 rooms, Link's mind and body will be strong enough to wield the Master Sword's full power and splendor any time the sword is usable!

Hero's Path Mode

A feature that allows you to view the path you've taken on your journey. It will record your journey for up to 200 hours of gameplay. Use this to find those shrines and Koroks that are still eluding you! You can even adjust the replay speed so you can manually select the pace you wish to watch your path unfold.

Master Mode

In Master Mode, most enemies you encounter will be one tier higher than they originally were. For example, where you would normally see red Bokoblins, you will now likely see Blue Bokoblins instead.

There is also a new top tier of enemies that don't appear in Normal Mode! Additionally, enemies will recover health if you stop attacking them, and they will also notice Link more easily, so you may need to make adjustments to your fighting strategies. You also might find enemies and treasure chests floating in the air! Use these locations to your advantage to score treasure or even recover stamina.

Travel Medallion

There is an item called the Travel Medallion hidden in a treasure chest somewhere. Place it at your current location and you will be able to travel there whenever you please. You can only register one location at a time, but this addition should aid you in your journey.

8 clothing items hidden in treasure chests

Items honoring the legacy of The Legend of Zelda series (Majora's Mask, Midna's Helmet, Tingle's Hood, Tingle's Shirt, Tingle's Tights, Phantom Helmet, Phantom Armor, and Phantom Greaves) will be hidden in 8 treasure chests scattered across Hyrule. There are hints to help you find these items hidden somewhere as well. Search for these hints and treasures while you journey across Hyrule!

Korok Mask

The Korok Mask is an item that will be hidden in a treasure chest somewhere in Hyrule, and unlike the 8 items mentioned above, this one has a special ability. When Link wears this mask, it will shake when a hidden Korok is nearby!
70050000000183.name: The Legend of Zelda™: Breath of the Wild DLC Pack 1

70050000000184.description:
"The Champions' Ballad" will include the following:

The Champions' Ballad

A mysterious voice beckons Link to challenge the Divine Beast Tamer's Trials. He must now prove himself by defeating enemies using the One-Hit Obliterator, conquering new Shrines, challenging a full dungeon, and overcoming many trials along the way. Once all challenges and trials have been bested, Link will obtain a new power known as the Master Cycle Zero!

Additionally, the bard Kass is traveling Hyrule to complete the unfinished song his teacher left behind. As Link and Kass chase their respective goals, Kass will share new original songs he wrote capturing lost memories of the four Champions and Zelda, previously unknown to Link. But that unfinished song... What could it be?

*To play The Champions' Ballad, you must first complete the Main Quest to free the four Divine Beasts.

9 clothing items hidden in treasure chests

Items honoring the legacy of The Legend of Zelda series will be hidden in 9 treasure chests scattered across Hyrule, including the Island Lobster Shirt, Ravio's Hood, Zant's Helmet, Phantom Ganon Skull, Phantom Ganon Armor, Phantom Ganon Greaves, and a Royal Guard outfit (complete with Royal Guard Cap, Royal Guard Uniform, and Royal Guard Boots).

Ancient Horse Gear

The Ancient Bridle will increase a horse's number of spurs while equipped. The Ancient Saddle will allow you to call your horse no matter how far away they are. Both of these items will appear in treasure chests somewhere in Hyrule.

70050000002681.description:
"THE BLOOD...I MUST HAVE THE BLOOD!"

Darkest Dungeon®: The Crimson Court is the first expansion for the award-winning grim and gothic RPG by Red Hook Studios. Crimson Court is a parallel campaign experienced alongside the main Darkest Dungeon content that will provide you with new challenges and variation at every difficulty level. The narrative grounding sheds some light on the Ancestor’s early days, and will be presented in the same style of cut-scenes you’ve seen elsewhere in the game.

The DLC is designed to be played alongside an existing campaign, or as a brand new one--your choice! The events and features will unlock over the course of play.

Features:
• A new hero class. “Awash in blood and delusion, they bear the burden of a thousand lifetimes.”
• A new dungeon region: The Courtyard
• A full faction of new deadly foes
• 5 new Bosses with some of the most complex and devious mechanics yet.
• A new wandering boss: The Fanatic
• Districts: 10 new buildings to upgrade your Hamlet
• Massive, sprawling maps with locked doors, prisoner rooms, and progress saves
• Lore-driven trinket sets for all heroes - with set bonuses!
70050000002681.name: Darkest Dungeon®: The Crimson Court

70050000002781.description:
The Shieldbreaker is a powerful ally in the fight to reclaim the Estate and banish the evil that squats in the Darkest Dungeon. A highly-tactical and solid damage dealing hero, she truly excels when countering monsters with high protection and those who guard their allies. Her movement, speed, and targeted abilities make her a valuable ally for dismantling intractable monster groups. Though relatively low health, the Shieldbreaker is yet highly survivable in short bursts thanks to her Aegis scales.

Features:
• New hero class: the Shieldbreaker
• Shieldbreaker class-specific trinkets, including a lore set
• 3 New Monsters - frightful illusions from the Shieldbreaker's origin, now slithering forward to infest the Estate
• New Consumable Item - Aegis Scale, providing a last bastion of protection for when a hero truly needs it.
70050000002781.name: Darkest Dungeon®: The Shieldbreaker

70050000004063.description: Play as an Octoling for the very first time in this large-scale downloadable content for the Splatoon™ 2 game! This full-on single-player adventure spans 80 missions starring Agent 8, a new character who awakens without her memories on a dark subway platform. Navigate this mysterious underground test facility in a desperate battle to reach the surface of Inkopolis. Escape from these twisted depths, and you’ll finally be able to join multiplayer* matches as an Octoling! You may think you know everything about the world of Splatoon, but these waters run deep, and so does the lore.

70050000004321.description:

Experience the thrilling storyline with up to 3 friends in an epic 4 player local co-op battle. Are you up to the task?

70050000007481.description:
Some hateful shard of alien origin has streaked through the night sky, crashing into the old Miller’s farm on the outskirts of the Hamlet!  Those unfortunate enough to witness the Comet’s arrival have been blinded by what they can only describe as a shifting, ephemeral hue of damnably abrasive intensity.  There has been no word from the farm in a fortnight, save for the unearthly groaning that echoes from the ruin of the mill…

“When men shake hands with time, time crushes them like tumblers; little pieces of glass.”
― Abu al-Ala al-Ma'arri

Features
* New region: The Farmstead!
* Endless Quest: Survive as long as you can while getting lost in time and space, confronted by unending waves of enemies new and old, pushing ever closer to the crash site of the Comet.
* Twisted new trinkets, available for purchase from the Jeweler. Put your gold away—he trades only in Comet Shards!
* All-New Enemy Faction: The Miller and his loyal workmen have become eerie husks of their former selves.
* 3 new bosses - The Miller, The Thing From the Stars, and the Comet itself!
* New Curios help keep your party in fighting shape as you face the endless hordes!
* Expand your Hamlet with 4 new District buildings and reap their benefits.
* New Quirks, with unique and powerful effects!
* Our biggest soundtrack addition yet from Stuart Chatwood
70050000007481.name: Darkest Dungeon®: The Color of Madness

70050000007482.description:
A celebrated competitive sharpshooter, The Musketeer arrives in the Hamlet, determined to prove her skill after a disappointing tournament. She aims to become a legend in hunting circles by putting her skills to the test against the terrifying beasts and unnameable abominations that roam the Ancestor's Estate!

Features
* New hero class: The Musketeer (mechanically identical to Arbalest)
* Musketeer class-specific trinkets.
70050000007482.name: Darkest Dungeon®: The Musketeer

70050000007543.description:

70050000007546.description:
Amanitore leads Nubia in Sid Meier’s Civilization VI! Nubia’s ranged units are strong, easy to build and quick promote, and they can use their unique Nubian Pyramid improvement to boost the construction and yield of districts. If you want to build a strong foundation early in the game for success, then Nubia is the right civ for you.

Includes the Nubian Civilization with Amanitore, the Pitati Archer unique unit, Nubian Pyramid unique improvement, and the new Jebel Barkal Wonder.

• Civ Unique Ability: Nubia gets bonus production towards Ranged units, and all Ranged units gain combat experience faster. Mines provide extra production over strategic resources, and extra gold over luxury resources.

• Leader Unique Ability: Amanitore gives Nubia bonus production towards building Districts, which can be boosted further if there is a Nubian Pyramid adjacent to the City Center.

• Unique Unit: The Pitati Archer replaces the Ancient Era Archer. It is stronger and faster than the ancient Archer and upgrades to Crossbowman.

• Unique Infrastructure: The Nubian Pyramid can be built on Desert, Desert Hills, or Floodplains, and provides Faith, as well as additional yields based on the adjacent District, or Food for the City Center.

New “Gifts of the Nile” Scenario:
• Choose Nubia or Egypt as you compete against the other civ to be the first to complete 7 Temples to Amun in this scenario set along the banks of the great Nile River.

• Includes unique rules and gameplay, and the Nile River is navigable by Naval units.

• 125 Turn limit.

New Jebel Barkal Wonder:
• This Wonder provides extra Faith to all nearby Cities, and must be built on Desert Hills.
70050000007546.name: Civilization VI - Nubia Civilization & Scenario Pack

70050000007547.description:
Jayavarman VII leads Khmer and Dyah Gitarja leads Indonesia in Sid Meier’s Civilization VI! Though each is versatile and unique, both civilizations bring new challengers to the religious game. Indonesia is a strong coastal civilization with potential for a huge Jong-powered navy, and the Khmer thrive in their populous riverside cities. Both of these civilizations come into play in the new “Path to Nirvana” scenario, where you compete to have the most followers of your religion on a unique Southeast Asia map.

Includes the Khmer civilization with Jayavarman VII, the Domrey unique unit, and the Prasat unique improvement.

• Civ Unique Ability: The “Grand Barays” ability gives Khmer additional food when Farms are built next to Aqueducts, and Aqueducts provide both Faith and an Amenity.

• Leader Unique Ability: Jayavarman’s “Monasteries of the King” ability lets Khmer grab adjacent territory as well as Food and Housing when Holy Sites are built on a river.

• Unique Unit: The Domrey, a ballista mounted on an elephant, is stronger than a Catapult, can move and shoot on the same turn, and exerts Zone of Control.

• Unique Building: The Prasat replaces the Temple and provides a Relic Great Work slot. Missionaries that are produced here gain a new attribute when killed in religious combat: they generate a Relic.

Also includes the Indonesian civilization with Dyah Gitarja, the Jong unique unit, and the Kampung unique improvement:

• Civ Unique Ability: With the “Great Nusantara” ability, Coastal Tiles provide Indonesia with minor adjacency bonuses for certain districts and Entertainment Complexes give an extra Amenity if they are adjacent to a non-lake Coastal Tile.

• Leader Unique Ability: Gitarja has the “Exalted Goddess of the Three Worlds” ability, granting bonus Faith to coastal cities and allowing her to purchase Naval units with Faith at a discount, as well as eliminating movement cost for Religious unit to embark or disembark.

• Unique Unit: Indonesia’s unique unit is the Jong, which replaces the Frigate. It is faster, gains extra combat power if it’s in a formation, and all of the units in its formation gain its movement speed.

• Unique Improvement: The Kampung provides Housing, Production and Food for each adjacent Fishing Boat, and can be improved through further tech research later in the game.

New “Path to Nirvana” Scenario:
• The lands around the Indian Ocean flourish with many religions and many people. Heaven has chosen you to bring the light to all these lands. Is your faith up to the challenge? In this 50 turn scenario, compete to have the most followers of your religion, the most faith per turn, and the most foreign cities following your religion.

New Wonder:
• Angkor Wat: The largest religious monument in the world returns to Civilization! This temple must be built adjacent to an Aqueduct and provides Faith, plus it adds Housing and a Citizen to every one of the owner’s cities when built.

New Natural Wonder:
• Ha Long Bay: This breathtaking bay was designated one of the New Seven Wonders of the World in 2012, and provides Food, Production, and Culture, in addition to providing a large combat bonus to naval units in its tiles.

New Map:
• Spread your empire through Southeast Asia in this new map, with a True Start and random location option.
70050000007547.name: Civilization VI - Khmer and Indonesia Civilization & Scenario Pack

70050000008421.description:
Piranha Plant joins the battle as a stand-alone fighter in the Super Smash Bros.™ Ultimate game! With its powerful bite, Poison Breath, and ability to call in Petey Piranha for a larger-than-life Final Smash, this fighter’s ferocity is as sharp as its teeth. Ready your pipes and flowerpots; your opponent won’t see you coming! (Then again, Piranha Plant doesn’t really “see” either. It doesn’t have eyes.)

Players who purchased and registered the game before January 31, 2019 have until June 30, 2019 to redeem their codes and receive Piranha Plant for free. Players who did not qualify for the early purchase bonus can purchase Piranha Plant in the Nintendo eShop for $4.99 USD.

Note: Piranha Plant is not a part of the Super Smash Bros. Ultimate Fighters Pass. Therefore, this fighter does not come with a stage or selection of music.
70050000008421.name: Super Smash Bros.™ Ultimate: Piranha Plant Standalone Fighter

70050000008422.description:
Joker steals the show when he joins the Super Smash Bros.™ Ultimate game as a playable fighter! This speedy fighter from the Persona series wields a knife and a gun to rack up damage. When his Rebellion Gauge is full, Joker summons his Persona, Arsene, to immediately power up his attacks for a limited time. This pack also includes Mementos, a stage that changes colors, depending on which Persona series music track is playing!

Challenger Pack 1 includes Joker as a playable fighter, his stage, Mementos, and a selection of music from the Persona series.

Note: The content of this Challenger Pack is already included in the Super Smash Bros. Ultimate Fighters Pass (sold separately).
70050000008422.name: Super Smash Bros.™ Ultimate: Challenger Pack 1

70050000008423.description:
The Hero from DRAGON QUEST® XI joins Super Smash Bros.™ Ultimate as a playable fighter!
Wielding the Supreme Sword of Light and a trusty shield, he can slice his foes and block incoming attacks. When Hero pulls up his Command Selection screen, he’ll have access to a random selection of spells that could turn the tide of battle in his favor! This pack also includes the Yggdrasil’s Altar stage, which sweeps across nearby areas around the sacred Tree of Life, as well as a selection of music from the DRAGON QUEST series.

Challenger Pack 2 includes Hero as a playable fighter, his stage, Yggdrasil’s Altar, and a selection of music from the DRAGON QUEST series.

* The content of this Challenger Pack is already included in the Super Smash Bros. Ultimate Fighters Pass (sold separately).
70050000008423.name: Super Smash Bros.™ Ultimate: Challenger Pack 2

70050000008424.description:
The missing piece of the puzzle has been found, as Banjo & Kazooie are joining the battle as a playable fighter! With Banjo’s bare hands to bruise rivals up close and Kazooie’s egg-cellent shooting skills, your rivals will be singing the blues in no time. For their Final Smash, these perfect partners call upon a flock of Jinjos and the Mighty Jinjonator to deal the final blow to any “feeble jerk” that may stand in their way! This pack also includes the Spiral Mountain stage (which umm…spirals!), as well as a selection of music from the Banjo-Kazooie™ series.

Challenger Pack 3 includes Banjo & Kazooie as a playable fighter, their stage, Spiral Mountain, and a selection of music from the Banjo-Kazooie™ series.

Note: The content of this Challenger Pack is already included in the Super Smash Bros. Ultimate Fighters Pass (sold separately).
70050000008424.name: Super Smash Bros.™ Ultimate: Challenger Pack 3

70050000008425.description:
Terry Bogard faces the fury in the Super Smash Bros.™ Ultimate game as a new playable fighter! This iconic fighter from the Fatal Fury series of fighting games is the fourth fighter in the Super Smash Bros. Ultimate Fighters Pass. Using his Power Wave and Burning Knuckle, earn your title as The King of Fighters!

Note: The content of this Challenger Pack is already included in the Super Smash Bros. Ultimate Fighters Pass (sold separately).
70050000008425.name: Super Smash Bros.™ Ultimate: Challenger Pack 4

70050000008426.description:
Byleth is coming to the Super Smash Bros.™ Ultimate game as a new playable fighter! This iconic fighter is the fifth fighter in the Super Smash Bros. Ultimate Fighters Pass. Using the Heroes’ Relics and the Sword of the Creator, represent the and realize their full potential.

Note: The content of this Challenger Pack is already included in the Super Smash Bros. Ultimate Fighters Pass (sold separately).
70050000008426.name: Super Smash Bros.™ Ultimate: Challenger Pack 5

Do you have what it takes to impress a god? The great Tiempochtli may have the power to help you... if you can wake him from his nap.

Head from Villachula to the Badlands and discover the entrance to the Proving Grounds, an ancient temple dedicated to the luchador arts. Tackle 15 unique new challenges to prove your worth and gain entrance to Tiempochtli’s sacred sleeping chamber.

Earn Challenge Medals to unlock 6 (or more?) new playable characters, each with their own special attributes:

Fight with fury and pummel your enemies as Flame Face. Get into tip top shape as Chamoya. Grapple your opponents into submission as Coscorrona. Strut your stuff as Rooster Ramirez. Puzzle out the nature of existence with Uay Coco.

Plus, unlock a super secret costume by earning a a Gold Medal in all 15 Challenges!

Maybe even unlock a REALLY super secret new costume by… well, you’ll have to figure that out.

70050000009822.description:
The west is the best – well it was until the big one hit and left behind a burning city in ruins. Thankfully, the stadium survived, and 2 new west coast teams have risen out of the ashes to battle for Mayhem Bowl supremacy. This pack also includes a brand new mutant human species who is ready to unleash his fury on the league. This pack includes:
• Mutant Cyborg – This new mutant character is evenly balanced in most skill categories and can’t wait to hit the gridiron to show his stuff.
• Los Scandalous Damned Team – This team has an explosive, high powered offense and are taking the league by storm. Their Quarterback, Jared Goth passes with demonic precision to the best receiving tandem in the league.
• Los Scandalous Volts Team – Led by All-Star veteran Bloody Rivers, a smart, gutsy Quarterback who’s not afraid to throw the long ball or bash his skull against any defense. While their offense gets most of the acclaim their defense is stout and can bloody up any offense in the league.
• Los Scandalous Shake & Bake Arena – Both teams share the same arena with different hazards. The stadium managed to survive the big one but is littered with cracks, crevice’s and other nasty obstacles.
70050000009822.name: LA Power Pack

70050000010169.description:

Its impressive features and sporty design make it an exceptional vehicle, perfectly adapted and ready for Extreme-Khana.
70050000010169.name: V-Rally 4 - Ford GT (2006)

70050000010170.description: The Citroën DS3 RX is a powerful monster. It combines power with incredible agility, letting you negotiate bends at blistering speeds. It takes heart and passion to tame this war machine. V-Rally Cross fans will love its extraordinary grip on both asphalt and dirt.

70050000010171.description: 0 to 100 in 2.2 seconds… That's what 2 electric motors with 250 KW (680 hp) of power can do in a 1,100 kg carbon body. The Volkswagen I.D. R prototype was designed to win the famous Pikes Peak International Hill Climb (USA). Objective achieved: in this technological beast roaring with power, French driver Romain Dumas smashed the record held by Sébastien Loeb. He became the first person in history to drive this legendary 20 km race, which has 156 bends, in less than 8 minutes (7' 57").
70050000010171.name: V-Rally 4 - Volkswagen Pikes Peak

70050000010172.description: A supercharged 650 hp 6.2L V8 engine, manual 6-speed transmission, launch control… all with rear-wheel drive! This legendary American muscle car burns rubber and makes Extreme-Khana a thrilling driving experience.

Overcooked! 2 - Night of the Hangry Horde sees players face the most terrifying threat to the Onion Kingdom yet, the unbread, and this time they’ve brought friends! This brand new DLC introduces an entirely new horde mode in which players must use all of their cooking know how to repel waves of ravenous undead ingredients.

70050000011524.description:
Overcooked! 2 Carnival of Chaos invites players to a celebration of all things cooking, co-op and chaos! This colourful new DLC will put players to the test as you take on combo meals and that kitchen essential, the canon!

Combo Meals! For extra hungry customers, players must combine cuisines on a trusty tray, topped off with a refreshing beverage.

New Recipes! Hot Dogs and everyone's favourite circular food, the mighty Donut, join the menu!

Sauces! Is it even possible to have a hot dog without ketchup or mustard…or both?!

Plus 15 New Levels! Players will burn burgers in the big top and tackle tasty treats on a tight rope in a series of vibrant new levels.

Four New Chefs! A quartet of colourful characters join the culinary chaos: Ringmaster Chef, Strongman Chef, Clown Chef and Stunt Chef!

70050000011531.description:
After the development of Dead Cells, we were completely blown away by the amazing reaction of the community. Without your support and feedback we wouldn’t be where we are today. Rise of the Giant is our way of saying thank you. Here’s a free DLC with a bunch of new content, mostly aimed at the people who have been hanging around since day 1, it’s high level and should offer more challenge than most sane people would think reasonable.

Features:
· New levels: You’ve got a new level that’s connected to the main level structure and immediately available to anyone who’s finished the game at least once. You’ve got another (poorly) hidden level, for the masochists who know that there is a Boss Cell 5
· New Bosses: Mirroring the above, you’ve got a new completely different type of boss available in the main level structure, with another INSANELY difficult boss hidden behind even more ridiculously difficult content.
· New content: There are 10 new enemies, 13 new weapons/skills and a bunch of other upgrades to core game systems. There are additions to the story/lore of the game, new secrets, new blueprints and…
· Skins: People have been requesting this for ages and we’ve finally found the time to make the necessary changes to accommodate the request. You’ve now got access to female skins, fluo skins and a Christmas tree skin, cos why the hell not.

The difficulty has been rebalanced so that the entry level of the game, while extremely challenging is now in line with the 5 extra difficulty levels available to those who like to suffer.

We hope that you like Rise of the Giant!
70050000011531.intro: Two new levels, two new bosses and stacks more content to explore and unlock… If you’re good... Real good.
70050000011531.name: Dead Cells: Rise of the Giant
