70050000060968.description:
Includes 5,000 Moonstones
Nestled amongst the Wishblossom Mountains is a special place powered by the Heart’s deepest wishes, where horses once roamed free and stables were full of life. That was until the Ranch fell into the hands of someone who neglected it, causing a mysterious phenomenon—the Decay. Saddle up for an adventure with your magical new Disney friends to find the missing horses, reverse the effects of the Decay, and restore the Ranch to its former glory!

Befriend Four New Villagers and Three Horses
Snow White has been taking care of the Ranch since the Decay, but now she needs your help! Awaken Tinker Bell in order to understand the power behind Wishblossom Magic. You'll work with (and against) Cruella De Vil to untangle the mysteries of the Mountains, and adventure with Tigger through areas transformed by weird and whimsical wishes.
That's not all! On your journey, you’ll befriend iconic steeds Maximus, Khan, and Pegasus as you ride towards the far reaches of the Mountains in search of adventure. Each horse brings their unique personality and special gameplay abilities to help you explore.

Mount Your Horses for New Adventures
Care for your horses daily by feeding, brushing, and petting your horses to deepen your Friendship Levels with them. You can also fully customize your horse’s appearance with customization features and accessories tailored to your style!
Ride your horses and unlock special abilities. Your new mounts can also help you care for your Valley by helping with gardening, mining, and cleaning out your Village, opening tons of unique new experiences.

Set Off on Horseback in a Vast World
The Wishblossom Mountains combine three new Biomes for you to explore, including the Wishblossom Ranch, a rustic farmland surrounded by snow-covered peaks and alpine meadows. Each Biome contains a fully customizable layout to make your own, exclusive craftable items and meals to unlock, and animal companions to befriend!

Help Snow White Restore the Ranch to Its Former Glory
With the help of your new friends, set out on a quest to reverse the effects of the Decay and bring life back to Wishblossom Ranch. Adventure deep into the Crystal Caverns, at the Heart of the Mountains, to find the key to get this world up and running again and complete puzzles to reach new areas.
70050000060968.intro: Rebuild the ranch of your dreams, forge bonds with your horses, and befriend new Villagers as you saddle up for a new Disney adventure!
70050000060968.name: Disney Dreamlight Valley: Wishblossom Ranch

Open your doors for customers and prepare them a delicious portion of pizza!

What can you expect from the DLC?
- 10 fresh Italian ingredients to put on your pizza - choose them accordingly to the orders!
- Possibility to organize your workplace - you can't cook in a mess...
- A professional oven - bake the best pizza, in the best conditions.
70050000061178.intro: Run the best restaurant in the middle of the city, complete orders, learn new recipes, and improve your cooking skills.
70050000061178.name: Cooking: Viva la Pizza!

70050000061180.description:
Personalize your store’s exterior with new and original graffiti! With the Graffiti Style Pack, you can change the artwork on your store’s walls to give it a fresh and unique look. Whether you prefer an urban style, colorful designs, or TCG-inspired art, your store will now catch everyone’s eye.

Show off your style and stand out from the competition! Create a space that speaks directly to TCG fans, turning your store into a vibrant meeting place for the community of enthusiasts.

With this DLC, your store’s exterior becomes as memorable as your card collection.
70050000061180.intro: Turn your shop into a street art legend.
70050000061180.name: TCG Card Market Simulator: Exterior Customization

70050000061192.description:
Expand your underground empire with the brand-new Metroliner Express! This high-performance train brings speed and modern design to your subway experience.

Hop into the driver’s seat of the Metroliner Express and master the tracks with style. Whether you’re rushing through tunnels or stopping at bustling stations, this sleek addition will redefine your subway operations.

Get ready to elevate your ride — the Metroliner Express is waiting for you in the depot!
70050000061192.intro: Elevate your skills with the newest high-speed train.
70050000061192.name: Subway Simulator – Underground Train Ride Station Ultimate Driving Games: Urban Speed

70050000061194.description: The Gildcrest Transmog Set gives your Inquisitor an exquisite-looking suit of armor that will turn the heads of even Faelduum's richest denizens and enemies. Don your golden armor and slay your enemies in style!
70050000061194.name: Gildcrest Transmog Set

70050000061196.description:
Embark on an exciting new quest within the world of Faelduum: Dark Ale!

Solve the mystery of what exactly is in a strange ale keg in the basement of Rosalie’s inn. Put not only your combat abilities to the test... but also your taste in ale!

Grab a flagon, Inquisitor, because it’s going to be a long night...
70050000061196.name: Dark Ale Quest

70050000061198.description:
Partner up with a friendly animal companion in Mandragora: Whispers of the Witch Tree.

Make friends with the Curious Ottling... for the rats’ sake, we hope the Ottlings are not curious about them.
70050000061198.name: Curious Ottling (Pet Follower)

70050000061200.description: Menace enemies with the Shadowpyre Transmog Set, a demon visage wreathed in shadows.
70050000061200.name: Shadowpyre Transmog Set

70050000061202.description:
Listen to the Original Soundtrack for Mandragora: Whispers of the Witch Tree.

Get whisked away by haunting melodies and dark fantasy soundscapes composed by Christos Antoniou and performed by the FILMharmonic Orchestra Prague.
70050000061202.name: Original Soundtrack

70050000061203.description: Fall into a dark fantasy world! Delve into the rich, atmospheric, painterly art style of Mandragora: Whispers of the Witch Tree with this Digital Artbook.
70050000061203.name: Digital Artbook

70050000061206.description: Thanks for supporting Mandragora: Whispers of the Witch Tree on Kickstarter! Claim your exclusive Crafty Kitling (Pet Follower) and adventure together with your new companion.
70050000061206.name: Crafty Kitling (Kickstarter Reward)

70050000061208.description: Thanks for supporting Mandragora: Whispers of the Witch Tree on Kickstarter! Claim your exclusive Night Witch Transmog Set and slay in style.
70050000061208.name: Night Witch Set (Kickstarter Reward)

70050000061209.description:
Battle Train DLC: Revenge of the Puffin is pulling into the station—are you ready for the ride?

Step into a frosty new battlefield with Ludwig the Buffin, a brand-new Champion with a beak full of vengeance and feathers full of fury. This action-packed DLC delivers a fresh narrative experience, explosive new content, and icy-cool challenges that will test your tactical mettle.

What's Included:
・A new story arc revealing Aalvado’s shady origins, complete with fully voice acted and animated cutscenes!
・A new NON-Roguelite Campaign stuffed with over 27 handcrafted puzzles, fights, and challenges to test your track laying skills.
・A slew of new content, including cards, train parts, ornaments, hats, stickers, and some brand new opponents
・The ability to play as some of your favorite characters in special combat scenarios!
70050000061209.name: Battle Train - Revenge of the Puffin

70050000061256.description:
It will add the following additional colors you can choose in the character select screen:

・Billy SPECIAL COLOR
・Jimmy SPECIAL COLOR
70050000061256.name: Additional Character Color

70050000061257.description:
Double Dragon Revive Digital Artworks includes the "ARTBOOK," which lets you view concept art and other illustrations from Double Dragon Revive, as well as the "SOUNDTRACK" featuring all 28 music tracks.

*Double Dragon Revive Digital Artworks is a separate application from the main game.
70050000061257.name: Double Dragon Revive Digital Artworks

70050000061303.description: See that feisty smile and those clenched fists? That’s the youngest sibling, armed with a unique weapon and ready to begin a journey of her own. She’s determined to prove she can take care of herself. Take control of her and experience a new way to play. Don’t let her size fool you! She’s fast and strikes fear into all who stand in her way.
70050000061303.name: Ray of Sunshine

70050000061310.description:
Deep within the jungle, beneath the shadow of forgotten temples, lies a sacred ground where heroes are tested and legends are born.
Enter the ancient arena of your ancestors and prove your worth.
Face unending waves of enemies in this relentless Endless Arena Mode, and see how long you can survive.
70050000061310.intro: Enter the ancient arena of your ancestors and prove your worth.
70050000061310.name: Arena of Heroes

70050000061312.description:
Fast Food 2025 Simulator puts you in charge of a fast-food empire, where you cook, serve, and grow your business in a bustling city. Customize your restaurant, upgrade your equipment, and delight your customers with delicious meals!

In the Vehicle Upgrade DLC, you can now change your vehicle model directly in the parking lot to attract even more customers without leaving the location!

Get ready to take your business to the next level and conquer the city in style!
70050000061312.name: Fast Food 2025 Simulator: Vehicle Upgrade

70050000061321.description:
The following in-game item will be added:
[Content]

Autumn Color School Uniform
70050000061321.name: Autumn Color School Uniform

70050000061370.description:
Embrace the crown as King Romus Toras, and lead the Golden Kingdom to a new era. Reclaim lost territories through diplomacy or force. Engage with noble houses and oversee the resources of Rizia. How will you reign?

Features:

New Kingdom, New King: Assume the role of King Romus, the newly crowned leader of the Kingdom of Rizia. Explore South Merkopa, an expansion of the Suzerain Universe.

Geopolitical Challenges & New Resources: Start dialogues with new national leaders. Will you forge new alliances or make new enemies? Oversee the management of new invaluable resources such as energy and authority.

A Game of Houses: Engage in discussions on religion, family, and romance. Dive into the intricate dynamics of a royal family and houses where relationships intertwine, merging the realms of love, duty, and politics.

Build Your Nation: Sign dozens of Royal Decrees on topics such as order, economy, and welfare to develop and improve Rizia. Will you be the guardian of peace or the catalyst for conflict?

War Mechanic & Military Build-up: Experience the strategic and tactical military challenges in a turn-based experience. Build up the Rizian Armed Forces and train units to intimidate neighbors.

Rich Character Interactions: Encounter a diverse cast of 20+ characters each with unique backgrounds and motivations.
70050000061370.name: Suzerain: Kingdom of Rizia

70050000061371.description: Work up a sweat while you vibe to a DLC pack containing instrumental versions of three tunes from popular anime TV series: "IDOL" from [OSHI NO KO], "Bling-Bang-Bang-Born" from the Divine Visionary Candidate Exam Arc of MASHLE: MAGIC AND MUSCLES, and "Where Our Blue Is" from JUJUTSU KAISEN: Hidden Inventory/Premature Death.
70050000061371.intro: Dial up the intensity with three tunes from popular anime TV series with the Fitness Boxing 3: Anime Tune Pack Vol. 1 DLC*
70050000061371.name: Fitness Boxing 3: Anime Tune Pack Vol. 1

70050000061372.description: Customize your exercise targets with a series of cat-themed icons in this DLC pack. Upon purrchase, it will be pawsible to select your new target type from the Customize menu.
70050000061372.intro: Go from fists to toe-beans with kitty-themed target designs in the Purrfect Punch Pack DLC*
70050000061372.name: Fitness Boxing 3: Purrfect Punch Pack

70050000061390.name: Colorful Sweets from Around the World

70050000061392.description:
Don't overlook any anomalies.

If you find anomalies, turn back immediately.

If you don't find anomalies, do not turn back.

To go out from Exit 8.

The Exit 8 is a short walking simulator inspired by Japanese underground passageways, liminal spaces and back rooms.
70050000061392.intro: This is a pack that upgrades the Nintendo Switch™ version of The Exit 8 to the Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition.
70050000061392.name: The Exit 8 Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition Upgrade Pack

70050000061394.name: [Moving] Beach

70050000061417.description:
Descend deeper into the nightmare with an essential survival upgrade.

This DLC unlocks a night vision camera with unlimited battery life, giving you a new edge in the suffocating darkness of the Backrooms. See what hides beyond the flickering lights and decaying walls—but beware, some things are better left unseen.

Adapt, observe, and survive longer. In the Backrooms, light may be your only friend.
70050000061417.intro: The camera sees it all. Even what you shouldn’t.
70050000061417.name: ESCAPE – BACKROOMS HORROR: Unlimited Camera Vision

70050000061430.description:
Add a touch of style and modernity to your supermarket and its surroundings! With this DLC, you can customize your game’s urban environment by:
- Changing the truck color from blue to sleek black for a professional and polished look.
- Revitalizing the sidewalk by replacing plain gray with a vibrant orange that catches shoppers’ eyes.
- Darkening the main road to an intense black, giving a modern and refined urban feel.

Give your management experience a visual refresh, make your supermarket stand out in the city, and create a fresh atmosphere that inspires success
70050000061430.intro: Upgrade your streets, upgrade your success.
70050000061430.name: Supermarket Owner Simulator: Business — City Style Upgrade

70050000061431.description: The Deluxe Edition of Shantae Advance: Risky Revolution adds three special bonus outfits that change Shantae’s appearance and boost her magical abilities: Sizzle Armor Costume (enhanced Fireball Power), Relic Hunter Costume (enhanced Pike Ball Power), and High Voltage Costume (enhanced Storm Puff Power)! This is add-on content, exclusively available in the Deluxe Edition bundle of Shantae Advance: Risky Revolution, and is not available separately.
70050000061431.intro: Experience Shantae's long-lost adventure along with three stylish Deluxe Edition costumes!
70050000061431.name: Shantae Advance: Risky Revolution - Deluxe Edition Costumes

70050000061432.description:
This Upgrade Pack grants access to Lynked: Banner of the Spark – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition. You must already own Lynked: Banner of the Spark on Nintendo Switch™* to purchase the Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition Upgrade Pack.

*Lynked: Banner of the Spark on Nintendo Switch™ is compatible with, and can be played on, Nintendo Switch™ 2, but will not feature the added functionality listed above without owning the Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition Upgrade Pack.
70050000061432.name: Lynked: Banner of the Spark – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition Upgrade Pack

70050000061451.description: Add a spooky touch to your restaurant! Halloween decorations will bring festive chills and turn every meal into frightful fun.
70050000061451.intro: Run your own restaurant for many hungry customers!
70050000061451.name: Spooky Season

70050000061452.description: Fill your restaurant with love and charm! Valentine’s decorations will create a warm, romantic atmosphere perfect for sweet moments and cozy dinners.
70050000061452.intro: Run your own restaurant for many hungry customers!
70050000061452.name: Valentine's Day

70050000061453.description: Give your restaurant a timeless makeover! Vintage decorations add classic elegance and nostalgic charm to every corner.
70050000061453.intro: Run your own restaurant for many hungry customers!
70050000061453.name: Vintage Vibe

70050000061494.description:
Journey to the desert nation of Sabaku and uncover a new chapter in Shujinkou's story! Picking up right after the Genya Arc, this full-length sequel introduces fresh characters, even more dangerous foes, and a perilous mission to save a fellow friend from an ominous fate.

Key Features:
• Brave eight massive labyrinths filled with new, challenging puzzles.
• Collect dozens of Kanji orbs to unleash ontological attacks and exploit elemental weaknesses.
• Discover signboards that teach proverbs, JLPT N4 grammar, lore, and more.
• Master a new Cooking system using ingredients gathered across Genya and Sabaku.
• Embark on 100 side quests that explore the lives of Sabaku’s people and expand the story beyond the Genya Arc.
• Experience 40+ new 4K illustrations highlighting pivotal story and bonding moments with the cast.

NO GENERATIVE AI WAS USED IN THE PROCESS OF CREATING SHUJINKOU
70050000061494.name: Shujinkou Sabaku Arc

70050000061496.description:
Dive deep into the rich worlds of Genya and Sabaku with the Akuma Quests DLC! This episodic expansion offers an exciting blend of story-driven content, new costumes, and plenty of new enemies to fight.

• Six Akuma-Themed Costumes: Transform your Fuu Lobby partners with striking new looks, each tied to engaging narrative storylines (the “Akuma Quests“).
• Special Costume Dialogue: Unlock unique interactions between Shu and the rest of the cast, bringing the costumes to life.
• New Enemies and Kanji Lessons: Test your skills against new, formidable foes while learning new kanji along the way.
• 18 Story-Driven Quests: Experience 10-15 hours of new gameplay, with each partner’s new costume tied to their own three-part storyline.
70050000061496.name: Shujinkou: Akuma Quests

70050000061500.description:
Take a plunge into the sparkling seas of Shujinkou with the Swimsuit Quests DLC! This episodic expansion delivers a fresh and playful blend of story-driven content, dazzling swimsuits, challenging foes, and opportunities to dive into learning new Japanese kanji.

• Six Swimsuit Costumes: Dress your Fuu Lobby partners in vibrant beachwear, each unlocking a unique narrative adventure as part of the “Swimsuit Quests.”
• Special Costume Dialogue: Enjoy lively, summer-inspired exchanges between Shu and the cast, bringing these stylish swimsuits to life.
• New Enemies and Kanji Lessons: Battle against tough, oceanic-themed foes and learn new Japanese kanji! These special orbs can be found in the various Meiro of Genya.
• 18 Story-Driven Quests: Embark on 10-15 hours of engaging gameplay, with each partner’s swimsuit tied to a three-part storyline brimming with summer vibes.
70050000061500.name: Shujinkou: Swimsuit Quests

70050000061508.description:
Show off your style with the Timeless Skin Pack - an exclusive collection of 4 outfits inspired by time, legends and dreams. These cosmetic skins will transform your heroes, with unique new designs and refined details that will leave a lasting impression.

Immerse yourself in the world of re-imagined tales, with:
* Scarlet, in both human and werewolf form, dressed like a wild huntress with armour made of rope and bone, and adorned with scarlet ritual paint.
* Melusine, ruler of the abyss, wearing golden armour and a crown, like a serpent queen.
* Aladdin, guardian of the sands of time, clad in reinforced armour, with gold tattoos sparkling powerfully.
* Geppetto, master pyrotechnist, kitted out in a mechanical suit and equipped with gears and fireworks for lighting up the night.

Access these new outfits from the hero selection menu, and bring timeless style to any battlefield.
70050000061508.intro: Four of the Ravenswatch heroes can now don timeless outfits featuring refined details: reminders of the glory of the past. Includes skins for Scarlet, Melusine, Aladdin and Geppetto.
70050000061508.name: Ravenswatch - Timeless Skin Pack

70050000061509.description: 20 new landscape images to cross stitch or color by number
70050000061509.name: Pixel Cross Stitch Color by Number: Landscapes 2

70050000061515.description:
Upgrade your arsenal and take your hunts to the next level.
  This exclusive DLC grants you the powerful Savatimp 8 rifle — a precision-crafted weapon designed for accuracy, range, and stopping power. Whether you’re tracking elusive deer or taking down apex predators, the Savatimp 8 gives you the edge you need in the wild.
  Already own this weapon? You’ll receive 1400 in in-game currency instead — invest it in new gear, ammo, or upgrades to enhance your next expedition.
  Stay sharp. Hunt smart. The wilderness just got more rewarding.
70050000061515.intro: Tactical advantage begins with the right weapon.
70050000061515.name: Hunter Simulator: Wild Hunting – Elite Weapon

70050000061517.description:
Fresh out of high school with no job and no ambition, you’ve really got nothing going for you until an alien cartel that wants to get high off humanity invades Earth. Now, you and a team of charismatic talking guns must answer the hero's call and become the deadliest intergalactic bounty hunter the cosmos has ever seen.

Travel to a variety of biomes and locations across the cosmos, go up against the nefarious Garmantuous and his gang of goons, collect loot, meet unique characters, and more, in the latest comedy adventure from Squanch Games!

High On Life: High On Knife DLC
It’s been 2 years since the Bounty Hunter defeated the G3 cartel. Now Knifey needs help tracking down a mysterious package from his homeworld. Will they get mixed up with a friendly giant, a pinball gun, poaching rings, and a terrifying intergalactic shipping company? Yeah. Sure.
70050000061517.name: High On Life: Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition Upgrade Pack

70050000061525.description: Can you decipher 100 more quotes from famous people?
70050000061525.name: Cipheur: Quotes Pack 2

70050000061530.description:
Discover the artistry of furniture restoration like never before! With this DLC, your creative journey begins with 5000 units instantly credited to your balance, giving you the perfect head start to build your dream workshop and tackle premium restoration projects.

Step into the world of skilled furniture restoration and decorating, where every piece tells a story and your hands bring it back to life. From vintage gems to forgotten relics, transform the old into something extraordinary.

Whether you’re a seasoned artisan or a passionate newcomer, this DLC offers a rewarding blend of creativity, strategy, and craftsmanship.
70050000061530.intro: Tools, talent, and a little treasure.
70050000061530.name: Furniture Flipper Simulator 2023: Revive, Restoration & Creative - Starter Kit

70050000061531.description:
Elevate your adventure with a stunning new skybox that transforms the world around you. This DLC introduces a completely redesigned environment backdrop, immersing you in breathtaking vistas as you and your companions scale the towering peaks.

Experience the climb like never before — the changing skies and atmospheric effects add a fresh layer of depth and challenge to your ascent. Whether you play solo or with friends, the new environment enhances every moment of your perilous journey.

Prepare to conquer the heights under a whole new sky.
70050000061531.intro: Let the transformed sky inspire your courage and fuel your climb.
70050000061531.name: Chained Climb Together: Skybound Environment

70050000061541.description: Gloomy tunes for gloomy souls! Immerse yourself in 40 tracks of haunting Halloween-inspired melodies and classical horror animation charm. From eerie waltzes to tense, cinematic themes, Gloomy Eyes - Soundtrack captures the dark, whimsical atmosphere of the game. Perfect for setting the mood, whether you’re wandering through moonlit graveyards or facing a slow and inevitable death.
70050000061541.name: Gloomy Eyes - Soundtrack

70050000061549.description:
From the makers of LEGO® Builder's Journey comes a new 2-player co-op adventure about friendship and play. When two friends make it their mission to rescue an abandoned spaceship, they embark on a journey beyond their wildest dreams, ultimately learning the value of being connected.

● Experience what it feels like to be a LEGO brick. Tumble, jump, snap together, and build your way through rich brick worlds.
● Unravel a poetic, non verbal narrative, set in beautiful brick built environments, supported by an atmospheric soundtrack.
● Cooperatively solve the game's many challenges and discover how two bricks are better than one. Play locally on the same screen, or online.
● Invite a friend to join your adventure for free with the Friend’s Pass. As long as one of you owns LEGO Voyagers, you can both play the full co-op experience together.

LEGO Voyagers asks open questions about building friendships, sharing dreams, and giving space.

It reminds us that while playing and being creative is for all shapes and sizes, it’s always better when you share it with a friend.
70050000061549.intro: Tumble, jump, snap together, and build your way through rich brick worlds
70050000061549.name: LEGO® Voyagers

70050000061551.description:
Meg's Monster: Lost Memories is a collection of short prequel adventures that expand upon the world and lore of Meg's Monster by letting players experience the heartwrenching backstories of five wholly unique characters.

An MMA fighter who steps into the ring to earn money for his ailing brother's medical treatment.

A young girl whose bickering parents seem eerily on edge about her upcoming fifth birthday.

An unseen creature in a dark cell, created for the sole purpose of killing a specific human being.

A man reborn after death as a monster, who devotes his newfound life to bringing order to the Underworld.

A monster child, raised in a laboratory and subjected to extensive experimentation—but to what end?

Five lives. Five stories, heretofore untold.

Yet all beg the same underlying questions:

Can a monster be just as human as a human?

And can a human be more monstrous than a monster?

(Estimated Play Time: Around 2 hours)
70050000061551.intro: Delve deeper into the world of Meg's Monster through the eyes of five beloved characters and unearth harrowing secrets from the past in this short, episodic prequel DLC.
70050000061551.name: Meg's Monster: Lost Memories

70050000061561.description:
Baki Hanma, the World’s Strongest Teen, joins the brutal world of Two Strikes. Born to fight and trained to surpass all limits, Baki brings his unmatched martial prowess and relentless spirit to the battlefield. With bone-crushing strikes, lightning reflexes, and a will forged through countless battles, Baki shakes up the fight like never before.

This DLC pack includes playable character Baki Hanma, from the hit anime Baki Hanma, featuring a completely new set of moves and animations. Also included: a brand-new stage, The Underground Arena, and an exclusive original music track.

Baki is fully playable across all online and offline game modes.
70050000061561.name: Two Strikes - Baki Hanma

70050000061568.description:
Pre-order now to get the Welcome Care Package (digital content), the head start that any good farmer needs! The Welcome Care Package includes:

• An extra 3000G to start your farming adventure!
• 10 Turnip Seeds, 10 Onion Seeds, and 10 Cabbage Seeds!
• 10 Daisy Seeds and 10 Marguerite Seeds!
70050000061568.name: Pre-Order Bonus - Welcome Care Package

70050000061569.description:
To our community– thank you for supporting Lynked: Banner of the Spark and our team! We’re humbled to have you along with us as we've developed this game for you. If you'd like to support us beyond the base game, we've released the Supporter Pack so you can take down the Combots in style! Gear up with new player outfits in the Spark-Tek theme, ten weapon class variants, backpacks, head wear, livery, and an Owl GoodBot to keep you company on missions. Taking a break from saving the world? Gild your space with a variety of decor items to make your town stand out!

Lynked: Banner of the Spark - Supporter Pack: Battle Ready will operate on both the Nintendo Switch™ and Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition

The Supporter Pack: Battle Ready Includes:

Player Outfits:
- Spark-Tek Commander outfit with 11 color variations
- Spark-Tek Scout outfit with 11 color variations
- This pack also includes 6 total alternate styles for the commander and scout outfits

Weapon Variants:
- All 10 weapon classes in the Spark-Tek theme

Accessories:
- 2x Backpacks
- 2x Head wear options with 11 Colors each
- This pack also includes 6 alternate headwear styles

Liveries:

70050000061749.description:
NOTE: The content of this expansion is only accessible near completion of the base game.

Winter descends, and a long-silenced deity stirs beneath the snow.

Yngya, the forgotten God of the lambs, summons you to restore the flock and reclaim what time has erased. But as you breathe life into what long passed, a creeping Rot awakens, spreading corruption through the sacred mountain the lambs once called home…

Not all who tread this peak come seeking redemption. Upon the frozen summit, a wolf prowls — his pack hungers for war with the covetous Gods. Deep within the hidden caverns, a shadowy figure waits, blade honed and patience fraying. Restless spirits drift along the ridges, each bound by former sins. The past was buried for good reason — will you unearth it, or will it consume you?

That which was sacred now rots, and nothing is as it seems. Last of the lambs, Woolhaven’s fate rests in your hooves.

Discover Woolhaven
Return the lost souls of Woolhaven to their spiritual home and learn the long-forgotten history of lambkind. Rebuild the fallen town to its former glory and reclaim the mountain to restore Yngya’s depleted power, but beware; there is always a price to be paid.

Survive the Winter
Endure harsh blizzards and freezing temperatures that threaten your Cult’s survival. Build new structures to keep your Cult warm and protect your Followers from frostbite and famine.

Explore The Mountain
Venture into a new realm battered by bitter storms, crawling with creatures corrupted with the Rot lurking beneath the snow. Battle through two vast new dungeons, where the echoes of the past refuse to rest. Every soul redeemed on the mountain defiles it further, threatening all of The Lands of the Old Faith. Can you undo the sins of the past?

Take up Ranching
Unlock ranching and breed rare animals that provide wool, warmth and when desperate, precious meat. Tame, ride and let your Followers care for these majestic creatures.
70050000061749.intro: A lost God calls you from a mysterious mountain—rebuild the flock and reawaken winter to uncover the truth of the fallen lambs.
70050000061749.name: Cult of the Lamb - Woolhaven

70050000061774.description:
Add the leader Edward Teach to your collection in Sid Meier's Civilization® VII!*

Edward Teach, better known as Blackbeard, was an English pirate whose name sparked dread in the captains of the Caribbean. In 1716, he joined the crew of Benjamin Hornigold, a leader of the Flying Gang, and quickly gained his own ships. With his impressive height, his long beard (decorated with, at times, lit fuses), and reputation for violence, he stalked the sea-lanes of the Caribbean and the nightmares of sailors. He outlived the Flying Gang and moved his operation to the Outer Banks of present-day North Carolina, where a pirate hunter, Robert Maynard, finally caught up with him.

Attributes, Unique Ability, and Agenda info on the Game Guide:
https://civilization.2k.com/civ-vii/game-guide/leaders/edward-teach/
70050000061774.name: Sid Meier's Civilization® VII: Edward Teach Pack

70050000061775.description:
Add the Republic of Pirates civilization to your collection for the Exploration Age in Sid Meier's Civilization® VII!*

Where there is wealth, there is greed. The scramble for new world riches in the early 18th century brought English, Spanish, French, and Dutch fleets – but the prospect of quick riches also brought pirates. These were rarely organized, but in 1706, one band, the Flying Gang, took over the island of New Providence in the Bahamas and set up a short-lived republic for all who sought fortune…and came with few scruples.

Attributes, Unique Ability, Unique Units, and Associated Wonder info on the Game Guide:
https://civilization.2k.com/civ-vii/game-guide/civilizations/republic-of-pirates/
70050000061775.name: Sid Meier's Civilization® VII: Republic of Pirates Pack

70050000061776.description:
Add the Tonga civilization to your collection for the Antiquity Age in Sid Meier's Civilization® VII!*

Into the endless blue, in search of new lands on scattered islands, the Polynesians sailed, settling the island of Tonga nearly three thousand years ago. Around 1000 CE, though, came another expansion, the Tu'i Tonga Empire – a struggle for dominance, tribute, and fealty over the Pacific. The Tongan kings maintained this system of hierarchical lordship over the islands until it, too, splintered.

Attributes, Unique Ability, Unique Units, and Associated Wonder info on the Game Guide:
https://civilization.2k.com/civ-vii/game-guide/civilizations/tonga/
70050000061776.name: Sid Meier's Civilization® VII: Tonga Pack

70050000061777.description:
Add the leader Sayyida al Hurra to your collection in Sid Meier's Civilization® VII!*

In the wake of Granada's fall, Sayyida al Hurra rose as Morocco's champion to challenge Iberian power in North Africa. As the sole ruler of Tétouan, she was a fierce diplomat who strong-armed the Europeans in their native tongues and earned their admiration. When talks failed, she turned to the Barbary corsairs, forging alliances with famed pirates who kept her waters safe and her city wealthy.
70050000061777.name: Sid Meier's Civilization® VII: Sayyida al Hurra Pack

70050000061778.description:
Add the Ottomans civilization to your collection for the Modern Age in Sid Meier's Civilization® VII!*

From the shores of the Bosphorus, the Ottomans ruled an empire spanning six centuries and three continents. By the 19th century, the world's wealth flowed through the Grand Bazaar and the Ottoman navy ruled the seas. Tension between the religious and the secular prompted major reforms to reforge the Ottomans for a new era. But these changes came too late, and the empire gave way to the modern Republic of Türkiye.
70050000061778.name: Sid Meier's Civilization® VII: Ottomans Pack

70050000061779.description:
Add the Iceland civilization to your collection for the Modern Age in Sid Meier's Civilization® VII!*

On a volcanic, windswept island, the Icelanders forged a commonwealth of chieftains and warriors, lawyers and scholars. Icelandic longships ranged far and wide – Vikings terrorized Europe's rivers and coasts as explorers roamed North America. Poets and saga-writers preserved their deeds alongside tales of gods, saints, and heroes. Centuries of independence held until Iceland, weakened by civil war, submitted to Norway.
70050000061779.name: Sid Meier's Civilization® VII: Iceland Pack

70050000061780.description: Explore new possibilities for your personalized empire with four new Wonders: Great Lighthouse, Nan Madol, Great Blue Hole, and Mapu'a Vaea Blowholes!

70050000061841.description:
They've demolished demons, battled bats, been to outer space, and failed to find any vampires, but now the Survivors face their greatest challenge yet: a bunch of Jokers. Will you fold under the pressure, or go all-in to be a Balatro-boosted bullet hell?
 
Join Jimbo and a cast of wild cards with combo potential that'll probably break the scoreboard. Get in on the action for a Full House of silly synergies, clownish combos, and bewildering Boss Blinds.

The house is full. The desk is rigged. And Luck is just another statistic. But fortune favours the bold, and if you can survive this clown car of poker puns, you can be the bullet hell even when the chips are down.

4 New Characters (send in the clowns)
Jimbo: Your favourite forklift-certified clown finally has full-body representation in Vampire Survivors. Level-up bonuses from Survarot cards are boosted by x4.
Canio: The tragic clown in oversized finery. Has a special technique to trigger additional Survarot drafts, but won't stop frowning about it.
Chicot - Wears the cap and bells, but makes bosses look like the real clowns by cutting their health in half and switching off their hazards.
Perkeo: Short in stature but never short on Passives, this fool has a practically unlimited pool to power him up.

4 New Weapons & Evolutions
Infernolatro - Summon a burning score counter to burn your foolish foes to ashes.  Each enemy you roast fans the flames, expanding the inferno until the whole table's alight.
Gros Michel: Release a barrage of banana projectiles, each with a 1-in-6 chance to explode for deliciously critical damage.
Fibonacci Seltzer - Fires mathematically beautiful spiralling streams of fizzy destruction that can trigger your other weapons.
Celestial Booster: Planets and a rocket orbit you constantly, dealing extra damage based on your current riches.

The Ante Chamber
Enter the Ante Chamber, an extradimensional analogue of Balatro's user interface. Battle buffoonish foes on a facsimile of Jimbo's home turf accompanied by a new ally, the Outer Saboteur, a silly little sidekick that steals your coins to throw them at enemies.

1 New Hypnotically Looping Track
70050000061841.intro: Prepare for a different kind of Stake as the Jokers run wild in Vampire Survivors: Ante Chamber.

70050000061908.description:
The Blightstorm rages on as Nightwatchers introduces a new species into the fray alongside two new biomes, new buildings, and more for any Viceroy seeking additional options in the endless struggle. The Bats bring with them a talent for metallurgy and a disdain for weakness, growing more resolute when their compatriots falter.

Meanwhile, as smugglers grow bolder, the harsh Rocky Ravines become an option for settlers – barren lands rich in ore and minerals. Viceroys building settlements among the scraggly rocks will find themselves reliant on black market traders while mining the basalt columns that grow here in place of trees.

Those seeking more verdant fields will find suitable sites among the Bamboo Flats instead. Though lush with life, the heavy rainfall erodes the loose soil, and settlers must work carefully to appease a peculiar species local to the ecosystem if they want any chance at success: the Fluffbeak. If kept happy, this beast is able to produce fertilizer, giving the local Viceroy an opportunity to plan exactly where to enrich the soil and secure the future of their settlement.

Nightwatchers includes:
- Bats have little patience for weakness, having grown hardy and austere in their isolated underground halls. Fiercely devoted and stern, they bring their expertise with metals and a willingness to make sacrifices for the greater good. Once the Bats’ starting ability is unlocked, you will be granted access to the Manorial Court blueprint – use it to expel a member of a chosen species, leveraging this harsh punishment to motivate all who remain to work harder in the name of the Scorched Queen.
- The Rocky Ravine biome presents an unforgiving landscape where even the trees are made of stone, and the Black Market will be a key partner in your success – with fluctuating prices and a notable lack of wood, you’ll need to leverage your plentiful stone and amber to acquire the resources needed to keep your settlement growing. But be warned – these criminals will quickly turn from merchants to miscreants, and while they present an excellent opportunity, they also expect debts to be paid in a timely manner.
- Settle the Bamboo Flats biome with the help of an unlikely ally – though the constant rain has left these regions devoid of fertile soil, the giant Fluffbeak, if kept happy,  is able to produce copious amounts of fertilizer to help create areas of fertile soil and establish a flourishing settlement.
- 3 new World Map Modifiers will bring harsher lands to conquer. From the Riverlands and their minimal space to places of great significance for the ancients, still watched by silent guardians that limit the number of Cornerstones that can be used.
- 3 new World Events introduce an increasingly powerful criminal organization, explosive alchemical experiments that threaten your carefully laid-out plans, and a tree-eating beast that inadvertently opens glades and unleashes the secrets hidden within them, whether you’re ready or not.
- 3 new Legendary Cornerstones, 16 new Deeds, and 6 new Decorations have been added alongside new rewards to the upgrade tree in the Smoldering City.
- The new biomes will appear on the world map after the current cycle ends. To unlock Bats as a playable species, you must reach level 11.

Punish the meek and push forth into harsher lands in service of the Scorched Queen – with the Bats by your side, there is little room for the weak-willed.
70050000061908.name: Against the Storm - Nightwatchers

70050000061915.description:
This pack is primarily a way to support our small team, helping us to continue creating stories and games set in the Riven Realms. If you enjoy our content and want to see it expand, this is a great way to endorse the effort.

As a token of our gratitude for the support, this pack unlocks a single alternative appearance for all Companions* in the game (unique to each Companion). These cosmetics are purely visual, do not alter gameplay in any way, and do not represent “canon” looks for the characters. 70050000061917.description:
This upgrade pack upgrades Simogo Legacy Collection for Nintendo Switch™ to Simogo Legacy Collection – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition.

From cute arcade novelties to innovative text-based thrillers and acclaimed fourth wall-breaking stories, Simogo Legacy Collection is an eclectic celebration of Simogo's past, featuring faithful renditions of seven games released on mobile platforms between 2010 and 2015.

• Kosmo Spin
• Bumpy Road
• Beat Sneak Bandit
• Year Walk (+ Year Walk Companion)
• DEVICE 6
• The Sailor’s Dream
• SPL-T

Additionally, Simogo Legacy Collection features bonus content with thoughtfully curated curios from Simogo's wide-ranging history.

• Year Walk Bedtime Stories for Awful Children – E-book
• The Lighthouse Painting – Audio drama Podcast
• Music – Tracks from Simogo’s history, including previously unreleased tracks
• Images – Illustrations from Simogo’s archive
• Year Walk Prototype – Playable prototype
• Bumpy Road Prototype – Playable prototype
• Rollovski Prototype – Playable prototype
• The Sensational December Machine – Playable short story

Requires understanding of written and spoken English to be fully enjoyed.
70050000061917.name: Simogo Legacy Collection - Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition Upgrade Pack

70050000061921.description: You’ve inherited your grandfather’s old farm plot in Stardew Valley. Armed with hand-me-down tools and a few coins, you set out to begin your new life. Can you learn to live off the land and turn these overgrown fields into a thriving home? It won’t be easy. Ever since Joja Corporation came to town, the old ways of life have all but disappeared. The community center, once the town’s most vibrant hub of activity, now lies in shambles. But the valley seems full of opportunity. With a little dedication, you might just be the one to restore Stardew Valley to greatness!
70050000061921.name: Stardew Valley: Nintendo Switch 2 Edition Upgrade Pack

70050000061922.description:
A daughter of a humble baker by day and a magical girl by destiny, Kaho’s bread-fueled justice comes to life with a freshly-baked moveset that’s as charming as it is chaotic. Whether flinging baguette blasts or unleashing croissant combos, she’s ready to roll… and rise.

Set against the vibrant backdrop of Los Angeles, California the downloadable content package includes:

-One new playable character Kaho Shibuya, a magical girl with the powers of cuteness and bread, available to use on Co-Op- and Battlegrounds Mode.
-Four new enemy mob characters to battle through on the new stage.
-A brand-new stage set in a fictional “LA,” dressed up for Anime Expo season available on Co-Op Mode.
70050000061922.name: Phantom Breaker: Battle Grounds Ultimate - KAHO DLC

70050000062001.description: Lead your SWAT team with confidence as you take on high-stakes hostage rescues and intense firefights. Upgrade your arsenal with the Sight 2 scope for Automatic Rifle III. This DLC enhances your weapon with cutting-edge optics, delivering sharper accuracy, faster target acquisition, and greater control in the heat of combat. Whether breaching enemy strongholds or holding the line under fire, the Sight 2 scope ensures you always have the advantage.
70050000062001.intro: Unlock the Sight 2 scope—precision wins battles.
70050000062001.name: Critical Strike Shooter: SWAT Rescue Missions - Advanced Scope

70050000062018.description:
Welcome to the warm and friendly world of autumn with the Autumn Pack. This DLC brings all the colours, symbols and cozy feelings of the season to your favourite puzzle game. Put your attention to detail and sorting skills to the test as you solve puzzles featuring golden leaves, pumpkins, Halloween items, mushrooms and much more.

Each new level features beautifully themed autumn scenes that spark creativity and soothe your mind. Whether you're arranging jack-o’-lanterns, organizing fall treats, or matching woodland mushrooms, every puzzle delivers satisfying gameplay with a festive twist.

So, why not get into the autumn spirit by giving some new challenges a go?

★ Sort colorful autumn leaves by type and hue
★ Organize spooky Halloween decor like ghosts, bats, and potions
★ Match mushrooms, acorns, and cozy seasonal items
★ Stack pumpkins, candles, and other fall decorations
★ Complete puzzles inspired by crisp forest walks and harvest time

Strengthen your logic and focus while enjoying a stress-free, cozy experience full of autumn magic.
70050000062018.intro: Cozy up with a new seasonal challenge.
70050000062018.name: Find Sort Match - Autumn Pack

70050000062021.description:
Lights, camera… organize! The Hollywood Pack brings the glitz and glam of iconic movies and TV shows into the relaxing world of Find Sort Match. Challenge your logic and creativity in puzzles inspired by blockbuster classics, cult favorites, and legendary scenes.

From arranging film reels and clapperboards to matching costumes, props, and set pieces. This pack offers a unique twist for every movie buff and puzzle lover alike.

Get ready to:
★ Sort famous movie memorabilia and scene props
★ Match iconic costumes, sunglasses, popcorn buckets, and more
★ Organize fictional scripts, VHS tapes, and red-carpet accessories
★ Recreate stylized scenes from cinema history
★ Spot clever references and Easter eggs hidden in the clutter

Perfect for fans of both film and precision, this DLC offers new levels that balance relaxing gameplay with film-inspired flair. Whether you're a casual viewer or a movie encyclopedia, the Hollywood Pack adds a whole new dimension of fun to your Find Sort Match experience.
70050000062021.intro: Enter the spotlight. Sort your way through cinema history!
70050000062021.name: Find Sort Match - Hollywood Pack

70050000062025.description:
Enjoy more brain-teasers with the Puzzle Pack! This time, the focus is on restoring order one piece at a time, whether that's repairing broken plates or assembling jigsaw-style images and intricate puzzles.

Test your logic, patience, and attention to detail as you organize scattered shards and match up picture pieces to reveal beautiful scenes. Whether you're restoring a shattered cup, piecing together a photograph, or completing a fragmented design, every task rewards focus and delivers that satisfying "click" of completion.

★ Rebuild broken plates, cups, and household items
★ Solve fragment puzzles to form complete images
★ Match visual pieces by pattern, color, and shape
★ Enjoy calm, satisfying gameplay with no timers or pressure
★ Discover new relaxing scenarios with every level

The Puzzle Pack expands the Find Sort Match universe with new mechanics and calming tasks that are as soothing as they are stimulating. Sharpen your mind and indulge your love of order in this cozy experience.
70050000062025.intro: Put the pieces together in the most satisfying way!
70050000062025.name: Find Sort Match - Puzzle Pack

70050000062028.description:
Celebrate the most wonderful time of the year with Find Sort Match: Christmas Pack, a special holiday-themed expansion packed with cozy, wintry puzzles. Bring your sorting skills into a magical world filled with snowflakes, festive treats, sparkling decorations, and heartwarming holiday vibes.

From arranging pine-scented candles and string lights to perfectly placing gingerbread cookies and colorful ornaments, each level is a charming nod to classic winter traditions. Whether you're stacking presents under the tree, sorting holiday tableware, or organizing snow globes and gift tags, there's joy in every task.

Get into the seasonal spirit with new activities:
 ★ Decorate trees with shiny baubles and twinkling lights
 ★ Sort snowflakes, candles, cookies, and gift items
 ★ Organize festive feasts, sweets, and hot cocoa stations
 ★ Pack presents with bows and ribbons
 ★ Arrange cozy winter scenes and cheerful holiday goods

The Christmas Pack is perfect for players who love puzzles and the magic of the holidays. It offers a relaxing yet mentally stimulating way to enjoy the season. Improve your focus and attention to detail while enjoying the cosy charm of winter.

Warm up your brain and your heart with Find Sort Match: Christmas Pack.
70050000062028.intro: Settle down by the fire and enjoy solving some puzzles!
70050000062028.name: Find Sort Match - Christmas Pack

70050000062246.description:
Do you love fast-paced kart racing, preferably with family and friends? Have you already raced through the tracks of GRAND PRIX – Racing Champions with Ed & Edda, are you longing for more, and are a fan of Europa-Park? Then we have just the expansion you've been waiting for!

Because ‘Ed & Edda: GRAND PRIX - Goes Europa-Park’ allows you to race through Europa-Park itself at high speed!

• Four brand new tracks at Europa-Park – drive them individually in different modes or one after the other in the Grand Prix!
• Race tracks inspired by the layout of Europa-Park for a real park feeling!
• Drive through many of the park's themed areas, racing past Voltron Nevera, Wodan Timburcoaster or the Eurosat sphere!
• Drive through the famous entrance gate of Europa-Park or venture into the Swiss bobsleigh track with your racer!
• Brand new racing mode: Prove that you are faster than the legendary ‘blue fire Megacoaster’ in the roller coaster challenge – alone or with up to four players in local multiplayer mode!
• 4 new characters with their own racers and designs – race through all the new and old tracks as Rulantica star Snorri, DINO MATES hero Mme Freudenreich, Sock the Allosaurus or the Yomi Rubi!

70050000062489.description:
Enhance your experience on Viewros with this upgrade pack. The Metroid Prime™ 4: Beyond – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition game features enhanced resolution, framerate, and load times. You can also aim with a Joy-Con™ 2 controller as a mouse!

Two display modes let you choose how to experience the adventure. Enjoy more detail in Quality Mode, which runs at 60 frames per second in 4K while docked and in 1080p while in handheld, or prioritize super-smooth action with a higher frame rate in Performance Mode, which runs at 120 frames per second in 1080p while docked and 720p in while in handheld. Both choices are HDR compatible.
70050000062489.intro: Upgrade your adventure on Viewros—only on the Nintendo Switch™ 2 system!
70050000062489.name: Metroid Prime™ 4: Beyond – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition Upgrade Pack

70050000062490.description: Upon purchasing  this DLC, you can claim these Holo-X and Holo-Y in-game apparel items and wear them even during your journey through the main game. Once you unlock the ability to adjust your character’s looks and outfit—about an hour into the main story—you can claim these apparel items by pressing the X Button to open the main menu, and then pressing the − Button to access the Outfit & Looks menu.
70050000062490.intro: Customize your character’s in-game outfit with Holo-X and Holo-Y apparel items
70050000062490.name: Holo-X and Holo-Y Apparel Items

70050000062491.description:
Mysterious distortions have appeared without warning in Lumiose City. They seem to connect to a place known as Hyperspace Lumiose...and the Mythical Pokémon Hoopa has the power to transform them into portals so you can travel there! Hoopa needs your help to do it, though: team up with the mysterious and talented baker, Ansha, to gather Berries and make donuts that will awaken Hoopa’s power and grant you and your Pokémon a variety of useful effects.

Once you’re in Hyperspace Lumiose, join the Mega Evolution successor, Korrina, and Team MZ to investigate its mysteries. Just be sure you’re ready—this otherworldly version of Lumiose City can be a threatening place. The Pokémon here are different, and sometimes rare, with hyperspace levels that can make their total levels exceed the normal limit of 100.

It looks like your story with Team MZ isn’t over yet—continue your journey in Hyperspace Lumiose after completing the main game!

Encounter more newly-discovered Mega Evolutions

As you progress through the Pokémon™ Legends: Z-A – Mega Dimension DLC*, you may encounter more newly-discovered Mega Evolutions, such as two additional ones for Raichu—Mega Raichu X and Mega Raichu Y—as well as Mega Chimecho and Mega Baxcalibur!
70050000062491.intro: Venture into Hyperspace Lumiose for the next chapter of your adventure!
70050000062491.name: Additional story content

70050000062631.description:
Give your supermarket a fresh new look with this exclusive DLC that lets you change the colors of both the interior and exterior of your store. Customize the atmosphere, create a unique style, and make your store stand out from the competition. 70050000062639.description: A rush of blood flows beneath the skin. The skin splits, and the symphony begins. It twists and contorts into a maddening crescendo; more scream than song... Dead by Daylight: Sinister Grace is an original Chapter featuring a new Killer, The Krasue, and a new Survivor, Vee Boonyasak.  Experience a terrifying take on Thai Folklore rooted in visceral body-horror.

Plus, many never-before-seen Blue Oni make their terrifying debut!

What story hides behind the main game?
Who is the new Blue Oni lurking in the ruins!?

• Discover eight unique regions, from the ocean’s depths to an island in the clouds

Sadie and Moss are ready to become full-time playable characters. Join them as they leave the NPC life behind and attend the Monster Con to have a good time… and find love, if they’re lucky!

Put on your favorite cosplay and grab your autograph book, because you’re going to the nerdiest convention ever... and becoming a hot, nerdy monster yourself!

In the metroidvania MARS 2120, you are sent on a rescue mission to Earth's first colony on Mars. Something terrible has happened, and it's up to you to uncover the truth. Combining intense melee combat, action-packed shootouts, and elemental special abilities, you'll need to explore hostile environments, face relentless enemies, and uncover the secrets of a threat that may extend far beyond the red planet.

With the “The More, The Merrier” DLC, the journey becomes even more challenging.

Play your way
Now with the long-awaited option to reconfigure controls.

Two new game modes
New Game+ - Relive the campaign while keeping your upgrades, but face stronger and more lethal enemies and bosses (health and damage increased by 1.5x).
New Game++ - For the most fearless, an even greater challenge: enemies and bosses with double health and damage.

New achievements
Each new game mode brings exclusive achievements to reward only the most skilled.

Get ready to return to Mars, test your limits, and prove that you can master every battle. After all, the harder... the better.
70050000064575.intro: Sci-fi Metroidvania set on Mars, now with two new difficulty levels.
70050000064575.name: MARS 2120 - The more, the merrier

70050000064585.description:
"The nostalgia of the tracks is back with even more excitement! The classic Top Racer Collection, which brings together four legendary racing games from the 90s, now receives brand-new content: the Top Racer Customs DLC.

And it doesn’t stop there: customized cars can be shared with other players. Who will be able to create the ultimate machine? This is your chance to build the perfect car for every track and challenge friends and rivals in adrenaline-fueled races.

Main features of the Top Racer Customs DLC (for Top Racer 1):
Performance tuning: speed, acceleration, nitro, and fuel capacity.
4 brand-new exclusive cars inspired by 80s and 90s icons.

70050000064608.description:
SHARES

The new "Shares" feature enables players to issue shares for their complete properties (eg. Player has all 3 blue color lands and he can issue 2,3 or 4 shares for them to be bought by other players).

When other player buys a share, he then gets % of the rent that is paid when some players lands on that blue land.

If 4 shares are issued from player A and then player B buys one share, then when player C lands on that blue land, player A will not get the full rent from player C, but only 75% of it. The other 25% of the rent will go to player B.

BONDS

Bonds (also called obligations) are debt papers issued from one player to other player (1 to 1). Bond issuer takes X money as debt to bond holder. Bond issuer later has to payback that money + some predefined interest. The bond issuer has to return the loaned amount and interest in X turns (defined when the bond is issued).

Failed to do so will default the bond, forcing the debtor (bond issuer) to pay the owned money to the bond holder or to go bankrupt.

Both shares and bonds can be traded in the game.

Other players can buy shares and bonds throughout the game at their own terms/prices.
70050000064608.intro:
Issue SHARES for your complete properties to raise money.
Hold a BONDS (Obligations) on other players
70050000064608.name: Rento Shares & Bonds

70050000064835.description:
Rento Dice Configurator is an optional dice editor addon, which allows you to make your own custom dice to be used in the online, solo and local games.

These custom dice are used when you turn on the setting "multiple dice".

In this game setting when each player has turn, he is allowed to choose which dice to roll. Apart from the default 1 2 3 4 5 6 dice, you can create custom dice with digits between 0 and 10 (including).

For example you can make dice like: 0  5  7  7  10  10   or   0  0   10  10  1  1.

Apart from the default die 1 2 3 4 5 6, you can make 4 more dice to be used in the game (so total 5 dice maximum).

There are 2 limitations as well:
-The sum of all 6 dice sides must be maximum 40
-Each custom die must have 3 even sides and 3 odd sides

Another thing to note - in games with multiple dice - if you roll doubles - you will not roll again.
70050000064835.name: Rento Dice Configurator

70050000065052.description:
You and your friend just crash-landed on an alien planet harboring a secret source of powerful magic. All of reality is on the verge of collapse, and two magical creatures have chosen you as their heroes. To save the planet, you’ll fight, die, and bond with the Stormhearts to rise again — stronger, fiercer, and unstoppable.

Storm Lancers is a fast-paced rogue-like, where every run means dodging death, overcoming enemies, and mastering powerful skills. The battle is on, so team up in chaotic co-op for survival.

GAME FEATURES

ROGUE-LIKE ACTION
On Cryptica, no two runs are the same. Explore ever-shifting biomes in HDR at a smooth 60 FPS, where every leap, slash, and dash brings you one step closer to unraveling the mystery. Discover powerful gear, master randomized weapons, and earn permanent upgrades that transform your base move set into an acrobatic arsenal.

CHAOTIC COUCH CO-OP
Help a friend then nab a rare drop right out from under them. This is all-out, rogue-like action that’s even better with two. Whether you’re having trouble with a later biome or just looking to add some chaos, a friend can dive in instantly in couch co-op or online with GameShare. If your partner drops, keep playing seamlessly in solo mode to stay in the action.

BOSSES & ENEMIES
From a machine race that consumes planets to alien flora and fauna that want to kill everything, fight through bosses and enemies who will force you to think faster, fight harder, and adapt quickly. This is an ever-changing battlefield where killer instincts and survival skills are everything.

WEAPONS & ABILITIES
Grow your acrobatic moveset with permanent upgrades like slide, dash, and double jump. Plus, experiment with an evolving arsenal, flaming swords, razor-sharp katars, rifles, hammers, and grenade launchers. Each weapon is designed for destruction, so choose wisely — or die quickly.

KEY FEATURES
• Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition—Enhanced with improved resolution, HDR, faster load times, and smoother performance
• Rogue-like Action—Playing at a smooth 60 FPS
• Chaotic Co-op—Invite a friend for couch co-op or online co-op with GameShare
• Grow Your Acrobatics—Unlock permanent upgrades, like slide, dash, and double jump
• Test Your Power—Mix and match weapons, abilities, and powerups run after run
• An Alien Mystery—Face shifting biomes and alien bosses to unravel the mystery
70050000065052.name: Storm Lancers – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition Upgrade Pack

70050000065074.description:
Descend once more into Mythringal - if you dare - with additional gameplay, game modes, and a much-requested New Game Plus mode to uncover secrets only the most devoted players will recognize.

Key Features:
The ultimate test awaits. Face 7 new merciless unique enemies and 5 unforgiving bosses in Awakened Ancients.

All new gameplay area and game modes.

Dungeon Mode. Once you have obtained the Nighthunter’s Grappling Claw, this area will become accessible within Oxnevylle Manor. In this new game mode, players can use 3 new characters to find new unique weapons, bosses, enemies, NPCs and items. Be rewarded with a new skin for completing.

New Game +. Take on an even more challenging journey with Eryk or as one of 3 new characters (after being unlocked in Dungeon Mode) in New Game Plus. Not challenging enough? Try NG+2, NG+3, and beyond. Note that previous save data will be replaced and all events will be reset.

Boss Rush Mode. Only available after completing the main game, start a New Game Plus and a new option will appear in the Extra section of the main menu. Take on all the bosses of The Last Faith as Eryk or 3 new characters, including optional bosses (excluding bosses from new Dungeon Mode). Be rewarded with a new skin for completing.

Tower of Despair. How long can you survive? The Tower of Despair is also accessible after completing the main game in the Extra section of the main menu, in this survival-style mode take down multiple waves of enemies from each act of the game as either Eryk or 3 new characters.

New executions and gameplay improvements. Wicked enemies deserve wicked takedowns. Defeat them with style with all new executions and gameplay improvements.

New selectable characters, items and weapons. Even more to explore and find in the new areas introduced in Awakened Ancients.
70050000065074.intro: Awakened Ancients delivers long-awaited content, answers, deeper challenges and the most polished version of The Last Faith to date.
70050000065074.name: The Last Faith: Awakened Ancients

70050000065183.description:
The Shinigami Descends DLC

Long watching from the veil of shadows, the Shinigami now steps into the arena. Cold, patient, and all-knowing, he fights not for glory or pride, but to decide how every story ends.

On the battlefield, the Shinigami is both inevitability and execution. He adapts to his opponent’s style, turning their own strength against them with devastating precision. Every strike is measured. Every movement is inevitable. To face him is to confront your final moment.

This DLC pack includes the playable character Shinigami, featuring a fully unique move set with stance-shifting combat, ritual executions, and soul-stealing finishers. Also included is a new stage, The Twilight Gate, where spirits wander between life and death — accompanied by an original music track composed exclusively for this release.

70050000065490.description:
Rediscover the boldest era of racing innovation with the Formula Legends: Tech Pack DLC. This pack introduces three legendary machines inspired by real-world technological breakthroughs — reimagined for the modern Formula Legends experience.

Each car in the Tech Pack captures a moment in motorsport history when creativity and engineering pushed beyond convention. Whether it’s radical aerodynamics, experimental traction systems, or perfect late-90s precision, these cars were built to challenge everything you know about racing.

Included Cars:

TramTram Cyclone – A fearless seventies design built around experimental aerodynamic technology. Master its unique handling and experience the raw power of its innovation.

HexaTyre 34 – An audacious multi-wheel marvel that redefines traction and control. Take on corners with impossible grip and feel every ounce of its mechanical ingenuity.

Jorsey BeeSting – Sleek, balanced, and lightning-quick. This nineties classic embodies engineering elegance and championship spirit.

Push the limits of innovation. Dominate the track with three of the most daring machines ever conceived in Formula Legends: Tech Pack DLC.
70050000065490.intro: Discover three groundbreaking cars in the Formula Legends: Tech Pack DLC! Inspired by bold eras of racing, each machine brings unique tech, daring design, and thrilling performance.
70050000065490.name: Formula Legends : Tech Power Pack

70050000065491.description:
Take your airport to new heights with this DLC! Experience a transformed sky that evolves with each in-game day, reflecting unique atmospheres, weather variations, and lighting conditions.

From bright sunrises to stormy nights, the sky now changes with each day, adding realism, atmosphere, and a touch of magic to every airport operation. Every flight feels alive under ever-changing skies, making your airport truly dynamic.

Bring the skies to life and make your airport more beautiful than ever!
70050000065491.intro: The sky changes, your airport evolves.
70050000065491.name: Airport Manager Simulator 2025: Beyond the Clouds

70050000065496.description:
Drive the Machines That Shaped History

Step into the world of racing innovation with the Pioneer Pack, a collection of three legendary machines that redefined speed, design, and engineering. From the golden age of racing to the modern era of precision performance, these cars don’t just compete—they tell the story of progress itself.

Included Cars:
Mclauden MID 70
It seemed built to chase the sun. Its golden body reflected every ray, and its heart pulsed with a steady, human-like rhythm. It didn’t race to win, but to exist in motion — a symbol of pure balance between light and speed.
Tram Tram Late 60
Raw and essential, made of strength and sound. Every curve told the story of a mechanical legend being born. It didn’t seek perfection, but the truth of speed — and its daring design introduced ideas that would change motorsport forever.
Gass Mid 20
A force of steel and carbon, driven by the spirit of challenge. Every piece seemed carved with pride and determination, echoing the roar of endless highways and racing hearts. Bold in line, fierce in heart, and free in soul.

Experience the Evolution of Motorsport
From the pioneers of innovation to the heroes of the modern track, the Pioneer Pack celebrates those who dared to redefine speed. Discover three cars that embody passion, progress, and pure performance.
70050000065496.intro: From classic icons to modern marvels, the Pioneer Pack brings three cars that embody courage, creativity, and the spirit of racing evolution.
70050000065496.name: Formula Legends : Pioneer Pack

70050000065500.description:
Step into the dawn of a transformative era in motorsport. The Early 2010’s Season Pack introduces two new cars and era-specific content that capture the innovation, unpredictability, and rapid evolution of the early 2010s — now fully integrated into Story Mode.

Lead your team with the new early-2010s generic chassis, representing the era’s core design philosophy across the grid. Then take on the challenge of the Early ’10 (Flower) — a bold car featuring a distinctive asymmetrical front-end concept and experimental aerodynamic ideas inspired by the period’s most daring engineering.

This era also marks the arrival of turbo-hybrid power units, a breakthrough that reshaped performance and dramatically reordered the competitive field. With its complete Story Mode integration, you’ll experience the narrative shifts, strategic upheavals, and rising rivalries that defined this pivotal decade.

This DLC includes:
2 new cars:
 - Generic early-2010s chassis
 - Early ’10 (Flower) with its radical asymmetric aero concept
A fully integrated Early 2010’s Season in Story Mode
Era-inspired liveries and visual elements
New challenges and scenarios reflecting key moments of the decade
Expanded season variety to enrich your Formula Legends journey

Relive the birth of the turbo-hybrid era — when innovation surged, power shifted, and racing changed forever.
70050000065500.intro: Dominate the Early 2010s turbo-hybrid era with a new season, two thrilling cars, and Story Mode!
70050000065500.name: Formula Legends : Early 2010’s Season Pack

70050000065507.description: Take a journey back to racing’s golden era with DLC 5 for Formula Legends! Step into the cockpit of the GoodJob Mi90, a sleek and daring classic built for precision and speed, and the Fyrex Early70, a vintage powerhouse made for pure track domination. Feel the roar of the engines, master every challenging curve, and experience the thrill that defined a generation of racing. With these legendary machines, the past comes alive—and the race is yours to win!
70050000065507.intro: Two Legendary Machines. Endless Classic Thrills.
70050000065507.name: Formula Legends : Turbo Power Pack

Work alongside Zhan Tianyou, the “Father of China's Railroad”, to transform the first railway connections into a proud national network, forming the backbone of expansion and progress.

Forge your expansive railway empire in the Middle Kingdom, powered by steam, steel, and ambition!

• The Middle Kingdom: Railway Empire 2 – Steel Dragons lets you explore and expand your railway network upon China while you enjoy the sights and sounds of the varied lands of the Middle Kingdom, including the Temple of Heaven.

• Smoke & Steel – Dragons unleashed:  Utilize 8 new authentic Chinese locomotives such as the “Rocket of China” and the Shèngli 8.

• Shanghai, Peking and Lanzhou: The DLC introduces 3 comprehensive, fully voiced scenarios, “Humble Beginnings” (1880), "Journey to the West” (1890) and "Of Bicycles and Fireworks” (1900).

• Forge ahead: The vast and varied landscapes of the Middle Kingdom await you on the regional "China" maps – playable on  5 individual map sections.

• Treasures of the Dragon: Transport more than 20 new regional products from traditional Medicine and mind-blowing Fireworks, to Bamboo, Gunpowder, and exquisite Silk Products.

• Pipa, Guzheng, and Suona: Over 15 themed music tracks and jingles inspired by traditional Chinese music to get you in the mood for the new setting.

70050000065664.description:
Unleash Turtle Power!
Grab your friends, pick your favorite Turtle and jump into an adventure to save Master Splinter from the Foot Clan! Master ninja skills, unite in bodacious online and local co-op gameplay, and conquer iconic NYC locales.

Bodacious Co-Op Gameplay
Brace yourself for fast-paced, roguelike action where no two runs are the same. With randomized power-ups, room layouts, and boss modifiers, the excitement never ends. Take control of all four Turtles, each wielding unique powers, and team up with friends for bodacious co-op gameplay. Explore iconic NYC locations, upgrade your Turtle powers, and prepare to face off against formidable enemies.

Build Your Power
Master the powers of water and fire, utrom and ooze, light and darkness, and -most importantly- Ninja to create unique and bodacious builds for your Turtles. Every run brings new challenges and opportunities - explore and perfect your favorite builds, and combine them with allies to conquer your enemies.

A Thrilling Story
When Splinter is kidnapped by Shredder, mysterious portals appear across NYC and the Turtles will battle to recover their father from the clutches of the Foot Clan. However, an even greater threat lingers in the shadows…

Splintered Fate promises to keep you engaged in the FIGHT, ADAPT, REPEAT portal loop. Be ready to restore peace to the city!

Optimized for Nintendo Switch 2!
70050000065664.intro: Unleash the Turtles in a roguelike quest to rescue Splinter from the Foot Clan! Unite in bodacious co-op gameplay, and conquer NYC locales. Now on Nintendo Switch™ 2!

70050000066047.description:
NINJA FOR LIFE
She's ready for action...and to get back at Shredder.
Meet Alopex, a mutant arctic fox and ninja assassin who went from being unwaveringly loyal to Shredder to a true friend of the Turtles. Expertly swinging her sickle-like kama, she slices at her foes with ease. Hurling her kunai at close range, she deals a powerful blast of damage. And the best part-- she can briefly become invulnerable while targeting multiple enemies in rapid succession. Ninja powers that modify shuriken also affect her kunai, so try her out with the Ninja, Flame, and Water Powers for maximum impact.

NEW STORY
Indebted to the Turtles, Alopex joins their fight to rescue Splinter. But things get complicated for her along the way as she faces off against her former sister-in-arms, Karai. Shredder previously held sway over Alopex, but when she escaped his grasp Karai stayed behind, leaving them on opposite sides when they used to be partners. In this story, she wrestles with self-doubt as her past catches up with her, and she needs to find the strength to overcome it.

NEW WAYS TO PLAY

70050000066476.description:
Factorio: Space Age continues the player's journey after launching rockets into space.
Discover new worlds with unique challenges, exploit their novel resources for advanced technological gains, and manage your fleet of interplanetary space platforms.

Space platforms
The backbone of planetary logistics and the first foray into space.
Space platforms are flying factories that act as the means of transportation between planets.
 - Build defenses to shoot down incoming asteroids which threaten to smash your platform.
 - Catch asteroid chunks, crush them and process them into thruster fuel and turret ammunition.
 - Use the Platform hub and Cargo bays to shuttle cargo between planets.

Vulcanus
Blazing volcanic mountains, imposing geological landforms, plains blanketed in ash, and thick yellow sulfuric fog that burns your lungs and etches your eyes.
Extract and refine tough unbreakable Tungsten to craft big mining drills and foundries.
 - Pull lava from the pits to produce an abundance of molten iron and copper.
 - Research advanced metallurgic technologies to build an industrial forge-world.

Fulgora
A lifeless and desolate place.
The thin air is freezing cold but bone dry.
A distant sun twinkles in the dull purple of the sky.
Wispy clouds race by as a gale whips up sand that grates against your armour.
 - Protect yourself from the nightly lightning storms, harness their unrelenting power for your own electricity needs.
 - Reclaim the high-tech scraps and ruins of a long-forgotten civilization and recycle them into usable products.
 - Unlock the advanced electromagnetic and superconducting powers of Holmium.

Gleba
A vibrant multi-coloured swampy landscape shrouded in a light mist.
The air is thick and humid, carrying the muffled cries of unseen animals from far away.
 - Discover exotic plants, cultivate and harvest their fruits with Agriculture towers.
 - Cook, crush, and process your produce before they rot and turn to spoilage.
 - Venture into a new realm of biochemical engineering.

Aquilo
It's day, but stars still twinkle in the dark sky.
You count the planet's sun among the stars, larger and brighter than the others, but still so you can barely feel its warmth at all.
A howling wind chills you to the bone and gently rocks the iceberg you are sitting on.
 - Build heat pipes to keep your machines operational in the freezing cold.
 - Extend your factory by building ice platforms.
 - Unlock the power of cryogenic technologies and fusion power.

Elevated rails
Take your trains to the next level!
Elevated rails bring a whole new dimension of challenge and possibility to your rail networks.
 - Heavy-duty rail ramps and supports to elevate your rails.
 - Cross over any obstacles, build supports on the water to cross oceans.
 - Design advanced multi-level intersections to optimize your train system.

Quality
Make high tiers of quality of all your items, machines and equipment.
 - Every Item, Entity, and Equipment has 5 possible qualities, from Normal to Legendary!
 - Research the new Quality modules, use them to craft higher quality items and intermediates.
 - Each level of quality gives a greater bonus, machines craft faster, equipment is more powerful, turrets have increased range, etc.

New enemies and defenses
Some new planets are inhabited by unique and dangerous creatures you will need to defend against.

Space Age Music
Each new planet is accompanied by a unique soundtrack by Czech composer Petr Wajsar.
 - 1+ hour of music for each of the new Planets + Space.
 - Professionally recorded orchestral performance.
70050000066476.name: Factorio: Space Age

70050000067222.description:
This is the original soundtrack for Dark Auction!

Featuring a total of 26 tracks.
The soundtrack is led by Yuko Komiyama
and Tsukasa Masuko,
with additional contributions from Yoshitaka Onishi, Takako Yumishima, and Ayumi Sumiki.

Select tracks also feature live performances by a jazz band.
Refined jazz sounds beautifully enhance the unique atmosphere of Dark Auction.

Jazz Band Performances
