Acoustic Bass: Shigeki Serizawa
Drums: Kenta Okamoto
Tenor Sax: Mitsuharu Ouchi
Trumpet: Atsushi Ozawa
Violin: Daisei Mii
70050000067222.intro:
The Auction of Dark Memories Begins Now.
What truths await beyond a bid made with your life?
70050000067222.name: Dark Auction Original Soundtrack

70050000067223.description:
It’s tiiiiiiime!
Deck the halls with festive cheer. This cozy pack features a customizable Christmas tree, twinkling lights, stockings to hang by the fireplace, festive wreaths, and elegant holiday dinner settings.
70050000067223.intro: Build your dream nook — one pixel at a time!
70050000067223.name: Christmas

70050000067227.description:
This sinister heroine weaves together the threads of battle with a style unlike any other. The Weaver commands a host of (mostly) adorable Pets, creatures bound in silk and shadow, who lend their aid to her cause.
As with other characters, the Weaver introduces her own pool of new cards (90+) and artifacts (50+), including a brand new card type!
70050000067227.intro: One of many skittering siblings, she has woven her own path and returned with friends in tow.
70050000067227.name: The Weaver

70050000067228.description: Expand your collection of puzzles with 6 new illustrations that will give you the thrill of meeting intriguing strangers on a tropical vacation.
70050000067228.intro: Relax and enjoy completing beautiful picture puzzles piece by piece.
70050000067228.name: Portraits Pack 1

70050000067241.description:
Kickstart your extreme cycling adventure with a generous boost! This DLC grants you 10,000 cash to spend freely in the game. Unlock new bike models, upgrade your gear, or customize your character to your heart’s content.

Whether you’re aiming for daring stunts or exploring every hidden corner, this cash injection gives you the freedom to accelerate your journey and stand out on every ride.
70050000067241.intro: Power up your cash flow - fuel your BMX fortune.
70050000067241.name: BMX CITY RUN: Cash Surge

70050000067242.description:
A new pack that adds 6 popular VTuber songs is now available as additional downloadable content for "GROOVE COASTER FUTURE PERFORMERS"!

This pack includes the following content.

■ Songs (6 tracks)
- Carnivorous Plant / RIM
- Ahoy!! We are Houshou Pirates / Houshou Marine
- CapSule / Mori Calliope x Hoshimachi Suisei
- Born to be "BAU"DOL☆★ / FUWAMOCO
- SHUKUSEI!! RORI GAMI REKUIEMU☆ / Shigure Ui
- Kiss Kitsune / HIMEHINA

All songs can be enjoyed immediately in "Performance" mode once the DLC is installed, and some tracks will also be added as challenge songs to certain stages in "Story" mode.
70050000067242.intro: A pack featuring 6 popular VTuber songs is now available!
70050000067242.name: VTuber Music Pack

70050000067248.description:
Embark on an adventure to Winter Festival Island with Baby Ogu!
Find the missing village chief and uncover the secrets hidden on the island.

<New Areas>
Trouble has broken out on Winter Festival Island, where a festival is held every month to celebrate the winter season.
 What secrets lie hidden on Winter Festival Island, where the village chief has vanished and a yeti has been unleashed?
This DLC adds 45 new maps, including dungeons, for you to explore.
<To Winter Festival Island!>
Take a hot air balloon from Snowflake Village and head to Winter Festival Island!
Many residents on Winter Festival Island, where the village chief has disappeared, are in need of Baby Ogu’s help.
From familiar headbutt puzzles to mine carts, inverted towers, and the trials of the divine beasts — a wide variety of content awaits those who enjoyed the main story.

<Local Multiplayer: 1v1 Tennis>
Become one of the bug villagers and enjoy a tennis match with your friend!
 Choose your own underwear color and compete in a prideful one-on-one battle.
70050000067248.intro: Embark on an adventure to Winter Festival Island with Baby Ogu! Find the missing village chief and uncover the secrets hidden on the island. Includes a 1v1 local tennis battle game.
70050000067248.name: Ogu and the Secret Forest - Winter Festival Blast

70050000067251.description:
This DLC is playable in Taiko no Tatsujin: Rhythm Festival game modes like Taiko Mode and Great Drum Toy War.

- Song: KUSUSHIKI
Easy ★2, Normal ★2, Hard ★5, Extreme ★8

- Song: Same Blue
Easy ★2, Normal ★4, Hard ★5, Extreme ★7

*This product is not compatible with Taiko no Tatsujin: Drum'n'Fun!
*The songs included in this product may be available in the Taiko Music Pass. Please take care to avoid duplicate purchases.
70050000067251.name: Taiko no Tatsujin: Rhythm Festival - Anime Pack Vol. 6

70050000067253.description:
In the underworld, where creatures of all shapes and sizes live, a Selection Battle is announced to decide the next Overlord. Complete labyrinths and collect crystals to achieve the title of Overlord!

Proceed through dungeon-like labyrinths building up your card deck in a roguelite style! There are up to 5 different labyrinth themes based on card genres like poison or graveyards. Enjoy a different deck experience each time you visit the labyrinth as the number of cards increases. Over 300 types of cards and 150 types of treasure await you, so combos and combinations are up to you.

Let's conquer the labyrinths and become the next Overlord!

Features:
- Card-deck turn-based battles
- Labyrinth exploration in a roguelite style
- Up to 5 unique labyrinth themes
- Over 300 types of cards
- Over 150 types of treasure
- And more elements you'd expect from a JRPG and roguelike game!
70050000067253.intro: A card deck-building roguelite! Explore labyrinths each time from level 1!
70050000067253.name: Overrogue: Nintendo Switch 2 Edition Upgrade Pack

70050000067263.intro: Become a creature of the night and sink your teeth into this customization pack for Farm Together 2!
70050000067263.name: Farm Together 2 - Gothic Pack

70050000067279.description:
Sho, a young man who spends his days in an exploitative company in modern Japan, is reincarnated into a parallel universe as Shaw, due to an accident!

While the job given in his new life is 'Unemployed' and hardships continue with a bad luck party, one day he acquires the ultimate job as a Sage, suddenly becoming the strongest with ultra rare passive skills!

Aiming for the long-awaited mellow life he finds himself in a battle to defeat the Overlord after meeting the Hero Viola.

With exceptional passive skills that for example can change the future by returning before Game Over, get rid of enemies in turn-based battles by summoning spirits or managing mana plants, or even use the skills of monsters!

Complete quests and raise the guild rank so you can challenge deeper dungeon or other adventuring parties, too! With other elements such as a battle arena and the dungeon where treasure chests are automatically generated, your adventure against the Overlord's Army will surely be an unparalleled quest to finally gain a calm, modest life!
70050000067279.intro: Quest for a parallel universe after being reborn with the ultimate job!
70050000067279.name: Isekai Rondo: Nintendo Switch 2 Edition Upgrade Pack

70050000067284.description:
Give your dragon a powerful edge with this exclusive DLC! Once activated, your dragon gains +100 additional health, allowing you to survive tougher battles and dominate even the fiercest monsters.

Become stronger, last longer, and push deeper into every realm with enhanced durability.
70050000067284.intro: Survive longer and unleash unstoppable power.
70050000067284.name: Dragons Legacy : Monsters Lair – Survival Boost

70050000067288.description: This is a pass to upgrade the Nintendo Switch™ software “PRITTO PRISONER” to “PRITTO PRISONER – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition.”
70050000067288.name: PRITTO PRISONER - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition upgrade pack

70050000067294.description:
The Late 2020’s (2026)Season Pack brings present-day racing to Formula Legends. This new DLC brings 8 new teams, each with 2 drivers and custom helmets, along with 2 new liveries per team, a new championship, updated next-generation season rules, and a brand-new track — all fully integrated into Story Mode.

Compete in a new championship featuring modernized racing rules that reflect the latest innovations and standards in professional motorsport. Every decision matters, as strategy, skill, and precision define the outcome. Race on the Azerbaijan track, a contemporary circuit that challenges timing, overtaking, and tactical thinking.

With this DLC, the Late 2020’s (2026)Season Pack delivers a complete, authentic and engaging present-day racing experience — perfect for fans of modern motorsport and Story Mode enthusiasts alike.

This DLC includes:
8 new teams
16 new drivers with unique helmets
16 new liveries (2 per team)
1 new Story Mode championship
Updated next-generation season rules
1 new track: Azerbaijan

Experience the thrill of present-day Formula Legends — where every team, every driver and every race counts.
70050000067294.intro: Race with 8 new teams, 16 drivers, and next-generation season rules — the latest era of Formula Legends starts now.
70050000067294.name: Formula Legends : Late 2020’s (2026)Season Pack

70050000067295.description:
The future of racing is electric.
Expand your Formula Legends experience with Formula E: Electric Evolution, the official all-electric championship. Get behind the wheel of cutting-edge Formula E cars and compete on iconic city circuits around the world.
From Berlin to Tokyo, London to São Paulo, Miami to Shanghai, every race demands precision, strategy, and total control. Master the unique challenges of electric racing, where energy management, timing, and racecraft define victory.

Key Features
Official Formula E experience: Compete in the world’s premier all-electric racing series
6 real-world circuits: Berlin, Tokyo, London, São Paulo, Miami, Shanghai
3 generations of cars: Gen 1, Gen 2, and Gen 3 EVO
Authentic Attack Mode: Activate boosted performance through strategic off-line zones, just like real races
Double Header race weekends: Take on two consecutive races on the same circuit, each with its own qualifying session
Manual team selection: Choose which teams compete alongside you on the grid
Fully integrated: Career, Quick Race, and Time Trials

Precision. Strategy. Energy.
This is the evolution of racing.
70050000067295.intro: Race the official Formula E championship across real-world city circuits, mastering energy, strategy, and cutting-edge electric performance.
70050000067295.name: Formula Legends : Formula E - Electric Evolution

70050000067309.description: If you purchase SUPER BOMBERMAN COLLECTION for Nintendo Switch™, you only need to purchase the upgrade pack to play the Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition.
70050000067309.name: SUPER BOMBERMAN COLLECTION - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition Upgrade Pack

70050000067314.description:
This is a large-scale DLC, with content far exceeding the base game and offering nearly 80 hours of gameplay. This DLC brings you the Dustlands like you've never experienced them before. With a new underground realm, exciting ruin exploration gameplay, and gripping storylines, you'll be immersed in the dangerous and opportunity-filled world of Dustland Delivery. Fix up your truck, call up your crew, and get ready for a brand new adventure!

※New Underground World: Sheol

Enter subway stations to travel between the darkness of the underground and the all-pervading danger of the surface. Explore and survive in two different worlds where your every decision could determine the future of the Dustlands.

• Volcanos and Glaciers: New terrain types bring whole new experiences. Change your strategy to fit the terrain, carefully shepherding resources to survive in the Dustlands.
 • Underground Cities and Factions: The cities of the underground are denser than the surface, each one with its own unique cultures and factions who could be potential allies—or potential enemies. Your choices will determine the balance of power in world of the underground.

※Ruins Exploration: No Risk, No Reward

Mysterious ruins lie scattered across the underground, symbols of the glories of the old world fraught with danger—and opportunity.

• Explore Ruins: Pull your crew out of your truck and send them to explore ruins filled with deadly traps, powerful enemies, and priceless loot. They'll need all their cunning to survive.
 • Incredible Rewards: Ruins are filled with rare equipment, road-building survey data, and other priceless resources. Every successful exploration will grant you huge rewards, helping you to stay alive in the underground.

※New Storyline: The Dustlands' Final Chapter

Deep in the underground lurks a secret that could shake the Dustlands to their foundations. The decision is yours: will you bring the truth to light?

• Experience a vast main storyline, with over 20 brand new side stories.
• Uncover mysteries, choose your own path, and witness the end of the Dustlands as we know it.
70050000067314.name: Sheol

70050000067342.description:
Venture beyond the trash pile in the first major expansion for Royal Vermin!

This downloadable content adds over 50 new levels and 4 brand new game modes. Discover new playable characters and face off against your friends in even crazier and more varied arenas.

Unlock more hats and outfits to customize your vermin. Some say the rat goes faster with a banana on his head.

Beyond the Waste is for players who want even more chaos, variety and fun with friends. All content is permanent, accessible offline and unlocked immediately after purchase.

If you loved the fast and unpredictable battles of Royal Vermin, this expansion multiplies the fun by four. More levels, more game modes, more laughs, more everything. Just pure local multiplayer fun.
70050000067342.intro: New worlds, new challenges, four times the content!
70050000067342.name: Beyond the Waste

70050000067403.description:
The battles fought. The pain endured. All of it leads back to him. The Upside Down has returned to The Fog, darkening the Realms with Vecna’s chilling presence. Only by banding together does hope stand the slightest chance.

Dead by Daylight: Stranger Things Chapter 2 includes a new Killer, Vecna, The First, and new Survivors, Dustin Henderson and Eleven. Purchasing this Add-On unlocks the Mind Flayer Badge and the Bloody Rainbow Room Banner.
70050000067403.name: Dead by Daylight: Stranger Things Chapter 2

70050000067505.description: Rev up your racing experience with the Expansion Pack #1 DLC! This pack introduces three stunning new liveries for your race cars, adding style and personality to your high-speed adventures.
70050000067505.intro: Feel the Speed, Own the Track!
70050000067505.name: Formula Racing Pro 2026 Expansion Pack #1

70050000067506.description: Take your racing game to the next level with the Expansion Pack #2 DLC! This pack delivers three exclusive liveries, each designed to make your car a true showstopper on the circuit.
70050000067506.intro: Feel the Speed, Own the Track!
70050000067506.name: Formula Racing Pro 2026 Expansion Pack #2

70050000067507.description: Unleash your inner champion with the Expansion Pack #3 DLC! This pack features three bold and eye-catching liveries, giving your race car a fresh, competitive edge.
70050000067507.intro: Feel the Speed, Own the Track!
70050000067507.name: Formula Racing Pro 2026 Expansion Pack #3

70050000067508.description: Cross the finish line in style with the Expansion Pack #4 DLC! This pack includes three exclusive liveries, each crafted to bring a unique flair to your racing experience.
70050000067508.intro: Feel the Speed, Own the Track!
70050000067508.name: Formula Racing Pro 2026 Expansion Pack #4

70050000067517.description: Expand your creative space with the new DLC. The set includes an elegant desk, a comfortable chair, and other accessories that let you create your dream office. Work in style!
70050000067517.name: Little Cozy Home: Creative Desk

70050000067518.description: Discover brand-new decorating possibilities with the new DLC. The pack includes stylish sofas, chairs, and accessories that will give your living room a unique atmosphere. Create a space you’ll always want to come back to.
70050000067518.name: Little Cozy Home: Cozy Living

70050000067522.description: By purchasing this content, you can upgrade the Nintendo Switch™ version of "BEYBLADE X EVOBATTLE" to "BEYBLADE X EVOBATTLE Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition."
70050000067522.name: BEYBLADE X EVOBATTLE Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition Upgrade Pack

70050000067547.description:
Reflections from the past, these retro inspired skins present Kain and Raziel as they appear in Legacy of Kain: Ascendance.
Includes:
-        Sarafan Ascendant – Skin for Raziel
-        Imperial Ascendant – Skin for Kain
70050000067547.name: Legacy of Kain: Defiance Remastered - Ascendance Skin Pack

70050000067605.description:
Through the World Tour Traffic Pack(2), players in the 'Richman 4 Fun' game can upgrade their character's transportation style to an exclusive design and extend the usage time from the original 5 turns to 10 turns every time they use a car or bike card!

The bundle includes exclusive car and bike transportation designs (characters not included) for the following 10 game characters:

Exclusive car and bike for Zhao Ling Er

70050000067605.intro: Happily Dash with Character-Specific Cars and Bikes! Explore the World Map, Accelerate from 5 Turns to 10!
70050000067605.name: World Tour Traffic Pack(2)

70050000067620.description:
Embark on an adventure with five exciting new looks for your Onbu.
The Onbu Skin Pack contains the following new skins:
- Azurda, the Cold Fire
- Aloba, Desert Sovereign
- Kizu, the Golden
- Makthaja of the Jungle
- Ourodon, the Amphibian
Skins only affect visual appearance and have no impact on gameplay.
70050000067620.intro: Embark on an adventure with five exciting new looks for your Onbu.
70050000067620.name: The Wandering Village: Onbu Skin Pack

70050000067625.description:
The Deserters & Disciples DLC is here to further add to the myriad ways you can approach Barony's deadly dungeons! This time we're bringing FIVE new races and classes, each introducing rich, fun, and unique mechanics to Barony for the first time.

Like before, monster races have a preferred class that can also be used by humans. Your new races can either use their signature class, or play as any of the stock classes from Barony! When you finish the game as a monster race, you'll unlock its signature class for any race to play. As always, you can wear monster skins as a costume without any gameplay changes if you prefer. Don't worry, you can still play with anyone who doesn't own the DLC.

Gremlins are short, wily, and mischievous. The only race in this DLC who Shopkeepers refuse to trade with! They get an extra boost from vandalizing the dungeon.

The Sapper starts with the Frypan, showing off the new Cooking feature. With a powerful flail, flammable greaseballs, and the Booby Trap spell, Sappers have a penchant for destruction.

The Dryad grows magical foliage to plant shrubs, healing friendlies and producing nutritious nuts to eat. Their natural magic provides defensive thorns and roots in battle!

The Scion shows off the three new schools of magic with equal skill. Summoning the durable Earth Sprite as a guardian, the Scion also wields the powerful Archon Scepter, rechargeable by sacrificing spells.

The Myconid grows a defensive cap that can be used to plant mushroom traps, doubling as a fungal food source! The mushrooms' toxic spores help weaken enemies for a decisive takedown (or escape)!

The Hermit uses debilitating spells on foes to empower their homemade shillelagh, taking down foes with a mystical bonk! Their beloved duck pet is always nearby, distracting enemies and even diving for fish!

The Gnome has a nose for gold, and improved magical potential, but won't get as far with brute-force melee attacks! Their ability to fashion jewels may help them make friends.

The Bard plays magical music to enhance their party with instruments that each provide a different inspirational buff. Their deadly rapier allows them to parry and riposte with expert finesse!

The Salamander's heart blazes with magical fire, getting hotter as they rampage! When cold, they are stony and tough. A hot salamander burns bright with glorious radiance. Watch out for flaming breath!

The Paladin can add holy light to their claymore's powerful strikes, perfect for banishing undead and demonic foes. Their Holy Symbol can be used to protect themselves and allies before a fight.
70050000067625.intro: Explore new realms and dimensions, and five new races to add even more variety to your next dungeon dive!
70050000067625.name: Deserters & Disciples

70050000067825.description:
Musashi Miyamoto, History's Strongest Swordsman, joins the brutal world of Two Strikes. Resurrected into the modern era to seek the ultimate challenge, Musashi brings his lethal mastery and an aura of death to the battlefield. With his legendary Niten Ichi-ryū two-sword style, the terrifying pressure of his "imaginary blades," and a ruthlessness that knows no bounds, Musashi cuts through the opposition with terrifying ease.

This DLC pack includes playable character Musashi Miyamoto, from the hit anime Baki-Dou, featuring a completely new set of moves and animations. Also included: a brand-new stage, The Tokugawa Scientific Research Facility, and an exclusive original music track.

Musashi is fully playable across all online and offline game modes.
70050000067825.name: Two Strikes - Musashi Miyamoto

70050000067833.description:
Doug is a former slime cube who's adopted a friendlier shape. He's got a soft side, a heart of gold, and is ready to have an unforgettable experience.

Jacqueline is an earthly pumpkin whose folksy farmer vibes will allow you to enjoy nature at its fullest.

You may have met them before, but now you can actually BE them as they hit the road with Polly and Scott!

Jacq and Doug are ready to become the unlikely heroes of the road. Join them as they take the wheel and lead you on a road trip like you've never experienced before!
70050000067833.intro: HIT THE ROAD WITH TWO NEW PLAYABLE CHARACTERS!
70050000067833.name: Monster Roadtrip - Jacqueline and Doug (Playable Character Pack)

70050000067834.description:
This exciting new expansion for Monster Train 2 adds a new clan, new artifacts and enemies, and a brand new game mode!

The Railforged Clan
Once, they built the rail and the train itself, now they have taken up their hammers to join the fight! Lead the clan as Herzal, the blacksmith that built the Rail and the Boneshaker. Or lead as Heph, the blacksmith behind the Skullcrusher and the Covenant Outpost!

With their extensive engineering knowledge, utilize their unique Forge mechanic to build up units and equipment. Deploy an army of newly built train stewards, turrets, machines, and assemble equipment and units during combat to add to your army and fend off the enemy!

Soul Savior
Introducing a new type of run! Free powerful Souls from the clutches of the Lifemother and her twisted children who have been trapped within the Soulstream for untold ages. Souls are upgrades that can be equipped to cards and have a huge array of effects. The Lifemother is an unstoppable force of nature so you will need to level up your Souls to gain enough power to take on the challenges found in the Soulstream.
70050000067834.intro: Lead the new Railforged clan in your battle against the Titans!
70050000067834.name: Monster Train 2: Destiny of the Railforged

70050000067858.description:

A thrilling new story where the PekoMari duo set sail on a wild adventure to acquire an unusual treasure!
New skills in the form of Peko RUSH and Holo Set Sail!!
70050000067858.name: Holo's Hanafuda DLC: Usada Pekora & Houshou Marine Set

70050000067863.description: Each cat has its own story and personality. Our heroes would like to show you their strengths! Get to know them and enjoy the game even more.

70050000067863.name: Cat's Stories

70050000067947.description:
Engines awaken with the rising sun.
Race on one new track bathed in morning light, with cool asphalt and perfect conditions for a flawless launch.
This is where reaction time and the first meters decide everything.

70050000067948.description:
Sunset brings no compromises.
One new track soaked in golden light, aggressive pacing, and maximum risk.
One last chance to prove who owns the strip.

70050000067949.description:

Unlock a classic ride packed with personality and take on brand-new missions crafted for true retro driving masters.

70050000067950.description:
Ignite the streets with the Sports Car DLC!
Take control of a high-performance machine and tackle brand-new missions built for speed, precision, and pure adrenaline.
70050000067950.name: Grumpy Driver Sport Car DLC

70050000067961.description:
In the mirror world, fantasies become reality.

Touka Hiiragi, the protagonist of "Death Forest: ANOTHER," is a huge fan of SEIKIN. While investigating the mysteries hidden in "the forest," she takes a break to watch his videos as usual—but an unexpected event transforms her world.

She wanders into a maddening mirror world where SEIKIN and Yoshie have fused together. Can she make it out of this nightmare alive?

[DLC Features]

Yoshie turns into SEIKIN! The giant looming faces all transform into video creator SEIKIN. A swarm of SEIKINs fills the screen, relentlessly hunting you down.

Exclusive Content Features exclusive voice lines recorded by SEIKIN himself and a unique story exclusive to this DLC. Includes multiple collaboration endings different from the main game—a must-see for fans!

■ About SEIKIN SEIKIN is a popular video creator who operates the channels SeikinTV and SeikinGames. He produces a wide variety of content that transcends genres, including singing, fun product reviews, challenge videos, and game commentary.

■ Recommended for:

Fans of first-person horror games.

Those who find horror scary but still want a thrill.

Streamers looking for an exciting game to play.
70050000067961.intro: A Shocking Collaboration with Video Creator "SEIKIN"!
70050000067961.name: DEATH FOREST SEIKIN

70050000067964.description:
Celebrate your support of Collector's Cove with this exclusive Supporter Pack!

It includes three unique cosmetic items:
- A crown for your animal companion
- A tiara for your animal companion
- A jester cap for your character

These cosmetics are designed to make your animal companion even more majestic, while you'll be able to bring a touch of humor to the court!

They are only available in this pack, as a special thank-you to players who are helping support Collector's Cove even further.
70050000067964.name: Collector's Cove Supporter Pack

70050000068019.description:
Enhance your swamp adventure with this update! In this DLC, the textures for essential tools such as the hammer and axe are updated, giving them a more detailed and realistic appearance when crafted or in your inventory. This visual enhancement adds a fresh layer of immersion to your survival experience, making every action—from chopping wood to building your raft—feel more satisfying.

Take your survival skills to the next level with these improved tools!
70050000068019.intro: Sharpen your skills and immerse yourself in a richer survival adventure.
70050000068019.name: Survival Float Simulator - Crocodile Waters Craft, Raft, Build: Tool Textures

70050000068022.description:
An expansion pack featuring two new missions!

First up, Spooky Platypus! It’s spooky season in Colossatropolis... With the help of a friendly witch and her trusted broomstick you’ll need your wits about you as bats, ghosts, giant pumpkins and more try and give the local inhabitants nightmares.

Next, the Winter Mission! Winter has its grasp on Mungola and throughout the icy borderlands the battle rages on.

In these all new levels from Anthony Flack and the Claymatic team you'll travel across shadowdraped hills and iceberg-laden seas, battling new foes and bosses.
70050000068022.name: Platypus Reclayed Expansion Pack

70050000068036.description:
Take your border defense to the next level! The temperature scanner now glows with a striking purple-pink hue, making it easier than ever to detect hidden fevers and subtle signs of infection.

Combine your upgraded tools with sharp intuition and strategic thinking to manage the increasing flow of desperate travelers, separating the healthy from the infected with precision.

Step into the checkpoint with enhanced surveillance and prove you can maintain control in a world on the brink of chaos.
70050000068036.intro: Scan faster, see clearer, stop infections in their tracks.
70050000068036.name: Quarantine Zone: Border Zombie Checkpoint – Infection Detection

70050000068049.description: Do you know a city whose symbol is two goats? Discover Poznań! A Polish city full of interesting places and beautiful corners. Search for hidden objects on another colorful map.

70050000068049.name: Spy Guy Poznan

70050000068050.description:
Take your arsenal to the next level with this DLC. Equip your pistol with a unique new skin that stands out in the heat of battle. Whether patrolling dangerous zones or engaging in high-stakes firefights, this visually striking upgrade gives your weapon a fresh, personalized look.

Combine style with precision — your enhanced pistol isn’t just for show. Make every shot count while showcasing your elite operative status in every mission. Upgrade your loadout, dominate the battlefield, and leave your mark in the world of BODYCAM SHOOTER 2025.
70050000068050.intro: A new look, same deadly precision—your pistol upgraded.
70050000068050.name: BODYCAM SHOOTER 2025 – Elite Weapon Skin

70050000068058.description:

Whether you’re climbing solo or tackling the heights with a partner, the updated rope brings smoother handling, sharper responsiveness, and a new visual look that stands out as you scale the most dangerous cliffs.

Strengthen your connection, master the climb, and rise higher than ever!

70050000068200.description: Adorable animals need your help with decorating their home for Christmas! Add the magic and warmth of the winter holidays to your designs with 20 brand new items and festive music!
70050000068200.intro: Welcome to Cozy Tiny Home, a warm and heart-melting decorating game where you can design the most adorable spaces imaginable - and fill them with sweet animal friends!
70050000068200.name: Christmas

70050000068205.description:
Kickstart your aviation empire with an instant $350,000 bonus! This DLC gives you the financial boost needed to expand your fleet, upgrade hangars, or invest in new routes right from the start. Whether you want to buy faster planes, expand your airport facilities, or explore new destinations, this cash injection puts your ambitious plans within reach.

Take advantage of the early financial support and make every flight count as you build your global air transport empire. With extra funds in your account, the sky is truly your business!
70050000068205.intro: Get your bonus and jumpstart your airline empire.
70050000068205.name: Flight Simulator 2025 – Bonus Cash

70050000068214.description:
Give your cleaning gear a fresh new look! This DLC changes the appearance of your mop and trash bucket, letting you tackle crime scenes in style. While your mission remains the same—erase every trace and stay undetected—your tools now match your professional flair.

Upgrade your aesthetic while maintaining peak cleaning efficiency, and make every crime scene cleanup feel uniquely yours.
70050000068214.intro: Crime scene cleaning just got a makeover.
70050000068214.name: Criminal Cleaner Simulator – Tactical Tools

70050000068219.description:
Important: 100% of the revenue from this DLC goes to charity for animals!

We’ve partnered with One Voice, an organization dedicated to rescuing and protecting animals around the world to bring you this very special DLC. By purchasing it, you’ll directly support their mission and also unlock a shelter with many adorable pets in the Garden of Astral Ascent. Taking care of your virtual companions in the game will help take care of real animals.

DLC FEATURES
- 5 valuable companions you can bring along on your explorations.

70050000068737.description:
Control the flow of time to solve subtle platform puzzles in this update of the indie classic "Braid," featuring refreshed artwork and seriously in-depth creator commentary.  Travel from a city house through a series of interconnected worlds where time behaves strangely, searching for an elusive Princess. Along the way you'll explore memories and regrets that still haunt you. This Anniversary Edition remaster of the award-winning platformer contains fully repainted high-resolution graphics, new sound effects and extensive audio commentary.

MANIPULATE TIME TO MOVE FORWARD
Rewind, pause and use the strange properties of time in each world to run and jump through beautifully painted environments. Avoid hazards, unlock doors and collect jigsaw puzzle pieces to assemble. If you get hung up on a particular puzzle, feel free to move on and return later.

A FRESH COAT OF PAINT
This is the game you remember, with all the original challenges and the same haunting, evocative score — but repainted pixel by pixel so that each carefully rendered world comes to life in high resolution. New visual details, animated brushstroke effects and revamped sounds add to the immersive experience.

GO (DEEP) BEHIND THE SCENES
Explore the most extensive developer commentary ever put into a game, with over 12 hours of recorded insight and conversation from developer Jonathan Blow, artist David Hellman and more members of the "Braid" creative team. Navigate it by visiting a new in-game world, which also contains new puzzles and redesigns of classic puzzles.  - Created by Thekla, Inc.

70050000068762.description:
Explore the Deepblue!
• Put the wind to your back and cast out into High Adventure over a vast ocean spanning dozens of eccentric regions.
• Discover countless isles bursting with their own flora, fauna, friendly folk, and fearsome foes.
• Playfully pursue a pod of curious dolphins, admire the beauty of the sun sinking into an icy horizon, or run down a clutch of cowardly criminals only to accept their apologies to the tune of wild cannonry.

Command a Sailing Fleet!
• Build and manage a custom cadre of specialized vessels to match any personality and play style.
• Buy, equip, upgrade, and modify your ships’ armaments to face off against the toughest privateers this side of the Eclipside.
• Crack open giant clams and loot lonely shipwrecks to fill your fleet’s treasure hoard and keep your crew in shipshape.

Fathom a Mystery!
• Join forces with the myriad inhabitants of this watery world to uncover a terrible secret buried in the depths of the Deepblue.
• Reel in a big one with the salty Anglerwranglers, learn the secret spyspeak of the Croaker Command Corps, save the sea life of the Moontiders, capture picturesque memories with a mysterious “camera” device, and much more.
• Inspire the finefolk from all over to work as one world-spanning crew to save the seas and the planet.

Sail Forth into Adventure!
• Tack and jibe and heave and cut with a sail and wind system designed with enough attention to realistic sailing physics to excite naval enthusiasts while also remaining deeply accessible to anyone and everyone.
• Sail through stormy swells and serene sunsets in a dynamic and breathtaking day-night weather system.
• Bask in the beauty of the benevolent ocean waters in Free Sail mode where the only goal is the ever-moving horizon.

The Deepblue calls with the bellow of High Adventure! Sail Forth!

70050000069034.description:
Merlin, the famous wizard from Arthurian legend, joins the ranks of Ravenswatch. Trapped for centuries in a prison of slumber woven by the Lady of the Lake, his former love, the sorcerer finally awakens, stripped of his gift of clairvoyance, but not of his power. Lost and haunted by his past, Merlin joins forces with heroes of Ravenswatch to uncover the truth… and destroy the Nightmare.

This new playable hero is distinguished by his exceptional mastery of magic. Merlin is not limited to just three skills: he can choose from nine spells, divided into three categories that reflect the full extent of his abilities.
* Nature spells: summon colossal brambles, make it rain stars, or raise a stone shield that explodes on your enemies.
* Arcane magic: cast lightning bolts through monsters, throw a fireball or unleash a frost orb that pursues your targets.
* Sacred light: heal your wounds and those of your allies, blind your enemies and tear down their defences, or escape danger by teleporting away.

As he fights, Merlin generates Power Runes, a unique resource that amplifies his spells and enables him to create devastating combinations. Due to his variety of spells, his four ultimate abilities and his numerous talents, the gameplay has unprecedented depth.

The DLC also includes four skins which can be unlocked in-game, as well as three exclusive premium skins: a Ravenswatch outfit, a Nightmare outfit and a Royal Counselor outfit.
70050000069034.intro: The greatest wizard in Avalon awakens from his prison of slumber, stripped of his clairvoyance but not his power.

70050000069229.description:
Choose from an even larger cast of characters in this Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition Upgrade Pack*, which now adds Rosalina and Co-Star Luma to the existing cast. You can also enable Assist Mode to make any character immune to damage, not just Yoshis and Nabbit! Assist Mode also provides some protection from falls, giving you a Propeller Flower the first time you slip into a pit, lava, or poison swamp.

Take on all seven of the Koopalings in newly added boss courses scattered throughout the Flower Kingdom. If you want an extra challenge, visit the Toad Brigade Training Camp and unlock Fierce Fights against buffed-up mighty versions of the Koopalings. Grab the Flower Pot power-up to throw flowers at your enemies and flower jump to flutter up and slowly glide down. You can also unlock Dual Badges that grant the effects of two Badges at once!

Meet up with friends for attractions and entertainment in Bellabel Park

Captain Toad has discovered some mysterious ruins in the Flower Kingdom! Explore this area with your friends in local**, online***, or local wireless** multiplayer in the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition. Visit the attractions to cooperate or compete in over 100 courses that use a variety of game mechanics like Joy-Con™ 2 mouse controls. As you play these attractions, you will unlock greetings to interact with your friends, flowers to decorate Bellabel Park, Dual Badges, and more.

Share the wonder with more friends—even via GameShare

Team up, or race to the finish, with up to 11 friends online*** or up to seven via newly added local wireless**. You can also play the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition of this game with friends who don’t have it, in person or online, via GameShare****.

Tap amiibo accessories for in-game extras

In the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition, you can now get power-ups in certain courses by tapping amiibo™ accessories*****, including three new ones: Elephant Mario, Poplin & Prince Florian, and Captain Toad & Talking Flower! The game is compatible with any amiibo accessories.
70050000069229.intro: Upgrade the wonder of Mario fun with more content and improvements for the Nintendo Switch™ 2 system

70050000069589.intro: Your ultimate angling boost for bigger, legendary catches.
70050000069589.name: FISHING SIMULATOR 2025: Fishing Boost

70050000069612.description:
This is an original Prison Skin created especially for players.
You can obtain the Prison Skin “Fun World.”
70050000069612.name: Prison Skin

70050000069618.description:
Cymanti Skin

Cymanti geneticists of the New Dawn Movement evolved these new, cuter appearances to ensure the lasting future of the swarm. Led by a Guru, this sect breeds hordes of adorable insects, colorful flowers, and funky toxins to dispatch their foes as they attempt to usher in a new age for the Cymanti!

This special New Dawn skin for Cymanti adds a cute, psychedelic spin on our favorite buggy tribe, which will help them work their way both into the enemy's backlines and your heart.

Features:

Unleash a horde of adorable, googly-eyed creatures upon your foes!

Bathe your enemies in trippy poisons with the flying Claude or long-ranged Lily!

Detonate the colorful Shoo and wreak havoc upon invading armies!

Froth up Foam that your creatures can use to cross the oceans!

Consume the docile Snulles and sweet Pupli Nectars to feed your expanding forces!

Use your Gurus to "convince" opposing troops to your side!

Eschew normal economics by spending Hearts to train troops and build structures!

Harness the combined might of Axolotls, Cacti,  Rubies, Fairies, and other bizarre creatures to overwhelm any who would underestimate your new form!



Note: This purely cosmetic New Dawn Cymanti Skin does not have any gameplay changes from the normal Cymanti Special Tribe, which must be purchased separately in order to be used.
70050000069618.intro: Master botanics with the new Cymanti Skin! Meet Claude, Squishy, Eggy, Fairy, and other adorable insects.
70050000069618.name: New Dawn Cymanti Skin

70050000069649.description:
As the situation at the border evolves, this DLC changes the exterior appearance of the container by altering its color. The update brings a new visual identity to the checkpoint, reflecting the changes in the area and the level of alert. The border remains under control, but the visual signals clearly show that things are no longer the same.

And even if the world changes, you remain the only one who can decide who gets through. The mission continues — are you ready?
70050000069649.intro: A fresh coat hides nothing—only the threat remains unchanged.
70050000069649.name: Quarantine Zone: Border Zombie Checkpoint – Frontline Upgrade

70050000069910.description:
Enter the portal to a lost realm enshrouded in eternal nightfall.

This is Prometheus, a city once blessed by the gods but has now been all but abandoned by them.
Battle through a new dungeon and corrupted marble
Face creatures born of the shadow and the god Erebos
Reclaim the stolen Golden Flame
— because in FATE, your journey never truly ends.

Features
A new town hub trapped by darkness
A new dungeon of corrupted marble
A new companion pet: Baby Pegasus


Prometheus is accessible in FATE: Undiscovered Realms via  the Temple of Fate.
70050000069910.intro: Battle through a new dungeon, defeat the god of darkness and reclaim the light — because in FATE, your journey never ends.
70050000069910.name: FATE: Reawakened - Prometheus

70050000069911.description:
Take your survival to the next level. This DLC grants your brave ant an expanded health pool, allowing you to withstand twice as much damage during exploration and battles. Survive longer and explore the surrounding world with greater confidence.

With increased resilience, every mission becomes smoother, every resource easier to collect, and every encounter more manageable. Rebuilding your colony feels more achievable than ever.

Step back into the natural battlefield—only this time, you’re stronger and better prepared.
70050000069911.intro: Stronger ants, tougher battles, greater triumphs.
70050000069911.name: Ants Empire Colony: Survival Boost

70050000069936.description:
Step up your arsenal and dominate the battlefield like never before!

With this DLC, every weapon you collect comes with double the ammo, and all ammo pickups for each weapon type are doubled too. More firepower means more chances to defend your magical tree against waves of enemies, from pesky animal control squads to relentless urban machinery.

Arm yourself, stock up, and prepare for an even more intense battle to protect your enchanted home!
70050000069936.intro: Double the ammo, double the squirrel chaos, unstoppable fun!
70050000069936.name: Squirrel Madness: Ammo Frenzy

70050000069942.description: Expand your collection of puzzles with 6 new illustrations that will let you feel the warmth of the setting sun and hear the whispers of the charming stranger you just met.
70050000069942.name: Portraits Pack 2

70050000069943.description: Expand your collection of puzzles with 6 new illustrations that will let you feel the warmth of the setting sun and hear the whispers of the charming stranger you just met.
70050000069943.name: Portraits Pack 3

70050000069948.description:
Boost your policing career with an instant $5,000 added to your balance! Use the extra resources to upgrade your patrol vehicles, enhance your equipment, or tackle challenging missions more efficiently. With this head start, you can explore the city freely, respond faster to incidents, and enforce the law with greater authority.

Step into the shoes of a US police officer and experience the excitement of maintaining order, investigating crimes, and chasing suspects with added support right from the start.
70050000069948.intro: Start your policing career with extra resources and take control of the city.
70050000069948.name: Cop Car Police Simulator Chase: Starter Cash

70050000069950.description: Compete in intense arcade races, now upgraded with smoother frame rates, higher resolution and enhanced visuals for the Nintendo Switch™ 2 system.
70050000069950.name: Asphalt Legends – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition upgrade pack

70050000069966.description:
A rainbow metropolis awaits! Collect, create, and customize in this cozy adventure. Run your own personalized Cafe, set up all-new shops with Sanrio friends, and unlock the power of dreams to uncover the City’s hidden wonders.

- Welcome, Usahana! Become best friends and unlock 35 friendship levels
- Explore City Town with 90+ original quests and 30+ hours of adventure
- Unlock New Outfits and Decor, including over 150+ new clothing and furniture items
- Run Your Own Cafe – customize your space and craft your own orders for Sanrio friends
- Solve 60+ Puzzles and Challenges throughout (and beneath!) the City
- Plushies, Orchards, Arcades, and more! Help your Sanrio friends open seven new shops in City Town
- Create Custom Avatar Palettes and switch between your favorite outfits for that perfect look
- Unlock a Customizable Apartment Complex inside the Rainbow Tower
- Meet Usahana’s Visitor Friends: Panya, Buppi, Wanwa, Sora, and Nyako
- And… keep an eye out for a mysterious cameo guest
70050000069966.intro: Bright lights. Big dreams. Bigger adventures. Welcome to City Town!
70050000069966.name: Hello Kitty Island Adventure - City Town

70050000069975.description:
Take your tactical identity to the next level with this exclusive customization pack! This DLC expands your arsenal of visual options by adding 13 brand-new skins designed to enhance both your character and weapon aesthetics. Each skin is crafted to fit perfectly within the gritty, bodycam-style realism of the game, giving you more ways than ever to stand out on the battlefield.

Equip your new skins, personalize your loadout, and show your enemies that you’re not just a fighter — you’re a force with a signature presence.
70050000069975.intro: New skins to make your mark on the battlefield.
70050000069975.name: OpsCam - Body Cam Shooter: Visual Warfare

70050000069980.description: Create your winter paradise! Enhance your experience and make charming, snowy cities with Cozy Land Ice Age DLC! The expansion includes 20 new items, which will challenge your creativity and help bring tons of new ideas to life.
70050000069980.intro: Creating the city of your dreams is at your fingertips in Cozy Land!
70050000069980.name: Ice Age

70050000070058.description:
Beyond the haunted swamps of western Golnir rises the grim fortress of Slank — the arch-fiend who has stolen the souls of mortals for centuries. Now the secret magic to destroy him is known, and your journey into the Castle of Lost Souls begins. Will you break his hold over the dead… or join them?

Based on the newly rewritten 700-section adventure by Dave Morris & Paul Gresty, this DLC brings one of the most iconic Fabled Lands quests into the CRPG with new locations, enemies, mechanics, and treasures.

A Dark Quest Awaits
Venture across cursed marshes, ruined villages, and the demon’s stronghold itself. Descend into the underworld, uncover forbidden rituals, battle corrupted spirits and undead guardians, and gather the tools needed to challenge Slank at the heart of his domain.

THE CASTLE OF LOST SOULS
3 Major Questlines: 50 000 words added to the base game in an interconnected arc culminating in a single high-stakes finale.

40 New Items: Cursed relics, underworld treasures, and powerful rewards tied to the wider campaign.

New Locations: Haunted roads, castle battlements, infernal chambers, and new underworld zones.

New Enemies & Mechanics: Face spectral knights, wraith executioners, chon-chon swarms, lammasu guardians, the Rauchwurm, the Undine - culminating in multiple confrontations with Slank himself.

New Achievements: 10 new achievements for explorers and completionists.

A legendary standalone gamebook - now a fully integrated Fabled Lands CRPG expansion.

The gates of the Castle have opened.

Do you dare enter?
70050000070058.intro: Beyond the haunted swamps of Golnir lies the Castle of Lost Souls. Challenge Slank, lord of stolen souls.
70050000070058.name: The Castle of Lost Souls

Both characters bring a new gameplay mechanic, allowing them to spend Sand Dollars to overcharge their reflect action, unleashing game-changing abilities.

Commodore Goldie – Flaunts its wealth with pride, yet hides a heart of gold

A goldfish with a taste for riches, Goldie digs with her trusty shovel to uncover Whirl Pearls. (or, with a bit of luck, maybe something else?)

On impact, these pearls create a Cash Vortex, scattering gold and wealth as they strike enemies!

Hanha – Relentlessly tracks the weak, leaving no bounty unclaimed

A fearsome bounty hunter, Hanha marks an enemy for the hunt.

When a marked foe is defeated, they drop a Hunting Trophy into the water—trinkets that boost player stats!

Each enemy has its own unique trophy, making every battle a high-stakes hunt.

Prepare to dig, plunder, and claim your fortune—solo or in co-op—with The Golden Bay Duo!

Both characters utilize a new gameplay mechanic that lets them roll to generate static charges. These charges build up and release into increasingly powerful electric effects.

Eelvis – Shock and Roll!

An amped-up electric eel with a jolted stage presence.

When he fires a cannon, he discharges all stored static energy, creating a devastating electric explosion on impact!

Gastropaul – Heavy shell, strong personality

This sea snail might be slow, but his resilience experiments make him a defensive powerhouse.

If Gastropaul gets knocked down or stunned, he shrugs it off and instead unleashes an electric explosion, fueled by his stored charges!

Get ready to uncover some of the greatest Sea-antific breakthroughs ever known to the archipelago—solo or in co-op—with The Thunder Tide Duo!

Note: Every Ship of Fools ""Pack of Fools"" DLC is automatically shared with your online co-op partner (host or client) for the duration of your play session.

70050000070383.name: Planet of Lana II - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition Upgrade Pack

70050000070399.description:
Welcome to Cozy Grove, a life-sim game about camping on a haunted, ever-changing island. As a Spirit Scout, you'll wander the island's forest each day, finding new hidden secrets and helping soothe the local ghosts. With a little time and a lot of crafting, you'll bring color and joy back to Cozy Grove!

Cozy Grove is synced to real world time, and provides 30-60 minutes of new quest content each day. After that, you can fish, craft and decorate to your heart's content!

Features:
• Beautiful, dynamic, hand-drawn landscapes that come alive when you help a spirit in need.
• Dozens of memorable characters and spirits for you to find and befriend. Each spirit has a unique, extensive story for you to unravel over time.
• Collect spirit animals, craft decorations, go fishing and more!
• 40+ hour campaign filled with side quests, designed to span months of playtime.
70050000070399.intro: Come for the view, stay for the friends.
70050000070399.name: Cozy Grove – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition Upgrade Pack

70050000070425.description: Looking for a purrfect way to spend your cozy evenings? Unleash the cat mania! Feed, sort, and prepare adorable toys to make your cutest furry friends happy! 10 new, pawtastic levels are waiting in Softly Placed Cats Pack.
70050000070425.intro: Unleash the childlike wonder and find the magic in everyday life! Place, fit, fill, cook, connect, and train your brain in the cutest possible way.
70050000070425.name: Cats Pack

70050000070427.description:
With this DLC, you'll unlock a pack of 20 new levels containing:
- 60 EXTRA LARGE handcrafted puzzles!

Ready to get back on track?
70050000070427.intro: Embark on a puzzle filled quest!
70050000070427.name: Rail Rescue: Puzzle Lines - Quest Track

70050000070429.description:
With this DLC, you'll unlock a pack of 20 new levels containing:
- 60 EXTRA LARGE handcrafted puzzles!

Ready to get back on track?
70050000070429.intro: Take on a puzzle filled challenge!
70050000070429.name: Rail Rescue: Puzzle Lines - Challenge Track

70050000070505.description:
Take your pigeon pranks to the next level! With this feather-boosted upgrade, the ammo count for each weapon is increased by 3 times (×3), giving you more freedom to unleash chaos across the bustling park.

Whether you’re dive-bombing unsuspecting picnickers or showing off your avian super moves, more ammo means more mischief, more mayhem, and more wanted stars! Keep your stamina in check, plan your aerial antics, and enjoy the park like never before — now with triple the firepower at your wings.

Unleash your inner pigeon powerhouse and turn the park into your personal playground!
70050000070505.intro: More feathers, more firepower, more fun!
70050000070505.name: Pigeon Sim - Bird Simulator: Ammo Mayhem

70050000070514.description:
Get ready for a whole new level of chaos! This DLC adds a brand-new skybox that completely changes the city’s atmosphere. Experience destruction and mayhem under a more dramatic and intense sky. Perfect for epic battles, massive destruction, and endless adventure.

Are you ready to rule the city under a new sky?
70050000070514.intro: New skybox, more mayhem, more destruction.
70050000070514.name: Tralalero Tralala Simulator: Sky of Chaos

70050000070520.description:
Get ready to command the ultimate machine and take your construction adventure to the next level!

Operate your new VBear 34 to lift, dig, and deliver with precision. Whether you’re tackling challenging missions, expanding your construction empire, or perfecting your machinery skills, this gift lets you work faster, smarter, and more efficiently.

Step into the cab, power up the VBear 34, and reshape your construction world like never before!
70050000070520.intro: Boost your construction projects with extra power!
70050000070520.name: Construction Machine Simulator 2023: New Machinery

70050000070523.description:
Walls of Judgment
Some places are built to confine the body.
Other places are built to attract strange, otherworldly spirits.
The Walls of Judgment introduces two grim new locations:
A prison where no one can hear you scream.
The church where you may hide from your nightmares.

Behind the iron bars and the locked doors, mortals wait, pace, and pray.
Mortals are unaware they are prey. In the prison, isolation and routine can drive you mad.
If you doubt this truth, ask inmate Kyle, who has been in prison serving a sentence extending into the afterlife.
In the church, faith is tested. Most win, most of the time. Others are less fortunate.

Justice may be blind… and fear can stare straight through you...
70050000070523.name: Walls of Judgment

70050000070526.description:
Get ready to hit the road with the School Bus Adventures DLC, where the trusty Schoolie becomes your new playable vehicle! Explore the wilderness in style and transform this iconic school bus into a fully customized camper van. Outfit and personalize every corner as you venture off the beaten path, turning the Schoolie into your perfect home on wheels.

Designed for big adventures, the Schoolie offers generous interior space for building and creativity. It features a large sliding door, a smaller passenger-side entry, and a rear door that lets you move through the entire vehicle with ease. A ladder-accessible rooftop rack opens up new possibilities for expanding your base above the bus. Please note that you select your vehicle at the start of your adventure.

This DLC includes:
- A fully customizable school bus available as a playable vehicle.
70050000070526.name: Outbound - Schoolbus Adventures DLC

70050000070530.description:
Power up your journey with an instant credit injection! This DLC adds 1,000,000 credits, giving you the financial edge to build the ultimate cyberpunk garage.

Unlock futuristic cars faster, apply powerful upgrades, and customize your machines exactly the way you want. With a massive boost to your balance, you’re free to focus on what truly matters—speed, style, and domination on the neon-lit tracks.

Less grinding. More racing. Total control.
70050000070530.intro: Invest in your fleet and conquer the streets in pure cyberpunk style.
70050000070530.name: Neon Drifter - Cyber Racing: Capital Boost

70050000070539.description:
Tiny Auto Knights Supporter Pack: Show off with style

A pack for those who want to support Mumpitz Games. You will significantly contribute to the further development of Tiny Auto Knights.

To express our sincere gratitude, you will receive the following set of prestigious items:

Player Profile Customizations
Show others that you support us by pimping your profile with these accessories:
- Picture frame
- Tiny Auto Knights Avatar
- Banner background effect
- Rainbow colored profile name

Arena Background
Fight your greatest battles in this special dungeon arena.
70050000070539.intro: Improve your Tiny Auto Knights experience with this Supporter Pack! Get exclusive items for your player profile and a new dungeon arena for battles.
70050000070539.name: Tiny Auto Knights - Supporter Pack

70050000070551.description:
Between Worlds
Not all places are meant to be destinations. The Train Station is a place of arrivals, departures, and fleeting encounters. Mortals pass through, never feeling safe, as though they are being watched. Platforms fade into the darkness. The tunnels echo with distant sounds from the past and the present. Panic spreads faster than the Phantom Train Conductor can operate his locomotive.

Introducing a new Train Station level built upon crowds, open spaces, and relentless motion. No place ever feels secure.

Introducing a new game mode: Second Side of the Coin.

For the first time, step into the role of a Ghost-breaker who hunts ghosts, sets traps, and experiences fear from the other side—where control is fleeting and fragile, resources are limited, and every mistake means punishment.
70050000070551.name: Between Worlds

70050000070554.description:
Solid Ice and Terror

Escape the bitter cold outside. Screams echo across the ice, celebrating victories and championships of years past.

A massive industrial hockey arena has been abandoned for years. The lights flicker over empty stands and scarred ice. Mortals enter believing their greatest enemy is the polar vortex, however outside something far worse stalks the rink tonight. What looks cute can be just as terrifying. The officials are watching from beyond.

In Canada, hockey is life—even in the afterlife. Something far worse than the cold stalks the rink on this winter evening. The rules of the natural and the supernatural can change without warning. Some will cry for decades. Others are haunted forever.

Introducing a new level set in an industrial Canadian hockey arena somewhere in Canada. We’ll give you 514 guesses where. Every whistle cuts through the darkness, and every decision feels final.

Beware the supernatural official, Jacques Rougeau, who’s on the job.
“Justice isn’t fair. I don’t care if you get screwed over… bon!”
70050000070554.name: Solid Ice and Terror

70050000070556.description:
Frightful Night

The holidays arrive in Ghost Master Resurrection with a new Christmas Market level, draped in lights, decorations, and false cheer. Mortals gather to celebrate, laugh, and shop—blissfully unaware that terror awaits just beneath the tinsel.

Carols echo. Shadows linger.

Every smile hides a scream.

The most wonderful time of the year is here—for you to scare!
70050000070556.name: Frightful Night

70050000070563.description: Is there anything better than cats? Yes - even MORE CATS! Make your house a home with 10 adorable brand new furry friends playing, relaxing, and practicing their cozy hobbies.
70050000070563.intro: Welcome to Cozy Tiny Home, a warm and heart-melting decorating game where you can design the most adorable spaces imaginable - and fill them with sweet animal friends!
70050000070563.name: Cat Pack 1

70050000070585.description:
A brand new story:
A new story unfolds with Tomomi as the protagonist.
Why did Riko undergo cryosleep?
How did Tomomi get here?
What's Laurie been up to? Secrets not found in her story will be revealed here.

Tomomi:
A ditzy, ninja lady who fights with a katana and shuriken. She has a crush on her partner, Riko.
Her controls and skills have been adjusted from the previous title to fit the world of ROLLING STAR. Enjoy a whole new gameplay experience with her.

New Vehicle:
A new combat vehicle exclusive to Tomomi's route has been added. It's a sleek, new unit completely different from Laurie's!
70050000070585.intro: The protagonist of the previous title TOMOMI joins the fight in ROLLING STAR!
70050000070585.name: TOMOMI Another Story

70050000070586.description:
Take your car wash business to the next level instantly! This DLC adds 5,000 to your balance, giving you the boost you need to expand faster, upgrade equipment, and attract more customers right from the start.

Invest in self-service stations, enhance your tunnel car washes, or stock your on-site shop to increase revenue. With extra funds at your disposal, you can focus on growing your business and creating the ultimate car wash empire.

Start strong, expand quickly, and watch your car wash become the talk of the town!
70050000070586.intro: Your car wash empire begins here — faster, smarter, stronger.
70050000070586.name: Car Wash Tycoon Business Simulator: Balance Boost

70050000070595.description:
Boost your underground adventure with an instant reward of 500 bonus coins! This DLC gives you the extra resources you need to upgrade your tools, unlock new possibilities, and accelerate your progress through the mysterious depths.

Whether you’re just starting out or looking to push further underground, these bonus coins help you dig faster, discover rare artifacts sooner, and uncover ancient secrets with ease.

Jump into the adventure fully equipped and make every excavation count!
70050000070595.intro: Dig deeper. Discover more. Dominate the depths.
70050000070595.name: Digging A Hole 2025: Power Start

70050000070600.name: Taiko no Tatsujin: Rhythm Festival - 2000 Series Pack Vol. 1

70050000070629.description:
Meet the New Challengers

Rick Johnson – The fearless gunslinger from Guns N’ Runs joins the battle with a high-speed, close-range combat style. His Machines at Work stage brings the industrial chaos of his world to life.

Brandon Carter – A former CIA operative who now fights on his own terms. His sharp, tactical approach is perfectly matched by the urban intensity of the City Hall Station stage.

Dvesha – A mysterious shadow-wielder who bends darkness to his will. Face your fears in his unsettling Disturbed Place stage, where energy and chaos collide.

Camille Leclerc – A rebellious punk fighter from Marseille with a fiery attitude and a rhythm that hits as hard as her strikes. Her Marseille, France stage captures her raw, untamed spirit.

Season 1 Pass Contents
- Four playable characters: Rick Johnson, Brandon Carter, Dvesha and Camille Leclerc
- Four new stages inspired by each fighter’s story and style
        - Bonus content including colour palettes, gallery artwork and exclusive music tracks
- Full roster integration across Versus, Arcade and Online modes

Upgrade your line-up, master new styles and experience the evolution of Pocket Bravery with the complete Season 1 collection.
70050000070629.intro: Expand your roster with new fighters and stages in Pocket Bravery Season 1 DLC
70050000070629.name: Pocket Bravery - Season Pass 1

70050000070637.description:
Hit the road with a clear advantage and accelerate your progress right from the very start of the game. This DLC gives you 50,000 coins, providing a fast start. Use these resources to upgrade your truck, customize the cabin and exterior, or invest in performance upgrades that will enhance your driving experience and delivery efficiency.

Be ready for any challenge on the roads of America and grow your trucking business faster than ever, while enjoying the freedom to create your own driving style.
70050000070637.intro: Step into the driver’s seat with a head start!
70050000070637.name: Truck Simulator 25 - American Driver: Coin Rush

70050000070642.description: If you purchase The Prince of Tennis Sweet School Festival ~♡-40 and more...~ for Nintendo Switch™, you only need to purchase the upgrade pack to play the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition.
70050000070642.name: The Prince of Tennis Sweet School Festival ~♡-40 and more...~ Nintendo Switch 2 Edition Upgrade Pack

70050000070707.description:
Fuel your fighting journey with an instant in-game currency boost! This DLC grants additional funds giving you the edge in every battle.
Spend less time grinding and more time mastering combos, honing your skills, and taking on elite opponents.
Prepare your roster and fight without limits.
70050000070707.name: Anime Warriors Money Bonus

70050000070708.description:
Order was their shield.
Fear will be their downfall.
Step inside the rigid world of bureaucracy with two new locations: a Government Bank and a Town Hall. Designed for security and control, these buildings quickly become pressure cookers when mortals realize the rules no longer protect them.

Tight corridors, public spaces, and fragile authority create the perfect environment for paranoia to spread. Watch calm routines collapse as whispers turn into panic and trust evaporates.

The system is failing.
Make sure they feel every second of it.
70050000070708.name: State of Panic

70050000070709.description:
The mansion has been waiting.

Beyond rusted gates and tangled vines lies a Gothic Mansion, steeped in sorrow and shadow. Its towering halls and hidden chambers tell stories of obsession, ritual, and souls that never left.

This atmospheric new level focuses on slow-burning dread and looming presence. Every creak carries intent. Every shadow feels alive. Mortals may enter seeking answers — but the house has its own designs.

Some places are haunted.
This one hungers.
70050000070709.name: Blood & Stone

70050000070712.description:
Impress your friends and family by playing 5 brand new songs!
With this DLC you can improve your piano skills and learn:
Polly Wolly Doodle
Happy Folk Melody
The Itsy Bitsy Spider
Row, Row, Row Your Boat
Bingo
70050000070712.intro: Wow everyone. Become a pianist in just a few moments.
70050000070712.name: Song Pack 8

70050000070726.description:
Cat Girl Survivor – Extra Episode DLC

A major story expansion that deepens the world of Cat Girl Survivor.

Featuring full-voice performances by a renowned Japanese voice cast including Yui Ogura, Kana Ueda, and Marie Miyake, this DLC introduces brand-new story episodes that expand the narrative beyond the main game.
Discover hidden sides of the protagonists and uncover untold stories that add new depth to their relationships.

■ Voice Cast & Roles

Yui Ogura – Yuri

Kana Ueda – Akane

Marie Miyake – Koro

Nozomi Yamane – Chloe

Chirin Sakura – Shiro

Kenta Kiyozumi – Leo

All new story content is fully voiced to enhance immersion and character development.

■ DLC Features

New fully voiced story episodes

5 newly designed stages

More challenging new boss battles

New playable character: Mio

Mio is a bard-style character who uses sound waves to slow enemy movement.
Her unique crowd-control abilities introduce new strategic options and fresh build possibilities for advanced players.

This DLC delivers both narrative expansion and intensified combat content for players who want to experience the world of Cat Girl Survivor in greater depth.

Base game required to play.
70050000070726.intro:
Featuring Yui Ogura, Kana Ueda, and Marie Miyake in a fully voiced new story.
5 new stages, stronger bosses, and a new playable character, Mi
70050000070726.name: Cat Girl Survivor – Extra Episode DLC

70050000070737.description:
Enhance your drifting experience with newly added background music! This DLC add more energy and atmosphere to every race. The new background music blends seamlessly with the fast-paced gameplay and Japanese manga-style visuals, making every drift feel more intense and immersive.

Every drift, every corner, and every victory now feels more intense. Take control and enjoy a renewed drifting experience.
70050000070737.intro: Take control of legendary cars and conquer the toughest roads.
70050000070737.name: Project Drift Japan Challenge: Tokyo Beats

70050000070742.description:
Add a fresh touch to your supermarket experience with a brand-new music track!
This DLC introduces new song bringing a cozy and cheerful mood to your daily routine.
Enjoy managing shelves, serving customers, and growing your store with a new sound that perfectly matches the cute and wholesome atmosphere.
Same adorable world.
A fresh vibe.
70050000070742.intro: Fresh music for your cozy market.
70050000070742.name: Supermarket Anime Cozy Music Track

70050000070746.description:
Boost your kawaii empire with extra in-game currency! This DLC provides an extra in-game currency to help you upgrade your shelves, unlock charming products, and make your supermarket even cuter and more efficient.

Spend less time earning and more time enjoying the adorable chaos of daily shop life. Upgrade faster, decorate your store, and delight your customers while growing your kawaii empire!
70050000070746.name: Supermarket Anime Cash Pack

70050000070753.description:
Some of your toy friends are dignified and have a taste for finer things. Make them happy by hanging masterpiece paintings on their walls and placing their own little fine art exhibitions in their houses.
Enhance your My Little Haven experience with 20 brand new items of Art DLC!
70050000070753.intro: Step into the beautiful dream world and help your toy friends settle into their miniature cozy homes!
70050000070753.name: Arts Pack

70050000070779.description:
Add a new legend to your skateboarding crew! Unlock a unique character and bring fresh style, tricks, and animations to your adventures.

Already have this character? No problem! Instead, you’ll receive the money equivalent to spend on upgrading your skateboard, gear, or other in-game items.

Whether you unlock the character or get the cash, this DLC enhances your skateboarding experience and adds even more meme-tastic fun!
70050000070779.intro: Unlock new character and bring fresh chaos to your skateboarding adventures.
70050000070779.name: Skateboard Drifting with Maxwell Cat: The Game Simulator – New Character

70050000070784.description: Add a refined, modern Combi with panoramic view to your garage with the Sleek Sports Auto DLC for Car Simulator: Driving School. Its smooth, balanced handling makes it perfect for exploring the open world with comfort and control. Experience how its precise steering and elegant design bring a fresh feel to every road you travel.
70050000070784.intro:
A smooth, refined ride built for the open road.
Explore the world with comfort, control, and style.
70050000070784.name: Car Simulator : Driving School - DLC Sleek Sports Auto

70050000070813.description:
All characters' experience gained increases by 200%.
Effect stacks for similar items.
Settings can be changed in the options section of the menu.
70050000070813.name: Experience x3 - Tears Revolude

70050000070814.description:
All characters' skill proficiency gained increases by 200%.
Effect stacks for similar items.
Settings can be changed in the options section of the menu.
70050000070814.name: Skill Proficiency x3 - Tears Revolude

70050000070816.description:
All characters' experience and skill proficiency gained increases by 100%.
Effect stacks for similar items.
Settings can be changed in the options section of the menu.
70050000070816.name: Experience & Skill Proficiency x2 - Tears Revolude

70050000070817.description:
Disables battle encounters.
Settings can be changed in the options section of the menu.
70050000070817.name: No Encounters - Tears Revolude

70050000070818.description:
Damage dealt to enemies is doubled.
Settings can be changed in the options section of the menu.
70050000070818.name: Damage x2 - Tears Revolude

70050000070835.description: Add a stylish convertible to your garage with this Classy Convertible DLC for Car Simulator: Driving School. This premium sports car includes a full body kit and lets you enjoy driving with the roof open or closed. Explore its customization options and try out the included body kit and rooftop features.
70050000070835.intro:
Drive in style with a classy, customizable convertible.
Experience open‑top freedom wherever the road takes you.
70050000070835.name: Car Simulator : Driving School - DLC Classy Convertible Auto

70050000070836.description: Add a trio of stylish vans to your garage with the Van Vibes DLC for Car Simulator: Driving School. Each van brings its own look and handling, giving you a fresh way to replay missions that feel more challenging with larger vehicles. Explore how each model changes the driving experience as you take them through the familiar course lineup.
70050000070836.intro:
Three vans, three new challenges.
Take on familiar missions with bigger, tougher rides.
70050000070836.name: Car Simulator : Driving School - DLC Van Vibes

70050000070837.description:
Take your prison experience to a whole new level. The prison world becomes even more immersive as ominous clouds fill the sky, changing the atmosphere and adding new challenges to your daily life. Move carefully across the yard, adapt your plans to the dimmed light, and use the shadows to avoid guards or uncover hidden opportunities.

Survive the gloom, outsmart the guards, and plan your escape while the skies grow darker. Can you maintain your freedom under the overcast skies?
70050000070837.intro: Navigate the shadows, outsmart the guards, and find your way to freedom.
70050000070837.name: Prison Life Simulator Jail – Dark Horizons

70050000070910.description:
This pack is primarily a way to support our small team, helping us to continue creating stories and games set in the Riven Realms. If you enjoy our content and want to see it expand, this is a great way to endorse the effort.
As a token of our gratitude for the support, this pack unlocks a single alternative appearance for all Companions* in the game (unique to each Companion). These cosmetics are purely visual, do not alter gameplay in any way, and do not represent “canon” looks for the characters. Instead, they are cool alternatives themed around various cultures of the Riven Realms.

The contents of the supporter pack are:

“Dervish” skin for Harvek
“Argadorean Huntress” skin for Criftaa
“Ash Stalker” & “Ash Haunter” skins for Renkailon
“Mercator” skin for Garrik
“Marauding Warrior” & “Angred Protector” skins for Gor’Goro
“Kalani Crystalmancer” skin for Finndurarth
“Sharduk Nomad” skin for Skornar
“Shalimi Sorceress” skin for Nedir
“Ahari Sunstrider” skin for Eylani
“Demon Thrall” skin for Vorax*
“Sadirar Spirit Talker” skin for Javek*
“Dark Paladin” skin for Sedarias*

As always, your support is much appreciated.
- The Lost Pilgrims Team
70050000070910.name: Vagrus - The Riven Realms Cultured Supporter Pack

70050000070924.description:
Elevate your parking empire to a whole new level with a stunning atmospheric transformation. This DLC adds volumetric fog to your lots, creating a sense of depth, mystery, and realism that changes the way you see and manage your properties.

Drive through misty lanes, observe how the fog alters customer behavior, and navigate a world where visibility affects every decision. Subtle shifts in light and shadows bring your parking lots to life, highlighting hidden details and enhancing the immersive experience.

Adapt your strategies, maintain efficiency, and continue building your empire while the fog adds a fresh challenge and a cinematic touch to your everyday management.
70050000070924.intro: Drive into a new atmosphere where fog transforms your parking empire.
70050000070924.name: Parking Tycoon: Business Simulator – Foggy Streets

70050000070932.description:
Venture through rugged landscapes and take on challenging deliveries across muddy forests, sandy careers, and snowy mountains. This exclusive DLC adds the legendary “Pajero” to your fleet—a powerful, versatile vehicle designed to tackle the toughest terrain with ease.

Upgrade your fleet, master difficult routes, and experience offroad driving like never before. Gear up, hit the dirt, and complete your deliveries faster, safer, and in style, all while enjoying the offroad adventure!
70050000070932.intro: Your fleet just got stronger—take the wheel and dominate.
70050000070932.name: Mudness Offroad Car Simulator: Fleet Expansion

70050000070940.description:
Another wing in the mansion opens up for Sophie and Teddy to explore, which extends the middle of the game with 3 new chapters that you can play as a part of the full experience or as a standalone adventure.

Uncover the story of a tormented Unseen, a spirit child who reaches out to Sophie for help with their final performance. Together with Teddy they reveal new perspectives, a chilling history, and a need to overcome their greatest fears.

The DLC also includes a set of cosmetic items Sophie can wear throughout the whole game.
New outfit - Soot & Tawny.
New hat - Cougher's Cap.
2 new masks (unlocked through play).
70050000070940.intro: Delve deeper into Lady Janna's mansion with the Out of Sight: Stage Fright DLC.

70050000070952.description:
