70050000071091.description:
ABOUT THE EXPANSIONS

THE LAST AUTUMN
The Last Autumn is a turning point in the Frostpunk universe. Revealing the restless events of Site 113 and its struggle to construct the generator before the freezing veil shrouds the Earth, this prequel expansion broadens the Frostpunk universe by introducing a new environment, new Books of Laws and unique technologies, and presents a range of new buildings — all of which let you shape society and the city in unconventional ways. Leading a group of engineers working on one of the world’s greatest technological marvels - a Generator - will require adapting your strategy to extraordinary situations. As the leader of Site 113, hope for the best, but be prepared for the worst. For Queen and Country!
•	experience a prequel story taking place before the freezing cataclysm
•	master a totally new Book of Laws allowing you to shape your society in previously unknown ways
•	construct new buildings
•	discover uncommon, steam-powered technologies
•	apply more advanced strategies to survive
•	delve into a beautiful new environment not yet covered by snow

ON THE EDGE
On The Edge expansion tells a story of citizens of New London sent for a special assignment after the Great Storm. It not only opens a brand new chapter set in the Frostpunk universe but also pits you against new challenges and offers unique mechanics, both in the city and on the Frostland map - further enriching the core experience. A brand new, frozen board is set and the pieces are moving. What destiny lies ahead for your people? What will this mean for you, as their leader? Shape the future of humanity in Frostpunk's final chapter - On The Edge.
•	brand new story scenario, set after the Great Storm
•	an array of challenges to overcome on a new, desolate map
•	unique mechanics to utilize on the Frostland view

THE RIFTS
Experience a new level of challenge on a brand new Endless Mode map, where the land itself threatens your survival. Using a new gameplay mechanic, bridge the rifts to access new areas. Expand the city to save your people from the inevitable doom!
•	unique new Endless Mode map
•	new constructible building
•	new gameplay mechanics
70050000071091.name: Frostpunk: All Expansions Pack

70050000071151.description:
Disney Dreamlight Valley is a hybrid between a life-sim and an adventure game rich with quests, exploration, and engaging activities featuring Disney and Pixar friends, both old and new.

Once an idyllic land, Dreamlight Valley was a place where Disney and Pixar characters lived in harmony—until the Forgetting. Night Thorns grew across the land and severed the wonderful memories tied to this magical place. With nowhere else to go, the hopeless inhabitants of Dreamlight Valley retreated behind locked doors in the Dream Castle.

Now it's up to you to discover the stories of this world and bring the magic back to Dreamlight Valley!

Discover the Secrets of Dreamlight Valley
Free the Dream Castle from the insidious grip of the Forgetting, and unlock the unique Realms of well-loved Disney and Pixar characters, including great queens and kings such as Anna and Simba. Each Realm contains unique challenges with puzzles to solve in the quest to bring friendship back to the Valley.
You’ll start your adventure in the Valley, but your journey will take you to infinity… and beyond! Explore what lurks in the Forest of Valor and brave the deepest caverns as you take on challenges from iconic Disney and Pixar heroes and villains. Who knows who—or what—you might discover.

Forge Friendships with Disney & Pixar Characters
Garden with WALL·E, cook with Remy, or kick back and fish with Goofy. What better way to collect, craft, and rebuild the Valley than with a friend! From beautiful princesses to nefarious villains, every Dreamlight Valley resident brings their own story arc, quests, and rewards. Meet up in daily hangouts and make friends with some of your favorite Disney and Pixar characters.

Restore the Valley to Its Former Glory
Free the Valley from the grip of the Forgetting and return Dreamlight Valley to its former greatness by making it your own. In Dreamlight Valley, you can build the perfect neighborhood that is just for you with a fully customizable layout, creative landscaping, and thousands of decorative items.
Will you settle on the Beach next to Moana, or call Buzz Lightyear your next-door neighbor in the Plaza?

Express Your Disney Style
Bring out your inner princess, villain, or Disney bounder! Assemble unique outfits and decorate your home with thousands of fantastic items. Using the Touch of Magic tool, you can even create your own designs with Disney- and Pixar-inspired decals!
With the in-game Camera, get ready to snap a sunset selfie with Mirabel, capture a culinary creation with Remy, or simply cherish a moment.

A Game in Constant Evolution
New content means that there's always something fresh to explore. Meet new characters in the Valley, check out the latest clothing and furniture collections in Scrooge’s Store, and complete challenging in-game events! Be sure to dream your way back to Dreamlight Valley regularly to discover new adventures!
70050000071151.intro: Explore a world filled with the magic of Disney! Discover rich stories while building the perfect neighborhood alongside Disney and Pixar Heroes and Villains.
70050000071151.name: Disney Dreamlight Valley - Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition Upgrade Pack

70050000071467.description:
Includes 2,000 Moonstones

Disney Dreamlight Valley: Honeyglow Woods is a brand-new Adventure Pack for Disney Dreamlight Valley, perfect for newcomers to the Valley or seasoned Dreamlight players. Befriend 3 beloved Winnie the Pooh Characters, explore and decorate 4 brand-new areas, and solve puzzles in the mysterious Everoak Tree. Reconnect with childlike curiosity, rediscover the joys of friendship with a playful game of Pooh Sticks, and bring a touch of honey to your Valley as you perfect the art of beekeeping, which unlocks dozens of new crafting recipes!


Meet Friends Old and New
Deep within Dreamlight Valley lies the Honeyglow Woods, where you once spent lazy afternoons with long-lost friends.  Rediscover this idyllic place, and you’ll quickly find Winnie the Pooh, radiating with optimism even on the gloomiest days. Nearby, the courageous Piglet is ready to face his fears, and the thoughtful Eeyore quietly accepts the Woods' melancholy... though a little cheering up would be most welcome!
This whimsical world isn't just about reconnecting with old friends; you'll also be making new ones. Befriend a delightful family of colorful hedgehogs, ready to join you on your adventures.


A Touch of Sweetness
At the heart of the Honeyglow Woods lies its golden secret: honey! Learn the art of beekeeping, crafting Busy Bees’ Houses and placing them among vibrant flowers to gather Golden Honey. Use it to create whimsical Honeyglow Furniture, bake delicious treats, and unlock new recipes. You'll soon be spreading a little sweetness to every corner of the Valley.


The Mystery of the Everoak Tree
The Everoak Tree stands tall in the middle of the Woods, surrounded by four entirely unique, enchanting areas. Wander through Drowsybloom Acre, venture into the blooming Braveheart Grove, wade through the delightfully swampy Gloommeadow, and step into the Nectar Apiary and its giant honeycombs. As you restore each area and uncover the secrets within the Everoak Tree, you'll mend the land and unravel the mystery at the heart of the Honeyglow Woods.


A brand-new mini-game!

Disney Dreamlight Valley: Honeyglow Woods includes a brand-new mini-game you can play with all your Villagers: Pooh Sticks, inspired by the game as it appears in classic Winnie the Pooh stories! To play Pooh Sticks, find a bridge in the Gloommeadow and gather four Villagers. Each will choose an object and drop it over the bridge downstream. Whoever's object reaches the finish line on the river first wins! Pooh Sticks is a wholesome new way of creating lasting friendship bonds with your friends and neighbors in the Valley.
70050000071467.intro: Explore the Honeyglow Woods, and reconnect with Disney's Winnie the Pooh, Eeyore and Piglet in a brand-new Adventure Pack!
70050000071467.name: Disney Dreamlight Valley: Honeyglow Woods

70050000071546.description:
Looking to add more flair to your space station?
This exclusive pack unlocks three brand-new decorative items for your decoration blueprint terminal, perfect for giving your station a personal touch.

STAT-O-MAT
The Stat-O-Mat tracks without mercy: how many products you’ve sold, how many customers you’ve made happy, and how many you sent off into galactic disappointment empty-handed. A device for those who love numbers. Or guilt.

GREENFLAME BULB
Rare plant with central fruit. Responds to D64 laser with a brief green flame burst. Presumably ionic, not thermal.

COIN FOUNTAIN
This decorative device launches a shower of coins into the air whenever someone walks by, like a fountain, but with more return on investment. Officially, it serves to motivate the crew. Unofficially, it’s a popular hangout for Erfis with a hunger for pocket change.

Star Ores Inc. – The Official Book
Want to learn more about Star Ores Inc., its characters, and the long-forgotten station? Then you’re in the right place!
This official companion book includes:

The Station’s Backstory
Written by Ben Calvin Hary (currently lead writer at PERRY RHODAN, among others).
Discover who originally built the station, why it drifted abandoned through space for 350 years - and what all of that does to the sensitive emotion chips of a little robot named B.O.B.I.

Entrepreneur’s Station Handout
The unofficial but highly practical quick-start guide for all newly minted station operators!
Everything you need to know about the modern (well… 350-year-old) facilities, amenities, and automated support bots (like B.O.B.I.s and F3000-I ore units - aka Erfis).
A must-read for anyone curious about what actually works on their shiny-almost-new station — and what only runs on sheer optimism.
(Be honest: it was cheap, and you couldn’t afford anything better anyway.)

Morey Millers Mining & Processing Product Portfolio
(Formerly known as the Morey Millers Mining & Processing Product Catalog - but hey, marketing needs to justify its salary somehow.)
The must-have reference for anyone who wants to dig deeper - literally.
From the Deep Core Drill Mk IV to the latest Smelt-O-Tron models and automated forge cores, this guide has everything a prospector could dream of.
Perfect for turning your mine into a thriving business - or at least impressing the Trader’s Guild with your contributions.


Experience the world of Star Ores Inc. like never before - with backstories, in-universe manuals, and plenty of tongue-in-cheek commentary.
Perfect for fans, collectors, and anyone curious about what really lurks beneath the surface.
70050000071546.intro: Unlock three exclusive decorative items and the digital Star Ores Inc. book!

The farther your monsters travel, the more experience points and gold coins they'll earn, and the more crafting items they'll be able to pick up.

Along the way, your party will run into enemy monsters. The only way to avoid them, and go as far as you can, is with perfectly timed jumps and expertly controlled speed.

70050000071756.description:
Downloadable content for DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Withered World.

The metallic ring is a special item you can use while out exploring to turn all the enemies in the area into metal monsters* or hunter mechs. You can use the metallic ring as many times as you like, but you'll have to wait 30 in-game minutes between uses.

The effects of the metallic ring wear off after some time has passed or if you leave your current area.

Depending on when you use the metallic ring, you may encounter monsters that provide far more experience points than otherwise available at that stage in the story. So whether you're just starting out or have already completed the main story, you can use the metallic ring to quickly and effectively boost your monsters' experience points.

*The metal monsters are metal slimes, liquid metal slimes and metal king slimes.

- This content does not include the main game of DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Withered World.

70050000071911.description:
We’re excited to introduce you to Turmoil - Deeper Underground!

• An all-new town with new buildings, a new mayor, and balloon trips to special deep-drilling grounds!
• Besides oil, you can now also find water underground – which comes in handy when you want to drill faster and cheaper! But it’s also essential for the production of the highly valuable petrol!
• Petrol marks the start of a new era. You can’t just dig it up and sell it right away; you first have to produce it in refineries. It’s a challenging but rewarding undertaking, and we trust there will be no complaints about the revenues it generates!
• A brand new expedition: Every few in-game years, regular drilling levels are alternated with special research missions. Here, it’s all about trying to drill as deep as possible with limited resources. Can you drill deeper than your opponents?
• Two new playable characters to choose from: meet Thorpe and Mabel! Both willing and able!
• To get your drilling operation up and running as quickly as possible, meet Yvonne, Sanjay, and Dynamite Dale who will introduce you to their new wares! And of course your old friends Edward, Raynor, Fred, and William will stop by with their train to provide you with all the drilling equipment you need.
• Philip is also back, and he’s got a new game for you: Dice Dice Dice. If you can outsmart him, you’re sure to make a few extra bucks on the side.
• Just like previous campaigns, it’s all about who has the most town shares in the end. Deeper Underground uses the same bidding system as in the multiplayer campaign, but shares can also be earned in the deep-drilling missions.
• And last but not least: we’ve added an explosive item to the game, dynamite! While hard rock can be nice when it comes out of speakers, it’s a big problem when you stumble upon it underground. Normal drills are not strong enough, so make sure to visit Dynamite Dale in the Saloon!
70050000071911.intro: Visit two new areas and discover new gameplay that you’ve never seen before in Turmoil!
70050000071911.name: Turmoil - Deeper Underground

70050000071912.description:

Samael, the “Angel of Death” in the heavens, has always been fiercely loyal. She faithfully follows divine will, guiding those on the brink of death to either Heaven or Hell. One day, she encountered a person protected by “Divine Light” and was unable to take their soul. She returned empty-handed and was reprimanded by God. Even after telling the truth, she received no understanding—only harsher punishment. Anger ignited within the once-loyal Samael, and when Lucifer rose in rebellion, she turned her resentment into fury and raised the banner of defiance.

Samael’s abilities are highly explosive. She burns her own life force to convert it into attack power, using her powerful execution skills to send the dying straight to Hell.
70050000071912.name: New Character: Samael

70050000071913.description:

Lucifer’s skills and abilities are designed around the concept of “Omnipotence.” Her skills and talents are truly one of a kind, offering a highly flexible and diverse set of combinations that allow her to handle any situation.

•Carry the parts and assemble a toy according to the plan!
"Chippy and Noppo" is an action puzzle that assembles parts into a toy!
Collect the parts in the factory, process the colors and shapes, and make the same toy as the blueprint.
"Even if it's a little different, you might be able to clear it...!?
Because the factory manager is a bit careless."

•Let's join the power of two guys with different personalities!
Cheerful "Chippy" is good in low places.
Tall and easy-going "Noppo" is good at jumping.
The key to clarifying the game is the cooperation of both, using their individuality to split roles, and more!

In solo play, operate two guys at the same time!
Operate well and aim for the fastest clear!
In multiplayer, operate "Chippy" and "Noppo" respectively.
This is a place where you can chat, so let's play while talking to friends and family!

•A lot of fun in the factory!
The factory is full of machines!
Let's make full use of the machine by processing the color and shape of the parts, using them for moving, and more!

Progress in the game, factories in the woods and seas will appear!

What kind of toys are those two really good friends going to make,
and what kind of future are they going to make?

70050000072575.description:
Live the life of an escaped worker, washed-up on a lawless station at the edge of an interstellar society. Inspired by the flexibility and freedom of Tabletop RPGs, explore the station, choose your friends, escape your past and change your future.

ABOUT THIS GAME
One of 2022’s most acclaimed indies, the Game Awards-nominated Citizen Sleeper is a Tabletop-inspired narrative RPG set on Erlin’s Eye, a ruined space station that is home to thousands of people trying to survive on the edges of an interstellar capitalist society.

You are a sleeper, a digitised human consciousness in an artificial body, owned by a corporation that wants you back. Thrust amongst the unfamiliar and colourful inhabitants of the Eye, you need to build friendships, earn your keep, and navigate the factions of this strange metropolis, if you hope to survive to see the next cycle.

ROLL THE DICE. DO THE WORK. GET PAID. SURVIVE.
Inspired by Tabletop Roleplaying games, Citizen Sleeper uses Dice, Clocks and Drives. Each cycle you use the dice you are dealt to choose what to do with your time. Make or break alliances, uncover truths and escape your hunters. Survive and ultimately thrive, one cycle at a time.

TURN UP FOR YOUR FRIENDS
The station plays host to characters from all walks of life, trying to eke out an existence among the stars. Salvagers, engineers, hackers, bartenders, street-food vendors, each has a history which brought them here. You choose which of them you wish to help, and together you will shape your future.

ACCESS THEIR SECRETS
Eventually, you will learn to use your dice to hack into the station’s cloud to access decades of digital data, uncover new areas and unlock secrets. This is your unique power, and with it you can change your future. Corporate secrets, rogue AIs and troves of lost data await those willing to dive into the depths of the station’s networks.

YOU WERE MADE TO DIE
Essen-Arp: to them you are just property, one more asset in a portfolio that stretches across the stars. You are the product of an abusive system, in a universe where humanity’s expansion is marked by exploitation and extraction. Escape the makers of your decaying body, and chart your own path in a richly imagined, deeply relevant sci-fi world which explores ideas of precarity, personhood and freedom.

THE COMPLETE EXPERIENCE
Citizen Sleeper now includes all three post-launch DLC episodes FLUX, REFUGE and PURGE, which expand the game and introduce additional characters and locations to Erlin’s Eye in an exciting new late game storyline.
70050000072575.intro: ROLEPLAYING IN THE RUINS OF INTERPLANETARY CAPITALISM

70050000072984.description:
The highly anticipated sequel to one of 2022’s most acclaimed RPGs!

You are a sleeper, an emulation of a human mind housed in an artificial body. You are on the run from the corporation that made you and the gang that seeks to control you. Commandeer a ship, build a network of crew and allies, and take on challenging contracts as you seek to build a future for yourself.

Choose a class, configure your skills and assemble your crew in unique tabletop-inspired gameplay. Your future depends on the roll of a dice, as you make difficult choices in a complex world. Reinventing the award-winning systems of Citizen Sleeper, this RPG will satisfy both fans of the original game and new players alike.

STAY AHEAD OF YOUR PAST
After a desperate attempt to free yourself from servitude by rewriting the very code that governs your system, you are on the run again, this time with a malfunctioning body, a price on your head and no memory of your past.

REBOOT / REBUILD / REPAIR
Citizen Sleeper’s revolutionary dice system returns, revised for the sequel. Manage your stress or take damage to your dice. Deal with glitches as they accrue in your system. Push yourself to get lucky and make this cycle count.

PUSH YOUR LUCK
Each character class now has a unique “Push” ability that can help you turn the tide of a difficult job or send you into a dangerous spiral depending on how and when you choose to use it. Reroll your dice to change your fate, or focus a single die to bet everything on a big success.

NAVIGATE THE BELT
Chart a course from hub to hub with complete freedom, taking on jobs and setting goals as you see fit. A living world, the Starward Belt rewards curiosity and care, but it's up to you to decide which locations and stories deserve your time and resources.

DO THE JOB, GET PAID
Contracts offer a new kind of focussed, tactical gameplay to the Citizen Sleeper experience. You’ll need to prepare carefully and choose the right approach for these multi-cycle, high-risk, high-reward jobs, but you’ll also have to react and adapt to both the roll of the dice and the twists and turns of each task.

CHOOSE YOUR FUTURE
Player choice is a massive part of the Citizen Sleeper experience, and the sequel deepens this with new skill checks that allow you to express your class and character in scenes, as well as branching storylines that will ask you to make hard choices. The future of your character is up to you.
70050000072984.name: Citizen Sleeper 2: Starward Vector – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition Upgrade Pack

IT'S CLOBBERIN' TIME!

With surprising mobility allowing him to bounce across environments to get the jump on enemies, this former ace pilot embraces his new role as a tanklike protector of family and allies alike, arriving as an incredible asset to any team.

70050000073467.description:
The second of Japan’s "Great Unifiers," Toyotomi Hideyoshi brought Japan under one rule in the chaos of the Sengoku period. Beginning his career as a lowly footsoldier, Hideyoshi rose to become one of Oda Nobunaga’s most trusted retainers and a fearless warrior, as well as a patron of the arts. Upon Nobunaga’s betrayal and death, Hideyoshi avenged his former lord and continued the work of conquest, extending his sights out to the Korean peninsula and beyond.

This content is also included with the Brush and Blade Collection DLC Bundle. If you own the Brush and Blade Collection, then you already own this content. DLC released in two installments through July 2026, each delivered automatically in-game on release. Exact release dates subject to change. Terms apply.
70050000073467.name: Sid Meier's Civilization® VII: Toyotomi Hideyoshi Pack

70050000073468.description:
By the light of the moon, in carefully cultivated gardens and elaborate villas, the poets of Heian Japan wrote their tales. The Heian period begins with the establishment of Heian-kyo (today Kyoto) in 794 CE, and marks the last era of classical Japanese history. It was a time of court refinement, when men and especially women of the court refined literature into a high art; it was also a time of rural neglect and decay, when the countryside grew increasingly restless, and tensions between powerful clans. This tension was to erupt in a revolt in the early 12th century, and the rise of the shogunates that were to dominate Japanese history for centuries afterward.

This content is also included with the Brush and Blade Collection DLC Bundle. If you own the Brush and Blade Collection, then you already own this content. DLC released in two installments through July 2026, each delivered automatically in-game on release. Exact release dates subject to change. Terms apply.
70050000073468.name: Sid Meier's Civilization® VII: Heian Japan Pack

70050000073469.description:
The Sengoku period was a war of all against all, when fortunes of samurai and daimyo were made and lost, and the source of many of the classic tales of feudal Japan. Beginning in the late 15th century and as feudal power grew, regional lords and clan leaders fought over control of the imperial throne, using European guns, ninja clans, temple armies. The period featured such figures as Hattori Hanzo, Oda Nobunaga, Toyotomi Hideyoshi, and Tokugawa Ieyasu. Tokugawa, securing the shogunate in 1603, ended the conflict, and established a centuries-long peace.

This content is also included with the Brush and Blade Collection DLC Bundle. If you own the Brush and Blade Collection, then you already own this content. DLC released in two installments through July 2026, each delivered automatically in-game on release. Exact release dates subject to change. Terms apply.
70050000073469.name: Sid Meier's Civilization® VII: Sengoku Japan Pack

70050000073470.description:
The famed admiral, Yi Sun-sin, was a man of duty and resolve. Through a volatile career plagued by betrayal, Admiral Yi never strayed from his duty, answering the call of his king even from the depths of prison. From the splintered remains of the Korean navy, he forged a fleet of strength and led his men to victory against the overwhelming odds of the enemy, cementing his legacy as a hero to his men and to his people.

This content is also included with the Brush and Blade Collection DLC Bundle. If you own the Brush and Blade Collection, then you already own this content. DLC released in two installments through July 2026, each delivered automatically in-game on release. Exact release dates subject to change. Terms apply.
70050000073470.name: Sid Meier's Civilization® VII: Yi Sun-sin Pack

70050000073471.description:
Out of the fragmentation of Korea’s Three Kingdoms period came Goryeo, a center for scholarship and art, and a formidable force in East Asia. Established in 918 CE, Goryeo became a bastion of Buddhist scholarship, and was an early innovator in moveable type – in other words, a printing press. Additionally, Goryeo celadon pottery is famous for its sophistication and artistry. Goryeo faced challenges, though, keeping peace on the peninsula at first through strength, and then through strategic positioning as a vassal of the Yuan Dynasty of China. Yet in that empire’s fall, a new order arose – Joseon.

This content is also included with the Brush and Blade Collection DLC Bundle. If you own the Brush and Blade Collection, then you already own this content. DLC released in two installments through July 2026, each delivered automatically in-game on release. Exact release dates subject to change. Terms apply.
70050000073471.name: Sid Meier's Civilization® VII: Goryeo Pack

70050000073472.description:
As stable as it was isolated, the Joseon Dynasty was a centuries-long period of peace in Korea, marked by the elaboration of Confucianism, a strong defense, and a rich local culture. Founded in 1392, the kingdom lasted until just before the dawn of the 20th century, repelling invasion after invasion from its neighbors. It was a highly structured society, with a rich scholarly tradition that carefully monitored outside influences, selecting only that which would make Joseon prosper. It would fall in 1897, after pressure from the ascendant Meiji Empire and the United States became overwhelming.

This content is also included with the Brush and Blade Collection DLC Bundle. If you own the Brush and Blade Collection, then you already own this content. DLC released in two installments through July 2026, each delivered automatically in-game on release. Exact release dates subject to change. Terms apply.

70050000073922.description:
Help cute, ghostly bears find peace in this relaxing sequel to the beloved life-sim game where kindness rules and new crafting, building, and camping island adventures await.

Attention, Spirit Scouts! Something spooky is afoot: A bus crash has left you stranded alone on a mysterious (yet delightfully cute) island. Explore the unique island, meet and befriend cute, ghostly spirit bears who need your help to remember their pasts and find peace. Customize a bustling, beautiful campsite by crafting, decorating, and building furniture to bring life and color back to this cute island, and hopefully reunite with your lost scout troop as you gradually repair your bus.

YOUR RELAXING ISLAND OASIS AT THE END OF A STRESSFUL DAY

Whether you're new to the "Cozy Grove" community or a devoted fan, this relaxing follow-up to the beloved life-sim adventure offers something for everyone. This edition of "Cozy Grove" is cuter and cozier than ever, introducing a fresh cast of quirky characters, new animal companions, a new setting and added gameplay features that offer endless ways to unwind at the end of a stressful day. So immerse yourself in a unique, relaxing watercolor art style filled with stunning details and activities to explore. Drop in daily for crafting, decorating, fishing and cooking fun, or embark on new quests to stay busy. Lead with kindness and achieve your camping dreams. Customize the cute, spooky island you've always wanted.

FIND NEW FOREVER FRIENDS AND CUTE ANIMAL COMPANIONS

Alongside familiar faces like Flamey and Mr. Kit, new spirit bears are waiting to bond with you and share their backstories. New animal companions are also on the island to offer support and relaxing comfort. Now you can pet a dog (!) or have a snail help lighten your load.

EXCHANGE GIFTS WITH ASYNCHRONOUS MULTIPLAYER MODE

A new asynchronous multiplayer mode lets you see spooky, cute astral projections of other players, connect with fellow Spirit Scouts and send and receive cute gifts through the mail. But introverts, no need to worry: There's no pressure to interact with your fellow players in real time. You're free to discover and gift in your own time, at your own relaxing pace.

NEW SPOOKY MYSTERIES TO INVESTIGATE

Uncover the secrets of the interconnected islands you've landed on as you complete daily quests. As you progress with patience and diligence, you may unlock new areas to explore. Visit dedicated stations for different activities and light up lamps to find bountiful new spots for foraging and mining.

CUSTOMIZE YOUR ISLAND WHILE CRAFTING, DECORATING AND CAMPING

Just because you're living on a haunted island doesn't mean you can't get comfortable! Immerse yourself in crafting and decorating activities, or collect furniture to make the island your own. Plant flowers and fruit trees to harvest, raise ghostly animals and attract pets to your house. And if things start to feel ho-hum, give yourself a custom head-to-toe makeover.

A POSITIVE, HEARTENING DAILY RITUAL

This life-sim game unfolds in sync with real-world time, bringing cute surprises and spooky seasons on the island. If you finish the day's quests, you can cook, craft, collect shells, catch bugs, go fishing, skip rocks or even spruce things up with a new power-washing tool. Rake in rewards as you add to your collection of cute items and earn merit badges for all your accomplishments. A Spirit Scout's work is never done!

Created with love by Spry Fox
70050000073922.intro: All those who are lost deserve kindness.
70050000073922.name: Cozy Grove: Camp Spirit – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition Upgrade Pack

Fight strategic turn-based battles that blend classic RPG command systems with modern mechanics. Exploit enemy weaknesses, trigger chain attacks, and unleash powerful break attacks. Earn notoriety through misdeeds to rank up and unlock unique arts via a skill tree. Explore dungeons, gather resources, and develop your own evil base with a smithery, lab, smuggling, and more. 70050000074418.description:
Step into the role of a truly hands-on mayor and shape your town from the ground up.

Plan neighbourhoods, optimise logistics networks, and help your community grow - all while juggling workers, infrastructure, suspiciously large tools, visiting robots, aliens & dinosaurs, and the general day-to-day chaos of building your dream town.

And when mayoral duties get a little much, take a break with a spot of fishing, have a spin on the Go-Kart track, or even high-five a cow.

Play solo for perfect control, or bring friends for co-op mayhem.

Grow Your Town

Lay down your streets, then place businesses, homes, and services where they’ll thrive. Welcome tourists, keep them happy, and give them plenty of reasons to stick around and make your town their home. Hire workers, keep shops stocked, and make sure the money keeps flowing, then upgrade, expand, and unlock new ways to help your town flourish.

Optimise, Automate, Prosper

Tailor each business, industry zone and building configuration to suit your wants and needs. Assign workers, optimise supply chains, set-up logistics networks and watch your systems flourish. Will you let automation do the heavy lifting, or will you be the Mayor of Micromanagement?

Bring The Style

As mayor, style starts at home, but it doesn't stop there. Dive into immersive house customisation with full 360° placement and a handy colour picker, then take that creative control across your town with recoloured buildings, and plenty of ways to make every street, shop, and neighbourhood feel uniquely yours. Need a new look while you work? Step into the Change-O-Tron and emerge as the mayor you were always meant to be. Your town. Your mayor. Your style.

Chaotic Co-Op

Team-up with up with another mayor, in either local and online play for just the right amount of teamwork and chaos. Build together, manage together, panic together, and discover how quickly a carefully planned town can go sideways when everyone has a different idea of ‘helping’.

For those light, feel-good sessions where you just want to pick a page and enjoy the moment, Happy Pack is the cozy go-to. Expect simple doodle-style drawings, bigger shapes, and thicker lines, made to feel friendly for little hands and calming for everyone.

You’ll color cheerful scenes filled with farm friends, friendly dinosaurs and adorable animals from around the world. Expect plenty of chibi-style cuties, happy foods and simple  mandalas, all made for quick, feel-good coloring without stress.

What’s included
- 11 collections (132 drawings total)
- 2 sticker packs (20 stickers total)
- 2 palettes (32 colors total)

And if you want the complete set, the full version—sold separately as the Cozy Bundle—includes: 450+ pages, 33 themed collections, 40 voxel 3D models, all sticker packs (110 stickers total), all palettes (192 colors total), plus 20 whiteboards for drawing freely.


Controls
Choose your favorite way to play:
- Motion pointer (Joy-Con™): move the pointer by tilting the controller like a magic wand.
- Touchscreen: tap and color directly for a smooth, hands-on experience.

Tools
Keep it simple or get creative: use cozy tools like brushes (with different looks), a satisfying fill bucket, an eraser, glitter and sticker stamps to decorate your pages.

70050000074835.description:
Leaving the Blue Hole behind, Dave and his crew travel to the jungle to investigate a mysterious phenomenon reported in the village of Utara. Beneath the jungle lake awaits a brand-new ecosystem to explore, along with new missions and discoveries.

Featuring over 10 hours of new story and gameplay, DAVE THE DIVER - In the Jungle Content Pack introduces new systems, new locations, and thrilling new adventures beyond the ocean.

■ Freshwater Lake - Discover a whole new ecosystem
Prepare to encounter unfamiliar creatures, discover new ingredients, and face the hidden dangers lurking deep within an ancient underwater civilization.

■ Bancho Grill - New restaurant, new menu, same Bancho standards
Welcome to Bancho Grill, where bold jungle ingredients meet Bancho’s uncompromising culinary craft. Build relationships with the villagers and they might stop by as guests. See for yourself whether Bancho’s legendary cooking can win over the jungle too!

■ Utara Village - a warm welcome in the jungle
Lend a hand to the villagers and build meaningful relationships. Some may be wary of outsiders at first... but a thoughtful gift or a great meal can go a long way!

■ The jungle runs deeper
The jungle holds more than just villages and lakes. From mysterious ancient temples to eerie forests, Dave and his crew’s adventure continues deeper into the unknown!
70050000074835.intro: Dave’s adventure continues, this time in the heart of the jungle.
70050000074835.name: DAVE THE DIVER - In the Jungle Content Pack

70050000074839.description:
Enhance an already critically acclaimed RPG adventure with this upgrade pack. Xenoblade Chronicles™: Definitive Edition – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition features improved visuals, running at 60 frames per second with 4K* resolution in TV mode and full HD resolution in handheld mode, as well as smoother and sharper cutscenes. Not only does it contain all the additions and improvements of the Definitive Edition on the Nintendo Switch system, but it also includes some additional content for you to enjoy!

Race across the Bionis and Mechonis on a high-powered vehicle

Introducing the Ether Jet: a vehicle that will greatly enhance the speed at which you can traverse the Bionis and Mechonis, both in the main game and in the extended story of Xenoblade Chronicles: Future Connected (which has also been enhanced). But this is not just a convenience feature—you can also race competitively against the clock or your party members on racetracks throughout the world and earn in-game rewards in the process.

Unlock additional equipment, experience fully voiced Heart-to-Heart conversations, and more

Get equipment made for riding the Ether Jet, and experience Heart-to-Heart scenes with fully voiced dialogue for the first time!
70050000074839.intro: Upgrade Shulk’s adventure on the Nintendo Switch™ 2 system!
70050000074839.name: Xenoblade Chronicles™: Definitive Edition – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition Upgrade Pack

70050000074851.description:

Solve crimes as Sherlock Holmes, Professor Moriarty, Dr Watson and Irene Adler in this epic crossover. Each character sports an all-new design, creating an updated look that blends them seamlessly into the game you know and love.

As these characters aren’t tied to any expansion or case files, you can use them and their alternate-pose tokens right away.

Add the legendary cast of Sherlock Holmes to your next game of Clue and figure out whodunit…
INCLUDES:

2 x SHERLOCK HOLMES TOKENS – Don the deerstalker and deduce who committed the crime as Sherlock himself!
2 x PROFESSOR MORIARTY TOKENS – Sherlock’s archenemy arrives, bringing his cunning wit to the Clue board.
2 x DR WATSON TOKENS – The ever-faithful doctor turns his attention to the problem at hand!
2 x IRENE ADLER TOKENS – The only person to have truly outwitted Holmes, Irene Adler takes on the case!
70050000074851.intro: Become the legendary detective himself and play Clue!
70050000074851.name: Clue: Sherlock Suspect Pack

Your road to success just got a whole lot faster!

70050000075105.description:
In ancient times, Saint Baal'Thasar had a vision of paradise, lit by a bright, red moon. And so he founded the Order of the Red Moon, to lead people to a land of eternal life. The myth says that Baal'Thasar found his paradise during a pilgrimage, and so never returned.

Having lost its leader, the Order shattered and many fringe sects were born from its remnants. Today, members of one of the most unscrupulous cults, Clan Bloodmoon, embark on a journey to follow in Baal'Thasar's footsteps…

10+ New Characters
Unscrupulous beings consumed by ambition, a cautionary tale, or a story better left untold?
Legacy of the Bloodmoon adds 10+ new cursed characters, including:

Malice Bloodmoon: Malice is leading a pack of disciples in the search for the ancient lair of the Order of the Red Moon. Little do they know, they are there just to be used as cannon fodder and meat shields by the ruthless matron.
Calogero Bloodmoon: A heinous beast of a man with an unquenchable bloodlust. Any obstacle in his path ends up shattered by his massive axe.
Baal'Thasar: The founder of what was once known as the Order of the Red Moon, or what's left of him. What did he truly find on his pilgrimage?
Ashtart: One of the first followers of Baal, now turned into a malevolent presence that inhabits any old bones it touches.
Sargon: A king from ancient times who followed Baal, driven by ambition and fear of death, only to end up forever trapped in a hellish dimension.

16+ New Weapons
16+ new weapons across base forms and evolutions, including:

Scarlet Needle: Malice's favourite attack. Enemies are impaled by needles that inflict paralyzing pain.
Incineration: Why deal damage when you can erase a whole bunch of enemies from existence with a single flick of the hand?
Blacken Firmament: An ominous celestial body darkens the heavens and starts tearing reality apart.
FireBall: Yep, peak originality: a weapon called fire ball will now be in Vampire Survivors. To not be confused with FireFall, FireWall, or their union: FireStall.

8 New Music Tracks
♫ Legacy of the Bloodmoon
♫ It's Her Nature
♫ What He Wished For
♫ Borrowed Feathers
♫ Grasp All
♫ Lose All
♫ You Knew What He Was
♫ When You Took Him In


A new XL Stage

Red Moon Manor: The ancient lair of the Order of the Red Moon. The myth says that Baal'Thasar had built it as a fortress to conceal the secret of immortality. But Malice and Calogero discovered that the manor does indeed exist. What is it truly hiding?
70050000075105.intro: A cautionary tale, or a story better left untold? Legacy of the Bloodmoon is the darkest expansion to date for Vampire Survivors.
70050000075105.name: Vampire Survivors: Legacy of the Bloodmoon

70050000075203.description:
ARVEN, THE WOLF BLADE

Play as Arven, a Ranger of relentless determination who heard of a group of heroes trapped within an Astral Prison. Fighting alongside the wolf Kat, his hunting companion, this new hero had no other choice but to lend his blade to those fighting for their survival.

Arven is a character from Fallen Fates, the upcoming action RPG by Hibernian Workshop.

DLC CONTENT
- Brand new mechanic - Arven never travels without Kat. Traverse the astral prisons in good company with this wolf who will follow you throughout your escape attempts. Compatible with the Celestial Heaven DLC: your pet and Kat will follow you side by side.
- 25 new unique spells - Use the greatsword to create powerful slashes, move nimbly while setting up explosive traps, and more.
- Signature Spell - Throw a hook onto an enemy and dash towards them, while summoning Kat to assist you in battle and follow you around the battlefield.
- 30 Associated Perks - Adapt Arven's Signature Spell to your playstyle.
- 2 Weapon types for different playstyles:
    - Alpha Sword - Medium-range attacks, swinging and slashing enemies.
    - Ethereal Missiles - Use magic to shoot powerful blasts of energy from long range.
- 6 Weapon Passives - Each weapon comes with 3 unique passives, making Arven and Kat an even deadlier duo.
- Stellar Voice Acting - Arven is fully voiced in Japanese and English by the incredibly talented Tagui Omi and Ben Starr, respectively.
- New Papa Yalee Stories - 4 new stories to learn about Arven and Kat's mysterious origins.
- Cinematics and ending screens - Brand new cinematics and a new ending screen have been added for Arven.

HOW TO ACCESS ARVEN
If you own this DLC and have not yet met Arven in the Garden, he will appear after a couple of escape attempts.

ADDITIONS TO THE BASE GAME
Even if you do not own the DLC, you will still be able to:

- See Arven hanging out in the Garden.
- Collect and use 2 Arven Echoes during runs.
- Fight Arven's Shadow Clone.
70050000075203.name: Arven - The Wolf Blade

70050000075206.description:

Navigate the deepest snow and conquer frozen peaks with half the standard energy consumption.

70050000075214.description:

The more enemies you defeat, the more you’ll fill a gauge that you can use to strengthen your forces. Enhance your abilities, gain additional allies, but choose wisely—you’ll need to prepare well to defeat the almighty foe awaiting you at the end!

Use faction perks — There are 50 Mandates in total, divided into five tiers. When a faction gains a seat in government it’ll grant one of these perks, providing a powerful one-time effect.

Leadership - Lead your Martian society in different ways with 4 new leaders. Invest in your leadership by increasing the amount of leaders that are proposed per term, or even increase the number of skills your leaders can use per turn.

Music - Accomplish all of this while listening to a new music track.

Turn the key, feel the nostalgia hit, and rewrite street racing history as you unleash this ultimate icon under the midnight sky!

70050000075624.description:

This DLC delivers an immediate boost to your tactical gear, providing 50 bonus shield health points to help you survive the most unforgiving firefights. When combat intensifies and enemy forces close in, this vital upgrade ensures you stay standing

Absorb heavy damage, outlast advanced artificial intelligence, and execute your espionage objectives with maximum efficiency.

70050000075655.description:
With this DLC, you will unlock:
• Permanent Auto Fire

When enabled, your fireballs are launched automatically during regular stages, helping you destroy targets, earn coins, and build strength without aiming every shot manually.

You can turn Auto Fire off in the Boosters tab if you want to return to manual control. Auto Fire does not work during Challenges, so you will still need to prove your skill when it is time to unlock the next stage.
70050000075655.intro: Let the fireballs fly on their own!
70050000075655.name: The Legend Of Fireball: Auto Fire DLC

70050000075657.description:
Speed defines survival.

The MP7 Arsenal Expansion introduces a lightweight and fast-firing weapon built for high-pressure combat. Designed for players who rely on quick reactions and constant movement, this weapon allows you to stay one step ahead in every encounter.

Ideal for close engagements, it delivers consistent performance when the fight becomes intense and unpredictable.

Key Features:
- Fast and responsive weapon handling
- Optimized for close-range encounters
- Supports high-mobility playstyle
- Expands combat flexibility
Stay fast. Strike first.
70050000075657.intro: Where Survival is Earned, Victory is Inherited.
70050000075657.name: Battle Royal - Battlegrounds Call MP7 Arsenal Expansion

70050000075658.description:
With this DLC, you will unlock:
• Griffith - Alpha Pet from the Light Family

Add Griffith to your pet collection and strengthen your team with a powerful Light Family companion. This Alpha Pet boosts the passive skills of all pets in its family, giving your lineup even more power during regular stages.

Griffith also comes with an active skill that increases Stamina Recovery, helping you keep the fireballs flying longer as you train, destroy targets, and prepare for tougher challenges.
70050000075658.intro: Unleash Light Family power with Griffith!
70050000075658.name: The Legend Of Fireball: Griffith DLC

70050000075661.description:
With this DLC, you will unlock:
• Rath - Alpha Pet from the Dark Family

Add Rath to your pet collection and strengthen your team with a fierce Dark Family companion. This Alpha Pet boosts the passive skills of all pets in its family, giving your lineup even more power during regular stages.

Rath also comes with an active skill that increases Fireball Power, helping you hit harder, destroy targets faster, and prepare for tougher challenges.
70050000075661.intro: Unleash Dark Family power with Rath!
70050000075661.name: The Legend Of Fireball: Rath DLC

70050000075666.description:
Stay unseen. Strike precisely.

The VAL Silent Strike DLC introduces a weapon designed for controlled and stealth-focused combat. Built for players who prefer precision over noise, this loadout allows you to eliminate targets efficiently while staying under the radar.

Ideal for tactical approaches, it gives you the advantage in situations where positioning and timing matter more than raw firepower.

Key Features:
- Precision-focused weapon for controlled engagements
- Designed for stealth-oriented gameplay
- Effective in mid-range combat situations
- Expands tactical playstyle options
Move quietly. Eliminate efficiently.
70050000075666.intro: Where Survival is Earned, Victory is Inherited.
70050000075666.name: Battle Royal - Battlegrounds Call VAL Silent Strike

70050000075671.description:
Get a leg up on the Bydo with the Unit Color Variation Fighter Pack for R-Type Tactics I･II Cosmos. In addition to new color variations, you'll also get access to the following units without spending any resources (perfect for clearing the game's early stages!)

70050000075673.description:
Celebration time! Bellfaire adds 6 exciting gameplay modules you can mix-and-match to expand your options and play with wild powers!
15 unique player powers which dramatically change your game
4 mysterious Forest locations
10 Events (9 special, 1 basic) to get you into the celebratory mood
Special Garland Awards for the most festive critters

Plus, Cardinals and Toads make their arrival as workers!

70050000075673.name: Everdell - Bellfaire

70050000075710.description:
In the high-stakes world of crime scene cleanup, a professional is only as good as their tools. This DLC changes the skin of your primary equipment, transforming both your brush and spray bottle into high-end, custom-designed variants.

While your cleaning power and stealth mechanics remain unchanged, you can now scrub away bloodstains and eliminate evidence with the sharp look of a top-tier cleaner who means business.

Gear up, head to the next crime scene, and erase the evidence with flawless style!
70050000075710.name: Criminal Cleaner Simulator – Elite Gear

70050000075719.description:
Boost your magical tree defense adventure and gain extra resources to strengthen your fight. Get 500 nuts added directly to your in-game balance and use them to unlock upgrades, improve your weapons, and prepare for tougher waves of enemies threatening your enchanted home.

Expand your arsenal, enhance your abilities, and gain the advantage you need to protect the magical tree from relentless attacks. Every nut brings you closer to victory!
70050000075719.intro: Expand your arsenal and stand stronger against every enemy wave.
70050000075719.name: Squirrel Madness: Nut Boost

70050000075880.description:
Enhance your survival capabilities with an extra shield bar added alongside your health. This shield starts at 100 units and absorbs incoming damage first, providing you with an additional buffer during intense encounters with deadly werewolves.

The shield regenerates using the same mechanics as your health, restoring over time when out of combat. Healing consumables prioritize restoring health first, and once your health is full, they will begin to repair your shield instead.

Adapt your strategy, manage your resources wisely, and increase your chances of surviving the night in the face of relentless supernatural threats.
70050000075880.intro: Outlast the horror with improved damage protection.
70050000075880.name: Werewolf Hunter - Survive The Howl: Damage Barrier

70050000075919.description: Unlock new boards where you can draw your own stories.
70050000075919.intro: Create your own colorful stories with the latest DLC!
70050000075919.name: Personal Boards 10

70050000075923.description:
Accelerate your rise through the criminal underworld and prepare for bigger, more rewarding heists.

Gain an instant financial boost for your criminal career with 1000 added directly to your in-game balance. Use your funds to improve your equipment, unlock useful upgrades, and prepare for increasingly challenging heists across the city.

Strengthen your preparation, improve your efficiency, and stay one step ahead of security systems as you work your way toward becoming the most skilled car thief in the city.
70050000075923.intro: More funds, more freedom, more successful heists.
70050000075923.name: Car Heist Simulator - Thief Mechanic: Cash Boost

70050000075925.description:
Wobbly Life is a vibrant open-world physics sandbox. Play with your friends online or in local co-op, with exciting jobs, mini games and wacky story missions. Earn cash to spend in the world on clothes, vehicles and houses. There is a whole Wobbly World out there to explore!

Grandma has kicked you out into the big wide Wobbly world demanding you go and GET A JOB! She would be so proud if you could earn some money and get your own house one day!

It's time to start earning and living your best Wobbly Life!

Includes Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition features:
- GameShare: Play Wobbly Life with anyone – even if they don't own the game!
- GameChat: Share audio and video while playing with your friends.
- Start where you left off on Nintendo Switch™ with forwards compatible save game to Nintendo Switch™ 2
- 1-4 players online and local split screen co-op

Open-world sandbox filled with mini-games, toys, secrets and SO MUCH more

+100 unique missions & jobs with exclusive rewards to unlock, alone or with friends

+90 vehicles to ride around (and crash)

+500 clothes items to show-off in your wobbly look

+infinite number of wobbly fun!

FUN, FRIENDS & PHYSICS!

Let's start exploring! Almost everything is interactive – grab, play, and experiment in a world filled with props, mini-games, and surprises.

Experience the joy of individual quests and shared adventures with up to 4 players in online or local co-op, all in one fantastical world.

MYSTERIES AND MISSIONS

Embark on story missions, each offering unique rewards through satisfying puzzles and challenges. Unveil the mysteries of the tropical island, uncover the mountain’s secrets, delve into hidden caves...

The Wobbly Museum has lost all its artifacts! Maybe you can help? Buy treasure maps and solve clues to find all the Museums' lost treasures and unlock fun rewards.

GO GET A JOB!

Make grandma happy and go get that job! Earn money by choosing from +20 exciting jobs, each bringing their new unique challenges. From pizza delivery to firefighting, taxi driver to disco dancer… your wobbly dream job is waiting for you.

LIVE THE HIGH WOBBLY LIFE!

Once you’ve fattened up your bank account why not go on a shopping spree? Visit the Pet Shop to buy a faithful companion, buy and unlock +500 clothes items and choose from +90 different vehicles.

When you’ve really made the big bucks, you can even buy a house: from a wooden shack to a huge fancy mansion, Wobbly Island has a home for everyone whatever your taste!

PLAY YOUR OWN WAY WITH ARCADE MODE

Want to take a break from the Wobbly Island? Try out the Arcade mode! Discover four new game modes: Trash Zone, Hide & Seek, Wobble Run and Sandbox. Each have customizable settings for you to play with, multiple mini-games and new areas to have fun in!

GO TO SPACE! The Wobbly Space Programme is looking for new recruits. Space is a whole new open world, with new jobs, missions, and secrets to uncover. You'll even get to fly your own spaceships too, so what are you waiting for!
70050000075925.name: Wobbly Life - Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition Upgrade Pack

70050000075938.description:
Give your winery a stronger foundation and accelerate your path to success with additional resources at your disposal.

With $1500 added directly to your in-game balance, you can expand your vineyard, invest in better equipment, and improve your production capabilities from the very beginning.

Grow your business faster, refine your winemaking process, and take your first steps toward becoming a renowned wine producer.
70050000075938.intro: Build, expand, and produce with greater confidence.
70050000075938.name: Wine Factory Simulator: Starter Capital

This cat will be the last” is the biggest lie in human history. With Cats Pack, you can get new furry friends without feeling guilty! Can you resist their feline charms?
Cats Pack DLC contains new cats to fit in the box.
70050000076147.intro: Purrfect cat organizer – fit them all
70050000076147.name: Cats Pack

70050000076148.description:
Wind Character Pack adds new winds to your adventure!

This pack introduces 4 new Wind Shards, each with unique abilities, playstyles, and synergies, allowing for new builds, strategies, and ways to face the game’s challenges.

Designed for players who enjoy experimenting with different mechanics and mastering agile movement, the Wind Shards focus on speed, area control, and dynamic interactions with enemies.

Included content:
• 4 new elemental Wind Shards
• Unique abilities for each character
• New build and synergy possibilities
• Fully integrated with the progression and systems of the base game
70050000076148.intro: Discover 4 new Wind Shards with unique abilities focused on speed, area control & enemy interaction. Unlock new builds and synergies!
70050000076148.name: Shard Squad - Wind Character Pack

70050000076149.description:
Making food is much more fun if it looks pretty! Pack your delicious food neatly in brand new boxes and never get bored!
Boxes Pack DLC allows you to change bento boxes – pick the one you like the most or change them every time you play to always keep things fresh!
70050000076149.intro: Your perfect, cat-themed lunchbox puzzle is here!
70050000076149.name: Boxes Pack

70050000076150.description: Give your kid more space to play and learn! Unleash their artistic talents with a new canvas ready to be filled with colorful stories.
70050000076150.intro: Awaken your child's imagination with Paint for Kids.
70050000076150.name: Additional Board 3

70050000076152.description:
Enhance your experience with a visual upgrade for your scanning equipment. This DLC changes the appearance of both the clothing scanner and the temperature scanner, giving your inspection tools a refreshed and distinctive look while maintaining full functionality.

Continue your duty at the border with improved visual clarity and a more personalized inspection setup as you monitor incoming survivors and detect potential infections in a world overrun by the outbreak.
70050000076152.intro: Border duty never stops—make sure your equipment is up for the challenge.
70050000076152.name: Quarantine Lockdown Simulator: Zombie Border – Security Gear

70050000076203.description:
Elevate your infernal style while tearing through the nightmarish hordes of Hell.

This DLC grants your lethal demoness an exclusive new outfit, blending supreme temptation with absolute power. As you slice, shoot, and scorch your way through twisted arenas, this stunning attire will ensure you look flawlessly fierce in every brutal encounter.

Embrace the dark temptation, unleash your full power, and show every monster who is in charge.
70050000076203.intro: Give your lethal succubus a stunning new appearance.
70050000076203.name: Succubus Sexy Devils: Abyss Outfit

70050000076205.description:
Take flight in your seaplane on a heartfelt adventure across the tropical Limbo archipelago. After a devastating storm, gather materials with your Swirler, and help the locals rebuild. Can you uncover the truth behind Uncle Lou’s disappearance?

A Seaplane, a Storm, and a Missing Uncle

Take to the skies in your trusty seaplane on a heartfelt adventure across the tropical Limbo archipelago. After receiving a distress call from Uncle Lou, you arrive only to find the islands in disarray and Lou nowhere to be found. Collect resources, help rebuild a community, and unravel the mystery of your uncle’s disappearance.

Collect, Craft, Restore

Harness the vacuum power of the Swirler! — a glorious multi-tool — to collect everything from scrap and native plants to materials dropped by Limbo’s unique wildlife. Use your finds to repair buildings, craft goods, and help the communities thrive again.

Claim your slice of paradise at Lou’s Lagoon. Build your dream beach hut, add your personal touch, and let the island rhythm take over.

Meet the islanders of Limbo

Discover the archipelago’s vibrant islands, each with their own spirited communities, hidden treasures, and unique problems to solve. Get a warm welcome from the Charneys in Tangle Bloom—the archipelago's liveliest town—then head to Gleam Reef to watch the Vooi move to the music of the tides. Lastly, visit Boulderia, home to the grumpy, sugar-crystal-mining Gorplins!

Key Features: 
- Explore the Limbo archipelago, home to vibrant communities and ancient secrets. 
- Pilot your very own seaplane, master ring challenges, and enjoy the freedom of open skies. 
- Upgrade your gadgets to expand your adventures. Scoop, build, glide and fish! 
- Build your island base, decorate it, and make Lou’s Lagoon feel like home. 
- A mystery to unravel. Piece together clues, follow Lou’s trail, and uncover the truth behind his disappearance! 

Whether you’re hot on the trail to solving the mystery of Uncle Lou or just kicking back and enjoying island life, Lou’s Lagoon is your ticket to an exciting adventure.

Ready for takeoff?
70050000076205.name: Lou's Lagoon – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition Upgrade Pack

70050000076214.description:
Who says the ultimate apex predator can’t have immaculate drip? Take your urban destruction to a whole new level of style!

With this DLC, your shark’s favorite footwear gets a premium upgrade. Experience a brand-new, high-end material texture on your sneakers that catches the light perfectly as you tail-slap your way through skyscrapers.

Run rampant, abduct characters, and crush bosses while sporting the freshest look in the entire metropolis. Destroy the city, but make it fashion!
70050000076214.intro: New kicks, fresh threads, unstoppable shark powers.
70050000076214.name: Tralalero Tralala Simulator: Fancy Predator

70050000076216.description:
Step into a refreshed version of your delivery experience with a playful visual twist.

Bring a fresh visual theme to one of your favorite challenges. This DLC replaces the standard boxes in the “Loader” level with a collection of retro televisions, giving one of the game’s delivery missions a completely different appearance.

Take on the Loader challenge with a different look and enjoy a new way to experience your favorite deliveries.
70050000076216.intro: The delivery industry called—they want their 90s technology back!
70050000076216.name: Animal Buddies - Party Beasts: Vintage Overhaul

70050000076220.description:
Take your first steps into the world of skateboarding with additional resources ready to support your adventure.

Expand your skateboarding journey with an additional $1000 added directly to your in-game balance. The extra funds provide greater flexibility for customizing your bunny, upgrading your skateboard, and exploring more of the game’s progression systems.

Enjoy a more versatile skating experience and create your own path to becoming a legendary skater bunny.
70050000076220.intro: Build your dream setup and ride your own way.
70050000076220.name: Skater Bunny Simulator: Skate Capital

70050000076225.description:
There are many rumors about why the ethereal Xuan Nü appeared. Some say she came by Heaven’s mandate to save the Great Fire; others say she drifted here because of a conflict between divine beliefs; or perhaps she carries an even greater, unspeakable secret. Whatever the truth may be, she seems to share some common goals with the Heir of Formlessness. If you can earn Xuan Nü’s trust and aid, you will surely gain an unmatched and powerful ally on your path to immortality!

Skill Introduction:
Voidbreaker
Deals self-element damage based on Attack to a single enemy character.
On Lucky Hit: Deals additional self-element damage based on the target’s lost HP.

Heaven-Earth Rectification
Deals self-element damage based on Attack to the single enemy character with the lowest HP.

Primordial Revelation
When dealing hit damage: Has a chance equal to a certain percentage of her Crit Rate to double the damage.

Mandate to Slay Evil
When landing a kill: Deals non-elemental damage to all enemy characters equal to a certain percentage of the overflow damage.
70050000076225.intro: Please update the game to the latest version first. After installing the DLC, restart the game and complete her story missions to recruit her into your squad.
70050000076225.name: Daughter of Fate

70050000076269.description:
Blood on the Danube takes Easy Red 2 to Hungary in 1945, focusing on some of the final and most brutal battles of the Eastern Front of World War 2.

Fight across three historical campaigns: the Siege of Budapest, the Konrad Offensives, and Operation Spring Awakening. Experience more than 30 missions across two maps, from large-scale armoured warfare near Lake Balaton to brutal street-to-street fighting inside Budapest.

The expansion adds new Hungarian and Romanian factions with dedicated voice acting, along with a wide selection of new weapons, vehicles, tanks, aircraft, support equipment, and late-war experimental gear such as the Vampir ZG-1229 night vision scope.

Blood on the Danube expands the base Easy Red 2 experience with new environments, factions, equipment, and combined-arms battles designed to integrate with the mission and map editor.
70050000076269.intro:
Fight the Eastern Front’s final battles.
From Budapest’s streets to Balaton’s frozen fields,
the Danube runs red.
70050000076269.name: Easy Red 2: Blood on the Danube

70050000076273.description:
Every great hotel mogul needs a place to retreat, unwind, and plan their next big expansion. It’s time to trade the standard look for something with a lot more character!

This DLC transforms your player’s personal room into a stylish, atmospheric basement retreat. Blending a cozy underground aesthetic with an industrial edge, this complete visual overhaul gives your private space a unique, modern-rustic look without altering any core hotel gameplay.

Step downstairs, enjoy your newly redesigned sanctuary, and return to the lobby fully recharged to manage your empire!
70050000076273.intro: Run your empire from a completely redesigned basement office.
70050000076273.name: Hotel Business Simulator: Cozy Basement

70050000076333.description:
Help King Moonracer find his toy soldiers who are scattered across an entirely new region, King Moonracer’s Castle. Venture through 6 secret doors to find each soldier and complete challenges to return them to King Moonracer. You’ll also search for 24 new bells across the new region!

Featuring Sam the Snowman as a new playable character.

• All new region featuring six levels, a new storyline, and challenges.

• Added playable character: Sam the Snowman

• A new game mechanic "Sliding Ice". Characters step on a slippery surface and they slide with increasing speed for exciting new platforming challenges.
70050000076333.name: Rudolph the Red-Nosed Reindeer - King Moonracer's Kingdom of Misfits

70050000076338.description: Add some hilarity to your demonic destruction with seven goofy weapons, including the Leek, Push Broom, Rainbow, Megaphone, Paw Stick, Paintbrush, and Demon Gun Yoshitsuna!
70050000076338.name: Disgaea Mayhem - Fun Weapons Pack

70050000076353.description:
Prepare for loads of fun with this cartoon version of the most popular board game in the world. This time with our new Grass Green Chessboard.
Help your thoughts flow easier with the new skin to your chessboard.
70050000076353.intro: Prepare for loads of fun with this cartoon version of the most popular board game in the world.
70050000076353.name: Grass Green Chessboard

70050000076357.description:
Add this powerful motorcycle to your garage with the Chopper Bike Pack DLC for Street Racing Simulator Evo : Car & Moto.
Upgrade and customize it to your liking to create your own unique chopper.
70050000076357.intro:
Ride this beast through city streets.
Kick it into gear and reach top speeds.
70050000076357.name: Street Racing Simulator Evo : Car & Moto - DLC Chopper Bike Pack

70050000076358.description:
Seven Stars Pavilion is an ancient sect deeply versed in the stars and the movements of heaven and earth. In an ancient age beyond record, Seven Stars Pavilion was founded in the northern part of the continent—a place better suited for observing the heavens. The Seven-Star Diviners are the core members of Seven Stars Pavilion. Their study of the starry heavens has reached perfection, allowing them to command the great power of the stars for their own use.

Skill Introduction:
Star Essence
Deals self-element damage based on Attack to a single enemy character.
On Lucky Hit: additionally restores a certain amount of Mana.

Seven-Star Soul Suppression
Summons 7 Star Pieces. Each Star Piece deals self-element damage based on Attack to a random single enemy character.

Starry Array
When triggering Lucky Hit:
Applies 10 stacks of 【Starry Array】 to the target, lasting until the end of the wave.

Astral Divination
After casting Ultimate:
Applies 10 stacks of 【Astral Divination】 to self, lasting until the end of the wave.
70050000076358.intro: Please update the game to the latest version first. After installing the DLC, restart the game and complete her story missions to recruit her into your squad.
70050000076358.name: Seven-Star Strategist

70050000076389.description:
Add this premium performance car to your garage with the Premium Car Pack DLC for Street Racing Simulator Evo : Car & Moto.

Upgrade and customize it to your liking to create your own unique ride.
70050000076389.intro:
Ride this beast through city streets.
Kick it into gear and reach top speeds.
70050000076389.name: Street Racing Simulator Evo : Car & Moto - DLC Premium Car Pack

70050000076395.description:
Add two exclusive vehicles to your garage with the Ultimate Vehicle Pack DLC for Street Racing Simulator Evo : Car & Moto.
Upgrade and customize them to your liking to create your ultimate collection.
70050000076395.intro:
Choose your beast and dominate the city streets.
Kick it into gear and reach top speeds.
70050000076395.name: Street Racing Simulator Evo : Car & Moto - DLC Ultimate Vehicle Pack

70050000076397.description:
As additional downloadable content for "GROOVE COASTER FUTURE PERFORMERS", a pack featuring 6 popular songs and the character Kasane Teto is now available!

This pack includes the following content.

■ Songs (6 tracks)
- Liar Dancer / masarada
- Science / MIMI
- CANDY COOKIE CHOCOLATE / HALLO CEL
- Daidaidaidaidaikirai / Amala
- Signaling / AnythingBecomeMoe
- Brain Rot / Tokyo Manaka

■Navigator
- Kasane Teto(GCFP)

■Avaters
- Kasane Teto(GCFP)
- Kasane Teto(SV)
- Kasane Teto(White coat)

Once you add the DLC, all songs are immediately available to play in Performance Mode! Additionally, each song will be added to specific spaces as challenge tracks in Story Mode!

The navigator “Kasane Teto(GCFP)” features an original design created for this game, and includes both animations and voice lines!
Navigator and avatars can be unlocked through the "Virtual Singer Vol.2 Song + Character Pack Mission" added to Story Mode!

This mission also lets you enjoy a mini-story in four parts featuring Kasane Teto and this work’s original character, Sarashina Rikka(CV: Ohzora Naomi)!
70050000076397.intro: A pack featuring 6 popular songs including "Liar Dancer" and "Brain Rot", along with a "Kasane Teto" navigator and avatar is now available!
70050000076397.name: Virtual Singer Vol.2 Music+Character Pack

70050000076417.description: Bored with your current Nintendo Switch™ theme? Give your console a fresh, fabulous look with nOS new Operating System and a pack of 4 cute, cozy wallpapers (coming both in light and dark mode!)
70050000076417.intro: Engage the newest Nintendo Switch™ experience. Transform your favorite console into an amazing, and surprisingly small personal computer.
70050000076417.name: Wallpapers Pack 2

70050000076420.description: Expand your pottery collection with Watering Can DLC! Discover a variety of beautifully decorated watering cans inspired by nature, animals, and cozy gardens.
70050000076420.intro: You'll forget about the rest of the world with the most satisfying hobby - repairing cute cat pots!
70050000076420.name: Watering Can

70050000076440.description: Upgrade from the Nintendo Switch™ software Outlaws + Handful of Missions: Remaster to Outlaws + Handful of Missions: Remaster – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition!
70050000076440.name: Outlaws + Handful of Missions: Remaster - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition Upgrade Pack

70050000076451.description: Experience higher resolutions, frame rates, and graphical quality when you upgrade to the Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition of STARBITES! You'll appreciate Bitter like never before!
70050000076451.name: STARBITES - Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition Upgrade Pack

70050000076456.description: Bring even more cuteness to your creations with Cats DLC! Decorate your cozy spaces with 20 adorable cat characters in playful poses, making every design even warmer and more charming.
70050000076456.intro: Unleash your creativity in a cutest possible way!
70050000076456.name: Cats

70050000076458.description: Experience SOMA on Nintendo Switch™ 2 with enhanced image quality and a smoother frame rate.
70050000076458.intro: A masterpiece of psychological horror. Fight to survive in a hostile world that will make you question your own existence.
70050000076458.name: SOMA - Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition upgrade pack
