70050000076483.description:
Expand your Coloree collection with a journey into the animal kingdom. Wildlife adds 15 new color-by-number illustrations featuring fascinating animals from around the world – from powerful predators and gentle herbivores to colorful birds, delicate insects, and many other remarkable creatures.
Each artwork offers a peaceful, relaxing experience with no timers, no scores, and no pressure. Simply follow the numbers and watch every animal come to life with vibrant colors. Whether you're looking for a quick moment to unwind or a more detailed coloring session, Wildlife has something for every mood.
What's inside:
15 new wildlife-themed artworks to color at your own pace
A diverse collection of mammals, birds, reptiles, insects, and more
A mix of simpler and more detailed illustrations for every skill level
Relaxing, number-guided coloring designed for adult players
Calm, pressure-free gameplay that's perfect for unwinding
Discover the beauty of wildlife, one color at a time.
70050000076483.intro: Find calm in relaxing world-themed coloring
70050000076483.name: Wildlife

70050000076492.description:
Darkness falls upon the world, bringing deeper secrets and an entirely new visual thrill.

The sky has changed, and a new atmosphere awaits.This DLC replaces the standard gray sky with a deep, mysterious night sky, altering the visual aesthetic of your entire adventure.

Every sword clash, fire-ball capture, and hidden clue feels completely different under the cover of darkness.
70050000076492.intro: Embrace the eternal night and rewrite your own legend.
70050000076492.name: Wukong Black Legend: Nightfall Descends

70050000076494.description:
Expand your fleet. Expand your power.

The Falcons A10 & F2 Pack introduces two advanced aircraft built for different combat styles. Whether you prefer heavy firepower or speed and precision, these jets give you more flexibility in every mission.

Take control of powerful new machines designed to handle intense aerial combat. Adapt your tactics, improve your performance, and approach missions with new strategies depending on the aircraft you choose.

This expansion adds more variety to your gameplay, allowing you to face every challenge in the skies with greater confidence and control.

Key Features:
* Two additional aircraft with unique performance styles
* Expanded combat strategies and playstyles
* Enhanced aerial combat flexibility
* More options for different mission types
Take to the skies with more power than ever.
70050000076494.name: AirJet Fighter : Sky Assault Warzone Falcons A10 & F2

70050000076495.description:
Double the jets. Double the impact.

The Dual Strike Fighters SU15 & F16 DLC expands your arsenal with two versatile aircraft designed for dynamic aerial combat. Each jet brings its own balance of speed, control, and firepower, allowing you to adapt your approach in every mission.

Switch between different combat styles and take advantage of new performance capabilities as you face increasingly intense battles. Whether you prefer precision or aggressive engagement, these aircraft give you the tools to stay ahead in the skies.

Key Features:
* Two new fighter jets with distinct handling styles
* Balanced performance for multiple combat approaches
* Increased flexibility during missions
* Expanded aircraft selection
Take control of the skies with new power and precision.
70050000076495.name: AirJet Fighter : Sky Assault Dual Strike Fighters SU15 & F16

70050000076496.description:
Strike unseen. Control the skies.

The Stealth Vanguard Pack SU57 & SAAB JAS 39 introduces two advanced aircraft built for precision, control, and low-profile combat. Designed for pilots who rely on positioning and timing, these jets allow you to approach every mission with a more tactical mindset.

With enhanced maneuverability and stealth-oriented performance, you can engage enemies on your terms and maintain control even in high-risk situations.

Key Features:
* Two stealth-focused fighter jets
* Designed for precision and tactical gameplay
* High maneuverability and control
* Expands strategic combat options

Dominate the skies without being seen.
70050000076496.name: AirJet Fighter : Sky Assault Stealth Vanguard Pack SU57 & SAAB JAS 39

70050000076498.description:
As Kril the hermit crab, you’ll need to wear the trash around you as shells to withstand attacks from enemies many times your size. Embark on an epic treasure hunt to buy back your repossessed shell, and discover the dark secrets behind the polluted ocean.

TRASH OR TREASURE?
In this undersea society, trash is not only a way of life, but a valuable resource, used for everything from fashion to firearms. But with the presence of trash comes a mysterious infection known as the Gunk, which could spell doom for the entire ocean.

LEARN FROM NATURE
As Kril explores the ocean, he'll gain a variety of Umami Techniques—powerful attacks learned from the denizens of the seas. Punch your enemies with the overwhelming might of a Mantis Shrimp, ensnare them with the horrifying Bobbit Worm, and much more.

UNEXPLORED DEPTHS
The ocean goes deeper than one can imagine. Fight your way through kelp forests, coral reefs, sand castle cities, and even the unfathomable darkness of the deep-sea trenches, all in the name of getting back your prized shell.

PLAY AT YOUR OWN PACE
Designed to be an approachable experience for newer soulslike players as well as provide a challenge for hardcore fans, Another Crab's Treasure offers something for any level of skill or time commitment. Assist options are provided for those seeking a less frustrating experience, but gluttons for punishment are sure to find the default game a challenge.

-Soulslike-inspired combat designed to be approachable for new players while still challenging experienced fans.

-A vast undersea world to explore with colorful creatures to fight and secrets to discover.

-Over 60 shells with a variety of special abilities to defend yourself against the ocean’s threats.

-Meet a host of undersea friends and foes as you slowly discover the dark secrets behind the polluted ocean.

-Learn magical Adaptations from creatures throughout the world, making their powers your own.
70050000076498.intro: A soulslike adventure set in a crumbling underwater world.
70050000076498.name: Another Crab's Treasure - Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition Upgrade Pack

70050000076504.description: Transform your virtual space into a peaceful Zen sanctuary with the Japan DLC! Design a traditional, tea-scented oasis for your cute animal residents - the ultimate cozy aesthetics of Japan are at your fingertips!
70050000076504.intro: Welcome to Cozy Tiny Home, a warm and heart-melting decorating game where you can design the most adorable spaces imaginable - and fill them with sweet animal friends!
70050000076504.name: Japan

70050000076506.description: Tasty bananas, juicy raspberries, refreshing lemons… Make sure ALL the fruits fit in, and nothing goes to waste! Have fun stuffing 34 new, delicious items in a fancy, new box with a Fruits DLC!
70050000076506.intro: Shove it, stack it, sort it out!
70050000076506.name: Fruits

70050000076514.description: It’s time for a fresh start – make your creative space reflect your vibe to the fullest! Give your crafting space a sweet makeover with this cosmetic DLC that transforms your atelier into a dreamy cotton candy-inspired haven filled with soft pastel charm.
70050000076514.intro: Watch your beautiful garden grow, dye fabrics, and turn them into beautiful clothing.
70050000076514.name: Cotton Candy Room

70050000076515.description:
Decorate your space with adorable feline charm in the Cats Art DLC! Fill your room with cat-themed wallpapers, wall art, and cute décor that celebrate everyone’s favorite companions.

Purr-fect style for every cat lover!
70050000076515.intro: Create your dream room and make it truly yours
70050000076515.name: Cats Art

70050000076537.description:
This Hoop Pack contains 60 unique Hoops in various categories and sizes.
Featuring your favorite categories plus brand-new ones to discover:
- Animals
- Fairy Tales
- Games & Hobbies
- Mythical Creatures
- Transportation
- Outdoors
- Best Friends
- Pixel Art
- Retro
- Tiny Dinos
- Aquarium
- Food & Drinks
Expand your stitching adventure today!
70050000076537.intro: Stitch it up to puzzle out!
70050000076537.name: Hoop Pack 3

70050000076539.description:
This Weekly Hoops Pack contains 52 unique Hoops inspired by celebrations, cultural events, and special days from around the world.
There's always a new story to stitch!
70050000076539.intro: Stitch it up to puzzle out!
70050000076539.name: Weekly Hoops Pack 1

70050000076548.description:
Disney Speedstorm is the ultimate hero-based combat-racing game, set on high-speed circuits inspired by Disney and Pixar worlds. It’s a thrilling arcade racing experience where players will need to master each Character’s unique Skills on the racetrack and claim victory.

DISNEY & PIXAR GO FULL BATTLE RACING
An incredible cast of characters, including Sulley, Beast, Mickey Mouse, Mulan, Baloo, Captain Jack Sparrow, and more, are suited and revving up for racing combat. Upgrade each Racer’s stats and make the most of their unique Skills that can impact the outcome of a single race and dramatically change the way you play the game!

ARCADE RACING REDEFINED
Anyone can pick up and play Disney Speedstorm, but mastering skills and techniques like timing your nitro boosts, precisely drifting around corners, and adapting to dynamic track environments are crucial to dominating each race.

RACING TOGETHER HAS NEVER BEEN EASIER
Pick your Racer and speed through action-packed tracks solo, or challenge friends in local and online multiplayer modes. You can even face off with players from around the globe to become an online legend.

DISNEY- & PIXAR-INSPIRED RACETRACKS
Start your engine in environments inspired by some of your favorite Disney and Pixar films. From the docks of Pirates of the Caribbean’s Kraken Port to the wilds of The Jungle Book’s Jungle Ruins or the Scare Floor from Monsters, Inc., you can experience these worlds from a fresh, exciting perspective geared specifically for racing!

CUSTOMIZE TO YOUR OWN STYLE
Choose your favorite Racer’s suit, a flashy kart livery, and show off stylish wheels and wings -- all of this and more is possible with the extensive customization features in the game!

NEW CONTENT RACING YOUR WAY
The action never slows down thanks to fresh seasonal content always around the corner. New Disney and Pixar Racers will be added regularly, bringing special skills for you to master (or overcome), and unique tracks will be created often, to pump fresh strategy into the mix. Support Crew characters, environments, customization options, and collectibles will also drop in regularly, so there’s always more to experience.
70050000076548.intro: Drift into the ultimate hero-based combat racing game, set on high-speed circuits inspired by Disney and Pixar worlds.
70050000076548.name: Disney Speedstorm – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition upgrade pack

70050000076553.description:
UNO™ gets flexible with UNO FLEX!™

Easy to learn and full of surprises, UNO FLEX!™ brings fresh dynamics to every UNO™ match. Flex cards and Power mechanics let you change colors and trigger alternate effects at the perfect moment, while powerful Action cards add even more twists and impact.

CHANGE COLORS, CHANGE THE GAME
Some cards feature a Flex side, offering an alternate color or effect.
Use them to change the color or trigger powerful effects, giving you more options when you’re stuck and keeping the game moving.

CHANGE WHEN YOU FLEX
Your Power determines when you can activate the Flex side of a card. Use it at the right moment to turn the game in your favor. Timing is everything.

NEW ACTION CARDS WITH BIG IMPACT
Unleash powerful Flex Action cards with memorable effects, including:
•Flex Draw Two, forcing all other players to draw one card.
•Flex Wild Draw Four, targeting a specific opponent.
•Flex Wild All Draw, making everyone else draw two cards.
•Flex Skip, skipping every player at once.
70050000076553.name: UNO FLEX!™

70050000076556.description:
Grants a T-shirt for your avatar that can be used in-game.
Select a character T-shirt for your avatar from 80 designs!
70050000076556.name: Hello Kitty Party Land - Bonus Avatar T-shirt

70050000076557.description: This blaze of colors will never fade away! Make your days at the laundry bright and colorful with the Rainbow Lady Birds DLC.
70050000076557.intro: What if your story started in the afterlife?
70050000076557.name: Rainbow Lady Birds

70050000076589.description:
Every legendary warrior requires gear that matches their valor. This DLC enhances a knight’s available arsenal, ensuring they are well-equipped for the challenges within the bustling cities.

Features:
- Adds Armor Number 7 to the inventory, sculpted to withstand heavy lance impacts in the heat of combat.
- In cases where Armor No. 7 is already available, a sum of 4,727 Coins will be rewarded instead to fund future tournament preparations.

Equip the armory, secure the treasury, and ride into the fray with confidence.
70050000076589.intro: Forge a legendary path with upgraded battlefield readiness.
70050000076589.name: Mounted Knights Battle : Medieval Warrior Honor Simulator - Elite Gear

70050000076670.description:
When every shadow could hide a deadly threat, reliable night vision becomes your greatest advantage.

This DLC adds a Night Vision Camera to your inventory with unlimited battery power, allowing you to explore the darkest corners of the Backrooms without worrying about losing visibility. If you already own a Night Vision Camera, it will be automatically upgraded with an infinite battery.

Keep your camera powered at all times, uncover hidden paths, spot dangers before they strike, and face the endless darkness with complete confidence.
70050000076670.intro: Every corridor. Every secret. Always visible.
70050000076670.name: Escape the Backrooms BODYCAM: Night Ops

70050000076692.description:
Expand your business faster and hit the road without worrying about your starting budget.

This DLC grants $75,000 directly to your in-game account, giving you the freedom to invest in better trucks, essential upgrades, and new opportunities from the very beginning. Build your transport company, complete more profitable contracts, and accelerate your journey toward becoming a successful trucking entrepreneur.

Take control of your future, grow your fleet with confidence, and keep your business moving forward.
70050000076692.intro: Build your trucking empire with a powerful financial advantage.
70050000076692.name: Truck Simulator 25: Euro Driver – Road to Success

70050000076697.description:
A fresh outfit can completely change the feel of every encounter.

This DLC replaces Mira’s default clothing with an entirely new outfit, giving the mysterious companion a distinctive new appearance throughout the adventure. Every conversation, discovery, and unforgettable moment is accompanied by a refreshed visual style that blends naturally with the game’s immersive atmosphere.

Experience the story from a new perspective as Mira’s updated look brings an extra touch of personality to every encounter.
70050000076697.intro: Keep the story, change the style.
70050000076697.name: MYSIDE REALITY: Cozy Style

70050000076707.description: Experience a bonus story and acquire five new enemy types (Sea Angel, Flora Beast, Evil Eye, Zombie Maiden, and Nine-Tails), each of which can become a battle buddy! You'll even be able to recruit Desco!
70050000076707.name: Disgaea Mayhem - Bonus Story: Catastrophe Flan Arc

70050000076708.description: Switch up N.A.'s look with these cool colors, unique to the Nintendo Switch™ and Nintendo Switch™ 2 versions of the game!
70050000076708.name: Disgaea Mayhem - N.A. Color Pack

70050000076709.description: With the Digital Soundtrack/Artbook App, you have the perfect digital accompaniment to Disgaea Mayhem. Enjoy the art and music even when you're not playing the game!
70050000076709.name: Disgaea Mayhem - Digital Soundtrack/Artbook App

70050000076778.description:
An unknown dimensional rift suddenly opened in the peaceful 'Slime Dimension'! Waking up in an unknown space filled with sticky and squishy monsters all around, two catgirls from the Catgirl Survivor dimension have crash-landed!

Akane, who deals continuous damage using her fiery fists, and Koro, who freezes enemies to deal massive damage using ice magic!

Strategically utilize the abilities of these two catgirls with completely different combat styles to defeat the Rainbow Slime and send them safely back home!
70050000076778.intro: Firepower support from cute catgirls from another dimension!!
70050000076778.name: No More Slimes!! - "Catgirl Survivor" Characters Unlocked! [Akane] [Koro]

70050000076971.description:
Expand your luxury car care business with additional funds available from the very beginning.

This DLC adds 2,500 to your in-game balance, providing extra resources to invest in better equipment, unlock valuable upgrades, and accelerate the growth of your detailing shop. Build a premium service faster and take on high-end vehicles with greater confidence.

A stronger starting budget means more opportunities to improve your workshop and establish a reputation as the city’s leading luxury car detailing expert.
70050000076971.intro: A financial boost for your luxury detailing business.
70050000076971.name: Car Detailing & Wash Simulator : Luxury Car Cleaner – Growth Fund

70050000077045.description: The adventure continues! Discover new items, locations, and challenging opponents with exciting rewards!
70050000077045.name: DLC 1

70050000077048.description:
Trading Places!
Resources gain a new role in Trade Secrets. The Goldlings have discovered your village, and they are eager to trade their coins for your resources!  Stockpile goods in warehouses, move them via roads, and trade them through markets. Then use your hard earned coins to trade even more!

Born to ride!
Pips have finally discovered a better way to get their work done, by riding horses and using other means of transports! Craft boats, build carts, and tame horses to aid in the expansion of your village!

Brave new world!
After years of fear, Pips are ready to explore the world beyond! Dispatch them on expeditions and see what they bring back: rare resources, lost blueprints… and the occasional unfamiliar disease.

Three new elders!
New elders join the world of dotAGE! Meet Wanna the Merchant; Darwin the Explorer, and the elusive Granny!

..and secrets?
The outside world is mysterious, what might be waiting for you out there? Some Pips say that there is a lost treasure out there, as well as some kind of... special cult. There is only one way to find out... start exploring in Trade Secrets!
70050000077048.intro: The world of dotAGE gets bigger! Trade Secrets adds 3 new elders, mechanics, resources, buildings, events, and much more!
70050000077048.name: dotAGE: Trade Secrets

70050000077049.description: Another thrilling quest awaits on the horizon - one full of formidable foes that will put your skills to the test!
70050000077049.name: DLC 2

70050000077066.description:
Bring even more life to the world of Raccoon Adventure with three brand-new animal species waiting to be discovered.

This DLC introduces three new types of animals that naturally appear throughout the game world, making every exploration feel more varied and alive. Encounter fresh wildlife during your adventures, discover new interactions, and enjoy a richer environment as you roam forests, parks, and suburban neighborhoods.

Every journey becomes more exciting with additional creatures to find, observe, and share the world with as you continue your mischievous raccoon adventure.
70050000077066.intro: Expand your adventures with brand-new wildlife encounters.
70050000077066.name: Raccoon Adventure: Animal City Simulator 3D Farm Super Deluxe – New Species

70050000077076.description:
Face the nightmare with two essential sources of light that will help you survive the horrors hidden within the maze. This DLC adds a flashlight and a candle, giving you additional ways to navigate dark corridors and uncover what lurks in the shadows.

The flashlight illuminates your path until you pick up the pistol, at which point it is automatically replaced. If you die, the flashlight disappears, making every decision and every step through the darkness even more meaningful.

Venture deeper into the unknown, reveal hidden dangers, and rely on every source of light as you fight to escape the nightmare.
70050000077076.intro: Every journey into darkness begins with a light.
70050000077076.name: SCREAM AND STEEL - Horror Story Shooter: Light the Way

70050000077078.description:
Strengthen your arsenal with the DKS-501, a precision weapon built for long-range engagements and tactical missions. This DLC adds the rifle directly to your inventory, giving you another reliable option for taking on challenging assignments.

In addition to the weapon itself, you’ll also receive six locked weapon skins, allowing you to unlock and customize the rifle’s appearance as you progress.

Gear up, complete your missions, and master every shot with a weapon designed for elite marksmen.
70050000077078.intro: Bring new firepower to the battlefield.
70050000077078.name: SNIPER WARRIOR ELITE: Ready to Fire

70050000077156.description:
Growing your fleet is an important step toward building a successful transportation network.

Features:
- Adds the Martopolo double-decker bus to your vehicle collection.
- If the Martopolo bus has already been purchased, 290,000 in-game currency is awarded instead.

Expand your fleet, optimize your routes, and keep your passengers moving with confidence.
70050000077156.intro: Drive more routes with an expanded fleet.
70050000077156.name: City Bus Simulator: New Wheels

70050000077161.description: Make the guests of your restaurant feel calm and eat your delicious meals with peace of mind with Green Zen Set! DLC adds a new customization option for tableware you serve your carefully prepared dishes on.
70050000077161.intro: Run the best restaurant in the middle of the city, complete orders, learn new recipes, and improve your cooking skills.
70050000077161.name: Green Zen Set

70050000077176.description:
Every successful supermarket begins with smart investments. This DLC instantly adds 2,000 to your in-game balance, giving you additional funds to stock your shelves, expand your inventory, upgrade equipment, and improve your store from the very beginning. Make strategic decisions, invest where it matters most, and accelerate your journey toward becoming a successful supermarket owner.

Grow your supermarket with confidence, make every investment count, and turn your local shop into a thriving retail destination.

70050000077232.description:
The Peabody Award-winning 1000xRESIST is a thrilling sci-fi adventure. 1000 years in the future, humanity is all but extinguished, and a disease spread by an alien occupation keeps the survivors underground. You are Watcher. You dutifully fulfil your purpose in service of the ALLMOTHER, until the day you learn a shocking secret that changes everything.

THE END OF HUMANITY
In the near future, we learn we are not alone in the universe. A mysterious alien race of giant entities arrives. We call them the Occupants.

They are not hostile, but it doesn’t matter. Their arrival is a death sentence. Humanity is wiped out in a matter of months, succumbing to a disease the Occupants have brought to our planet.

There is one survivor, a teenage girl called Iris. Somehow she is immune.

SOCIETY IS REBORN IN HER IMAGE
1000 years later. Iris is not only immune, but immortal. She has birthed a new society consisting exclusively of her own clones. She calls them Sisters. They call her the ALLMOTHER.

RELIVE HER MEMORIES
Within the Orchard, every sister has an assigned function, while six sisters have special roles to play.  As the new Watcher, Your role is unique. You have the great privilege of reliving and interpreting the memories of the ALLMOTHER through a process known as Communion, made possible by Secretary, your floating AI companion. You're excited to embark on your first Communion.

RESIST A THOUSAND-YEAR-OLD LIE
Your closest sister, Fixer, comes to you with a dangerous revelation. You have been lied to. The ALLMOTHER is not what she claims to be. Fixer’s claims rock the foundations of your world, throwing everything you know and believe into doubt as it falls to you to discover the truth.

DISCOVER THE TRUTH
Dive into the memories of the ALLMOTHER and explore pivotal moments in her life, jumping back and forth through moments in time to solve puzzles and access locked-off areas and secrets.

A STORY LIKE NO OTHER
Experience perspective shifts both literal and metaphorical as the game blends between 3rd person adventure, visual novel and first person walking simulator while throwing twists, turns and revelations at you until you question everything you think you know.
70050000077232.intro: A society of clones is ripped apart by a 1000-year-old secret.
70050000077232.name: 1000xRESIST – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition Upgrade Pack

The southern Vainlands have long been forsaken and left to rot by the One Kingdom. Though too treacherous for most, the hooded stranger is called to this mystifying region. Explore new dungeons, discover secrets, and face new challenges that await in these accursed lands.

70050000077751.description:

Alongside new assist characters, combos, and powerful new moves, these fan-favorite additions expand the action with fresh ways to battle through Toronto.


• New Playable Characters
Stephen Stills
An aggressive rushdown frontman who keeps the pressure on with six strings-fueled attacks. Whether he's smashing enemies with his guitar or blasting them away with ear-popping feedback, Stephen is all about staying in your face and orchestrating devastating beatdowns.

Kim Pine
A hard-hitting mix-up fighter who combines brutal drumstick strikes, stomping breakdowns, and goth-cutie attitude. Kim lays down devastating rhythms with explosive drum solos, and trades BPM for PPM: Punches Per Minute!

Knives Chau
A lightning-fast hit-and-run rogue specialist who overwhelms enemies with acrobatic attacks, and shadow clone techniques.Agile and elusive, Knives excels at weaving through the battlefield while delivering precise punishment.

• New Combos and Sick Moves
Discover new ways to string together over-the-top combos: Master new techniques, supers, and character-specific abilities. Launch enemies with sonic uppercuts, unleash drum-powered beatdowns, create shadow clone pressure, a whole setlist of moves worthy of a reunion!

• New Assist Characters
Expand your strategies with an all-new lineup of assist characters:

Joseph
The legendary producer behind the band cranks the volume to eleven, dropping a towering wall of sound that sends sonic projectiles crashing through the battlefield.

Hollie
No-Account Video's finest employee is done collecting late fees! Armed with her trusty remote, Hollie traps enemies in a relentless barrage of hits, giving you plenty of time to rewind the pain.

Mr. Chau
Knives' fiercely protective father joins the fight. Channel his unwavering determination to summon shadow clone support, turning every attack into a devastating multi-hit assault.

New alternate looks inspired by Scott Pilgrim EX's multiversal adventures give your favorite fighters a fresh style for the battle ahead.

70050000078875.description:
Includes all six episodes of the TV drama broadcast on Nippon TV, one of Japan's leading nationwide television networks!
Experience the world of AKIBA LOST through a unique live-action experience that offers a different perspective from the game.

Story
Thirteen years ago, six girls mysteriously disappeared in Akihabara — a series of unsolved cases known as "The Akiba Vanishing".

At the annual Tokyo Game Expo, Daiki Shinjo (played by Hiromitsu Kitayama), once hailed as a "genius creator," boldly announces the development of a new game inspired by this very incident: AKIBA LOST.
But soon thereafter, the strange disappearances begin again.

The cast of the game includes his sister Aoi Shinjo, who works at a maid cafe, underground idol Kokone Nagato, food writer Moe Kurosu, shrine maiden Chihiro Jimbo, cosplayer Wakana Yusa, and game streamer Yukimi Kurahashi — each a colorful icon of Akihabara’s vibrant subculture.

The story they were supposed to perform soon begins to bleed into reality.
It all starts with a threatening phone call — and the sudden disappearance of Aoi.

"Stop developing the game now. Or else...the tragedy will repeat again."

Can Shinjo finish developing the game? Can he protect everyone? Who is behind it all? And what really happened 13 years ago?
70050000078875.intro: A live-action multi-perspective suspense game of fate and choice in Akihabara
70050000078875.name: AKIBA LOST - Drama Movie

70050000078915.description:
“...we have each of us in the dustiest cellars of our minds a counter at which we strive to repay the debts of the past with the debased currency of the present.” - Gene Wolfe

Two more wayward souls wander the Old Road. The Duelist and Runaway, debuted in Darkest Dungeon II, bring their unique abilities to bear against horrors that lurk beneath the manor.
Patterned in burns, draped in tatters and wielding a crude poker, the vagrant Runaway favours fire and stealth when pressed to fight.
By contrast, the Duelist stands severe, her ornate capelet conspicuously pierced above the breast. No challenger has yet to hold quarter against her bitter edge.


Features:
Two new hero classes: the Duelist and the Runaway
Set the dungeon alight with Runaway’s new combat mechanic: Burn!
New Trinket Mechanics such as Trigger Uses, Quest Charges and Progressive Trinkets
3 new Hamlet Districts: Academie Duello, Craftworks, and Archaeological Base Camp

The Runaway is a position-flexible damage dealer utilizing a unique Burn damage type with high synergy for teams that like to utilize Stuns and Pull/Knockback/Shuffle effects.

The Duelist is a complex damage dealer that dances between the party’s ranks, able to freely maintain Riposte while alternating between her two combat stances, Defensive and Aggressive. Proper planning of the Duelist’s future turns is key to mastering her playstyle and maximizing her potential!

Fans of both games will delight in this re-visioning of these two new iconic heroes for Darkest Dungeon.
70050000078915.intro: The Fire’s Edge DLC brings two new recruitable heroes - The Runaway and the Duelist - to Darkest Dungeon.

70050000079168.name: Toy Cowboy Royale : RPG Dragon’s Challenge – New Arsenal

70050000079183.description:
Step into a new level of performance with the R34 Legends Pack. Built for balance and control, these vehicles deliver a refined driving experience focused on precision and responsiveness.

Designed for demanding tracks and high-speed sections, they give you the confidence to handle corners, maintain stability, and stay in control during intense races. Adapt your driving style and approach each track with greater accuracy.

Expand your garage and elevate your performance on every lap.
70050000079183.intro: Speed, control, and pure racing focus.
70050000079183.name: Auto Sport Racing Simulator – R34 Legends Pack

70050000079191.description:
Bring a sharper, more agile edge to your races.

The Z Street Edition focuses on responsive handling and fast transitions, giving you vehicles built for precision in tighter layouts and urban-style tracks. Every turn demands control, and every acceleration rewards timing.

Feel the difference in how your car reacts, adapt to fast-changing situations, and keep your momentum through every corner.

Take a new approach to racing and refine your driving with a more dynamic style.
70050000079191.intro: Speed, control, and pure racing focus.
70050000079191.name: Auto Sport Racing Simulator – Z Street Edition

70050000079193.description:
Built for the track. Tuned for precision.

The GT3 Racing Pack introduces a class of vehicles focused on stability, grip, and clean execution. These machines are made for drivers who rely on control, consistency, and perfect racing lines rather than raw speed alone.

Every corner becomes a test of balance, every lap a chance to improve. Push your limits, reduce mistakes, and stay locked into the rhythm of the track.

This is where precision driving takes over.
70050000079193.name: Auto Sport Racing Simulator – GT3 Racing Pack

70050000079197.description:
A young cleric named Verselio once devoted his life to serving the deity Treises—until the truth shattered everything he believed. When the divine is revealed to be a lie, faith turns into fury, and a journey of rebellion begins. Joined by a mysterious maiden, a disciplined vigilante chief, and a self-proclaimed deity, Verselio sets out across a vast fantasy world in search of answers. As their paths intertwine, each carries their own burdens, beliefs, and secrets, in a story of betrayal, redemption, and the meaning of faith in a deityless world.

Asdivine Knot is a classic turn-based JRPG that blends strategic command battles with modern systems and deep customization. Master the shared Nexus Gauge to control the flow of combat, unleash powerful Nexus Skills, and summon devastating entities to turn the tide. Explore a wide world with your fully customizable airship, craft and upgrade equipment using collected materials, and shape your adventure with side quests, crew recruitment, fishing, and puzzle dungeons. Packed with rich content and designed for a complete single-player experience, this is a must-play fantasy RPG for fans of traditional Japanese role-playing games.
70050000079197.intro: Tie the knot of fate in a skybound fantasy RPG!
70050000079197.name: Asdivine Knot: Nintendo Switch 2 Edition Upgrade Pack

70050000079202.description:
Improve your chances of survival with a reliable sidearm and additional ammunition, ready from the moment your journey begins.

This DLC adds a pistol loaded with 7 rounds and 200 reserve rounds to your inventory. If you already have a pistol, its ammunition is automatically updated to 7/200, ensuring you’re ready to face every threat lurking in the endless maze.

Fight with confidence, conserve your ammunition wisely, and survive the horrors hidden within the Backrooms.
70050000079202.intro: Enter the Backrooms ready for every encounter.
70050000079202.name: Escape the Backrooms BODYCAM: Armed Survivor

70050000079206.description:
You must own the digital download version of Flying Fire Shark in order to play the content of this DLC.

This DLC adds the console versions of Flying Shark and Fire Shark. Experience the differences between the console versions and the original arcade versions. The NES™ version of Sky Shark (based on Flying Shark) recreates the effects of the arcade version with ingenuity, and the boldly rearranged music is a like a gust of fresh wind as you take to the skies. The Mega Drive version of Fire Shark provides a lower difficulty level, making it easier to play compared to the arcade original.

The DLC also includes Wardner, an action platformer first released in the arcades in 1987. Using fire magic to defeat enemies, the player receives money which can be used to buy items that helps them advance further into the insidious forest. Deep inside lurks the evil boss Wardner, who captured a young girl and turned her into a crystal ball. Can you save the fair maiden?

The following games will be added to the base game with this DLC:
• Sky Shark (NES™ version released in 1989)
• Fire Shark (Japanese Mega Drive version released in 1990)
• Fire Shark (English Mega Drive/Genesis version released in 1990)
• Wardner (Japanese arcade version released in 1987)
• Wardner (International arcade version released in 1987)
• Pyros (North American version of Wardner released in 1987)
• Wardner (Japanese FDS version released in 1988)
70050000079206.intro: Console versions of Flying Shark and Fire Shark, and the action platformer Wardner.
70050000079206.name: Flying Fire Shark Console versions + Wardner DLC

70050000079212.description:
Take a break from fighting hordes of zombies with a rejuvenating session in your very own sauna. Then slip into an exclusive outfit and show the locals who the true village dandy is.

The pre-order bonus includes:

- A personal sauna outside the player’s house
- An exclusive outfit for the player character
70050000079212.name: Graveyard Keeper 2 - Pre-Order Bonus

70050000079216.description:
Give your trading card business a stronger beginning with additional funds at the start of every new game.

This DLC grants a 3,000 bonus at the beginning of every new game, helping you expand your inventory, purchase more booster packs, improve your shop, and attract customers from the very first day.

Build your collection, grow your business faster, and create the ultimate destination for baseball card collectors.
70050000079216.intro: Build bigger, trade smarter, and grow faster.
70050000079216.name: Baseball Card Shop Simulator: Retail Boost

70050000079227.description:
With the Airport Code Quiz, you get an arcade machine where you can test your knowledge of IATA codes: Which city is behind FRA? Which code belongs to Sydney?

If you ask me: a little general knowledge never hurts - not even at the airport.

And always remember: Further education in airport operations tolerates no negligence either! Kind regards

Günther Gewinn
- Management
70050000079227.name: Airport Baggage Simulator - Airport Code Quiz

70050000079230.description:
From the creators of Nidhogg comes a game about 2D platforming survival. You'll have to parkour your way around treacherous dungeons to kite monsters while gathering blood and powerups.

Survive a run, take the bones you’ve earned to the Bone Shop, and get stronger.

Complete quests to unlock upgrades, arenas, skins, and more.

Features:
- 9 unlockable playable characters with different traits and weapons
- 6 unlockable unique survival arenas
- Over 100 enemy types
- Over 100 quests to complete
- Over 100 unlockable weapons and upgrades
- Dynamic “dungeon dnb” soundtrack by Thomas Hooey
70050000079230.intro: These dungeons are full of monsters. The blood is there. Take it!
70050000079230.name: Blood Dungeon - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition Upgrade Pack

70050000079323.description:
Give your construction company a stronger financial foundation with an additional 5,000 in-game currency.

This DLC instantly adds 5,000 in-game currency to your account, allowing you to purchase equipment sooner, expand your fleet, and take on larger construction contracts with greater confidence.

Invest in better machinery, grow your business faster, and build your path toward becoming the ultimate construction tycoon.
70050000079323.intro: Build your company with a stronger financial start.
70050000079323.name: Construction Sim: City and Road Builder - Business Boost

70050000079333.description:
Take on every border inspection with renewed confidence as you continue protecting the checkpoint from smugglers and illegal activity. Every search, every document check, and every decision brings you one step closer to keeping the border secure.

This DLC adds a new knife with a unique appearance, giving one of your essential tools a refreshed style. Continue inspecting vehicles, searching suspicious belongings, uncovering hidden contraband, and protecting the border while carrying an updated blade.

Stay alert, enforce the law, and carry out your duties with a distinctive new look for one of your essential tools.
70050000079333.intro: Step into every mission with updated equipment.
70050000079333.name: CONTRABAND BORDER POLICE SIMULATOR: Elite Knife

70050000079343.description:
The leader Elizabeth I is now available in Sid Meier's Civilization® VII!*

Queen Elizabeth I, the last of the Tudors, reigned over England for 44 years. Under her rule, England went from a small, insignificant country to a major player on the world stage, decimating Spain's armada and founding early settlements in North America. Her English privateers dominated the seas, her merchants laid the foundation of the East India Company, and her policies created room for Shakespeare and the other great English playwrights. She was a monarch, a queen, a woman who refused to be limited by the expectations of her time.

Attributes, Unique Ability, and Agenda info on the Game Guide:
https://civilization.2k.com/civ-vii/game-guide/leaders/elizabeth-i/

*This content is included with the Hall of History Collection DLC Bundle. If you own the Hall of History Collection, then you already own this content. Terms apply.
70050000079343.name: Sid Meier's Civilization® VII: Elizabeth I Pack

70050000079344.description:
The leader George Washington is now available in Sid Meier's Civilization® VII!*

The first President of the United States, George Washington did not seek greatness; he was pulled to it. A planter and surveyor from Virginia, Washington gained a reputation for fortitude under fire in the French and Indian War, a reputation that led to his being placed at the head of the Continental Army in the Revolution. Outmanned and outgunned, Washington nevertheless managed to defeat the British and secure the freedom of the United States - but he could not rest. Called upon again to serve as President of the new republic, Washington remained a tireless advocate for unity, for individuals to put their party politics and personal interest aside and work together to make a more dignified, more orderly nation.

Attributes, Unique Ability, and Agenda info on the Game Guide:
https://civilization.2k.com/civ-vii/game-guide/leaders/george-washington/

*This content is included with the Hall of History Collection DLC Bundle. If you own the Hall of History Collection, then you already own this content. Terms apply.
70050000079344.name: Sid Meier's Civilization® VII: George Washington Pack

70050000079348.description:
Experience the prehistoric wilderness with a fresh visual update that brings even more variety to your adventures. Every journey across ancient landscapes feels more dynamic as familiar creatures appear with redesigned looks.

This DLC changes the appearance of three dinosaurs, giving them brand-new skins that add more visual diversity to the world around you while you explore, hunt, survive, and complete challenging missions.

Discover a refreshed prehistoric world and continue your survival adventure alongside dinosaurs with striking new appearances.
70050000079348.intro: Refresh your journey through the ancient wilderness.
70050000079348.name: Dinosaur Survival Simulator - Prehistoric RPG: Jurassic Style

70050000079352.description:
Every sin has a voice. Every voice joins the chorus. And when the final verse is sung, judgement awaits us all. The proud shall burn in flames of retribution, and the meek shall toil in the ashes left behind.

Step into the world of divine horror in Dead by Daylight's first community-created Chapter: Chorus of Sin. Play as The Judgment, a divine Killer sent to cleanse the world in flame, and Aurora Stardotter, a resolute Survivor leading her people out of the ashes.
70050000079352.name: Dead by Daylight: Chorus of Sin

70050000079356.description:
The Gauls civilization is now available in Sid Meier's Civilization® VII!*

In the Iron Age, the Celtic tribes of Gaul dotted the hilltops of western Europe with their walled settlements. In nearby groves, the druids led their rituals to the gods of nature. Within the towns, famed smiths created brilliant works of gold and silver. Rich and prosperous, Gallic tribes expanded to the lands of their neighbors, most famously, the Romans. In 390 BCE, the Gauls sacked Rome, becoming the most feared of Rome's enemies for centuries. Eventually united under their chieftain Vercingetorix, the Gauls offered fierce resistance to Rome's imperial ambitions, forever leaving their mark on history.

Attributes, Unique Ability, and Agenda info on the Game Guide:
https://civilization.2k.com/civ-vii/game-guide/civilizations/gauls/

*This content is included with the Hall of History Collection DLC Bundle. If you own the Hall of History Collection, then you already own this content. Terms apply.
70050000079356.name: Sid Meier's Civilization® VII: Gauls Pack

70050000079357.description:
The Babylon civilization is now available in Sid Meier's Civilization® VII!*

From the time of Hammurabi to the height of Nebuchadnezzar II, the city of Babylon was the center of Mesopotamian culture. Though Babylonia changed hands several times throughout the period, it eventually overthrew the Assyrian Empire, extending Babylonian reach through the Levant and northern Arabia. The Persians conquered Babylon in 539 BCE, but the city remained a center of economic prosperity and cultural excellence long into the next millennium.

Attributes, Unique Ability, and Agenda info on the Game Guide:
https://civilization.2k.com/civ-vii/game-guide/civilizations/babylon/

*This content is included with the Hall of History Collection DLC Bundle. If you own the Hall of History Collection, then you already own this content. Terms apply.
70050000079357.name: Sid Meier's Civilization® VII: Babylon Pack

70050000079358.description:
The England civilization is now available in Sid Meier's Civilization® VII!*

Forged in battle, refined at the altar, England dominated medieval Europe. Under the Plantagenets, the crown contended with the church, the aristocracy, and restive neighbors to shore up a kingdom of strength and beauty, of longbows and Gothic cathedrals. Transformed by plague and the Hundred Years’ War, England emerged into the Tudor era rich in arts and economy, primed for reformation and colonial expansion – growth that laid the foundations for the British Empire.

Attributes, Unique Ability, and Agenda info on the Game Guide:
https://civilization.2k.com/civ-vii/game-guide/civilizations/england/

*This content is included with the Hall of History Collection DLC Bundle. If you own the Hall of History Collection, then you already own this content. Terms apply.
70050000079358.name: Sid Meier's Civilization® VII: England Pack

70050000079643.description:
Give your pharmacy a fresh new identity and create a more distinctive shopping environment for every customer. A renewed appearance adds a different atmosphere to your daily business while you continue managing products, serving customers, and growing your store.

This DLC changes the design of your pharmacy, introducing a refreshed visual style that transforms the overall appearance of your business. Continue stocking shelves, expanding your inventory, setting prices, and building a successful pharmacy in a newly redesigned environment.

Manage your pharmacy in style and enjoy every business day with a fresh new look.
70050000079643.intro: Redesign your pharmacy and stand out in style.
70050000079643.name: Pharmacy Store Simulator: Shop Style

70050000079645.description:
Welcome to “Miracle Circus,” a wondrous dream stage where fruits and magic sparkle!
Your smiles and applause are precious energy that makes the circus shine.
Use the power you collect to unleash a variety of performances, merge fruits, and aim for an even higher score!

【Highlights of This Mode】
■ A spectacularly reimagined circus experience
Brand-new visuals and an exciting exclusive BGM transform the familiar stage into a special circus.
■ Boost your score with a variety of gimmicks!
From the “Spotlight” and “Fire Ring” to random magic bursting from the “Magic Hat,” a variety of performances bring the game to life.
Make clever use of each gimmick and aim for a high score!
■ Special merge effects
Merge fruits to create a watermelon in a brand-new form!
And when you complete the dream “Double Watermelon,” something unexpected might happen…?
Be sure to witness the surprising effects that can only be experienced in Miracle Circus!

Harness the power of magical energy and make Miracle Circus shine more spectacularly than ever!
70050000079645.intro:
Welcome to “Miracle Circus”!
On a dazzling circus stage, the fruits will delight you with cute and surprising magical performances!
70050000079645.name: Miracle Circus

70050000079673.description:
During our journey so many fans reached out to ask how they could further support our little Veewo team - and so the Supporter Pack was born! Your support has been so incredible, and we genuinely couldn't thank you enough!

This is a cosmetic-only pack, full to the brim with costumes for our Agents, including:
- A unique, flowing outfit for Saya
- A record player in the bar to listen to the OST
- An exclusive badge for Supporters to highlight your support in game
- A glittering ghost skin for if you die in multiplayer
- ALL holiday-exclusive items
- Our heartfelt and ETERNAL gratitude (but the bosses still won’t go easy on you)

Your passion and support has been an incredible, inspiring motivation. Thank you for standing with us and may your luck be endless!
70050000079673.name: Neon Abyss 2 - Supporter Pack

70050000079674.description:
This DLC is BOSS! We know how much our Agents loved the bosses within the first Neon Abyss, so we’ve brought them right up to date with a huge refresh project for Neon Abyss 2!

All 35 bosses from the original Neon Abyss have returned, and they’re not too happy to see you. After numerous passes of skill optimizations, visual effects upgrades and complete reworks for some manager bosses, we’ve made sure they’re fully evolved to match the upgraded Abyss.
70050000079674.name: Neon Abyss 2 - Archenemy Returns

Start your hunting journey with an additional financial boost that helps you unlock new opportunities faster.

This DLC adds 1,000 in-game coins directly to your balance, giving you additional funds to support your progress. Spend them on essential gear, upgrades, and equipment as you explore vast landscapes, track wild animals, and master the art of hunting.

Upgrade your setup, venture into the wilderness, and take on every hunt with greater preparation.
70050000079839.intro: Equip yourself better and take on the wilderness.
70050000079839.name: Hunter Simulator: Wild Hunting – Extra Capital

70050000079940.description:
Face the horrors lurking inside the forsaken chocolate factory with a greater supply of ammunition at your disposal. This DLC adds 100 bullets, giving you extra firepower as you explore eerie rooms, solve sinister puzzles, and confront the malevolent entities hiding in the darkness.

Use your ammunition wisely as you uncover the factory’s disturbing secrets and fight to survive its twisted corridors. Every bullet can make a difference when danger is waiting around every corner.
70050000079940.intro: Extra bullets for a more prepared fight for survival.
70050000079940.name: CANDYLAND: Sweet Survival – Ammo Boost

70050000080013.description:
Make a splash in Lou's Lagoon with the bubbly Deluxe Pack! This pack includes:

- Bubblefan Engine: Add some whimsical flair to your flights with an engine that trails a beautiful stream of bubbles across the sky!

- Lifeguard Skin: Keep the islanders safe in style while sporting this vibrant lifeguard outfit (complete with its own bubble accessory).

- Beachside Decor Pack: Dive into decorating with 8 exclusive, bubble-themed furniture pieces—the perfect additions to your ultimate beachside hangout.
70050000080013.name: Lou's Lagoon Deluxe Pack

70050000080020.description:
This DLC unlocks the exclusive Usada Pekora outfit “Noble White.”
Featuring an elegant white-based design, this outfit lets you enjoy a different side of Pekora.
70050000080020.name: Hololive Fantasy Battle DLC - Usada Pekora Outfit “Noble White”

70050000080021.description:
This DLC unlocks the exclusive Houshou Marine outfit “Jellyfish Swimsuit Outfit.”
Featuring a cool and cute swimsuit design inspired by jellyfish, this outfit lets you enjoy a different side of Houshou Marine.
70050000080021.name: Hololive Fantasy Battle DLC - Houshou Marine Outfit “Jellyfish Swimsuit Outfit”

70050000080126.description:
The 11th pack of additional characters is here!

This character is Suika Ibuki, an oni!
She has the ability to fill the "Ibuki Gourd" and change the bubbles on the field to random colors. She is also a character with unique spell cards.

 This pack contains the following:

 ■One character

 "Suika Ibuki"

 ・Ability: When "Ibuki Gourd" is full, it changes bubbles in the area to random colors.

 ・Spell Card
① Oni Sign "Missing Power"
Change the color of the third-most common colored bubbles in the area to the color of the most common colored bubbles.
② "Night Parade of a Million Demons"
Pops 40 "Blank Bubbles" and increase "Ibuki Gourd".
③ Gather Sign "Mt. Togakushi Toss"
Sends "Stone" in a mountain shape on the your opponent's area.

 ■1 Song
 ・Flowery Moonlit Night / Yonder Voice

 ■1 Challenge Stage
 ・Lv.8 Suika Ibuki Enters the Arena!

 * Internet connection required for purchase.
 * You will need to restart the game after purchasing contents.
70050000080126.name: Character Pack Suika Ibuki

70050000080129.description:
This Weekly Hoops Pack contains 52 unique Hoops inspired by celebrations, cultural events, and special days from around the world.
There's always a new story to stitch!
70050000080129.intro: Stitch it up to puzzle out!
70050000080129.name: Weekly Hoops Pack 2

70050000080133.description:
Face the endless maze with one less limitation standing between you and survival. This DLC improves your exploration experience by removing the need to manage your flashlight battery while you search for clues, solve puzzles, and navigate through dangerous backrooms.

With this upgrade, your flashlight battery will no longer run out, allowing you to keep your path illuminated as you uncover secrets, avoid hidden threats, and progress through the terrifying environments.

Stay focused on the challenges ahead and explore the darkness with a constant source of light.
70050000080133.intro: Keep the way illuminated and focus on escaping the backrooms.
70050000080133.name: Tralalero Tralala - Escape Backrooms: Survival Boost

70050000080139.description:
Give your trucking journey a valuable head start with an extra 40,000 in-game currency. Use your funds to support your progress, customize your trucks, and prepare for the challenging lessons and driving courses ahead.

Build your career, improve your driving skills, and make the most of your resources as you work toward becoming a professional truck driver.
70050000080139.intro: Prepare for the road ahead and grow your driving career.
70050000080139.name: Trucking School: Truck Simulator Driving 2025 – Road Fund

70050000080143.description:
Give your cleaning gear a fresh visual upgrade with a redesigned appearance for your trusty water gun.

The DLC changes the color of the water gun, giving one of your essential cleaning tools a bold new look throughout every space station restoration mission.

Keep every station spotless and complete your cosmic cleanup duties with equipment that looks as polished as your work.
70050000080143.intro: Make every cleanup mission look even better.
70050000080143.name: Space CleanUp: Cosmic Robot Disinfector – Cleanup Style

70050000080156.description:
In the Daylight DLC, it's finally time for all the station's secrets to come to light in the rays of the sun. Take on the role of the employee's wife and conduct your own investigation every day in search of your missing husband, documenting all unusual events in photographs.

Photograph anomalies every day to advance your investigation in the new game mode
Survive 7 days of investigation, but miss even one detail and you'll lose the trail and have to start over
 Face supernatural events and try to make sense of what defies logic
See the story from the other side and discover what really happened to your husband
70050000080156.intro: It's finally time for all the station's secrets to come to light!
70050000080156.name: Before Exit: Gas Station - Daylight DLC

70050000080157.description:
Over 40 story-rich scenarios, packed with unique content, 4 different endings, and 6 mysterious bonus episodes.
Play through the game again and again to unlock everything and uncover the true ending. Are you ready to return home?
Play through 9 new scenarios beyond the classic workweek and descend into deeper darkness with each passing night
Face unique challenges and don't let the new weather conditions at the station get the better of you
 Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of horror and tremble with fear as your boss appears when you least expect it
Discover the true nature of the station and learn the secrets of its owner
70050000080157.intro: Midnight DLC is the first major expansion for Before Exit: Gas Station, pushing the anomaly-detection experience into its darkest hours yet.
70050000080157.name: Before Exit: Gas Station - Midnight DLC

70050000080199.description:
Transform your digging adventure with a new weather effect and a refreshed sky.

This DLC adds a rain effect and changes the default skybox, creating a new environment while you continue exploring underground layers, uncovering hidden treasures, and searching for valuable discoveries.

Dig through the changing weather, enjoy a fresh atmosphere, and continue uncovering the secrets hidden beneath the surface.
70050000080199.intro: Discover hidden treasures under changing skies.
70050000080199.name: Hole Digging Simulator 2025: Rainy Digging

70050000080203.description:
This pack upgrades WOODO to WOODO Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition.

Enjoy WOODO in higher resolution and with improved frame rates
70050000080203.name: Woodo - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition Upgrade Pack

70050000080204.description:
Add a vibrant touch to your adventures. Equip a magical bow and arrows that feature a smooth RGB animation, seamlessly transitioning through the full spectrum of colors.

Whether you’re exploring mysterious landscapes or battling dangerous foes, your weapon will shine with an eye-catching, ever-changing glow.

Bring color to the darkness and make every shot unforgettable.
70050000080204.intro: Embrace the full spectrum in every battle.
70050000080204.name: VoidCraft Island Chronicles: Sky Survival – Vivid Arsenal

70050000080213.description:
The Prophecy Pack gives you more options to enhance your Warrior Cats experience with additional content.

The Prophecy Pack includes:
•        8 Accessories to use in the cat creator
•        12 Wearable accessories
•        Cel-shaded characters skin
•        4 cat poses for photo mode
•        4 photo mode effects
70050000080213.intro: New character skin and additions to the cat creator.
70050000080213.name: Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest - Prophecy Pack

70050000080219.description:
Boost your experience with a powerful clicking upgrade that makes every action count twice. This DLC adds the double-click feature, allowing each click to trigger two actions and helping you collect bananas more efficiently.

With every press working twice, you can increase your banana collection faster, discover more unique collectibles, and progress through the game with improved clicking power.

Click smarter, grow your collection, and enjoy a faster path to becoming the ultimate banana collector.
70050000080219.intro: Double your clicks and collect bananas faster than ever.
70050000080219.name: Banana-Clicker: Click Power

70050000080222.description:
Your look can be as sharp as your claws!

Prepare for your adventure and gain additional items for the cat creator. The robust cat creator becomes even bigger as the Purrfect Look Pack includes five new elements for players to create their Warrior Cat.

Strut away from victory with a puffy tail. Strike fear into your enemies with intense eyes and lightning bolt-shaped whiskers. Be the envy of the Clan with a truly unique fur pattern. Completing the pack is a set of very distinctive ears.

The Purrfect Look Pack is exclusive to preorders and includes four elements to create an iconic look for your Warrior Cat.
70050000080222.intro: Additional exclusive items for the cat creator.
70050000080222.name: Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest - The Purrfect Look Pack

70050000080310.description:
Refresh the atmosphere of the magical realm with a brand-new sky that gives every flight a unique and unforgettable look.

This DLC replaces the default sky with a unique custom skybox, giving the world a distinctive new appearance while preserving the original gameplay experience.

Take to the skies, admire a new magical horizon, and continue your quest beneath a completely transformed sky.
70050000080310.intro: Give every flight a magical new horizon.
70050000080310.name: Wizards Owl: Magic Delivery – Mystic Horizon

70050000080356.description:
Dive into a relaxing seaside getaway with Sticky Business: Seaside Tales! 

Bring the ocean breeze to your cozy sticker shop with over 113 new stickers and colorful variants inspired by sunny beaches, salty waves, sea creatures, pirate treasures, tropical vacations, and peaceful moments by the shore.

Pack heartfelt orders for brand-new customers and discover 10 charming new stories full of surf contests, beach adventures, drifting romances, pirate conventions, summer vacations, and quiet coastal towns.

This DLC includes:

- 113 new stickers with additional color variants
- 10 new customer stories about surfing, pirates, summer vacations, and more!
- 8 new goodies
- 6 glitter papers

Whether you love turtles, whales, seashells, surfboards, palm trees, or treasure chests, Seaside Tales brings a splash of ocean magic to your sticker business.
70050000080356.intro: Escape to the seaside and fill your cozy sticker shop with ocean magic.
70050000080356.name: Sticky Business: Seaside Tales

70050000080387.description: Welcome the Year of the Horse in style! This DLC brings a festive Japanese New Year makeover to your restaurant - think golden crane screens, lucky cats, sake bottles and warm red accents. Decorate your space and greet your guests with good fortune this season.
70050000080387.intro: Run the best restaurant in the middle of the city, complete orders, learn new recipes, and improve your cooking skills.
70050000080387.name: Year of the Horse Set

70050000080388.description: Unlock the Nordex Pack and add Nordex to your garage — one of the quickest Class D cars, built for fast starts, smooth handling, and confident high-speed racing. With its agile feel and strong performance, Nordex is a perfect choice for players who want to push every race to the limit.
70050000080388.name: Nordex Pack

70050000080389.description:
With this DLC, you'll unlock:
- Permanent x2 Game Speed!
- A new playable hero: Claire

Turn up the pace and fight through waves of monsters twice as fast! Switch x2 Game Speed On or Off at any time, giving you full control over the pace of every battle.

Claire brings powerful support to your army. Her permanent Mighty boost increases the damage of all units by 10%, while her Thunder Storm combat skill damages and slows every enemy caught within the storm.

Upgrade Claire, equip powerful gear, and use her abilities to bring new strength to your defense!
70050000080389.intro: Double the game speed and unleash Claire’s power!
70050000080389.name: Fortress Merge: Claire Pack DLC

70050000080392.description:
This pack upgrades Trails in the Sky 2nd Chapter to Trails in the Sky 2nd Chapter Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition.
This version features higher framerates and enhanced graphics.
70050000080392.name: Trails in the Sky 2nd Chapter Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition upgrade pack

70050000080491.description:
Accelerate your progress with a huge bonus that gives you more freedom to expand your garage and enjoy the road ahead. Invest in better vehicles, unlock new opportunities, and build your collection faster than ever.

This DLC credits $100,000 directly to your in-game balance, giving you extra funds to purchase cars and continue your journey through intense highway traffic and high-speed challenges.

Upgrade your garage, choose your next ride, and race toward victory with the advantage of a powerful financial boost.
70050000080491.intro: Boost your budget and race without limits.
70050000080491.name: Grand Rush: Highway Car Traffic Racing Simulator – Driver’s Fortune

70050000080495.name: Pixel Cross Stitch Color by Number Seasons Collection: Easter

70050000080516.description:
Give your port a fresh new look with a unique sky that transforms the atmosphere of every operation.

This DLC replaces the default sky with a unique custom skybox, giving the port a completely refreshed appearance while preserving the original gameplay.

Operate under a new horizon, enjoy an enhanced atmosphere, and keep the harbor running smoothly beneath a brand-new sky.

70050000080516.name: Port Logistics Simulator: Dockside Harbor Handling – Dockside Skies

70050000080519.description:
Take command of a massive orchestra as the walls tremble and humanity’s fate hangs in the balance!

Step into the world of the Japanese anime masterpiece Attack on Titan and conduct one of its most iconic musical pieces. Feel the tension build from haunting melodies to explosive orchestral moments as you unleash the full power of the orchestra.

Your Attack on Titan music piece:

Kohta Yamamoto – “Attack on Titan” (from Attack on Titan)

Raise your Titan Sweeper, the exclusive conductor baton included with this DLC, and bring the world of Attack on Titan to life!
70050000080519.name: Attack on Titan

70050000080524.description:
Refresh your garage with a selection of stylish new paint options and make every vehicle stand out on the road. Whether you prefer bold, vibrant finishes or a fresh new appearance, these exclusive colors give you even more ways to personalize your favorite cars.

This DLC adds 4 brand-new vehicle colors, available immediately in the customization shop. The new colors are displayed at the top of the paint selection list, making them quick and easy to access whenever you’re ready for a new look.

Customize your collection, create your perfect style, and drive with a finish that matches your personality.
70050000080524.intro: Drive cars that truly match your personal style.
70050000080524.name: Car Parking - Garage Simulator: Fresh Look

70050000080526.description:
Hoist the canvas and take the helm, for a booty-laden Content Update is rumored to be buried somewhere in Maestro!

Follow the culture map and lead the most ragged, salt-soaked scurvy scummy scallywags cutnote musyc-mongerin’ miscreants blossoming cockroaches of an orchestra through five treasures o’ rarest sound.

Hear hear, the cannon-blastin’ Pirates of the Caribbean themes from the quill of Hans Zimmer himself, sea shanties sung by the drunkest of mates and authentic symphonies of the most classical orrrderrrrr…

 • Zimmer & Badelt – “He’s a Pirate” (from Pirates of the Caribbean)
 • Zimmer – “Jack Sparrow” (from Pirates of the Caribbean)
 • Unknown Author - “Wellerman”

Seize command of La Cultivée, summon your mighty Buccaneers crew, grab yer Kraken’s foot and set sail to find the hidden pirate culture. And remember Capt’n: an X sharp always marks the spot!

70050000080605.description:
Take your offroad adventures to the next level with a new vehicle built for challenging terrain. This DLC adds the Hummer H2, giving you a powerful new ride to use as you explore swamps, hills, muddy trails, and rugged landscapes.

Put its distinctive design to the test as you navigate difficult routes, search for lost car parts, and overcome demanding offroad obstacles. Expand your vehicle collection and experience the wilderness from behind the wheel of a new 4x4.

Get behind the wheel of the Hummer H2, conquer rough terrain, and prove your offroad driving skills.

70050000080607.description:
What’s better than delicious food? EVEN MORE DELICIOUS FOOD!
Keep your restaurant guests excited by adding brand new snacks and products to your bentos!
Enhance your gameplay with mouthwatering ingredients of the Food Pack DLC!
70050000080607.intro: Your perfect, cat-themed lunchbox puzzle is here!
70050000080607.name: Food Pack

70050000080611.description:
Take on rugged trails, muddy swamps, steep hills, and challenging offroad environments as you search for lost vehicle parts and build powerful 4x4 machines.

This DLC adds a new vehicle Jeeb, giving you another offroad machine to drive as you explore wild landscapes and tackle difficult routes. Take the new vehicle into challenging environments and discover a fresh way to experience the offroad adventure.

Get behind the wheel, conquer the terrain, and prove your offroad driving skills.

70050000080616.description:

70050000080619.description:

Customise your office, suit up in style and make every day on the job your own with the Hotshot DLC.

Packed with 18 trendy gamer-themed cosmetic items, the Hotshot DLC lets you customise both Dan and his office, creating the ultimate gaming setup while you tackle the strange and satisfying jobs of Clumsy County.

70050000080646.description: Bask in the glamour of the French Riviera with the new La Côte d'Azur DLC! Sun-soaked colors, elegant coastal charm, and a touch of Mediterranean glitz will transform your kitchen into a slice of paradise.

70050000080723.description:
Strengthen your strategy and take command with extra resources.

Give your campaign a valuable boost with 1,000 in-game currency added to your balance. Use your resources to support your army, prepare for challenging scenarios, and expand your strategic possibilities as you face intense battles governed by realistic physics.

Plan your moves carefully, customize your forces, and adapt to the chaos of the battlefield as you work toward becoming a legendary commander.

70050000080735.description:
Enhance your space adventure with five additional VR helmets designed to expand your collection and bring more variety to your intergalactic experience. Equip your journey with new options as you explore distant planets, build and defend your base, gather valuable resources, and battle waves of hostile enemies across the galaxy.

Prepare your spacecraft, strengthen your defenses, and continue your fight for survival as you push deeper into the vastness of space.

70050000080746.description:
Add a charming new character appearance to your adventure.

This DLC introduces an exclusive skin featuring an adorable orange tabby kitten with bright blue eyes and a vivid expression of surprise and fright. The new character skin is displayed on the left side of the game’s main menu, giving the game’s opening screen a fresh and playful look.

70050000080749.description:
Enjoy the playful charm of curious cats and loyal dogs in a collection full of adorable furry companions.

• 29 puzzles with playful Dogs

Spend more time with your favorite furry friends!

Let your imagination run wild and take flight!

70050000080750.name: Puzzle Galaxy: Gallop & Glide - 58 new puzzles

70050000080751.description:
Relax with intricate patterns inspired by the stars, traditional folk art and the beauty of nature.

Puzzle Galaxy: Mandala adds 57 NEW jigsaw puzzles filled with detailed and mesmerizing designs:

70050000080752.description:
Escape into peaceful landscapes filled with quiet forests and the gentle colors of sunrise and sunset.

70050000080775.description:
Give your personal room a fresh new appearance with this visual upgrade. The DLC changes the model of the bed, adding a refreshed look to the place where you rest and recover between demanding days at the airport.

After reaching the second upgrade level, the vending machine in your room is replaced with a table filled with food, creating a more welcoming and practical atmosphere.

Enjoy a renewed personal space as you manage your resources, complete daily tasks, and work toward your ultimate escape from the terminal.

70050000080780.description:
Enter the terrifying world and face anomalous creatures lurking within dark and unsettling facilities.

This DLC adds 200 pistol bullets directly to your inventory, giving you an additional supply of ammunition for encounters with hostile anomalies. Use your resources wisely as you navigate dangerous corridors, investigate unexplained phenomena, and fight to survive the horrors hiding within the Foundation.

Keep your inventory prepared, stay alert, and face the unknown with greater confidence.

70050000080789.description: Enjoy a brand new set of fun icons!

70050000080796.description:
Take on intense firefights with increased durability and gain a significant advantage in every encounter. This DLC doubles the character’s health capacity, allowing you to withstand more damage and stay active in combat for longer.

With greater resilience against enemy attacks, you can push forward with confidence, adapt to challenging situations, and survive encounters that would otherwise end your run. Make every tactical decision count and stay ready for whatever awaits.

Strengthen your character, withstand more enemy attacks, and stay in the action longer.

70050000080802.description:
Stand out on your journey through the underwater realms with a unique new color for your character’s outfit.

This DLC changes the player’s costume to a distinctive color, adding a fresh visual style as you navigate challenging submerged environments, overcome obstacles, and work together with your companions.

Customize your appearance and take on the depths with a new look as you climb toward the surface.
70050000080802.name: Chained Survive Together: Abyssal Style

70050000080809.description:
Build your real estate empire by purchasing, renovating, and managing properties across the city. Negotiate with clients, respond to market changes, and develop your properties as you work your way from a small-time investor toward becoming a successful real estate tycoon.

This DLC refreshes the interiors of three offices with a complete visual makeover. New furniture is added while the wallpapers, floors, and ceilings are replaced, creating updated and more polished spaces for your real estate operations.

Transform your offices and give your growing property empire a fresh new environment.

70050000080820.description:
Refresh your delivery operations with a striking new vehicle color.

This DLC changes the color of your delivery car to red, giving your vehicle a distinctive appearance as you manage parking lots, expand your business, and build your parking empire.

Take your red delivery vehicle on the road as you handle daily tasks, overcome unexpected challenges, and work toward becoming the ultimate Parking Lot Tycoon.

70050000080825.description:
Give your supermarket business a financial boost and grow your store faster.

A bonus of €2,000 is automatically added to the in-game balance, providing extra funds for managing and developing the supermarket. The added capital can support product purchases, store improvements, inventory management, daily operations, and future expansion.

Make smart financial decisions, adapt to customer demand, and put your additional capital to work as you build and grow your supermarket business.

70050000080832.description:
Enter the battlefield where every decision can change the course of combat. Build your forces, choose the right units, manage your resources, and adapt your tactics as realistic physics turn every encounter into a dynamic strategic challenge.

This DLC adds 2,000 in-game currency directly to the player’s balance, providing additional resources for managing your army and preparing for upcoming battles.

Use the extra funds to support your strategy, experiment with different units, and expand your tactical possibilities.
Prepare your forces, make every resource count, and take command of the battlefield.
70050000080832.name: Warfront Tactics: Battlefield Chronicles Battle Simulator – War Funds

70050000080844.description:
Experience the excitement of equestrian competition as you ride powerful horses, master challenging courses, and compete across three diverse maps.

This DLC changes the sand texture across all three maps, giving the racing environments a refreshed visual appearance. Enjoy a new look across the courses as you train, compete, and explore the world of equestrian sports.

Refresh your surroundings and experience every race with a renewed visual atmosphere.

70050000081017.description:
IMPORTANT NOTE

The book is only available in German and English.

THE OFFICIAL BOOK

Want to dive even deeper into the world of Airport Baggage Simulator? Then grab the official book about the game!

This digital companion book gives you extra information, helpful tables and practical tips all about your job in baggage handling.

Besides useful overviews of the game, the book also takes a humorous look at the characters from the world of Airport Baggage Simulator. In short diary entries and personal notes, you'll get to know characters like Risiko-Rolf, Günther Gewinn and Deko-Denise from a whole new side.

CONTENTS

- Tips and explanations of the game mechanics
- Tables on career progression, upgrades and unlocks
- additional background texts on the characters
- and much more!

Whether you want to optimize your airport operations, better understand all the systems, or simply learn more about the strange people around Terminal 1: the book about the game is your official guide to the everyday madness of baggage logistics.
