- The Lost Sequel featuring 6 extra chapters
- Real 8-bit graphics
- Console and handheld game versions
- Intense battles with bosses who await your arrival
- Nostalgic retro music with sounds of dying demons in the background
- Achievements and extra challenges
70070000022232.intro: Protect your world from demons as one of legendary Crypt Stalkers.
70070000022232.name: Crypt Stalker Deluxe Edition

70070000022238.description:
DOOM Anthology

The DOOM Anthology takes players through more than three decades of demon slaying – from the classic games that popularized the first-person shooter genre to the fan favorite franchise reboot and its sequel. Wield an arsenal of powerful weapons as you battle demon hordes on Mars, on Earth, and across Hell in six critically acclaimed games.

DOOM + DOOM II

Developed by id Software, and originally released in 1993, DOOM pioneered and popularized the first-person shooter, setting a standard for all FPS games. The critically acclaimed sequel, DOOM II, followed in 1994. Now the definitive, newly enhanced versions of DOOM + DOOM II are available as a combined product.

DOOM 64

In this enhanced version of DOOM 64, years have passed since you stopped Hell’s invasion of Earth. Quarantined for humanity’s safety, the UAC research facilities on Mars were abandoned and forgotten...until now. A signal from a degraded satellite suggests a single entity remains, and it has the power to resurrect the demons. As the only surviving marine who fought Hell’s forces, you are sent on a lone crusade to hunt down the Mother of Demons and stop a renewed demonic invasion.

DOOM 3

A demonic invasion has overwhelmed the Union Aerospace Corporation's Mars research facility. As one of only a few survivors, you must fight your way to hell and back against a horde of demons in this award-winning horror/action FPS and reimagining of the original DOOM.

DOOM (2016)

Developed by id software, the studio that pioneered the first-person shooter genre and created multiplayer Deathmatch, DOOM returns as a brutally fun and challenging modern-day shooter experience. Relentless demons, impossibly destructive guns, and fast, fluid movement provide the foundation for intense, first-person combat – whether you’re obliterating demon hordes through the depths of Hell in the single-player campaign, or competing against your friends in numerous multiplayer modes. Expand your gameplay experience using DOOM SnapMap game editor to easily create, play, and share your content with the world.

DOOM Eternal (Deluxe Edition)

Hell’s armies have invaded Earth. Become the Slayer in an epic single-player campaign to conquer demons across dimensions and stop the final destruction of humanity. The only thing they fear... is you.
The Deluxe Edition contains a demonic Slayer skin, classic weapon sound pack and access to both campaign expansions for the critically-acclaimed DOOM Eternal. Your victory over Hell’s armies pulled humanity back from the edge of extinction, but it came at a cost. An imbalance of power in the heavens requires the true ruler of this universe to rise and set things right. Wage war across never-before-seen realms of the DOOM Universe, fight against new demons, and wield new abilities in your never-ending battle against the forces of evil.
70070000022238.name: DOOM Anthology

70070000022239.description:
Get Darkest Dungeon II and The Binding Blade DLC together for a discount!

Darkest Dungeon II is a roguelike road trip of the damned. Form a party, equip your stagecoach, and set off across the decaying landscape on a last gasp quest to avert the apocalypse. The greatest dangers you face, however, may come from within...

Gather your courage and ride out into the chaos of a world undone.
Four heroes and a stagecoach are all that stand between darkness and salvation.

Roguelike Runs, Each With Its Own Emerging Story
Each expedition lasts from 30 minutes to several hours. Even an untimely end will arm you with resources that can be spent to improve your next journey.

The Affinity System
As travels progress, heroes bond with each other or grate on each others’ nerves, leading to desperately needed combat synergies or journey-ending dysfunction. Manage their stress and interaction to keep the team together until the bitter end.

Face Your Failures
Uncover and experience the tragic origin stories of each hero and unlock their full potential.

Nightmarish Environs
From the burning Sprawl to the diseased Foetor, the road will challenge your strategies and your endurance.

And more...
Rest your weary, shell-shocked heroes at the Inn, where you can manage their stress and relationships with a variety of diversions and delights.
Uncover and experience the tragic origin stories of the heroes.
A stylish and dynamic evolution of Darkest Dungeon’s signature art style.
A return of the narration system and voice actor Wayne June!
Exciting improvements to the turn-based combat from Darkest Dungeon.

The Binding Blade
One waits at the crossroads for redemption, the other, adrift in the sprawling wilds of the Kingdom.  Master the ruthless Duelist, battle through barricades, and seek clues that will lead you to...the last of the Crusaders.

Features:
Two New Playable heroes: The Duelist & The Crusader
Both new heroes are complete with unique trinkets, signature items, and fully voiced backstories including playable flashback encounters
New Roaming mini-boss: The Warlord

The Duelist is a disciplined and deadly combatant who can tactically switch between Defensive and Aggressive stances. A formidable presence in any lineup, she is able to ignore enemy defenses, and strike back with Riposte. Her pursuit of perfection means she will demand the best of her team and command them to victory by wiping out cooldown times and providing both offensive and defensive buffs. The Duelist is able to move between ranks with ease, attacking from both the front and back ranks, dispatching her enemies with ruthless efficiency.

The Crusader has returned! This battle hardened knight is fueled by a radiant Holy fire and will Smite his foes where they stand. The Crusader is a well rounded front rank hero who can withstand punishing blows, support his team with healing and stress recovery, and rend his opponents with his righteous blade.
70070000022239.name: Oblivion Edition

70070000022243.description:
With nPaint, the best illustration app for Nintendo Switch™ , you'll create both simple, ordinary and professional paintings - from drawings of your favorite fairy tale characters to mind-blowing works of art.

Develop creativity

Put yourself in control and have freedom of choice. Use crayon, brush or spray paint. Paint and draw your beloved animals, holiday cards or the design of your dream living room. Become a modern Picasso and enjoy a remarkable personal gallery of your masterpieces.

Magical experience

Choose from basic all the way to a mix of smoothly gradient alternating colors.

Innovative small, handy sketchpad or easel

Create anywhere - on the go, on a break at work, at the beach and on an airplane. Go to the next level of relaxation and indulgence.

This bundle includes the second and fifth gallery expansion.

Key features:
- Essential and versatile tools in different sizes
- Mixed colors with smooth gradients in between
- Create technical drawings, birthday cards or portraits
- Tuned to you
- Unprecedented ease of use
- For everyone, regardless of age
70070000022243.intro: Wow yourself. Become an outstanding artist with nPaint.
70070000022243.name: nPaint Ultra Complete

70070000022255.description:
Make your grandma proud in Tokyo Cooking! Run your own restaurant and prepare the most iconic Japanese dishes. Take orders from customers, prepare their meals with passion and listen to their opinions to become better and better with each passing day.


DO THE COOKING BY THE BOOK…
Your kitchen has all the necessary equipment and ingredients you will need to prepare the most delicious sushi. Follow and complete each step from your to-do list while choosing from many available kinds of fish, vegetables and spices and adding them depending on the client's wish.


…AND CUSTOMIZE TO YOUR HEART’S CONTENT
Earn money from the orders and customize the interior of your Japanese restaurant in Tokyo Cooking. At the end of each day, you will have access to your laptop, where you can browse through equipment you can purchase for your place. Enjoy new chairs, tables, plants and utensils.

Become a master of composing the perfect sushi. Be precise and use the exact amount of ingredients such as soy sauce or rice. Complete mini-games to receive extra money as a bonus for your order.

Decorate your restaurant with the Cherry Blossom Set DLC included in this bundle.

KEY FEATURES:
- You can learn to make your own sushi!
- A total of 32 unique ingredients like fish, vegetables that NEVER run out
- Step-by-step recipes
- Interesting customers
- Day/night system and access to laptop after work
- 6 unique sushi recipes like Hosomaki or Uramaki and relaxing tea
70070000022255.intro: Run the best sushi restaurant in the city, talk to customers and learn new recipes.
70070000022255.name: Tokyo Cooking Deluxe Edition

70070000022260.description:
WRITE IT DOWN

Put your life in order. You'll never forget to buy milk, skip a dentist appointment or lose THE TASTIEST muffin recipe in your life. Customize your notes and create your own style.

STICK TO WHAT'S BEST

Enjoy a collection of adorable stickers and play around with their settings. Brighten up your memories without any effort.

Get access to new colorful stickers with Sticker Pack 2 and 4 included in this bundle.

Key Features:

- Cutest stickers you've seen
- Classic notepad formula with extra steps
- Dozens of color combinations
- A safe place for your memories
- Simple design with high functionality
70070000022260.intro: Write down every amazing moment of your day using Notes + Stickers. Discover a new outlet for your fantastic memories.
70070000022260.name: Notes + Stickers GOTY Edition

70070000022262.description:
Brain Memory 2 is based on simple memory game principles. It effectively helps improve focus and memory for everyone.


ADORABLE ILLUSTRATIONS
Thanks to colorful pictures, it’s easier to remember where each card is located. However, be cautious as some cards may differ in the held object or the pose the character assumes. Pay attention to the smallest details as it is key to success.


CUSTOMIZE YOUR CARDS
To train effectively, the player can choose their preferred difficulty level and customize the appearance of the card covers. This allows the mind to focus on the appropriate number of cards and colors on the board.

Get new look of cards with Cards Pack 2 DLC included in this bundle.

KEY FEATURES:
- 18 levels of difficulty
- Colorful illustrations on cards
- 10 colors of covers
- Relaxing music
70070000022262.intro: Enhance your memory every day and become a master!
70070000022262.name: Brain Memory 2 Extended Edition

70070000022269.description:
Tell Me Your Story is a story-driven cozy puzzle game, which might remind you of the warm times spent with your grandparents or loved ones on getting to know the many, sometimes unexpected stories from their lives.

THE PERFECT TRIO

Meet Amelia, a schoolgirl with a vivid imagination, who’s going on her summer vacation to her grandma Rose’s cottage – her loyal best friend, Peanut, in tow.  This is where Rose had settled to find inner peace in her old age after the life she’s had…

What made her life so special, you ask?

Rose is not an ordinary grandmother – she has a home full of wondrous items and stories to tell. All her life she was a globetrotter, an adventurer – but without dangerous artifacts to deal with.

ADVENTERES AROUND THE WORLD

Discover Asia, Europe, and the Amazon rainforest and feel like a child again, while listening to grandmother's colorful stories alongside Amelia and the adorable corgi doggie.

While helping unpack Rose’s things together with Amelia, you will find plenty of interesting artifacts that she took from her escapades around the world. They will help you get a better picture of the memories she wants to share with you and let you traverse through the images of her past.

Going through the adventure, you will have many puzzles to solve, which will help you discover the wonders Rose has hidden. Help out Amelia with writing everything down in the diary, and make all these stories even better with her imagination.

Following Rose’s footsteps will lead you to historical sites all over the world. First will be the journey through the Amazon rainforest in search of Aztec legends, then through the Yunnan region in China – where the masters of brewing tea lay. Last but not least, you will find yourself on board the Orient Express and its magical first route – from Paris to Istanbul.

Will this busy summer full of memories and adventure bring together two generations, that thought they had so little in common until now?

PICTURE ADVENTURE

Despite the remarkable stories we have to tell, Tell Me Your Story is also a beautiful eye-catching minimalist game with hand-drawn scenes, where there’s no need for any words – everything is brought together in your imagination, enhanced by the colorful images and puzzles.

Discover the process of creating characters and locations with the Peanut Artbook DLC included in this bundle.

WHAT TO EXPECT:
- Multiple puzzles to solve
- A heartwarming story about the family bond
- A corgi dog – Peanut
- Minimalistic cozy graphic design
- Wonderful OST, to smooth your gameplay experience
70070000022269.intro: Dive into globetrotter adventures, discover granny’s treasures, and relax along the way.
70070000022269.name: Tell Me Your Story Ultimate Edition

70070000022278.description:
Head to the golf course after a hard day at work, and meet three stunning business women: Yumiko, Narumi, Misa and show them how to become a master of the golf field.


SHOW THEM HOW TO DO IT
Pick one of the available golf clubs, choose the direction, feel the wind and swing! Every single factor matters and can decide on your score. Prepare your tactic, check the surroundings and impress girls with your skills.


DON’T DISTRACT YOURSELF
Girls will watch your every move and as you hit more holes they will feel more comfortable around you. Hopefully it won’t make you lose your focus even for a second. Admire their suits and spend more time with them later in the game menu.


AUTHENTIC MECHANICS
As every professional, you should use all the information given in order to become a good teacher. Check the direction of wind and its speed. Choose the correct golf club for the situation. Plan your route using minimap and many more!

Remember to avoid tanks of water and use sand piles to stop your ball if necessary.

Get access to the new golf courses and check girls' stunning outfits with River's Edge and Lakeside Fairways DLCs included in this bundle.

KEY FEATURES:
- Three amazing girls that will cheer you up after hard day at work
- Classical golf gameplay
- 40 maps with unique layouts
- Energetic soundtrack
70070000022278.intro: Experience the best date ever and become champion in golf with little help from beautiful girls!
70070000022278.name: Hentai Golf Legendary Edition

70070000022318.description:
Put your imagination to the test and go on a freaky rescue trip. Help rescue Salcy’s beloved cockapoo from unknown danger in which she was sure to find herself . In Freaky Trip you will encounter many logical puzzles, which you can find everywhere. Watch your surroundings carefully and use everything that might be helpful – even if it seems unusual.


(NON)OBVIOUS SOLUTIONS
In this game, puzzles are not as easy as they might look like – as everything around you. Think outside the box, be unpredictable, and succeed on every level, to be an egg forward. Remember that sometimes the most unbelievable answers are the right ones. Try all possibilities and ask for help if you are stuck at any point.


FREAKY CHARACTERS
Meet surprising characters on your journey with Salcy, but don’t even bother to think if they are real – they somehow are. Try to help them and they will return the favor. Hey, have you seen this big buffalo merchant behind the tree? No? That’s weird, I'm sure it was standing there…


CARTOON GRAPHICS
Falling into the world of Freaky Trip is much easier thanks to colorful and cartoon graphics. Progress through this twisted story and watch how the riddles surprise you and make you laugh with every second.

Explore even more with Salcy due to the Summer, Fall and Winter Pack DLCs included in this bundle.

Key features:
- Humorous and totally absurd point-and-click adventure
- 14 various levels with a commonly uncommon story behind
- Entertaining characters and locations
- Exciting soundtrack
70070000022318.intro: Go through untypically typical places and solve totally absurd riddles on your rescue mission.
70070000022318.name: Freaky Trip Happy Edition

70070000022319.description:
Welcome to The Smurfs: Colorful Stories, a place where your creativity and imagination lead to creating unique tales. Visit their village like you are one of them and experience amazing adventures - Smurfs can’t wait to meet you!


ALL CHARACTERS IN ONE PLACE
You don’t have to worry you will miss your favourite Smurfette or Grouchy Smurf. They all gathered here, so you can get to know each one of them, while they tell you their stories. Just relax and take a look at what they have prepared for you.


MULTIPLE TOOLS
In order to make every story personal, the game offers a lot of tools to choose from. You decide what color, brush size, or tool type to use. Try to mix different options to achieve a surprising effect.

This bundle includes first and fourth Personal Boards DLC.

KEY FEATURES:
- All your favourite blue creatures!
- 14 categories full of drawings
- Unlimited options for creating your personal story
- Cartoon type soundtrack
70070000022319.intro: Hop into the wonderful world of Smurfs and check what stories are waiting for you!
70070000022319.name: The Smurfs: Colorful Stories Platinum Edition

70070000022338.description:
Let's Sing 2025 brings the ultimate karaoke experience straight to your living room! Sing along with your family and friends to the latest hits, as well as a generous selection of all-time classics.
Complete your journey to stardom with a brand-new career mode, or join the VIP ranks to gain access to even more tracks. Perform at home or online with a global cast of singers!

Classic mode
The Classic karaoke experience where you sing solo or with friends up to 4 singers. Compete for the highest score based on your pitch and rhythm.

Feat mode
Team up with another player to sing a duet. You'll need to work together to harmonize and hit the right notes to score big. It's a great way to test your vocal chemistry with a friend!

Complete the new Career mode
The Let's Sing career mode returns with a brand-new single player adventure! Join forces with a cast of unforgettable characters and tackle exhilarating challenges on your journey to stardom.

Customise your character
Create your own unique avatar, with options to customise your appearance as well as your in-game voice and dance moves!

Perform in the Let's Sing Music Awards
Show off your star potential, rise up the leaderboards, and earn exclusive rewards by performing in the seasonal Let's Sing Music Awards!

Mic up with the Companion App
Short of a microphone or two? Your friends and family can simply download the companion app and use their smartphone as a mic. Everyone’s invited to this party!

Get in the VIP Lane
Subscribe to the Let's Sing VIP Pass for 1, 3 or 12 months and enjoy instant access to more than 150 songs with the launch of Let's Sing 2025. The VIP Pass also grants access to exclusive year-round seasonal events!

Join in the Let's Sing Fest
Step up to the Local Stage to enjoy a one player game mode where you'll compete with dozens of singers online in a dynamic leaderboard free-for-all!
Players who own the VIP Pass can take to the Main Stage instead, and enjoy the limelight with other VIPs from all over the world!

Get ready for Showtime
The exciting Let's Sing Showtime event lasts for one hour each week, opening up the Main Stage to every player! Enjoy access to all the songs in the VIP Pass while the event is active, even if you don't have an active subscription.

Standard Edition: The Let’s Sing 2025 Standard edition includes 35 songs and a one month free trial of VIP Pass.

70070000022364.description:
SYNDROME

YOU’RE NOT ALONE
You wake up from cryosleep on "Valkenburg" - the most advanced science space station in the “Novacore”. The ship appears to be abandoned, but suddenly you hear a voice on the communicator that makes you aware of the situation.

Something from the abyss of space is kidnapping and killing the people on the ship. And it doesn't stop hunting.

RUN. HIDE. FIGHT. SURVIVE.
The enemies are strong and they outnumber so you have no choice but to go out of sight. Unfortunately, sooner or later you will have to face them, then remember that there is not much ammunition on the science ship…

Stay in the shadows and survive!

YOUR MIND IS ALSO YOUR ENEMY
Meanwhile, strange things start happening to your mind. Will you trust the voice or are they against you too? Where did the " thing" on the ship come from? Will you be able to survive?

Explore the dark corridors of a spacecraft and discover the mystery behind the disappearance of your crewmates.



DEFLECTOR

Deflector is a hack and slash game, where you will experience a dynamic gameplay with an unlimited and unique combo system. Test your reflex and don’t let your guard down – enemies will have no mercy.

Jump into the future, select your loadout, and save the world from the enormous and well known danger in history – viruses.

FUTURISTIC WORLD
Explore locations controlled by viruses and set them free from evil. Progress through the run and choose your path. Use the environment to your advantage, and beware of toxic water, spikes, or electrical fences. Each location offers its unique layouts and traps – so watch your every step.

ENTERTAINING COMBAT SYSTEM
Pick your character and defeat enemies with style. Each hero has a different set of skills and abilities. If you are a fan of melee combat, pick up a sword or put on your boxing gloves. Do you prefer to keep a distance from enemies? No time to waste – get your boomerang and deflect enemies’ projectiles to kill them.

UNLIMITED POSSIBILITIES
Create unique combos, test them, and find your favorite way to slash through enemies. Thanks to game mechanics each approach will be slightly different. You will have to choose additional abilities, stats, and routes on the map. In addition, remember to gather resources from missions to permanently upgrade your skills.



WARHAMMER 40,000: DAKKA SQUADRON

Warhammer 40,000: Dakka Squadron is a dynamic, aerial shooter full of action and explosions where you take on the role of an aircraft pilot.

CAMPAIGN MODE
Fly through 5 unique planets and complete tasks as a commander. The missions provide diverse objectives such as defense or sabotage. Enjoy the explosions and the scenery while defeating enemy bases.

ACTION-PACKED COMBAT
Perform barrel rolls, use boost or air brake to destroy the targets more precisely. Join one of the five available Ork Clans, gaining various bonuses. Stay tactical, attack swiftly and unpredictably, so the opponent cannot recover from defeat.

UPGRADE YOUR WAR MACHINE
Customize your plane with a variety of weapons and upgrades that can be used on the battlefield to gain an advantage over the opponent. Unlock new ships and choose your favorite loadout for sowing devastation.
70070000022364.intro: Step into the battle and experience dynamic gameplay in 3 action-packed games full of duels: Syndrome, Deflector and Warhammer 40,000: Dakka Squadron
70070000022364.name: Action Games Bundle

70070000022365.description:
NORA: THE WANNABE ALCHEMIST

Join Nora, a spirited young witch who's made a few… reckless choices. Embark on a whimsical point-and-click adventure and help her right the wrongs she’s done. While you’re at it, help this wannabe alchemist become a licensed witch.

A MAGICAL GARDENER
Take on the role of a budding alchemist, tasked with nurturing magical gardens. Keep your plants from withering and gather all you can carry. Keep in mind that the clock is ticking, so don’t waste a single second.

EARN A LIVING
Take the literal fruits of your labor to create dozens of unique potions. You decide if you’d rather use them to remove some obstacles or sell them for a profit. Visit the nice elderly lady who runs the magic shop next door. Spend your money wisely and expand your range of possibilities.

DISCOVER SECRETS
Use your alchemy to revitalize the old gardens left by Nora’s grandmother. Uncover new locations and new materials to speed up your journey to the top. Help Nora realize her dream and become a master alchemist.

CUSTOMIZE
Chose from a wide plethora of options to make Nora’s home into the place you could call home. Use your hard-earned cash and customize it to your heart’s content.  It won’t influence your alchemy, but it will look glorious.



MOSAIC CHRONICLES DELUXE

An remarkable tale
Immerse yourself in a story of courage, love and happiness.

You are the hero
Follow the plot to save a beautiful princess or a handsome mage from a powerful beast!

Take a look
Match colored pieces of glass to reveal the next page of adventures in one of two stories: A Bit of Horoscoping and The Lucky Knot.

Mosaic Gallery
Each picture depicts unique characters and events in the stunning style of stained glass mosaics. You will find the completed ones in one place. This makes it easy to check your progress.

Exercise your mind
Puzzles develop your concentration and spatial imagination.
70070000022365.intro: Enter worlds full of magic and enchantment with Nora: The Wannabe Alchemist and Mosaic Chronicles Deluxe.
70070000022365.name: Nora: The Wannabe Alchemist + Mosaic Chronicles Deluxe

70070000022366.description:
HENTAI GOLF

Head to the golf course after a hard day at work, and meet three stunning business women: Yumiko, Narumi, Misa and show them how to become a master of the golf field.

SHOW THEM HOW TO DO IT
Pick one of the available golf clubs, choose the direction, feel the wind and swing! Every single factor matters and can decide on your score. Prepare your tactic, check the surroundings and impress girls with your skills.

DON’T DISTRACT YOURSELF
Girls will watch your every move and as you hit more holes they will feel more comfortable around you. Hopefully it won’t make you lose your focus even for a second. Admire their suits and spend more time with them later in the game menu.

AUTHENTIC MECHANICS
As every professional, you should use all the information given in order to become a good teacher. Check the direction of wind and its speed. Choose the correct golf club for the situation. Plan your route using minimap and many more!

Remember to avoid tanks of water and use sand piles to stop your ball if necessary.



HENTAI GIRLS

These girls want to invite you into the most tempting puzzle game experience Nintendo Switch™ has to offer.

HENTAI IS ART
A familiar anime art style of Hentai Girls brings you right into the lives of these young and beautiful women. Progress through the story by solving their respective puzzles. These lovely girls will keep you company.

INCREASING DIFFICULTY
The gameplay mechanics are simple yet challenging – increasing difficulty as you progress. Their lovely outfit might distract you... so maybe help them get rid of it? Every success on your part will make them happier.



HENTAI WORLD

HENTAI IS ART
Sink into the familiar anime art style of Hentai World. Progress through the story by solving all puzzles. These lovely girls will keep you company.

INCREASING DIFFICULTY
You need to stay focused to truly enjoy the journey ahead. The difficulty will increase depending on the "outfit" of the girl you're helping out. Every success on your part will make them happier!



HENTAI STARS

Get to know Ayame, Ran, and Tsubaki by completing puzzles and discovering their stories.

AMAZING ART
The art style of Hentai Stars brings you into the world of anime. Explore every story by solving puzzles and watch how the beautiful girls change. And don't worry, they will accompany you through the entire game.

INCREASING DIFFICULTY
With the gameplay mechanics, after each puzzle is completed, the difficulty will increase. Try to solve all of them and don't get too distracted by girls’ outfits, which will change every time.

70070000022381.description:
Gas Station Simulator is all about renovating, expanding and running a gas station along a highway in the middle of a desert. Freedom of choice and multiple approaches to run your business and deal with pressure are key ingredients in this game.

Buy an abandoned gas station in the middle of nowhere and restore it to its former glory. Get rid of debris and broken furniture, fix up the walls, paint and decorate the place to your liking. Just don’t spend all your cash on the looks right away, you bought a gas station after all. Repair the equipment, buy what can’t be repaired and start serving your customers to earn money for further renovations and improvements.

Airstrip DLC

It is more story-driven than what we did in the past and it allows you to build a small airstrip close to your gas station.

Meet Joe
Joe is an old pilot flying an old single engine plane. He is a bit strange and one day
approaches you to help him with his endeavours. For that he needs a place to land in the
middle of nowhere to make a stop halfway to his destination. In return he is willing to cut you
in on his deals.

The Airstrip
You have plenty of space and as it turned out, there used to be an old military landing strip
during WWII close to your gas station. Should be that hard to make it work again, right? You
might even go a step further, order some aviation fuel and some parts for planes. A
windsock wouldn’t probably hurt and some lights might turn out to be useful, since you will
on occasion also need to help him land. Let’s see how things develop and what Joe is up
to...

The Plane
Joe’s plane is like its pilot: old. It’s also simple. The most advanced technology on this thing
is the LED reading light Joe uses to find his way on the chart. How hard can it be to fix some
simple things on a small plane? And it’s not like you are doing it for free.

The Gameplay
The Airstrip DLC brings new game mechanics and content to Gas Station Simulator based
on events. Unlike the content we introduced in the past, it does not require your constant
attention, it is more something that happens every now and then.
70070000022381.intro: Buy an abandoned gas station in the middle of nowhere and restore it.
70070000022381.name: Gas Station Simulator and Airstrip DLC Bundle

70070000022389.description:
Purchasing this Bundle will upgrade owners of DREDGE: Deluxe Edition to DREDGE: Complete Edition.

The Pale Reach
Take your DREDGE adventure into unchartered territory. Explore icy waters that hide more than just fish, sell your discoveries, enhance your boat, and unravel a bitter betrayal, dredging up long-buried mysteries from this frozen land.

Embrace the sizzle of the grill as your new symphony in "Kebab Bar Tycoon". With 60 diverse levels serving as your playground, you'll orchestrate a ballet of skewers, veggies, and spices, crafting the perfect kebab.

Treat your virtual customers with wide selection of exotic dishes that go far beyond the classic kebab. Ready to embark on a flavor-filled journey?

Unlock the secrets of spices and secure your legacy as a kebab tycoon!

With nDay, you'll optimize your free time, schedule your day without worrying that something slipped your mind. Choose the year, month, day, exact hour and add a note. How simple is that? Add even more text in your description to remember more details about this date.

70070000022420.description:
Urban Flow is a game about the subtle beauty of city streets filled with cars moving in perfect harmony. But such order does not happen all by itself - the city needs YOU to control the traffic lights and to make sure everything goes smoothly. That means no crashes, no jams. Everything will run perfectly - as long as you stay focused!

Immerse yourself in a beautiful, hand-crafted, low-poly world to discover the enormous satisfaction of watching the hundreds of tiny, colorful cars flowing through the streets – all while listening to the chill, urban music.

Over 100 levels, each with its own busy intersection. You have one job: operate the lights and keep it safe.

Party Game (even if you party all alone!)
-----
 Play by yourself or with friends in scalable drop-in, drop-out local co-op mode for two, three, or four players!
You can help your friends or be a little rascal and spread the chaos!

Avoid accidents by paying close attention to special vehicles and to the other players. Special vehicles include the ambulance, which can’t wait for long, and the tank – which will plow through anything in its way.

Don’t want to play the campaign?
-----
 Try our score-based Endless Mode or the Chill Mode - where you play for as long as you want, no rush and no score - only you and the music. Urban Flow is designed to be a great single player experience!

Discover various environments and weather conditions. Play with touch controls, Pro Controllers or Joy-Con™ controllers. Complete challenges and unlock rewards.

Become one with the flow. The Urban Flow!

This bundle includes base game, Winter Expansion Pack and Streets Supplement #2 with:

•    7 new vehicles
•    20 new levels!
•    winter theme and new music!
70070000022420.intro: Manage the city lights and try to avoid the chaos!
70070000022420.name: Urban Flow Metropolis Edition

Our brains are the most important tools of the XXI century. Do your child a favor, and give thema gift that will help them reach their full potential.

Imagine a cardboard box. Is it shaped to fit one to two fluffy felines? What about five? What about twenty?

Fit My Cat presents you with many cute kitties that all wish to sit where they deem fit. That being said, we're running out of space and we are seriously looking for a cat organizer. If you could spare a moment or two to make that happen we would be grateful.

Every single one of them is trained and well-equipped for some spatial management – pick them up and rotate them as you see fit.

Just so you're aware, some boxes might come with yarn balls or entire cathouses – but that will not prevent those spunky kitties from trying to get inside.

Test your skills and show the world that herding cats is where fun begins!

Get access to new levels with Cat's Puzzle Pack 1 and 3 included in this bundle.

KEY FEATURES
- Over 90 pawesome levels of cardboard boxes, ready to be filled with fluff

70070000022457.description:
Grab your equipment with you and begin your journey to become a master of nGolf. Explore beautiful and minimalist locations full of traps, puzzles, and amazing views.


FIND YOUR WAY
While playing nGolf you will face many challenges on your way. Lasers, spikes, flames and many more will try to stop your ball. Remember that timing is the key to success and you shouldn’t hurry with your hit. Go with the flow and master all worlds.


PLAN YOUR APPROACH
There is an unlimited number of possible solutions to finish levels. Different angles and strengths can change the trajectory of the ball diametrically. Check your surroundings for hills, teleports, or speed boosters. Each element gives you a new opportunity to hit the hole.


BECOME A GOLF MASTER
To become a professional, you have to collect all stars on each stage and accomplish the lowest amount of hits. Study the layout of the map, take as many attempts as you need and obtain the title of champion!

Change the appearance and visuals with Colorful Golf Balls 2 DLC included in this bundle.

KEY FEATURES:
- 8 unique worlds
- Over 60 levels to master
- Scorecards to help you track your progress

Start a new journey and see how this is more than just a farming game.

ADORABLE CAT
Help cute cat Niko escape from the big city and settle with him on the Ostara archipelago. Just choose an island and start your new life! His knowledge and passion for nature will let you turn this island into the most stunning place on Earth.

GAME ECONOMY
Your garden will produce many products you can sell and earn money. Remember to order unnecessary seeds, saplings and equipment to make your garden grow even bigger. Manage space on your island and pick the best place for your crops. Don’t forget to water them every day!

VARIOUS ACTIVITIES
It’s your choice what to do. Developing your skills by farming, mining, foraging, crafting, fishing will let you unlock new recipes and abilities. Make sure to unlock all of them and explore all possibilities in the game.

Make your island even more cozy with the Easter and Cows DLCs.

KEY FEATURES
- Charming 2D pixel art graphics
- More than 20 hours of amazing gameplay
- Outfit customization
- Your own pets!
- Simple and clear economy system
- Lovely music track
70070000022493.intro: Make your dream of settling on an island and growing a beautiful garden come true!
70070000022493.name: Sprout Valley Definitive Edition

70070000022497.description:
nZen will help you on your journey to finding yourself and understanding the world around you. Begin your contemplation, clear your mind, and let nZen guide you through the unexplored areas of your mind.


IDENTIFY YOUR GOAL
Select one of the available inspirational programs prepared for various occasions. During each of them, you will be able to focus on a voice that will help you achieve your goal. Focusing on the energy flowing through your body or stimulating your creativity are just two examples of how nZen can help you.


CALMING SOUNDS
During your sessions, you can switch between two available background noises that will help you relax. A harmonious melody or the sounds of waves breaking against the shore. Choose the one that soothes you more and drift away into the depths of your mind.

Find you inner peace with additional Practice On Concentration DLC.

KEY FEATURES:
- 5 different inspirational programs
- Calming background sounds
- Motivational quotes that will help you achieve your goal
70070000022497.intro: Find your inner peace by relaxing with nZen.
70070000022497.name: nZen Extended Edition

70070000022502.description:
Brain Memory 2 is based on simple memory game principles. It effectively helps improve focus and memory for everyone.


ADORABLE ILLUSTRATIONS
Thanks to colorful pictures, it’s easier to remember where each card is located. However, be cautious as some cards may differ in the held object or the pose the character assumes. Pay attention to the smallest details as it is key to success.


CUSTOMIZE YOUR CARDS
To train effectively, the player can choose their preferred difficulty level and customize the appearance of the card covers. This allows the mind to focus on the appropriate number of cards and colors on the board.

Get new look of cards with Cards Pack 3 DLC included in this bundle.

KEY FEATURES:
- 18 levels of difficulty
- Colorful illustrations on cards
- 10 colors of covers
- Relaxing music
70070000022502.intro: Enhance your memory every day and become a master!
70070000022502.name: Brain Memory 2 Special Edition

70070000022503.description:
With nBlocks you will be able to construct any project that resides in your mind using 2D blocks of various shapes. You can either use prepared templates and collect stars or start your own project from the beginning.


UNLIMITED POSSIBILITIES
To ensure each of your projects stands out, you can choose from 19 elements that you can fully rotate, duplicate, and customize their colors. Additionally, you can adjust the color of the board on which you arrange the blocks to suit your preferences.


CREATE YOUR OWN
Freestyle mode offers blank boards just waiting to be filled with blocks. This mode is perfect if you want to build a masterpiece from scratch all by yourself. No limitations, just you and your creativity.

Unblock new set of templates with Builder Pack 3 included in this bundle.

KEY FEATURES:
- 96 templates in challenge mode
- Freestyle mode to unleash your creativity.
- 19 unique elements and 20 colors
- Relaxing music that helps to focus
70070000022503.intro: Design, build and create all of your fantastic ideas!
70070000022503.name: nBlocks - Unblock Your Creativity Extended Edition

70070000022504.description:
Cat Piano is the ultimate cat-tastic piano game designed especially for kids! Dive into a world of whimsical melodies and playful paw prints as you unleash your inner feline musician.


PURR-FECT PIANO PLAY
Cat Piano is a delightful piano version where kids can create music using charming cat sounds instead of traditional piano notes. Each paw print on the piano produces a different tone of cat sound, allowing children to compose their own tunes with a touch of feline flair.


PAWS FOR CREATIVITY
The only limit is your imagination! Challenge yourself to replicate your favorite songs using only cat sounds. Whether you're composing a gentle lullaby or a lively tune to get the whole family dancing, Cat Piano provides endless opportunities for creative expression.

Are you ready to unleash your inner feline musician? Let the whisker-tickling fun begin with Cat Piano!

Change adorable cats that accompany you while playing piano with Background Pack 3 DLC.

KEY FEATURES
- Playful piano game featuring adorable cat sounds
- Different backgrounds with lovely cats
- Unlimited opportunities for creative expression and musical exploration
- Super option to show your kid different sounds
70070000022504.intro: Start the whisker-tickling Fun with Cat Piano.
70070000022504.name: Cat Piano Extended Edition

70070000022505.description:
Tell Me Your Story is a story-driven cozy puzzle game, which might remind you of the warm times spent with your grandparents or loved ones on getting to know the many, sometimes unexpected stories from their lives.

THE PERFECT TRIO

Meet Amelia, a schoolgirl with a vivid imagination, who’s going on her summer vacation to her grandma Rose’s cottage – her loyal best friend, Peanut, in tow.  This is where Rose had settled to find inner peace in her old age after the life she’s had…

What made her life so special, you ask?

Rose is not an ordinary grandmother – she has a home full of wondrous items and stories to tell. All her life she was a globetrotter, an adventurer – but without dangerous artifacts to deal with.

ADVENTERES AROUND THE WORLD

Discover Asia, Europe, and the Amazon rainforest and feel like a child again, while listening to grandmother's colorful stories alongside Amelia and the adorable corgi doggie.

While helping unpack Rose’s things together with Amelia, you will find plenty of interesting artifacts that she took from her escapades around the world. They will help you get a better picture of the memories she wants to share with you and let you traverse through the images of her past.

Going through the adventure, you will have many puzzles to solve, which will help you discover the wonders Rose has hidden. Help out Amelia with writing everything down in the diary, and make all these stories even better with her imagination.

Following Rose’s footsteps will lead you to historical sites all over the world. First will be the journey through the Amazon rainforest in search of Aztec legends, then through the Yunnan region in China – where the masters of brewing tea lay. Last but not least, you will find yourself on board the Orient Express and its magical first route – from Paris to Istanbul.

Will this busy summer full of memories and adventure bring together two generations, that thought they had so little in common until now?

PICTURE ADVENTURE

Despite the remarkable stories we have to tell, Tell Me Your Story is also a beautiful eye-catching minimalist game with hand-drawn scenes, where there’s no need for any words – everything is brought together in your imagination, enhanced by the colorful images and puzzles.

Discover the process of creating characters and locations with the Rose Artbook DLC included in this bundle.

WHAT TO EXPECT:
- Multiple puzzles to solve
- A heartwarming story about the family bond
- A corgi dog – Peanut
- Minimalistic cozy graphic design
- Wonderful OST, to smooth your gameplay experience
70070000022505.intro: Dive into globetrotter adventures, discover granny’s treasures, and relax along the way.
70070000022505.name: Tell Me Your Story Extended Edition

70070000022506.description:
Bomb Cat takes inspiration from classic 2048 games but elevates the challenge with an insane bomb mechanic. In other words, it’s pretty simple – match the fluffy cats carefully, and watch out – the bombastic Bomb Cat can either assist you or completely disrupt your game.


2048 MATCH GAME WITH A BANG… OR A BOMB?
There are eleven fluffy cats, starting with sweet tiny blue kitten babies to match together. Each cat has a different weight depending on its size. Your goal is to achieve the highest score without running out of space.

To increase the challenge, a Bomb Cat will occasionally appear... to activate this kitty’s ability, it needs to touch the Flamey Cat. That’s when the explosion’s countdown starts!

Depending on the circumstances, the blast can help you match smaller cats, as they will jump around the box, or end your game, as the cats can pop out of the open parcel and fly into space. Just like typical cats.


BE A COMBO HERO
Take the challenge of making your score furry freaking best. The more cats you match, the bigger your combo, which translates to more points.

Placing the cats strategically will help you maximize your score.

Unlock new board with Spring Background DLC included in this bundle.

KEY FEATURES:
– Eleven colorful cats to match like in classic 2048
– Possibility of sending cats to the Moon and back
– One special cat – Cat Bomb to make the game more challenging
– Combo mechanic to make your score even better
– Easy controlling, but challenging gameplay (sometimes)
– Endless and addictive fun
– Enjoyable music, which you can always turn off
– Once again... CATS (No regrets, cats are superior to other animals; deal with it already)
70070000022506.intro: Match ultra-fluffy cats to achieve the highest score and unleash chaos with Bomb Cat.
70070000022506.name: Bomb Cat Ultimate Edition

70070000022511.description:
Get to know Ayame, Ran, and Tsubaki by completing puzzles and discovering their stories.

AMAZING ART

The art style of Hentai Stars brings you into the world of anime. Explore every story by solving puzzles and watch how the beautiful girls change. And don't worry, they will accompany you through the entire game.

INCREASING DIFFICULTY

With the gameplay mechanics, after each puzzle is completed, the difficulty will increase. Try to solve all of them and don't get too distracted by girls’ outfits, which will change every time.

This bundle includes Singing Puppy Tsubaki DLC.

Key Features:
- Hand-drawn Hentai art
- Sensual music track
- Simple gameplay mechanics
- Different difficulty levels
- Unique outfits and locations
70070000022511.intro: Dive into the world of hentai stars and meet lovely girls.
70070000022511.name: Hentai Stars Amazing Edition

70070000022512.description:
HENTAI IS ART

Sink into the familiar anime art style of Hentai World. Progress through the story by solving all puzzles. These lovely girls will keep you company.

INCREASING DIFFICULTY

You need to stay focused to truly enjoy the journey ahead. The difficulty will increase depending on the "outfit" of the girl you're helping out. Every success on your part will make them happier!

In this bundle, you will meet students Sayuri, Rose in kitty costume and Nanami in puppy costume.

Key Features:

- Hand-drawn Hentai art
- Relaxing music track
- Almost 50 art pieces to unlock
- Simple gameplay mechanics
- Unique premise
70070000022512.intro: Feast your eyes with Akane, Rose, and Nanami in the most sensual puzzle game experience Nintendo Switch™ has to offer.
70070000022512.name: Hentai World Ultra Deluxe

70070000022516.description:
EASY TO PLAY
Play with family and friends! Controls are intuitive, so simply move like you'd usually do while swimming and push forward. Swap your swimming style at any point for some extra fun.

REACH YOUR GOAL
Play with your friends or challenge yourself. Complete daily goals to improve your health and do your best to unlock every achievement.

ENJOY YOURSELF
Remember to swim at your own pace, and make time for some much needed breaks. Revel in the healthiest gameplay loop in your entire life.

This bundle includes two new characters - an adorable swimming piglet, a super-sweet red panda and dragon.

KEY FEATURES:

- cute characters
- different swimming styles
- change characters and style at any time
- variety of places to swim
- daily goals
- family fun great for all ages
- multi and singleplayer mode
70070000022516.intro: Discover a new world of fun! Dive into Sport & Fun: Swimming and use your Joy-Con™ controllers to experience the cutest challenge in your life.
70070000022516.name: Sport & Fun: Swimming Ultra Legendary

70070000022518.description:
One Night: Burlesque offers one of a kind visual novel story with puzzle elements. Become a detective and solve the case of an upcoming murder mystery. Your hidden talent gives you an advantage over the killer so use it wise.


SPECIAL GIFT
Get into the high heels of Holly, a talented dancer graced with a unique gift of telepathy.
Delve into the minds of those around her and try to solve this captivating noir mystery. Uncover their hidden motives and unveil the truth. Be cautious; every mind holds secrets, and not all are willing to share them right away.


WHO IS THE KILLER?
The wannabe murderer might not be a butler, but he's certainly in the audience. Navigate a labyrinth of tangled relationships and peel back the layers of deceit. The clock is ticking ominously, and every choice you make might decide the fate of your friends.

With this bundle, you can learn about the creation stories of Holly, Liz, and the Suspects by accessing the artbook from the game menu.

KEY FEATURES:
- A noir aesthetic
- A detective-style murder mystery
- A unique setting (a Burlesque Club)
- Multiple endings depending on your choices
- An Incredible music track
- A charming telepathic dancer
70070000022518.intro: Step into the smoky, seductive world of the Angels Den, a luxurious burlesque club. Help her on a desperate mission to save a friend from certain doom.
70070000022518.name: One Night: Burlesque GOTY Edition

70070000022519.description:
Welcome to the most bustling place in the world. Important notice: no, you can’t hide the bell from the guests. Yes, they will keep ringing it. Your role here will be to take care of the hotel and attend to guests and all their needs for the duration of their stay.


CLEAN, PREPARE, AND SERVE - SERVICE, I MEAN SERVICE
Before the guests arrive you’ll need to tidy up and prepare their rooms. Look at your to-do list, take all the necessary equipment from the trolley and get rid of the mess. To answer incoming questions: yes, the guests will complain if they see but a crumb on their carpet.

Time is money. Delivering the guests’ special requests - like luxurious sheets or delicious sushi - need to be completed in a specific amount of time for you to receive your entire monetary bonus.


RUN THE HOTEL ALONE OR WITH A FRIEND
If you’d like to play with a friend, your stakes will be a bit higher, but two heads are better than one. The camera will pan out to include both characters on the screen at all times.

Happy hustling and do not forget: a “no running, wet floor” sign is not enough of an excuse not to deliver a guests their meal on time.

Browse amazing drawings from the Artbook Part 2 DLC included in this bundle.

KEY FEATURES:
- Singleplayer and coop mode
- Stars that unlock new levels
- Many activities to complete
- 25 levels with various layouts
70070000022519.intro: Take a very hands-on approach to managing a bustling hotel and make sure your guests leave with a smile on their face.
70070000022519.name: Hotel Hustle Ultimate Edition

70070000022524.description:
Make your grandma proud in Tokyo Cooking! Run your own restaurant and prepare the most iconic Japanese dishes. Take orders from customers, prepare their meals with passion and listen to their opinions to become better and better with each passing day.


DO THE COOKING BY THE BOOK…
Your kitchen has all the necessary equipment and ingredients you will need to prepare the most delicious sushi. Follow and complete each step from your to-do list while choosing from many available kinds of fish, vegetables and spices and adding them depending on the client's wish.


…AND CUSTOMIZE TO YOUR HEART’S CONTENT
Earn money from the orders and customize the interior of your Japanese restaurant in Tokyo Cooking. At the end of each day, you will have access to your laptop, where you can browse through equipment you can purchase for your place. Enjoy new chairs, tables, plants and utensils.

Become a master of composing the perfect sushi. Be precise and use the exact amount of ingredients such as soy sauce or rice. Complete mini-games to receive extra money as a bonus for your order.

Decorate your restaurant with the Oceanic Fish Set DLC included in this bundle.

KEY FEATURES:
- You can learn to make your own sushi!
- A total of 32 unique ingredients like fish, vegetables that NEVER run out
- Step-by-step recipes
- Interesting customers
- Day/night system and access to laptop after work
- 6 unique sushi recipes like Hosomaki or Uramaki and relaxing tea
70070000022524.intro: Run the best sushi restaurant in the city, talk to customers and learn new recipes.
70070000022524.name: Tokyo Cooking Ultimate Edition

70070000022534.description:
Get ready to embrace the thunderous roar of engines, ignite the spark of competition, and embark on an unforgettable journey that redefines the essence of being a speed enthusiast. This Ultimate Racing Bundle combines the thrilling main game with the groundbreaking DLC which including innovative motorcycle handles, offering you an unbeatable package that promises endless excitement and intense thrills.
Features:
	•	Innovative Motorcycle Handles: Experience new levels of speed and thrills.
	•	Wide Selection of Motorcycles: Choose from diverse, powerful bikes to match your racing style.
	•	Customization at Your Fingertips: Upgrade and modify your motorcycle to dominate the tracks.
This Bundle It’s the perfect choice for racing enthusiasts who want to get the most out of their gaming adventure.
70070000022534.intro: All-In-One Racing Bundle: Endless Speed, Ultimate Control.
70070000022534.name: Highway Moto Racing Rush 2023 Simulator - Premium Edition

70070000022539.description:
A third-person, stealth, adventure game focused on the story of the Moonshadow Huntress: Cynthia Stranborg. Take control of the young adept and learn new stealth skills during your journey. Find out what happened in the home village and follow your desired path to rescue the ones you love the most. Travel through Tesana Valley to find a secretly hidden missing piece of artifact to enhance your bow. The Dark Power is coming from the north. You need to destroy the source of this power before it's too late. You are the last one that can reach that destination. At least you need to try, for your loved ones!

Key features:
-Stylized and colorful world
-Fully voice acted emotional story
-Stealth mechanics, arrows crafting, climbing sequences and light puzzle solving
-A short story-driven game (to finish in one evening)
-Several alternative outfits to unlock throughout the game.
-A dedicated photo mode with multiple options to modify: pose, camera effects, stickers, face mimics etc.
70070000022539.name: Cynthia: Hidden in the Moonshadow - Special Edition

70070000022543.description:
Introducing the new Bundle, where high-speed cars meet intense soccer action in an electrifying fusion! Dive into the heart of the game and take advantage of the DLC pack + the main game, which provides double adrenaline and interest. Where you'll choose from a range of stylish vehicles, each with unique abilities, and engage in fast-paced gameplay across various modes and immersive stadium arenas. But the excitement doesn't stop there - with the DLC which including new Rim for Wheel with Spokes seamlessly integrated, customize your car with new accessories and elevate your gaming experience.
Features:
	•	Customizable with new Accessories: Personalize your car with the latest accessories, including the New Rim for Wheel with Spokes DLC.
	•	Immersive Environments: Unlock stadium arenas, each with its own unique theme and design, providing immersive environments for intense battles.
Don't miss this unbeatable value that offers speed and adrenaline!
70070000022543.intro: Gear Up for Maximum Excitement: Drive, Score, and Dominate with our Exclusive Bundle!
70070000022543.name: Rocket Car: Ultimate Ball League Machines Premium Edition

70070000022544.description: New to The Fog? Check out Dead by Daylight: Dungeons & Dragons Edition, which includes the base game, the Dungeons and Dragons Chapter, and 2 Dungeons & Dragons Outfits: Baermar’s Roadside Ambush and Vecna’s Whispered One.
70070000022544.name: Dead by Daylight: Dungeons & Dragons Edition

70070000022548.description:
Will you manage to completely destroy the wall until not a single brick is left standing?

Immerse yourself in the most satisfying casual game where you tear down walls brick by brick using a circular saw!

Features:
- tear down 11 regular and 8 new brickwork mosaics using your saw!
- earn coins for each brick you claim and reset your progress to get Prestige Points!
- upgrade your machinery for more power, size, length, and fuel capacity
- buy a variety of improvements: treadmill, tank, multiplier, discount, and servo!
- change the look of your saw with 10 different funny skins!
- relax and de-stress after a long day
- beware, because the game is very addictive!

Push the bricks into your Bucket Crusher to convert them into cash, but watch out because you can run out of fuel!

Once you complete the first wall, there are various colorful and interesting mosaics with different shapes waiting for you to dig into and pull to pieces!

Upgrade your machinery after each level and think carefully about the wisest way to invest your money. Increase the length, power, size, and fuel capacity to get more bricks with every run of the level!

If you want to knock down walls faster and earn more cash, consider buying special permanent upgrades that cost prestige points, but there's a catch here. To get them, you have to reset all your progress!
70070000022548.intro: Power up your machine and get caught up in the craze of destruction!
70070000022548.name: Bucket Crusher: Worldwide Edition

70070000022550.description:
Treat your patients with different dental issues, from cavities to plaque buildup, and watch as their smiles transform under your expert care!

Perform treatments under time pressure, and don't forget about your customer's comfort. If you drill too long in the teeth, the customer will be dissatisfied with your service!

Features:
- perform a lot of different dental procedures on your new fairy tale forest chair
- decorate customers' teeth with new sparkling diamonds or apply a varnish that will change their color
- work under time pressure and do your job the best you can!
- unlock and apply 12 tooth skins, 10 bling skins, and 10 chair skins
- upgrade the look of your clinic to make it cozier
- buy an upgrades so your customers can last longer during dental treatment

Pull out decaying teeth and replace them with shiny new ones. Change their shape to fangs or apply braces. Yes doctor, at your salon, your patients LOVE braces!

Don't forget about your special BLING diamond treatment. This is a fancy teeth salon after all!

Whatever you do, BLING, make them smile!
70070000022550.intro:
Ready for the ultimate dental experience?
Dive into the world of tooth care and become a master dentist!
70070000022550.name: Dentist Bling: Fantasy Edition

70070000022552.description:
Get your neon cables out of knots and connect them to the right light sources to create amazing neon masterpieces!

In Neon On, the colors are the key to each puzzle. Every box needs to be connected to the socket of the same color otherwise it won't work. Some boxes even require combining a couple of hues to create a different color!

Features:
- unlock 3 new boxes, 3 cables and 3 theme skins!
- solve puzzles by matching the colorful light sources to the correct boxes
- grab neon light cables by tips and connect the power
- combine different hues to create entirely new colors
- connect the cables if the wire is too short, but be careful - the more you move them, the more they can get tangled!
- avoid pulling wires through laser walls - they will cut everything in half
- complete all stages of a level to light up a large animated neon sign!
- collect coins and buy skins for power boxes, cables, and themes

Challenge yourself to complete many levels where you will find various obstacles, from laser gates that can cut your cables to moving light sources or rotating boxes. Besides, be careful while moving the wires because they can easily get tangled, disconnected, and fall to the ground!

Light up the cities with vibrant neon artworks!
70070000022552.intro: Wanna see something amazing? Like, really electrifying? The ultimate neon puzzle game is here!
70070000022552.name: Neon On!: Bright Edition

Start a new journey and see how this is more than just a farming game.

70070000022557.intro: Make your dream of settling on an island and growing a beautiful garden come true!
70070000022557.name: Sprout Valley Complete Edition

70070000022563.description:
Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun - Forges of Corruption Edition is the most complete way to experience the ultimate Warhammer 40,000 homage to retro shooters, including the base game and Forges of Corruption DLC.

Load up your Boltgun and plunge into battle headfirst! Experience a perfect blend of Warhammer 40,000, classic, frenetic FPS gameplay and the stylish visuals of your favourite 90’s retro shooters.

Play as a battle-hardened Space Marine on a perilous mission across the galaxy, as they battle against the Chaos Space Marines and daemons of Chaos.

In glorious boomer shooter style, unleash your devastating Space Marine arsenal as you blast through an explosion of sprites, pixels and blood. Run, jump and charge across huge levels to shoot, shred and slice the worst heretics across the galaxy!
70070000022563.name: Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun - Forges of Corruption Edition

70070000022566.description:
Watch the party grow lively as you party hustle and show your party spirit!
The Party Hustle Pack, Party Spirit Pack, and Lively Party Pack are now available together as a downloadable content bundle!
70070000022566.intro: Power up Party Party Time 2 with 30 additional minigames!
70070000022566.name: Hustle Spirit Lively 3 Pack Set

70070000022570.description:
Introducing an all-new party game for everyone to pick up, play, and enjoy!
Share Joy-Con™ for up to 6 players to join the party!

Streamlined, enhanced, and intuitive controls make every play session unlimited and easy fun!
Compete with friends and family and let the fun times roll!

The Party Party Time 2 + Three Pack Set is a value bundle that includes Party Party Time 2 as well as the Party Hustle Pack, Party Spirit Pack, and Lively Party Pack!
Enjoy the party together with everybody!
70070000022570.intro:
It's Party Party Time again!
Everyone join in and Let's Party!
70070000022570.name: Party Party Time 2 + Three Pack Set

70070000022583.description:
Purchase the SONIC X SHADOW GENERATIONS Digital Deluxe Edition and receive additional iconic music tracks from previous Sonic and Shadow games, a Terios skin based on Shadow’s original concept, behind-the-scenes art, the Sonic the Hedgehog 3 Movie Pack featuring the voice of Keanu Reeves, and more!

It includes:
•	Base Game
•	Digital Deluxe Season Pass:
o	Sonic the Hedgehog 3 Movie Pack (releasing December 12, 2024)
o	Terios Skin
o	Extra BGM Pack
o	Digital Art Book + Soundtrack
o	Skill Points (Sonic Generations)

Shadow the Hedgehog is back with Classic and Modern Sonic in SONIC X SHADOW GENERATIONS, an all-new collection featuring two unique experiences!

Play as Shadow in a brand-new story campaign featuring never-before-seen abilities that prove why he’s known as the Ultimate Life Form! Speed through iconic stages from Shadow’s history, discover hidden secrets in an expansive hub world, and unlock new powers to take on Black Doom and save the world.

SONIC X SHADOW GENERATIONS also includes a complete remaster of the highly acclaimed SONIC GENERATIONS, a time-traveling adventure featuring a greatest-hits collection of 3D and 2D Sonic stages, now with upgraded visuals and new bonus content.

The Return of Shadow
In this new standalone campaign, Shadow’s nemesis, Black Doom, has reemerged and threatens to take over the world once again. Shadow must journey into his past, confront his painful memories, and unlock new dark powers to save the world.

Shadow Evolved
Harness Shadow’s new Doom Powers to battle hordes of enemies and tackle platforming challenges like never before. Surf on water, fly over obstacles, and stop time with the return of Chaos Control!

A Journey Through Time and Dimensions
Relive signature levels from Shadow’s previous adventures and accelerate through mind-bending stages in both 3D and 2D, warped by Black Doom’s influence as Shadow works to piece together the timeline and thwart his evil plans.

Explore the New White Space

70070000022587.description:
Crypt Stalker is an 8-bit retro-styled arcade game. Take on the role of Gladys, one of the descendants of the world's defenders, and stop the demons before they unleash hell on the planet. Explore and defend diverse locations such as pyramids, a lake of fire, or overgrown ruins from unearthly creatures.


EXPLORE THE CRYPTS
As a highly trained Stalker, your task is to search and overcome every danger standing in your way. Watch out for your surroundings - unstable stones, and moving platforms are just a few dangers awaiting you during exploration.


FACE THE MONSTERS
Fight your way through enemies with a cyber whip or your reliable laser gun. At the end of each crypt, you will have to confront the powerful boss. Remember to replenish your gun ammunition or restore some health by destroying blocks, before going to battle.

Unlock new mode and save the world with Boss Rush+ DLC.

KEY FEATURES:
- Main story available in 2 difficulty levels: original and casual mode
- The Lost Sequel featuring 6 extra chapters
- Real 8-bit graphics
- Console and handheld game versions
- Intense battles with bosses who await your arrival
- Nostalgic retro music with sounds of dying demons in the background
- Achievements and extra challenges

UNO™ Legacy Edition features the classic card game alongside three exciting DLCs:

UNO™: Play one of the most iconic games as you match cards by color, number, or symbol and play action cards to spice things up. Race against others to empty your hand before anyone else, and don’t forget to shout “UNO!” when you’re down to your last card!

UNO Flip!™ DLC: Elevate your UNO™ matches with a double-sided deck, introducing a competitive twist to the classic gameplay. Switch between the light and dark sides and get ready to spice things up with new action cards that are funnier than ever!

UNO™ 50th Anniversary DLC: Celebrate five decades of one of the most popular card games in style with this DLC and its gorgeous velvety cards. Plus, add a touch of flair with the special 50/50 card and its Gold Coin rule.

UNO Party! Mania™ DLC: For those craving chaos, UNO Party! Mania™ introduces 3 thrilling new action cards: the Point Taken, Wild Drawn Together, and Wild Pile Up cards. Brace yourself for bursts of laughter, nail-biting tension, and epic comebacks.

Whether it's a game night with friends or a solo adventure, UNO™ Legacy Edition promises endless hours of fun!
70070000022591.name: UNO™ Legacy Edition

This is a comprehensive Experience where get the full “GhostX” game and enhance it with the “GhostX wich New skins for military rifles” DLC. Are you ready to prove your skills?

70070000022635.description:
Head to the golf course after a hard day at work, and meet three stunning business women: Yumiko, Narumi, Misa and show them how to become a master of the golf field.


SHOW THEM HOW TO DO IT
Pick one of the available golf clubs, choose the direction, feel the wind and swing! Every single factor matters and can decide on your score. Prepare your tactic, check the surroundings and impress girls with your skills.


DON’T DISTRACT YOURSELF
Girls will watch your every move and as you hit more holes they will feel more comfortable around you. Hopefully it won’t make you lose your focus even for a second. Admire their suits and spend more time with them later in the game menu.


AUTHENTIC MECHANICS
As every professional, you should use all the information given in order to become a good teacher. Check the direction of wind and its speed. Choose the correct golf club for the situation. Plan your route using minimap and many more!

Remember to avoid tanks of water and use sand piles to stop your ball if necessary.

Get access to the new golf courses and check girls' stunning outfits with River's Edge and Sunset Pines DLCs included in this bundle.

- Three amazing girls that will cheer you up after hard day at work
- Classical golf gameplay
- 40 maps with unique layouts
- Energetic soundtrack

Welcome to the matching jungle of Fit My Cat's wild and wacky animal edition!

Picture this: your Zoo pals have embarked on a lavish holiday retreat to an exclusive hotel with a sprawling pool oasis, just for them. But there's a snag – they're all vying for space on a colossal floatie, and they need your finesse to make it work.

Here's what makes this ZOOOOOish escapade roar to life:

70070000022654.intro: Help wacky animals to relax in the pool by matching them on the floatie!

70070000022655.description:
Choose your favourite skin, eat, grow and stay alive.
Compete in multiplayer mode with up to 4 players or eat it all by yourself.

Features:
- 7 maps with different things to swallow
- 21 animated skins to make your black hole look cooler
- 2 multiplayer modes up to 4 players on one screen!
- endless mode where you swallow things falling from the sky
- powerups spawning  during the game
- collecting themed stickers
- easy controls so anyone can play
- simple rules and lots of fun!

Grow by swallowing everything in front of you, whether it be garbage cans, fire hydrants or cars. Get large enough to consume even bigger objects or other players. Eat until nothing and no one is standing in your way!
70070000022655.intro: Show who is the biggest black hole in the universe!
70070000022655.name: Hole io: Warzone Edition

70070000022661.description:
Put your imagination to the test and go on a freaky rescue trip. Help rescue Salcy’s beloved cockapoo from unknown danger in which she was sure to find herself . In Freaky Trip you will encounter many logical puzzles, which you can find everywhere. Watch your surroundings carefully and use everything that might be helpful – even if it seems unusual.


(NON)OBVIOUS SOLUTIONS
In this game, puzzles are not as easy as they might look like – as everything around you. Think outside the box, be unpredictable, and succeed on every level, to be an egg forward. Remember that sometimes the most unbelievable answers are the right ones. Try all possibilities and ask for help if you are stuck at any point.


FREAKY CHARACTERS
Meet surprising characters on your journey with Salcy, but don’t even bother to think if they are real – they somehow are. Try to help them and they will return the favor. Hey, have you seen this big buffalo merchant behind the tree? No? That’s weird, I'm sure it was standing there…


CARTOON GRAPHICS
Falling into the world of Freaky Trip is much easier thanks to colorful and cartoon graphics. Progress through this twisted story and watch how the riddles surprise you and make you laugh with every second.

Explore even more with Salcy due to the Summer, Fall and Spring Pack DLCs included in this bundle.

Key features:
- Humorous and totally absurd point-and-click adventure
- 14 various levels with a commonly uncommon story behind
- Entertaining characters and locations
- Exciting soundtrack
70070000022661.intro: Go through untypically typical places and solve totally absurd riddles on your rescue mission.
70070000022661.name: Freaky Trip Amazing Edition

70070000022662.description:
Welcome to The Smurfs: Colorful Stories, a place where your creativity and imagination lead to creating unique tales. Visit their village like you are one of them and experience amazing adventures - Smurfs can’t wait to meet you!


ALL CHARACTERS IN ONE PLACE
You don’t have to worry you will miss your favourite Smurfette or Grouchy Smurf. They all gathered here, so you can get to know each one of them, while they tell you their stories. Just relax and take a look at what they have prepared for you.


MULTIPLE TOOLS
In order to make every story personal, the game offers a lot of tools to choose from. You decide what color, brush size, or tool type to use. Try to mix different options to achieve a surprising effect.

This bundle includes first and fifth Personal Boards DLC.

KEY FEATURES:
- All your favourite blue creatures!
- 14 categories full of drawings
- Unlimited options for creating your personal story
- Cartoon type soundtrack
70070000022662.intro: Hop into the wonderful world of Smurfs and check what stories are waiting for you!
70070000022662.name: The Smurfs: Colorful Stories Director's Cut

70070000022664.description:
Bomb Cat takes inspiration from classic 2048 games but elevates the challenge with an insane bomb mechanic. In other words, it’s pretty simple – match the fluffy cats carefully, and watch out – the bombastic Bomb Cat can either assist you or completely disrupt your game.


2048 MATCH GAME WITH A BANG… OR A BOMB?
There are eleven fluffy cats, starting with sweet tiny blue kitten babies to match together. Each cat has a different weight depending on its size. Your goal is to achieve the highest score without running out of space.

To increase the challenge, a Bomb Cat will occasionally appear... to activate this kitty’s ability, it needs to touch the Flamey Cat. That’s when the explosion’s countdown starts!

Depending on the circumstances, the blast can help you match smaller cats, as they will jump around the box, or end your game, as the cats can pop out of the open parcel and fly into space. Just like typical cats.


BE A COMBO HERO
Take the challenge of making your score furry freaking best. The more cats you match, the bigger your combo, which translates to more points.

Placing the cats strategically will help you maximize your score.

Unlock new board with Summer Background DLC included in this bundle.

KEY FEATURES:
– Eleven colorful cats to match like in classic 2048
– Possibility of sending cats to the Moon and back
– One special cat – Cat Bomb to make the game more challenging
– Combo mechanic to make your score even better
– Easy controlling, but challenging gameplay (sometimes)
– Endless and addictive fun
– Enjoyable music, which you can always turn off
– Once again... CATS (No regrets, cats are superior to other animals; deal with it already)
70070000022664.intro: Match ultra-fluffy cats to achieve the highest score and unleash chaos with Bomb Cat.
70070000022664.name: Bomb Cat Extended Edition

	•	Diverse Truck Fleet: Choose from a variety of detailed trucks, each with unique handling.
	•	Open World: Explore a vast, realistic map inspired by American landscapes.
	•	Varied Missions: Complete diverse tasks to test and hone your driving skills.
	•	Truck Upgrades: Improve your truck with powerful engines, advanced transmissions, and more.
	•	Business Management: Expand your trucking empire by investing wisely.

This bundle offers the perfect combination for fans of off-road racing and long-haul trucking, providing a comprehensive and immersive simulation experience.

HENTAI IS ART

INCREASING DIFFICULTY

The gameplay mechanics are simple yet challenging – increasing difficulty as you progress. Their lovely outfit might distract you... so maybe help them get rid of it? Every success on your part will make them happier.

Meet your new golf buddies, grab a club, and embark on a hilariously absurd golfing journey through the most ridiculous places.


SWAP BALLS FOR BANANAS, TEE OFF AND LET THE CRAZINESS BEGIN!
In Uzzuzzu’s universe, everything can be a golf ball. Sausage, egg, tuna – everything you can think of… Check with Boo what other surprises are waiting for you, and be aware of the item shape, because every “golf ball” bounces differently.


MORE THAN AN ORDINARY GOLF ROUND
You won’t experience only casual levels in this game. Running away from enormous basketball or defending your friends from danger as a hot dog. Not to mention traps on your way like falling crates, moving knives or even bursts of pressure.


GO WITH THE FLOW
After you complete a certain amount of levels, you will earn a badge. It allows you to track your progress, and make a step forward into collecting all the trophies! Kung will be proud if you can make your collection extra shiny.

BUNDLE INCLUDES "Extra Mission Pack" !

As a skilled motorcyclist, you'll navigate through abandoned warehouses to recover stolen loot from a bank heist. Using abandoned warehouses as your playground, dodge obstacles and race against the clock to collect as much loot as possible.
Compete with friends in two-player mode to see who can become the ultimate loot hunter.
With thrilling gameplay, challenging levels and the excitement of the chase, this game is perfect for anyone looking for a heart-pumping challenge.

Get ready to embark on an action-packed journey and become the ultimate loot hunter!
