70070000023373.name: Tokyo Cooking Special Edition

70070000023379.description:
Dive into a charming world full of cards and girls with Hentai Solitaire. Play the most iconic card game and practice your skills all along. Switch between cards, think about your next move and try to organize your deck from ace to king.


ONE DECK TWO MODES
Test yourself in two available modes: Standard and Tripeaks Solitaire. Try out both of them and check if you manage to complete them with no trouble. If you feel like you are stuck you can always go back or ask for a little help to receive a small hint.


CUSTOMIZE YOUR CARDS
At any point of the game you can change the appearance of your deck. Simply choose one out of the ten amazing girls waiting for you and enjoy your new cover.

Unlock new covers for your deck with Cards Pack 2 DLC included in this bundle.

KEY FEATURES:
- Each playthrough is a new challenge
- 2 game modes: Standard and Tripeaks Solitaire
- 10 stunning girls on covers
- Relaxing soundtrack
70070000023379.intro: Pull an ace out of your pocket and check what challenges await you!
70070000023379.name: Hentai Solitaire Ultimate Edition

70070000023384.description:
Embark on a romantic adventure across the colorful landscapes of Rio de Janeiro in Hentai Dating Stories: Brazil. Play as Touji Ishikawa, a young heir to a prestigious family business in Japan, as he ventures into the vibrant streets of Rio de Janeiro in search of true love.

In this visual novel with puzzle mechanics, immerse yourself in Touji's quest to break free from the expectations of his family and discover his path in life.

Meet Tainara Alves, a spirited Brazilian beauty whose passion for dance and zest for life will ignite a spark within Touji's heart. Explore the bustling streets of Rio de Janeiro, from the dazzling lights of Carnival to the tranquil shores of Copacabana Beach, as you uncover the secrets of Tainara's world.

But the path to true love is never easy, and Touji and Tainara will face their fair share of challenges along the way. Join them as they unravel mysteries and solve puzzles to see what’s waiting for you next.

Relive your favorite moments from Brazil with Best Stories 3 DLC included in this bundle.

KEY FEATURES:
– Pocket love story
– Over 19 puzzles to solve along the way – the difficulty level rises going forward
– Beautiful anime-style characters
– Not the last Touji journey
70070000023384.intro: Travel to Rio de Janeiro with Touji to meet his date – Tainara. Solve puzzles to unlock the story and discover what outcome awaits.
70070000023384.name: Hentai Dating Stories: Brazil Extended Edition

70070000023389.description:
Head to the golf course after a hard day at work, and meet three stunning business women: Yumiko, Narumi, Misa and show them how to become a master of the golf field.


SHOW THEM HOW TO DO IT
Pick one of the available golf clubs, choose the direction, feel the wind and swing! Every single factor matters and can decide on your score. Prepare your tactic, check the surroundings and impress girls with your skills.


DON’T DISTRACT YOURSELF
Girls will watch your every move and as you hit more holes they will feel more comfortable around you. Hopefully it won’t make you lose your focus even for a second. Admire their suits and spend more time with them later in the game menu.


AUTHENTIC MECHANICS
As every professional, you should use all the information given in order to become a good teacher. Check the direction of wind and its speed. Choose the correct golf club for the situation. Plan your route using minimap and many more!

Remember to avoid tanks of water and use sand piles to stop your ball if necessary.

Get access to the new golf courses and check girls' stunning outfits with Prairie Greens, River's Edge and Lakeside Fairways DLCs included in this bundle.

KEY FEATURES:
- Three amazing girls that will cheer you up after hard day at work
- Classical golf gameplay
- 40 maps with unique layouts
- Energetic soundtrack
70070000023389.intro: Experience the best date ever and become champion in golf with little help from beautiful girls!
70070000023389.name: Hentai Golf GOTY Edition

70070000023390.description:
nZen will help you on your journey to finding yourself and understanding the world around you. Begin your contemplation, clear your mind, and let nZen guide you through the unexplored areas of your mind.


IDENTIFY YOUR GOAL
Select one of the available inspirational programs prepared for various occasions. During each of them, you will be able to focus on a voice that will help you achieve your goal. Focusing on the energy flowing through your body or stimulating your creativity are just two examples of how nZen can help you.


CALMING SOUNDS
During your sessions, you can switch between two available background noises that will help you relax. A harmonious melody or the sounds of waves breaking against the shore. Choose the one that soothes you more and drift away into the depths of your mind.

Find you inner peace with additional Life Purpose Reflection and Practice On Concentration DLCs.

KEY FEATURES:
- 5 different inspirational programs
- Calming background sounds
- Motivational quotes that will help you achieve your goal
70070000023390.intro: Find your inner peace by relaxing with nZen.
70070000023390.name: nZen Definitive Edition

70070000023395.description:
A new reign of Khaos unfolds in Liu Kang's Era. This pack includes a new Story Expansion + 6 New Fighters

3 MK Fighters Available at Launch
3 Guest Fighters Available Post-Launch
70070000023395.name: Mortal Kombat™ 1: Khaos Reigns Expansion

70070000023396.description:
Level-up your Mortal Kombat 1 Base Game Experience and finish the fight through Havik's Reign of Khaos.

The Bundle includes access to the upcoming Story Expansion, 6 New Fighters (3 MK Fighters available at launch, 3 Guest Fighters available post-launch) and instant access to the Kombat Pack.

Kombat Pack Fighters (Available Now):
Omni-Man (Invincible)
Quan Chi
Peacemaker (DC’s Peacemaker)
Ermac
Homelander (The Boys)
Takahashi Takeda

Kameo Fighters:
Tremor
Khameleon
Janet Cage
Mavado
Ferra

Jean-Claude Van Damme Skin for Johnny Cage
70070000023396.name: Mortal Kombat™ 1: Khaos Reigns Bundle

70070000023418.description:
Experience the ultimate drifting thrill with Drift Legacy!
Choose and customize your dream car, from its performance to its appearance, making it truly yours. Tackle a variety of routes, from the industrial atmosphere of bustling docks to high-speed racetracks. With intuitive controls, stunning visuals, and the freedom to modify your ride, the game invites you to carve your path to victory.

Are you ready to leave your mark on the racing world?

★ THE LEGACY BEGINS ON THE TRACK ★

BUNDLE INCLUDES "Racetrack of Champions" !
70070000023418.intro: Epic Drifts, Legendary Roads: Your Journey Begins Now!
70070000023418.name: Drift Legacy Extended Edition

70070000023429.description:
Edition includes*:
•	LEGO® Horizon Adventures™
•	Roller Coaster Customization
•	Banuk Armor outfit
•	Shadow Stalwart outfit
•	“Alloy” Aloy outfit
•	Ratchet outfit
•	Rivet outfit
•	Sackboy outfit

Journey to a distant future, where the land is made of LEGO bricks and lush nature has reclaimed the Earth. Meet the Nora tribe who live in the settlement of Mother’s Heart, and catch your first glimpse of the incredible dinosaur-like machines that roam the forests, mountains, and deserts that stretch beyond the village walls...

The LEGO adventure of a lifetime
Join hunter Aloy as she battles to save Earth from an ancient digital demon, and a gang of sunworshippers who want to live in a world without shade so they can soak up the rays while everything burns.

Play alone or with friends
Hunt machines on your own as Aloy, or unlock colourful heroes Varl, Teersa, and Erend, and use their unique skills to defeat enemies and overcome challenges. Share the fun with another player online, or via innovative couch co-op on a single screen, so you’re always in the same world together.

Customize your home and your characters
Give the village of Mother’s Heart a unique makeover, decorating it in delightful ways to unlock unique LEGO buildings and ornaments. You can even dish out hilarious outfits for your friends to wear!

For LEGO and Horizon fans new and old
Uncover secrets from Aloy’s mysterious past as you explore stunning LEGO locations inspired by the world of Horizon, including thriving forests and soaring mountains. Delve deep into the underground Cauldrons or climb the iconic Tallnecks – all beautifully recreated in LEGO bricks.

Need an extra challenge? Replay levels that change to test your skills and unlock new surprises, or check the Mother's Heart Community Board for ways to help the village. See if you've got what it takes to ace every aspect of the game!
70070000023429.name: LEGO® Horizon Adventures™ Digital Deluxe Edition

70070000023458.description:
Take on a series of epic battles against powerful bosses. Unlock new abilities and power-ups and become the ultimate warrior. Dodge a barrage of laser beams, and explosions and make sure YOU are the last one standing.

With its vibrant graphics, pulse-pounding soundtrack, and intuitive controls, Mixx Island Remix is a game that's easy to pick up but hard to put down.

Whether you're a seasoned gamer or a newcomer to the world of side-scrolling games, you'll find plenty to love in this thrilling adventure.

In this bundle, in addition to the main game, you will get access to Winter, Spring and Vol. 2 Islands.

Key Features:

- 2D World
- High-action gameplay
- Rewarding gameplay loop
- Cute characters
- Astounding soundtrack
- Anime style aesthetic
70070000023458.intro: Mixx Island Remix Plus is a high-energy, action-packed shooter set in a fantastic 2D world. Gather your wits, sharpen your reflexes, and prepare for the ultimate challenge.
70070000023458.name: Mixx Island: Remix Plus Ultra Definitive

70070000023460.description:
Meet your new golf buddies, grab a club, and embark on a hilariously absurd golfing journey through the most ridiculous places.


SWAP BALLS FOR BANANAS, TEE OFF AND LET THE CRAZINESS BEGIN!
In Uzzuzzu’s universe, everything can be a golf ball. Sausage, egg, tuna – everything you can think of… Check with Boo what other surprises are waiting for you, and be aware of the item shape, because every “golf ball” bounces differently.


MORE THAN AN ORDINARY GOLF ROUND
You won’t experience only casual levels in this game. Running away from enormous basketball or defending your friends from danger as a hot dog. Not to mention traps on your way like falling crates, moving knives or even bursts of pressure.


GO WITH THE FLOW
After you complete a certain amount of levels, you will earn a badge. It allows you to track your progress, and make a step forward into collecting all the trophies! Kung will be proud if you can make your collection extra shiny.

Test your skills in Kung's, Boo's and Ta's Challenge DLCs added to this bundle.

KEY FEATURES:
- 4 well-known, adorable characters like Tary or Ta
- Over 70 challenging levels to beat
- 60 FPS on Nintendo Switch™ console
- Funky and twirky soundtrack
- Lots of humor and funny scenarios
70070000023460.intro: Swing into action and tee off on the craziest golf course ever with Uzzuzzu pack!
70070000023460.name: Uzzuzzu My Pet - Golf Dash Happy Edition

70070000023462.description:
Use your head and arrange colored liquids to solve unique puzzles!

Master the art of water sorting and rise to the top as a champion! Strategically move the water until every color is separated, proving your puzzle-solving prowess!

Features:
- face over 5000 levels! (you get 2500 new levels in Classic Mode)
- play in three game modes: classic, timed, and hard
- face off against a friend in local multiplayer mode!
- give your brain an excellent workout
- use 70 additional powerups right away: hints, undo, and extra tubes
- get 9 new tubes and 5 new caps
- get 4 new wallpapers
- collect keys and open prize chests
- get 75000 coins and spend them on new tubes, wallpapers, caps, and powerups!

Immerse yourself in the challenge of sorting water into tubes with the same colored liquid on top. Remember, the tubes can't be full for the water to go in. Plan your moves carefully to avoid losing!

Complete thousands of levels in 3 different modes:
• Classic - a standard mode where you can relax
• Timed - move fast and complete the level within the time limit
• Hard - think about your every move, because you have a limited number of them

Enjoy this colorful brain challenge by yourself or against your friend!
70070000023462.intro: It's time to show how smart you are! Test your puzzle-solving skills in this water sorting game!
70070000023462.name: Color Water Sort: Relax Edition

70070000023469.description: This is a special set of all four titles in the sixth additional puzzle pack for "Jigsaw Masterpieces 2".
70070000023469.name: Additional Puzzle Pack Set Vol.6

70070000023471.description:
Stack all kinds of mouth-watering baked goods, from croissants to cookie hearts and everything in between!

Grab your spatula, lift the baked goods out of the oven, and put them on display so that customers can buy them! With a steady stream of hungry customers waiting in line, it's up to you to deliver their orders quickly and efficiently!

Features:
- Bake over 30 different pastries that your customers won't resist!
- Collect baked goods with a spatula and put them on the display to sell them!
- Operate the cash register and satisfy your customers' appetites!
- Use your diamonds to unlock 32 new adorable and speedy pets that will help you travel faster than ever before!
- Earn tons of money to unlock new levels of your bakery!
- Hire staff to help you collect the baked goods much faster!
- Upgrade your character and workers to walk faster or carry more pastries!
- Perform baker's tasks and claim your rewards
- Prepare baked goods for special large orders!
- Feed your cookie monsters to get money each second
- Use the teleport to move faster between levels
- Get caught up in the cooking fever and try not to get hungry!

Satisfy your customers and earn money that you can spend to hire additional staff and expand your bakery! Unlock new recipes and serve even more delicious pastries!

Need a helping hand? Invite your friend to play in local co-op mode and expand your bakery to the next level! Grab your aprons and get ready to bake up a storm in Baking Time together!

So what are you waiting for? Keep those ovens hot and bake on!
70070000023471.intro: Satisfy your cooking fever and love for pastries with the help of new fast animals!
70070000023471.name: Baking Time: Fast Edition

70070000023477.description:
Put on those cowgirl boots, style your new horse, and start racing like a champ!

You were looking forward to chilling this summer in NYC, but your plans have changed. You're sent to middle-of-nowhere Kentucky to spend the summer with your grandma on a star-stable horse farm.

Soon, you realize that this summer adventure holds untold potential! The horse farm becomes your heaven, and with each passing day, you grow closer to your loyal companion - a graceful horse with whom you'll weave your own unique horse-riding tale!

Features:
- Meet the new horse - Shadow. Choose which horse out of 3 will become your best friend!
- Make the most of the horse story summer - become a horse racing champ!
- Train every day with your horse till you're ready to compete in international horse races
- Compete in exciting horse story racing competitions around the world! - Wow the crowd with your amazing jumps!
- Dress up like a champion in 70 various clothes and change your hairstyles!
- Take good care of your horse: feed, groom, and dress him with 70 accessories!
- Spend an additional 250 gems to buy clothes, energy, missing items for building improvements, and more!
- Do farm chores. Too lazy? Too bad! Grams won't let you off easy. Upgrade your horse-story farm and build new facilities.
- Climb the leaderboard and make your family proud!

To rise above the competition and conquer the racetracks, you must train tirelessly, immersing yourself in the art of horsemanship. Your dedication will bring you face-to-face with rival stars and formidable opponents who will test your skills and determination. You and your horse will form an unbreakable bond through intense training sessions, setting the stage for legendary horse-riding tales that will be whispered for years to come!

But it's not all about intense races and fierce rival stars. In the tranquil moments between training, you'll find solace in the stars' stable horses - majestic creatures that inspire awe and joyfully fill your heart. Take the time to nurture and care for them because their well-being is crucial to your success. Pamper them with love, groom their silky manes, and dress them in dazzling saddles that reflect their extraordinary beauty.

Boost your potential by partnering with Shadow and win competitions with confidence, while looking like a true champion!
70070000023477.intro: Make unforgettable memories with new horse Shadow and experience the beauty of the countryside like never before!
70070000023477.name: My Horse Stories: Classy Edition

70070000023483.description:
Welcome to Parking Masters, where you'll face the ultimate test of your parking skills across a vast array of challenges! Maneuver cars, trucks, buses, and vehicles with trailers through numerous levels, all designed with realistic physics and a captivating visual style.

This package includes:
- Parking Masters
- Parking Masters - Big Rig DLC
- Parking Masters - Bus Driver DLC

With the addition of 2 DLCs, take on 100 additional levels that push your precision to the limit as you maneuver large vehicles with finesse and control.

Parking Masters Deluxe Edition offers a realistic and rewarding experience for all parking enthusiasts. Are you ready to prove your mastery and become parking champion?
70070000023483.name: Parking Masters Deluxe Edition

70070000023491.description:
Hentai Academy opens the door to a school full of delinquents – teens who need help with getting a headstart in life. Kenji, whose shoes you’ll step into, is passionate about giving them a second chance. Besides lectures and school trips, you will soon find yourself entangled in the matters of the heart of a fellow teacher.


IN SEARCH OF PASSION
You started a new life in a new place! The headmaster wants you to be comfortable so he introduces you to your guide - Camille - a beautiful young woman who teaches art. After a day well-spent together…


FIND LOVE WHERE IT IS LEAST EXPECTED
…you start getting closer. Where will this relationship go? What obstacles will stand in your way? Will you help the troubles of the heart just like you help the troubled teens?

Revisit your favorite moments with the Academic Stories 1 DLC included in this bundle.

KEY FEATURES:
- A story of true love full of passion and spark between the characters
- Puzzles to solve along the way with increasing difficulty
- Iconic and colorful locations
70070000023491.intro: As a professor in a school for troubled teens you’ll have one goal - to teach, but what will you do when a troubled heart comes your way?
70070000023491.name: Hentai Academy Deluxe Edition

70070000023495.description:
Racers, beware!

Fast-paced, polished and dynamic motorbike racing now on Nintendo Switch™!

One of a kind game entirely playable with any control method including... Toy-Con™ Motorbike! (Nintendo Labo™ Toy-Con 01: Variety Kit)

Forget about speed limits and the rules of the road! Here, you are in charge!

A unique mix of endless and arcade racing game featuring countless hours of fun!

MOTO RUSH GT FEATURES:

• Over 100 levels to beat!
• Endless racing experience
• 12 customizable motorbikes
• Toy-Con™ Motorbike support – break out your LABO if you have it!
• Race against time, ghost opponents or try various challenges!
• Tilt support – play by rotating your console!
• Play with Nintendo Switch™ Pro Controller, or any other control method!
• Support all play styles - TV, Tabletop, Handheld, Toy-Con Motorbike
• Experience 4 different game modes
• Weather and day-cycle effects: rain, night, storm!
• Experience beautifully designed roads from around the world

This bundle includes base game and Grip Collection #3 with:

• four pairs of state-of-the-art racing gloves, crafted for the ultimate grip and control. Outshine and outpace your rivals!

Check it out!
70070000023495.intro: Ultimate motorbike racing experience for all ages!
70070000023495.name: Moto Rush GT Style Edition

70070000023505.description:
Make your grandma proud in Tokyo Cooking! Run your own restaurant and prepare the most iconic Japanese dishes. Take orders from customers, prepare their meals with passion and listen to their opinions to become better and better with each passing day.


DO THE COOKING BY THE BOOK…
Your kitchen has all the necessary equipment and ingredients you will need to prepare the most delicious sushi. Follow and complete each step from your to-do list while choosing from many available kinds of fish, vegetables and spices and adding them depending on the client's wish.


…AND CUSTOMIZE TO YOUR HEART’S CONTENT
Earn money from the orders and customize the interior of your Japanese restaurant in Tokyo Cooking. At the end of each day, you will have access to your laptop, where you can browse through equipment you can purchase for your place. Enjoy new chairs, tables, plants and utensils.

Become a master of composing the perfect sushi. Be precise and use the exact amount of ingredients such as soy sauce or rice. Complete mini-games to receive extra money as a bonus for your order.

Decorate your restaurant with the Cherry Blossom and Oceanic Fish Sets DLC included in this bundle.

KEY FEATURES:
- You can learn to make your own sushi!
- A total of 32 unique ingredients like fish, vegetables that NEVER run out
- Step-by-step recipes
- Interesting customers
- Day/night system and access to laptop after work
- 6 unique sushi recipes like Hosomaki or Uramaki and relaxing tea
70070000023505.intro: Run the best sushi restaurant in the city, talk to customers and learn new recipes.
70070000023505.name: Tokyo Cooking Premium Edition

70070000023521.description:
Sam is a six-foot canine detective with a nose for justice. Max is a hyperkinetic rabbity-thing with a taste for mayhem. Together, they’re the Freelance Police—an irreverent comedy duo whose esoteric crime-fighting style has been entertaining comic book and video game fans for more than thirty five years.

In 2006–2010, Sam & Max starred in a series of episodic adventures created by Telltale Games. Now you can play their first three seasons (Sixteen episodes altogether!) in these remastered versions, which have been lovingly updated with gorgeous HD graphics, overhauled lighting and lip-sync, finessed cinematography, remastered audio, and several all-new musical tracks featuring live jazz musicians.

SAM & MAX SAVE THE WORLD
It's just another day at the office when the Commissioner calls in with a disturbing report: former child stars are running amok in the street!

What starts as an open-and-shut case of idiotic vandalism balloons into an all-out conspiracy as Sam & Max encounter one miscreant after another who have been mysteriously hypnotized. (You can tell from the "spinny thing" they do with their eyes.)

Who's the source of this malfeasance, and what is their dastardly plan? Cracking this case will require Sam's nose for detective work, Max's lack of conscience, an assortment of inventory items, and a little help from neighbors Sybil Pandemik, Bosco, and Jimmy Two-Teeth. From Sam & Max's street to the White House lawn, inside the internet, and all the way to the moon, this baffling mystery gets weirder and funnier as it unfolds.

SAM & MAX: BEYOND TIME AND SPACE
The Freelance Police are back on the crime beat in a showdown with Santa Claus, a race to subdue a giant volcano, and a face-off with a Eurotrash vampire… and then things get even weirder.

Is paranoid shopkeeper Bosco on to something with his talk of a grand conspiracy? Is diner proprietress Stinky hiding the truth about what happened to her grandfather (also named Stinky)? Will flaky neighbor Sybil Pandemik ever find true love? Did someone say… BIRTHDAY?!

Zombies will dance. Mariachis will sing. A giant battle robot will trash the streets. And when their friends’ lives are on the line, Sam & Max will risk their very souls to set things right.

SAM & MAX: THE DEVIL’S PLAYHOUSE
Max has always been the more unhinged member of the Freelance Police—a lovable lunatic with a knack for spreading chaos wherever he goes. But recently his abilities have taken a supernatural turn.

It all started when he stumbled upon a mysterious toy that allows him to glimpse the future. Now Sam & Max have aroused the attention of a host of villains from across the galaxy who are hellbent on acquiring the magical Toys of Power to achieve their own ends.

As those who seek the Devil’s Toybox close in and Max’s psychic abilities grow beyond his control, the Freelance Police will come up against their most frightening adversary yet: the power of Max’s mind.
70070000023521.intro: What's better than one Sam & Max season? Three Sam & Max seasons!
70070000023521.name: Sam & Max: The Complete Trilogy

70070000023525.description:
Your adventure begins with Food Truck Tycoon. Cook, chop, bake and enjoy hundreds of unique dishes.

But the journey of a thousand dishes is just the beginning!

As you hone your cooking skills and build your reputation with food trucks, you'll be given the opportunity to explore more gourmet games as DLC.

Customize your kitchen with countless upgrades and serve delicious food in different locations. Keep the grill hot, keep your customers smiling, sauté, mix and serve to the top.

Face cooking challenges to become the ultimate chef in town!

So put on your apron, sharpen your knives and enter the cooking arena. Life is a party - let's cook delicious!

This bundle contains "Food Truck Tycoon" and "Sweet Bakery Tycoon".
70070000023525.intro: Universe bursting with flavors and culinary adventures awaits!
70070000023525.name: Cooking Arena Pastry Chef

70070000023531.description:
Natsu-Mon: 20th Century Summer Kid DLC Bundle includes the main game and DLC.

Natsu-Mon: 20th Century Summer Kid
A circus troupe comes to Yomogi Town, a rural town in Japan situated between mountains and the ocean. As the son of the circus ringmaster, enjoy a special summer filled with adventures!

All of Yomogi Town and the nature surrounding it are an open world where you can enjoy summer to its fullest. Immerse yourself in nostalgic scenery filled with towering clouds, beautiful sunsets, and the sound of cicadas.

Summer days are always filled with activities like fishing at the river or catching rare bugs in a field. Help the circus succeed and interact with the townspeople if you'd like. Enjoy a night at the summer festival, dancing and watching fireworks. There's even a train so you can visit a neighboring town.

Your own special summer vacation filled with unique experiences awaits you on Nintendo Switch™!

DLC: Broadcast Over Sunset
■ New area "Sunset Island"
Set sail with the kids of the Trumpet Forest Detective Agency to uncover the secrets of Sunset Island, a mysterious island off the shore of Yomogi Town. 30 new fish and bug species have been added, as well as a dungeon with new mechanics.

■ New character "Tobiyama-san" and new events
Tobiyama-san, a member of the circus troupe, arrives in Yomogi Town. The new story revolves around a small radio station run by her and DJ Tei-kiatsu. New events and interactions have been added for the people of Yomogi Town as well.

*This is a bundle that includes the main game and DLC. Please be mindful of duplicate purchases.
70070000023531.intro: Explore the wonder of the Japanese countryside!
70070000023531.name: Natsu-Mon: 20th Century Summer Kid Sunset Bundle

70070000023554.description:
Experience high-octane racing with our Bundle Street Drag Racing Car Driving Simulator 2022 and the Millionaire's Boost DLC! Street Drag Racing Bundle offers an adrenaline-fueled 3D racing experience where you build, race, and tune your car to perfection. Compete in challenging races, upgrade your engine, and customize your ride with colorful paints and stickers. Enjoy realistic sounds, HD graphics, and online multiplayer mode.
          This bundle is composed of our main game + DLC which gives you 1,000,000 coins to unlock top-tier vehicles, exclusive parts, and dominate every race. Transform your racing experience and prove you’re the ultimate drag racer. Are you ready to become the king of the streets with Street Drag Racing Car Driving Simulator - Premium Edition? The challenge awaits!
70070000023554.intro: Your racing empire begins here, with our premium bundle, which comes with a bonus, our new DLC millionaire's boost!
70070000023554.name: Street Drag Racing Car Driving Simulator - Premium Edition

70070000023562.description:
The Digital Deluxe Edition includes:
• That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime ISEKAI Chronicles main game
• Bonus Side Quest Collection: Shopping
• Season Pass
- DLC 1: A Strange Fate
- DLC 2
- DLC 3
- Season Pass Bonus Content: Bonus Side Quest Collection: Remembering Shizu

Spin a new tale of the Jura Tempest Federation together with all your favorite characters from the animated series!

• Action-Packed Battles with Exhilarating Combo Attacks
Players can enjoy thrilling action battles that combine flashy special moves and powerful combos. Through leveling up bonds with friends, Rimuru will learn Special Attacks, and even have allies join in to back up Rimuru’s attack. Finish off formidable enemies that are coming to destroy Tempest with Secret Skills animated in retro 8-bit style!

• Experience Stories from the Anime, as well as All-New Adventures
Relive the original story from the encounter with the Kijin to the battle against the Kingdom of Falmuth fully voiced! In addition, there are two brand new adventures from the original author for fans to enjoy!

Goblin's Revenge Arc:
Kataki is a Bugbear who lost his friends in an attack by the Direwolves. The story of his revenge begins when he discovers that his former enemies and the Hobgoblins coexist in Tempest.

Religious Nation Arc:
The Theocracy of Angels is a mysterious religious nation that believes in angels. Aiming to take the power of the Storm Dragon, they face off with Tempest.

• Exciting City-Building
As players progress through the story and meet new allies, their community will grow from a small village to a great nation. Build a wide variety of buildings to take advantage of the Tempest Resonance which strengthens residents as you create more structures in your village! There are even modern Japanese-style buildings that make use of Rimuru's memory from the world before his reincarnation.

There are also more than 50 original subquests to enjoy! Enjoy the daily life in Tempest with laughter and tears as Rimuru and his friends work together to solve residents' problems and make the country a better place.

*This edition comes with content which is also sold separately. Please be mindful of duplicate purchases.
*DLC 1, 2, and 3 will be released after the main game, by December 31st 2024. Content of each DLC will be announced at a later date.
*Main game must be cleared before DLC or Bonus Content can be accessed.
*Contents and specifications are subject to change at any time.
70070000023562.name: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime ISEKAI Chronicles Digital Deluxe Edition

70070000023563.name: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime ISEKAI Chronicles - Season Pass

70070000023565.description:
Imagine a cardboard box. Is it shaped to fit one to two fluffy felines? What about five? What about twenty?

Fit My Cat presents you with many cute kitties that all wish to sit where they deem fit. That being said, we're running out of space and we are seriously looking for a cat organizer. If you could spare a moment or two to make that happen we would be grateful.

Every single one of them is trained and well-equipped for some spatial management – pick them up and rotate them as you see fit.

Just so you're aware, some boxes might come with yarn balls or entire cathouses – but that will not prevent those spunky kitties from trying to get inside.

Test your skills and show the world that herding cats is where fun begins!

Decorate your board with New Floor Pack included in this bundle.

KEY FEATURES
- Over 90 pawesome levels of cardboard boxes, ready to be filled with fluff
- Tons of purrfect cats of varying shapes, colors, and sizes
- Meowtastic soundtrack
70070000023565.intro: Purrfect cat organizer – fit them all
70070000023565.name: Fit My Cat Legendary Edition

70070000023568.description:
Cat Quest: The Fur-tastic Trilogy contains three meow-nificent catventures in the Cat Quest Universe: Cat Quest, Cat Quest II, and Cat Quest III!

Cat Quest's loot-fuelled cat-venture is as beautifully crafted, as its combat and magic are ultra-satisfying. Universally adored by critics - it'll have you purring for joy! Leap into a grand adventure in purrsuit of the evil Drakoth and your catnapped sister! Explore Felingard's huge overworld map, risk life and limb delving into dungeons for epic loot, and lend a paw to a furry cast of characters in a flurry of side quests.

CAT QUEST II lets you play solo or with a friend, as both a cat and dog! Quest in a world filled with magic, defeat monsters and collect loot in a catventure like never before! Under threat from a continuing war between the cats of Felingard and the advancing dogs of the Lupus Empire, CAT QUEST II tells the tail of two kings, brought together against their will, on a journey of paw-some discovery to reclaim their thrones

In Cat Quest III you play as a purrivateer in a freely explorable 2.5D open-world swarming with Pi-rats. You can sail the seas in your ship for treasures galore! But prepare for peril, as the Pirate King aims to hunt you down… Play as a swashbuckling purrivateer in this 2.5D open-world action RPG set in a fantastical pirate-themed world – the Purribean - an archipelago swarming with Pi-rats searching for the North Star - a long-lost mythical treasure. Alongside your trusty spirit companion, set sail through the Purribean in your very own ship! But beware, the seas are dangerous, and a meow-tiny is nigh as the hordes of Pi-rats under the order of the Pirate King hunt you down…
70070000023568.intro: Cat Quest: The Fur-tastic Trilogy contains three meow-nificent catventures!
70070000023568.name: Cat Quest: The Fur-tastic Trilogy

70070000023574.description:
Inspired by the classics, developed for the modern audiences.

A classic revenge story set in a medieval fantasy world… with a touch of deadly modern firepower just to turn things up to eleven. Fight through the armies of undead, mutants, aliens, machines and beasts in order to get back what is rightfully yours and bring some semblance of peace back to the land. Who knows - if you’re thorough enough you might even discover the history of the kingdom itself, long lost to the scholars of the realm.

Knights & Guns brings you to a dangerous world where you will fight, alongside your friend, against demons, ghouls & ghosts. Use shotguns, lasers and the power of chivalry to overcome every obstacle. Become the best version of a knight - one with a gun.

Inside the game:
•	Fight awesome bosses on various stages!
•	Conquer the non-linear world! Rush through over 150 hand crafted stages, or enjoy the game at your own pace, looking for secrets and special routes!
•	Entire game designed for both single player or co-op multiplayer. Invite a friend at any time for some extra firepower and mayhem.
•	60 fps gameplay! Try the different modes! Hunt the monsters! Survive! Play on small, big and narrow maps!
•	Check out all the awesome suits of armor and, of course, all the GUNS! Lasers, shotguns, grenade launchers, sniper rifles... They are all here!
•	Over 30 unique guns. (That’s probably more flavors of death than flavors of ice cream you can name.)
•	Over 25 types of enemies, 5 types of mini-bosses and 3 types of bosses. Most of these come in different colors, too.
•	30 unique suits of armor for the knights. Extra protection and extra style!
•	Traps, chests, keys, scrolls of lore, books of monsters...

This bundle includes base game and Armor Pack #3 with:
- 2 new armors to help you on your quest
70070000023574.intro: Knight in shining armor, fight your way... with Guns!
70070000023574.name: Knights & Guns Summer Edition

70070000023575.description:
Train Traffic Manager isn't your grandpa's model railway set. Think fast, plan faster, and keep those trains from turning into flaming metal confetti. In this strategy-puzzle game, you're in charge of everything from switches and signals to drawbridges and, oh yeah, preventing cataclysmic train disasters.

Take on over 80 levels across diverse environments that range from sunny desertscapes to mysterious midnight scenes. It's more fun than a cactus in your caboose!

Each environment has its own unique challenges. Deserts have meteor showers (because of course they do), forests have fallen trees (what's a forest without a little lumber?), winters bring the freeze to your switches, and at midnight, well, you'll just have to see.

And if the chaos of normal mode gets too much, take a breather in endless mode. No objectives, just you, the tracks, and an infinite number of trains. It's the zen garden of train management!

Ready to dive into the madness? Take control of the tracks and show that chaos who's boss in Train Traffic Manager.

And remember: don't fall asleep at your post!

This bundle includes base game, expansion pack #1 (Subterranean Switch-Up) and expansion pack #3 (Fleet Upgrade - Jet & Circus) with:

- 10 brand new underground maps that challenge you to navigate the dimly lit and intricate tunnels.

- 2 new skins - Jet & Circus.
70070000023575.intro: All Aboard the Chaos & Strategy Express!
70070000023575.name: Train Traffic Manager Platinum Edition

70070000023591.description:
Choose your favorite skin, eat, grow and stay alive!
Compete in multiplayer mode with up to 4 players or eat it all by yourself.

Features:
- 7 maps with different things to swallow
- 20 animated skins to make your black hole look cooler
- 2 multiplayer modes up to 4 players on one screen!
- endless mode where you swallow things falling from the sky
- powerups spawning  during the game
- collecting themed stickers
- easy controls so anyone can play
- simple rules and lots of fun!

Grow by swallowing everything in front of you, whether it be garbage cans, fire hydrants or cars. Get large enough to consume even bigger objects or other players. Eat until nothing and no one is standing in your way!
70070000023591.intro: Show who is the biggest black hole in the universe!
70070000023591.name: Hole io: Godlike Edition

70070000023598.description:
Enjoy the cozy puzzle game A Little to the Left with everything in one place! This bundle includes the A Little to the Left base game with two premium DLC packs, Cupboards & Drawers and Seeing Stars.

A Little to the Left
Sort, stack, and organize household objects into just the right spot in A Little to the Left, a tidy puzzle game with a mischievous cat who likes to shake things up!

Featuring charming illustrations and surprising scenarios, A Little to the Left is satisfying and curious with over 100 delightful puzzles to discover. Keep your eye out for a mischievous cat who has an inclination for chaos!

A Little to the Left: Cupboards & Drawers
Prepare to clean out the cabinets and secret compartments of the home with even more charming illustrations, surprising scenarios, and 25 delightful new Cupboards & Drawers themed puzzles to discover.

A Little to the Left: Seeing Stars
Collect up to 100 stars as you discover the logic behind a multitude of ways to tidy up the house. Fold, flap, crush, join, stick, bounce, stack, strum and lovingly smash your way through a huge variety of new interactive items. Enjoy a total of 38 new levels that are layered with both easy-to-find solutions, as well as more challenging puzzles. There are also some extra cute visitors who will make an appearance as well.
70070000023598.name: Extra Tidy Bundle

70070000023603.description:
Join millions of players and stumble to victory in this fun multiplayer knockout battle royale! Are you ready to enter the running chaos? Running, stumbling, falling, jumping, and winning has never been so fun!

The Stumble Guys Founder's Pack is only available until August 20th 2024. It includes:
Hi Sp33d P0rtia Mythic Stumbler
Oh Yeah Animation
2000 Gems

Explore the world of Stumble Guys with over 30 maps, levels and game modes that offer even more ways to play, and experience the fastest multiplayer knockout battle royale. Join the party and get ready to stumble, fall and win your way to victory.
70070000023603.name: Stumble Guys - Founder's Pack Bundle

70070000023605.description:
Secrets lie beneath the covers... avoid enemies and uncover pictures of beautiful girls posing exclusively for you.

Discovering the truth is never easy... the more tempting the secrets, the greater the challenges you'll face. Unravel all the mysteries to uncover what the girls are hiding, and prepare yourself for plenty of alluring photos along the way.

Features:
- Over 90 pictures of beautiful girls in enticing outfits to reveal
- Sensual music and sound effects
- Simple and engaging gameplay
- Easy and difficult levels
- A treat for your eyes
70070000023605.intro: Find all the hidden secrets of tempting anime girls.
70070000023605.name: Ecchi Secrets: Complete Edition

70070000023607.description:
Enjoy "those games" you've seen before and always wanted to try!
You can now get YEAH! YOU WANT "THOSE GAMES," RIGHT? SO HERE YOU GO! NOW, LET'S SEE YOU CLEAR THEM! 1 and 2 together in one bundle!

"Those Games" contains a total of 250 stages and 5 minigames: Pin Pull, Number Tower, Color Lab, Parking Lot, and Cash Run!
"Those Games 2" also contains 250 stages and 5 minigames: Knock-Back Shooter, Pin Pull 2, Draw & Guard, Numbers Dungeon, and Spellbinding Scroll!

Play your favorite minigames casually, or keep conquering higher difficulties for a greater challenge! Think you can get a 3★ rating on every stage?

Clearing all minigame stages in each title will unlock a Rank-Up Challenge, where you can compare your score and clear time to other players in monthly rankings.

You can also use the coins you earn in-game to win prizes from the Gotcha! machine. Get new titles and plates to customize your player nameplate! There are a total of 8,910,000 combinations in "Those Games" and 30,375,000 combinations in "Those Games 2" to choose from! Make something cool, or funny, or cute, and really express yourself!
Create your own Title Plate and show it off to the world when you compete in the monthly rankings!

This bundle contains YEAH! YOU WANT "THOSE GAMES," RIGHT? SO HERE YOU GO! NOW, LET'S SEE YOU CLEAR THEM! and YEAH! YOU WANT "THOSE GAMES," RIGHT? SO HERE YOU GO! NOW, LET'S SEE YOU CLEAR THEM! 2.
70070000023607.intro: This bundle, containing "Those Games" and "Those Games 2" is for you! Play Pin Pull, Number Tower, and more to your heart's content!
70070000023607.name: YEAH! YOU WANT "THOSE GAMES," RIGHT? SO HERE YOU GO! NOW, LET'S SEE YOU CLEAR THEM! 1+2

70070000023608.description:
Want all of the playable game modes? This bundle is for you!

Develop your skills, try to survive as much as you can and become the biggest snake. You start as a small snake, get bigger by eating other snakes who try to do the same. You have to attack wisely but defend skillfully. How long can you survive?

Attack fast with the mass-eject booster and get in front of other snakes to beat them when they hit you head on, no matter how small you are or how big they are. The best one wins.

Play against your friends as well! Snake.io introduces local multiplayer where you can compete with up to 3 other players on the same device for the highest score!

In the live event game mode, you'll need to complete a series of challenges in order to unlock each month's exclusive skins. Beware the boss snake as you try to complete these challenges, but with careful capture of the attack point you can take it down and claim its pellets for yourself! Make strategic use of super pellets to grant yourself a brief bout of invincibility and speed to assist you in taking down the formidable bosses!
Each monthly live event will contain the following features:
- 4 levels of increasingly difficult challenges
- 4 unlockable skins, themed around the monthly live event
- Roughly 25 days to complete all of the challenges each month!

Game Features:
- Grow fast to dominate the board with smooth gameplay
- No lag due to connectivity issues
- Supports handheld, docked, tabletop, and even touchscreen joystick controls
- Local Multiplayer with up to 4 players
- Access to unique live event game mode and real-time leaderboards

How to play:
- Cut in front of other snakes quickly to make them explode when they hit you head on
- Once you get them to hit you, eat them as fast as you can to gain more mass
- Eject mass to boost your speed with one button
- Try to beat the highest score based on your length during a session
- Internet connection is not needed, play wherever, you are offline or online

Are you a snake or a worm?
70070000023608.name: Snake.io + Live Event Pass

70070000023609.description:
Whether a champion or an amateur, all pool fans will find what they’re looking for in nPool. Whether it's 8ball, 9ball, or customizable tables – a champion will have what a champion needs.


A CLASSY CHALLENGE
nPool features single-player mode and friends mode, so you can choose to play versus AI or challenge your friends. With accurate rules, classy graphics, and transparent controls; winning is all you need to care about!


A FEAST FOR YOUR EYES AND YOUR SPIRIT
Customize the game’s background, pool table, and even the stick to make it a pleasurable experience for more than your competitive spirit.

Have even more fun by unlocking Snooker Mode DLC included in this bundle.

KEY FEATURES:
- Play vs a friend or vs AI
- Two base game modes – 8ball and 9ball
- Multiple customizable options for the background, table, and stick
70070000023609.intro: A classic game of pool on your Nintendo Switch™ – play with a friend or hone your skills vs an AI opponent.
70070000023609.name: nPool Deluxe Edition

70070000023629.description:
The DREDGE: Complete Edition Upgrade Bundle features:

The Iron Rig
The Iron Rig introduces a new constructible town to your DREDGE adventure. Uncover ancient disturbances and craft advanced equipment, items and gadgets with the help of new acquaintances. Progress always comes at a price.

The Pale Reach
Take your DREDGE adventure into unchartered territory. Explore icy waters that hide more than just fish, sell your discoveries, enhance your boat, and unravel a bitter betrayal, dredging up long-buried mysteries from this frozen land.

Blackstone Key
The mysterious workshop on Blackstone Isle is locked tight. Inside are otherworldly creations, products of cruel machinations by the previous occupants. Now they lie idle and abandoned. With this key you can put them to some use.
70070000023629.intro: The DREDGE: Complete Edition Upgrade Bundle nets together all three DLC packs for DREDGE, a critically acclaimed single-player fishing adventure game with a sinister undercurrent.
70070000023629.name: DREDGE - Complete Edition Upgrade Bundle

70070000023640.description:
With the Looney Tunes Wacky World of Sports - Deluxe Edition, you not only get the base game, but you also get to play as the rootinist, tootinist athlete North, South, East and West of the Pecos: Yosemite Sam!

Exclusive to the Deluxe Edition:

• Play as everyone's favorite hombre: Yosemite Sam!

• Add a new team uniform to your selection with The Golden Outlaws! Suit up and get out there, and you might even bring home the Ultimate Cup!

• Add some new Wild West themed sports equipment to your collection including a new basketball, soccer ball, tennis racket, and set of golf clubs. Great horny toads!

Base Game features:
• Compete in four iconic sports: 2v2 arcade basketball, 1v1 or 2v2 arcade Tennis, 4-player golf, and 3v3 arcade soccer.

• Play as nine iconic Looney Tunes characters, including Bugs Bunny, Lola Bunny, Daffy Duck, Porky Pig, Elmer Fudd, Sylvester, Taz, Wile E. Coyote and Road Runner!

• Play Your Way: Speed by with Road Runner, Lola Bunny, or Sylvester; overpower with brute force as Elmer Fudd, Porky Pig or Taz; or outwit your opponents with Wile E. Coyote , Daffy or Bugs Bunny.

• Play Against your Friends and Family In 4-player Local Co-Op.

• Experience the Looney Universe: play across iconic levels such as Galactic Outpost Delta, Porky’s Barn, Foghorn’s Farm, Road Runner’s Canyon, Whispering Woods, Martian Command Center, Granny’s House, and many more!

• Unleash the full arsenal of ACME and disrupt your opponents in the wackiest way possible, but watch out for falling anvils!
70070000023640.intro: Yeehaw! Enter the wild world of Sam!
70070000023640.name: Looney Tunes: Wacky World of Sports - Deluxe Edition

70070000023642.description:
Fashion is better together with your friends!

Become a stylist to the models, actresses and fashion girls! Play a mix of classic arcade games where you have to cut the picture in a new game aimed for children and adults alike.


- 80 levels!
- Hundreds of mix betweens costumes, backgrounds and items!
- Photo mode!
- Three stars system, giving the game replayability!
- Aimed at kids & adults alike!
- Become friends with Fashion!

This bundle includes base game and DLC#3 with additional levels that challenge your puzzle-solving skills and creativity.
Play more, try more, and elevate your style to new heights with the latest levels in Fashion Friends!
70070000023642.intro: Make a Fashion Hits together with your friends!
70070000023642.name: Fashion Friends: Super Version

70070000023647.description:
Get ready for the thrilling gaming experience and endless hours of entertainment!

Hole io - Grow by swallowing everything in front of you, whether it be garbage cans, fire hydrants or cars. Get large enough to consume even bigger objects or other players. Eat until nothing and no one is standing in your way!

Helix Jump - Blast your way through helix platforms, smash, bump and bounce to reach the end! Your ball drops like a brick through colorful helix platforms that block its descent, but if you hit a red spot, it's over! Your ball shatters to pieces and you have to start your fall all over again.

Simple entertainment can be the most addictive!
70070000023647.intro: Here's the ultimate arcade bundle you've been waiting for! Eat & jump solo or with friends in multiplayer mode!
70070000023647.name: Hole io & Helix Jump

70070000023648.description:
Find Room 96
You are trying to find room 96 but you are stuck in a loop. To find room 96, observe your surroundings and get familiar with it.

Exit Station 7
You entered a train station and appear to be stuck in a loop. Multiple levels to test your observation skill. See if you have what it takes to escape the loop!

The Eerie Surroundings
You are trying to find the exit but you are stuck in a loop. To find the exit, observe your surroundings and get familiar with it.

HighScore Anomaly Shop
When you start you will be on level 0.  You will be presented with an area to study the layout of objects observe your surroundings and get familiar with it.

HighScore Anomaly Underground
When you start you will be on level 0.  You will be presented with an area to study the layout of objects observe your surroundings and get familiar with it.
70070000023648.intro: Dive into the thrilling world of anomalies.
70070000023648.name: Find Room 96 + Exit Station 7 + The Eerie Surroundings +HighScore Anomaly Shop +HighScore Anomaly Underground

70070000023653.description: Bundled with popular additional puzzle pack "Sweet Kittens" and "[Moving] Fluffy Kittens" on "Jigsaw Masterpieces 2".
70070000023653.intro: This is a great value set for cat lovers just starting out with "Jigsaw Masterpiece 2".
70070000023653.name: Jigsaw Masterpieces 2　Kitten Starter Pack with Moving Puzzle

70070000023656.description:
A third-person, stealth, adventure game focused on the story of the Moonshadow Huntress: Cynthia Stranborg. Take control of the young adept and learn new stealth skills during your journey. Find out what happened in the home village and follow your desired path to rescue the ones you love the most. Travel through Tesana Valley to find a secretly hidden missing piece of artifact to enhance your bow. The Dark Power is coming from the north. You need to destroy the source of this power before it's too late. You are the last one that can reach that destination. At least you need to try, for your loved ones!

Key features:
-Stylized and colorful world
-Fully voice acted emotional story
-Stealth mechanics, arrows crafting, climbing sequences and light puzzle solving
-A short story-driven game (to finish in one evening)
-Several alternative outfits to unlock throughout the game.
-A dedicated photo mode with multiple options to modify: pose, camera effects, stickers, face mimics etc.
70070000023656.name: Cynthia: Hidden in the Moonshadow - Extended Edition

70070000023663.description: Bundled with popular additional puzzle pack "Sweet Puppies" and "[Moving] Fluffy Puppies" on "Jigsaw Masterpieces 2".
70070000023663.intro: This is a great value set for dog lovers just starting out with "Jigsaw Masterpiece 2".
70070000023663.name: Jigsaw Masterpieces 2　Puppy Starter Pack with Moving Puzzle

70070000023667.description:
The Deluxe Edition of Golfing in Aether includes the base game and the Golfing in Aether - Deluxe Edition Upgrade.

Deluxe Edition Upgrade instantly unlocks:
Sportsball Pack containing six ball customizations including American Football, Baseball, Basketball, Football, Tennis ball, and Volleyball.
Holidays Part 1 (Halloween) containing three ball customizations including Dead Face, Eyeball, and Vampire.
Holidays Part 2 (Christmas) containing three ball customizations including Belt, Snowman, and Pudding.
Deluxe Hats containing six hat customizations including Bicorn, Capotain, Mage, Santa, Top hat, and Knight.
70070000023667.intro: Includes Golfing in Aether and the Golfing in Aether - Deluxe Edition Upgrade.
70070000023667.name: Golfing in Aether Deluxe Edition

70070000023673.description:
A classic collection of Solitaire games featuring stunning 3D graphics, now on Nintendo Switch™!

Find the secret behind the cards and uncover a mysterious quest in World of Solitaire, featuring 5 classic versions: Klondike, Spider, FreeCell, Tri-Peaks and Pyramid.
Progress through the game to unlock unique card sets and backgrounds. Customise the game’s appearance with beautiful card designs, while stunning animations offer a unique and immersive playing experience.

Enjoy the most popular card game ever with hours of endless entertainment in the palm of your hand!

70070000023679.description:
Relax as you follow the numbers and paint at your own pace!

Dive into unique canvases full of unicorns, hearts, cakes, and other stunning images. Enjoy the satisfying 'click' as each diamond snaps into place, bringing vibrant colors to life!

Bring a dinosaur back from the past or draw a diamond castle in 3D - whatever you imagine, you can paint it... with diamonds!

Features:
- Color by numbers over 900 pictures!
- Create beautiful 3D paintings
- Choose from different canvas sizes
- Make awesome diamond art
- Listen to relaxing ASMR

Watch your masterpiece sparkle with each diamond you place!
70070000023679.intro: Let your imagination shine as you create over 900 stunning paintings with diamonds!
70070000023679.name: Diamond Painting ASMR: Complete Edition

Racers, beware!

Fast-paced, polished and dynamic motorbike racing now on Nintendo Switch™!

One of a kind game entirely playable with... Toy-Con Motorbike!

Forget about speed limits and traffic rules 'cause on this road you're the boss!

A unique mix of endless and arcade racing game featuring countless hours of fun!

70070000023686.description:
Create tons of incredible fashion design looks for your clients and find them the perfect outfits for their big events!

Welcome to Hollywood, the fabulous land of VIPs! Here, fashion rules, and all the amazing celebrities and fabulous models need to look their best to maintain their star status. That's where you come in - you're the stylist to the stars! Everyone's talking about the incredible looks you created at the latest red carpet event!

Your awesome reputation in fashion design is already bringing you fame and fortune! Lots of girls are heading to your stylist salon for fabulous fashion makeovers. Choose the perfect dress or outfit, add gorgeous accessories and fabulous shoes to complete the look! And don't forget to pick out a new hairstyle for your clients and make sure their nails are absolutely perfect!

Features:
- Open up your very own stylist salon and become famous!
- Style and dress up your clients in glamorous outfits!
- Help your clients get the prettiest makeovers the world has ever seen!
- Make sure their nails are perfect and complement them with rings and bracelets!
- Get your celebrity models amazing new hairstyles!
- 480 new clothing items in streetwear and summer style to make your clients look even more trendy!
- 14 new stunning hair colors and 7 hairstyles
- 94 new accessories such as glasses and jewelry
- 61 new makeup items
- 49 new nail salon items

Whether you're already a makeover fan or new to the genre, this game is bound to leave you amazed!
70070000023686.intro: Dress up famous models and VIP celebrities to bring out their best looks with fabulous makeovers!
70070000023686.name: Stylist Girl: Complete Edition

70070000023689.description:
Urban Flow is a game about the subtle beauty of city streets filled with cars moving in perfect harmony. But such order does not happen all by itself - the city needs YOU to control the traffic lights and to make sure everything goes smoothly. That means no crashes, no jams. Everything will run perfectly - as long as you stay focused!

Immerse yourself in a beautiful, hand-crafted, low-poly world to discover the enormous satisfaction of watching the hundreds of tiny, colourful cars flowing through the streets – all while listening to the chill, urban music.

Over 100 levels, each with its own busy intersection. You have one job: operate the lights and keep it safe.

Party Game (even if you party all alone!)
-----
 Play by yourself or with friends in scalable drop-in, drop-out local co-op mode for two, three, or four players!
You can help your friends or be a little rascal and spread the chaos!
Avoid accidents by paying close attention to special vehicles and to the other players. Special vehicles include the ambulance, which can’t wait for long, and the tank – which will plough through anything in its way.

Don’t want to play the campaign?
-----
 Try our score-based Endless Mode or the Chill Mode - where you play for as long as you want, no rush and no score - only you and the music. Urban Flow is designed to be a great single player experience!

Discover various environments and weather conditions. Play with touch controls, Nintendo Switch™ Pro Controller or Joy-Con™. Complete challenges and unlock rewards.

This bundle includes base game, Expansion Pack, Winter Expansion Pack and Streets Supplement #2 with:

•    Play more than 40 new stages!
•    New challenge mode offers medals - no more star system in challenge mode! You have to pass the challenge bar to pass the challenge mode stages.
•    Enjoy 7 new vehicles
•    Enjoy the winter theme and new music!

Become one with the flow. The Urban Flow!
70070000023689.intro: Manage the city lights and try to avoid the chaos!
70070000023689.name: Urban Flow Grand Edition

Transform your clock into a portal to the anime realm you love.

70070000023780.description:
Day One Edition Bonus:

Purchase your copy of the RetroRealms Double Feature: Halloween and Ash vs Evil Dead bundle and receive two additional playable characters: Laurie Strode from “Halloween” and Kelly Maxwell from “Ash vs Evil Dead”! Each character includes their own play style, story, and achievements to unlock! Offer expires on November 17, 2024.

Enter the RetroRealms and take control of horror icons in two separate games filled with over-the-top arcade action!

Step into a 16-bit Pixel Art world filled with gory good fun as horror legends Michael Myers and Ash Williams! Slice and shoot your way across multiple levels of terrifying platformer action filled with familiar sights and sounds from both the original “Halloween” film and the STARZ television series “Ash vs Evil Dead”! Test your skill, use your weapons, and confront twisted and fiendish versions of iconic characters in two separate games in one Double Pack that can be connected for even more fun. Engage in epic, heart-pounding encounters to overcome the ultimate evil in this sprawling adventure filled with over-the-top terror!

Special Features:

Play as Horror Icons Michael Myers and Ash Williams (both games included):
Use brute strength and wickedly sharp weapons to help Michael Myers vanquish opponents across multiple levels of retro arcade action!  Or play as Ash Williams wielding both his chainsaw and trusty 12-gauge shotgun from the STARZ television series “Ash vs Evil Dead”! Transport characters between games to unlock additional abilities and achievements in the ultimate retro horror mash-up (additional games and DLC sold separately)!

Go to Hell:
Journey into worlds where nightmares manifest, filled with treacherous landscapes and unspeakable horrors. Overcome obstacles, enemies, and bosses that lay in your path to save yourself from eternal damnation!

Retro Aesthetic:
Immerse yourself in Pixel Art-styled 16-bit visuals and a hauntingly nostalgic horror soundtrack. RetroRealms pays homage to classic side-scrollers while delivering a fresh take on retro gameplay.

Secrets, Upgrades, and Unlockables:
Discover hidden relics and collectibles. Unlock new power-ups and abilities to enhance your character’s skills, and discover all-new ways play.

See where you Stand:
With leaderboards for both “Halloween” and “Ash vs Evil Dead” you can see how you stack up against other RetroRealms players. Do you have skills to get your name on the high score list?
70070000023780.intro: It’s the ultimate arcade experience with iconic legends of horror! Crossover into the RetroRealms and see if you have what it takes to make it out alive!
70070000023780.name: RetroRealms Double Feature: Halloween and Ash vs Evil Dead

70070000023801.description:
Inspired by the classics, developed for the modern audiences.

A classic revenge story set in a medieval fantasy world… with a touch of deadly modern firepower just to turn things up to eleven. Fight through the armies of undead, mutants, aliens, machines and beasts in order to get back what is rightfully yours and bring some semblance of peace back to the land. Who knows - if you’re thorough enough you might even discover the history of the kingdom itself, long lost to the scholars of the realm.

Knights & Guns brings you to a dangerous world where you will fight, alongside your friend, against demons, ghouls & ghosts. Use shotguns, lasers and the power of chivalry to overcome every obstacle. Become the best version of a knight - one with a gun.

Inside the game:
•	Fight awesome bosses on various stages!
•	Conquer the non-linear world! Rush through over 150 hand crafted stages, or enjoy the game at your own pace, looking for secrets and special routes!
•	Entire game designed for both single player or co-op multiplayer. Invite a friend at any time for some extra firepower and mayhem.
•	60 fps gameplay! Try the different modes! Hunt the monsters! Survive! Play on small, big and narrow maps!
•	Check out all the awesome suits of armor and, of course, all the GUNS! Lasers, shotguns, grenade launchers, sniper rifles... They are all here!
•	Over 30 unique guns. (That’s probably more flavors of death than flavors of ice cream you can name.)
•	Over 25 types of enemies, 5 types of mini-bosses and 3 types of bosses. Most of these come in different colors, too.
•	30 unique suits of armor for the knights. Extra protection and extra style!
•	Traps, chests, keys, scrolls of lore, books of monsters...

This bundle includes base game, Armor Pack #1 and Armor Pack #3 with:
- 4 new armors to help you on your quest

70070000023816.description:
Train Traffic Manager isn't your grandpa's model railway set. Think fast, plan faster, and keep those trains from turning into flaming metal confetti. In this strategy-puzzle game, you're in charge of everything from switches and signals to drawbridges and, oh yeah, preventing cataclysmic train disasters.

Take on over 80 levels across diverse environments that range from sunny desertscapes to mysterious midnight scenes. It's more fun than a cactus in your caboose!

Each environment has its own unique challenges. Deserts have meteor showers (because of course they do), forests have fallen trees (what's a forest without a little lumber?), winters bring the freeze to your switches, and at midnight, well, you'll just have to see.

And if the chaos of normal mode gets too much, take a breather in endless mode. No objectives, just you, the tracks, and an infinite number of trains. It's the zen garden of train management!

Ready to dive into the madness? Take control of the tracks and show that chaos who's boss in Train Traffic Manager.

And remember: don't fall asleep at your post!

This bundle includes base game and DLC #4 - Fleet Upgrade - SciFi & Horror with:

two uniquely themed trains - embrace the eerie with the Horror skin, or embark into the future with the SciFi skin. Whether you’re evading ghostly apparitions or cruising in cyber-style, these skins add a new layer of excitement to your managerial prowess.
70070000023816.intro: All Aboard the Chaos & Strategy Express!
70070000023816.name: Train Traffic Manager Upgrade Edition

Use brute strength and wickedly sharp weapons to help Michael Myers vanquish opponents across multiple levels of retro arcade action! Connect Halloween with select RetroRealms titles (games and DLC sold separately) to unlock additional abilities and achievements in the ultimate retro horror mash-up!

Go to Hell
Journey into worlds where Hellish nightmares manifest, filled with treacherous landscapes and unspeakable horrors. Overcome obstacles, enemies, and bosses that lay in your path to save Haddonfield from eternal damnation!

RetroRealms includes access to the RetroRealms Arcade that connects select RetroRealms games with other titles in the series that you own (games and DLC sold separately) to unlock new access and abilities and create the ultimate mash-up of horror legends!

Retro Aesthetic
Immerse yourself in the golden age of gaming with Pixel Art-styled 16-bit visuals and a hauntingly nostalgic horror soundtrack. RetroRealms: Halloween pays homage to classic side-scrollers while delivering a fresh take on platformer gameplay.

Secrets, Upgrades, and Unlockables
Discover hidden relics and collectibles. Unlock new power-ups and abilities to enhance your character’s prowess, and find all-new ways play!

Check out the RetroRealms leaderboards to see how you stack up against other players. Do you have skills to get your name on the high score list?

Theater of war, infinite drama.
A masterpiece of historical simulation, "ROMANCE OF THE THREE KINGDOMS 8" is revived after 20 years.

Combining 2D and 3D technologies, the game features both new and nostalgic visual effects, as well as many new officer graphics created specifically for this title.
Enjoy the greatest military drama in the "THREE KINGDOMS" series, with the largest number of officers and scenarios!

Note: “ROMANCE OF THE THREE KINGDOMS 8 REMAKE” is also available for purchase on its own. Please avoid making redundant purchases.

70070000023911.description:
Digital Bonus Content
• Royal outfit
• Bonus Mission: “The prince from another world”

Get ready to experience an unforgettable adventure with Grendizer, the famous giant robot. This action/adventure game adapted from the cult animated series will immerse you in the heart of the universe of its creator, Go Nagai, and will give you the chance to pilot the most powerful of robots and fight the forces of evil.

After Planet Fleed is destroyed by the  Empire of Vega , Prince  Daisuke takes refuge on our planet. Taken in and adopted by Genzo Umon, he lives at the Shirakaba Farm. While Vega's invasion of Earth is imminent,  Daisuke will defend the planet Earth with the help of Grendizer, the titanic robot hidden deep inside Genzo Umon's observatory. With the help of Koji Kabuto, the prince of Planet Fleed will constantly repel Vegans' attacks and fight his terrible robots, the Monstronefs, which were sent to destroy him.

Play as  Daisuke and his colossal robot while fighting in epic battles with multiple gameplays: Piloting the Spazer (flying module where Grendizer is housed), vertical shoot-them-up in the Koji Kabuto's TFO, and 3rd person action/combat by controlling Grendizer. Use his iconic and devastating attacks to destroy the terrifying Monstronefs and save the earth.

Find yourself in  Daisuke's shoes and meet many essential characters during dialog sequences in the iconic environments of the series, which was so diligently reproduced in accordance with the designs of the original series.
And finally, earn experience points while completing missions to achieve new abilities and upgrade your powers.

GAME FEATURES
• For the very first time, play as Grendizer and Umon Daisuke in this action/adventure game, which is all about the metal colossus.
• Execute and improve the famous must-have attacks of the giant robot.
• Find all the characters, iconic places, and enemies of the TV series.
• A new gaming experience is offered to you in multiple game phases: Action/Brawler, 3rd person Shoot, Shoot Them Up and Exploration.
• The iconic music of the series has been remastered, and you will able to enjoy it throughout the game.
70070000023911.intro: Climb aboard Grendizer the Legendary Robot and fight the forces of evil

70070000023979.description:
Train Traffic Manager isn't your grandpa's model railway set. Think fast, plan faster, and keep those trains from turning into flaming metal confetti. In this strategy-puzzle game, you're in charge of everything from switches and signals to drawbridges and, oh yeah, preventing cataclysmic train disasters.

Take on over 80 levels across diverse environments that range from sunny desertscapes to mysterious midnight scenes. It's more fun than a cactus in your caboose!

Each environment has its own unique challenges. Deserts have meteor showers (because of course they do), forests have fallen trees (what's a forest without a little lumber?), winters bring the freeze to your switches, and at midnight, well, you'll just have to see.

And if the chaos of normal mode gets too much, take a breather in endless mode. No objectives, just you, the tracks, and an infinite number of trains. It's the zen garden of train management!

Ready to dive into the madness? Take control of the tracks and show that chaos who's boss in Train Traffic Manager.

And remember: don't fall asleep at your post!

This bundle includes base game, DLC #2 - Classic Tracks Reimagined  and DLC #3 - Fleet Upgrade - Jet & Circus with:

- 10 of the best campaign levels, transformed and remixed for an even more engaging challenge.

- Two New skins - with the vibrant colors of the circus or the sleek design of a jet.
70070000023979.intro: All Aboard the Chaos & Strategy Express!
70070000023979.name: Train Traffic Manager Prime Edition

70070000024009.description:
Inspired by the classics, developed for the modern audiences.

A classic revenge story set in a medieval fantasy world… with a touch of deadly modern firepower just to turn things up to eleven. Fight through the armies of undead, mutants, aliens, machines and beasts in order to get back what is rightfully yours and bring some semblance of peace back to the land. Who knows - if you’re thorough enough you might even discover the history of the kingdom itself, long lost to the scholars of the realm.

Knights & Guns brings you to a dangerous world where you will fight, alongside your friend, against demons, ghouls & ghosts. Use shotguns, lasers and the power of chivalry to overcome every obstacle. Become the best version of a knight - one with a gun.

Inside the game:
•	Fight awesome bosses on various stages!
•	Conquer the non-linear world! Rush through over 150 hand crafted stages, or enjoy the game at your own pace, looking for secrets and special routes!
•	Entire game designed for both single player or co-op multiplayer. Invite a friend at any time for some extra firepower and mayhem.
•	60 fps gameplay! Try the different modes! Hunt the monsters! Survive! Play on small, big and narrow maps!
•	Check out all the awesome suits of armor and, of course, all the GUNS! Lasers, shotguns, grenade launchers, sniper rifles... They are all here!
•	Over 30 unique guns. (That’s probably more flavors of death than flavors of ice cream you can name.)
•	Over 25 types of enemies, 5 types of mini-bosses and 3 types of bosses. Most of these come in different colors, too.
•	30 unique suits of armor for the knights. Extra protection and extra style!
•	Traps, chests, keys, scrolls of lore, books of monsters...

This bundle includes base game, Expansion Pack #1, Expansion Pack #2 and Armor Pack #3 with:

- 20 new levels for you to bring back the peace
- 12 new armors to help you on your quest
- New enemies for that extra little kick
70070000024009.intro: Knight in shining armor, fight your way... with Guns!
70070000024009.name: Knights & Guns Grand Edition

No matter what your fashion style may be, this shopping mall has exactly what you're looking for! Get a fabulous new hairstyle at your favorite hair salon Chic Cuts, and dress up in the latest hot trends from our stylish shops!

Get set for an unforgettable shopping adventure like no other!

With stunning anime visuals, engaging puzzle mechanics, and a wealth of characters to discover, the Deluxe Edition is your gateway to an unforgettable puzzle adventure. Solve, collect, and explore like never before!

Transform your grandma’s old mansion into a warm, welcoming home filled with playful kittens. Design fun rooms, choose cute furniture, and watch as the cats explore and relax in their new cozy spaces.

•  Attract lots of different cats to your cozy home.

Transform a run-down mansion into a cozy paradise for adorable kittens! Renovate, decorate, and fill the mansion with playful feline friends. Unlock new rooms, collect cute cats, and create the ultimate kitty haven!

70070000024646.description:
Welcome to the most bustling place in the world. Important notice: no, you can’t hide the bell from the guests. Yes, they will keep ringing it. Your role here will be to take care of the hotel and attend to guests and all their needs for the duration of their stay.


CLEAN, PREPARE, AND SERVE - SERVICE, I MEAN SERVICE
Before the guests arrive you’ll need to tidy up and prepare their rooms. Look at your to-do list, take all the necessary equipment from the trolley and get rid of the mess. To answer incoming questions: yes, the guests will complain if they see but a crumb on their carpet.

Time is money. Delivering the guests’ special requests - like luxurious sheets or delicious sushi - need to be completed in a specific amount of time for you to receive your entire monetary bonus.


RUN THE HOTEL ALONE OR WITH A FRIEND
If you’d like to play with a friend, your stakes will be a bit higher, but two heads are better than one. The camera will pan out to include both characters on the screen at all times.

Happy hustling and do not forget: a “no running, wet floor” sign is not enough of an excuse not to deliver a guests their meal on time.

Browse amazing drawings from the Artbook Part 2 and 3 DLC included in this bundle.

KEY FEATURES:
- Singleplayer and coop mode
- Stars that unlock new levels
- Many activities to complete
- 25 levels with various layouts
70070000024646.intro: Take a very hands-on approach to managing a bustling hotel and make sure your guests leave with a smile on their face.
70070000024646.name: Hotel Hustle Legendary Edition

70070000024676.description:
Live your Disney dream life with the Enchanted Edition, which includes the base game and two Expansion Passes. This edition also contains exclusive digital items.
· Access to Disney Dreamlight Valley, Disney Dreamlight Valley: A Rift in Time and Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Storybook Vale
· 18,000 Moonstones*
· Autumn Manor House style
· Baby Pegasus Animal Companion and Companion House
· Storybook Vale Dress and Ensemble

Disney Dreamlight Valley is a hybrid between a life-sim and an adventure game rich with quests, exploration, and engaging activities featuring Disney and Pixar friends, both old and new. Once an idyllic land, Dreamlight Valley was a place where Disney and Pixar characters lived in harmony—until the Forgetting. Night Thorns grew across the land and severed the wonderful memories tied to this magical place. With nowhere else to go, the hopeless inhabitants of Dreamlight Valley retreated behind locked doors in the Dream Castle. Now it's up to you to discover the stories of this world and bring the magic back to Dreamlight Valley!

In Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Storybook Vale, the second Expansion Pass for the game, discover a land made up of fabled stories, where myths and fairy tales sprang to life… until Maleficent and Hades tore the Vale apart. With the guidance of the Lorekeeper, journey to the Vale and meet heroes and villains who will bring epic trials to undertake, stories to reassemble, and friendships to recover.

Journey to Eternity Isle in Disney Dreamlight Valley: A Rift in Time, the first Expansion Pass for the game. Adventure to this faraway land and utilize a mysterious new Royal Tool—the Hourglass—as you discover new secrets and uncover lost treasures. Foil Jafar’s plan to steal the Spark of Imagination, an ancient relic that holds the fabric of Dreamlight Valley together. With the help of the Hourglass, you are the key to fixing rifts in time and putting an end to Jafar’s evil plan!

*Moonstones are an in-game currency that can be collected for free by performing tasks in the game or be purchased using real money. They are used to unlock the premium track of the Star Path (a battle-pass-inspired system that grants in-game cosmetic items as a player completes various tasks and missions). Moonstones can also be used to accelerate progress in the Star Path. Additionally, Moonstones can be used to purchase cosmetic items from the in-game store.
70070000024676.intro: Explore a magical world in Disney Dreamlight Valley alongside Disney and Pixar friends, and expand your journey to Eternity Isle and the Storybook Vale where more adventures await!
70070000024676.name: Disney Dreamlight Valley – Enchanted Edition

70070000024679.description:
