• Search abandoned warehouses for food and rescue lost kittens.
• Avoid obstacles and complete timed objectives.
• Play through 20 challenging levels.
• Compete in two-player split-screen mode.

Embark on an adventure as a brave cat, exploring abandoned warehouses to find food and rescue lost kittens. Navigate tricky obstacles and beat the clock to complete challenging objectives. Compete with friends in a thrilling two-player split-screen mode for even more fun and excitement!
70070000026679.intro: Step into the paws of a brave cat, navigating a perilous world to help kittens in need.
70070000026679.name: Little Strays: Legacy Edition

70070000026686.description:
When Splinter is kidnapped by Shredder, mysterious portals simultaneously appear across NYC. With April and Metalhead analysing recovered artifacts for clues, the Turtles battle to recover their father from the clutches of the Foot Clan. However, as the gang gets ever closer to Splinter’s otherworldly location, an even greater threat lingers in the shadows…

In Splintered Fate, brace yourself for fast-paced, roguelike action where no two runs are the same. With randomised power-ups, room layouts, and boss modifiers, the excitement never ends. Take control of all four Turtles, each wielding unique powers, and team up with friends for bodacious co-op gameplay. Explore iconic NYC locations, upgrade your Turtle powers, and prepare to face off against formidable enemies.

With thrilling combat and endless challenges, Splintered Fate promises to keep you engaged in the FIGHT, ADAPT, REPEAT portal loop. Be ready to restore peace to the city!
70070000026686.intro: Unleash the Turtles in a roguelike quest to rescue Splinter from the Foot Clan!
70070000026686.name: TMNT: Splintered Fate + DLC Bundle

70070000026688.description:
The Discolored Bundle includes the first-person puzzle adventure games Discolored and Discolored 2.

In Discolored all the colors have gone missing and it's up to you to bring them back. In the first Discolored you explore a lonely roadside diner where strange and surreal events occur. Solve inventive puzzles and try to unravel the mystery of how to bring all the colors back to the world.

Discolored 2 picks up right where the first one left off as you continue your mission to restore the missing colors, but now you discover you are being pursued by a shadowy organization that wants to stop you and steal the colors for their own sinister purposes. Your only hope is a woman in red who may be holding the key to preventing the world from becoming discolored.
70070000026688.intro: All the colors have gone missing and it's up to you to bring them back.
70070000026688.name: Discolored Bundle

70070000026693.description:
Like going in to town for a bite to eat? Everybody does!

But perhaps you'd like to see that from the other side?
Not everyone can, so don't waste the opportunity!

Manage the preparation of burgers, french fries, crispy chicken and a multitude of other treats!

Try to deliver the orders on time, but be careful not to mix them up!

Upgrade your restaurant and beautify it and find ingredients of the best quality, so that you'll be able to create the best burger joint in town!

To work!

In BURGER CHEF TYCOON you will find:

* 60 achievements to complete
* 40 statistics to track and beat
* 60 awesome levels to complete
* Countless dishes to master and serve
* Amazing graphics, music and sound effects
* Countless upgrades, decorations to make your bar the best!

This bundle includes base game, Expansion Pack #1, Multiplayer Mode and DLC#4 Endless Mode with:

• 20 new levels,
• 6 new achievements
• New Endless Mode
• local multiplayer gameplay mode, allowing players to team up and play together. It adds a new layer of excitement and replayability to the game, while providing a fun and engaging experience for players to enjoy with friends and family.

NOTE: to play the Multiplayer Mode DLC, each player will need their own set of Joy-Con™ or an additional Nintendo Switch™ Pro Controller.
70070000026693.intro: Tasty burgers? We've got you covered!
70070000026693.name: Burger Chef Tycoon Elite Edition

70070000026694.description:
This bundle includes two escape room games:

*Pyramids and Aliens: Escape Room
*Mystic Academy: Escape Room

PYRAMIDS AND ALIENS: ESCAPE ROOM
Embark on an archaeological adventure inside an ancient pyramid to find your missing mentor. As an intrepid explorer, solve puzzles, investigate clues, and unravel the pyramid's secrets. Spoiler: it was not built by humans!

MYSTIC ACADEMY: ESCAPE ROOM
Today is the day of your final exam to become a wizard. Within this enchanting escape room, you'll navigate a wizardry school, unravel puzzles, master new spells, and put your magical skills to the ultimate test. The question remains: Will you emerge triumphant?
70070000026694.intro:
Two escape rooms developed by mc2games are included!
Pyramids and Aliens: Escape Room and Mystic Academy: Escape Room.
70070000026694.name: Escape Room Ultimate Duo

70070000026695.description:
This bundle includes three escape room games:

*Pyramids and Aliens: Escape Room
*Mystic Academy: Escape Room
*Between Time: Escape Room

PYRAMIDS AND ALIENS: ESCAPE ROOM
Embark on an archaeological adventure inside an ancient pyramid to find your missing mentor. As an intrepid explorer, solve puzzles, investigate clues, and unravel the pyramid's secrets. Spoiler: it was not built by humans!

MYSTIC ACADEMY: ESCAPE ROOM
Today is the day of your final exam to become a wizard. Within this enchanting escape room, you'll navigate a wizardry school, unravel puzzles, master new spells, and put your magical skills to the ultimate test. The question remains: Will you emerge triumphant?

BETWEEN TIME: ESCAPE ROOM
You are going to steal a time machine. In this escape room, you must travel through time, explore mysterious places, and solve puzzles to obtain untold treasures. Will you come back alive?
70070000026695.intro:
Three escape rooms developed by mc2games are included!
Pyramids and Aliens, Mystic Academy, Between Time.
70070000026695.name: Escape Room Ultimate Trilogy

70070000026697.description:
This bundle includes the following:
River City Girls 2 (full game)
River City Girls 2: Double Dragon DLC (add-on content)

About River City Girls 2:
The River City Girls are ready for round 2! When an old foe returns for revenge, Misako, Kyoko, Kunio, and Riki - joined by newcomers Marian and Provie - hit the streets for an all-new beat-'em-up adventure packed with new abilities, enemies, allies, locations, and more! Team up for local or online co-op, then pound punks into the dirt with brand-new guard-crush attacks, lift-off combos, elemental status effects, and other knuckle-busting techniques! Level-up to earn new moves, buy items and accessories in more than 40 shops, and recruit defeated foes and hired heavies to help you on your way! River City is bigger than ever, offering more areas to explore, more objects to destroy, and a day-night cycle! With nonlinear gameplay, character-specific VO, and another epic soundtrack by Megan McDuffee, River City Girls 2 will keep you brawling until all your enemies yell "BARF!"

Key Features:
• Six playable characters, each with their own fighting styles and upgradable move sets!
• Enhanced combat: guard crushes, lift-off combos, elemental attacks, and more!
• River City is bigger than ever! New locations with multiple routes and secret areas!
• Play solo or team up with a friend, locally or online
• New "hired heavies" aid you in battle! Have two recruits at once!
• Loads of NPCs to meet, interact with, and punch in the face - including surprise cameos!
• Awesome anime intro, comic book cutscenes, English and Japanese voiceovers, and a spectacular soundtrack featuring RCG1 composer Megan McDuffee!

About River City Girls 2: Double Dragon DLC:
LET'S GO, BROS! The legendary Double Dragons, Billy and Jimmy Lee, are busting out of their dojos and joining River City Girls 2 as playable characters! These twin brothers jump into battle as distinctive fighters, ready to throw down with bone-shattering punches, kicks, slams, and special attacks - including trademark moves such as the Hurricane Kick and Rising Knee! The bros are fully integrated into River City Girls 2's story mode, complete with full voice overs, plus this premium DLC also adds an epic new vocal song and a new dojo master!

Contents:
• Playable Billy Lee
• Playable Jimmy Lee
• Full story integration with new voiceovers by Dan Avidan (Billy) and Arin Hanson (Jimmy)
• New vocal song performed by Hanson and Avidan with music by RCG series composer Megan McDuffee
• New dojo master Boro
70070000026697.intro: It's a one-two punch: River City Girls 2 plus add-on heroes Billy & Jimmy Lee!
70070000026697.name: River City Girls 2 + Double Dragon DLC Bundle

70070000026698.description: This is a special set of all four titles in the eleventh additional puzzle pack for "Jigsaw Masterpieces 2".
70070000026698.name: Additional Puzzle Pack Set Vol.11

70070000026703.description:
Enter the battlefield in "Tank vs Tank", an explosive clash of steel titans.

This isn't just a game; it's war. Life and death hang in the balance, demanding your full attention. Every decision, from the drive to the deadly aim, could mean the difference between victory and defeat. Outwit, outshout, and outlast your opponents to ensure it's them, not you, who bite the dust.

Your choices are crucial - every move, every shot counts towards victory or defeat.

Enhance your tank with cutting-edge upgrades and face off against cunning opponents.

Use the vast arsenal at your disposal, make each shot your path to glory.

Ready your cannon, refine your tactics, and enter the battle.

Victory awaits the bold – are you prepared to claim it?

This bundle includes base game, "War Paint #1" and "War Paint #2", with:

-8 unique tank skins and 8 country flags, allowing you to customize your armored vehicles.
70070000026703.intro: Battle of the Tanks: Aim, Ready.... Fire!
70070000026703.name: Tank vs Tank Deluxe Edition

70070000026712.description:
Discover the perfect balance of strategy and skill in Snooker Fever.  This game brings the classic snooker experience to the Nintendo Switch™, whether you're a seasoned snooker player or just picking up a cue for the first time.

With 10 beautifully crafted tables, customizable cues, and CPU opponents that keep you on your toes, every game feels fresh. Take on the challenge solo or invite a friend for some local competition. Focus on sinking that perfect shot, while the stunning 3D visuals capture the atmosphere of a real snooker hall.

Snooker Fever has all the tools you need to master the game, enjoy some friendly competition, and just have a great time.

Key Features:

10 different tables 
15 custom cues 
3 levels of opponents
Local multiplayer 
Smooth controls and realistic 3D graphics

This bundle includes base game and Expansion Pack #1 with:

five stunning new table designs
70070000026712.intro: The classic pool experience, right at home!
70070000026712.name: Snooker Fever Extended Edition

70070000026713.description:
Urban Flow is a game about the subtle beauty of city streets filled with cars moving in perfect harmony. But such order does not happen all by itself - the city needs YOU to control the traffic lights and to make sure everything goes smoothly. That means no crashes, no jams. Everything will run perfectly - as long as you stay focused!

Immerse yourself in a beautiful, hand-crafted, low-poly world to discover the enormous satisfaction of watching the hundreds of tiny, colorful cars flowing through the streets – all while listening to the chill, urban music.

Over 100 levels, each with its own busy intersection. You have one job: operate the lights and keep it safe.

Party Game (even if you party all alone!)
-----
 Play by yourself or with friends in scalable drop-in, drop-out local co-op mode for two, three, or four players!
You can help your friends or be a little rascal and spread the chaos!

Avoid accidents by paying close attention to special vehicles and to the other players. Special vehicles include the ambulance, which can’t wait for long, and the tank – which will plow through anything in its way.

Don’t want to play the campaign?
-----
 Try our score-based Endless Mode or the Chill Mode - where you play for as long as you want, no rush and no score - only you and the music. Urban Flow is designed to be a great single player experience!

Discover various environments and weather conditions. Play with touch controls, Pro Controllers or Joy-Con™. Complete challenges and unlock rewards.

This bundle includes base game, Expansion Pack, Winter Expansion Pack, London Rules, Streets Supplement #1 and Streets Supplement #2 with:

•    New challenge mode offers medals - no more star system in challenge mode! You have to pass the challenge bar to pass the challenge mode stages.
•    50 new stages!
•    Winter theme and new music!
•    12 new vehicles
70070000026713.intro: Manage the city lights and try to avoid the chaos!
70070000026713.name: Urban Flow Full Edition

70070000026714.description:
Look out! This pizzeria will soon become the talk of the town!

Well... at least that's the plan.

Your customers are already queuing up, so you'll have to serve them as quickly as possible. However, that's easier said than done!

Everyone's in a hurry and you'll have to prepare each order correctly, or else your customers are going to get crossed!

Give it your all and you'll come out on top!

IN PIZZA BAR TYCOON YOU WILL FIND:

* 60 levels to explore, 70+ dishes to serve.
* Great cartoonish graphics, music and sound effects.
* Countless upgrades you can apply to ingredients and bar decorations.
* 47 Achievements to complete.
* Easy to play and hard to master.

This bundle includes base game, Expansion Pack #1, Expansion Pack #2 and Endless Mode with:

* 40 new levels
* endless gameplay mode
70070000026714.intro: Become a pizza magnate! Create the best pizza in town!
70070000026714.name: Pizza Bar Tycoon Legendary Edition

70070000026721.description:
In S.N.I.P.E.R.: Hunter Scope you will shoot, you will fight, and you will win!

Play S.N.I.P.E.R., the latest sniping game where you aim, fight and destroy virtual enemies. Try different types of missions, inspired both by classic rail shooters and modern cover shooters. Fight your way out during day and night, destroy evil forces and unlock new weapons and power-ups.

Game includes:
15+ STAGES
30+ WEAPONS
30+ GALLERY ITEMS
60+ SPECIAL ACHIEVEMENTS

Become a hunter, mount your scope, and fight for our freedom!

This bundle includes base game, Expansion Pack, Weaponry Upgrade, Elite Arsenal, Target Acquired and Neon Strike with:

- With the Expansion Pack you can fight and survive the zombie apocalypse in a brand new game mode!
- Play new maps or revisit old ones with new weapons.
-PIS-30-ARM pistol: a reliable sidearm
-FMS-1-LEO rifle: a versatile and adaptable rifle for any situation
-SN-1000-FUT sniper rifle: a state-of-the-art weapon with cutting-edge features for ultimate accuracy
-RVL-357-WES pistol: a classic revolver with a timeless design
-BK-47-CAM rifle: a rugged and reliable rifle inspired by the old west
-SN-1100-TRI sniper rifle: a modern-day cowboy sniper rifle
-RIF-16-DOT rifle: a high-tech rifle with a dot sight for quick target acquisition
-SN-200-FOR sniper rifle: a powerful and accurate sniper rifle for long-range engagements
-SN-300-FFD sniper rifle: a versatile sniper rifle for special assignments
-SN-400-SKY sniper rifle: a sleek design combined with cutting-edge technology
-SHG-12-AQA: an aquatic-themed shotgun, with a blast like an ocean wave
-UZ-90-CLD: a frosty Uzi, delivering a cool demise
-SN-1200-NEO: a sniper rifle straight out of a neon dream, precision only matched by its glowing elegance.
70070000026721.name: S.N.I.P.E.R. - Hunter Scope Full Edition

70070000026722.description:
Have you ever wondered what it’s like to run your own breakfast kitchen?

In Breakfast Bar Tycoon, you'll learn that it's no easy task!

You will take on the role of a breakfast bar manager and try your best to serve the hordes of hungry customers as quickly as possible.

Take orders, prepare dishes and fight for tips!

Invest your earnings into upgrading your restaurant and become a breakfast magnate!

Bon appetite!

This bundle includes base game, Expansion Pack #2, Endless Mode and Multiplayer Mode with:

• 45 new levels to explore
• 8 new Achievements to complete
• local multiplayer gameplay mode, allowing players to team up and play together. It adds a new layer of excitement and replayability to the game, while providing a fun and engaging experience for players to enjoy with friends and family.
• endless gameplay mode

NOTE: to play the Multiplayer Mode DLC, each player will need their own set of Joy-Con™ or an additional Nintendo Switch™ Pro Controller.
70070000026722.intro:
It's almost time for breakfast!
Go and prove that your breakfast bar deserves its fame!
70070000026722.name: Breakfast Bar Tycoon Definitive Edition

70070000026723.description:
Start a new journey and see how this is more than just a farming game.

ADORABLE CAT
Help cute cat Niko escape from the big city and settle with him on the Ostara archipelago. Just choose an island and start your new life! His knowledge and passion for nature will let you turn this island into the most stunning place on Earth.

GAME ECONOMY
Your garden will produce many products you can sell and earn money. Remember to order unnecessary seeds, saplings and equipment to make your garden grow even bigger. Manage space on your island and pick the best place for your crops. Don’t forget to water them every day!

VARIOUS ACTIVITIES
It’s your choice what to do. Developing your skills by farming, mining, foraging, crafting, fishing will let you unlock new recipes and abilities. Make sure to unlock all of them and explore all possibilities in the game.

This bundle includes a total of 8 DLCs: Lovely, Easter, Cows, Summer, Nico's Skins, New Friend: Momo, Spray Paint, and the largest expansion ever created for Sprout Valley – Friends Forever.

KEY FEATURES
- Charming 2D pixel art graphics
- More than 20 hours of amazing gameplay
- Outfit customization
- Your own pets!

70070000026762.description:
A modern reimagining of the road to Oregon, this official successor to the iconic classic will fully immerse you in epic journeys ranging from the historically accurate to the totally extreme. Surviving blizzards, broken limbs, snakebites, exhaustion, starvation, and the dreaded dysentery is no small feat. Can you guide your party to a new life in Oregon before winter?

The Oregon Trail - Digital Deluxe Bundle includes:

- The Oregon Trail base game
- Cowboys and Critters DLC

ALWAYS A NEW ADVENTURE
• Build and name your party from different classes—each with their own starting items, skills, and personalities—to make every journey to Oregon unique.
• Overcome hundreds of random events where your choices affect the fate of your travelers, and are influenced by their unique skills and traits.
• Remember to take care of your party, wagon, and oxen, or they'll become casualties of the trail.

FRESH FEATURES
• Take on 15 playable Journeys.
• Experience 7 Quests inspired by historical events.
• Monitor your party members' health, morale, stamina and hygiene.
• Manage your inventory to squeeze everything you can into the wagon.
• Maintain your wagon to prevent breakdowns and inventory loss from spoiling or spillage.
• Learn about real people and places in your interactive Journal.
• Collect and learn about the many interesting animals you'll see on the trail.
• Catch 80+ species in the new Fishing mini-game.
• Obtain 140+ achievements.

COWBOYS AND CRITTERS DLC
• New Journey: The Chisholm Trail
• New character class: Cook
• New Quests: Forlorn Hope and Horse Creek Treaty
• New waypoint: Myths, Critters & Legends, Oh My!
• And lots more: New achievements, new pieces of Artwork, and new characters

TRUE TO THE ORIGINAL
• Hunting and Rafting make a long-awaited return, with faithful gameplay and all-new visuals.
• Dysentery, river fording, broken legs, and many more classic hazards await!

STRIKING ART DIRECTION AND SCORE
• A beautiful blend of charming pixel art characters, 3D environments and cutting-edge lighting and visual effects creates a unique visual style that's both nostalgic and contemporary.
• An all-original soundtrack of alt-country-inspired music combined with 8-bit-style sound effects.

RESPECTFUL REPRESENTATION
• For the first time, the game features Native American playable characters and stories, celebrating the history and cultures of the peoples who first lived on this land and still live here today.
• Native American scholars contributed to the game's storylines and dialogue to ensure accuracy and respectful representation.

OFFICIALLY LICENSED & SUPPORTED
• The Oregon Trail™ is an officially licensed game from HarperCollins Productions, who supported the evolution of The Oregon Trail™ so it would be true to the original, but with updated gameplay and visuals.
• 2016 Video Game Hall of Fame inductee
70070000026762.intro: Experience the classic adventure with The Oregon Trail and expand your frontier tales with the Cowboys and Critters DLC!
70070000026762.name: The Oregon Trail - Digital Deluxe Bundle

Match three blocks of the same color to clear levels and build amazing structures for your blocks. Sounds easy? Think again! – you only have so much room on your bench, and if you overfill it, it's game over!

Earn money from the orders and customize the interior of your restaurant in Cooking. After each order you will earn enough money to either upgrade your equipment or purchase new decorations. Enjoy new chairs, tables, plants and utensils.


Become a master of composing the perfect sushi. Be precise and use the exact amount of ingredients such as soy sauce or rice. Mix ingredients with passion and follow each step with maximum precision to become a master of Cooking!

Decorate your restaurant with an amazing Green Dragon Set and Animal Set included in this bundle.

70070000026822.description:

Following the sudden death of a mafia family’s matriarch, her sons Gerald and Xander are put on the defensive as former partners threaten to take over their collective business ventures for themselves. See through the eyes of the Gallo children as they witness murders, kidnappings and other crimes wrought upon their households by their own fathers.

Crime Opera II: The Floodgate Effect

Experience a new chapter in the mafia tale surrounding the Gallos family! This story begins 9 years after the original. Xander Gallo is now bitter, alone and out of control. He’s causing problems for not only other families within the syndicate but also for younger Gallo members as well. Those who remained behind to continue the family legacy are soon forced to take sides with or against Xander Gallo, while others who have seemingly moved on with their lives are pulled back in against their will.

Crime Opera Fandisk: The Caterpillar Candids

In this new anthology release of Crime Opera, explore a variety of short stories that take place before, during and after the events of the original visual novel, all presented in beautifully crafted hand-drawn style to convey the drama, emotion and gritty truth surrounding characters’ lives in the criminal underworld.

70070000026858.description:
Inspired by the classics, developed for the modern audiences.

A classic revenge story set in a medieval fantasy world… with a touch of deadly modern firepower just to turn things up to eleven. Fight through the armies of undead, mutants, aliens, machines and beasts in order to get back what is rightfully yours and bring some semblance of peace back to the land. Who knows - if you’re thorough enough you might even discover the history of the kingdom itself, long lost to the scholars of the realm.

Knights & Guns brings you to a dangerous world where you will fight, alongside your friend, against demons, ghouls & ghosts. Use shotguns, lasers and the power of chivalry to overcome every obstacle. Become the best version of a knight - one with a gun.

Inside the game:
•	Fight awesome bosses on various stages!
•	Conquer the non-linear world! Rush through over 150 hand crafted stages, or enjoy the game at your own pace, looking for secrets and special routes!
•	Entire game designed for both single player or co-op multiplayer. Invite a friend at any time for some extra firepower and mayhem.
•	60 fps gameplay! Try the different modes! Hunt the monsters! Survive! Play on small, big and narrow maps!
•	Check out all the awesome suits of armor and, of course, all the GUNS! Lasers, shotguns, grenade launchers, sniper rifles... They are all here!
•	Over 30 unique guns. (That’s probably more flavors of death than flavors of ice cream you can name.)
•	Over 25 types of enemies, 5 types of mini-bosses and 3 types of bosses. Most of these come in different colors, too.
•	30 unique suits of armor for the knights. Extra protection and extra style!
•	Traps, chests, keys, scrolls of lore, books of monsters...

This bundle includes base game, Expansion Pack #2, Armor Pack #2  and Armor Pack #3 with:
- 10 new levels for you to bring back the peace
- 13 new armors to help you on your quest
- New enemies for that extra little kick
70070000026858.intro: Knight in shining armor, fight your way... with Guns!

This bundle includes:
	•	Bid Battle: Auction War Simulator Storage Hunter – Engage in intense bidding wars, explore diverse storage units, and discover valuable treasures hidden behind locked doors. Outbid your competitors, find rare collectibles, and build your
reputation as a top storage hunter.
	•	Bid Battle: Auction War Simulator Storage Hunter - Cash Hunter DLC –  Start your journey with 400 in-game currencies, giving you a head start in dominating auctions and securing the best deals. Take your skills to the next level with access to exclusive storage units and rare artifacts.

Don’t miss your chance to become the ultimate storage hunter!

"Pawfect Cat Mansion" – Build and decorate a mansion for orphaned kittens, filling it with warmth and comfort so they can snuggle up by the fireplace.

In "Drift Legacy", master the art of drifting, earn rewards, upgrade your ride, and unlock new cars to dominate the streets. Precision and style will make you a true drifting master!

Race against time in "Theft Ride Legacy" to recover stolen loot in high-speed chases. Navigate intense courses, outmaneuver obstacles, and prove your skills under pressure. Take on the challenge solo or compete with a friend in two-player split-screen mode!

Buckle up—this bundle delivers the ultimate thrill ride!

Experience the Ultimate Driving Thrill
Get ready for the most exhilarating racing experience with the CAR RACING & DRIFT & DRIVING & DRAG BUNDLE. This high-octane collection brings together 10 adrenaline-fueled games packed with intense street racing, drifting challenges, drag battles, and open-world driving. Whether you’re a fan of JDM culture, illegal night races, high-speed police chases, or deep car customization, this bundle has everything you need to satisfy your need for speed.

FEATURES
	•	Street Racing & Drifting – Master the art of drifting and dominate the underground racing scene with legendary 90s JDM cars and modern performance machines.
	•	Ultimate Car Customization – Swap engines, fine-tune performance, upgrade suspensions, and apply stunning vinyls to create your dream car.
	•	Drag Racing & Speed Battles – Take your ride to the streets, fine-tune gear ratios, and push your car to its limits in head-to-head drag races.
	•	Open-World Driving – Explore neon-lit cities, Japanese highways, and thrilling circuits in an immersive open-world setting.
	•	Multiplayer & PVP Modes – Challenge players worldwide in intense online drift battles, time attack races, and police chases.
	•	Realistic Driving Physics – Feel the power of real engine sounds, dynamic weather, and detailed car handling mechanics.

With 10 games combined into one action-packed bundle, this is the ultimate experience for every racing and drifting enthusiast. Are you ready to push your skills to the limit and become the king of the streets?

Travel through Tesana Valley to find a secretly hidden missing piece of artifact to enhance your bow. The Dark Power is coming from the north. You need to destroy the source of this power before it's too late. You are the last one that can reach that destination. At least you need to try, for your loved ones!

-Stylized and colorful world
-Fully voice acted emotional story
-Stealth mechanics, arrows crafting, climbing sequences and light puzzle solving
-A short story-driven game (to finish in one evening)

-A dedicated photo mode with multiple options to modify: pose, camera effects, stickers, face mimics etc.

Experience the ultimate simulation adventure with SIMULATORS MEGA BUNDLE – a must-have collection for every simulation enthusiast! Dive into five thrilling worlds where you take control of powerful machines, manage businesses, and conquer challenging environments.

What’s inside the bundle?
	•	Tow Truck Driver Simulator 2023 – Rescue stranded vehicles, navigate through city streets, and build your own towing empire!
	•	Construction Simulator – Operate heavy machinery, complete challenging construction projects, and expand your business!
	•	Farming Tractor Simulator 2023 – Cultivate crops, raise animals, and run a successful farm in an open-world farming experience!
	•	Off-Road Racing Simulator – Conquer extreme terrains, customize your 4x4 vehicles, and prove your skills in adrenaline-fueled races!
	•	City Bus Driving Simulator – Navigate a bustling metropolis, pick up passengers, and become the ultimate bus driving legend!

Why choose SIMULATORS MEGA BUNDLE?
	•	Diverse Gameplay – Experience five unique and immersive simulation genres.
	•	Realistic Physics – Authentic vehicle handling and mechanics for maximum immersion.
	•	Business & Strategy – Manage resources, expand your empire, and thrive in each simulation.
	•	Endless Customization – Upgrade and personalize your vehicles and equipment.

Whether you’re a fan of trucks, construction, farming, off-road racing, or city driving, this bundle has everything you need to test your skills and enjoy hours of engaging gameplay.
Get behind the wheel, take control, and master every challenge – all in one incredible bundle!

Get ready for a thrilling duo of fast-paced, brick-stacking action with Bridge Race and Stacky Dash!

Bridge Race - Grab your bricks, get building, and race to the finish line before your rivals even lay their first stone! Collect bricks of your color and build your bridge to the next level. Got some extra bricks? Use them to expand your castle and unlock quirky new brick designs!

Stacky Dash - Slide to collect tiles, build paths, and race through colorful levels full of exciting surprises. Dodge blasting cannons, and zip through portals as you conquer each tricky stage!

Ready to build, stack, and dash your way to the top?

+ 10 characters, 220 skills, 180 talents, over 400 equipments, and more than 200 equipment affixes. Plus, endless stage challenges that never stop!

+ Idle Gameplay: Enjoy a laid-back, stress-free experience where the game truly helps you unwind and relax. Even when you're taking a break, your devils will keep fighting, ensuring you continue to grow stronger.

+ Rich Loot and Equipment System:
During battles, every enemy you defeat has a chance to drop equipment. The equipment quality is determined by the stage level and treasure rank, with higher-quality equipment offering more diverse affixes. There’s even a chance to obtain exclusive, rare affixes to supercharge your power in combat!
70070000026980.intro: Summon your devils to form the ultimate devil squad! Watch your power grow every moment, even when you're away! Are you ready to become the new Devil King?
70070000026980.name: Idle Devils (Deluxe Edition)

70070000026986.description:
West Escape throws you into a chaotic frontier where the law is on your tail and alien invaders are wreaking havoc. As a fugitive desperate to reunite with your lost love, you'll need to collect scrap, upgrade your gear, and face off against relentless extraterrestrial threats.

Features:
- Premium Equipment: Equip to gain extra tool and weapon damage, twice the loot from expeditions and reduced crafting time!
- Rare Gear and more: Obtain rare and uncommon equipment to boost your power level!
- Bonus currency: Get 2000 gems and spend them to progress even faster!
- High-Energy Combat: Dodge enemy attacks and blast aliens with powerful weapons like revolvers and shotguns.
- Gear Upgrades: Collect scrap and loot to upgrade weapons and gear, boosting stats like speed and damage.
- Explosive Expeditions: Venture into dangerous areas to uncover new gear, resources, and challenges.
- Wild West Meets Sci-Fi: Experience a unique fusion of classic Western adventure and alien invasion chaos.
- Fast-Paced Progression: Keep moving forward with nonstop action, upgrades, and intense encounters.

Fast-paced combat keeps you on your toes—dodge deadly attacks and strike back with revolvers, shotguns, and more. Every battle and upgrade brings you one step closer to freedom and the ultimate showdown in this explosive mix of Wild West grit and sci-fi action.

Saddle up, lock and load—freedom and love are waiting on the other side of this alien-infested frontier!
70070000026986.intro: Outrun the law, blast aliens, and fight for love in the wildest ride through the Wild West!
70070000026986.name: West Escape: Complete Edition

70070000026994.description:
Bomb Cat takes inspiration from classic 2048 games but elevates the challenge with an insane bomb mechanic. In other words, it’s pretty simple – match the fluffy cats carefully, and watch out – the bombastic Bomb Cat can either assist you or completely disrupt your game.


2048 MATCH GAME WITH A BANG… OR A BOMB?
There are eleven fluffy cats, starting with sweet tiny blue kitten babies to match together. Each cat has a different weight depending on its size. Your goal is to achieve the highest score without running out of space.

To increase the challenge, a Bomb Cat will occasionally appear... to activate this kitty’s ability, it needs to touch the Flamey Cat. That’s when the explosion’s countdown starts!

Depending on the circumstances, the blast can help you match smaller cats, as they will jump around the box, or end your game, as the cats can pop out of the open parcel and fly into space. Just like typical cats.


BE A COMBO HERO
Take the challenge of making your score furry freaking best. The more cats you match, the bigger your combo, which translates to more points.

Placing the cats strategically will help you maximize your score.

Unlock new Wild Cat Mode along with Spring Background and Summer Background DLCs included in this bundle.

KEY FEATURES:
– Eleven colorful cats to match like in classic 2048
– Possibility of sending cats to the Moon and back
– One special cat – Cat Bomb to make the game more challenging
– Combo mechanic to make your score even better
– Easy controlling, but challenging gameplay (sometimes)
– Endless and addictive fun
– Enjoyable music, which you can always turn off
– Once again... CATS (No regrets, cats are superior to other animals; deal with it already)
70070000026994.intro: Match ultra-fluffy cats to achieve the highest score and unleash chaos with Bomb Cat.
70070000026994.name: Bomb Cat Purrfect Edition

70070000027004.description:
When a friend gets captured, Maki comes to her rescue! Fight your way through five diverse locations with funky fresh minigames, and conquer the dangerous opponents that stand in your way!


FEEL THE 90S IN AN ANIMAL STYLE — Maki: Paw of Fury’s combat elements are inspired by the hit beat ‘em up arcade games from the 90s, while the story of Maki takes place in the original world of Pangea. Animals rule here, and they’re passionate about sports, technology, and lifelong friendships. Speaking of, one is about to be on the brink of breaking!


A FRIEND IN NEED, A FIGHT INDEED — Maki gets a pleading call for help and realizes that his dear friend - Mapu - has betrayed him. Here starts the road of Maki: The Paw of Fury! He might look adorable, but don’t mistake his fox cuteness for weakness - he has studied the martial art of Tsume no Ken and can wield a tuna like a professional.


MAKI ISN’T ALONE — You can choose to play Maki the fox, but you can also choose Tincho, the muscular capybara, and Maka, the colorful otter who will show your enemies the power of music. Each of these characters is unique when it comes to looks, strength, and fighting style!

Unlock Maki Aviator and Tincho Nerd skins, included in this bundle.

VIBE WITH THE MUSIC AND THE WONDERFUL WORLD OF PANGEA — While all the fighting’s going on it’s hard to appreciate the visuals. But if you stand down just for a moment you’ll be able to appreciate the stunning views of Pangea’s world! You’’ travel through dark ninja forests, icy planes, and desert dunes in the tune of energetic and fighting-ready tracks.
70070000027004.intro: Beat ‘em up and Retro Arcade game enjoyers – welcome to the world of Pangea!
70070000027004.name: Maki: Paw of Fury Ultimate Edition

70070000027042.description:
Enroll in the Special Defense Unit today! The Hundred Line -Last Defense Academy- Digital Deluxe Edition includes the following content.

Base Game
Digital Art Book
Digital Soundtrack

Takumi Sumino is a totally average teenager living in the Tokyo Residential Complex, a place where every day is much like the last and nothing bad ever happens. All that changes when freakish monsters attack the town and start wreaking havoc. A strange creature calling itself Sirei appears and offers Takumi the power to protect those he holds dear... All he has to do is stab himself in the chest!

The next thing he knows, Takumi is in Last Defense Academy, a colossal school in the middle of nowhere surrounded by a wall of otherworldly flames. He and 14 other students have been drafted into the Special Defense Unit, a team tasked with keeping the school safe for the next 100 days. Initiated students transform their blood into the mysterious Hemoanima, a unique type of mutated blood which provides supernatural abilities. How much are they willing to sacrifice to take back their normal lives and save the world from the grotesque school invaders? The curtain rises on 100 days of war and despair...

Extreme Despair-Filled Endings
Takumi's choices will decide his future, but there's no telling what kinds of consequences these decisions might have...

Defensive Battles
When the invaders attack, it's up to Takumi to protect the school in tactical RPG battles. Use each student's unique Specialist Skills to turn the tide of battle in his favor!

Free Time & Exploration
Spend time with Takumi’s teammates to deepen his bonds with them, or explore the wilderness and ruins outside the school. Players can even use the items found to craft gifts and get even closer to Takumi’s allies!
70070000027042.intro: A deluxe set containing The Hundred Line -Last Defense Academy- base game, digital art book, and digital soundtrack.
70070000027042.name: The Hundred Line -Last Defense Academy- Digital Deluxe Edition

70070000027048.description:
Welcome to the perfect vacation getaway: Borgo Marina. Be warned, there’s mysteries around every corner in this Italian paradise. Befriend the locals, find clues, and play your cards right to uncover the town’s secrets in this story-driven adventure.


On Your Tail Original Soundtrack

Dive into the most unique timeless vacation with the On Your Tail Original Soundtrack!

Featuring 23 tracks composed by Pietro Milanesi, this collection brings 41 minutes of immersive music straight from the charming town of Borgo Marina. Includes the standout single "Ricominciare", performed by the talented Kimono.

Don't just play the game—experience it!


On Your Tail Digital Artbook

Uncover the secrets of Borgo Marina with the Official On Your Tail Artbook!

Dive into 244 pages of behind-the-scenes content, never-before-seen artwork, and a heartfelt foreword from the developers.

This vibrant journey takes you through the creation of On Your Tail, from its earliest concepts to the final designs. A must-have for fans and art enthusiasts alike!

70070000027049.description:
Artifact Seeker: Resurrection is a 3D Roguelike Survivor RPG game. A game of gods, with Aurorium as the board, And all the mortals as their pawns and swords. You can obtain artifacts by slaying corrupted enemies, collecting gold to exchange it for artifacts at mysterious merchants. How to use the power of artifacts, to play the game of gods? to end the game of gods or to become a god yourself. Artifact Seeker, Your choice.

Mortia, once the glory of the dwarven kingdom, birthed countless legendary master craftsmen. However, the dwarves never knew when to stop digging. Deep within the mines of Mortia, they unearthed something that should not have been awakened. Thus, Mortia sank into an endless darkness, never to see the light of day again.
The new DLC for Artifact Seeker, “The Legacy of Mortia” is coming soon! New characters, new maps, new boss, new Synergy, new artifacts, new events, and many more new contents await everyone’s exploration!

70070000027085.description:
Rune Factory: Guardians of Azuma Digital Deluxe includes the main game plus the "Seasons of Love" Romance Scenarios, and the "Marvelous Swimsuits" and "Festive Attire & Dark Woolby" bundles.

■"Seasons of Love" Romance Scenarios
Love is blooming in Azuma! With the Seasons of Love DLC Pack, you can unlock the romance scenarios for Cuilang and Pilika. Explore compelling romance scenarios and forge deeper connections as these enigmatic characters open their hearts to you.

■ Festive Attire & Dark Woolby Bundle
Celebrate in style with this elegant Festive Attire for Subaru and Kaguya. With a striking dark color palette, this refined yet timeless look is perfect for any special occasion.

■Marvelous Swimsuit Bundle
Because love is about enjoying life's little moments, this DLC also unlocks a ‘Marvelous Swimsuit’ for each marriage candidate, offering an alternative seaside style with bespoke designs for each character.

Choose from one of two protagonists whose destinies are intertwined by mysterious forces. Use sacred treasures to fight against the Blight’s many forms to restore the people, and even gods, to their natural glory. Take farming further, as you’ll manage more than a plot, rebuilding entire villages and cultivating new allies and resources along the way. Explore seasonal-themed villages heavily inspired by traditional Japanese culture, each with brand-new festivals and revamped fan-favorites, as well as charming romance candidates.

Key Features

■Bold New Abilities and Weapons
As an Earth Dancer, use the power of dance, sacred treasures, and fresh weapons like the Bow and Talisman to purify the land, your farms, and undo the Blight’s damage.

■It Takes a Village
Don’t just mind the farm—rebuild entire villages! Construct and place buildings, enticing people to return to the villages and contribute. Revive the gods to bring vitality and valuable resources back to the plagued lands.

■Your Fantasy Japanese Life
Experience beautiful Japanese-inspired character designs and aesthetics—from festivals to events to monsters. Explore Azuma’s natural landscapes and its seasonal-themed locales steeped in tradition.

■Classic Romance and Relationships
Choose between male and female protagonists, then befriend or romance any of the eligible candidates in fully voiced scenarios. Recruit these new friends to aid you in battle, too!
70070000027085.intro: Battle corrupted monsters, rebuild seasonal farms and villages, and form bonds with the colorful locals along the way.
70070000027085.name: Rune Factory: Guardians of Azuma Digital Deluxe Edition

Keep things cute with additional hairstyles, or go full-on adorable with alpaca and chick costumes.

Bring the winds of change to Zephyr Town
Build your farm in Zephyr Town and breathe new life into the once-famous bazaar. Set up your stall to sell produce and goods from the crops and animals you raise on your farm, and meet charming townsfolk to befriend and romance as you help the close-knit community thrive.

Key Features

■Breathe the refreshing alpine air!
Begin your idyllic new life on a farm and enjoy the daily rhythms of rural living. Nurture a variety of crops and care for adorable animals in the picturesque mountainside settlement of Zephyr Town.

■Soar to Success in the Weekly Bazaar
Sell your farm's produce and goods at the lively weekly bazaar. Customize your stall and take charge of your sales to build buzz, power up profits and put Zephyr Town’s Grand Bazaar back on the map.

■An Easy-Breezy New Life
Harness the power of the wind! Catch a breeze to effortlessly drift across the town on your glider, and use windmills to gather those gusts to create new goodies to sell at the bazaar.

■Love is in the Air
Meet the cherished community of Zephyr Town with a colorful cast of characters, from friendly townsfolk to magical nature sprites. Find friendship, fall in love, and maybe even start a family with one of twelve charming individuals ready to share this new chapter with you.
70070000027086.intro: Build your farm in Zephyr Town and breathe new life into the once-famous bazaar

70070000027087.description:
Welcome to The Smurfs: Colorful Stories, a place where your creativity and imagination lead to creating unique tales. Visit their village like you are one of them and experience amazing adventures - Smurfs can’t wait to meet you!


ALL CHARACTERS IN ONE PLACE
You don’t have to worry you will miss your favourite Smurfette or Grouchy Smurf. They all gathered here, so you can get to know each one of them, while they tell you their stories. Just relax and take a look at what they have prepared for you.


MULTIPLE TOOLS
In order to make every story personal, the game offers a lot of tools to choose from. You decide what color, brush size, or tool type to use. Try to mix different options to achieve a surprising effect.

This bundle includes three Personal Boards DLCs.

KEY FEATURES:
- All your favourite blue creatures!
- 14 categories full of drawings
- Unlimited options for creating your personal story
- Cartoon type soundtrack

The Short N Sweet Collection brings four acclaimed indie gems together in one vibrant bundle.

FoodBoy — 1980's Paperboy meets 2020's Food Delivery Service in an exciting, stylish arcade adventure.
HolyHunt — A love letter to the 8-bit era in a punishing, rewarding, tight retro top-down shooter.
Mirrored Souls — A mind-bending “single-player-coop” puzzle-platformer in a beautifully illustrated soothing, lovely game.
UDO — A delicious arcade down-scroller roguelike where you dig into a creepy hole with an oversized drill!

Perfect for players who want instant, plug‑and‑play fun, addictive adventures without demanding hours

70070000027098.description:
Music Box is a drum machine app in the form of a handheld, easy-to-use mixing board, allowing you to create a variety of percussion beats. Compose everything that is playing in your soul and feel like a real DJ!


FEEL THE BEAT
At your disposal there will be a panel with a 16-step sequencer, where you will program your drum beat step by step. Whether you have heavier rock sounds or melancholic jazz in your heart, Music Box will have something to suit you.


ALL THE DRUMS AT YOUR FINGERTIPS
Snare drums, toms, cymbals – mix and match percussion elements to create the perfect beat. Switch between different genres, experiment and test your musical ear. There are countless settings at your disposal!

Unlock new sounds from Dance, Electro Pop genres and mix them for creating rhythmic beats.

- 3 different genre sets: Rock, Jazz, Acoustic,
- Every set includes 8 different sounds - a whole drum kit!
- Play your beats in real time or…
- …arrange them with 16-step sequencer
- Mix sounds together and control the tempo

70070000027103.description:
Experience the ultimate driving and vehicle simulation with the Truck / Real Car Driving / Offroad / Motorcycle / Demolish Derby Bundle! This collection includes five thrilling games, each offering unique driving challenges, stunning environments, and realistic mechanics. Whether you’re delivering cargo, racing through city streets, conquering offroad terrain, riding high-speed motorcycles, or wrecking cars in demolition derbies, this bundle has it all!

	•	Real Truck Simulator USA Car Games - Driving Games, Parking Sim, Car Speed Racing 2022
Become an American truck driver and take on the challenge of transporting cargo across vast landscapes. Upgrade your truck, manage fuel, and navigate highways while following traffic rules. Experience realistic trucking with dynamic weather, day-night cycles, and a deep economic system.

	•	Real Car Driving Simulator & Parking 2022 Games
If you’re passionate about high-end cars, this game is for you! Drive luxury vehicles through expansive cities, test your driving skills, and explore diverse maps with challenging missions. With realistic driving physics, customizable cars, and high-speed thrills, this game is the perfect driving simulator experience.

	•	Ultimate 4x4 Offroad Trucks :Car Racing Driving Simulator 2022
Take on extreme offroad driving challenges with a variety of rugged vehicles. Navigate through deserts, snowy mountains, muddy roads, and forests. Experience dynamic weather, realistic vehicle physics, and full customization as you conquer the wildest terrains.

	•	Motorcycle Driving Simulator-Dirt & Parking 2022 Racing Games Ultimate 4x4 City Offroad Kart
Expand your motorcycle collection, customize your ride, and dominate the streets in multiple racing modes! Perform stunts, drift through traffic, and complete exciting missions. With realistic bike physics, turbocharged engines, and immersive city environments, this game is perfect for motorcycle enthusiasts.

	•	Demolish Derby Nitro-Battle Driving Car Games 2022 Deluxe Driver
Unleash destruction in this high-speed car crashing simulator! Choose from a variety of vehicles, complete insane stunts, and wreck everything in sight. With realistic crash physics, detailed damage models, and massive arenas, the thrill of destruction has never been more fun!

Why Choose This Bundle?
	•	Five unique driving experiences in one package
	•	Realistic physics, vehicle handling, and environments
	•	Open-world exploration, missions, and challenges
	•	Customization options for trucks, cars, motorcycles, and offroad vehicles
	•	Thrilling demolition derby with detailed car damage mechanics

Get behind the wheel and experience the ultimate driving bundle today!

70070000027103.name: TRUCK / REAL CAR DRIVING / Offroad / Motorcycle / DEMOLISH DERBY BUNDLE

70070000027108.description:
Rail Route - Deluxe Edition will take your love for railway management to the next level!
This edition includes the base game and the mesmerizing official soundtrack with music player in-game!

Rail Route - Base Game
Start with a simple network and transform it into a sprawling, fully automated railway empire! Whether you’re planning efficient routes, upgrading infrastructure, or optimizing train schedules, every decision impacts the flow of your network.

The Official Soundtrack & Music Player
Immerse yourself in the atmospheric compositions of Rupert Cole, a soothing mix of neoclassical piano and string melodies designed to keep you calm amidst the controlled chaos of railway management.
70070000027108.intro: Rail Route - Deluxe Edition: Includes the base game and soundtrack!

70070000027110.description: Book Supermarket: Library Manager Simulator Complete Edition is the ultimate all-in-one package for aspiring bookstore moguls! This edition combines the main game with all DLCs, offering a complete experience where you can manage, expand, and customize your bookstore to perfection. Stock up on bestsellers, manage inventory, optimize storage, and attract a loyal customer base. With new products, licensing options, and strategies for growth, you’ll be able to create the bookstore of your dreams. Everything you need to succeed in the world of literature and retail is right here!
70070000027110.intro: Everything you need to build your Bookstore Empire – all in one edition!
70070000027110.name: Book Supermarket: Library Manager Simulator Complete Edition

70070000027111.description:
Gas Station Simulator is all about renovating, expanding and running a gas station along a highway in the middle of a desert. Freedom of choice and multiple approaches to run your business and deal with pressure are key ingredients in this game.

Buy an abandoned gas station in the middle of nowhere and restore it to its former glory. Get rid of debris and broken furniture, fix up the walls, paint and decorate the place to your liking. Just don’t spend all your cash on the looks right away, you bought a gas station after all. Repair the equipment, buy what can’t be repaired and start serving your customers to earn money for further renovations and improvements.

Let the party begin
There is nothing like a cool night party in the middle of nowhere. When the normal customer traffic goes down, this might be another revenue stream to open up. Create a great party spot to attract people, offer them interesting products and cater to their needs. The more successful your parties and the more the partygoers are satisfied, the more money you earn and the bigger the party.

It is more story-driven than what we did in the past and it allows you to build a small airstrip close to your gas station.
Meet Joe
Joe is an old pilot flying an old single engine plane. He is a bit strange and one day
approaches you to help him with his endeavours. For that he needs a place to land in the
middle of nowhere to make a stop halfway to his destination. In return he is willing to cut you
in on his deals.
70070000027111.intro: Buy an abandoned gas station and restore it to its full glory. Renovate, upgrade and expand upon the offered services to keep up with your clients demands.
70070000027111.name: Gas Station Simulator, Airstrip DLC and Party Time DLC Bundle

70070000027136.description:
Rune Factory: Guardians of Azuma Super Digital Deluxe includes the main game plus the "Season of Love" Romance Scenarios, and the "Marvelous Swimsuits" and "Festive Attire & Dark Woolby" bundles. It also includes a Digital Artbook and Soundtrack app.

■"Seasons of Love" Romance Scenarios
Love is blooming in Azuma! With the Seasons of Love DLC Pack, you can unlock the romance scenarios for Cuilang and Pilika. Explore compelling romance scenarios and forge deeper connections as these enigmatic characters open their hearts to you.

■ Festive Attire & Dark Woolby Bundle
Celebrate in style with this elegant Festive Attire for Subaru and Kaguya. With a striking dark color palette, this refined yet timeless look is perfect for any special occasion.

■Marvelous Swimsuit Bundle
Because love is about enjoying life's little moments, this DLC also unlocks a ‘Marvelous Swimsuit’ for each marriage candidate, offering an alternative seaside style with bespoke designs for each character.

■Rune Factory: Guardians of Azuma Digital Artbook and Soundtrack
A Digital Artbook and Soundtrack App featuring 134 pages of exclusive artwork, including illustrations of characters, monsters, and development materials. Enjoy all 56 music tracks from Rune Factory: Guardians of Azuma at your leisure.

Please note: The Digital Artbook and Soundtrack App is a separate application from the main game.


Choose from one of two protagonists whose destinies are intertwined by mysterious forces. Use sacred treasures to fight against the Blight’s many forms to restore the people, and even gods, to their natural glory. Take farming further, as you’ll manage more than a plot, rebuilding entire villages and cultivating new allies and resources along the way. Explore seasonal-themed villages heavily inspired by traditional Japanese culture, each with brand-new festivals and revamped fan-favorites, as well as charming romance candidates.

Key Features

■Bold New Abilities and Weapons
As an Earth Dancer, use the power of dance, sacred treasures, and fresh weapons like the Bow and Talisman to purify the land, your farms, and undo the Blight’s damage.

■It Takes a Village
Don’t just mind the farm—rebuild entire villages! Construct and place buildings, enticing people to return to the villages and contribute. Revive the gods to bring vitality and valuable resources back to the plagued lands.

■Your Fantasy Japanese Life
Experience beautiful Japanese-inspired character designs and aesthetics—from festivals to events to monsters. Explore Azuma’s natural landscapes and its seasonal-themed locales steeped in tradition.

■Classic Romance and Relationships
Choose between male and female protagonists, then befriend or romance any of the eligible candidates in fully voiced scenarios. Recruit these new friends to aid you in battle, too!
70070000027136.intro: Battle corrupted monsters, rebuild seasonal farms and villages, and form bonds with the colorful locals along the way.
70070000027136.name: Rune Factory: Guardians of Azuma Super Digital Deluxe Edition

70070000027137.description:

■Trunk of Transformation
Mix up your style with a customization collection that's sure to get townsfolk talking!

Keep things cute with additional hairstyles, or go full-on adorable with alpaca and chick costumes.
Seeking something stealthy? This set includes ninja outfits, a ninja glider, and even ninja-themed bazaar customizations!

Alpaca Costume Sets

A Digital Art Book & Soundtrack App featuring 115 pages of exclusive artwork, including illustrations of characters, animals, and development materials. Enjoy all 66 music tracks from STORY OF SEASONS: Grand Bazaar at your leisure.

Please note: The Digital Art Book and Soundtrack App is a separate application from the main game.


Bring the winds of change to Zephyr Town
Build your farm in Zephyr Town and breathe new life into the once-famous bazaar. Set up your stall to sell produce and goods from the crops and animals you raise on your farm, and meet charming townsfolk to befriend and romance as you help the close-knit community thrive.

Key Features

■Breathe the refreshing alpine air!
Begin your idyllic new life on a farm and enjoy the daily rhythms of rural living. Nurture a variety of crops and care for adorable animals in the picturesque mountainside settlement of Zephyr Town.

■Soar to Success in the Weekly Bazaar
Sell your farm's produce and goods at the lively weekly bazaar. Customize your stall and take charge of your sales to build buzz, power up profits and put Zephyr Town’s Grand Bazaar back on the map.

■An Easy-Breezy New Life
Harness the power of the wind! Catch a breeze to effortlessly drift across the town on your glider, and use windmills to gather those gusts to create new goodies to sell at the bazaar.

■Love is in the Air
Meet the cherished community of Zephyr Town with a colorful cast of characters, from friendly townsfolk to magical nature sprites. Find friendship, fall in love, and maybe even start a family with one of twelve charming individuals ready to share this new chapter with you.
70070000027137.intro: Build your farm in Zephyr Town and breathe new life into the once-famous bazaar
70070000027137.name: STORY OF SEASONS: Grand Bazaar Super Digital Deluxe Edition

Travel through Tesana Valley to find a secretly hidden missing piece of artifact to enhance your bow. The Dark Power is coming from the north. You need to destroy the source of this power before it's too late. You are the last one that can reach that destination. At least you need to try, for your loved ones!

Mini Market Design is a creative sandbox game where you can design and decorate your very own mini market. With 8 unique store layouts, you have the freedom to create the perfect shopping experience—arrange shelves, add stylish displays, and choose decorations that suit your vision.


Explore around 510 different furniture and decor items, and set the mood with beautiful wallpapers and flooring. Get hyped for the legendary franchise to return with Tony Hawk’s™ Pro Skater™ 3 + 4. Everything you loved is back, but revamped with more skaters, new parks, gnarlier tricks, eardrum shattering music, plus a whole lot more.

- Reunite the crew with cross-platform online Multiplayer* for up to 8 skaters in new and returning game modes.
- Drop in to new parks or tear it up across the timeless parks from both Tony Hawk’s™ Pro Skater™ 3 & Tony Hawk’s™ Pro Skater™ 4, authentically remade in jaw dropping HD resolution with streamlined goals and the epic 2-minute format.
