70070000030768.description:
Set out on an unforgettable ocean adventure with Raft Survival Simulator, now bundled with the Skin Upgrade DLC! Start your journey stranded on a small makeshift raft and transform it into a thriving floating haven. Explore the ocean, gather resources, craft tools, fend off sharks, and expand your raft to survive the challenges of the high seas.

Key Features:
- Raft Survival Simulator - Find yourself in the middle of the ocean on a small, makeshift raft, and your task is to turn this modest means of transportation into a thriving floating haven.
- Skin Upgrade DLC - Transform your survival base on the ocean with a unique skin for your raft.

Embark on this thrilling survival journey and make every moment on the open ocean count.
70070000030768.intro: Survive, upgrade, and explore the open ocean!
70070000030768.name: Raft Survival Simulator: Ocean Adventure

70070000030770.description:
Travel the cosmos with Mario in these two classic games—now with enhanced resolution, improved UI, and additional content on Nintendo Switch!

Use button, stick, and motion controls—adapted to the Joy-Con™ controllers from the original Wii™ versions—to jump, glide, swing, and more as you collect Power Stars and power-ups. Learn more about the Lumas from additional Storybook chapters, and groove to all the game’s music, including a few additional tracks, in soundtrack mode. You can also give yourself additional Health and fall recovery with Assist Mode and use compatible amiibo™ figures* for a little extra help in your adventure. The galaxy awaits!

Save** on the Super Mario Galaxy™ and Super Mario Galaxy™  2 games  when you purchase the bundle!

Save the galaxy from Bowser and his minions in the original planet-hopping adventure

Bowser has attacked the Star Festival, abducted Princess Peach, and put the whole galaxy in danger! Join up with Rosalina and the Lumas, protectors of the cosmos, to restore the Comet Observatory and rescue the princess in the Super Mario Galaxy™ game. Use power-ups like the Bee Mushroom to fly, the Boo Mushroom to float and move through certain types of barriers, and more on your journey to reclaim the Power Stars!

Travel aboard Starship Mario to save the galaxy again…this time with Yoshi’s help!

Bowser is at it again, but this time Mario has a little extra help in recovering the Power Stars. Join Lubba aboard Starship Mario for the duration of your journey, and team up with Yoshi to enhance your planet-hopping moves in the Super Mario Galaxy™ 2 game.  With Yoshi by your side, you can jump higher and further—and you can even attack foes using his tongue! Yoshi has his own power-ups too, like the Dash Pepper and the Blimp Fruit, which allow him to sprint super quickly, float Mario high into the air, and more.

Download the free update for improved visuals and mouse controls on the Nintendo Switch 2 system

Enhance your adventure even further with a free update to take advantage of the processing power of Nintendo Switch 2 features! This update brings visuals in 4K resolution*** and allows a second player to use mouse controls for collecting Star Bits and attacking enemies.
70070000030770.intro: Journey through space in two Super Mario adventures, now improved for the Nintendo Switch™ system!
70070000030770.name: Super Mario Galaxy™ + Super Mario Galaxy™ 2

70070000030771.description:
Mysterious distortions have appeared without warning in Lumiose City. They seem to connect to a place known as Hyperspace Lumiose...and the Mythical Pokémon Hoopa has the power to transform them into portals so you can travel there! Hoopa needs your help to do it, though: team up with the mysterious and talented baker, Ansha, to gather Berries and make donuts that will awaken Hoopa’s power and grant you and your Pokémon a variety of useful effects.

Once you’re in Hyperspace Lumiose, join the Mega Evolution successor, Korrina, and Team MZ to investigate its mysteries. Just be sure you’re ready—this otherworldly version of Lumiose City can be a threatening place. The Pokémon here are different, and sometimes rare, with hyperspace levels that can make their total levels exceed the normal limit of 100.

It looks like your story with Team MZ isn’t over yet—continue your journey in Hyperspace Lumiose after completing the main game!

Encounter more newly-discovered Mega Evolutions

As you progress through the Pokémon™ Legends: Z-A – Mega Dimension DLC*, you may encounter more newly-discovered Mega Evolutions, such as two additional ones for Raichu—Mega Raichu X and Mega Raichu Y—as well as Mega Chimecho and Mega Baxcalibur!

Customize your character’s in-game outfit with Holo-X and Holo-Y apparel items

Upon purchasing this DLC, you can claim these Holo-X and Holo-Y in-game apparel items and wear them even during your journey through the main game. Once you unlock the ability to adjust your character’s looks and outfit—about an hour into the main story—you can claim these apparel items by pressing the X Button to open the main menu, and then pressing the − Button to access the Outfit & Looks menu.

The following DLC is included in this purchase:

• Holo-X and Holo-Y apparel items: Available October 16th, 2025
• Additional story content: Available December 10th, 2025
70070000030771.intro: Venture into Hyperspace Lumiose for the next chapter of your adventure!
70070000030771.name: Pokémon™ Legends: Z-A – Mega Dimension DLC

70070000030778.description:
Dive into two completely different yet equally captivating adventures with Fast Food 2025 Simulator and MYSIDE REALITY. Whether you crave a mysterious, mind-bending journey or the thrill of running a fast-paced business, this bundle has it all.

In Fast Food 2025 Simulator, the stakes are different but just as high. Start from a humble food stand and grow into a global fast-food empire. Cook mouthwatering meals, manage your staff, upgrade your kitchen, and dominate the industry with futuristic tools and smart strategies.

In MYSIDE REALITY, you find yourself trapped inside your favorite game, face-to-face with the enigmatic Mira. Every conversation, puzzle, and choice leads you closer to uncovering her true intentions — and the secret of this strange world. Will you find your way home, or lose yourself in the illusion?

From unraveling dark mysteries to sizzling burgers at lightning speed — this bundle offers the best of both worlds.
70070000030778.intro: Step into two worlds of unforgettable adventure.
70070000030778.name: Fast Food 2025 Simulator & MYSIDE REALITY

70070000030779.description:
Plunge into two unique survival experiences that test your courage in completely different worlds.

 Squirrel Madness – Defend a magical tree that grew from a legendary acorn in the middle of a bustling city. Armed with nut blasters, pinecone crossbows, and your unbreakable determination, face endless waves of animal control squads, machines, and city forces determined to bring down your home. Can you protect nature’s last beacon of hope?

 Silent Mist – Step into a forgotten, mist-covered world where fear and uncertainty lurk in every shadow. Your only weapons are your instincts, scarce resources, and the will to uncover the truth hidden deep within the fog. Not all dangers can be seen… and not all memories should be remembered.

From high-octane action to psychological horror, this bundle brings you:
- Two games with contrasting worlds and unique survival challenges.
- An unforgettable mix of intense combat and nerve-racking stealth.
- Stories that pit you against forces both seen and unseen.

Will you fight to protect the light of life, or survive the darkness of fear?
This bundle lets you do both.
70070000030779.intro: Two different worlds, one ultimate fight for survival.
70070000030779.name: Squirrel Madness & Silent Mist

70070000030830.description:
Pre-order to receive a Gold Choice Pack and Early Access on March 13, 2026.

This edition of MLB The Show 26 includes:
• MLB® The Show™ 26
• 20 The Show Packs
• 2 World Baseball Classic Choice Packs
• 1 Legend Choice Pack
• 1 World Baseball Classic Uniform Pack
• 1 Equipment Pack
• Double Daily Rewards

Step up and take control of how you leave your mark in the most immersive MLB® The Show™ yet.

Discover new Road To The Show mechanics, deeper Franchise experiences, enhanced customization options, and true-to-life on-field action.

Road To The Show
NEW – Road to Cooperstown & Expanded Amateur Years Career
Your journey to greatness starts here, which path will you choose?
Earn a coveted spot at the MLB Draft Combine® or catch the eye of one of 11 additional new colleges as you advance through chapters of your career.
Compete in the officially licensed Men’s NCAA® College World Series® as you rise from a promising high school talent to one of the all-time MLB® greats – immortalized in the National Baseball Hall of Fame and maybe even a place on the first ballot.

Diamond Dynasty¹
Unmissable Updates
Build your ultimate fantasy team with a new Red Diamond rarity tier and World Baseball Classic player cards featuring elite game-changing players.
Play revamped Mini-Seasons campaigns as you level up your stars with an upgraded PXP system, customize their skills with Parallel Mods, and hit Parallel V faster through special challenges.

Franchise
NEW – Revamped Front Office Experience
Play the nail-biting key matches and moments of your Franchise GM career with streamlined seasons and Custom Game Entry. Track rumours and strike big deals in the ultimate all-in-one Trade HUB, where a new Trade Logic System delivers real depth, immersion, and high-stakes decision-making. Smarter lineups and improved player regression now mirror the real decisions and realities that shape your organization’s future.

Storyline¹
The Negro Leagues Season 4
The award-winning game mode returns with all-new legends, uniforms, and stadiums – celebrating the stories of some of the most important yet often forgotten ballplayers in history.

Gameplay Updates – More Control Than Ever
Bear Down Pitching: exert total control over your pitches by earning a limited supply of elite focus to deploy in the most critical moments.

Big Zone Hitting: rack up the home runs with more control over your swing placement, giving you a better chance to nail that sweet spot.

¹Internet connection required.
70070000030830.intro: Make your mark. Become a Legend. Own The Show™.
70070000030830.name: MLB® The Show™ 26 - Digital Deluxe Edition

70070000030844.description:
Careful - it’s a hot-dog-eat-hot-dog world out there. So fight to the death and push them all till your enemies are oozing Tomato Blood!!

With this edition you will unlock:
- new Trapdoor stage in each local multiplayer mode!

Battle other sausages on a new, unstable ground. Trigger the trapdoors and watch them fall into the toxic soup!

Release to head-bang and push enemy sausages into sausage wars battle obstacles like sharp tools, kitchen sinks, garden fire, or off the counter to their doom. The crowded city is overcrowded and we need to empty it! Try to push them all, fight and smash those sausages to smithereens!

Don’t forget your hot-diggity-dog victory dance at the end of each sausage wars battle level! Make sure you become the biggest wiener in town!

You're about to dive into a sugary adventure! Combine sweets, and prepare yourself for a sugar overload!

- Candivity: Deep Mines DLC

NEW VERSUS MODE!
Race to merge the biggest candy while using clever tactics to slow down your opponent. Unleash tricky power-ups, and prove who’s the ultimate candy master!

Gather extraordinary powers that can save you from any sticky situation. Mix them up, and you might create something even more powerful!

Journey through worlds full of surprises. Each has its own set of challenges. Can you master them all and merge the largest sweet?

Features:

70070000030852.description:
Step into a labyrinthine nightmare where reality bends and sanity crumbles. This bundle includes the base game ESCAPE - BACKROOMS HORROR and an exclusive DLC that adds a powerful survival tool to your inventory: a pistol loaded with 7 bullets in the chamber and 200 spare rounds.

In the base game, navigate an endless maze of damp carpets, flickering lights, and twisted corridors. Face unknown horrors, hide or confront terrifying creatures, and survive through diverse rooms, each presenting new challenges and fears. Use your camcorder to capture the horrors and add a strategic layer to your survival.

With the Arm Yourself DLC, you are armed to face the maze’s darkest threats. The pistol gives you a fighting chance against the relentless dangers lurking in every shadow, making every decision and every shot crucial.

This bundle offers the ultimate survival horror experience: explore the twisted Backrooms, confront terrifying creatures, and arm yourself to survive the unimaginable. Can you escape this endless nightmare?
70070000030852.intro: Explore, fight, and survive the labyrinth of horrors.
70070000030852.name: ESCAPE - BACKROOMS HORROR: Nightmare

70070000030853.description:
Your quest is simple... rescue as many survivors as you can by killing all the walking dead!

Features:
- Hordes of zombies
- Interactive surroundings
- Fire power up
- 3 new helicopter skins
- 3 new weapon sights
- Legendary zombie and survivor skin
- 10000 additional coins to spend
- Levels with rewards and bigger zombies!
- Skins for zombies, survivors and helicopters
- Fun and addictive gameplay
- Lots of shooting!

Zombies run and climb on buildings very fast, so make sure to shoot quickly and precisely. If there are too many of them, use your surroundings - shoot at exploding barrels, destroy bridges, and glass roofs or just drop heavy building materials to stop the zombie horde!

Rescue the survivors before they become infected! But beware, after each successful escape, the zombies will become even more challenging. You must apply your strategy in real-time and spot the right target to shoot in order to win!

If you believe that shooting zombies is not just a matter of luck, show your abilities and become the best helicopter sniper ever. Best of luck!
70070000030853.intro: Get to the chopper! Pick up the machine gun and destroy all of the zombies to save your crew!

You’ll not only enjoy the thrill of driving trains, but also the freedom to personalize your experience and push the limits with high-speed travel. It’s the complete package for every subway simulation fan!
70070000030859.intro: Navigate, customize, and conquer the subway tracks.

The Gateway to the Void has opened! The corrupting power it contained has engulfed Petrichor V and plunged the planet into darkness. For millennia, The Void Creatures have grown dominant by taking artifacts from our realm to theirs. Now they look to add you to their collection.
2 New Survivors

2 New Survivors

Note: Some mature content from Dispatch's original version has been modified.

You play as Robert Robertson, AKA Mecha Man, whose mech-suit is destroyed in a battle against his nemesis, forcing him to take a job at a superhero dispatch center: not as a hero, but a dispatcher.

> Shape the Story

70070000031248.description:
Which games are included in The Jackbox Big Bang Bundle?

The Jackbox Party Pack 11 catapults you and your crew into the best timeline of party game pandemonium. Whether you’re a trivia titan, a joke mastermind, or the resident undercover detective of your friend group, there’s something for everyone in your group. This pack includes five brand-new party games and countless laughs:
Doominate (Writing): Take a perfectly lovely situation and destroy it in this head-to-head joke game where it feels so good to be so bad. Doominate supports 3-8 players.
Hear Say (Sound Effects): Record sound effects and dialogue directly from your phone in a foley-inspired game where laughter is the soundtrack. Then, watch your voices come to life in a series of short movie clips! Hear Say supports 2-8 players.
Cookie Haus (Drawing): Play our coziest and kookiest drawing game yet by fulfilling cookie design orders for unusual clientele. Don’t play on an empty stomach! Cookie Haus supports 3-8 players.
Suspectives (Social Deduction): There’s been a crime, one player secretly did it, and the evidence comes from your own survey answers! Study the clues, defend your innocence (even if you’re lying), and put your friends on trial. Suspectives supports 4-8 players.
Legends of Trivia (Trivia): Assemble your team and put your trivia knowledge to the test in a fantastical world full of danger! Trivia! Teamwork! Monsters! Do you dare? Legends of Trivia supports 1-6 players.

The Jackbox Survey Scramble is a standalone game that takes real surveys from real people around the globe. This game is constantly changing based on answers submitted from players, including you! Discover how your fellow players think when it comes to questions like, “In one word, what’s the cutest nickname for butts?” or “In one word, what’s the best sandwich topping?” Enjoy endless replayability with six different game modes:
Hilo: Can you guess the most popular one-word cat names? How about the least? In Hilo, compete to find the most and least popular answers to a wide variety of questions. The rankings may surprise you!
Speed: In the fast-paced Speed, think on your toes to uncover as many answers on the list as possible, as quickly as possible. It’s everyone for themselves in a race against the clock! Each round the points increase, and the stakes get a little higher!
Squares: Two teams compete to claim three squares in a row on the grid. Guess popular choices for the first squares, semi-popular choices for the middle squares, and least popular choices for the final squares.
Bounce: In Bounce, two teams control a paddle that sits on a scale between most popular-to-least popular answers. Work with your team to guess an answer that puts your paddle in the right place to intercept a bouncing ball and stop your opponents from scoring a goal!
Dash: You’re competing against your fellow players: find the most popular answer in a group of options taken from one of our enormous lists to move ahead. Double down on your choice for more progress (or more punishment), send extra choices to your opponent’s list to slow them down, and tune into public opinion to outpace everyone on your way to the finish line.
Dares: You control whether a fellow player must guess something higher or lower on the list than what’s just been revealed. Throw them a nearly impossible challenge… but don’t be shocked when they nail it and rake in the points. After you’ve completed a dare, turn around, share the love and dare another player.
All game modes in The Jackbox Survey Scramble support 2 to 10 players.
70070000031248.intro: The Jackbox Big Bang Bundle includes 6 party games designed to send your night to a new dimension of infinite fun! Perfect for get-togethers with family or friends!
70070000031248.name: The Jackbox Big Bang Bundle

70070000031255.description:
Handling a restaurant has never been easier. In Cozy Cooking: Tiny Tastes you can welcome customers and cook them the most delicious dishes they have ever tasted without breaking a sweat!


It’s high time you showed your culinary skills and prepared amazing meals for your guests who came to finally eat something tasty.

Mix the right ingredients, add a dash of creativity, and voilà, culinary magic right before your eyes! But remember to read the customers’ orders carefully, they can be picky.

Throughout your adventure you will be able to unluck more components and recipes, once you level up from receiving positive feedback from your customers.


What you can find inside your restaurant:
- 172 wonderful recipes.
- 24 unique ingredients.
- 4 different cooking options - blender, pan, pot, or oven

Unlock new decorations for your restaurant with Vintage Vibe, Spooky Season and Valentine's Day DLCs included in this bundle.

The hardest part of this job is not eating the dish before it comes out of the kitchen, they are that delightful!

Take your culinary tools and open the best restaurant in town right away!

70070000031299.description:
West Escape throws you into a chaotic frontier where the law is on your tail and alien invaders are wreaking havoc. As a fugitive desperate to reunite with your lost love, you'll need to collect scrap, upgrade your gear, and face off against relentless extraterrestrial threats.

This bundle includes:
- West Escape
- West Escape: Gambler DLC
- West Escape: Adventurer DLC

Features:
- High-Energy Combat: Dodge enemy attacks and blast aliens with powerful weapons like revolvers and shotguns.
- Gear Upgrades: Collect scrap and loot to upgrade weapons and gear, boosting stats like speed and damage.
- Explosive Expeditions: Venture into dangerous areas to uncover new gear, resources, and challenges.
- Wild West Meets Sci-Fi: Experience a unique fusion of classic Western adventure and alien invasion chaos.
- Fast-Paced Progression: Keep moving forward with nonstop action, upgrades, and intense encounters.
- Silver coin for X2 expedition loot
- Silver bullet for 25% combat power
- Rare Revolver and Sawed-off shotgun
- Rare Gambler vest
- Rare Adventurer boots
- Uncommon Gambler and Adventurer hats
- Uncommon Gambler and Adventurer pants
- Uncommon Gambler boots
- Uncommon Adventurer vest
- 1000 gems

Fast-paced combat keeps you on your toes - dodge deadly attacks and strike back with revolvers, shotguns, and more. Every battle and upgrade brings you one step closer to freedom and the ultimate showdown in this explosive mix of Wild West grit and sci-fi action.

Saddle up, lock and load - freedom and love are waiting on the other side of this alien-infested frontier!
70070000031299.intro: Outrun the law, blast aliens, and fight for love in the wildest ride through the Wild West!
70070000031299.name: West Escape: Gambler & Adventurer Edition

70070000031303.description:
Create, farm, and style your way to success in Cottonville!
Welcome to Cottonville – a cozy dress-up and farming sim where creativity blossoms and fashion takes root! Run your own sewing atelier, grow essential crops, and craft stylish outfits for a charming cast of characters.


A Fresh Start in Cottonville
After leaving the hustle of Friglight, you arrive in peaceful Cottonville to take over a small family sewing shop. Start fresh, grow your business, and build a new life—one stitch at a time.


Customize Your Character
Express yourself! Choose from 18 hair colors, 15 hairstyles, and a variety of eye shapes, mouths, lashes, eyebrows, and skin tones. Dress your character in a wide range of outfits that grow with your fashion journey.


From Farming to Fashion
Cultivate cotton, linen, and bamboo—then harvest natural dyes from flowers to create fabrics in 7 vibrant colors. Craft materials, unlock new sewing patterns, and design custom outfits that reflect your unique style.


Run Your Atelier
Take charge of your boutique with over 60 sewing patterns and 120+ total clothing variations. Listen to customer requests, mix and match fabrics, and tailor outfits that reflect their personalities—from winter sweaters to breezy summer styles.


Features:
- 60+ sewing patterns with multiple color variants (120+ total!)
- 3 farmable crops and 7 dye colors to craft your own fabrics
- Fully customizable character with a wide selection of features
- A charming story about starting over and finding creativity in a cozy town
- Unique customers and outfit requests that evolve with your boutique
- Dive into 60+ hours of fashion-filled farming and storytelling!

This bundle includes Halloween Outfits Pack, High Couture Outfits Pack, Holidays Outfits Pack and Japan 90s DLCs with new additional looks waiting for you.

Grow crops, craft clothes, and chase your fashion dreams—Cottonville awaits you!
70070000031303.intro: Watch your beautiful garden grow, dye fabrics, and turn them into beautiful clothing.
70070000031303.name: Cottonville Nihon Pack

70070000031305.description:
Go fish in the sea, swim, catch species like goldfish, starfish, koi fish and add them to your fish tank to expand your aquarium shop!

This bundle includes:
- Aquarium Land
- Aquarium Land: Baby Seal
- Aquarium Land: Parrot

Drive a motorboat, ride a jet ski or just jump in the water and dive with a friend in multiplayer mode!

Discover amazing places filled with a wide variety of beautiful animals. Discover huge and legendary creatures to attract more visitors. There is a customer for every sea animal, big or tiny, all you have to do is fish with attitude!

Invest in your aquarium shop and explore the sea world like a real fishy tycoon! The more money you earn, the more upgrades and aquariums you can get!

Features:
- many different aquatic worlds
- 2 pets: baby seal and parrot, each with active bonuses that increase fishing speed at sea
- 100+ species to catch
- multiplayer mode up to 2 players
- 20 funny skins to choose from
- character, customer and employee upgrades
- motorboat and jet-ski riding
- different diving styles with cool animations
- aquarium decorations
- ship expeditions
- 2 secret fish you can feed to earn beauty cup points
- 2 fishbowl decorations
- 200 gems

Can you be the best fish tycoon, let the tides lead you and rule your tile aquarium?
70070000031305.intro: Dive into an aquatic world where amazing animals await you!
70070000031305.name: Aquarium Land: Seal & Parrot Edition

70070000031306.description:
Say hello to Neko Bento 2 — a flavor-packed puzzle experience where lunch is still cute, but now even trickier to pack!

This time your favorite feline chef is back with even more riddles to solve! You thought you knew it all? Think again because these levels with brand new ingredients and shapes will put your spatial brain to the test.

Although the challenge has risen, you don’t have to worry too much about that. You may have as much time as you like to complete a puzzle.

What will Neko Bento 2 serve you?
- Over 90 levels to eat up.
- 29 various ingredients to organize - pay attention to their shapes, it’s crucial…
- Music track that will help your mind focus and lock in!
- Artwork that will win your taste over… and not only the music one.

This bundle includes the Chef's Dream 1 DLC, featuring even more levels to complete.

Chefs tend to be impatient, so don’t wait for too long and become the ultimate bento master!
70070000031306.intro: Get ready to stretch your brain and your belly — the cutest lunchbox puzzle is back with even more satisfying challenges!
70070000031306.name: Neko Bento 2 Deluxe Edition

70070000031353.description:
Take command of your very own airline and experience the thrill of global air cargo. From small regional flights to managing a growing fleet, hangars, and airports worldwide, embark on a journey to become a top aviation tycoon.

This bundle includes:
	•	Flight Simulator Delivery: Cargo Business – Build your airline, complete diverse cargo missions, and expand your aviation empire.
	•	Powerlift Cargo DLC – Receive the Heavy Lift Carrier and a dedicated aircraft slot for transporting heavier cargo. Already own the Heavy Lift Carrier? You’ll get $525,000 to invest in upgrades and growth.

Take on bigger missions, expand your fleet, and dominate the skies in this ultimate air cargo experience.
70070000031353.intro: Dominate skies, master logistics, earn glory.
70070000031353.name: Flight Simulator Delivery: Cargo Business - Freight Master

70070000031357.description:
Urban Flow is a game about the subtle beauty of city streets filled with cars moving in perfect harmony. But such order does not happen all by itself - the city needs YOU to control the traffic lights and to make sure everything goes smoothly. That means no crashes, no jams. Everything will run perfectly - as long as you stay focused!

Immerse yourself in a beautiful, hand-crafted, low-poly world to discover the enormous satisfaction of watching the hundreds of tiny, colorful cars flowing through the streets – all while listening to the chill, urban music.

Over 100 levels, each with its own busy intersection. You have one job: operate the lights and keep it safe.

Party Game (even if you party all alone!)
-----
 Play by yourself or with friends in scalable drop-in, drop-out local co-op mode for two, three, or four players!
You can help your friends or be a little rascal and spread the chaos!

Avoid accidents by paying close attention to special vehicles and to the other players. Special vehicles include the ambulance, which can’t wait for long, and the tank – which will plow through anything in its way.

Don’t want to play the campaign?
-----
 Try our score-based Endless Mode or the Chill Mode - where you play for as long as you want, no rush and no score - only you and the music. Urban Flow is designed to be a great single player experience!

Discover various environments and weather conditions. Play with touch controls, Nintendo Switch™ Pro Controllers or Joy-Con™. Complete challenges and unlock rewards.

This bundle includes base game, Expansion Pack and Streets Supplement #3 with:

•    New challenge mode offers medals - no more star system in challenge mode! You have to pass the challenge bar to pass the challenge mode stages.
•    20 new stages
•    5 new vehicles
70070000031357.intro: Manage the city lights and try to avoid the chaos!
70070000031357.name: Urban Flow Green Wave

70070000031361.description:
Step into the world of Gloomy Eyes with complete experience of this cozy horror fairytale - featuring the full game and its haunting 40-track soundtrack.

Gloomy Eyes: A cozy horror, “self-coop”, adventure about two unlikely souls who forge a forbidden bond and journey together to find the sun. Explore eerie yet charming spooky levels, switch between two unique characters, and solve brain-teasing puzzles.

Gloomy Eyes - Soundtrack: Gloomy tunes for gloomy souls! Immerse yourself in 40 tracks of haunting Halloween-inspired melodies and classical horror animation charm. From eerie waltzes to tense, cinematic themes, Gloomy Eyes - Soundtrack captures the dark, whimsical atmosphere of the game. Perfect for setting the mood, whether you’re wandering through moonlit graveyards or facing a slow and inevitable death.
70070000031361.intro: Explore Gloomy Eyes in complete experience of this cozy horror fairytale.

70070000031371.description:
Face the ocean’s dangers and discover its mysteries as you survive on a fragile raft, gathering resources, expanding your floating base, and confronting the fiercest predator in the sea with a brand-new, redesigned look that makes every encounter more thrilling.

Bundle Includes:
- Float Survival Simulator – Ocean Survivor – Gather resources, build and expand your raft, explore mysterious islands, and fight to survive against the unforgiving ocean.
- Shark Upgrade DLC – Face a fearsome shark with a unique new design, adding fresh intensity and immersion to your survival battles.

Take your ocean journey to the next level with the Float Survival Simulator – Ocean Survivor: Predator Rising!
70070000031371.intro: Survive the relentless hunt of ocean predators.
70070000031371.name: Float Survival Simulator – Ocean Survivor: Predator Rising

70070000031375.description:
Magical Bakery:
Magical Bakery is a single-player cooking and management game set in an enchanted bakery that sells all sorts of sweets and pastries, with a twist, they may contain traces of magic!

Lemon Cake:
While the bakery might initially be broken down, overgrown and even haunted, don’t worry! You’ll be able to repair, furnish and decorate every room in the bakery. Gather honey from your beehive, raise a cow to collect fresh milk and adopt a few chickens to add eggs to your recipes. You’ll also be able to grow trees and plants to harvest a variety of fruits.
70070000031375.intro: Serve up sweet delights and enchanting treats in the whimsical worlds of Magical Bakery and Lemon Cake.
70070000031375.name: Bakery Bundle - Lemon Cake + Magical Bakery

70070000031376.description:
Orange Season:
Orange Season is a delightful farm-life RPG inspired by the classics of the genre! Make your farmer dreams come true in the charming Orange Town.

Grow crops, raise animals, fish, and mine to build a successful and profitable farm. Socialize with the residents by helping them out with quests and forge meaningful relationships that will last a lifetime. Take a break from time to time by participating in town festivals and minigames. Explore and farm as you deal with the challenges of your new life in Orange Season!

Garden Witch Life:
You're a little witch from the big city who has just lost her job. Life didn't go as you'd expected, but now you can start anew on a tiny island full of possibilities!

Grow your own magical garden, decorate your ancient treehouse, care for cute creatures, and make friends along the way.
70070000031376.intro: Cultivate your dream farm, befriend the townsfolk, and embrace a cozy life in Orange Season and Garden Witch Life.
70070000031376.name: Farming Adventure Double Pack - Orange Season + Garden Witch Life

70070000031377.description:
Saint Kotar:
In this story-and-choice driven psychological horror detective game, you play as Benedek and Nikolay – two troubled godly men in search for their missing relative in an ancient God-devoted town called Sveti Kotar. Here, an unknown presence preys upon the weak and sways on devil worship and witchcraft. Evidence points to your missing relative being involved in the grisly murders and the occult, but what is the truth? Are you also to blame for what happened?

Charon's Staircase:
In the 1970s, a totalitarian regime known as The Ministry ruled with an iron fist. They committed numerous inhumane and sinister acts during their reign, but those days are over, as they now aspire to join the European Union.

You play as an agent codenamed: ‘Desmond’, sent by The Ministry who is tasked with retrieving and destroying classified documents from the Oack Grove estate, that reveal the horrifying activities that happened in the past. Your journey, however, leads you to an unpleasant and gruesome discovery – Project Alpha.
70070000031377.intro: Face your fears, solve puzzles, and unravel secrets in Saint Kotar and Charon's Staircase.
70070000031377.name: Mystery Horror Bundle - Saint Kotar & Charon's Staircase

70070000031413.description:
Experience the full thrill of running your own trading card empire with the TCG Card Market Simulator: Trading Empire! This complete package gives you everything you need to manage, expand, and dominate your card shop from the very beginning.

The bundle includes:
	•	TCG Card Market Simulator – Start your own card shop, stock booster packs, manage rare collectibles, and organize exciting tournaments to attract trading card fans.
	•	Balance Boost DLC – Your balance grows by 2500 cash, providing the resources to expand faster and smarter.

Whether you’re a new player or looking to enhance your shop, this bundle provides all the tools and rewards you need to build, strategize, and succeed in the competitive world of trading cards.
70070000031413.intro: Build your trading card empire from the ground up.
70070000031413.name: TCG Card Market Simulator: Trading Empire

70070000031418.description:
Explore stunning wild landscapes and experience the authentic challenges of hunting in an open, dynamic world. With a wide range of customizable weapons and ever-changing environments, every hunt becomes a unique and thrilling adventure.

- Hunter Simulator: Wild Hunting – Use a diverse arsenal of weapons and adapt your strategy based on dynamic weather conditions and complex animal behaviors for a truly immersive hunting experience.
-  Tactical Gloves DLC – Adds an exclusive gloves skin to complete your hunter’s gear. If you already own this item, you will receive its coin value instead, giving you the freedom to use your resources as you wish.

Get ready to embark on a wilderness adventure full of challenges and customization, equipped with everything you need right at your fingertips!
70070000031418.intro: Prepare for unpredictable hunts with tactical enhancements.
70070000031418.name: Hunter Simulator: Wild Hunting – Elite Sniper

70070000031419.description:
Experience the thrill of racing and drifting in one powerful package! This edition includes Drift Master Simulator 2024 – Driving Sim along with two exciting DLCs that expand your garage with exclusive cars and customization options.

- Drift Master Simulator 2024: Driving Sim
Immerse yourself in high-speed action with races, time trials, and drift challenges across five dynamic modes. Choose your vehicle, tune it with rims, spoilers, and upgrades, and show your skills on every track.
 - Unlock4 Cars Pack DLC
Add 4 high-performance cars to your garage, designed to deliver speed, precision, and unique style.
- 4 Ultimate Cars Pack DLC
Expand your collection with another 4 legendary drift machines. Unlock them through the special Cars Pack or choose their value in in-game currency to boost your progress.

Take control, customize your ride, and dominate the road—your ultimate drifting journey starts here!
70070000031419.intro: Speed, style, and legendary machines in one pack.
70070000031419.name: Drift Master Simulator 2024 - Driving Sim: Cars Collection

70070000031423.description:
Step into three unique worlds of strategy, management, and high-stakes action with this simulation bundle! Whether you dream of running a successful business, managing a global airport, or pulling off daring heists, this bundle has something for every type of player.

1. TCG Card Market Simulator – Build and expand your very own trading card shop! Stock the hottest booster packs, manage your inventory, and turn your store into a bustling hub for TCG fans while navigating an ever-changing market.
2. Airport Manager Simulator 2025 – Take control of a major international airport, ensuring smooth passenger flow, flawless logistics, and on-time flights. From ground equipment to flight schedules, every detail is in your hands.
3, Heist Simulator 2025 – Master the art of the perfect heist. Plan your strategies, equip yourself with high-tech gear, and outsmart the law in adrenaline-fueled missions that test your stealth and cunning.

With this bundle, you’ll explore the thrill of entrepreneurship, the pressure of global operations, and the excitement of high-risk adventures—all in one package. Are you ready to prove your skills across three worlds where every decision counts?
70070000031423.intro: Business, aviation, and crime – all under your control.
70070000031423.name: TCG Card Market Simulator & Airport Manager Simulator 2025 & Heist Simulator 2025

70070000031424.description:
The "Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Infinity Castle" Character Pass bundle includes all 7 playable characters.

※The additional content included in the Character Pass will be released incrementally, with multiple releases scheduled through September 2026.

What's included:
Tanjiro Kamado (Infinity Castle) Character Pack
Zenitsu Agatsuma (Infinity Castle) Character Pack
Giyu Tomioka (Infinity Castle) Character Pack
Shinobu Kocho (Infinity Castle) Character Pack
Doma Character Pack
Akaza (Infinity Castle) Character Pack
Kaigaku Character Pack
70070000031424.name: "Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Infinity Castle" Character Pass

70070000031436.description:
A third-person, stealth, adventure game focused on the story of the Moonshadow Huntress: Cynthia Stranborg. Take control of the young adept and learn new stealth skills during your journey. Find out what happened in the home village and follow your desired path to rescue the ones you love the most. Travel through Tesana Valley to find a secretly hidden missing piece of artifact to enhance your bow. The Dark Power is coming from the north. You need to destroy the source of this power before it's too late. You are the last one that can reach that destination. At least you need to try, for your loved ones!

Key features:
-Stylized and colorful world
-Fully voice acted emotional story
-Stealth mechanics, arrows crafting, climbing sequences and light puzzle solving
-A short story-driven game (to finish in one evening)
-Several alternative outfits to unlock throughout the game.
-A dedicated photo mode with multiple options to modify: pose, camera effects, stickers, face mimics etc.
70070000031436.name: Cynthia: Hidden in the Moonshadow - Ultra Edition

70070000031451.description:
Experience the full thrill of drifting on Japan’s legendary mountain roads with this complete bundle! Take control of your favorite JDM cars, master every turn, and show off your style with new DLC.

This bundle includes:

Two unforgettable puzzle adventures packed with mystery, exploration, and clever twists - all together in one must-have collection.

70070000031485.description:
Will you manage to completely destroy the wall until not a single brick is left standing?

This bundle includes:
- Bucket Crusher
- Bucket Crusher: Cool Kidz
- Bucket Crusher: Around The World

Immerse yourself in the most satisfying casual game where you tear down walls brick by brick using a circular saw!

Features:
- tear down 11 regular and 16 playful brickwork mosaics using your saw!
- earn coins for each brick you claim and reset your progress to get Prestige Points!
- upgrade your machinery for more power, size, length, and fuel capacity
- buy a variety of improvements: treadmill, tank, multiplier, discount, and servo!
- change the look of your saw with 12 different funny skins!
- relax and de-stress after a long day
- beware, because the game is very addictive!

Push the bricks into your Bucket Crusher to convert them into cash, but watch out because you can run out of fuel!

Once you complete the first wall, there are various colorful and interesting mosaics with different shapes waiting for you to dig into and pull to pieces!

Upgrade your machinery after each level and think carefully about the wisest way to invest your money. Increase the length, power, size, and fuel capacity to get more bricks with every run of the level!

If you want to knock down walls faster and earn more cash, consider buying special permanent upgrades that cost prestige points, but there's a catch here. To get them, you have to reset all your progress!

70070000031485.name: Bucket Crusher: Cool World Edition

- DIY Fashion Star: Stylish Outfits

- Make 2 new hairstyles with beautiful braids!
- Transform your doll's style with 20 new and captivating clothes that will add a touch of sparkle to her look!
- Manage your very own DIY fashion dreamhouse studio from the comfort of your home and make videos of your dolly creations to gain followers. Become a famous fashion super stylist!
- Take pictures of your doll dressed in your DIY designer outfits and compete in selfie contests with other DIYers!
- Get a stunning, sweet doll makeover to look extra pretty in your DIY clothing. Dye your doll's hair, get her a new hairstyle, and do her makeup!

You're about to blow the world away with all of your fabulously stylish DIY fashion design skills to give your followers the ultimate doll makeover. Get creative with super-fun, sweet doll dress-up projects. Use your outfit designer imagination and turn your ordinary clothes into OMG-to-die-for stylish DIY dress-up outfits!

Take selfies with your new DIY clothes and compete in selfie contests! Run your own fashion designer channel and post videos of your DIY outfits to gain a huge fan base!

To all DIY game lovers, unleash your creativity and dive into the world of doll dress-up inspired outfits!
70070000031492.intro: Refresh your wardrobe with stylish DIY projects and put your clothing design skills to the test!
70070000031492.name: DIY Fashion Star: Stylish Beauty Edition

70070000031494.description:
Dream big and step into the exciting world of electronics retail! Turn your passion for technology into a thriving business, create your own high-tech empire, and experience the thrill of managing a bustling electronics store.

This bundle includes:
- Electronics Supermarket Simulator – Step into the dynamic world of high-tech retail, design and manage your own electronics store, stock the hottest products, and create an engaging shopping experience for your customers. Build your brand, grow your business, and dominate the competitive electronics market.
- Electronics Supermarket Simulator: Starter Cash – Receive a financial support to start your business, allowing you to expand faster, make strategic decisions, and take your electronics empire to the next level.

Take control, grow your business, and become the ultimate electronics tycoon with this complete package!
70070000031494.intro: Build your tech empire and dominate the electronics market.
70070000031494.name: Electronics Supermarket Simulator: Gadget Kingdom

70070000031505.description:
*"BUBBLE Symphony" is also included with "BUBBLE BOBBLE Sugar Dungeons."

Bub the bubble-blowing dragon goes on an adventure through sweet dungeons that change every time!
Blow bubbles to catch bullies, use your horns and spikes to burst the bubbles and beat them!
Bubbles can be carried by the wind, and you can get to high places by riding bubbles!
Collect treasures in dungeons that change every time you step inside and conquer huge castles!
Collecting treasure will strengthen Bub's abilities and skills.
Get stronger along with Bub and explore the depths of treat-filled dungeons!

■Game features
-The first in the series to feature "dungeons" that change every time you step into them!
Each time you enter a dungeon, the shape of the stage, the platforms, the enemies that appear, and their placement change, so you can always enjoy a fresh level!
You don't necessarily have to beat all of the enemies in this game!
Simply trap them or defeat them your way, and move on to the next stage by passing through the donut-shaped gate!
In the dungeons, it is easy to get "treasures" that can be used to make Bub stronger, so dive back into dungeons repeatedly to collect treasures and build Bub's skills up!

Once you get used to the controls and familiar with leveling Bub up, we recommend challenging your limits and dive even deeper into the dungeon!

- A huge "castle" that develops the map appears for the first time in the series!
The castle is one huge stage, and you will progress through each room that is connected like a maze, sometimes getting lost, sometimes finding your way using the knowledge you have build playing.
Unique bosses are waiting, so level Bub up, equip yourself, and aim for the deepest treasures.

- Master new and returning skills!
The Water Bubble is back in a new form!
You'll also find new skills that will help you along your journey, like Rolling Attack, which wipes enemies out, as well as many other abilities.

Use your skills to break through paths that were previously inaccessible, and defeat strong enemies in one go...!

- Find the skills and strategies that suit you!
The skills you have learned become items you can use.
The number of items you can take to a dungeon or castle at once is fixed, so it's up to you to decide what kind of skill items and useful items you take and how many of them you take.

You can also decide in what order you use the treasures you collect to make Bub stronger.

■The setting

The setting of the new Bubble Bobble game is a world full of "strange" sweet treats!
Cute Candy-shaped enemies start appearing in vibrant dungeons and castles.

■The Story

When Bub wakes up... finding himself in a strange laboratory.
A mysterious person named "Dolchen" suddenly appears and asks him to take on a mission to retrieve the "treasure" that lies dormant in the dungeon and castle.
Bub loves adventure, so when he hears "treasure," you bet he's up for it!
And so begins Bub's strange and sweet adventure.
70070000031505.intro:
More Quests, More Power!
An All New Bubble Bobble Experience!
70070000031505.name: BUBBLE BOBBLE Sugar Dungeons

Unlock and upgrade 4 powerful buggies
Experience dynamic racing modes

Jump into the driver's seat in Buggy Off-Road Racing and turn the whole world into your racing arena.

70070000031543.description:
Get the full UNO™ experience with the Ultimate Edition, which combines the base game with all 9 exciting DLCs.
From DLCs inspired by Mattel's iconic games to Ubisoft's best-loved worlds, each adds a unique twist to the classic gameplay.
Whether you're in the mood for party fun, strategic chaos, or themed adventures, UNO Ultimate Edition is packed with variety, surprises, and hours of fun.

UNO Ultimate Edition features the classic card game alongside nine exciting DLCs:
• UNO is the iconic card game you love, now with new ways to play and connect. Match cards by color, number, or symbol, play action cards to spice things up, and race against others to empty your hand first. Customize your experience with house rules and cosmetic options for a fresh twist on a timeless favorite.
• UNO Flip!™ elevates your UNO matches with a double-sided deck and new action cards, introducing a competitive twist to the classic gameplay!
• Celebrate in style with UNO 50th Anniversary and its gorgeous velvety cards.
• Unleash chaos with UNO Party! Mania™, which introduces 3 new action cards that promise wild thrills and epic comebacks.
• UNO Show ‘Em No Mercy™ turns up the heat with the most unforgiving version yet. Brutal action cards, extreme draw penalties, and knockout mechanics turn every match into a ruthless fight for survival.
• Play like a Viking in UNO Valhalla where the board is part of the gameplay!
• Join the revolution in UNO The Call of Yara, the DLC that brings resource management into the game.
• Play an action-packed game mode featuring characters from Immortals Fenyx Rising in UNO Fenyx's Quest.
• Get ready to move with the UNO Just Dance theme, offering upbeat rhythms, funky effects, and new Theme Cards.
• UNO Rayman adds a playful twist with lush visuals and four unique Theme Cards.
70070000031543.name: UNO™ ULTIMATE EDITION

70070000031544.description:
Dive into the world of UNO™ with the Legacy Edition bundle!

This collection features the classic card game alongside 4 exciting DLCs: UNO Flip!™, UNO 50th Anniversary, UNO Party! Mania™, and UNO Show ’Em No Mercy!™.
With four unique ways to play, UNO Legacy Edition brings extra fun and variety to your game nights!

UNO Legacy Edition features the classic card game alongside four chaotic DLCs:
• UNO is the iconic card game you love, now with new ways to play and connect. Match cards by color, number, or symbol, play action cards to spice things up, and race against others to empty your hand first. Customize your experience with house rules and cosmetic options for a fresh twist on a timeless favorite.
• UNO Flip! elevates your UNO matches with a double-sided deck, introducing a competitive twist to the classic gameplay. Switch between the light and dark sides and get ready to spice things up with new action cards that are wilder than ever!
• Celebrate five decades of one of the most popular card games in style with UNO 50th Anniversary and its gorgeous velvety cards. Plus, add a touch of flair with the special 50/50 card and its Gold Coin rule.
• For those craving chaos, UNO Party! Mania introduces 3 thrilling new action cards: the Point Taken, Wild Drawn Together, and Wild Pile Up cards. Brace yourself for bursts of laughter, nail-biting tension, and epic comebacks.
• UNO Show ‘Em No Mercy cranks up the intensity with brutal action cards, extreme draw penalties, and knockout mechanics. Outsmart your opponents, survive the chaos, and win by emptying your hand or being the last one standing.
70070000031544.name: UNO™ LEGACY EDITION

It's time to try ramen like you've never had before! Filled with delicious aromas, Neko Ramen will stimulate your logical thinking and ignite your senses!


Fulfill ramen orders under the guidance of a true master – the one and only feline chef! Each ramen is a perfectly calculated arrangement of flavors and shapes, so strain your brain to accommodate all the ingredients! The orders will become increasingly sophisticated and difficult (but also more delicious). However, you don't have to worry about that, as you have as much time as you want to prepare the dish!


Here's what you'll find on the Neko Ramen menu:
- Over 90 scrumptious levels!
- 29 ingredients to compose perfect dishes.
- Music that will make you want ramen yourself.
- And charming graphics that stimulate both the eyes and the taste buds!

This bundle includes Chopstick Finesse 1 DLC with even more delicious levels to complete.

Do not wait, because even though the ramen will not get cold, the cat chief may not be so forgiving!

This bundle brings together two contrasting worlds, offering the perfect experience whether you're in the mood for a peaceful getaway or an adrenaline rush.

Sailing The Winds is an adventure simulator that blends exploration with fishing. Step into the shoes of an adventurer on a quest to help a friend find his missing father, navigating an archipelago with a pirate past.

New Tanks is a fast-paced action game that delivers non-stop excitement.
70070000031608.name: Sailing the winds & New Tanks

70070000031630.description:
The kingdom is shrouded in darkness, cursed by a powerful sorcerer and haunted by deadly vampires. Solar eclipses cast shadows over the land, and brave knights must rise to survive the night.

This bundle combines the full Vampires and Knights : Eclipse Survival & Magic Craft experience with the Tools of Survival DLC, giving you everything you need to face the growing threat.

Included in this bundle:
- The Full Game – Explore cursed lands, craft weapons, build fortifications, and engage in epic battles against vampires and other dark creatures.
- Tools of Survival DLC – Start your journey with essential gear appearing near the player: Level 1 Helmet and Level 1 Armor, giving you an early advantage in survival and combat.

Step into the cursed fog, gather your courage, and fight for the kingdom’s survival. Every night is a test, every battle shapes your legend, and every dawn brings new hope.
70070000031630.intro: Armor up and face relentless shadowed enemies.
70070000031630.name: Vampires and Knights : Eclipse Survival & Magic Craft – Armor of Legends

70070000031652.description:
Feel the ultimate rush of high-speed street racing! Dive into Grand Rush: Highway Car Traffic Racing Simulator, where precision and speed are your best allies navigating busy city streets — and unlock the exclusive Drive in Color DLC to customize your ride like never before.

This bundle includes:
- Grand Rush: Highway Car Traffic Racing Simulator - the full base game with realistic driving physics, intense traffic challenges, and multiple game modes to test your skills.
- Drive in Color DLC - featuring three fresh new paint jobs — bold blue, striking pink, and sleek turquoise — to customize your rides and stand out on the streets.

Dominate the highways in style and speed. Choose your car, choose your color, and race like never before. One bundle. Infinite rush.

Ever wished you could turn a tiny room into a perfect little hideaway?
In Pocket Nook, you design charming spaces in cozy pixel art — shifting the layout, placing furniture, and keeping everything neat and clean!


Start with a simple room, then turn it into something unique. Place a bed, a desk, or a plant — you may rotate and reposition items however you like — it’s all flexible!


There’s no need to stress or rush yourself — take your time and enjoy the relaxing vibe of Pocket Nook but also be prepared to savor before-and-after transformations.

Relive sunny days with Summer Tiki Party DLC included in this bundle.

Features you may find:
- 65 wallpapers — choose wisely, it’s a thing that catches the attention quickly.
- 80+ styles to embellish the most forgotten part of a room - FLOOR!
- 150+ furniture options to choose from and infinite possibilities.
- 100+ items to decorate your space with —  you name it!
- 20+ ways to lighten the room — lighting is key!
- 32 outdoor elements to fill every pixel of empty space.
- 32 characters ready to live in a place created by an architectural genius mind!
- Cozy pixel art — nice to look at, nicer to relax in.
- Various cozy tunes to choose from — just enough to get into the relaxing vibe.

Cute graphics, endless options, a lot of fun — that’s what awaits you in Pocket Nook, everyone’s welcomed!

70070000031657.name: Pocket Nook Breath of Summer Edition

BROK THE INVESTIGATOR – The world’s first Punch & Click! A unique adventure mixing classic storytelling and investigation with beat’em up action. Play as Brok, a private detective and former boxer, in a cyberpunk world where animals have replaced humans. - Experience a story-driven adventure and an action-focused beat’em up featuring the same characters
- Local co-op supported in both the main adventure and The Brawl Bar
- A great entry point into the BROK universe.

70070000031671.description:
The "INAZUMA ELEVEN: Victory Road Deluxe Edition" is a value package which adds the following bonus content to the base game.

■ Package Contents:
- Base Game
- Choose-a-Character Crate
- Bond Object: Football Club Room (Raimon)
- Bond Object: Rai Rai Noodles (Inazuma Town)
- Promise Pendant (equipment that boosts EXP gained)
- Victory Jump! (Goal Celebration)

*For more details on the bonuses included with each edition, visit the official website.

O smoldering clouds, let INAZUMA's lightning split the sky!

The newest title in the hyperdimensional football RPG series "Inazuma Eleven" is finally here!
A new story featuring a new protagonist, over 5,400 characters to collect and train, as well as an intense competitive mode; there is no shortage of activities to enjoy!

■ Story Mode
This new story takes place 25 years after the first Inazuma Eleven.
In search of a world without football, protagonist Destin Billows enrolls at South Cirrus Junior High. Meanwhile, within the prestigious Raimon Junior High - renowned as the top team in the nationals - rises a Football Monster named Harper Evans.
When these two cross paths, a tale begins to unfold...

■ Chronicle Mode
A roster spanning over 5,400 characters from previous entries in the series!
Relive past Inazuma Eleven matches with Victorio, the boy who came from the future.
Take on various teams, collect and train characters, and build your ultimate dream team!

■ Bond Station (Kizuna Station)
Freely arrange nostalgic objects from the Inazuma Eleven series to create your own "Bond Town"!
Customize your avatar, invite friends over and enjoy socializing and playing matches together!
Your custom made avatar can also be used in matches!

■ The Ultimate Anime Experience Brought to Life by MAPPA
In-game anime cutscenes were made in cooperation with animation studio MAPPA!
With the longest anime runtime in the series' history, the story's intensity will reach new heights.
70070000031671.intro: A new era of hyperdimensional football will see online battles ignite the world!
70070000031671.name: INAZUMA ELEVEN: Victory Road Deluxe Edition

70070000031681.description:
Inspired by the classics, developed for the modern audiences.

A classic revenge story set in a medieval fantasy world… with a touch of deadly modern firepower just to turn things up to eleven. Fight through the armies of undead, mutants, aliens, machines and beasts in order to get back what is rightfully yours and bring some semblance of peace back to the land. Who knows - if you’re thorough enough you might even discover the history of the kingdom itself, long lost to the scholars of the realm.

Knights & Guns brings you to a dangerous world where you will fight, alongside your friend, against demons, ghouls & ghosts. Use shotguns, lasers and the power of chivalry to overcome every obstacle. Become the best version of a knight - one with a gun.

Inside the game:
•	Fight awesome bosses on various stages!
•	Conquer the non-linear world! Rush through over 150 hand crafted stages, or enjoy the game at your own pace, looking for secrets and special routes!
•	Entire game designed for both single player or co-op multiplayer. Invite a friend at any time for some extra firepower and mayhem.
•	60 fps gameplay! Try the different modes! Hunt the monsters! Survive! Play on small, big and narrow maps!
•	Check out all the awesome suits of armor and, of course, all the GUNS! Lasers, shotguns, grenade launchers, sniper rifles... They are all here!
•	Over 30 unique guns. (That’s probably more flavors of death than flavors of ice cream you can name.)
•	Over 25 types of enemies, 5 types of mini-bosses and 3 types of bosses. Most of these come in different colors, too.
•	30 unique suits of armor for the knights. Extra protection and extra style!
•	Traps, chests, keys, scrolls of lore, books of monsters...

This bundle includes base game, Expansion Pack #1 and Armor Pack #4 with:

- 10 new levels for you to bring back the peace
- 6 new armors to help you on your quest
- New enemies for that extra little kick
70070000031681.intro: Knight in shining armor, fight your way... with Guns!
70070000031681.name: Knights & Guns Arcane Arsenal

70070000031695.description:
Discover a whole new world of combat sports games. As a newbie boxer, challenge experienced opponents and try to win and score a KO! Explore the world of boxing and make your way to the top. You can become the boxing champion, the best warrior of all time! So get ready to punch, and punch hard! Discover what you’re made of, and try to climb to the top.

This bundle includes:
- Real Boxing 2: Remastered
- Real Boxing 2: Remastered - Lord Maywinner DLC
- Real Boxing 2: Remastered - Masaru DLC

Become the ultimate champion! Use jabs, hooks, uppercuts & combine them into devastating combos.

PLAY AS LEGENDARY BOXERS
Receive 2 legendary boxers - Lord Maywinner and Masaru with their unique equipment and a bonus of 43000 experience points right from the start!

REMASTERED VERSION
A brand new challenge awaits you as the game has been rebalanced for a fresh and fair boxing experience. With better effects and improved graphics you can feel like you're boxing for real!

CHOOSE YOUR STYLE OF BOXING
Before you KO your opponent, you need to improve your fighting skills! Adjust your boxer's stats to match your playstyle and level up quickly to unlock new abilities that will help you in fights to come! Use powerful boosts to make your dream come true. Get ready - a KO is in the air!

PLAY MINI-GAMES
Train your fighter in exciting mini games that reflect real life boxers’ training and develop your character! You need to leave a lot of sweat in your training hall to be a champion. No one said it would be an easy challenge!

CREATE YOUR DREAM BOXER
Real Boxing 2: Remastered allows you to customize your fighter! Choose your outfit, get a new tattoo and even change your haircut. Adjust all the aspects of the fighter’s body, from mass and muscle sculpture to nose shape.

DRESS TO IMPRESS
As in all fighting sports, it's best to enter the punch-out and serve a smackdown with style, so gear up - equip a pair of boots, trousers and gloves that fit your style and knock down your opponents with your looks alone.

BATTLE AGAINST UNIQUE BOSSES
Take on challenging opponents! Clown? Check. Santa? Yeah, he's there. A real stone golem? You bet. Defeat them all and claim their epic gear!

Join the club, create your boxer, and start your boxing career. Get ready to punch, and punch hard! Discover what you’re made of, and climb to the top!
70070000031695.intro: Take the fight to the next level with a remaster of award winning Real Boxing™ 2. Train hard, fight harder. Prove your worth in the career and multiplayer mode.
70070000031695.name: Real Boxing 2: Remastered - Masaru & Maywinner Edition

Face the swamp’s mysteries fully prepared and discover the true depths of your resilience — all in one complete survival package!

Johnny Trigger - International Man of Mayhem!

This bundle includes:
- Johnny Trigger
- Johnny Trigger: Lunatic DLC
- Johnny Trigger: Hunter DLC
- Johnny Trigger: Butcher DLC

Stylish, deadly and smooth as a billiard ball, Johnny Trigger is a man on a mission in this non-stop platform shooter game where the action never ends.

Do you have what it takes to bring down the underground world of the mafia?
“Less talk, more bullets” - that’s Johnny’s motto as he runs, jumps, spins, slides and keeps on shooting till every bad guy’s bitten the dust.

Dive straight in and get shooting! Johnny Trigger’s short but immensely satisfying levels make it the perfect action game to fill a short break.
And if you’ve got a little more time, there’s so much to collect and a new challenge round every corner.

Features:
- 3 new skins: Lunatic, Butcher and Hunter
- 3 new weapons: Showtime, Vengeance and Triforce
- 3000 additional gemms to buy other currencies
- 150 additional puzzles to unlock more comic graphics
- 40 additional keys to open locked doors in base
- 50 additional hammers to unlock another upgrades in base

So what are you waiting for? Those bad guys aren’t going to beat themselves, you know.

70070000031724.name: Johnny Trigger: Triple Rebel Edition

Discover the joy of relaxation and creativity with this bundle! Whether you prefer bringing beauty and harmony to a lively small town or transforming abandoned houses into dream homes, this bundle offers two unique and heartwarming experiences.

1. Cozy Gardener Simulator
Step into the role of the town’s gardener and caretaker. Plant, water, and nurture vibrant gardens, mow overgrown lawns, and bring charm to every street corner. Meet townsfolk, complete wholesome quests, and enjoy calm, pressure-free gameplay.

2. House Renovator Simulator
Grab your tools and give forgotten homes a second life. Demolish walls, renovate interiors, paint, decorate, and design each space in your own style. With realistic mechanics and a wide selection of materials, every renovation becomes a success story.

Why choose this bundle?
- Two complementary games combining relaxation and creativity.
- Rewarding experiences: from cultivating nature’s beauty to renovating homes.
- Freedom to design, create, and transform at your own pace.

With the Cozy Gardener Simulator & House Renovator Simulator Bundle, every day brings new opportunities to craft warmth and beauty around you.
70070000031729.intro: Grow colorful gardens and craft welcoming living spaces.
70070000031729.name: Cozy Gardener Simulator & House Renovator Simulator

70070000031739.description:
*** Storm Tale 2 ***
Sharpen your sword and take up your bow - it’s time to fight back a powerful sorcerer and his mighty dragon. Join Griffri, the wizard, on a quest to not only rebuild his village, but to put an end to the perilous reign of evil that threatens the realm. Play bonus mini-games with cool 3D hidden object scenes and jigsaw puzzles. Beat the obstacles and win many trophies on your journey through this addictive match 3 game. Bring the peace back to this fabulous land. Are you ready for an adventure?

*** Ancient Relics: Egypt ***
Embark on an extraordinary journey through time in "Ancient Relics - Egypt", an immersive match-3 adventure set in the captivating world of Ancient Egypt. Solve challenging Match-3 puzzles to gather precious gold and rebuild a once-thriving village to its former glory. Unearth priceless power-ups hidden within the Pharaoh's tomb, as you delve deeper into the ancient secrets. Be strategic and make every move count to overcome the pharaoh's dark and ancient magic. Can you conquer the puzzles, save the village, and put an end to the Pharaoh's fury? The fate of Egypt rests in your hands.
70070000031739.intro: Test your Match-3 skills in an epic adventure in Storm Tale 2, alongside Griffri the wizard, as Ancient Relics: Egypt takes the genre to extraordinary new heights.
70070000031739.name: Storm Tale 2 & Ancient Relics: Adventure Bundle

Two complete horror games. One deadly challenge.

This bundle brings together Zombie Survival and The Ripper: Serial Killers, offering two different takes on survival horror for players who enjoy tension, danger, and dark atmospheres.

In Zombie Survival, the threat is everywhere. You must endure relentless undead attacks, manage scarce resources, and fight to stay alive as the world collapses around you.

In The Ripper: Serial Killers, the danger is more personal. Face a chilling psychological hunt where every step forward could bring you closer to the killer or to becoming the next victim.

Whether you prefer chaotic survival against the undead or a tense battle of nerves against a human predator, this bundle delivers hours of horror driven gameplay at a reduced price.

Survive both nightmares.
Or let them consume you.
Ready to play?

Two nightmares.
One bundle.

- The Nintendo Switch™ version of the Erdrick Trilogy Collection includes the Nintendo Switch™ version of DRAGON QUEST III HD-2D Remake and the Nintendo Switch™ version of DRAGON QUEST I & II HD-2D Remake.
There is also a Nintendo Switch™ 2 version of the collection available, which contains DRAGON QUEST I & II HD-2D Remake for Nintendo Switch™ 2. Please ensure you check the contents of the collection before purchasing.

Three legendary adventures. One definitive bundle.
Get the complete Erdrick Trilogy that includes DRAGON QUEST III HD-2D Remake and DRAGON QUEST I & II HD-2D Remake at a discounted price.
Immerse yourself in the adventure of a lifetime with these three masterpieces.

DRAGON QUEST III
Years ago, the great hero Ortega bid farewell to his wife and child as he set off on a quest to defeat the villainous Archfiend, Baramos. Ortega failed his quest, and Baramos still threatens the world.
Now, on their 16th birthday, Ortega’s only child is summoned by the king of Aliahan and entrusted with a mission of the highest import: to take on Ortega’s quest, vanquish Baramos and save the world.

DRAGON QUEST I
Thanks to the heroic efforts of the legendary Erdrick, the Lord of the Underworld was defeated and peace returned to the land of Alefgard. Yet this peace was not to last, as the diabolical Dragonlord has risen and unleashed hordes of monsters on the realm once more. Now, descendant of Erdrick, it is your destiny to defeat this new evil and rescue the world from its plight!

DRAGON QUEST II
Many years have passed since Alefgard was saved at the hero's hand, earning him the same title as his storied forebear. The descendants of this Erdrick and his scions founded three kingdoms that thrived in peacetime. Yet, darkness stirs once more and a sudden invasion of malicious monsters plunges the world into shadow again. All that stands between the forces of evil and their wicked ambitions is a band of young princes and princesses of Erdrick's lineage. The time has come for them to venture forth and honor their ancestor's legacy!
70070000031760.name: DRAGON QUEST - HD-2D Erdrick Trilogy Collection

70070000031772.description:
Experience the full intensity of tactical combat with this ultimate bundle, designed for elite operatives ready to take on any challenge.

Bundle includes:
- Critical Strike Shooter: SWAT Rescue Missions — Lead your squad through heart-pounding hostage rescues and fast-paced firefights in this thrilling first-person tactical shooter.
- Combat Gloves DLC — Unlock exclusive tactical gloves that enhance your grip and style on the battlefield, or receive the equivalent in-game currency to upgrade your gear.

Gear up, strategize, and dominate every mission with precision and professionalism. Are you ready to become the ultimate SWAT hero?
70070000031772.intro: Gear up, move fast, and dominate the battlefield.
70070000031772.name: Critical Strike Shooter: SWAT Rescue Missions – Elite Combat

70070000031779.description:
Double the chaos, double the fun! Get ready for the ultimate goose-filled adventure with this bundle.

What’s included in this bundle:
- Crazy Goose Simulator – Take control of a mischievous goose and roam freely through quirky environments. Honk, flap, and prank your way through hilarious scenarios while completing entertaining objectives.
- New Skybound DLC – Transform the skies above every level with vibrant, dynamic landscapes. Soar through whimsical clouds, enjoy stunning sunsets, and make your goose antics even more epic!

Whether you’re a seasoned honker or a feathered newcomer, this bundle delivers hours of outrageous fun, spectacular sights, and sky-high mischief!
70070000031779.intro: Honk loud, flap harder, cause havoc!
70070000031779.name: Crazy Goose Simulator: Chaos Edition

70070000031784.description:
All the Suicide Guy games are now available on Nintendo Switch™ in one mega bundle!
Experience the full trilogy of the indie hit Suicide Guy in a single, dream-filled collection:

- Suicide Guy
- Suicide Guy: Sleepin' Deeply
- Suicide Guy: The Lost Dreams

Dive into the bizarre and extraordinary dreams of our clumsy hero — this time, you'll have to save not one, not two, but three beers!.

Features:

• Physics-based puzzles and levels
• Hilarious creatures to mess with
• Powerful “ultimate moves”: grab, throw, activate, and even burp your way through dreams
• Drive all sorts of crazy vehicles

Use all your skills to wake him up!
Despite the title, this game series is NOT about suicide or depression — it’s a light-hearted, funny, and surreal adventure that will keep you smiling till the end.

70070000031785.description:
This bundle contains the first two set of Woodle Tree videogames!

Woodle Tree Adventures
is an old school platform game with a catchy and unique art style! Explore a total of 6 worlds and save the lands with the magical water drops you'll find through your journey, bringing back peace and balance and finally becoming the new hero!


Woodle Tree 2: Worlds
is an open world platformer/adventure game. This time the forces of evil are taking over the Wood Lands with a black substance that is absorbing energy and life from the living creatures! Will you be able to take over this enormous new evil force?
70070000031785.name: Woodle Tree Bundle

70070000031786.description:
Four different worlds, one ultimate bundle of thrilling experiences. From the serenity of hidden forests and the struggle for survival in the Stone Age, to the blood-soaked arenas of Ancient Rome and the heart-pounding rush of wingsuit flight—this bundle takes you on a journey through time, nature, and pure adrenaline.

Included Games:
	•	Forest Ranger Life Simulator – Reclaim the Wild
Step into the role of a forest ranger, restore forgotten landscapes, care for wildlife, and protect nature’s treasures.
	•	Primitive Life Simulator
Travel back to prehistoric times—hunt, gather, craft, and build your tribe to survive the unforgiving wilds.
	•	Gladiators Simulator: The Champions of Liberty
Enter the deadly arenas of Rome, manage fighters, and battle for honor, power, and freedom.
	•	Skydiving Simulator: Wingsuit Flight
Leap into the skies and master extreme wingsuit flights across breathtaking landscapes.

Why this bundle?
- Unique adventures – nature, survival, history, and extreme sports.
- Diverse gameplay – from crafting and exploration to combat and high-speed flight.
- A complete journey – from the ground of ancient forests to the endless skies.

Step into the adventure bundle and live four unforgettable worlds in one epic collection!
70070000031786.intro: Explore, survive, fight, and soar through four epic worlds.
70070000031786.name: MEGA SIMULATOR BUNDLE - Forest Ranger Life Simulator / Primitive Life Simulator / Gladiators Simulator: The Champions of Liberty / Skydiving Simulator: Wingsuit Flight

70070000031791.description:
Get the ultimate street racing experience with this bundle! Featuring the full game Street Drag Racing Car Driving Simulator 2022 Games and two exciting DLCs, this collection delivers speed, power, and limitless customization.

Bundle Includes:
- Street Drag Racing Car Driving Simulator 2022 Games – The adrenaline-fueled 3D car racing simulator where you can build, tune, and race your dream cars. Compete in online multiplayer, master drag and drift challenges, and prove yourself as a street racing legend!

- Street Drag Racing: Rise of GELENVAGEN (DLC) – Unlock the beastly GELENVAGEN and dominate the streets or off-road tracks. Upgrade, customize, and push this powerful machine to its limits for the ultimate performance. Already own it? You’ll receive full coin compensation!

- Street Drag Racing – Garage Expansion (DLC) – Add the legendary Lamborghini Huracan to your garage and take street racing to the next level. Tune, paint, and master this supercar, or receive its in-game cash value if it’s already in your collection.

Take control, challenge rivals worldwide and rise as the king of drag racing. With realistic sounds, over 30 cars, and endless tuning options, this bundle is the perfect package for every racing fan!
70070000031791.intro: Drive, drift, and dominate – your garage, your legacy!
70070000031791.name: Street Drag Racing Car Driving Simulator – The Racer’s Journey

70070000031797.description:
Experience the full power of the African savannah with survival bundle! Step into the paws of the king of the jungle and explore vast landscapes, hunt diverse prey, and lead your pride with strategy and skill.

Bundle Highlights:
- Lion Simulator Survival: RPG Animal Battle: Roam expansive ecosystems, experience realistic lion behavior, sharpen your hunting skills, and manage your pride while surviving the challenges of the wild.
- Strength of the King DLC: Enjoy double health and stamina, making your lion stronger and more enduring in every hunt, chase, and territorial battle.

Dominate the savannah like never before, where every hunt and every challenge tests your strength, strategy, and survival instincts.
70070000031797.intro: Hunt longer, roam farther, survive stronger.
70070000031797.name: Lion Simulator Survival: RPG Animal Battle – Dominant Predator

70070000031802.description:
A wild rain of bouncing rocks crashes down - move fast, blast faster!

Every rock has a number - hit it that many times and boom! it splits into two rocks with half the number and double the speed, turning the field into fast-moving chaos!

Play solo or with a friend for double firepower. Beat hundreds of levels, survive endless waves, and climb the world leaderboard!

Pick up coins and unlock new cannons: a wide-spread shotgun, a boomerang that swings back and spinning saw blades that slice through rocks as they fall. Upgrade power-ups like a piercing laser beam, explosive drones, and huge shockwaves to wipe out waves in a flash!

Features:
- 3 New Halloween Maps: Blast your way through Haunted Castle, Candy Land and Vaporwave map!
- CO-OP: Team up with a friend and fend off the falling rocks together!
- Online Leaderboards: Survive as long as you can and get the best score in the world!
- Powerful Cannons: Choose between basic, shotgun, boomerang, and saw cannons!
- Devastating powers: Buy and upgrade powerful abilities to destroy everything!
- Special Levels: Defeat epic bosses and protect the bridge from destruction!
- 6 Extra Cannon Boosters: Amplify your firepower!
- 15 Boomerang Shards
- 10 Shock Wave Shards
- 10 Laser Shards
- 2500 gems: Spend extra gems on crates, fresh shards, and more power-ups!
- Replayability: Complete hundreds of unique levels and challenges!

The rocks won’t stop bouncing - are you ready to keep blasting?
