If you want to improve on your own, try out one of five difficulty options and play with an NPC. Find your favorite opening and improve with every game. If you are looking for a real challenge try out the expert mode.

This bundle includes the Sky Blue Chessboard DLC.

Key features
- local multiplayer
- family friendly
- balanced gameplay
- charming aesthetic
- invigorating music track
70070000039380.intro: Prepare for loads of fun with this cartoon version of the most popular board game in the world.
70070000039380.name: Family Chess Sky Blue Pack

70070000039381.description:
A revolution has come!

Enjoy every awesome feature of the nOS. Draw, write, calculate, organize your day and play around at your convenience. All the tools you need are here!

You have the power

Brighten up your day and customize the nOS to suit your every need. Find your favorite setup and create the fantastic user experience you deserve.

This bundle includes the Wallpapers Pack 3 DLC.

Key features:
- Splendid customization options
- Reliable tools (Notepad, Scetchbook, Day Planner)
- Brilliant design
- A charming puzzle game
70070000039381.intro: Engage the newest Nintendo Switch™ experience. Transform your favorite console into an amazing, and surprisingly small personal computer.
70070000039381.name: nOS new Operating System Wallpapers Collection 3

70070000039386.description:
Enter the wild world of Gorilla Jungle King Simulator and experience the journey of becoming the true Alpha. Survive the dangers of the jungle, build your gorilla pack, protect your allies, gather resources, and prove your strength through every challenge.

The Bundle Includes:
1. Gorilla Jungle King Simulator - Lead your gorilla pack through a dangerous jungle, search for resources, defend your territory, face predators and rivals, and rise as the king of the wild.
2. Gorilla Jungle King Simulator: New Skies - Transform the jungle atmosphere with a new green morning skybox, creating a brighter and more immersive environment during your survival journey.

Build your legacy, protect your pack, and experience the jungle kingdom with an enhanced visual atmosphere.
70070000039386.intro: Explore, survive, and dominate the world of the jungle.
70070000039386.name: Gorilla Jungle King Simulator: Jungle Paradise

70070000039395.description:
Welcome to a world of crazy organizers, explosive makeup bags, and kitchen shelves barely holding on under the weight of random stuff! In Stuff It, there’s only one rule: everything has to fit... somewhere!


Your mission? To cram the most absurd combinations of items into tight spaces. Hairbrushes, colorful hairdryers, giant ladles, way too many trinkets, and even rubber duckies - all waiting for your master-level packing skills!


Each level throws you into a totally new challenge - bizarre shapes, unruly objects, and sometimes things you don’t even remember ever owning. But don’t panic! Use your superpower of organizing, make some room, and... stuff it!

This bundle includes the Bakery DLC.

What’s in store?
- Over 105 levels of chaos to conquer!
- Special modes (Easy, Medium, Hard) unlocked after completing the game - for those who  love a challenge!
- Dozens of colorful items - from kitchen gear to beauty products!
- Relaxing, feel-good music to help you focus… even when everything is falling out!
- Wacky graphics that bring every drawer item to life!
- Funny effects and reactions - because every win deserves a fanfare (and confetti)!

Don’t ask where that giant spoon came from - just find a spot for it!

Stuff It - because who said cleaning can't be epic?
70070000039395.intro: Shove it, stack it, sort it out!
70070000039395.name: Stuff it! Backery Pack

70070000039396.description:
Welcome to Make It Cozy!

Create the sweetest little home and share it with the cutest animal friends imaginable!

Step into a charming world filled with soft colors, cozy corners, and adorable companions waiting to move in. Design dreamy bedrooms, sunny living rooms, peaceful reading nooks, relaxing bathrooms, and magical outdoor spaces — then watch them come to life with playful kittens, a curious fox, a cheerful penguin, a tiny hedgehog, and many other fluffy friends.

Every room is a place where memories are made. Arrange comfy furniture, decorate with lovely plants, hang cute decorations, and create warm spaces where your animal companions can feel safe, happy, and loved. Whether you prefer a pastel paradise, a cozy cottage, or something wonderfully unique, your imagination is the only limit.

Relax, decorate, and enjoy the gentle atmosphere as your tiny residents explore the home you've created just for them. Every smile, nap, and playful moment makes your cozy world feel even more magical.

This bundle includes the Cats and Summer Collection DLCs.

KEY FEATURES:
- Design and decorate adorable cozy homes and beautiful outdoor spaces
- Meet charming animal residents including kittens, foxes, penguins, hedgehogs, bunnies, and more
- Hundreds of cute furniture pieces, plants, and decorations to personalize every room
- Warm pastel visuals and relaxing music that create a peaceful atmosphere
- Endless creative freedom to build your dream cozy retreat
- Watch your lovable animal friends enjoy and explore their new home
- Perfect for players who love cozy vibes, cute animals, creativity, and relaxing gameplay
70070000039396.intro: Unleash your creativity in a cutest possible way!
70070000039396.name: Make It Cozy! Deluxe Edition

70070000039398.description:
Create, farm, and style your way to success in Cottonville!
Welcome to Cottonville – a cozy dress-up and farming sim where creativity blossoms and fashion takes root! Run your own sewing atelier, grow essential crops, and craft stylish outfits for a charming cast of characters.


A Fresh Start in Cottonville
After leaving the hustle of Friglight, you arrive in peaceful Cottonville to take over a small family sewing shop. Start fresh, grow your business, and build a new life—one stitch at a time.


Customize Your Character
Express yourself! Choose from 18 hair colors, 15 hairstyles, and a variety of eye shapes, mouths, lashes, eyebrows, and skin tones. Dress your character in a wide range of outfits that grow with your fashion journey.


From Farming to Fashion
Cultivate cotton, linen, and bamboo—then harvest natural dyes from flowers to create fabrics in 7 vibrant colors. Craft materials, unlock new sewing patterns, and design custom outfits that reflect your unique style.


Run Your Atelier
Take charge of your boutique with over 60 sewing patterns and 120+ total clothing variations. Listen to customer requests, mix and match fabrics, and tailor outfits that reflect their personalities—from winter sweaters to breezy summer styles.

This bundle includes the Lavender Room DLC.

Features:
- 60+ sewing patterns with multiple color variants (120+ total!)
- 3 farmable crops and 7 dye colors to craft your own fabrics
- Fully customizable character with a wide selection of features
- A charming story about starting over and finding creativity in a cozy town
- Unique customers and outfit requests that evolve with your boutique
- Dive into 60+ hours of fashion-filled farming and storytelling!


Grow crops, craft clothes, and chase your fashion dreams—Cottonville awaits you!
70070000039398.intro: Watch your beautiful garden grow, dye fabrics, and turn them into beautiful clothing.
70070000039398.name: Cottonville Soft Lavender Edition

70070000039399.description:
My Cozy Room is a relaxing sandbox game where you can design and decorate your very own spaces. Choose from 11 different room shapes and sizes to create unique spaces—your dream bedroom, a cozy living room, a stylish kitchen, or even a playful kids' room.


With over 500 furniture pieces and decorations, plus more than 30 wallpaper and flooring patterns, you’ll have everything you need to craft the perfect look. Whether you're a kid or just love makeover and sandbox games, My Cozy Room is the ideal place to unleash your creativity and have fun!

This bundle includes the Fast Food DLC.

Features:
- 11 unique room shapes and sizes to choose from.
- Over 500 furniture and decoration items to explore.
- 30+ wallpaper and flooring patterns for a personal touch.
- Design spaces like bedrooms, kitchens, bathrooms, and more.
- Perfect for kids and fans of makeover and sandbox games.
- Relaxing and creative gameplay for all ages.

Start decorating your cozy dream room today!
70070000039399.intro: Create your dream room and make it truly yours
70070000039399.name: My Cozy Room Foodie Lover Edition

70070000039403.description:
Build your trucking career in Truck Simulator 2025: City Work Delivery, where every route brings new challenges across busy city streets and demanding off-road terrain. Complete delivery missions, upgrade your vehicles, and master realistic truck handling as you grow your transport business.

This Bundle Includes:
• Truck Simulator 2025: City Work Delivery
Drive powerful cargo trucks, complete a wide variety of delivery missions, earn rewards, unlock new vehicles, and prove your skills across diverse environments.

• Truck Simulator 2025: City Work Delivery – Urban Makeover
Refresh the appearance of your first truck with a vibrant pink paint design, giving your vehicle a distinctive new style throughout every delivery.

Take on every route, expand your trucking career, and enjoy every mile with a fresh new visual upgrade.
70070000039403.intro: Take on every delivery and become the ultimate driver.
70070000039403.name: Truck Simulator 2025: City Work Delivery – Highway Driver

70070000039409.description:
Build, renovate, decorate, and organize with the ultimate home design collection.
This bundle includes two games, each offering its own unique take on creating beautiful living spaces.
Restore neglected houses in Fix & Flip Dream House by renovating interiors, choosing new finishes, placing furniture, and transforming outdated properties into stunning modern homes. Then continue your creative journey in Unboxing: Cozy Home Simulator, where you'll unpack belongings, organize every room, and decorate warm, inviting spaces filled with personality and charm.
Whether you enjoy large-scale home renovations or the relaxing satisfaction of organizing and decorating cozy interiors, this bundle offers countless hours of creative gameplay. Design stylish rooms, personalize every detail, and experience two relaxing home-building adventures in one complete collection.
70070000039409.name: Flipper & Unboxing House 2-in-1

70070000039410.description:
Choose Chikorita, Tepig, or Totodile as your first partner Pokémon, and then set off on a grand adventure! Your journey will take you to all manner of sights in the streets arrayed around Prism Tower, including shops, restaurants, and places called wild zones—where Pokémon roam free. As you catch, train, and battle Pokémon, there will be plenty of people to meet too—like AZ, the enigmatic owner of Hotel Z, and Team MZ, the crew that aims to keep Lumiose a peaceful place.

Catch, battle, and Mega Evolve—all in real time!

Step onto the battlefield and command your Pokémon directly—there are no turns! For the first time in the Pokémon RPG series, Trainers and their Pokémon can both move around in real-time battles, and your Pokémon will unleash their moves when you tell them to.

Harness the power of Mega Evolution! Unleash your Pokémon’s hidden energy to temporarily transform its appearance, enhance its capabilities, and perhaps even change its type. Use this power wisely and try to overcome your toughest challenges, like those posed by the rampaging Rogue Mega-Evolved Pokémon across Lumiose City.

Compete in the Z-A Royale when night falls—or battle with other players in the Z-A Battle Club

You’re invited to join the Z-A Royale, a competition for Pokémon Trainers to test their skills and determine who’s strongest. Each night, a battle zone for the competition will appear. Prepare yourself by spending the day catching and training Pokémon, then venture into the battle zone to take on other Trainers.

You can also test your skills against friends or Trainers around the world in the Z-A Battle Club. Take on up to three other Trainers at once, locally* or online**, in frenetic real-time battles!

Venture into Hyperspace Lumiose for the next chapter of your adventure!

Mysterious distortions have appeared without warning in Lumiose City. They seem to connect to a place known as Hyperspace Lumiose...and the Mythical Pokémon Hoopa has the power to transform them into portals so you can travel there! Hoopa needs your help to do it, though: team up with the mysterious and talented baker, Ansha, to gather Berries and make donuts that will awaken Hoopa’s power and grant you and your Pokémon a variety of useful effects.

Once you’re in Hyperspace Lumiose, join the Mega Evolution successor, Korrina, and Team MZ to investigate its mysteries. Just be sure you’re ready—this otherworldly version of Lumiose City can be a threatening place. The Pokémon here are different, and sometimes rare, with hyperspace levels that can make their total levels exceed the normal limit of 100.

It looks like your story with Team MZ isn’t over yet—continue your journey in Hyperspace Lumiose in the Pokémon™ Legends: Z-A – Mega Dimension DLC, after completing the main game!
70070000039410.intro: Live the life of a Pokémon Trainer and help protect the peace in Lumiose City!
70070000039410.name: Pokémon™ Legends: Z-A Bundle (Game + DLC)

70070000039412.description:
Build your automotive empire and prove your skills behind the wheel with the ultimate driving and dealership collection.
This bundle includes two games that let you experience both sides of the automotive world. Build a successful car dealership by buying, selling, upgrading, and expanding your business, then put your vehicles to the test in a rewarding parking simulator packed with challenges, customization, and progression.
Grow your showroom, unlock new cars, expand your garage, and master increasingly demanding driving objectives. Whether you're negotiating the perfect deal, customizing your favorite vehicles, or aiming for flawless parking, every achievement brings you one step closer to becoming a true automotive expert.
From running a thriving dealership to perfecting every maneuver, this collection delivers hours of satisfying simulation, progression, and driving fun.
70070000039412.name: Car Sales & Parking Bundle

70070000039413.description:
Test your instincts across three unique adventures where every decision can mean the difference between survival and failure.

This bundle includes three games, each delivering a different challenge. Escape from a heavily guarded prison using patience and clever planning, survive aboard a crippled ship abandoned after a brutal pirate attack, and investigate a mysterious hospital where reality itself cannot be trusted.

Every experience places you under constant pressure. Search for vital resources, solve environmental challenges, uncover hidden secrets, and make difficult decisions while facing unpredictable dangers. Whether you're managing scarce supplies, plotting the perfect escape, or carefully observing your surroundings for subtle anomalies, success depends on your ability to stay calm, think ahead, and adapt to changing situations.
Blending survival, stealth, exploration, and psychological horror, this collection offers three distinct stories united by one common theme: overcoming impossible odds. Every location presents new threats, every objective demands careful planning, and every victory feels earned.

Do you have what it takes to survive, escape, and uncover the truth?
70070000039413.intro: Face the unknown, escape the impossible.
70070000039413.name: Big Survival Collection 3-in-1

70070000039464.description:
Experience the original adventures of the Treflik Family. Get ready for a wholesome journey through childhood. A new Nintendo Switch™ children's show is here!

VALUABLE LIFE LESSONS

Get to know these adorable characters and watch them learn valuable friendship, respect, honesty, and tolerance.

A COLORFUL WORLD

Journey through your favorite adventures of The Treflik Family. Put your spin on these stories through the Coloring Book section and give them your unique look.

This bundle includes the Girl's Night DLC.
70070000039464.intro: Leap into a world of imagination alongside Treflik and his sister Treflinka. Give in to this magical land and see it through their eyes.
70070000039464.name: The Treflik Family Girl's Night Edition

70070000039468.description:
Enter a dangerous ocean adventure, where every wave brings new threats and every decision can determine your survival. Navigate unpredictable waters, protect your ship from relentless shark attacks, gather resources, and fight to stay afloat in a hostile environment.

This Bundle Includes:
1. SHARK SIEGE - TOGETHER SURVIVAL
Survive the endless ocean, manage your ship, collect resources, and defend yourself against a massive shark while facing storms, hazards, and unpredictable challenges.
2. SHARK SIEGE - TOGETHER SURVIVAL: Ocean Vessel
Expand your ocean adventure with a brand-new ship, giving you a fresh vessel to explore dangerous waters and continue your battle for survival.

Take on the deep sea, overcome every threat, and experience your survival journey with an upgraded maritime adventure.
70070000039468.intro: Survive the waves and conquer the endless deep sea.
70070000039468.name: SHARK SIEGE - TOGETHER SURVIVAL: Wild Waters

70070000039496.description:
Experience the mystery and challenges of the desert in The Long Desert Drive. Wake up with no answers, rely on your old car, gather resources, and travel through an unpredictable world filled with danger, secrets, and unexpected encounters.

Bundle Includes:
The Long Desert Drive ‒ Explore the vast desert, scavenge for supplies, upgrade your vehicle, and uncover the mystery behind a silent world while fighting to survive every mile.

The Long Desert Drive: Survival Knife ‒ Give your survival knife a fresh new appearance with an updated skin and inventory icon, adding a unique style to one of your most important tools.

Continue your journey through the desert, overcome every challenge, and experience survival with an enhanced visual upgrade.
70070000039496.intro: Explore the endless desert and uncover the secrets left behind.
70070000039496.name: The Long Desert Drive: Forgotten World

70070000039517.description:
Begin your adventure with Cup Heroes and a helpful collection of Coins, Diamonds, Rare Keys, and Epic Keys!

Step into the whimsical world of Cup Heroes, where everyday cups turn into mighty heroes on an epic quest to save their beloved Queen!

How to Play:
- Control Your Heroes: Navigate your heroes through various obstacles and puzzles.
- Save the Queen: Your goal is to rescue the Queen, who has been captured by evil forces.
- Unlock and Upgrade Characters: Collect coins and diamonds to unlock a diverse cast of characters, each with unique abilities. Upgrade their skills to make them even more powerful and adaptable to different challenges.

Features:
- Premium Currency: Use 250 Diamonds to unlock new heroes, purchase keys to open exclusive chests, obtain high-rarity gear, and gain a powerful edge in battle
- Base Currency: Use 1500 Coins to upgrade your gear and permanent stats
- Rare Keys: Open 25 rare crates containing Common, Uncommon, or Rare gear
- Epic Keys: Open 10 epic crates containing Uncommon, Rare, or Epic gear
- Merge Gear: Merge identical items to create stronger versions and unlock new bonuses
- Unique Characters: Meet a colourful cast of cup heroes, from the brave Knight Cup to the cunning Ninja Cup. Each character brings their own special skills and personality to the team
- Epic Adventures: Explore various enchanting worlds, from mystical forests to fiery volcanoes. Every level is a new adventure filled with hidden secrets and dangerous foes
- Challenging Puzzles: Test your brain with mind-bending puzzles that require clever solutions. Use your heroes’ abilities to overcome obstacles and progress through the game
- Exciting Battles: Engage in thrilling combat with evil minions and powerful bosses. Use your heroes’ special moves and teamwork to defeat enemies and save the Queen
- Beautiful Graphics: Enjoy stunning, colourful graphics that bring the world of Cup Heroes to life. Each scene is meticulously designed to enhance your gaming experience
- Daily Quests: Log in every day to participate in limited-time quests and earn multiple resources
- Addictive Gameplay: Easy to learn but hard to master

Your Cup Heroes are waiting for you to lead them to victory!
70070000039517.intro: Power up your gear and climb the rarity ranks!
70070000039517.name: Cup Heroes: Beginner Merge Bundle

70070000039519.description:
Step into a pastel paradise where creativity meets comfort. In Cozy Tiny Home, every item tells a story - from soft cushions and glowing lamps to shelves packed with memories. Whether you’re decorating a snug study, a sunny living room, or a peaceful bedroom, each space becomes your own cozy retreat filled with charm, color, and serenity.


Relax and express yourself through endless decorating possibilities. Combine cute furniture, cheerful plants, and playful accessories to make your dream home come alive with warmth and personality. With cuddly cats, curious bunnies, and plenty of smiles, every moment feels like a cozy hug!

This bundle includes the Floor & Wallpaper, Cat Pack 1, Cat Pack 2, Japan, and Capibara Pack DLCs.

KEY FEATURES:
- Build and decorate your own cozy rooms in a cute, pastel world
- Invite adorable cats, bunnies, and other fluffy friends to share your space
- Hundreds of lovely furniture pieces, plants, and decorations to mix and match
- Soft, relaxing music and soothing atmosphere for pure comfort
- Endless creativity — design your dream home your way
- Perfect for players who love cozy vibes, cute animals, and relaxing design games
70070000039519.intro: Welcome to Cozy Tiny Home, a warm and heart-melting decorating game where you can design the most adorable spaces imaginable - and fill them with sweet animal friends!
70070000039519.name: Cozy Tiny Home Decorator Edition

70070000039524.description:
America has fallen into enemy hands. It’s up to you to fight back! Build your defenses, rally your firepower, and lead the charge to take the nation back - state by state, battle by battle.

Strategically deploy turrets, unleash devastating machine guns, and adapt your tactics to survive relentless enemy waves and towering bosses. Every victory pushes the front lines forward and brings you one step closer to restoring freedom across the land.

Earn cash from every fallen foe, upgrade your weapons, and unlock powerful new gear to hold the line. Each liberated state strengthens your army and opens up new challenges, enemies, and rewards. With every push and every win, you’re shaping the future of a free America!

Features:
- Tower defense-inspired gameplay with intense tactical action
- New weapons: Bring the cold to the front lines with the Snowball Launcher and Blizzard!
- Extra coins: Boost your campaign with 2500 coins to upgrade your weapons, turrets, and base
- Tons of guns, turrets, and upgrades to build your unstoppable defense
- Ruthless enemies and bosses to test your strategy and reflexes
- Dozens of states and countries to liberate, each with unique challenges and rewards
- Strategic progression system. Earn resources, upgrade gear, and conquer!

Take back the land. Rebuild the nation. Fight For America!
70070000039524.intro: Gear up, soldier - it’s time to reclaim freedom!
70070000039524.name: Fight For America: Cold Edition

70070000039526.description:
Push your limits and dominate the asphalt in Speedway Legends: Overdrive Racing, a high-octane experience where speed, precision, and style define your legacy. Master intense modes like Drift, Circuit, and Time Attack, unleash powerful Overdrive boosts, and build the ultimate racing machine to outpace every rival.

This bundle includes the main title and the Money Boost DLC, giving you an instant cash injection to accelerate your journey to the top. Upgrade your cars, fine-tune performance, unlock powerful vehicles, and customize your ride with ease. Gain the advantage you need to compete at the highest level and leave your rivals behind.

Strap in, hit the gas, and become the legend every racer fears.
70070000039526.name: Speedway Legends Premium Edition

70070000039529.description:
Enter the blocky world, where relentless zombie hordes, dangerous bosses, and challenging missions await around every corner. Explore ruined locations, collect valuable resources, upgrade your equipment, and fight to survive in an action-packed pixel adventure.

Bundle Includes:
1. Zombie Blocks: Pixel Shooter Gun (Base Game)
Battle endless waves of zombies, explore dangerous environments, complete rewarding quests, defeat powerful bosses, and build your arsenal as you fight for survival.

2. Zombie Blocks: Pixel Shooter Gun – Coin Boost (DLC)
Receive an additional 500 coins added to your in-game balance, giving you extra resources to upgrade your equipment and support your progress throughout the adventure.

Face the undead, strengthen your arsenal, and survive the blocky apocalypse with extra resources ready to spend.
70070000039529.intro: Survive the pixel apocalypse and fight endless zombie waves.
70070000039529.name: Zombie Blocks: Pixel Shooter Gun – Pixel Warrior

70070000039538.description:
Face the untamed wilderness of the swamp with the ultimate Survival Float Simulator collection. Build and expand your raft, gather resources, craft equipment, catch fish, purify water, defend yourself against dangerous crocodiles, and transform a simple floating shelter into a thriving sanctuary.

This bundle includes:
1. Survival Float Simulator - Crocodile Waters Craft, Raft, Build
Explore dangerous swamp waters, craft essential equipment, expand your raft, gather resources, fish for survival, and defend yourself against deadly crocodiles.

2. Survival Float Simulator: Fishing & Crafting Tools Update
Improve your survival with upgraded fishing and grappling tools featuring better performance, durability, and precision.

3. Survival Float Simulator - Crocodile Waters Craft, Raft, Build: Legendary Arms
Equip redesigned versions of the sword, spear, and club with striking new visuals inspired by the mysterious swamp.

4. Survival Float Simulator - Crocodile Waters Craft, Raft, Build: Tool Textures
Refresh the look of your essential tools with enhanced hammer and axe textures for a more immersive crafting and building experience.

Strengthen your raft, upgrade your equipment, and master every challenge as you fight to survive the dangers hidden within the swamp.
70070000039538.intro: Build, battle, and thrive in crocodile territory.
70070000039538.name: Survival Float Simulator - Crocodile Waters Craft, Raft, Build: Survival Quest

70070000039539.description:
A third-person stealth adventure game focused on the story of Moonshadow Huntress Cynthia Stranborg. Take control of the young adept and learn new stealth skills during your journey. Find out what happened in her home village and follow your own path to rescue the ones you love the most. Travel through Tesana Valley to find a hidden fragment of an artifact to enhance your bow. The Dark Power is coming from the north. You need to destroy the source of this power before it's too late. You are the last one who can reach that destination. At the very least you have to try, for your loved ones!

Key features:
- Stylized and colorful world.
- Fully voiced emotional story.
- Stealth mechanics, arrow crafting, climbing sequences and light puzzle solving.
- A short story-driven game (to finish in one evening).
- Several alternative outfits to unlock throughout the game.
- A dedicated photo mode with multiple options to modify poses, camera effects, stickers, facial expressions, etc.
70070000039539.name: Cynthia: Hidden in the Moonshadow - Combo Edition

70070000039542.description:
Step into the role of a police officer, where every decision shapes your career and every mission tests your skills. Train at the shooting range, patrol the city, respond to dangerous situations, and maintain order while building your reputation as a trusted officer.

Bundle Includes:
POLICE OFFICERS SIMULATOR – Experience the life of a police officer, complete various missions, develop your skills, unlock new equipment, and make choices that influence the city around you.

POLICE OFFICERS SIMULATOR: Patrol Style – Change your character’s appearance with a new visual style, giving your officer a refreshed look as you continue your patrols and protect the city.

Take on new challenges, uphold justice, and experience your police career with an updated appearance.
70070000039542.intro: Make your officer truly stand out during every mission.
70070000039542.name: POLICE OFFICERS SIMULATOR: City Patrol

70070000039545.description:
The CAPTAIN TSUBASA 2: WORLD FIGHTERS Season Pass includes:

• DLC Character Pack 1
Includes 2 playable characters, 9 move cards, 4 uniforms, 10 customization items, and more!
• DLC Character Pack 2
Includes 2 playable characters, 9 move cards, 5 uniforms, 9 customization items, and more!
• DLC Character Pack 3
Includes 2 playable characters, 8 move cards, 5 uniforms, 9 customization items, and more!
• Season Pass Bonus
- Ball Customization: Black Ball

*Season Pass DLC contents will be released by August 2027. Additional details will be provided at a later date.
*This product includes content sold individually and within the Deluxe & Ultimate Editions. Please be aware of duplicate purchases.
70070000039545.name: CAPTAIN TSUBASA 2: WORLD FIGHTERS - Season Pass

70070000039580.description:
This special bundle includes the main game Exstetra together with the following content:
• Exstetra - Item Set
• Exstetra - Rune Set
----------------------------
Exstetra follows the story of Ryoma, a high school student chosen to become a Prisma, the savior destined to protect Amejia, a Tokyo fused with another world and doomed to destruction.
During his journey, Ryoma meets future Prisma Knights who share the same mission. By awakening their powers with a kiss, he joins them on an adventure to save two worlds.

◆ STORY ◆
Kiss her...
It is the only way to save two worlds from ruin.
Amejia was born from the fusion of Tokyo and another realm. As the chosen Prisma, Ryoma fights to prevent the extinction of both worlds.
Find the friends who were drawn into Amejia and awaken their hidden powers as Prisma Knights through the power of a kiss.
The only way to save the world is a kiss.

◆ WORLD ◆

70070000039806.description:
Deluxe Edition includes the following content:
- Base Game
- Ink & Gold Elegance Outfit Collection
- Mistveil Detective Outfit Collection

Murders on the Yangtze River is a Chinese-style side-scrolling detective adventure game developed by OMEGAMES STUDIO.
There is no such thing as a perfect crime — only clues that have yet to be discovered.

- Every Trace Leaves a Mark -

Set in the turbulent era of the late Qing Dynasty and early Republic of China, where ancient and modern, Eastern and Western cultures collided and intertwined, you will step into the role of the protagonist and become entangled in an unavoidable conspiracy.

Seemingly unrelated events gradually lead you toward a massive mystery and the secrets hidden behind your own identity.

A lie is simply a fact disguised in another form. Can you uncover the truth hidden beneath layers of deception and piece together the final answer from a series of intertwined cases?

- A Meticulously Crafted Logic-Based Mystery -

During your journey, you will encounter a series of bizarre and perplexing cases. To uncover the truth behind each incident and identify the culprit, you will need to:

Explore different locations as the story unfolds, searching for every hidden clue and subtle detail.

Investigate crime scenes, collect evidence, and question witnesses.

Even uncover contradictions and loopholes hidden within the testimonies you have gathered...

- Intricate Cases with Twists and Turns -

The seemingly unrelated cases that occur across different locations are, in fact, connected by countless threads to the greater mystery surrounding the protagonist.

Behind every case lies an ingenious method of crime and a deeply moving motive.

Every ordinary person carries their own complicated past, with countless hidden conflicts and entangled relationships.

Can you unravel every layer of the mystery, discover the ultimate truth behind the grand case, and complete your journey of revenge?

- A Breathtaking Chinese Ink Painting World -

Follow a beautifully unfolding ink-wash scroll as you travel through the landscapes of China over a century ago.

Sail across Dongting Lake and encounter the historic Yueyang Tower once again;

Travel along the Yangtze River and explore the steampunk-inspired Hanyang Iron Works;

Wander through the misty waterways and elegant scenery of Jiangnan in Yangzhou;

Step into the dazzling streets of Shanghai’s foreign concessions and experience the city's retro modernity from a century ago...

Every scene is carefully crafted like a living painting, inviting you to experience local cultures, explore historical landscapes, and solve mysteries across different regions.

- Meticulously Researched Historical and Cultural Design -

The game's world, art style, and environments are based on extensive research from museum archives, historical photographs, and discussions with experts in history and culture.

The story is built upon real historical backgrounds, recreating the architecture, landscapes, and social atmosphere of China over a hundred years ago.

From carefully researched character costumes to authentic everyday objects, every detail is designed to immerse you in the rich historical and cultural atmosphere of the late Qing Dynasty and early Republic of China.
70070000039806.name: Murders on the Yangtze River Deluxe Edition

70070000039897.description:
Includes all six episodes of the TV drama broadcast on Nippon TV, one of Japan's leading nationwide television networks!
Experience the world of AKIBA LOST through a unique live-action experience that offers a different perspective from the game.

Also included are the in-game Pixel Character Costume Sets!
The set includes Shinjo in his school days, along with costumes for Kokone, Chihiro, and Yukimi.

Story
Thirteen years ago, six girls mysteriously disappeared in Akihabara — a series of unsolved cases known as "The Akiba Vanishing".

At the annual Tokyo Game Expo, Daiki Shinjo (played by Hiromitsu Kitayama), once hailed as a "genius creator," boldly announces the development of a new game inspired by this very incident: AKIBA LOST.
But soon thereafter, the strange disappearances begin again.

The cast of the game includes his sister Aoi Shinjo, who works at a maid cafe, underground idol Kokone Nagato, food writer Moe Kurosu, shrine maiden Chihiro Jimbo, cosplayer Wakana Yusa, and game streamer Yukimi Kurahashi — each a colorful icon of Akihabara’s vibrant subculture.

The story they were supposed to perform soon begins to bleed into reality.
It all starts with a threatening phone call — and the sudden disappearance of Aoi.

"Stop developing the game now. Or else...the tragedy will repeat again."

Can Shinjo finish developing the game? Can he protect everyone? Who is behind it all? And what really happened 13 years ago?
70070000039897.intro: A live-action multi-perspective suspense game of fate and choice in Akihabara
70070000039897.name: AKIBA LOST: Drama Movie & Pixel Character Costume Set

The Slormancer is an epic 2D Action-RPG Dungeon Crawling game following a band of outcasts on their fight against hordes of enemies led by The Slormancer! Play as a Mighty Knight, a Fierce Huntress or a Mischievous Mage, master hundreds of abilities and ancestral powers, gear up, fight for the reputation of your kind and prove your value to the realm.

Experience fast-paced gameplay, loads of shiny loot, tons of collectibles, countless hours of content, and carefully crafted pixel art.

You were born with absolutely no skill whatsoever, and yet you find a way to be the last hope of the realm as the enigmatic Slormancer and his incompetent underling try to conquer the world once again. How great. But like your grandfather once told you: "You might not have the talent but you have the will."

KEY FEATURES
- Unlock and master more than 200 unique Abilities, Upgrades and Passives for every class. Each active Ability has its own skill tree, allowing you to create unique combinations.
- Choose your Legacy and inherit ancient powers among more than 150 Element-related Skills and Passives in the Ancestral Skill Tree.
- Master Fire and summon powerful elementals, use Ice to freeze your foes, convoke Thunder and create massive storms, embrace the power of Light or make one with Shadow, it's up to you!
- 120 unique and game-changing weapons available for every class. Each Slorm Reaper is a unique and priceless weapon that you can loot during your adventure. Once found, wield it to benefit from its powerful effect, level it up, and eventually evolve it to a greater form.
- Find and collect Normal, Magic, Rare and Epic items with completely random properties but also shiny Legendary items with more than 200 unique affixes.
- Then enhance them with an infinite upgrade system!
- Unlock Skills, Upgrades, Ancestral Abilities, Ultimatums and Runes, find Epic Items, and collect Slorm Reapers to create deadly combinations that suit your own play style!
- The Slormancer is all about Collection and Progression so you can switch at any point between any skills you’ve previously unlocked, Slorm Reapers and items you’ve previously found, even between the 3 classes of the game! This unique Flexibility allows you to swap between different combinations and play styles in the blink of an eye, whenever you feel like it.
- Defeat lots of unique monsters, elites and bosses with more than 40 different affixes through procedurally generated adventures, venture into The Slorm Temple, face The Great Forge and hunt down The Warlords in The Netherworld through 7 different environments. There are always things to do and monsters to kill! And it's always different!

WAIT! THERE'S MORE
- A soundtrack so breathtaking that you will never want to hear something else again.
- A story so deep and meaningful that you will tell it to your grandchildren.
- A spooky but lovely village full of absurd villagers.
- Loadouts, Loot Filters, it’s all in there!
- Tons of options, screenshakes, damage numbers, we got you covered!
- Bindable controls.

70070000039927.description:
Welcome to Hex Park – Ultra Bundle, the complete puzzle experience that includes both the Hex Park base game and Hex Park: Ultra DLC.

Rotate and align arrow tiles to guide directions, trigger satisfying chain reactions, clear obstacles, and solve each board in as few moves as possible. Easy to learn yet delightfully challenging to master, Hex Park offers relaxing, strategic gameplay that's impossible to put down.

The base game introduces a colorful world of handcrafted puzzles featuring clever mechanics like keys and locks, mystery tiles, bombs, ice counters, gears, and more. Once you've mastered those challenges, continue your journey with Hex Park: Ultra DLC, adding 75 brand-new handcrafted levels designed to test your planning, precision, and puzzle-solving skills with even more intricate layouts and clever combinations of mechanics.

Need a little help? Handy tools like the hammer, dynamite, and drill can get you unstuck without taking away the satisfaction of solving each puzzle. With no timers and no pressure, you can enjoy every challenge at your own pace.

Why you'll love Hex Park – Ultra Bundle:

• Includes the complete Hex Park base game and Hex Park: Ultra DLC
• 75 additional handcrafted Ultra DLC levels
• Clever mechanics including keys, locks, mystery tiles, bombs, ice counters, gears, and more
• Strategic gameplay that's easy to learn and rewarding to master
• Helpful tools that keep the challenge fair and fun
• Relaxing gameplay with no timers or pressure
• Achievements and cloud save support

Whether you're discovering Hex Park for the first time or looking to conquer every challenge, Hex Park – Ultra Bundle is the definitive way to experience the complete Hex Park adventure.
70070000039927.intro:
One bundle. Endless brainteasers.
Master every puzzle in Hex Park
with the complete game and DLC.
70070000039927.name: Hex Park - Ultra Bundle

70070000039970.description:
Dive deeper into the chaotic, beautifully pixelated Abyss with Neon Abyss 2! The action is faster, the stakes are higher, and the possibilities are endless in this cybermyth roguelike. With explosive run 'n' gun gameplay, diverse combat styles, and unlimited item synergies, Neon Abyss 2 delivers a dramatic, thrill-packed experience every time you enter.

This Deluxe Edition includes the Archenemy Returns DLC and our Supporter Pack! 

Every God from the original Neon Abyss makes an appearance in Neon Abyss 2 with Archenemy Returns - with 35 bosses upgraded, balanced and visually enhanced to fit with the evolving Abyss.

If Agents would like to support a little further, the Supporter Pack provides a cosmetic-only enhancement with a new Saya outfit, in-game representation, an in-game record player with the OST and all holiday-exclusive cosmetics!

NEW 4 PLAYER CO-OP!
Team Work makes the Dream Work!
Neon Abyss 2 introduces exhilarating online 4-player co-op, allowing you and up to three friends to dive into the roguelike chaos together. Band together to multiply each of your unique synergies and combos, creating powerful forces of destruction. Coordinate your builds and conquer the Abyss as a team, even exploring different
rooms within the same map to maximize efficiency and uncover hidden secrets and treasures.

UNIMAGINABLE WEAPONRY
A Revolutionary Weapon System
What's your combat style? Smash enemies up close with a bat or saber, unleash attacks with deadly plants, or command fierce dragon-like creatures to fight for you—the choice is yours! With limitless options and an inventive arsenal, every run lets you experiment with unique, wild ways to conquer the Abyss.

UNLIMTED  ITEM SYNERGIES
Even More Monstrous!
Random item drops in the Abyss grant you powers that combine in surprising and powerful ways. Stack as many as you can to create wild, unstoppable synergies that make every run feel unique. Show the Abyss who’s really in charge—there’s no limit to how many items you can wield!

HATCH THEM ALL!
Hatchmon! I choose you!
Your favourite Abyss companions, now in even brighter colours! Hatch and collect these cute creatures, then evolve them into powerful and unique allies to spice up your runs. With a wide variety of Hatchmon to discover, each run brings new possibilities!

THE POWER OF FAITH
Turn the Tides!
Introducing the all-new Faith System, designed to turn the tides when the Abyss gets tough. How will you wield this power? Spend it in a shop stocked with powerful items, recruit more Hatchmon to fight by your side, or... risk it all in a game of chance? Either way, we have faith in you!

...AND MORE!
Discover as You Explore
Uncover a host of new features and surprises in this dynamic second instalment. From new enemies and powerful gods, to updated loot and hidden secrets, there’s always something fresh to discover. The Abyss awaits—dive deeper and uncover secrets you may not face alone!
70070000039970.name: Neon Abyss 2 - Deluxe Edition

70070000039977.description:
Play as a courageous stray cat and explore a ruined city filled with danger. Rescue lost kittens, find food for other strays, uncover hidden paths, and avoid swarms of insects and hostile dogs. Use stealth, speed, and teamwork to survive.

Team up with a friend in two-player local co-op. Share supplies, protect each other, and rely on stealth and speed through the expanded set of eight story-driven levels, filled with quests and secret areas. The world may be overrun… but courage still meows in the dark.

Features

• Rescue kittens and help other strays survive
• Solve puzzles, discover secrets, and avoid dangerous enemies
• Atmospheric visuals and an evolving ambient soundtrack

70070000039977.name: Little Strays 2: Cat Rescue

Oxide Room 104

70070000040004.name: Shalnor: Silverwind Saga Bundle

70070000040005.description:
Street Racing Simulator EVO : Car & Moto
Are you ready to take the wheel and experience the most realistic and exhilarating driving simulation on handheld? Street Racing EVO, developed by Ovilex, is here to redefine your expectations of car and motorcycle racing games. With its stunning visuals, immersive gameplay, and endless customization options, this game is a must-play for any driving enthusiast.

What Makes Street Racing Simulator EVO Stand Out?
Unmatched Realism and Highly Detailed Vehicles
Every car and motorcycle is crafted with precision, featuring intricate interiors and exteriors that bring your ride to life.

Dual Thrills: Cars & Motorcycles
Whether you’re a fan of high-performance sports cars or the agility of motorcycles, Street Racing EVO has it all. Race through challenging terrains on two wheels or dominate the streets in your customized dream car.

Thrilling Challenges
Engage in high-speed races, evade police chases, and complete adrenaline-pumping challenges. Test your driving skills and prove you’re the best on the road.

Multiple Race Types to Choose From
Compete in Sprint, Time Attack, Speed Camera, Average Speed, Drag, and Top Speed races. Take your skills to the track for endless racing excitement.

Stunning Graphics
Experience breathtaking visuals that bring the game world to life. From scenic rural roads to vibrant cityscapes, every environment is designed to immerse you in the ultimate driving adventure.

Why You’ll Love Street Racing EVO
Immersive Gameplay
The combination of realistic vehicle dynamics, first-person POV, and dynamic environments creates an experience that feels truly authentic.
Something for Everyone
Whether you’re into street racing, police pursuits, or simply cruising through an open world, this game caters to all types of players.

Car Simulator : Driving School
Car Simulator : Driving School puts you behind the wheel and lets you become a true master of the road! Explore vast open regions inspired by real-world locations, drive an impressive collection of cars across multiple categories, and take on a wide variety of driving challenges — all powered by realistic handling and immersive driving conditions.

Choose from 50 detailed vehicles, including hatchbacks, sedans, coupes, SUVs, supercars, and hypercars. Complete 75 unique missions, race on 3 dedicated tracks, or enjoy Free Ride mode across all maps. Customize your car inside and out with paint options, bodykits, interior trims, and more.

Features:

• 50 cars to choose from, including 11 hatchbacks, 8 sedans, 10 coupes, 7 SUVs, 9 supercars, and 5 hypercars
• 8 open regions inspired by real locations: Washington, Chicago, Madrid, Montreal, Arizona Countryside, Texas Highway, European Countryside, and Europe Highway
• 75 missions ranging from beginner driving lessons to advanced challenges
• 3 Race Tracks plus Free Ride mode available on all maps
• Extensive vehicle customization, including exterior paint, bodykits, wheels, interior trims, and more
• 4 selectable driving conditions: Daytime, Nighttime, Dusk, and Rain
• Realistic driving physics and detailed vehicle interiors
• Explore, practice, race, or simply cruise — the choice is yours

Become the ultimate driver with Car Simulator : Driving School!
70070000040005.intro:
Feel the engine. Hear the world.
Every road becomes a story —
...and you’re the one behind the wheel.
70070000040005.name: Car & Moto Simulator Bundle : Racing & Driving

70070000040006.description:
Vikings Pinball
Fun pinball style battles. Attack the military camps of the holy Roman Empire and crush the legionaries. Choose the right trajectories to inflict as much damage as possible.  Shoot down enemies, blow up barrels and collect coins. Free the map from these lazybones!

Sled Riders
Jump into the most fun sled race game! Get ready for snowy tracks, each one special and full of surprises. Race through Snowflake City or over Frost Mountain - every race is an adventure!
Make your Racer look cool with fun outfits and hats. Pick a bright suit or a cute snowman costume to stand out in the snow.
Choose your sled! Race with friends in exciting races that are easy to play but hard to win. You'll get new outfits and sleighs the more you race.
So grab your controller, pick your sled, and let's race!

Fridge Escape
Everyone wants to eat you! Open the refrigerator door and run away. Avoid obstacles so you don't lose speed.
Jump over stools, slip under chairs and run onto tables.
Remember that a very hungry person is running after you and you can't stop.
Collect coins and choose fun skins for each new run. Make big jumps, take sharp turns and find shortcuts. The main thing is not to stop and run!

Forest Cafe
It's time to take care of cute animals and build a cozy cafe for them in a forest clearing. Get everything ready for the reception. Add various tasty dishes and drinks to the menu.
Set the work so that no one has to wait in line for too long, or the animals will get upset. Hire and train staff. Make your cafe the most popular in the forest!

Race Track Maniacs
Experience racing like never before! Feel the adrenaline as you race through the best tracks, mastering every turn and straightaway with precision. It's not just about speed - it's about control and strategy.
Navigate sharp turns, push your limits, and feel the rush of high-speed competition. The racetrack is your playground - conquer it, own it, and become a true racing champion!

Be A Bee
Honey isn't just a sweet treat. It's a whole new world, and you can be a part of the delicious bee life. Build your hive. Explore new green zones to gather resources and produce honey. It's not as easy as it seems at first. But it's worth a try!
Add more hives for the families of bees to keep them comfortable. This is the right way to grow your bee empire and reach new worlds! Enjoy the rewards of your hard work.

Crowd Run
Being a hero isn't easy. Use all your skills to protect people from the hordes. Stay alert to keep everyone safe.
Use all available weapons to cause as much damage as possible. Clear the all levels from the danger and keep your fortress safe. Shoot. Reload. And shoot again. Repeat.

Save The Doge
Solving the puzzles and saving the little puppies is the best way to spend your time.
Draw the lines accurately, so the angry bees can't even touch our beloved dog. Each level is a new challenge for your brain and skills. Find the best solutions in every puzzle. The bees are so annoying. Keep them away as much as possible!

Save The Doge 2
New challenging levels are here! Solve the puzzles and save the little puppies. This is still the best way to spend your time!
You still have to draw the lines so the angry bees can't even touch the puppy. All new levels will challenge your brain and skills. Still find the best solution in each level. The bees won't stop until they reach the goal. Keep them away as long as you can!

Skull Pirates: Adventures
Ahoy, buddy! Get ready for an exciting adventure! Board your pirate ship to explore mysterious islands and find hidden treasures. But beware! Dangerous torpedoes from enemy submarines and rival pirates are out to sink your ship.
You are the captain trying to find your way to new islands. Customize your ship, navigate the deep waters, and face all the challenges of the pirate life. Use your skills to stay alive as long as possible and collect trophies for your skills.
70070000040006.intro: This 10-in-1 Best Hits bundle is perfect for players of all ages and interests! You'll find everything you want to play in this one-of-a-kind bundle!
70070000040006.name: Best Hits Fun Collection 10 in 1 Bundle

70070000040027.description:
The Digital Deluxe Edition Includes:

Dispatch Full Game
Cast & Crew Commentary* - Play with unscripted audio commentary from the voice cast or the development team
Storyboard Mode - Play the game with the original storyboards
The Art of Dispatch: Digital Artbook** - 100+ pages
4 Digital Comics* - 45+ pages

*Commentary audio is English only and is not subtitled
**Only available with English text

Dispatch is a superhero workplace comedy set in modern day Los Angeles from the writers and directors of Tales from the Borderlands and The Wolf Among Us, and features an all-star cast including Aaron Paul, Laura Bailey, and Jeffrey Wright.

Note: Some mature content from Dispatch's original version has been modified.

You play as Robert Robertson, AKA Mecha Man, whose mech-suit is destroyed in a battle against his nemesis, forcing him to take a job at a superhero dispatch center: not as a hero, but a dispatcher.

As their dispatcher, you take charge of a team of ex-supervillains given a shot at redemption. Manage and level up your roster, all while navigating office relationships and romances, and rebuilding your suit for a shot at revenge!

> Shape the Story

In Dispatch, every decision you make influences the unfolding narrative. From banter in the breakroom to life-or-death situations in the field, your choices affect your relationships with the heroes, their allegiances, and the path your own story takes.

>  Deploy Your Heroes

Use the strategy map to review ongoing emergencies and deploy the right (or wrong) heroes to deal with them. Balance the risks and rewards as you make tactical decisions, knowing that each choice can have lasting consequences for your team and the city.

> Manage Your Roster

Managing heroes sometimes goes beyond their powers. Each hero comes with quirks, flaws, and baggage you’ll need to navigate to keep the team together. Upgrade their skills and unlock abilities to boost their effectiveness in the field.

Blending narrative, strategy, and humor, Dispatch explores what it means to be a hero, whether you're wearing a cape or behind a desk.

Featuring an all-star cast from every corner of entertainment

Aaron Paul (Breaking Bad, Westworld, Black Mirror)
Laura Bailey (The Legend of Vox Machina, The Last of Us II, Marvel's Spider-Man)
Erin Yvette (Hades II, The Wolf Among Us, Armored Core VI: Fires of Rubicon)
MoistCr1TiKaL (Charles White)
Jacksepticeye (Sonic Prime, River City Girls 1 & 2, Bendy and the Ink Machine)
Travis Willingham (The Legend of Vox Machina, Critical Role, Lego Avengers)
Alanah Pearce (V/H/S Beyond, Cyberpunk 2077, Gears 5)
Lance Cantstopolis (Karate, Dancing, Actor)
Joel Haver (Filmmaker, Actor, YouTuber)
THOT SQUAD (Musician: Pound Cake, Hoes Depressed)
Yung Gravy (Musician: Betty (Get Money), oops!)
Matthew Mercer (Critical Role, Overwatch, Resident Evil 6)
and Jeffrey Wright (American Fiction, The Batman, Casino Royale)
70070000040027.name: Digital Deluxe Edition

70070000040226.intro: Awaken your child's imagination with Paint for Kids.
70070000040226.name: Paint For Kids Master Edition

70070000040227.description:
DELICIOUS ADVENTURE
Cook For Love is a cozy cooking game where you’ll be in the shoes of Clement – a young Frenchman, who gets hired at a popular Parisian restaurant. With the help of a recipe book, you will be able to cook unique dishes of varying complexity and conquer the world’s taste buds!


FROM NOVICE TO MAESTRO
Clement starts his mentorship under Jean-Luc Chatillone – a culinary legend… currently onboard the Orient Express. Even though he’s away, Jean-Luc’s recipe book lands in Clement’s hands.

You will be cooking with various kitchen appliances and using many different ingredients. With over 40 available recipes you have your path laid out in front of you – now it’s time to roll up your sleeves and cook until you earn the title of a true chef.


RECIPES FOR JOYFUL LIFE
As you learn how to cook new dishes you also earn reputation points, which in turn level up your chef experience. New recipes will be unlocked on the way and they will get more complex (and more delicious) as you go.

After everything’s ready there will be a final test… will the critics grant you the Golden Spoon, young chef?

Cook For Love is a look into the past of Grandma Rose’s husband – Clement, before he met his wife on the Orient Express. While this is not a prequel to Tell Me Your Story, it’s a look at the youth of these two lovebirds from another perspective.

This bundle includes the La Côte d'Azur DLC.

HIGHLIGHTS:
- Over 40 various recipes to master…
- …and delicious pictures to look at.
- Cozy and stressless vibes.
- Learning how to make some of the most well-known recipes.
- Get to know Clement better long before he met Rose.
- Beautiful, hand-drawn art style with bright colors.
- English, Korean and Japanese subtitles and UI
70070000040227.intro: Win the hearts of Parisians with your cooking, discover delicious recipes, and become a chef worthy of working onboard the Orient Express.
70070000040227.name: Cook For Love La Côte d'Azur Pack

70070000040228.description:
Grab your equipment with you and begin your journey to become a master of nGolf. Explore beautiful and minimalist locations full of traps, puzzles, and amazing views.


FIND YOUR WAY
While playing nGolf you will face many challenges on your way. Lasers, spikes, flames and many more will try to stop your ball. Remember that timing is the key to success and you shouldn’t hurry with your hit. Go with the flow and master all worlds.


PLAN YOUR APPROACH
There is an unlimited number of possible solutions to finish levels. Different angles and strengths can change the trajectory of the ball diametrically. Check your surroundings for hills, teleports, or speed boosters. Each element gives you a new opportunity to hit the hole.


BECOME A GOLF MASTER
To become a professional, you have to collect all stars on each stage and accomplish the lowest amount of hits. Study the layout of the map, take as many attempts as you need and obtain the title of champion!

This bundle includes the Colorful Golf Balls 9 DLC.

KEY FEATURES:
- 8 unique worlds
- Over 60 levels to master
- Scorecards to help you track your progress
70070000040228.intro: Set off on the most engaging golf adventure you have ever seen and visit breathtaking places from around the world.
70070000040228.name: nGolf Classy Tartan Pack

70070000040238.description:
Step into the heart of modern warfare, where teamwork, precision, and tactical decisions can determine the outcome of every match. As part of an elite squad, fight across diverse combat environments, adapt to different battlefield situations, and work together to reduce the opposing team’s 1000-point score before they can eliminate yours.

Bundle Features:
1. Call of Warfare - FPS MODERN SHOOTER – Engage in fast-paced 5v5 military battles across diverse maps. Use more than 20 weapons, coordinate with your squad, and fight strategically to reduce the opposing team’s score to zero.

2. Call of Warfare - FPS MODERN SHOOTER: Green Armour – Refreshes the armour HUD with a distinctive green visual style and clearer feedback for monitoring your protection during combat.

3. Call of Warfare - FPS MODERN SHOOTER: Tactical Hands – Adds a camouflage green appearance to the player’s hands and gloves, giving your operative a more authentic modern military look.

4. Call of Warfare - FPS Modern Shooter: Battlefield Sky – Updates the skybox across all maps with refreshed skies and a more atmospheric visual presentation for every battle.

Sharpen your skills, coordinate with your squad, customize your battlefield visuals, and step into modern combat ready for the next fight.
70070000040238.intro: Ready your weapon, join your squad, and answer the call of warfare.
70070000040238.name: Call of Warfare - FPS MODERN SHOOTER: Battleground

70070000040248.description:
Give yourself over to the ultimate relaxation! Clay&Cats will make you feel good in a way you didn't know you needed.

Your task is simple - assemble adorable, cat-themed pottery to its full glory. Put back together pawesome vases, purrfect plates, and kittiful bowls. Don't worry about the timers and sweating to pass the challenge - take all the time getting the pieces together and enjoy the satisfying way they click into the right places. Can't get cozier than that!

This bundle includes the Sugar Bowl DLC.

KEY FEATURES:
- 9 categories with 14 levels of pure joy in each
- Lo-fi music providing good vibes for the hours of playing
- Satisfying gameplay that soothes your nervous system
- Tons of adorable, furry troublemakers to admire
70070000040248.intro: You'll forget about the rest of the world with the most satisfying hobby - repairing cute cat pots!
70070000040248.name: Clay&Cats Sugar Bowl Pack

70070000040262.description:
Single Player: Story Mode
Play as Tanjiro and relive the Entertainment District Arc, the Swordsmith Village Arc, and the Hashira Training Arc from the TV anime, Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba!
Battle Upper Rank demons with your allies!

VS Mode:
A total of 54 characters, including those from "Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Infinity Castle", join the fray!

The game features a total of 54 characters, including Tanjiro Kamado, the nine Hashira (The highest-ranking swordsmen of the Demon Slayer Corps), the progenitor of demons, Muzan Kibutsuji and characters such as Akaza and Doma from the movie "Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Infinity Castle".

Take on new challenges both online and offline!

◆ Contents
- Demon Slayer -Kimetsu no Yaiba- The Hinokami Chronicles 2 Main Game
- Character Unlock Keys: Tengen Uzui, Obanai Iguro, Sanemi Shinazugawa, and Gyomei Himejima
- Battle Attire: Tanjiro's Kimono (Entertainment District), Inosuke's Kimono (Entertainment District), and Uzui's Shinobi Attire
- VS Mode System Voices: Upper Rank Demons Set (Akaza, Daki, Gyutaro, Gyokko, Zohakuten)
-"Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Infinity Castle" Character Pass:
Tanjiro Kamado (Infinity Castle), Zenitsu Agatsuma (Infinity Castle), Giyu Tomioka (Infinity Castle), Shinobu Kocho (Infinity Castle), Akaza (Infinity Castle), Doma, Kaigaku

Character Unlock Keys: Academy Tanjiro, Academy Nezuko, Academy Zenitsu, Academy Inosuke, Academy Giyu, Academy Shinobu

Character Unlock Key: Hinatsuru, Makio and Suma
Battle Attire: Hinatsuru, Makio and Suma Kimono (Meal Prep)

70070000040270.description:
Step into the role of a battlefield commander and experience intense strategy shaped by realistic physics. Build your army, manage your resources, deploy diverse units, and adapt your tactics as every battle unfolds in real time.

Bundle Includes:
1.Warfront Tactics: Battlefield Chronicles Battle Simulator
Craft strategic formations, command diverse forces, and overcome challenging scenarios where every decision can determine the outcome. Experience dynamic battlefields, realistic physics, and countless tactical possibilities as you lead your army toward victory.

2. Warfront Tactics: Battlefield Chronicles Battle Simulator – Military Capital
Adds 1,000 in-game currency to your balance, providing extra resources to support your campaign and expand your strategic possibilities.

Plan your moves, strengthen your forces, and adapt to the chaos of war. Take command of the battlefield and prove that your strategy can turn every challenge into victory.
70070000040270.intro: Command your forces and turn strategy into victory.
70070000040270.name: Warfront Tactics: Battlefield Chronicles Battle Simulator – Battlefield Legacy

70070000040275.description:
Embark on an intense intergalactic journey where space combat, exploration, and base building go hand in hand. Pilot your spacecraft, gather resources, discover new worlds, and defend your base against relentless waves of enemies as you fight to survive across the galaxy.

What This Bundle Includes:
1. Space Planet Invader - Cosmic Power
Take command of your own spacecraft and explore diverse planets in search of the perfect location for your base. Gather resources, upgrade your ship, construct defensive structures, and battle hostile aliens, enemy spacecraft, and increasingly powerful waves of threats.

2. Space Planet Invader - Cosmic Power: VR Gear
Expand your equipment collection with additional VR helmets that give you more options as you explore planets, build your base, and take on intense battles across the galaxy.

Prepare for the challenges ahead, strengthen your defenses, and continue your journey through the vastness of space.
70070000040275.intro: Explore alien worlds, build your base, and prepare for the battles ahead.
70070000040275.name: Space Planet Invader - Cosmic Power: Alien Worlds

70070000040278.description:
Step into the role of a border guard in a world overwhelmed by a devastating zombie outbreak. Inspect survivors, assess suspicious symptoms, manage quarantine procedures, and make critical decisions as you work to prevent infection from spreading beyond the restricted zone.

What this bundle contains:
1. Quarantine Lockdown Simulator: Zombie Border
Take control of a dangerous quarantine border, inspect incoming survivors, detect signs of infection, manage the isolation zone, and make difficult decisions under constant pressure.

2. Quarantine Lockdown Simulator: Zombie Border – Frontline Gear
Adds a new visual appearance for the player’s hands, refreshing your first-person view throughout your shifts.

3. Quarantine Lockdown Simulator: Zombie Border – Security Gear
Changes the appearance of the clothing scanner and temperature scanner, giving your inspection equipment a distinctive new look.

Stay vigilant, keep the quarantine zone under control, and face every shift with a refreshed visual setup as the last line of defense against the outbreak.
70070000040278.intro: Guard the border, inspect every arrival, and face the outbreak head-on.
70070000040278.name: Quarantine Lockdown Simulator: Zombie Border – Border Control

70070000040285.description:
Take on a whimsical cooperative platforming adventure where teamwork, timing, and clever navigation are the keys to success. Transport fish through imaginative environments filled with obstacles, traps, secret paths, and unexpected challenges while exploring colorful worlds inspired by chocolate factories, frozen confectioneries, and enchanted forests.

This Bundle Includes:
1.Meow Delivery: Fish Frenzy
Control one or two characters as you coordinate movements, navigate conveyor belts, icy slides, and other hazards, and work toward flawless deliveries. Discover hidden routes, master unique level mechanics, unlock achievements, and put your platforming skills to the test across a variety of creative stages.

2. Meow Delivery: Fish Frenzy – Cute Cat
The DLC adds an exclusive character skin featuring an adorable orange tabby kitten with bright blue eyes and an expressive surprised or startled look.

Take on every delivery, discover new paths, and enjoy the adventure with a fresh feline style by your side.
70070000040285.intro: Deliver fish, overcome obstacles, and do it with extra feline charm.
70070000040285.name: Meow Delivery: Fish Frenzy – Cats on Delivery

70070000040307.description:
Stranded in an international airport with no money, no documents, and nowhere to go, you must find a way to survive while working toward freedom. Manage your time and resources, search for food and water, take on jobs, interact with airport workers and other stranded travelers, and carefully plan each day to avoid falling further behind.

This Bundle Includes:
1. Life in Terminal Simulator : Airport Adventures
Survive life inside a busy international airport, manage limited resources, complete jobs, explore restricted areas, and earn enough money to purchase a forged passport and escape.
2. Life in Terminal Simulator : Airport Adventures – Cozy Shelter
Refreshes the player’s room with a new bed model and introduces a food table in place of the vending machine after reaching the second upgrade level.

Survive another day, make smarter choices, improve your shelter, and keep moving toward the freedom waiting beyond the terminal.
70070000040307.intro: Survive the airport, improve your living space, and chase your way to freedom.
70070000040307.name: Life in Terminal Simulator : Airport Adventures – Airport Life

70070000040311.description:
A third-person stealth adventure game focused on the story of Moonshadow Huntress Cynthia Stranborg. Take control of the young adept and learn new stealth skills during your journey. Find out what happened in her home village and follow your own path to rescue the ones you love the most. Travel through Tesana Valley to find a hidden fragment of an artifact to enhance your bow. The Dark Power is coming from the north. You need to destroy the source of this power before it's too late. You are the last one who can reach that destination. At the very least you have to try, for your loved ones!

Key features:
- Stylized and colorful world.
- Fully voiced emotional story.
- Stealth mechanics, arrow crafting, climbing sequences and light puzzle solving.
- A short story-driven game (to finish in one evening).
- Several alternative outfits to unlock throughout the game.
- A dedicated photo mode with multiple options to modify poses, camera effects, stickers, facial expressions, etc.
70070000040311.name: Cynthia: Hidden in the Moonshadow - Infinite Edition

70070000040313.description:
Dark facilities, unexplained phenomena, and hostile anomalies create a constant fight for survival. Explore eerie locations, investigate disturbing mysteries, and confront unpredictable SCP entities as you search for answers and try to make it through each dangerous encounter.

This bundle includes:
- SCP Foundation: Universe Horror: Explore dark facilities, investigate paranormal mysteries, encounter terrifying SCP entities, and fight to survive unpredictable threats.
- SCP Foundation: Universe Horror – Pistol Ammo: Adds 200 pistol bullets to your inventory, giving you additional ammunition for dangerous encounters.

Uncover what lies beyond the locked doors, stay alert, and be ready for the horrors hiding in the shadows.
70070000040313.intro: Prepare for unexpected encounters around every corner.
70070000040313.name: SCP Foundation: Universe Horror – Survival Protocol

70070000040318.description:
Piece together mysterious fragments of imaginary worlds, where silence reigns and beauty hides beneath decay. Each puzzle draws you deeper into the desolation — will you uncover what remains, or fade into oblivion?

Features:
- Over 64 atmospheric images inspired by dystopian dreams and wasteland landscapes.
- Simple yet captivating swap puzzle mechanics.
- Multiple difficulty levels to test your focus and patience.
- Immersive ambient soundtrack to enhance the somber mood.

Every solved puzzle uncovers another fragment of a dream long forgotten.
70070000040318.intro: Peek into visions of forgotten worlds and reassemble what remains.
70070000040318.name: Oblivion Dreams: Community Edition

70070000040323.description:
Step into the role of a tactical operator in BODY CAM SHOOTER and face aggressive enemies across highly detailed environments. Use different weapons, adapt your tactics, and navigate two unique maps where every encounter demands quick thinking and precision.

This bundle includes:
• BODY CAM SHOOTER – A realistic tactical first-person shooter featuring reactive enemies, detailed environments, two weapon types, and two unique tactical maps.
• BODY CAM SHOOTER: Survival Boost – Doubles the character’s health capacity, helping you withstand more damage and stay in combat longer.

Experience high-stakes tactical action with enhanced survivability and face every encounter with greater confidence.
70070000040323.intro: Survive longer and make every shot count.
70070000040323.name: BODY CAM SHOOTER: Frontline Survivor

70070000040326.description:
Embark on a relaxing journey through a galaxy of beautiful illustrations, breathtaking photographs, and special video puzzles that come to life once completed.

Puzzle Galaxy: Complete Bundle brings together 622 jigsaw puzzles from the entire series. Explore outer space and steampunk worlds, meet adorable animals, admire peaceful landscapes, discover intricate mandalas, and piece together nostalgic scenes filled with warmth and memories.

With such a wide variety of styles and subjects, there is always something new to assemble. Choose a quick and simple puzzle or take on a more challenging picture with up to 150 pieces.

Features:
- 622 jigsaw puzzles in one complete collection
- A wide range of themes, including animals, fantasy, nature, art, space, nostalgic scenes, and more
- Beautiful illustrations, photographs, and special video puzzles
- Single-player and multiplayer modes for up to 2 players
- Choose from 6, 15, 28, 40, 56, 60, 96, or 150 pieces

Take your time, find your focus, and enjoy hundreds of calming puzzle-solving moments.
70070000040326.intro: A complete bundle for those who never get tired of jigsaw puzzles!
70070000040326.name: Puzzle Galaxy: Complete Bundle - 622 puzzles

70070000040328.description:
Dive into a challenging underwater journey where teamwork, coordination, and precise movement are essential for survival. Bound to your companions by mystical chains, navigate submerged worlds, overcome dangerous obstacles, complete quests, and climb from the depths toward the surface.

This Bundle Includes:
1. Chained Survive Together - Embark on a unique vertical adventure through the depths of the ocean. Explore diverse underwater realms, master realistic chain physics, conquer challenging territories, complete quests, and develop powerful skills as you work together with your companions to overcome each obstacle.

2. Chained Survive Together: Abyssal Style - Give your character a distinctive new appearance with a unique color for their outfit. Add a fresh visual style to your underwater journey as you explore the submerged realms and face the challenges ahead.

Team up, master your movement, and make your way through the depths while looking the part for your next underwater adventure.
70070000040328.intro: Navigate the abyss, master your movement, and survive the journey upward.
70070000040328.name: Chained Survive Together: Ocean Escape

70070000040339.description:
Turn ambitious investments into a growing real estate empire as you purchase, renovate, and manage properties across the city. Negotiate with clients, follow market trends, overcome business challenges, and make strategic decisions on your path from a small-time investor to a successful tycoon.

This bundle includes:
1. REAL ESTATE Simulator - FROM BUM TO MILLIONAIRE
Purchase, renovate, manage, and sell properties while negotiating with clients and building your real estate empire.

2. REAL ESTATE Simulator - FROM BUM TO MILLIONAIRE: Office Redesign
Refreshes the interiors of three offices with new furniture, wallpapers, floors, and ceilings.

Expand your business, improve your properties, and create a real estate empire built on smart decisions.
70070000040339.intro: Build your business, expand your properties, and grow your fortune.
70070000040339.name: REAL ESTATE Simulator – FROM BUM TO MILLIONAIRE: Investor’s Rise

70070000040343.description:
Take control of your own parking business and turn an ordinary parking lot into a thriving empire. Manage facilities, expand your properties, handle daily challenges, and keep customers satisfied while adding a fresh visual style to your delivery vehicle.

- Parking Tycoon: Business Simulator
Build and manage your parking facilities, optimize your business, upgrade your properties, and maximize your revenue. Handle unexpected challenges, uncover the mysteries surrounding your land, and work your way toward becoming the ultimate Parking Lot Tycoon.

- Parking Tycoon: Business Simulator – Delivery Style
Give your delivery vehicle a distinctive new appearance with a custom color change. Refresh your ride and bring a unique visual touch to your daily parking and delivery operations.

Grow your business, manage every challenge, and hit the road with a delivery vehicle that stands out from the crowd.
70070000040343.intro: Manage your lots, grow your empire, and keep business moving.
70070000040343.name: Parking Tycoon: Business Simulator – Park Manager

70070000040348.description:
Step into a mysterious world filled with dangerous enemies, hidden secrets, and challenging puzzles. Master sword and bow combat, capture enemy projectiles, explore hidden areas, and uncover the clues that lead deeper into the adventure while enhancing your combat style and visual experience.

What the content includes:
Wukong Black Legend
Take on an action-packed adventure where combat and exploration go hand in hand. Wield your sword, strike from a distance with your bow, capture incoming projectiles, discover hidden rewards, and solve clever puzzles as you uncover the mysteries hidden across each level.

Wukong Black Legend: Hero’s Weapon
Expand your arsenal with a brand-new weapon and enhanced visual effects. Experience more impactful attacks, stronger visual feedback, and a refreshed combat style as you face enemies and overcome challenging encounters.

Wukong Black Legend: Nightfall Descends
Transform the atmosphere of your adventure with a deep and mysterious night sky. This DLC replaces the standard gray sky, giving every battle, exploration sequence, and hidden discovery a darker and more immersive visual setting.

Uncover the secrets, sharpen your combat skills, and experience the adventure with new weapon power and a completely transformed atmosphere.
70070000040348.intro: Master your weapon and fight through the darkest dangers.
70070000040348.name: Wukong Black Legend: Darkened World

70070000040352.description:
This bundle includes the full version of "GROOVE COASTER WAI WAI PARTY!!!!" and the DLC "Touhou Project Arrangements Pack 1".

▼"GROOVE COASTER WAI WAI PARTY!!!!"
■Rhythm Game x Roller Coaster!!!!
Ride a roller coaster of sound with simple controls, and get grooving in this exhilarating rhythm game!

You can also play with Standard Controls, using the buttons and control sticks!

In this mode you can choose from two types of play. In Casual Versus, players of any ability level can enjoy the game together, and in Hardcore Versus, players compete to show off their true skill!

■A huge line-up of popular music!!!!
A massive 112-track line-up featuring J-pop hits like “Lemon” and “U.S.A.,” anime songs, Vocaloid and Touhou Project arrangements, as well as popular original songs from the Groove Coaster series!

■Choose from a fabulous cast of characters!!!!
Featuring characters from VTubers and Vocaloid, to the Touhou series and more! These characters will feature in songs, as avatars and game navigators, and appear throughout various scenes!

70070000040352.name: "GROOVE COASTER WAI WAI PARTY!!!!"+DLC"Touhou Project Arrangements Pack 1" Set

70070000040354.description:
Take control of your own supermarket and experience the challenges of running a growing retail business. Manage inventory, organize your store, respond to customer demand, develop marketing strategies, and make important financial decisions as you work toward building a successful supermarket chain.

This bundle includes:
• Full Game – Supermarket Owner Simulator: Business
