Design and customize your supermarket, manage inventory, handle daily operations, attract customers, compete with rivals, and expand your retail business.

 • Supermarket Owner Simulator: Business – Store Success
Adds €2,000 automatically to the in-game balance, providing additional funds for store management, investments, improvements, and expansion.

Build your supermarket, manage your resources, and shape your own path to retail success.
70070000040354.intro: Build your supermarket, shape your business, and create your own retail success story.
70070000040354.name: Supermarket Owner Simulator: Business – Grocery Market

70070000040358.description: Infinite Seek and Find + Infinity Times Two + Fruits + Move It!
70070000040358.name: Infinite Seek and Find - Season 3

70070000040361.description:
Step into intense physics-based battles where strategy, resource management, and tactical decisions determine the outcome. Build your army, choose the right units, create effective formations, and adapt your plans as dynamic battles unfold in real time.

Bundle Includes:
1. Warfront Tactics: Battlefield Chronicles Battle Simulator
Command diverse forces, manage limited resources, experiment with formations, and overcome a variety of challenging battle scenarios where every decision can change the course of combat.

2. Warfront Tactics: Battlefield Chronicles Battle Simulator – War Funds
Adds 2,000 in-game currency directly to your balance, giving you additional resources to support your army and strategic preparations.

Assemble your forces, make smart decisions, and lead your army toward victory.
70070000040361.intro: Build your army, develop your tactics, and lead your forces into intense combat.
70070000040361.name: Warfront Tactics: Battlefield Chronicles Battle Simulator – Warfront Operations

70070000040376.description:
Step into the bustling world of medieval trade in Medieval Supermarket Shop Simulator, where every decision shapes your destiny as a merchant. Buy and sell goods, from freshly baked bread to rare exotic treasures, expand your shop, and win the hearts of the kingdom’s residents. Grow from a humble stall into a legendary trading empire in a beautifully stylized medieval world.

This bundle includes the main title and the Coin Pack DLC, giving you an instant boost of extra coins to accelerate your shop’s growth. Upgrade your inventory, improve your store layout, and unlock new trading opportunities faster than ever. With these resources at your fingertips, you’ll be able to expand efficiently and establish your dominance in the kingdom’s marketplace.

Build, trade, and become the ultimate medieval merchant.
70070000040376.name: Medieval Supermarket Simulator Gold Edition

70070000040385.description:
Take on thrilling equestrian competitions where speed, precision, and agility are essential for success. Ride unique horses, overcome challenging obstacles, train your skills, and compete across diverse courses as you work toward becoming a champion.

Bundle Includes:
• Gallop Glory: Obstacle Racing & Horse Simulator
Ride majestic horses, compete in obstacle races, explore different disciplines, build your dream stable, and overcome challenging courses.

• Gallop Glory: Obstacle Racing & Horse Simulator – Dusty Trails
Changes the sand texture across all three maps, giving the racing environments a fresh visual appearance.

Experience exciting horse competitions with refreshed surroundings across every race.
70070000040385.intro: Ride powerful horses and pursue your championship dreams.
70070000040385.name: Gallop Glory: Obstacle Racing & Horse Simulator – Wild Horizons

70070000040393.description:
In addition to the main Touhou Koumakyou game, this edition includes "Touhou Koumakyou: New Classic Soundtrack Player," which lets you listen to over 30 tracks in total from the New Classic and Classic versions of Touhou Koumakyou.

"Touhou Koumakyou: New Classic Soundtrack Player" is an application for Nintendo Switch™. Launch the application to view and listen to the content.

A standard edition containing only the main game is also available. Please take care not to purchase the same content twice.

・About This Game
Touhou Koumakyou from the Touhou makes its debut on Nintendo Switch™ and Nintendo Switch 2.
Take control of Reimu the shrine maiden or Marisa the magician as you set out to resolve an incident threatening Gensokyo.

The New Classic version features upgraded high-resolution visuals, with every BGM track arranged by ZUN. It also introduces a new mode, where you can take on the game with unlimited lives.

You can also play the Classic version, which perfectly preserves the original 2002 gameplay.
*All text in the Classic version is in Japanese.

This product is for the Nintendo Switch™. It can also be played on the Nintendo Switch 2 , but a separate Nintendo Switch 2 -exclusive version, “Touhou Koumakyou: New Classic - the Embodiment of Scarlet Devil,” is also available.
Save data and downloadable content are not compatible between the two versions. Please check carefully to avoid duplicate or mistaken purchases.
Please note that there is no Nintendo Switch 2 Edition or Nintendo Switch 2 Edition Upgrade Pack for this title.
70070000040393.intro: A deluxe edition of the Touhou Koumakyou shooting game, bundled with an app featuring over 30 tracks in total composed and arranged by ZUN
70070000040393.name: Touhou Koumakyou: New Classic - the Embodiment of Scarlet Devil Deluxe Edition

70070000040398.description:
This special set includes all four titles from the twenty-fifth additional puzzle pack for "Jigsaw Masterpieces 2". The set includes the following titles:
- Colorful Markets
- Tile Art Around the World
- Flowers and Little Friends
- [Moving] Scenic Bridges of Japan
70070000040398.name: Additional Puzzle Pack Set Vol.25

70070000040400.description:
Your sibling is a cat now. Time to fix that.

In Ashwood Valley, you’ll step into the shoes of either Luna or Draco – two magical siblings whose spell-casting mishap opens a portal to a vibrant world… and turns one of them into a cat. Now, it’s up to you to restore a ruined cottage, befriend quirky creatures, and uncover the secrets of the enchanted valley to break the curse.


Grow magical plants, explore changing seasons, complete odd quests for chocolate-loving mayors or cheese-obsessed dwarves, and pet all the wild animals you can find – even the strawberry cows!


With cozy farming, whimsical characters, and hand-animated pixel art, Ashwood Valley is a charming adventure about family, friendship, and a lot of fluff.

This bundle includes the Blush Nook DLC.

Key Features
- Farming with a magical twist: Grow seasonal crops, forage for rare ingredients like cinnamon, and tend a garden that changes with the seasons.
- Befriend and transform animals: Pet, feed, and discover hidden forms like mushroom chickens or beetroot cows.
- Choose your hero: Play as Draco or Luna, and try to reverse the feline curse on your sibling.
- Restore and decorate: Fix up your cozy cottage, clear out cobwebs, patch the floor, and make it feel like home again.
- Quirky characters and cozy quests: Help unique NPCs like Olaf the sailor-fisherman and Emma the chocoholic mayor with their oddball tasks.
- A living valley across seasons: Explore a colorful pixel-art world that transforms with spring blossoms, autumn leaves, and snowy winters.
70070000040400.intro: A magical sibling, a fluffy curse, and a valley full of curious creatures to befriend.
70070000040400.name: Ashwood Valley Peach Perfect Pack

70070000040402.description:
Pick your favorite

Choose one of the heros and challenge other players in this family-friendly version of Chess. Thanks to the cartoony graphics, this variation can be enyojed by people of all ages.

Hone your skills

If you want to improve on your own, try out one of five difficulty options and play with an NPC. Find your favorite opening and improve with every game. If you are looking for a real challenge try out the expert mode.

This bundle includes the Sky Blue Chessboard, Grass Green Chessboard, Black & White Chessboard, Ocean Blue Chessboard, Grandmaster Chessboard, Winter White Chessboard, Wisdom Chessboard, Emerald Green Chessboard, and Pink Bubble Gum Chessboard DLCs.

Key features
- local multiplayer
- family friendly
- balanced gameplay
- charming aesthetic
- invigorating music track
70070000040402.intro: Prepare for loads of fun with this cartoon version of the most popular board game in the world.
70070000040402.name: Family Chess Refined Edition

70070000040405.description:
A revolution has come!

Enjoy every awesome feature of the nOS. Draw, write, calculate, organize your day and play around at your convenience. All the tools you need are here!

You have the power

Brighten up your day and customize the nOS to suit your every need. Find your favorite setup and create the fantastic user experience you deserve.

This bundle includes the Screensaver Clock, Icon Themes, Long Cat, Sudoku, Wallpapers Pack 1, Wallpapers Pack 2, and Wallpapers Pack 3 DLCs.

Key features:
- Splendid customization options
- Reliable tools (Notepad, Scetchbook, Day Planner)
- Brilliant design
- A charming puzzle game
70070000040405.intro: Engage the newest Nintendo Switch™ experience. Transform your favorite console into an amazing, and surprisingly small personal computer.
70070000040405.name: nOS new Operating System Ultra Deluxe

70070000040410.description:
Create, farm, and style your way to success in Cottonville!
Welcome to Cottonville – a cozy dress-up and farming sim where creativity blossoms and fashion takes root! Run your own sewing atelier, grow essential crops, and craft stylish outfits for a charming cast of characters.


A Fresh Start in Cottonville
After leaving the hustle of Friglight, you arrive in peaceful Cottonville to take over a small family sewing shop. Start fresh, grow your business, and build a new life—one stitch at a time.


Customize Your Character
Express yourself! Choose from 18 hair colors, 15 hairstyles, and a variety of eye shapes, mouths, lashes, eyebrows, and skin tones. Dress your character in a wide range of outfits that grow with your fashion journey.


From Farming to Fashion
Cultivate cotton, linen, and bamboo—then harvest natural dyes from flowers to create fabrics in 7 vibrant colors. Craft materials, unlock new sewing patterns, and design custom outfits that reflect your unique style.


Run Your Atelier
Take charge of your boutique with over 60 sewing patterns and 120+ total clothing variations. Listen to customer requests, mix and match fabrics, and tailor outfits that reflect their personalities—from winter sweaters to breezy summer styles.

This bundle includes the High Couture Outfits Pack, Holidays Outfits Pack, Japan 90s Outfits Pack, Love Outfits Pack, Pistachio Room, Cotton Candy Room, and Lavender Room DLCs.

Features:
- 60+ sewing patterns with multiple color variants (120+ total!)
- 3 farmable crops and 7 dye colors to craft your own fabrics
- Fully customizable character with a wide selection of features
- A charming story about starting over and finding creativity in a cozy town
- Unique customers and outfit requests that evolve with your boutique
- Dive into 60+ hours of fashion-filled farming and storytelling!


Grow crops, craft clothes, and chase your fashion dreams—Cottonville awaits you!
70070000040410.intro: Watch your beautiful garden grow, dye fabrics, and turn them into beautiful clothing.
70070000040410.name: Cottonville Platinum Edition

70070000040411.description:
My Cozy Room is a relaxing sandbox game where you can design and decorate your very own spaces. Choose from 11 different room shapes and sizes to create unique spaces—your dream bedroom, a cozy living room, a stylish kitchen, or even a playful kids' room.


With over 500 furniture pieces and decorations, plus more than 30 wallpaper and flooring patterns, you’ll have everything you need to craft the perfect look. Whether you're a kid or just love makeover and sandbox games, My Cozy Room is the ideal place to unleash your creativity and have fun!

This bundle includes various My Cozy Room DLCs, featuring wallpaper collections, floor designs, themed decoration packs, and additional room customization content.

Features:
- 11 unique room shapes and sizes to choose from.
- Over 500 furniture and decoration items to explore.
- 30+ wallpaper and flooring patterns for a personal touch.
- Design spaces like bedrooms, kitchens, bathrooms, and more.
- Perfect for kids and fans of makeover and sandbox games.
- Relaxing and creative gameplay for all ages.

Start decorating your cozy dream room today!
70070000040411.intro: Create your dream room and make it truly yours
70070000040411.name: My Cozy Room Legendary Edition

70070000040412.description:
Welcome to a world of crazy organizers, explosive makeup bags, and kitchen shelves barely holding on under the weight of random stuff! In Stuff It, there’s only one rule: everything has to fit... somewhere!


Your mission? To cram the most absurd combinations of items into tight spaces. Hairbrushes, colorful hairdryers, giant ladles, way too many trinkets, and even rubber duckies - all waiting for your master-level packing skills!


Each level throws you into a totally new challenge - bizarre shapes, unruly objects, and sometimes things you don’t even remember ever owning. But don’t panic! Use your superpower of organizing, make some room, and... stuff it!

This bundle includes the Fruits and Bakery DLCs.

What’s in store?
- Over 105 levels of chaos to conquer!
- Special modes (Easy, Medium, Hard) unlocked after completing the game - for those who  love a challenge!
- Dozens of colorful items - from kitchen gear to beauty products!
- Relaxing, feel-good music to help you focus… even when everything is falling out!
- Wacky graphics that bring every drawer item to life!
- Funny effects and reactions - because every win deserves a fanfare (and confetti)!

Don’t ask where that giant spoon came from - just find a spot for it!

Stuff It - because who said cleaning can't be epic?
70070000040412.intro: Shove it, stack it, sort it out!
70070000040412.name: Stuff it! Ultra Edition

70070000040417.description:
Welcome to Make It Cozy!

Create the sweetest little home and share it with the cutest animal friends imaginable!

Step into a charming world filled with soft colors, cozy corners, and adorable companions waiting to move in. Design dreamy bedrooms, sunny living rooms, peaceful reading nooks, relaxing bathrooms, and magical outdoor spaces — then watch them come to life with playful kittens, a curious fox, a cheerful penguin, a tiny hedgehog, and many other fluffy friends.

Every room is a place where memories are made. Arrange comfy furniture, decorate with lovely plants, hang cute decorations, and create warm spaces where your animal companions can feel safe, happy, and loved. Whether you prefer a pastel paradise, a cozy cottage, or something wonderfully unique, your imagination is the only limit.

Relax, decorate, and enjoy the gentle atmosphere as your tiny residents explore the home you've created just for them. Every smile, nap, and playful moment makes your cozy world feel even more magical.

This bundle includes the Chic Collection DLC.

KEY FEATURES:
- Design and decorate adorable cozy homes and beautiful outdoor spaces
- Meet charming animal residents including kittens, foxes, penguins, hedgehogs, bunnies, and more
- Hundreds of cute furniture pieces, plants, and decorations to personalize every room
- Warm pastel visuals and relaxing music that create a peaceful atmosphere
- Endless creative freedom to build your dream cozy retreat
- Watch your lovable animal friends enjoy and explore their new home
- Perfect for players who love cozy vibes, cute animals, creativity, and relaxing gameplay
70070000040417.intro: Unleash your creativity in a cutest possible way!
70070000040417.name: Make It Cozy! Chic Pack

70070000040441.description:
Enjoy the slow life in a peaceful countryside village.
Hunt for bugs in forests, bamboo groves, rivers, and more.
Meet the villagers, make new friends, and create unforgettable summer memories.

Peaceful Bug Catching Story and the Festival Pack are now available!
Enjoy a relaxing bug-catching life!
70070000040441.intro:
Pick up your net and set off on a grand bug-catching adventure.
Your very own bug-collecting story is about to begin!
70070000040441.name: Peaceful Bug Catching Story + Festival Pack Set

70070000040452.description:
Experience the original adventures of the Treflik Family. Get ready for a wholesome journey through childhood. A new Nintendo Switch™ children's show is here!

VALUABLE LIFE LESSONS

Get to know these adorable characters and watch them learn valuable friendship, respect, honesty, and tolerance.

A COLORFUL WORLD

Journey through your favorite adventures of The Treflik Family. Put your spin on these stories through the Coloring Book section and give them your unique look.

This bundle includes the following episodes: Cure for Treflinka, New Neighbour, A House Within A House, Happy Family, A Visit, Treflik Is King, and Girl's Night.
70070000040452.intro: Leap into a world of imagination alongside Treflik and his sister Treflinka. Give in to this magical land and see it through their eyes.
70070000040452.name: The Treflik Family Ultimate Edition

70070000040456.description:
How do you stop the two biggest egos of the Seven Seas from fighting? A clash between the Flying Dutchman and King Neptune has unleashed ghostly mayhem all over Bikini Bottom. SpongeBob and Patrick will need all their skills, bravery and - dare I say - wit, to return life to what passes for normal in their undersea home. Join Bikini Bottom's most notorious duo on their ghostliest adventure yet!

Includes the Tidal Season Pass
Switch seamlessly between SpongeBob and Patrick
Combine SpongeBob and Patrick's unique platforming skills
Master Patrick's brand-new skills like grappling and burrowing
Experience a new ghostly story
Fully voiced by the original cast of the show
Visit iconic locations like Neptune's Palace and Mount Bikini
Battle epic bosses like the Flying Dutchman, King Neptune and Hibernation Sandy
70070000040456.intro: Would you like a Tidal Season Pass with that?
70070000040456.name: SpongeBob SquarePants: Titans of the Tide - Ghostly Digital Edition

70070000040466.description:
This bundle includes five escape room adventure games:

+ Darkstone Bay
+ Project 7: Escape Room
+ ALUMNI - Escape Room Adventure
+ VENARI - Escape Room Adventure
+ SUBNET - Escape Room Adventure

DARKSTONE BAY - ESCAPE ROOM ADVENTURE
Journey to Darkstone Bay, a mysterious island where ancient caves, abandoned mines and dense jungle conceal the fate of a lost Spanish galleon. Solve escape room inspired puzzles, uncover hidden secrets and follow the trail across the island in search of El Diablo Dormido.

PROJECT 7: ESCAPE ROOM
Enter the abandoned home of Dr. Hillman, solve escape room puzzles and explore the old mansion room by room as you uncover the secrets of Project 7 and find a way to escape.

ALUMNI - ESCAPE ROOM ADVENTURE
Play as a scientist transported back in time to memories of college, now trapped in the past use your puzzle solving skills to escape back to the present time.

VENARI - ESCAPE ROOM ADVENTURE
Embark on an escape room adventure to an ancient, mysterious island where your puzzle skills will be put to the test as you try to uncover a secret artifact.

SUBNET - ESCAPE ROOM ADVENTURE
Play as an IT expert sent on a mission to track down and stop the hacker group drkFORCE and their underground subway exploit before they escape!
70070000040466.intro:
Five epic escape room adventures to puzzle through
Darkstone Bay, Project 7, Alumni, Venari and Subnet
70070000040466.name: Epic Escape Room Bundle

70070000040467.description:
The Hidden Object Adventure Bundle 3 combines captivating hidden object and puzzle fun in one jam-packed package. Tricky mini-games, atmospheric hidden object scenes, and three gripping stories await you:

Dreamscapes – The Sandman
Use a dream machine to dive into Laura’s subconscious and free her from her worst nightmares.

Greed 2 – Forbidden Experiments
Rescue Julia’s sister from the clutches of an oracle cult and put a stop to their forbidden experiments!

Dracula’s Legacy
Join Isabella on a journey to an abandoned ghost town to uncover the buried secrets of her origins.

Explore atmospheric locations, find hidden objects, solve tricky puzzles, and uncover dark secrets.

• Explore mysterious and atmospheric locations
• Search for hidden objects and vital clues
• Solve a variety of puzzles and mini-games
• Uncover dark secrets and surprising connections
• Experience three thrilling mystery stories filled with supernatural events
70070000040467.name: Hidden Object Adventure Bundle 3

70070000040491.description: Experience Trinket Studios' signature style of fully voiced anime adventures in this two-game bundle. Vive la Brigade and Suit Up!
70070000040491.name: Battle Chef Brigade + Battle Suit Aces

70070000040492.description:
“Legendary Tales" is a series of adventure games in the Hidden Objects genre, with plenty of mini-games and puzzles, unforgettable characters, and complicated quests.
- Gather old friends to overcome hardships together.
- Travel through incredible places no one ever believed existed
- Solve puzzles and play mini-games to put your wits to the test
- Examine locations carefully and find every collectible
70070000040492.intro: With every adventure, hope for a safer world grows.
70070000040492.name: Legendary Tales

70070000040493.description:
Step into the world of Mai and experience the complete adventure with Mai: Child of Ages and Mai: Child of Ages – Storms of Time.

Travel across shattered ages, battle mysterious creatures, solve ancient puzzles, unlock powerful abilities, and uncover the secrets of Mai’s forgotten origins.

Then continue your journey in Storms of Time, featuring an all-new story chapter set within a massive floating factory, along with new enemies, deadly traps, challenging puzzles, craftable items, and exciting new gameplay.
70070000040493.intro: A legendary journey through the Ages.
70070000040493.name: Mai: Child of Ages Bundle

70070000040501.description:
MERGE, BUILD, AND DEFEND
Your fortress is under attack! Place buildings, merge matching structures to make them stronger, and prepare for relentless waves of monsters. Train knights, horsemen, archers, and mages, then support them with turrets and barricades that damage or slow approaching enemies.

MAKE EVERY TILE COUNT
Space is limited, so plan your layout carefully. Clear trees to unlock new tiles, choose the best positions for your buildings, and create a fortress that balances attack and defense. Leave enough space to place and merge structures as your army grows stronger.

START WITH 1200 GEMS
Use your Gems to support your progress, strengthen your forces, improve your fortress, and access useful options during battle. Reroll available buildings when you need a better choice and adapt your strategy to the challenges ahead.

LEAD YOUR HEROES
Deploy unique heroes to fight alongside your army. Upgrade their stats, equip powerful gear, and use their combat skills and permanent bonuses to gain an advantage against tougher enemies.

FEATURES:
• 1200 Gems - Use them to reroll buildings and skills, purchase chests, clear trees and unlock various upgrades
• Units and Defenses - Build structures that produce different units or protect your fortress
• Strategic Placement - Clear trees, manage limited space, and balance offense with defense
• Merge and Upgrade - Combine matching buildings to create stronger structures
• Lead Your Heroes - Upgrade your heroes, equip powerful gear, and use their combat skills
• Powerful Enemies - Face skeletons, slimes, dragons, giants, bosses, and unexpected threats
• Upgrade Choices - Gain experience and choose new bonuses as you progress
• Gold Management - Protect gold mines and spend your earnings on building rerolls
• 3 Challenge Modes - Test your strategy in Grand Battle, Boss Fight, and Hero Battle
• Varied Battlefields - Adapt your fortress to different environments, obstacles, and layouts

Build your defenses, develop your army, and begin your adventure with a powerful boost!
70070000040501.intro: Power up your fortress and expand your strategy with 1200 Gems!
70070000040501.name: Fortress Merge: Strong Start Pack

70070000040504.description:
Step into the demanding world of border control and take on inspections, document checks, pursuits, and high-pressure decisions as you work to keep the frontier secure. Expand your experience with new visual gear and a redesigned skybox that bring additional variety and immersion to every patrol.

Bundle Contents:
1. Border Police: Contraband Simulator 2024 – Take on the role of a Border Patrol officer and inspect vehicles, verify documents, uncover hidden contraband, pursue smugglers, and make critical decisions that shape the future of your border post.

2. Military Gear DLC – Adds a military camouflage skin for gloves and sleeves, giving your uniform a more tactical and authentic appearance during border operations.

3. Red Camo Ops DLC – Adds a distinctive camouflage skin for gloves and sleeves, providing another visual style for your character during inspections, patrols, and high-pressure missions.

4. Frontier Skies DLC – Replaces the standard skybox with a redesigned visual backdrop, creating a more refined atmosphere across checkpoints, urban entry points, and remote border areas.

Take control of the border, face challenging situations, and experience your patrols with expanded customization and a refreshed visual atmosphere.
70070000040504.intro: Detect hidden contraband before it crosses the frontier.
70070000040504.name: Border Police: Contraband Simulator 2024 – Checkpoint Control

70070000040516.description:
All aboard! Collector’s Cove is a cozy farming adventure on the high seas. Sail with your animal friend to uncharted waters, cultivate your floating farm, and discover new islands, crops and fish on your quest to become a Named Collector!

Get ready for seasonal thrills with the Collector's Cove Halloween Pack!
This outfit collection offers the ultimate festive threads to celebrate the spooky season.
This pack features five haunting cosmetics for your animal companion and five wicked additions for your character.
70070000040516.name: Collector's Cove Halloween Bundle

70070000040517.description:
Mini Market Design is a creative sandbox game where you can design and decorate your very own mini market. With 8 unique store layouts, you have the freedom to create the perfect shopping experience—arrange shelves, add stylish displays, and choose decorations that suit your vision.


Explore around 510 different furniture and decor items, and set the mood with beautiful wallpapers and flooring. Enjoy 9 floor styles and 18 wallpaper patterns right from the start, and expand your options to 18 floor styles and 27 wallpaper patterns with DLC. Whether you’re new to design games or a decorating pro, Mini Market Design is your chance to let your creativity run free!

This bundle includes the Furniture Material Collection 1, Furniture Material Collection 2, Furniture Material Collection 3, Furniture Material Collection 4, Wallpaper Collection, Floor Design Collection, School, and Cinema DLCs.

Features:
- 8 distinct mini market layouts to choose from.
- Around 510 furniture and decoration items.
- 9 flooring and 18 wallpaper patterns (18 floors and 27 wallpapers with DLC!).
- Design a welcoming space for your customers.
- Relaxing, creative gameplay for all ages.
- Ideal for fans of design and decorating games.
70070000040517.intro: Build your dream market and welcome your customers!
70070000040517.name: Mini Market Design Massive Makeover

70070000040518.description:
Piece together bright, colorful images by swapping tiles and solving lively puzzles. Watch patterns shift, colors click into place, and pictures slowly reveal themselves as you play. Jump in, make a few swaps, and watch the colors come together.

Features:
- 48 puzzles big and small for you to solve
- Simple and satisfying swap puzzle mechanics.
- A lively and colorful aesthetic!

Watch the colors fall into place!
70070000040518.intro: Fill the world with color one puzzle at time!
70070000040518.name: Splash of Color: Mountains Edition

70070000040519.description:
Run your own restaurant and prepare the most iconic Japanese dishes and traditional drinks. Take orders, prepare meals, decorate your restaurant and develop your cooking skills each day.


DO THE COOKING BY THE BOOK…
Your kitchen has all the necessary equipment and ingredients you will need to prepare the most delicious sushi. Follow and complete each step from your to-do list while choosing from many available kinds of fish, vegetables and spices and adding them depending on the client's wish.


…AND CUSTOMIZE TO YOUR HEART’S CONTENT
Earn money from the orders and customize the interior of your restaurant in Cooking. After each order you will earn enough money to either upgrade your equipment or purchase new decorations. Enjoy new chairs, tables, plants and utensils.


Become a master of composing the perfect sushi. Be precise and use the exact amount of ingredients such as soy sauce or rice. Mix ingredients with passion and follow each step with maximum precision to become a master of Cooking!

This bundle includes the Green Zen Set and Year of the Horse Set DLCs.

KEY FEATURES:
- Upgrades that will help you prepare meals faster
- You can learn to make your own sushi!
- A total of 32 unique ingredients like fish, vegetables that NEVER run out
- Many decorations to choose from!
- Step-by-step recipes
- 6 unique sushi recipes like Hosomaki or Uramaki and relaxing tea
70070000040519.intro: Run the best restaurant in the middle of the city, complete orders, learn new recipes, and improve your cooking skills.
70070000040519.name: Cooking Special Edition

70070000040522.description:
Step into the world of hospitality and take control of your own motel. Design inviting spaces, manage rooms, set prices, attract different types of guests, and expand your property as you work toward becoming a successful motel owner.

This bundle includes:
- The full Motel Owner Simulator game – Design and manage your motel, decorate rooms, welcome guests, set prices, control expenses, expand your property, and develop strategies to grow your hospitality business.
- New Exterior DLC – Refresh the motel’s exterior appearance by changing the exterior and front-facing walls to gray while giving the exterior bricks a darker tone for a more refined visual style.

Build your property, attract more guests, and create a motel that stands out with its own distinctive atmosphere.
70070000040522.intro: Welcome new guests, improve your property, and grow your motel from the ground up.
70070000040522.name: Motel Owner Simulator – Rental Manager

70070000040531.description:
UNO™ is the iconic card game reimagined with a large variety of gameplay and customization options. Play solo or with friends, personalize your experience from rules to cosmetics, and try the Happy Hour!

UNO™ Ultimate Edition includes:
• UNO™, the iconic card game you love, now with new ways to play and connect.
• UNO™ Flip!, which elevates your UNO™ matches with a double-sided deck and new action cards.
• UNO™ 50th Anniversary and its gorgeous velvety cards.
• UNO™ Party! Mania™, which introduces 3 new action cards.
• UNO™ Show ‘Em No Mercy™ turns up the heat with the most unforgiving version yet.
• UNO FLEX!™ with its action cards and high-impact power mechanics.
• Play like a Viking in UNO™ Valhalla, where the board is part of the gameplay!
• In UNO™ The Call of Yara, the DLC brings resource management into the game.
• Play an action-packed game mode featuring characters from Immortals Fenyx Rising in UNO™ Fenyx's Quest.
• Get ready to move with the UNO™ Just Dance theme.
• UNO™ Rayman adds a playful twist with lush visuals and four unique Theme Cards.
70070000040531.name: UNO™ ULTIMATE EDITION

70070000040532.description:
UNO™ is the iconic card game reimagined with a large variety of gameplay and customization options. Play solo or with friends, personalize your experience from rules to cosmetics, and try the Happy Hour!

UNO™ Legacy Edition includes:
• UNO™, the iconic card game you love, now with new ways to play and connect.
• UNO™ Flip!, which elevates your UNO™ matches with a double-sided deck and new action cards.
• UNO™ 50th Anniversary and its gorgeous velvety cards.
• UNO™ Party! Mania™, which introduces 3 new action cards.
• UNO™ Show ‘Em No Mercy™ turns up the heat with the most unforgiving version yet.
• UNO FLEX!™ with its action cards and high-impact power mechanics.
70070000040532.name: UNO™ LEGACY EDITION

70070000040538.description:
Experience the intensity of world-class motorsport in Formula Racing: Grand Prix League, a high-speed racing simulation where precision, strategy, and skill define every victory. Compete against elite drivers on dynamic international circuits, each crafted with unique challenges, realistic physics, and immersive sound design that captures the true essence of formula racing.

Choose from a diverse lineup of high-performance cars, each offering distinct handling and customization options to match your driving style. Master tight corners, push through long straights, and fight for every millisecond as you chase the ultimate prize - the Grand Prix championship title.

This bundle includes the main title, the Supercharged Duo Pack DLC, and the Cash Boost DLC, giving you access to two elite supercars engineered for maximum speed and control, along with a massive cash injection to upgrade, customize, and perfect your garage. Build your dream machine faster, enhance performance parts, and gain a competitive edge over every rival on the track.

From rookie driver to racing legend - every lap brings you closer to greatness.
70070000040538.name: Formula Racing DELUXE EDITION

70070000040544.description:
Sticky Business Features
- Get creative and build the cutest stickers out of thousands of possible combinations!
- Optimize your sticker production by building the perfect sticker sheets and make as much use of your resources as possible!
- Pack orders for your customers and hear about their lives!
- Buy upgrades to get more sticker graphics and effect foils to make your shop even more exciting!
- Add goodies and custom packaging to your orders to make your customers even more happy!

Sticky Business: Plan With Me adds
- More than 100 new sticker elements like habit trackers, days of the week, sticky notes, frames, washi tape, and more...
- Additional glitter effects for your stickers
- More candies and goodies to surprise your customers with
- Plus 10 additional customer stories all about planning, writing and new beginnings

Sticky Business: Camp Zinnias adds
- 99 new, unique stickers (+ 4 additional variations) with focus on wildlife and plants
- 7 charming new goodies
- 6 all-new glitter papers
- 10 lovable characters sharing their summer camp stories

Sticky Business: Book of Shadows adds
- 83 magical new stickers (+ 34 charming variations) themed around witchery, potions, familiars, and more
- 10 new customer stories exploring themes of love spells, coven friendships, family magic, and the little rituals that make life special
- 8 mystical new goodies to tuck into your sticker packages – from fancy crystals to bewitching keychains
- 6 new glitter papers to add some serious sparkle to your spellwork

Sticky Business: Seaside Tales adds
- 113 new stickers with additional color variants
- 10 new customer stories about surfing, pirates, summer vacations, and more!
- 8 new goodies
- 6 glitter papers
70070000040544.intro: Create, pack and sell your own unique sticker creations!
70070000040544.name: Sticky Business: All-In Bundle

70070000040546.description:
Step into the intense world of MFC - Midnight Fight Club, where every fight demands timing, strategy, and determination. Build your career through challenging leagues, face skilled opponents, customize your fighters, and work your way toward the toughest battles.

What’s included:
- MFC - Midnight Fight Club – Fight through 10 challenging leagues, master attacks and defensive maneuvers, face unique opponents, customize fighter stats, and compete in intense battles.
- MFC - Midnight Fight Club: Fighter Arrival – Adds access to a new fighter, Jason Mitchell, expanding your roster with another contender for your matches. If Jason Mitchell is already owned, the cost of the fighter will be refunded.

Expand your roster, take on new challenges, and fight your way toward the top.
70070000040546.intro: Enter the arena, face tough rivals, and fight for your place at the top.
70070000040546.name: MFC - Midnight Fight Club: Road of Champions

70070000040562.description:
Imagine a cardboard box. Is it shaped to fit one to two fluffy felines? What about five? What about twenty?

Fit My Cat presents you with many cute kitties that all wish to sit where they deem fit. That being said, we're running out of space and we are seriously looking for a cat organizer. If you could spare a moment or two to make that happen we would be grateful.

Every single one of them is trained and well-equipped for some spatial management – pick them up and rotate them as you see fit.

Just so you're aware, some boxes might come with yarn balls or entire cathouses – but that will not prevent those spunky kitties from trying to get inside.

Test your skills and show the world that herding cats is where fun begins!

This bundle includes the Color Boxes Pack DLC.

KEY FEATURES
- Over 90 pawesome levels of cardboard boxes, ready to be filled with fluff
- Tons of purrfect cats of varying shapes, colors, and sizes
- Meowtastic soundtrack
70070000040562.intro: Purrfect cat organizer – fit them all
70070000040562.name: Fit My Cat Color Boxes Edition

70070000040570.description:
Step into the wild world and experience life as a powerful lion roaming the African savannah. Hunt for prey, explore diverse landscapes, manage your pride, defend your territory, and take on challenging quests as you fight to survive in the wilderness.

Bundle Highlights:
- Lion Simulator Survival: RPG Animal Battle: Explore vast savannah landscapes, hunt various prey, manage your pride, protect your territory, and adapt to the challenges of life in the wild.
- Lion Simulator Survival: RPG Animal Battle – Wild Guardian: Adds a distinctive new appearance for the lion, giving your character a unique visual style throughout exploration, hunting, and survival.

Take on the challenges of the savannah, grow your pride, and experience the wild with a fresh new appearance.
70070000040570.intro: Build your pride, explore the wild, and make the savannah your territory.
70070000040570.name: Lion Simulator Survival: RPG Animal Battle – Wild Kingdom

70070000040581.description:
Welcome to The Smurfs: Colorful Stories, a place where your creativity and imagination lead to creating unique tales. Visit their village like you are one of them and experience amazing adventures - Smurfs can’t wait to meet you!


ALL CHARACTERS IN ONE PLACE
You don’t have to worry you will miss your favourite Smurfette or Grouchy Smurf. They all gathered here, so you can get to know each one of them, while they tell you their stories. Just relax and take a look at what they have prepared for you.


MULTIPLE TOOLS
In order to make every story personal, the game offers a lot of tools to choose from. You decide what color, brush size, or tool type to use. Try to mix different options to achieve a surprising effect.

This bundle includes the Personal Boards 12 DLC.

KEY FEATURES:
- All your favourite blue creatures!
- 14 categories full of drawings
- Unlimited options for creating your personal story
- Cartoon type soundtrack
70070000040581.intro: Hop into the wonderful world of Smurfs and check what stories are waiting for you!
70070000040581.name: The Smurfs Drawing Board Pack

70070000040604.description:
Enter a world on the brink of a zombie outbreak and take control of a critical border checkpoint where every traveler could pose a hidden threat. Use advanced screening tools, inspect documents, manage limited supplies, and make difficult decisions as you work to separate the healthy from the infected.

Bundle Includes:
• Quarantine Zone: Border Zombie Checkpoint
Manage a high-risk border checkpoint using UV lights, thermometers, scanners, and strategic judgment. Inspect travelers, identify potential infections, manage resources, and decide who can enter, who must be quarantined, and who poses too great a threat

• Quarantine Zone: Border Zombie Checkpoint – Infection Detection
Changes the temperature scanner to a distinctive purple-pink visual style, giving your screening equipment a fresh appearance during inspections.

• Quarantine Zone: Border Zombie Checkpoint – Frontline Upgrade
Changes the exterior color of the checkpoint container, giving the border area a new visual identity that reflects the changing situation.

• Quarantine Zone: Border Zombie Checkpoint – Visual Horizon
Replaces the standard skybox with a unique combination of horizon, clouds, and lighting, creating a fresh atmosphere across the entire checkpoint.

Strengthen the visual identity of your checkpoint, manage every inspection, and face the growing pressure of a world struggling to contain the outbreak.
70070000040604.intro: Keep the checkpoint secure while searching for signs of infection.
70070000040604.name: Quarantine Zone: Border Zombie Checkpoint – Border Defense

70070000040609.description:
Enter a mysterious dark fantasy world where ancient forces, dangerous enemies, and forgotten secrets await. Combine magic and weaponry, explore mysterious environments, overcome relentless battles, and develop your abilities as you uncover the truth behind the Shadowforge.

What’s included:
- Shadowforge Chronicles: Experience a dark fantasy first-person shooter featuring magical abilities, powerful weapons, challenging enemies, giant bosses, interactive environments, hidden mechanisms, and a progression system built around upgrades and customization.
- Coin Boost DLC: Adds 3,000 in-game currency directly to the  balance, providing additional resources to support equipment, abilities, and progression.

Explore forgotten lands, strengthen your combat style, and face the ancient forces threatening the world of Shadowforge.
70070000040609.intro: Build your strength, master your abilities, and face the darkness ahead.
70070000040609.name: Shadowforge Chronicles: War of Shadows

70070000040614.description:
Enter the brutal depths of hell in a fast-paced shooter inspired by classic 90s action games. Master strafe-jumping, discover infernal weapons, explore dangerous environments, uncover hidden upgrades, and face increasingly powerful hordes of demonic creatures.

This bundle includes:
- Flames of Damnation – Battle through hellish environments filled with demonic enemies, discover powerful weapons, find keys and hidden areas, and use quick reflexes and strategy to survive unforgiving encounters.
- Battle Armor DLC – Increases the player’s maximum armor capacity from 50 to 100 units, providing greater protection during intense battles and allowing you to withstand more damage.

Push deeper into hell, strengthen your defenses, and prove you have what it takes to survive the darkness.
70070000040614.intro: Enter the depths of hell and face relentless demonic forces.
70070000040614.name: Flames of Damnation: Hellstorm

70070000040619.description:
Step into a neon-lit futuristic world where automotive trading, advanced technology, and ambitious business decisions come together. Search for valuable vehicles, repair and modify them, negotiate deals, expand your dealership, and build your reputation in a city where every car can become your next opportunity.

With this bundle, you’ll get:
- The full Cyber Car Seller Simulator - Buy, repair, customize, and sell futuristic vehicles while expanding your dealership and building a successful automotive business in a cyberpunk-inspired city.
- Above the City DLC - Replaces the standard skybox with a new celestial background, giving the futuristic city a refreshed visual atmosphere and a distinct new look.

Grow your dealership, discover new opportunities, and enjoy your automotive journey beneath a fresh horizon.
70070000040619.intro: Manage your dealership, customize futuristic vehicles, and chase bigger opportunities.
70070000040619.name: Cyber Car Seller Simulator: Cyber Streets

70070000040624.description:
The Endless Summer Edition contains Woodo, the Supporter Pack and the Soundtrack Pack.

Contents

-Woodo
-Woodo Original Soundtrack: 39 songs from the colorful world of Woodo
-3D models, ready to print, for you to print your very own figurines of Foxy and Ben
-2D print templates for a poster of the in-game village map and a set of stickers
-Extra outfit colors for Foxy and Ben
-Two extra colors for your in-game cursor-hand: "Foxy Orange" and "Ben Green"
-A sticker on the in-game map expressing our gratitude
70070000040624.intro: The Endless Summer Edition contains Woodo, the Supporter Pack and the Soundtrack Pack
70070000040624.name: Woodo - Endless Summer Edition

70070000040630.description:
Memory for Kids improves on the classic formula of memory games. It allows you to increase the difficulty level at your own pace and customize the challenges to your liking.

Our brains are the most important tools of the 21st century. Do your child a favor and give them a gift that will help them realize their full potential.

This bundle includes the Cards Pack 4 DLC.

Key features:
- Improves memory
- Cute cards
- Adjustable difficulty level
- Relaxing music
- 20 card designs
- 18 difficulty levels
70070000040630.intro: Help your child harness the hidden potential of their mind. Use these colorful cards to improve their memory skills. Let them become masters of their own minds.
70070000040630.name: Memory For Kids Cozy Menagerie Edition

70070000040639.description:
Hole Digging Master
The rules are as simple as possible - dig the hole. Dig deep. Deeper than you can even imagine.

Don't be afraid to get your hands dirty, because there's real treasure waiting for you in the ground. Start digging and miracles will happen. You have no idea what could be under your lawn.

Everything you find can be sold and used to upgrade your tools or buy new equipment to help you dig faster and find more.

8 SECRET MINES
Uncover hidden tunnels and exclusive areas throughout the game.

20 TYPES OF ORE
Discover a wide variety of ores, each offering unique value and potential for upgrades.

3 TYPES OF DIG TOOLS
Upgrade your tool from Shovel to Drill and up to a Vacuum Cleaner.

CONSUMABLES
Utilize Dynamite for explosive power and a Lamp for enhanced visibility in dark areas.

4 BIOMES
Explore diverse environments that impact your digging experience and resource availability.

69 UPGRADES
Enhance all your equipment with a nice and robust upgrade system, including special upgrades for rare minerals.

Hole Digging Master: Solar Panels DLC
Don't be limited by recharge time!

SOLAR PANELS
Recharge the batteries without wasting time or interrupting the digging process. Use the equipment non-stop!

SPEED UP THE DIGGING
No pauses, no annoying waiting. Nothing will distract you from the best part of the game. Just keep going deeper and deeper to find all the hidden treasures.

FREE BATTERY RECHARGE
No payment. No waiting. It's totally free now.

IT'S ECO-FRIENDLY
Even in games we consider the environmental impact. The sun is our friend, and we can call it a win-win situation: the sky remains clear, and work doesn't stop.
70070000040639.intro: This bundle will give you all you need to dig deep into the game from the start!
70070000040639.name: Hole Digging Master: Recharged Edition

70070000040644.description:
Bored with the food you take to work every day? Do you wish it was more… meowtastic?


Neko Bento will let you put together your own, perfect lunchbox. Here, your food will be made by a hardworking cat-chef, and fitting in all the snacks will require your puzzle-solving skills.


To prepare you to pack as much food as you can in the tiniest space possible, you’ll have to put your thinking cap on. Onigiri snacks, plumpy tomatoes, and adorable octopus sausages - you’ll be able to pack these and so many more into your bento. They’re all in a cute visual style, too - hopefully, no one will feel bad about eating them!


With every level, your lunchbox’s size and its supposed contents will change. You can expect more (or less) space, different snacks (hello tofu!), and new obstacles in the form of rice pulps or balls. This is one filling meal!


No worries about the amount of lunchbox levels, they will last you for a while. Each new level will be just a bit harder - but that’s no issue for a professional bento packer! After all, no one wants to leave a tasty meal in the fridge and wait for them to get home.

This bundle includes the New Levels 1, New Levels 2, New Levels 3, Homes Pack, Backgrounds Pack, Boxes Pack, and Food Pack DLCs.

Key Features:
- Over 90 different bento levels to conquer!
- 29 different pawsome snacks to pack!
- Music that ranges from relaxing lofi hip hop to more energetic funk!
- Cute and sweet-looking graphics that will conquer your heart… and your tastebuds!
- An adorable and skilled cat chef - the cook of these snacks!
70070000040644.intro: Your perfect, cat-themed lunchbox puzzle is here!
70070000040644.name: Neko Bento Games Collection

70070000040646.description:
Start your adventure with a touch of bubbly magic! The Deluxe Edition includes the base game along with:

Bubblefan Engine: Add some whimsical flair to your flights with an engine that trails a beautiful stream of bubbles across the sky!

Lifeguard Skin: Keep the islanders safe in style while sporting this vibrant lifeguard outfit (complete with its own bubble accessory).

Beachside Decor Pack: Dive into decorating with 8 exclusive, bubble-themed furniture pieces—the perfect additions to your ultimate beachside hangout.
70070000040646.intro: Make a splash in Lou's Lagoon with the bubbly Deluxe Edition!
70070000040646.name: Lou's Lagoon Deluxe Edition

70070000040653.description:
Welcome to Snapshot Girls Collection 6 in 1 — a complete collection of six relaxing puzzle games featuring beautiful heroines, stylish looks, and photorealistic scenes.

Discover a variety of charming girls and unique atmospheres as you assemble each image piece by piece. Every completed puzzle reveals a detailed, high-resolution scene designed to look like a real photograph, with natural lighting, realistic skin tones, expressive characters, and carefully crafted environments.

With six games in one collection, there are plenty of puzzles to complete and beautiful images to unlock. Enjoy simple and intuitive gameplay, relax to an atmospheric soundtrack, and revisit your favorite completed scenes whenever you like.

Game Features:
- 6 complete Snapshot Girls games in one collection
- Numerous puzzles and beautiful heroines to discover
- Photorealistic high-resolution images with detailed environments
- Smooth and intuitive puzzle mechanics
- Relaxing and atmospheric soundtrack
- Gallery mode to revisit your favorite completed scenes
- Different characters, outfits, locations, and visual themes throughout the collection

Complete every puzzle and unlock the entire Snapshot Girls Collection!
70070000040653.intro: Solve puzzles, uncover secrets, and marvel at every detail of stunning photorealistic masterpieces!
70070000040653.name: Snapshot Girls Collection 6 in 1

70070000040667.description:
A brutally frustrating co-op boat adventure you probably won’t survive. But hey—at least you’ll look ridiculous trying.

Grab your paddles (and your patience) and set out on a stupidly long, lava-surrounded parkour adventure. In Paddle Paddle Paddle, you and/or a deeply regretting friend must paddle your way through swinging axes, weird wind, evil slopes, and that one jump you’ll miss at least 27 times in a row ... maybe more.

At the end of the journey? A legendary, mysterious, possibly pointless prize awaits. Maybe. If you ever get there. Probably not.
70070000040667.intro: Paddle through pain. Solo or co-op. One paddle each. Lava everywhere. You’ll fall. You’ll scream. You might cry. Good luck and embrace the salt.
70070000040667.name: Paddle Paddle Paddle Deluxe

70070000040672.description:
Paint for Kids, the best app made especially for kids on Nintendo Switch™ will let you create both simple, ordinary, and professional paintings - from drawings of your favorite cartoon characters to landscapes.

Many possibilities for the creation

Use crayons, a brush, or spray paint. Paint and draw your beloved animals, Christmas cards, or portraits. Enjoy an extraordinary personal gallery of your masterpieces and delight your loved ones.

A magical experience

Drawing improves the ability to concentrate, develops eye-hand coordination, and contributes to the consolidation of a correct writing grip. With its total power, you will awaken your child's creativity and sensitivity to beauty.

This bundle includes the Additional Board 5 DLC.

Key features:
- Basic and versatile tools in different sizes
- Mixed colors with smooth gradients in between
- Tuned for Kids
- Unprecedented ease of use
70070000040672.intro: Awaken your child's imagination with Paint for Kids.
70070000040672.name: Paint For Kids Drawing Stories Edition

70070000040674.description:
DELICIOUS ADVENTURE
Cook For Love is a cozy cooking game where you’ll be in the shoes of Clement – a young Frenchman, who gets hired at a popular Parisian restaurant. With the help of a recipe book, you will be able to cook unique dishes of varying complexity and conquer the world’s taste buds!


FROM NOVICE TO MAESTRO
Clement starts his mentorship under Jean-Luc Chatillone – a culinary legend… currently onboard the Orient Express. Even though he’s away, Jean-Luc’s recipe book lands in Clement’s hands.

You will be cooking with various kitchen appliances and using many different ingredients. With over 40 available recipes you have your path laid out in front of you – now it’s time to roll up your sleeves and cook until you earn the title of a true chef.


RECIPES FOR JOYFUL LIFE
As you learn how to cook new dishes you also earn reputation points, which in turn level up your chef experience. New recipes will be unlocked on the way and they will get more complex (and more delicious) as you go.

After everything’s ready there will be a final test… will the critics grant you the Golden Spoon, young chef?

Cook For Love is a look into the past of Grandma Rose’s husband – Clement, before he met his wife on the Orient Express. While this is not a prequel to Tell Me Your Story, it’s a look at the youth of these two lovebirds from another perspective.

This bundle includes the Powder Red Blender, Colorful Stove, Wooden Fridge, Lyon, Provence, and La Côte d'Azur DLCs.

HIGHLIGHTS:
- Over 40 various recipes to master…
- …and delicious pictures to look at.
- Cozy and stressless vibes.
- Learning how to make some of the most well-known recipes.
- Get to know Clement better long before he met Rose.
- Beautiful, hand-drawn art style with bright colors.
- English, Korean and Japanese subtitles and UI
70070000040674.intro: Win the hearts of Parisians with your cooking, discover delicious recipes, and become a chef worthy of working onboard the Orient Express.
70070000040674.name: Cook For Love Extended Edition

70070000040680.description:
Grab your equipment with you and begin your journey to become a master of nGolf. Explore beautiful and minimalist locations full of traps, puzzles, and amazing views.


FIND YOUR WAY
While playing nGolf you will face many challenges on your way. Lasers, spikes, flames and many more will try to stop your ball. Remember that timing is the key to success and you shouldn’t hurry with your hit. Go with the flow and master all worlds.


PLAN YOUR APPROACH
There is an unlimited number of possible solutions to finish levels. Different angles and strengths can change the trajectory of the ball diametrically. Check your surroundings for hills, teleports, or speed boosters. Each element gives you a new opportunity to hit the hole.


BECOME A GOLF MASTER
To become a professional, you have to collect all stars on each stage and accomplish the lowest amount of hits. Study the layout of the map, take as many attempts as you need and obtain the title of champion!

This bundle includes the Colorful Golf Balls 9, Colorful Golf Balls 8, and Colorful Golf Balls 7 DLCs.

KEY FEATURES:
- 8 unique worlds
- Over 60 levels to master
- Scorecards to help you track your progress
70070000040680.intro: Set off on the most engaging golf adventure you have ever seen and visit breathtaking places from around the world.
70070000040680.name: nGolf Gold Edition

70070000040681.description:
Ready to line things up and see where it leads? Match colorful pieces, chain together juicy combos, and clear the board to reveal a gorgeous surprise waiting underneath.

Every move clears a little more of the picture. Keep crushing tiles, breaking through tougher boards, and revealing beautiful girls piece by piece. The deeper you go, the hotter it gets... so stay sharp and keep the matches coming.

Features:
- A quartet of beautiful women with a clock display
- Unique music for every girl
- Simple and engaging match-3 gameplay
- Satisfying combos and challenging stages
- A treat for your eyes

Your crush is waiting for you.
70070000040681.name: Ecchi Crush: Goth Edition

70070000040682.description:
Give yourself over to the ultimate relaxation! Clay&Cats will make you feel good in a way you didn't know you needed.

Your task is simple - assemble adorable, cat-themed pottery to its full glory. Put back together pawesome vases, purrfect plates, and kittiful bowls. Don't worry about the timers and sweating to pass the challenge - take all the time getting the pieces together and enjoy the satisfying way they click into the right places. Can't get cozier than that!

This bundle includes the Watering Can, Tray, and Sugar Bowl DLCs.

KEY FEATURES:
- 9 categories with 14 levels of pure joy in each
- Lo-fi music providing good vibes for the hours of playing
- Satisfying gameplay that soothes your nervous system
- Tons of adorable, furry troublemakers to admire
70070000040682.intro: You'll forget about the rest of the world with the most satisfying hobby - repairing cute cat pots!
70070000040682.name: Clay&Cats Extended Edition

70070000040718.description:
Pick your favorite

Choose one of the heros and challenge other players in this family-friendly version of Chess. Thanks to the cartoony graphics, this variation can be enyojed by people of all ages.

Hone your skills

If you want to improve on your own, try out one of five difficulty options and play with an NPC. Find your favorite opening and improve with every game. If you are looking for a real challenge try out the expert mode.

This bundle includes the Ash Grey Chessboard DLC.

Key features
- local multiplayer
- family friendly
- balanced gameplay
- charming aesthetic
- invigorating music track
70070000040718.intro: Prepare for loads of fun with this cartoon version of the most popular board game in the world.
70070000040718.name: Family Chess Ash Grey Pack

70070000040720.description:
Step into the intense world of competitive fighting and build your roster as you train, upgrade, and take on challenging opponents. Choose your fighter, develop their abilities, master different attacks, and compete your way toward championship glory.

Bundle Includes:
1. OFC – Ultimate Fighting Club (Full Game): Choose your fighter, train and upgrade key stats, master punches and kicks, block incoming attacks, and compete in intense fights as you work toward becoming a champion.
2. OFC - Ultimate Fighting Club: Ring Legend: Adds Hunter Dawson as a new playable fighter, giving you another combatant to train, upgrade, and take into the ring.

Expand your roster, discover a new fighter, and take on the competition with fresh opportunities in the ring.
70070000040720.intro: Build your fighting legacy and rise toward glory.
70070000040720.name: OFC – Ultimate Fighting Club: Call of Champions

70070000040724.description:
Step into a mysterious world filled with dangerous enemies, hidden secrets, and challenging adventures. Master intense combat, explore mysterious locations, solve clever puzzles, and discover the secrets waiting beyond every path.

What the content includes:
Wukong Black Legend
Fight with sword and bow, capture enemy projectiles, explore hidden areas, solve puzzles, and overcome dangerous challenges.

Wukong Black Legend: Hero’s Weapon
Add a brand-new weapon to your arsenal with enhanced visual effects and impactful attack visuals.

Wukong Black Legend: Warrior Skin
Change your character’s appearance with a striking red-themed outfit and distinctive back tattoo.

Face every challenge with a powerful new weapon and a bold new appearance as you continue your journey toward becoming a legend.
70070000040724.intro: Awaken your warrior spirit and face your fate.
70070000040724.name: Wukong Black Legend: Dark Destiny

70070000040735.description:
Step into the world of retail management and take control of a growing supermarket. Manage daily operations, satisfy customers, expand your store, and make smart decisions as you build your business.

This bundle includes:
1. Supermarket Simulator 2026
Design your store, stock shelves, set prices, manage inventory, serve customers, hire staff, and expand your supermarket as your business grows.

2. Supermarket Simulator 2026: Retail Boost
Adds 2,500 to your in-game balance, giving you extra funds to invest in products, upgrades, expansions, and other business needs.

Build from the ground up, manage your resources wisely, and turn your supermarket into a thriving retail business.
70070000040735.intro: Manage the shelves, serve the customers, grow the store.
70070000040735.name: Supermarket Simulator 2026: Market Builder

70070000040765.description:
Set out across a vast ocean and create your own path through an unpredictable world. Build a floating base, discover distant islands, and find new ways to keep moving forward as you turn a simple raft into a place you can call home.

Bundle Includes:
1. Float Survival Simulator: Ocean Survivor (Base Game) – Explore the open sea, collect materials, craft useful equipment, upgrade your raft, discover islands, fish for food, and manage the essentials needed to establish your floating home.

2. Float Survival Simulator - Ocean Survivor: Survival Kit (DLC) – Changes the material of the hammer and adds gloves to the player character, giving your survival gear a distinctive new appearance throughout your ocean adventure.

Explore the ocean, strengthen your raft, and experience your survival journey with a fresh new visual style.
70070000040765.intro: Survive the ocean and build your own path forward.
70070000040765.name: Float Survival Simulator – Ocean Survivor: Island Explorer

70070000040773.description:
Step into the dangerous world of crime scene cleaning and take on the dirty work left behind by criminals. Clean challenging locations, remove evidence, manage your equipment, and stay ahead of the authorities.

Bundle Includes:
- Criminal Cleaner Simulator: Clean crime scenes, dispose of evidence, upgrade your equipment, and complete risky jobs while avoiding detection.
- Criminal Cleaner Simulator – Clean Style: Give your water bucket a fresh new appearance with a unique visual skin.

Take on demanding cleaning jobs and give your equipment a fresh new style along the way.
70070000040773.intro: Clean crime scenes and make every job count.
70070000040773.name: Criminal Cleaner Simulator – Secret Cleanup

70070000040780.description:
Step into a tense quarantine zone where every arrival must be carefully inspected and every decision can affect the safety of the surrounding area. Take on the role of a border guard during a zombie outbreak, manage incoming survivors, identify potential infections, maintain order at the checkpoint, and respond to threats under constant pressure.

What this bundle contains:
1. Quarantine Lockdown Simulator: Zombie Border
Inspect survivors, assess suspicious symptoms, manage quarantine areas, make critical decisions, and defend the border against the growing zombie threat.

2. Quarantine Lockdown Simulator: Zombie Border – Elite Skins
Refresh the appearance of soldiers and scientists with updated character designs that bring a more distinctive and immersive visual style to the quarantine zone.

3. Quarantine Lockdown Simulator: Zombie Border – Security Gear
Give your scanning equipment a new appearance by changing the skins of both the clothing scanner and temperature scanner.

Stay alert, manage the quarantine zone, and keep your border prepared for whatever comes next.
70070000040780.intro: Face the outbreak and keep the quarantine zone secure.
70070000040780.name: Quarantine Lockdown Simulator: Zombie Border – Outbreak Response

70070000040782.description:
Hit the roads of America and experience the life of a professional truck driver. Complete deliveries, explore different environments, customize your vehicles, and improve your trucking skills as you progress through a variety of challenging routes.

What’s included in the bundle:
1. Truck Simulator 25 - American Driver
Drive across industrial areas, suburbs, and busy city streets while completing delivery missions, customizing your truck, and upgrading its performance.

2. Truck Simulator 25 - American Driver: Heavy Drive
Adds the Truck MC9FX to your fleet, giving you a new vehicle to use while exploring American roads and completing your trucking missions.

Get behind the wheel, expand your fleet, and keep your deliveries moving across America.
70070000040782.intro: Keep your wheels moving and your trucking career growing.
70070000040782.name: Truck Simulator 25 - American Driver: Road Explorer

70070000040790.description:
Your sibling is a cat now. Time to fix that.

In Ashwood Valley, you’ll step into the shoes of either Luna or Draco – two magical siblings whose spell-casting mishap opens a portal to a vibrant world… and turns one of them into a cat. Now, it’s up to you to restore a ruined cottage, befriend quirky creatures, and uncover the secrets of the enchanted valley to break the curse.


Grow magical plants, explore changing seasons, complete odd quests for chocolate-loving mayors or cheese-obsessed dwarves, and pet all the wild animals you can find – even the strawberry cows!


With cozy farming, whimsical characters, and hand-animated pixel art, Ashwood Valley is a charming adventure about family, friendship, and a lot of fluff.

This bundle includes the Cozy Comforts Style, Sunny Summer Style, Draco's Nook, Luna's Nook, Seaside Stories, Aqua Nook, Mystic Nook, and Blush Nook DLCs.

Key Features
- Farming with a magical twist: Grow seasonal crops, forage for rare ingredients like cinnamon, and tend a garden that changes with the seasons.
- Befriend and transform animals: Pet, feed, and discover hidden forms like mushroom chickens or beetroot cows.
- Choose your hero: Play as Draco or Luna, and try to reverse the feline curse on your sibling.
- Restore and decorate: Fix up your cozy cottage, clear out cobwebs, patch the floor, and make it feel like home again.
- Quirky characters and cozy quests: Help unique NPCs like Olaf the sailor-fisherman and Emma the chocoholic mayor with their oddball tasks.
- A living valley across seasons: Explore a colorful pixel-art world that transforms with spring blossoms, autumn leaves, and snowy winters.
70070000040790.intro: A magical sibling, a fluffy curse, and a valley full of curious creatures to befriend.
70070000040790.name: Ashwood Valley Platinum Edition

70070000040792.description:
Step into a pastel paradise where creativity meets comfort. In Cozy Tiny Home, every item tells a story - from soft cushions and glowing lamps to shelves packed with memories. Whether you’re decorating a snug study, a sunny living room, or a peaceful bedroom, each space becomes your own cozy retreat filled with charm, color, and serenity.


Relax and express yourself through endless decorating possibilities. Combine cute furniture, cheerful plants, and playful accessories to make your dream home come alive with warmth and personality. With cuddly cats, curious bunnies, and plenty of smiles, every moment feels like a cozy hug!

This bundle includes the Gym & Fitness DLC.

KEY FEATURES:
- Build and decorate your own cozy rooms in a cute, pastel world
- Invite adorable cats, bunnies, and other fluffy friends to share your space
- Hundreds of lovely furniture pieces, plants, and decorations to mix and match
- Soft, relaxing music and soothing atmosphere for pure comfort
- Endless creativity — design your dream home your way
- Perfect for players who love cozy vibes, cute animals, and relaxing design games
70070000040792.intro: Welcome to Cozy Tiny Home, a warm and heart-melting decorating game where you can design the most adorable spaces imaginable - and fill them with sweet animal friends!
70070000040792.name: Cozy Tiny Home Fitness Collection

70070000040796.description:
A revolution has come!

Enjoy every awesome feature of the nOS. Draw, write, calculate, organize your day and play around at your convenience. All the tools you need are here!

You have the power

Brighten up your day and customize the nOS to suit your every need. Find your favorite setup and create the fantastic user experience you deserve.

This bundle includes the Wallpapers Pack 4 DLC.

Key features:
- Splendid customization options
- Reliable tools (Notepad, Scetchbook, Day Planner)
- Brilliant design
- A charming puzzle game
70070000040796.intro: Engage the newest Nintendo Switch™ experience. Transform your favorite console into an amazing, and surprisingly small personal computer.
70070000040796.name: nOS new Operating System Wallpapers Collection 4

70070000040809.description:
Total Vibes Vol. 18 includes the base game Musical Vibes RX and 16 additional songs.

Musical Vibes RX is the new version of Musical Vibes, the first-ever dance game to let players use the camera of their smartphone connected to a console. Originally released in June 2023, the original broke new ground, and now RX takes the experience even further!

Dance Hands-Free with Incredible Moves!
Groove to fantastic music and master exciting new dance moves with full-body tracking powered by advanced AI technology. No controllers required when using your smartphone camera, just let your body move to the beat!

Track Your Progress
Stay motivated with the built-in calorie counter that provides an estimated calorie burn during your game session.

Included Songs (21)

"Runway" by Zai Miles – R&B/Trap
"Into The Night" by Aria Kodee – Pop
"Quiet Replay" by Zai Miles – R&B
"Bright Tonight" by Lyrae – K-Pop
"Spark of Life" by Lyrae – K-Pop
"Shine Through" by Nyomi King – R&B/Soul
"Yeah" by Jaevi – Hip Hop/K-Pop
"On My Way" by Zai Miles – Afrobeats/R&B
"Night Shift Flex" by Alina Rae feat. J-Rhyme — Drill/R&B
"Velvet Nights" by Vénna — K-Pop
"Club Reverie" by Naya Luz Feat. J-Rhyme – R&B
"Platinum Dreams" by NARAE SOLIS — K-Pop
"Champion Sound (Remix)" by SIZZLA feat. TURBULENCE — Dancehall
"Noche de Brillo" by LINA RIKO — Reggaeton
"Embrace Your Light" by NINA RAY — Pop
"Party" by FIVEEBEATZ — Amapiano
"Victory Lap" by Cipher Blaze feat Lila Brooks — Hip Hop
"Queen Of The Night" by Elara Mae - K-Pop
"Lost and Found" by Lyra Rin – K-Pop
"Magnetic Pulse" by Vénna feat. Jinseo — K-Pop
"Pretty Boy" by Clara Solane — R&B

More tracks are planned for future updates!

Multiplayer Fun
• Up to 4 players can join the fun with Joy-Con™ controllers.
• Up to 2 players can dance together using smartphone camera tracking.

Customize Your Experience
Personalize your avatar with fun outfits and choose from a variety of vibrant venues to match your style and mood!

Enhance Your Dance Floor
Own a Philips Hue smart lighting system? Connect it to transform your space into a dazzling concert venue with lights that react to the music!

More Than Dance
Feeling less energetic? Switch to Rhythm Game Mode, where you can press the correct direction on your controller in time with the beat, perfect for playing on the go!

Exciting Updates to Come!
Stay tuned for more tracks and features coming soon.
70070000040809.intro: Get ready to move with Musical Vibes RX, a dynamic dance game you can play using Joy-Con™ controllers or your smartphone camera connected to your console!
70070000040809.name: Musical Vibes RX: Total Vibes Vol. 18

70070000040811.description:
Think you’ve got the skills to go all the way? Fill in the right positions and slowly clear away the puzzle—revealing more than just your brainpower.

Every number brings you closer to the full picture. Get it right, and you’ll uncover a beautiful picture waiting just beneath the surface... but one wrong move and you might just ruin the mood.

Features:
- 52 beautiful girls looking for company
- Sensual music and sound effects
- Simple and engaging gameplay
- A treat for your eyes

Take your time, plan your moves, and finish strong.
70070000040811.intro: Fill her grid and reveal the picture.
70070000040811.name: Ecchi Numbers: Fifth Edition

70070000040833.description:
Run your own restaurant and prepare the most iconic Japanese dishes and traditional drinks. Take orders, prepare meals, decorate your restaurant and develop your cooking skills each day.


DO THE COOKING BY THE BOOK…
Your kitchen has all the necessary equipment and ingredients you will need to prepare the most delicious sushi. Follow and complete each step from your to-do list while choosing from many available kinds of fish, vegetables and spices and adding them depending on the client's wish.


…AND CUSTOMIZE TO YOUR HEART’S CONTENT
Earn money from the orders and customize the interior of your restaurant in Cooking. After each order you will earn enough money to either upgrade your equipment or purchase new decorations. Enjoy new chairs, tables, plants and utensils.


Become a master of composing the perfect sushi. Be precise and use the exact amount of ingredients such as soy sauce or rice. Mix ingredients with passion and follow each step with maximum precision to become a master of Cooking!

This bundle includes the Green Zen Set, Year of the Horse Set, Green Dragon Set, Animal Set, Japanese Set, Floral Set, and Cooking: Viva la Pizza! DLCs.

KEY FEATURES:
- Upgrades that will help you prepare meals faster
- You can learn to make your own sushi!
- A total of 32 unique ingredients like fish, vegetables that NEVER run out
- Many decorations to choose from!
- Step-by-step recipes
- 6 unique sushi recipes like Hosomaki or Uramaki and relaxing tea
70070000040833.intro: Run the best restaurant in the middle of the city, complete orders, learn new recipes, and improve your cooking skills.
70070000040833.name: Cooking Platinum Edition

70070000040851.description:
Choose your favorite skin, eat, grow and stay alive.
Compete in multiplayer mode with up to 4 players or eat it all by yourself.

ENDLESS PLUS IS HERE!
Take on a new version of Endless mode and play on all 16 maps included in this edition! Each map is filled with its own objects to swallow, so every run brings a different challenge. Finish a map in Endless Plus to unlock a themed skin as your reward!

Play through all 16 maps to collect 16 new skins: Minotaur, Farmer, Tech-Punk, Martian, College, Cowboy, Food Court Girl, Pirate Zombie, Magician, Policeman, T-Rex, Khepri, Gorilla, Navy, Agent and Komainu!

This edition features:
• 16 maps with different things to swallow
• 93 animated skins to make your black hole look cooler
• 2 multiplayer modes up to 4 players on one screen!
• Endless mode where you swallow things falling from the sky
• NEW Endless Plus! - play on all 16 maps, eat map-specific objects and unlock a themed skin for finishing each one
• Powerups spawning during the game
• Collecting themed stickers
• Easy controls so anyone can play
• Simple rules and lots of fun!

Grow by swallowing everything in front of you, whether it be garbage cans, fire hydrants or cars. Get large enough to consume even bigger objects or other players. Eat until nothing and no one is standing in your way!
70070000040851.intro: Show who is the biggest black hole in the entire universe!
70070000040851.name: Hole io: Complete Edition

70070000040878.description:
Play with beautiful varied illustrations, breathtaking photos and special video puzzles playing after completing a particular assembly.

NEW MODES ARE HERE!
Try two brand-new ways to play:
• Rotate - all pieces are already in the right places, but turned the wrong way. Rotate them by 90 degrees until the whole picture is correctly aligned.
• Swap - choose two misplaced pieces and swap their positions until every piece finds its correct place.

Features:
• 299 jigsaw puzzles in one bundle!
• Various themes: space, steampunk, ocean animals, dogs and cats, princesses, horses, landscapes and more
• 4 puzzle modes: Classic, Slide, Rotate and Swap
• Single and multiplayer mode (up to 2 players)
• Range of pieces number: 6, 15, 28, 40, 56, 60, 96, 150

Dive in, find your perfect difficulty, and let every completed puzzle become a small, satisfying work of art.
70070000040878.intro: Unwind in a casual jigsaw puzzle game with a variety of themes, pleasing graphics and adorable effects.
70070000040878.name: Puzzle Galaxy: Platinum Edition - 299 puzzles

70070000040904.description:
Welcome to The Smurfs: Colorful Stories, a place where your creativity and imagination lead to creating unique tales. Visit their village like you are one of them and experience amazing adventures - Smurfs can’t wait to meet you!


ALL CHARACTERS IN ONE PLACE
You don’t have to worry you will miss your favourite Smurfette or Grouchy Smurf. They all gathered here, so you can get to know each one of them, while they tell you their stories. Just relax and take a look at what they have prepared for you.


MULTIPLE TOOLS
In order to make every story personal, the game offers a lot of tools to choose from. You decide what color, brush size, or tool type to use. Try to mix different options to achieve a surprising effect.

This bundle includes the Personal Boards 1–12 DLCs.

KEY FEATURES:
- All your favourite blue creatures!
- 14 categories full of drawings
- Unlimited options for creating your personal story
- Cartoon type soundtrack
70070000040904.intro: Hop into the wonderful world of Smurfs and check what stories are waiting for you!
70070000040904.name: The Smurfs Ultimate Whiteboard Edition

70070000040909.description:
KEEP YOUR CAT EYES SHARP
Step into a cozy world of colorful rooms, adorable cats and little details waiting to fool your eyes. Compare rooms carefully and find everything that has changed. Objects may move, disappear, rotate, change color or hide somewhere you least expect!

TRUST YOUR MEOWMORY
Think you can remember every little detail? Study a room carefully, keep its layout in mind and then find what has changed without a side-by-side comparison. If things get tricky, use helpful boosters such as Highlight, Peek and Freeze to give yourself a little extra help.

CREATE YOUR PURR-FECT ROOM
