Take a break from puzzling and become an interior designer! Build your own cozy rooms from scratch, experiment with colors and fill them with furniture, decorations, plants, floors, walls and much more. Create retro listening corners, dreamy spaces made for catnaps or calm little retreats, then watch your cats wander around and make themselves at home.

TWO PLAYERS, TWICE THE PURR
Challenge a friend in local multiplayer and see who can spot the differences faster! Play together on one screen, put your observation skills to the test and turn every cozy room into a little friendly competition.

FEATURES:
• Spot the Difference - Compare 2 rooms and find objects that have moved, disappeared, rotated, changed color or been replaced
• Memory Rooms - Study a room carefully, remember every detail and then find what has changed
• Cozy Room Editor - Build and decorate your own cozy rooms from scratch!
• Over 960 Customization Items - Choose from furniture, decorations, plants, floors, walls and more to create your perfect cozy space!
• Local Multiplayer - Challenge a friend and see who can spot the differences faster
• Cute Kitties - Collect 5 adorable feline friends that wander around the room
• Custom Memory Challenges - Choose the number of differences, Time to Look, Time to Spot and Allowed Mistakes
• Helpful Boosters - Use Highlight, Peek and Freeze when you need a little help

More cats, more ways to decorate and plenty of little differences to cat-ch!
70070000040909.intro: More cats, more decor and even more cozy meow-ments!
70070000040909.name: Cozy Meowmory: Deluxe Edition

70070000040912.description:
[Digital Deluxe Edition]
This set includes the following items:
・Digital VISUAL COLLECTION
・Digital SOUNDTRACK
・Live footage from the "STEINS;GATE 15th LIVE - ONE WORLD -" event
・STEINS;GATE Octet of Shifting Space"

STEINS;GATE has become universally beloved from its inception back in 2009.
Since then, the series has sold more than 4 million units worldwide. STEINS;GATE is now being rebooted with major revamps and a completely new look.

Follow a ragtag group of tech-savvy students led by Rintaro Okabe, whose latest invention accidentally gains the ability to send messages to the past, unleashing the power to alter history itself. As global conspiracies stir and timelines begin to twist, the curtain rises on a future steeped in chaos. Your choices shape the fate of the characters and the world itself! Featuring multiple endings that branch based on your decisions.

Characters, backgrounds, and pivotal moments have all been updated from scratch. There are twice the amount of still images and 20% more background graphics compared to the original version.

Character designer huke returns with redesigned outfits and accessories that bring a contemporary flair to the cast while Akihabara has been recreated with stunning realism and depth, including new scenes.

Uses E-mote, which has been well-received in Anonymous;Code. Smooth animations and rich expressions breathe new life to beloved characters.

Series composer Takeshi Abo has remade the soundtrack, and the original voice actors have returned to re-record all in-game voices in Japanese.

Additional Route - Gamma Worldline
A new kind of brutality, unlike anything seen before, awaits both Rintaro Okabe and the player.
70070000040912.name: STEINS;GATE RE:BOOT Digital Deluxe Edition

70070000040913.description:
Enter the colorful world of Anime Codex Collection 4 in 1 — a collection of four relaxing puzzle games filled with beautiful anime-style artwork and captivating challenges.

Piece together stunning images of charming anime heroines and unlock new illustrations as you progress. Each puzzle offers a satisfying challenge, with difficulty gradually increasing as you advance through the collection.

Smooth and intuitive controls make every move feel natural, while a relaxing soundtrack creates the perfect atmosphere for solving puzzles at your own pace. Complete each image, unlock the next one, and enjoy your favorite artwork in full detail.

Features:

• 4 complete puzzle games in one collection.
• A large selection of stylish anime illustrations.
• Smooth and intuitive controls.
• Gradually increasing puzzle difficulty.
• Relaxing and atmospheric music.
• New images to unlock as you progress.
• Enjoy completed artwork in full detail.
70070000040913.intro: Relaxing puzzles with cute anime girls.
70070000040913.name: Anime Codex Collection 4 in 1

70070000040914.description:
Hentai House Collection 4 in 1 brings together four captivating puzzle games in one complete collection.

Dive into a world of stunning, realistic puzzles and discover a variety of beautiful women, unique scenes, and eye-catching artwork across four full games. Piece by piece, reveal breathtaking images and unlock new masterpieces as you progress through each collection.

With four games included, there’s even more to discover — more puzzles to complete, more images to unlock, and more relaxing challenges to enjoy. Smooth and intuitive controls make every move feel natural and satisfying, while gentle, soothing music creates the perfect atmosphere to unwind and focus.

Complete every puzzle, explore all four games, and build a gallery filled with your favorite images.

Relax, enjoy, and lose yourself in the details with Hentai House Collection 4 in 1.

Features:

• 4 complete puzzle games in one collection.
• A large variety of gorgeous, realistic artwork featuring beautiful women.
• Addictive and easy-to-play puzzle mechanics.
• Smooth and satisfying controls.
• Unlock new and even more stunning images as you progress.
• Plenty of puzzles and scenes to discover across all four games.
• Perfect balance of challenge and relaxation.
• Soothing soundtrack that enhances the relaxing atmosphere.
• Admire every completed image in full detail.
70070000040914.intro: Every piece brings you closer to perfection!
70070000040914.name: Hentai House Collection 4 in 1

70070000040916.description:
This edition includes:
・Base Game
・Rolling Live Highlights:
- 10 New Quests
- 12 Katamari BGM Tracks
- 6 new Cousins
- 18 costume items

Once upon a time a katamari rolled through both past and present.

In this story across time, the adage endures: Let The Good Times Roll!

Now onward through new worlds to roll up thy heart's desires and to restore the stars!

• A Shiny New Katamari Damacy Adventure Awaits
Experience new stages and a fabulous new soundtrack! Behold a fresh rolling experience, with never-before-seen support tools like the magnet to draw in nearby objects! How...attractive!

• Roll Through the Ages
The King was so well-behaved until he mistakenly crushed the Earth, the Moon, and numerous planets while fiddling with a peculiar scroll. Now roll your katamari through the Jurassic Era, Ice Age, historic Japan, and more eras to rebuild the sky's dazzling field of stars.

• Keep the Family Close With Cousin Customization
Play as The Prince, or choose among his 74 cousins and kin to play as. Customize their colors and faces to create as many original Cousin designs as there are stars in the sky.

• Compete in Celestial 4-Player KatamariBall
Conquer the game of KatamariBall, the galactic sport of choice across the Cosmos! Compete online against cousins around the world, or hone your skills with scintillating offline play against CPU opponents.

*A Standard Edition and Royal Sound Edition are also available separately. Please be careful not to purchase duplicate copies.
70070000040916.name: Once Upon a Katamari - Rolling Live Highlights Edition

70070000040917.description:
The Royal Sound Edition includes:
• Main Game
• Rolling Live Highlights
- 10 new Quests
- 12 BGM Tracks
- 6 new Cousins
- 18 new costume items
• Katamari Damacy Series Dance Dance Remixes
• Katamari Damacy Series Neo Remixes
• Katamari Damacy Series Songs: Side A
• Katamari Damacy Series Songs: Side B

Once upon a time a katamari rolled through both past and present.

In this story across time, the adage endures: Let The Good Times Roll!

Now onward through new worlds to roll up thy heart's desires and to restore the stars!

• Keep the Family Close With Cousin Customization

Conquer the game of KatamariBall, the galactic sport of choice across the Cosmos! Compete online against cousins around the world, or hone your skills with scintillating offline play against CPU opponents.

*The Standard and Rolling Live Highlights Editions are also available separately. Please be careful not to purchase duplicate copies.
*This product includes content that is planned to be sold separately.
70070000040917.name: Once Upon a Katamari - Royal Sound Edition

70070000040928.description:
Why don't we play a little game to jog your memory? Impress the girls, and they might show you a bit of their "personality" ;)

Match the cards within the time limit in this bra-dropping memory game. It gets harder the further you get... If you can do it in time, you'll see something your eyes will never forget.

Features:
- 8 beautiful girls with impressive proportions (clothes optional)
- Sensual music and sound effects
- Simple and engaging gameplay
- A treat for your eyes

Enjoy an unforgettable experience and make some ecchi memories.
70070000040928.intro: Let the bras hit the floor!
70070000040928.name: Ecchi Memories: Trixie Edition

70070000040940.description:
■ Demons Are Coming!

Face endless waves of demons in this roguelike action game. Traverse treacherous maps connecting challenging combat arenas. Discover powerful upgrades and combine weapon mods to take down deadly bosses in style. Fight on your own or grab a buddy in local co-op to banish the demons together!

■ Twins of the Sun

A mysterious clan has kidnapped the twins' little sister! Journey through jungles, haunted mines, and ancient temples on a desperate rescue mission!

Each stage is its own hazardous arena mixing combat and puzzle challenges. Collect upgrades, learn enemy behaviors and overcome dangers standing between you and your baby sister!

Choose your twin and master their unique playstyle alone or together in 2-player local co-op!
70070000040940.intro: Battle the forces of darkness in Co-Op survivor games Demons Are Coming! and Twins of the Sun!
70070000040940.name: Co-Op Survivors of the Dark Bundle

70070000040959.description:
The Deluxe Edition includes:
• Tales of Eternia Remastered
• Battle BGM Pack
• Digital Artbook & Soundtrack
• Super Growth Support Item Set

Experience Tales of Eternia, remastered for the first time ever.

• An Epic Journey with Two Worlds at Stake
Journey to Eternia, a world split into two isolated realms, Inferia and Celestia.
In the remote Inferian village of Rasheans, Reid Hershel and his childhood friend Farah Oersted meet a mysterious girl named Meredy. During their journey to discover Meredy's origins, the group discovers that a collision called the "Great Fall" threatens both Inferia and Celesita.
Harnessing the power of elemental spirits known as the Greater Craymels, Reid and his companions embark on an epic journey to save the two realms from catastrophe.

• Exhilarating Battle Action with Speed and Freedom
Featuring the Aggressive Linear Motion Battle System (A-LMBS), which enables diverse Arte usage, continued combos, and coordination with each unique party member.
Experience thrilling combat as you outmaneuver enemies and defeat them one after another with fast-paced, dynamic 2D battle action.

• The Same Moving Experience, Now Easier to Play
Gameplay is better than ever with the quality-of-life features that have been added, including destination markers, the ability to disable enemy encounters, and high-speed mode during auto-battle.
Additionally, graphics and SFX can be toggled between modes, allowing you to experience the nostalgic atmosphere of the original game.

*A Standard Edition is also available. Be careful of duplicate purchases.
70070000040959.name: Tales of Eternia Remastered Deluxe Edition

70070000040965.description:
Combining two sushi of the same type will merge them into a new type of sushi!
Keep on matching your sushi so that they don't pile up and overflow onto the counter!
A new high score is always just within reach!

Up to 4 players can battle together with a Joy-Con™ controller for each!
70070000040965.intro:
Aim your sushi and shoot!
Hit sushi of the same type to make them grow bigger and bigger!
70070000040965.name: SUSHI Shot + Deluxe Toppings & Skins Double Pack Set

70070000041036.description:
Mini Market Design is a creative sandbox game where you can design and decorate your very own mini market. With 8 unique store layouts, you have the freedom to create the perfect shopping experience—arrange shelves, add stylish displays, and choose decorations that suit your vision.


Explore around 510 different furniture and decor items, and set the mood with beautiful wallpapers and flooring. Enjoy 9 floor styles and 18 wallpaper patterns right from the start, and expand your options to 18 floor styles and 27 wallpaper patterns with DLC. Whether you’re new to design games or a decorating pro, Mini Market Design is your chance to let your creativity run free!

This bundle includes the Wallpapers DLC.

Features:
- 8 distinct mini market layouts to choose from.
- Around 510 furniture and decoration items.
- 9 flooring and 18 wallpaper patterns (18 floors and 27 wallpapers with DLC!).
- Design a welcoming space for your customers.
- Relaxing, creative gameplay for all ages.
- Ideal for fans of design and decorating games.
70070000041036.intro: Build your dream market and welcome your customers!
70070000041036.name: Mini Market Design Pattern Parade

70070000041049.description:
A third-person stealth adventure game focused on the story of Moonshadow Huntress Cynthia Stranborg. Take control of the young adept and learn new stealth skills during your journey. Find out what happened in her home village and follow your own path to rescue the ones you love the most. Travel through Tesana Valley to find a hidden fragment of an artifact to enhance your bow. The Dark Power is coming from the north. You need to destroy the source of this power before it's too late. You are the last one who can reach that destination. At the very least you have to try, for your loved ones!

Key features:
- Stylized and colorful world.
- Fully voiced emotional story.
- Stealth mechanics, arrow crafting, climbing sequences and light puzzle solving.
- A short story-driven game (to finish in one evening).
- Several alternative outfits to unlock throughout the game.
- A dedicated photo mode with multiple options to modify poses, camera effects, stickers, facial expressions, etc.
70070000041049.name: Cynthia: Hidden in the Moonshadow - Royal Edition

70070000041056.description:
Have you ever wanted to relive a cartridge-era adventure? Now's your chance! In Doki Monsters: Quest, you set out to find your missing childhood friend - teaming up with captured creatures, battling turn-by-turn, and pushing deeper into a dangerous open world. Grow stronger, unlock new routes, and face off against Rangers and shady corporations that disturb the peace.

Prefer comfort with your challenge? Modern touches keep the journey smooth: fast-forward battles, optional helper tips, and a quest log that keeps your goals crystal clear.

What the adventure offers:
- 140+ original monsters to collect, train, and evolve your strategy.
- About a 20 hour story spanning 15+ towns, plus caves, shrines, seas, and mountains.
- Turn-based battles against Rangers and corporations, with seamless overworld encounters.
- Rare-hunt post-game content and 7 alternate looks per monster (one ultra-rare!).
- Fast-forward battles, optional tips, and a clear quest log - you choose your way of playing!
- Side activities - everyone's favorite - FISHING!
- 4 save files available in case you would like to share your world with your friends!

Sharpen your strategy, build the ultimate team, and bring a friend home! Doki Monsters: Quest's amazing adventure awaits you!

This bundle also includes The Great Fairy Island DLC - a new 3-5 hour side story in which you face the Xer and their plot to capture powerful Fairy-type Doki Monsters.
70070000041056.intro: Catch creatures, choose your style, and conquer the quest to save your friend.
70070000041056.name: Doki Monsters Fairy Island Adventure

70070000041081.description:
Put your imagination to the test and go on a freaky rescue trip. Help rescue Salcy’s beloved cockapoo from unknown danger in which she was sure to find herself . In Freaky Trip you will encounter many logical puzzles, which you can find everywhere. Watch your surroundings carefully and use everything that might be helpful – even if it seems unusual.


(NON)OBVIOUS SOLUTIONS
In this game, puzzles are not as easy as they might look like – as everything around you. Think outside the box, be unpredictable, and succeed on every level, to be an egg forward. Remember that sometimes the most unbelievable answers are the right ones. Try all possibilities and ask for help if you are stuck at any point.


FREAKY CHARACTERS
Meet surprising characters on your journey with Salcy, but don’t even bother to think if they are real – they somehow are. Try to help them and they will return the favor. Hey, have you seen this big buffalo merchant behind the tree? No? That’s weird, I'm sure it was standing there…


CARTOON GRAPHICS
Falling into the world of Freaky Trip is much easier thanks to colorful and cartoon graphics. Progress through this twisted story and watch how the riddles surprise you and make you laugh with every second.

This bundle includes the Pool Pack DLC.

Key features:
- Humorous and totally absurd point-and-click adventure
- 14 various levels with a commonly uncommon story behind
- Entertaining characters and locations
- Exciting soundtrack
70070000041081.intro: Go through untypically typical places and solve totally absurd riddles on your rescue mission.
70070000041081.name: Freaky Trip Splash Zone

70070000041086.description:
Memory for Kids improves on the classic formula of memory games. It allows you to increase the difficulty level at your own pace and customize the challenges to your liking.

Our brains are the most important tools of the 21st century. Do your child a favor and give them a gift that will help them realize their full potential.

This bundle includes the Back Cards, Cards Pack 1, Cards Pack 2, Cards Pack 3, and Cards Pack 4 DLCs.

Key features:
- Improves memory
- Cute cards
- Adjustable difficulty level
- Relaxing music
- 20 card designs
- 18 difficulty levels
70070000041086.intro: Help your child harness the hidden potential of their mind. Use these colorful cards to improve their memory skills. Let them become masters of their own minds.
70070000041086.name: Memory For Kids Ultimate Edition

70070000041087.description:
Paint for Kids, the best app made especially for kids on Nintendo Switch™ will let you create both simple, ordinary, and professional paintings - from drawings of your favorite cartoon characters to landscapes.

Many possibilities for the creation

Use crayons, a brush, or spray paint. Paint and draw your beloved animals, Christmas cards, or portraits. Enjoy an extraordinary personal gallery of your masterpieces and delight your loved ones.

A magical experience

Drawing improves the ability to concentrate, develops eye-hand coordination, and contributes to the consolidation of a correct writing grip. With its total power, you will awaken your child's creativity and sensitivity to beauty.

This bundle includes the Additional Board 1, Additional Board 2, Additional Board 3, Additional Board 4, and Additional Board 5 DLCs.

Key features:
- Basic and versatile tools in different sizes
- Mixed colors with smooth gradients in between
- Tuned for Kids
- Unprecedented ease of use
70070000041087.intro: Awaken your child's imagination with Paint for Kids.
70070000041087.name: Paint For Kids Extended Edition

70070000041092.description:
Experience three distinct worlds of speed, precision, and high-stakes action. Take to the skies in intense aerial battles, push high-performance vehicles to their limits on challenging racing circuits, and pilot advanced delivery drones through a bustling city. Each experience challenges your reflexes, decision-making, and control as you pursue new goals and overcome increasingly demanding missions.

Bundle Includes:
1. Ace Thunder: Aircraft Wingman Simulator
Take control of powerful fighter jets and defend Earth against an alien invasion in intense aerial combat. Engage enemy fleets, perform advanced maneuvers, evade incoming attacks, and upgrade your aircraft’s speed, armor, and firepower to gain an advantage in demanding missions across diverse environments.

2. Auto Sport Racing Simulator
Get behind the wheel of high-performance vehicles and compete across diverse tracks with unique layouts and racing challenges. Customize your cars, upgrade engines, suspension, brakes, and boost systems, unlock new vehicles and tracks, and compete in multiple race types as you work your way toward becoming a champion.

3. DRONE DELIVERY - FPV SIMULATOR
Pilot advanced delivery drones through a vibrant city, transporting meals, packages, documents, electronics, and urgent medical supplies to their destinations. Master realistic FPV controls, navigate traffic and narrow passages, adapt to changing weather, and upgrade your drones to improve speed, durability, and battery life while expanding your delivery business.

Whether you are engaging enemy aircraft, chasing victory on the racetrack, or navigating busy city streets from the air, every challenge offers a new opportunity to sharpen your skills. Take control, push your limits, and prove your abilities across the skies, roads, and city routes.
70070000041092.intro: Take control of every vehicle and prove your skills across skies, tracks, and city routes.
70070000041092.name: Racing & Flight Simulator Triple Pack – Cars, Jets & Drones

70070000041102.description:
Immerse yourself in the world of Japanese car culture, where drifting, drag racing, and street racing come together in an enhanced driving experience. Build and customize your cars, master challenging tracks, explore different racing styles, and push your skills further as you chase the thrill of the streets.

What’s included:
1. Hashiriya Drifter-Car Racing,Drift,Drag REMASTER
Experience intense street racing, spectacular drifting, and thrilling drag races while customizing your cars with over 100 tuning parts and taking on challenging levels and tracks.

2. Hashiriya Drifter-Car Racing,Drift,Drag REMASTER: Road Success
Adds 100 Gems to your in-game balance, giving you additional resources to use throughout your racing journey.

Take to the streets, customize your ride, and keep chasing new racing achievements.
70070000041102.intro: Build your ride and dominate every challenge.
70070000041102.name: Hashiriya Drifter-Car Racing,Drift,Drag REMASTER: Street Legends

70070000041106.description:
This bundle includes the following main game and DLC.

"GROOVE COASTER FUTURE PERFORMERS"
■An Overwhelming Fusion of Music and Visuals
Groove Coaster is a rhythm game where you play along while racing down tracks that twist and turn to the music.

With dynamic sound and light effects, you’ll feel completely immersed—as if you’ve stepped into a world of music and are performing right inside it!

■Enhanced Visuals
For the first time in the series, the gameplay screen features a full horizontal layout, letting the world of music fill your entire view!

Visual expression has been greatly improved, and some songs even include scenes using the original music videos!

■Two Play Styles to Choose From
You can select from two different play styles to match your skill level!
Basic: Enjoy the game casually with four types of notes—perfect for beginners.
Advanced: Challenge yourself with nine types of notes—ideal for rhythm game veterans and fans of the classic series who want a deeper, more rewarding experience!

■Fully Voiced "Story Mode" Featuring a Star-Studded Cast
For the first time in the series, enjoy a luxurious, fully voiced Story Mode!

Centered around two protagonists, Sendou Kakeru and Himekawa Aria, a rich cast of characters—including classmates, teachers, and rivals from other schools—join the story.

The journey begins as they aim for victory in the "Groove Coaster" tournament, a futuristic sport where players perform while racing along the tracks...

Main Characters
- Sendou Kakeru(Voice: Kawashima Reiji/ Theme Song Artist: Somari)
- Himekawa Aria(Voice: Sakura Ayane/ Theme Song Artist: 40mP)

70070000041111.description:
Explore the open roads of a vast rural landscape while building, maintaining, and driving your own car. Assemble your vehicle piece by piece, manage essential resources, handle realistic mechanical challenges, and make smart decisions as you work to keep your journey moving.

What the bundle includes:
1. My Summer Drive (Base Game) – Build your car from the ground up, manage fuel and resources, maintain every component, and survive the challenges of life on the road.
2. My Summer Drive: New Ride (DLC) – Adds a new yellow car to your game, giving you another vehicle to drive and enjoy during your summer adventures.

Build your car, hit the road, and discover new possibilities on every journey.
70070000041111.intro: Master car mechanics and survive life on the road.
70070000041111.name: My Summer Drive: Road Life

70070000041119.description:
Take control of your own aviation business and build your path from a small cargo operation to a growing airline empire. Fly across diverse locations, manage your aircraft and hangars, complete cargo deliveries, and make important decisions as you expand your business.

This bundle includes:
• Flight Simulator Delivery: Cargo Business – Build and manage your own cargo airline, purchase and upgrade aircraft and hangars, explore airports around the world, and complete a variety of delivery missions. Handle changing weather conditions, fly during day and night, and develop your business as you work toward becoming an aviation tycoon.
• Money Grand DLC – Adds $200,000 to your in-game funds, giving you additional financial resources to invest in your aircraft, hangars, upgrades, and growing cargo business.

Expand your operations, strengthen your fleet, and take on new opportunities as you work toward building a successful aviation empire.
70070000041119.intro: Build your fleet and expand across the world.
70070000041119.name: Flight Simulator Delivery: Cargo Business – Flight Command

70070000041142.description:
Secrets lie beneath the covers... avoid enemies and uncover pictures of beautiful girls posing exclusively for you.

Discovering the truth is never easy... the more tempting the secrets, the greater the challenges you'll face. Unravel all the mysteries to uncover what the girls are hiding, and prepare yourself for plenty of alluring photos along the way.

Features:
- Over 62 pictures of beautiful girls in enticing outfits to reveal
- Sensual music and sound effects
- Simple and engaging gameplay
- Easy and difficult levels
- A treat for your eyes
70070000041142.intro: Find all the hidden secrets of tempting anime girls
70070000041142.name: Ecchi Secrets: Hot & Cold Edition

70070000041146.description:
DELICIOUS ADVENTURE
Cook For Love is a cozy cooking game where you’ll be in the shoes of Clement – a young Frenchman, who gets hired at a popular Parisian restaurant. With the help of a recipe book, you will be able to cook unique dishes of varying complexity and conquer the world’s taste buds!


FROM NOVICE TO MAESTRO
Clement starts his mentorship under Jean-Luc Chatillone – a culinary legend… currently onboard the Orient Express. Even though he’s away, Jean-Luc’s recipe book lands in Clement’s hands.

You will be cooking with various kitchen appliances and using many different ingredients. With over 40 available recipes you have your path laid out in front of you – now it’s time to roll up your sleeves and cook until you earn the title of a true chef.


RECIPES FOR JOYFUL LIFE
As you learn how to cook new dishes you also earn reputation points, which in turn level up your chef experience. New recipes will be unlocked on the way and they will get more complex (and more delicious) as you go.

After everything’s ready there will be a final test… will the critics grant you the Golden Spoon, young chef?

Cook For Love is a look into the past of Grandma Rose’s husband – Clement, before he met his wife on the Orient Express. While this is not a prequel to Tell Me Your Story, it’s a look at the youth of these two lovebirds from another perspective.

This bundle includes the Rhône-Alpes DLC.

HIGHLIGHTS:
- Over 40 various recipes to master…
- …and delicious pictures to look at.
- Cozy and stressless vibes.
- Learning how to make some of the most well-known recipes.
- Get to know Clement better long before he met Rose.
- Beautiful, hand-drawn art style with bright colors.
- English, Korean and Japanese subtitles and UI
70070000041146.intro: Win the hearts of Parisians with your cooking, discover delicious recipes, and become a chef worthy of working onboard the Orient Express.
70070000041146.name: Cook For Love Rhône-Alpes Pack

70070000041147.description:
Grab your equipment with you and begin your journey to become a master of nGolf. Explore beautiful and minimalist locations full of traps, puzzles, and amazing views.


FIND YOUR WAY
While playing nGolf you will face many challenges on your way. Lasers, spikes, flames and many more will try to stop your ball. Remember that timing is the key to success and you shouldn’t hurry with your hit. Go with the flow and master all worlds.


PLAN YOUR APPROACH
There is an unlimited number of possible solutions to finish levels. Different angles and strengths can change the trajectory of the ball diametrically. Check your surroundings for hills, teleports, or speed boosters. Each element gives you a new opportunity to hit the hole.


BECOME A GOLF MASTER
To become a professional, you have to collect all stars on each stage and accomplish the lowest amount of hits. Study the layout of the map, take as many attempts as you need and obtain the title of champion!

This bundle includes the Colorful Golf Balls 10 DLC.

KEY FEATURES:
- 8 unique worlds
- Over 60 levels to master
- Scorecards to help you track your progress
70070000041147.intro: Set off on the most engaging golf adventure you have ever seen and visit breathtaking places from around the world.
70070000041147.name: nGolf Snack Pitch Pack

70070000041152.description:
Take charge of your own zoo and transform a neglected park into a successful wildlife destination. Restore enclosures, care for exotic animals, improve visitor facilities, manage your staff, and make important decisions that shape the future of your zoo.

This bundle includes:
1. ZOO MANAGER SIMULATOR
Restore damaged enclosures, purchase and care for a variety of animals, improve visitor facilities, manage staff, and expand your zoo as you work toward creating a highly rated wildlife attraction.

2. ZOO MANAGER SIMULATOR: Park Growth
Adds $7,500 to your in-game balance, giving you additional funds to use for animal care, facility upgrades, repairs, and other zoo management needs.

Create better habitats, improve the visitor experience, and grow your zoo into a thriving destination filled with wildlife and opportunities.
70070000041152.intro: Restore your park, care for animals, and turn it into a popular attraction.
70070000041152.name: ZOO MANAGER SIMULATOR: Animal Kingdom

70070000041160.description:
Give yourself over to the ultimate relaxation! Clay&Cats will make you feel good in a way you didn't know you needed.

Your task is simple - assemble adorable, cat-themed pottery to its full glory. Put back together pawesome vases, purrfect plates, and kittiful bowls. Don't worry about the timers and sweating to pass the challenge - take all the time getting the pieces together and enjoy the satisfying way they click into the right places. Can't get cozier than that!

This bundle includes the Pot DLC.

KEY FEATURES:
- 9 categories with 14 levels of pure joy in each
- Lo-fi music providing good vibes for the hours of playing
- Satisfying gameplay that soothes your nervous system
- Tons of adorable, furry troublemakers to admire
70070000041160.intro: You'll forget about the rest of the world with the most satisfying hobby - repairing cute cat pots!
70070000041160.name: Clay&Cats Pot Pack

70070000041167.description:
Step into a vast and dangerous world where survival, exploration, and base-building come together. Gather valuable resources, construct and expand your shelter, manage your character’s needs, and face the challenges of a world filled with wild creatures and hidden possibilities.

- Full Game: Palland - Explore three distinct maps, gather essential materials, build and expand your bases, manage your health, hunger, and energy, and complete dynamic quests as you progress through the world of Palland.
- DLC: New Outfit - Adds a new color option for your character’s suit, giving you another way to customize your appearance while exploring and surviving.

Build your shelter, gather resources, face the dangers of the wild, and create your own path through the world of Palland.

70070000041171.description:
Step into a cozy world where fixing broken porcelain is full of surprises! In this fun puzzle game, you’ll put together teapots, cups, and plates—and sometimes, you’ll find a magical moving porcelain cat hidden inside!

This bundle includes the Autumn DLC.

Features:
- Fun Puzzle Gameplay: Fit pieces together to fix up broken porcelain items like teapots, cups, and plates.
- 126 Different Puzzles: Tons of unique pieces to restore, each with its own charm.
- Hidden Magical Cats: Sometimes a piece will surprise you with a cute, moving porcelain cat inside!
- Choose Your Challenge: Play at your own pace with three difficulty levels—from easy to tricky.
- Never the Same Puzzle: Each puzzle is different, so you’ll always get a fresh challenge every time you play.
- Replay for More Fun: After completing a level, replay it for a new twist!


Fix, discover, and enjoy the magic of cats—one puzzle at a time!

Build and manage your own waterpark with exciting slides, pools, food stands, and leisure areas. Keep your facilities clean and safe, satisfy your visitors, upgrade attractions, and grow your park into a thriving destination.

Expand your park, improve the visitor experience, and create a waterpark where every day brings new opportunities for fun and growth.

Imagine a cardboard box. Is it shaped to fit one to two fluffy felines? What about five? What about twenty?

Fit My Cat presents you with many cute kitties that all wish to sit where they deem fit. That being said, we're running out of space and we are seriously looking for a cat organizer. If you could spare a moment or two to make that happen we would be grateful.

Every single one of them is trained and well-equipped for some spatial management – pick them up and rotate them as you see fit.

Just so you're aware, some boxes might come with yarn balls or entire cathouses – but that will not prevent those spunky kitties from trying to get inside.

Test your skills and show the world that herding cats is where fun begins!

- Over 90 pawesome levels of cardboard boxes, ready to be filled with fluff
- Tons of purrfect cats of varying shapes, colors, and sizes

70070000041230.name: Fit My Cat Scenic Backdrop Edition

70070000041234.description:
Create, farm, and style your way to success in Cottonville!
Welcome to Cottonville – a cozy dress-up and farming sim where creativity blossoms and fashion takes root! Run your own sewing atelier, grow essential crops, and craft stylish outfits for a charming cast of characters.


A Fresh Start in Cottonville
After leaving the hustle of Friglight, you arrive in peaceful Cottonville to take over a small family sewing shop. Start fresh, grow your business, and build a new life—one stitch at a time.


Customize Your Character
Express yourself! Choose from 18 hair colors, 15 hairstyles, and a variety of eye shapes, mouths, lashes, eyebrows, and skin tones. Dress your character in a wide range of outfits that grow with your fashion journey.


From Farming to Fashion
Cultivate cotton, linen, and bamboo—then harvest natural dyes from flowers to create fabrics in 7 vibrant colors. Craft materials, unlock new sewing patterns, and design custom outfits that reflect your unique style.


Run Your Atelier
Take charge of your boutique with over 60 sewing patterns and 120+ total clothing variations. Listen to customer requests, mix and match fabrics, and tailor outfits that reflect their personalities—from winter sweaters to breezy summer styles.

This bundle includes the Azure Room DLC.

Features:
- 60+ sewing patterns with multiple color variants (120+ total!)
- 3 farmable crops and 7 dye colors to craft your own fabrics
- Fully customizable character with a wide selection of features
- A charming story about starting over and finding creativity in a cozy town
- Unique customers and outfit requests that evolve with your boutique
- Dive into 60+ hours of fashion-filled farming and storytelling!


Grow crops, craft clothes, and chase your fashion dreams—Cottonville awaits you!

70070000041234.name: Cottonville Sunny Azure Edition

70070000041237.description:
My Cozy Room is a relaxing sandbox game where you can design and decorate your very own spaces. Choose from 11 different room shapes and sizes to create unique spaces—your dream bedroom, a cozy living room, a stylish kitchen, or even a playful kids' room.


With over 500 furniture pieces and decorations, plus more than 30 wallpaper and flooring patterns, you’ll have everything you need to craft the perfect look. Whether you're a kid or just love makeover and sandbox games, My Cozy Room is the ideal place to unleash your creativity and have fun!

This bundle includes various My Cozy Room DLCs, featuring wallpaper collections, floor designs, themed decoration packs, and additional room customization content.

This bundle includes the Halloween, Cottagecore, and Mediterranean DLCs.

Features:
- 11 unique room shapes and sizes to choose from.
- Over 500 furniture and decoration items to explore.
- 30+ wallpaper and flooring patterns for a personal touch.
- Design spaces like bedrooms, kitchens, bathrooms, and more.
- Perfect for kids and fans of makeover and sandbox games.

Start decorating your cozy dream room today!

Take control of a growing construction company and tackle a wide range of projects across the city and beyond. Operate specialized machinery, transport materials, clear construction sites, build roads, and complete demanding contracts as you develop your business.

Construction Sim: City and Road Builder
Build and manage your construction company, purchase and operate specialized machinery, complete contracts, transport materials, and take on projects ranging from roadwork to major infrastructure.

Take it across muddy forests, sandy terrain, and snowy mountains as you complete deliveries, tackle side missions, and explore challenging routes.

Take on demanding routes, explore diverse environments, and build your skills across a world where every journey brings a new challenge.

Transform empty rooms into warm, cozy spaces in Cozy Home Unpacking - a relaxing organization and decoration simulator where every box hides a new story. Unpack furniture, arrange everyday belongings, organize charming details, and turn simple spaces into beautiful homes filled with comfort and personality.

Take your time as you decorate bedrooms, kitchens, living rooms, and cozy corners exactly the way you want. Place books, plants, posters, kitchenware, toys, and dozens of everyday objects while enjoying a calm atmosphere and satisfying gameplay. With soft visuals, relaxing vibes, and stress-free gameplay, every room offers a peaceful opportunity to create something unique.

This bundle includes the base game Cozy Home Unpacking  along with two DLCs, adding 20 new rooms to the existing selection of in-game levels. Discover fresh layouts, unpack new spaces, organize every corner, and bring each room to life as you continue your relaxing home decoration journey.

Step into a vast wilderness filled with diverse landscapes, challenging hunts, and unpredictable wildlife. Track animals through forests, mountains, lakes, and open plains, customize your equipment, and develop your hunting skills as you take on new adventures.

This bundle includes:
1. Hunter Simulator: Wild Hunting (Base Game)
Explore expansive environments, track diverse wildlife, and experience realistic hunting with advanced animal AI and dynamic weather. Customize your weapons, scopes, camouflage, and equipment as you progress and take on increasingly challenging hunts.

2. Hunter Simulator: Wild Hunting – Weapon Upgrade (DLC)
Adds the Regmintona 070 shotgun to your arsenal for free, giving you a powerful weapon for close-range encounters with wild game. If the Regmintona 070 is already unlocked, you will receive its full in-game value as compensation.

3. Hunter Simulator: Wild Hunting – Extra Capital (DLC)
Adds 1,000 in-game coins to your balance, giving you additional funds to spend on hunting gear, upgrades, and equipment throughout your adventure.

Explore new territories, prepare your equipment, and take on the wilderness with everything you need for your next hunt.

Step into the role of a firefighter and face intense emergency situations across a city filled with dangerous fires and rescue missions. Drive through urban streets, save civilians, use specialized firefighting tools, and complete challenging missions as you build your firefighting career.

Choose from six firefighter characters, complete missions, unlock new vehicles, and use specialized equipment to handle different rescue situations.

Explore deeper, stay prepared, and continue the hunt with greater endurance as you face the mysteries of the wilderness.

70070000041417.description:
Set out across the open sea and build your career as an independent fisherman. Navigate changing waters, search for valuable catches, manage your resources, and develop your operations as you work toward commanding a successful fishing fleet.

This edition includes:
1. SHIP SIMULATOR OCEAN FISHING (Base Game)
Start with an old boat and explore coastal waters in search of fish, crabs, and rare seafood. Sell your catches at different ports, manage fuel and ship handling, improve your equipment, and expand your fleet as your fishing business grows.

2. SHIP SIMULATOR OCEAN FISHING: Sea Fortune (DLC)
Adds 10,000 coins to your account, giving you additional funds to support your fishing operations, improve your progress, and prepare for new voyages across the ocean.

Take on changing weather, discover valuable fishing grounds, and grow from a small independent fisherman into an experienced captain with a thriving maritime business.
70070000041417.intro: Explore the open ocean, build your fishing business, and chase new opportunities.
